terms.definition: Reduced ability to turn the eyes inward in order to focus on a nearby object.

terms.name: Dacryocystitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the nasolacrimal sac.

terms.name: Entropion
terms.definition: An abnormal inversion (turning inward) of the eyelid (usually the lower) towards the globe. Entropion is usually acquired as a result of involutional or cicatricial processes but may occasionally be congenital.

terms.name: Blurred vision
terms.definition: Lack of sharpness of vision resulting in the inability to see fine detail.

terms.name: Supranuclear ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: A vertical gaze palsy with inability to direct the gaze of the eyes downwards.

terms.name: Eyelid coloboma
synonyms: Full thickness defect of the eyelid
terms.definition: A short discontinuity of the margin of the lower or upper eyelid.

terms.name: Posterior embryotoxon
terms.definition: A posterior embryotoxon is the presence of a prominent and anteriorly displaced line of Schwalbe.

terms.name: Periorbital fullness
terms.definition: Increase in periorbital soft tissue.

terms.name: Abnormal retinal arterial/arteriolar morphology
terms.name_zh: 视网膜动脉/小动脉形态异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal structure of the retinal artery or arterioles.

terms.name: Retinal arterial tortuosity
terms.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the retinal artery.

terms.name: Lacrimation abnormality
terms.definition: Abnormality of tear production.

terms.name: Decreased lacrimation
terms.definition: Abnormally decreased lacrimation, that is, reduced tear production.

terms.name: Impaired ocular abduction
terms.definition: An impaired ability of the eye to move in the outward direction (towards the side of the head).

terms.name: Blue irides
terms.definition: A markedly blue coloration of the iris.

terms.name: Upper eyelid coloboma
synonyms: Full thickness defect of the upper eyelid
terms.definition: A short discontinuity of the margin of the upper eyelid.

terms.name: Long palpebral fissure
terms.definition: Distance between medial and lateral canthi is more than two standard deviations above the mean for age (objective); or, apparently increased length of the palpebral fissures.

terms.name: Nystagmus
terms.definition: Rhythmic, involuntary oscillations of one or both eyes related to abnormality in fixation, conjugate gaze, or vestibular mechanisms.

terms.name: Gaze-evoked nystagmus
terms.definition: Nystagmus made apparent by looking to the right or to the left.

terms.name: Dysmetric saccades
terms.definition: The controller signal for saccadic eye movements has two components: the pulse that moves the eye rapidly from one point to the next, and the step that holds the eye in the new position. When both the pulse and the step are not the correct size, a dysmetric refixation eye movement results.

terms.name: Red-green dyschromatopsia
terms.definition: Difficulty with discriminating red and green hues.

terms.name: Blepharospasm
terms.definition: A focal dystonia that affects the muscles of the eyelids and brow, associated with involuntary recurrent spasm of both eyelids.

terms.name: Amblyopia
terms.definition: Reduced visual acuity that is uncorrectable by lenses in the absence of detectable anatomic defects in the eye or visual pathways.

terms.name: Sclerocornea
synonyms: Hardening of skin and connective tissue
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly in which a part or the whole of the cornea acquires the characteristics of sclera, resulting in clouding of the cornea.

terms.name: Optic atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the optic nerve. Optic atrophy results from the death of the retinal ganglion cell axons that comprise the optic nerve and manifesting as a pale optic nerve on fundoscopy.

terms.name: Abnormality of visual evoked potentials
terms.definition: An anomaly of visually evoked potentials (VEP), which are electrical potentials, initiated by brief visual stimuli, which are recorded from the scalp overlying the visual cortex.

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 图形翻转视觉诱发电位振幅异常

terms.name: Diplopia
terms.definition: Diplopia is a condition in which a single object is perceived as two images, it is also known as double vision.

terms.name: Lower eyelid coloboma
synonyms: Full thickness defect of the lower eyelid
terms.definition: A short discontinuity of the margin of the lower eyelid.

terms.name: Sparse eyelashes
terms.definition: Decreased density/number of eyelashes.

terms.name: Decreased light- and dark-adapted electroretinogram amplitude
terms.name_zh: 明适应及暗适应视网膜电图振幅降低
synonyms: Decreased amplitudes on flash visual electroretinogram
terms.definition: Decreased amplitude of eletrical response upon electroretinography.

terms.name: Ectropion
terms.definition: An outward turning (eversion) or rotation of the eyelid margin.

terms.name: Oculomotor apraxia
synonyms: Defective or absent horizontal voluntary eye movements
terms.definition: Ocular motor apraxia is a deficiency in voluntary, horizontal, lateral, fast eye movements (saccades) with retention of slow pursuit movements. The inability to follow objects visually is often compensated by head movements. There may be decreased smooth pursuit, and cancelation of the vestibulo-ocular reflex.

terms.name: Peters anomaly
terms.definition: A form of anterior segment dysgenesis in which abnormal cleavage of the anterior chamber occurs. Peters anomaly is characterized by central, paracentral, or complete corneal opacity.

terms.name: Lipemia retinalis
terms.definition: A creamy appearance of the retinal blood vessels that occurs when the concentration of lipids in the blood is extremely increased, with pale pink to milky white retinal vessels and altered pale reflexes from choroidal vasculature.

terms.name: Nyctalopia
terms.definition: Inability to see well at night or in poor light.

terms.name: Synophrys
terms.definition: Meeting of the medial eyebrows in the midline.

terms.name: Horizontal nystagmus
terms.definition: Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements.

terms.name: Phthisis bulbi
terms.definition: Atrophy of the eyeball with blindness and decreased intraocular pressure due to end-stage intraocular disease.

terms.name: Hypodontia
synonyms: Failure of development of between one and six teeth
Missing between one and six teeth
terms.definition: The absence of five or less teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop.

terms.name: Carious teeth
terms.definition: Caries is a multifactorial bacterial infection affecting the structure of the tooth. This term has been used to describe the presence of more than expected dental caries.

terms.name: Anodontia
synonyms: Failure of development of all teeth
terms.definition: The absence of all teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop.

terms.name: Macrodontia of permanent maxillary central incisor
terms.name_zh: 恒牙上颌中切牙巨牙症
synonyms: Increased width of permanent maxillary central incisor
Increased width of permanent upper central incisor
terms.definition: Increased size of the maxillary central secondary incisor tooth.

terms.name: Abnormality of the incisor
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Incisor tooth.

terms.name: Oligodontia
synonyms: Failure of development of more than six teeth
Number of teeth decreased by more than six
terms.definition: The absence of six or more teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop.

terms.name: Dental crowding
terms.definition: Changes in alignment of teeth in the dental arch

terms.name: Taurodontia
terms.definition: Increased volume of dental pulp of permanent molar characterized by a crown body-root ratio equal or larger than 1:1 or an elongated pulp chambers and apical displacement of the bifurcation or trifurcation of the roots.

terms.name: Delayed eruption of primary teeth
terms.definition: Delayed tooth eruption affecting the primary dentition.

terms.name: Abnormal dental enamel morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the dental enamel.

terms.name: Grayish enamel
terms.definition: A gray discoloration of the dental enamel.

terms.name: Delayed eruption of teeth
terms.definition: Delayed tooth eruption, which can be defined as tooth eruption more than 2 SD beyond the mean eruption age.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of teeth
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of teeth.

terms.name: Widely spaced teeth
terms.definition: Increased spaces (diastemata) between most of the teeth in the same dental arch.

terms.name: Dental malocclusion
synonyms: Incorrect relation between upper and lower dental arches
Malalignment of upper and lower dental arches
Misalignment of upper and lower dental arches
terms.definition: Dental malocclusion refers to an abnormality of the occlusion, or alignment, of the teeth and the way the upper and lower teeth fit together, resulting in overcrowding of teeth or in abnormal bite patterns.

terms.name: Agenesis of maxillary lateral incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of maxillary lateral incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of one or more maxillary lateral incisor, comprising the maxillary lateral primary incisor and maxillary lateral secondary incisor.

terms.name: Microdontia
terms.definition: Decreased size of the teeth, which can be defined as a mesiodistal tooth diameter (width) more than 2 SD below mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased maximum width of tooth.

terms.name: Tooth malposition
terms.definition: Abnormal alignment, positioning, or spacing of the teeth, i.e., misaligned teeth.

terms.name: Odontodysplasia
synonyms: Teeth with thin dentin and large pulp chambers
Teeth with type iii dentinogenesis imperfecta
terms.definition: The diagnosis odontodysplasia requires clinical and radiological exams, in which unusually large pulp chambers and large pulp room chambers with thin enamel and dentin are visible. It may affect either a single tooth or several teeth. The term regional odontodysplasia is used if several teeth are affected. It affects the deciduous and permanent dentitions in the maxilla, the mandible or both, although the maxilla is more frequently involved. A type of dental dysplasia occurring in dentinogenesis imperfecta in which the pulp chambers are enlarged and there is a reduced amount of coronal dentin.

terms.name: Natal tooth
terms.definition: A tooth present at birth or erupting within the first month of life.

terms.name: Delayed eruption of permanent teeth
terms.definition: Delayed tooth eruption affecting the secondary dentition.

terms.name: Conical tooth
terms.definition: An abnormal conical form of the teeth, that is, a tooth whose sides converge or taper together incisally.

terms.name: Diastema
terms.definition: Increased space between two adjacent teeth in the same dental arch.

terms.name: Periapical bone loss
synonyms: Dark spot around tooth root on x-ray
terms.definition: Radiolucency (reflecting a reduction in the bony substance) around the apex (the tip of the dental root).

terms.name: Dentinogenesis imperfecta
terms.definition: Developmental dysplasia of dentin.

terms.name: Periodontitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the periodontium.

terms.name: Amelogenesis imperfecta
terms.definition: A developmental dysplasia of the dental enamel.

terms.name: Eruption failure
terms.definition: A tooth which does not erupt within the teeth eruption timeline and after the loss of eruption potential.

terms.name: Abnormality of the nervous system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the nervous system.

terms.name: Atypical behavior
terms.definition: Atypical behavior is an abnormality in a person's actions that can be controlled or modulated by the will of the individual. While abnormal behaviors can be difficult to control, they are distinct from other abnormal actions that cannot be affected by the individual's will.

terms.name: Psychosis
terms.definition: A condition characterized by changes in personality and thought patterns, often accompanied by hallucinations and delusional beliefs, is known as psychosis.

terms.name: Hyperorality
terms.definition: Hyperorality is a condition characterized by an excessive preoccupation with oral sensations and behaviors, such as chewing, sucking, biting, swallowing, and excessive mouthing of objects.

terms.name: Restlessness
terms.definition: A state of unease is characterized by diffuse motor activity or motion, which is subject to limited control, nonproductive, or disorganized behavior.

terms.name: Emotional lability
terms.definition: Unstable emotional experiences and frequent mood changes; emotions that are easily aroused, intense, and/or disproportionate to events and circumstances.

terms.name: Agitation
terms.definition: A state of excessive motor activity that is associated with mental distress or a feeling of substantial unease or inner tension. Distinguished from restlessness by the increased level of emotional distress and negative intensity of the experience. Agitation has a significant level of physical activity that is typically threatening to the self or others.

terms.name: Depression
terms.definition: Frequently experiencing feelings of being down, miserable, and/or hopeless; struggling to recover from these moods; having a pessimistic outlook on the future; feeling a pervasive sense of shame; having a low self-worth; experiencing thoughts of suicide and engaging in suicidal behavior.

terms.name: Autism
terms.definition: Autism is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by impaired social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior. Autism begins in childhood. It is marked by the presence of markedly abnormal or impaired development in social interaction and communication and a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest. Manifestations of the disorder vary greatly depending on the developmental level and chronological age of the individual (DSM-IV).

terms.name: Aggressive behavior
terms.definition: Behavior or an act aimed at harming a person, animal, or physical property (e.g., acts of physical violence; shouting, swearing, and using harsh language; slashing someone's tires).

terms.name: Inappropriate behavior
terms.definition: An explicit or perceived action, demonstration, conduct, or language (verbal and written) that is contrary to generally accepted norms, rules, procedures, or unacceptable within the context in which it is carried out. Inappropriate behaviors could take place in a sexual or social context and could be aggressive, violent, impulsive, intimidating, or threatening in nature.

terms.name: Compulsive behaviors
terms.definition: Behavior that consists of repetitive acts, characterized by the feeling that one \

terms.name: Restrictive behavior
terms.definition: Behavior characterized by an abnormal limitation to a few interests and activities.

terms.name: Psychotic episodes
terms.definition: Periods of time during which an individual experiences significant disturbances in their thoughts, perceptions, emotions, and behavior, resulting in a loss of touch with reality. These episodes are hallmark features of psychotic disorders such as schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, and certain forms of bipolar disorder.

terms.name: Dementia
terms.definition: A loss of global cognitive ability of sufficient amount to interfere with normal social or occupational function. Dementia represents a loss of previously present cognitive abilities, generally in adults, and can affect memory, thinking, language, judgment, and behavior.

terms.name: Reduced ability to form peer relationships
synonyms: Impaired ability to form peer relationships
terms.definition: Difficulty to establish relations with others in a comparable social group (peers) that may be manifested in pehnomena such as not being able to initiative a conversation, understand social cues, or to discuss shared interests. This feature is associated with poor integration within a community or group.

terms.name: Autistic behavior
terms.definition: Persistent deficits in social interaction and communication and interaction as well as a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest as well as repetitive patterns of behavior.

terms.name: Inflexible adherence to routines
terms.definition: A need to strictly adhere to repetitive routines or patterns of behavior which are created by the environment. One becomes upset or distressed when their routines are disrupted or altered.

terms.name: Motor stereotypy
terms.definition: Use of the same abnormal action in response to certain triggers or at random. They may be used as a way to regulate one's internal state but must otherwise have no apparent functional purpose.

terms.name: Disinhibition
terms.definition: Reduced ability to control, or a failure to resist a temptation, urge, or impulse. Examples include disregard for social conventions, general impulsivity, and poor risk assessment.

terms.name: Short attention span
terms.definition: Reduced attention span characterized by distractibility and impulsivity.

terms.name: Irritability
terms.definition: An emotional state characterized by negative feelings of heightened frustration, annoyance, or feeling upset, often triggered by internal factors (e.g., fatigue, hunger, unfulfilled desires) or external factors (e.g., social or environmental challenges). Irritability may be unpredictable, and is accompanied by a lowered threshold for emotional reactivity and observable features (speech, facial expressions, or psychomotor activity).

terms.name: Hallucinations
terms.definition: Perceptions in a conscious and awake state that, in the absence of external stimuli, have qualities of real perception. These perceptions are vivid, substantial, and located in external objective space.

terms.name: Anxiety
terms.definition: Intense feelings of nervousness, tension, or panic often arise in response to interpersonal stresses. There is worry about the negative effects of past unpleasant experiences and future negative possibilities. Individuals may feel fearful, apprehensive, or threatened by uncertainty, and they may also have fears of falling apart or losing control.

terms.name: Episodic paroxysmal anxiety
terms.definition: Recurrent attacks of severe anxiety, which occur without restriction to any particular situation or set of circumstances, are therefore unpredictable.

terms.name: Apathy
synonyms: Lack of feeling, emotion, interest, motivation, initiation
terms.definition: Apathy is a quantitative reduction of interest, motivation and the initiation and persistence of goal-directed behavior, where often the accompanying emotions, thoughts, and social interactions are also diminished. The individual is typically non-reactive to provocations, positive or negative, and appears to not care. Distinguished from lethargy which involves lack of physical or mental energy.

terms.name: Self-mutilation
terms.definition: Deliberate harm to one's body resulting in tissue damage, without a conscious intent to die.

terms.name: Frontal release signs
terms.definition: Primitive reflexes traditionally held to be a sign of disorders that affect the frontal lobes.

terms.name: Low frustration tolerance
terms.definition: The feeling of frustration can be defined as an emotional reaction that occurs when a desired goal is not achieved. Frustration intolerance is defined as an age-inappropriate response to frustration, characterized by crying or temper tantrums in children, or aggressive or other maladaptive behaviors.

terms.name: Abnormal diminished volition
terms.definition: A reduction in willful and motivated goal-directed behavior that is considered the determinant of behavior and adaptation that allows individuals to get started, be energized to perform a sustained and directed action.

terms.name: Delusion
terms.definition: A delusion is a fixed false belief held despite evidence to the contrary. The term delusion broadly encompasses all false judgments that possess the following external characteristics to a significant, albeit unspecified, extent: (1) they are held with an exceptional level of conviction, accompanied by an unparalleled subjective certainty; (2) there is an inability to consider alternative experiences or compelling counter-arguments; (3) the content of the belief is impossible.

terms.name: Inappropriate laughter
terms.definition: Laughing that may be excessive and/or inappropriate in context (e.g., laughing at a funeral while others are crying).

terms.name: Delayed speech and language development
terms.definition: A degree of language development that is significantly below the norm for a child of a specified age.

terms.name: Personality changes
terms.definition: An abnormal shift in patterns of thinking, acting, or feeling.

terms.name: Hyperactivity
terms.definition: Hyperactivity is a condition characterized by constant and unusually high levels of activity, even in situations where it is deemed inappropriate.

terms.name: Agoraphobia
terms.definition: A type of anxiety disorder characterized by the avoidance of public places, especially where crowds gather.

terms.name: Lack of insight
terms.definition: Lack of insight (Anosognosia) is a neurological condition in which an individual is unaware of his or her own neurological deficit or psychiatric condition. Anosognosia can be associated with mental illness, dementia, and structural brain lesions and can affect an individual's conscious awareness of deficits involving judgment, emotions, memory, executive function, language skills, and motor ability.

terms.name: Abnormal nonverbal communicative behavior
terms.definition: Abnormalities in eye contact, communicative facial expressions, gesture use, or the use of others' bodies to communicate convey shared meanings within a culture that replace or supplement verbal communication.

terms.name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system morphology
terms.name_zh: 周围神经系统形态异常
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the peripheral nervous system, which is composed of the nerves that lead to or branch off from the central nervous system. This includes the cranial nerves (olfactory and optic nerves are technically part of the central nervous system).

terms.name: Decreased nerve conduction velocity
terms.definition: A reduction in the speed at which electrical signals propagate along the axon of a neuron.

terms.name: Sensory neuropathy
synonyms: Damage to nerves that sense feeling
terms.definition: Peripheral neuropathy affecting the sensory nerves.

terms.name: Peripheral axonal degeneration
terms.definition: Progressive deterioration of peripheral axons.

terms.name: Abnormal thorax morphology
synonyms: Structural abnormality of the chest wall
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the thorax (the region of the body formed by the sternum, the thoracic vertebrae and the ribs).

terms.name: Abnormal sternum morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the sternum, also known as the breastbone.

terms.name: Pectus excavatum
terms.definition: A defect of the chest wall characterized by a depression of the sternum, giving the chest (\

terms.name: Pectus carinatum
terms.definition: A deformity of the chest caused by overgrowth of the ribs and characterized by protrusion of the sternum.

terms.name: Abnormality of the breast
terms.definition: An abnormality of the breast.

terms.name: Gynecomastia
terms.definition: Abnormal development of large mammary glands in males resulting in breast enlargement.

terms.name: Abnormal rib morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the rib.

terms.name: Short ribs
terms.definition: Reduced rib length.

terms.name: Narrow chest
terms.definition: Reduced width of the chest from side to side, associated with a reduced distance from the sternal notch to the tip of the shoulder.

terms.name: Abnormality of the diaphragm
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the diaphragm, the sheet of skeletal muscle that separates the thoracic cavity from the abdominal cavity.

terms.name: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia
terms.definition: The presence of a hernia of the diaphragm present at birth.

terms.name: Abnormal thymus morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the thymus, an organ located in the upper anterior portion of the chest cavity just behind the sternum and whose main function is to provide an environment for T lymphocyte maturation.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the thymus
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the thymus.

terms.name: Abnormal scapula morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the scapula, also known as the shoulder blade.

terms.name: Kidney stone
terms.definition: Kidney stones (calculi) are mineral concretions in the renal calyces and pelvis that are found free or attached to the renal papillae.

terms.name: Hematuria
terms.definition: The presence of blood in the urine. Hematuria may be gross hematuria (visible to the naked eye) or microscopic hematuria (detected by dipstick or microscopic examination of the urine).

terms.name: Uric acid nephrolithiasis
terms.definition: The presence of uric acid-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

terms.name: Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
terms.definition: A type of glomerulonephritis characterized by diffuse mesangial cell proliferation and the thickening of capillary walls due to subendothelial extension of the mesangium. The term membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis is often employed to denote a general pattern of glomerular injury seen in a variety of disease processes that share a common pathogenetic mechanism, rather than to describe a single disease entity

terms.name: IgA deposition in the glomerulus
terms.definition: The presence of immunoglobulin A deposits in the glomerulus.

terms.name: Abnormality of the urethra
terms.definition: An abnormality of the urethra, i.e., of the tube which connects the urinary bladder to the outside of the body.

terms.name: Urethral obstruction
terms.definition: Obstruction of the flow of urine through the urethra.

terms.name: Oligozoospermia
terms.definition: Reduced count of spermatozoa in the semen, defined as a sperm count below 20 million per milliliter semen.

terms.name: Renal steatosis
terms.definition: Abnormal fat accumulation in the kidneys.

terms.name: Impotence
terms.definition: Inability to develop or maintain an erection of the penis.

terms.name: Renal cortical cysts
terms.definition: Cysts of the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Xanthine nephrolithiasis
terms.definition: The presence of xanthine-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

terms.name: Enuresis
terms.definition: Lack of the ability to control the urinary bladder leading to involuntary urination at an age where control of the bladder should already be possible.

terms.name: Glanular hypospadias
terms.definition: A type of hypospadias in which the urethral meatus is located at the head of the penis, but not all the way at the tip.

terms.name: Penoscrotal hypospadias
terms.definition: A severe form of hypospadias in which the urethral opening is located at the junction of the penis and scrotum.

terms.name: Urinary tract atresia
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the normal opening of a structure of the urinary tract.

terms.name: Abnormal external genitalia morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the external genitalia.

terms.name: Abnormal internal genitalia
terms.definition: An anomaly of the adnexa, uterus, and vagina (in female) or seminal tract and prostate (in male).

terms.name: Bicornuate uterus
terms.definition: The presence of a bicornuate uterus.

terms.name: Hypergonadotropic hypogonadism
terms.name_zh: 高促性腺激素性性腺功能减退症
terms.definition: Reduced function of the gonads (testes in males or ovaries in females) associated with excess pituitary gonadotropin secretion and resulting in delayed sexual development and growth delay.

terms.name: Abnormality of Krebs cycle metabolism
terms.definition: An abnormality of the tricarboxylic acid cycle.

terms.name: Reduced eye contact
terms.definition: A reduced frequency or duration of eye contact.

terms.name: Abnormality of the endocrine system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the endocrine system.

terms.name: Diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: A group of abnormalities characterized by hyperglycemia and glucose intolerance.

terms.name: Abnormality of the thyroid gland
terms.definition: An abnormality of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Hypothyroidism
terms.definition: Deficiency of thyroid hormone.

terms.name: Hypertension
terms.definition: The presence of chronic increased pressure in the systemic arterial system.

terms.name: Delayed puberty
terms.definition: Passing the age when puberty normally occurs with no physical or hormonal signs of the onset of puberty.

terms.name: Decreased response to growth hormone stimulation test
terms.name_zh: 生长激素刺激试验反应降低
terms.definition: Insufficient responses to growth hormone (GH) provocation tests. GH deficiency is defined as a serum peak GH concentration less than 10 ng/mL on provocation with a combination of at least two separate stimulation tests.

terms.name: Hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of insulin combined with a decreased concentration of glucose in the blood.

terms.name: Precocious puberty
terms.definition: The onset of secondary sexual characteristics before a normal age. Although it is difficult to define normal age ranges because of the marked variation with which puberty begins in normal children, precocious puberty can be defined as the onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls or 9 years in boys.

terms.name: Abnormality of the parathyroid gland
terms.definition: An abnormality of the parathyroid gland.

terms.name: Hypoparathyroidism
terms.definition: A condition caused by a deficiency of parathyroid hormone characterized by hypocalcemia and hyperphosphatemia.

terms.name: Anterior hypopituitarism
terms.definition: A condition of reduced function of the anterior pituitary gland characterized by decreased secretion of one or more of the pituitary hormones growth hormone, thyroid-stimulating hormone, adrenocorticotropic hormone, prolactin, luteinizing hormone, and follicle-stimulating hormone.

terms.name: Insulin-resistant diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: A type of diabetes mellitus related not to lack of insulin but rather to lack of response to insulin on the part of the target tissues of insulin such as muscle, fat, and liver cells. This type of diabetes is typically associated with increases both in blood glucose concentrations as well as in fasting and postprandial serum insulin levels.

terms.name: Primary hypothyroidism
terms.definition: A type of hypothyroidism that results from a defect in the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Abnormality of the adrenal glands
terms.definition: Abnormality of the adrenal glands, i.e., of the endocrine glands located at the top of the kindneys.

terms.name: Adrenal hypoplasia
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the adrenal glands.

terms.name: Hyperthyroidism
terms.definition: An abnormality of thyroid physiology characterized by excessive secretion of the thyroid hormones thyroxine (i.e., T4) and/or 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine zwitterion (i.e., triiodothyronine or T3).

terms.name: Increased circulating gonadotropin level
terms.name_zh: 血循环促性腺激素水平升高
terms.definition: Overproduction of gonadotropins (FSH, LH) by the anterior pituitary gland.

terms.name: Pituitary dwarfism
terms.definition: A type of reduced stature with normal proportions related to dysfunction of the pituitary gland related to either an isolated defect in the secretion of growth hormone or to panhypopituitarism, i.e., a deficit of all the anterior pituitary hormones.

terms.name: Adrenogenital syndrome
terms.definition: Adrenogenital syndrome is also known as congenital adrenal hyperplasia, which results from disorders of steroid hormone production in the adrenal glands leading to a deficiency of cortisol. The pituitary gland reacts by increased secretion of corticotropin, which in turn causes the adrenal glands to overproduce certain intermediary hormones which have testosterone-like effects.

terms.name: Hyperactive renin-angiotensin system
terms.name_zh: 肾素-血管紧张素系统亢进
terms.definition: An abnormally increased activity of the renin-angiotensin system, causing hypertension by a combination of volume excess and vasoconstrictor mechanisms.

terms.name: Hyperinsulinemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of insulin in the blood.

terms.name: Hyperparathyroidism
terms.definition: Excessive production of parathyroid hormone (PTH) by the parathyroid glands.

terms.name: Elevated circulating growth hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环生长激素浓度升高
terms.definition: Acromegaly is a condition resulting from overproduction of growth hormone by the pituitary gland in persons with closed epiphyses, and consists chiefly in the enlargement of the distal parts of the body. The circumference of the skull increases, the nose becomes broad, the tongue becomes enlarged, the facial features become coarsened, the mandible grows excessively, and the teeth become separated. The fingers and toes grow chiefly in thickness.

terms.name: Adrenal insufficiency
terms.definition: Insufficient production of steroid hormones (primarily cortisol) by the adrenal glands.

terms.name: Abnormality of renin-angiotensin system
terms.name_zh: 肾素-血管紧张素系统异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the renin-angiotensin system.

terms.name: Increased circulating renin concentration
terms.definition: An increased level of renin in the blood.

terms.name: Congenital hypothyroidism
terms.name_zh: 先天性甲状腺功能减退症
terms.definition: A type of hypothyroidism with congenital onset.

terms.name: Pseudohypoparathyroidism
terms.definition: A condition characterized by resistance to the action of parathyroid hormone, in which there is hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, and (appropriately) high levels of parathyroid hormone.

terms.name: Goiter
terms.definition: An enlargement of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Thyroid adenoma
terms.definition: The presence of a adenoma of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Insulin resistance
synonyms: Body fails to respond to insulin
terms.definition: Increased resistance towards insulin, that is, diminished effectiveness of insulin in reducing blood glucose levels.

terms.name: Irregular menstruation
terms.definition: Abnormally high variation in the amount of time between periods.

terms.name: Increased circulating aldosterone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环醛固酮浓度升高
terms.definition: Overproduction of the mineralocorticoid aldosterone by the adrenal cortex.

terms.name: Parathyroid hypoplasia
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the parathyroid gland.

terms.name: Central diabetes insipidus
terms.definition: A form of diabetes insipidus related to a failure of vasopressin (AVP) release from the hypothalamus.

terms.name: Abnormality of the hypothalamus-pituitary axis
terms.definition: Abnormality of the pituitary gland (also known as hypophysis), which is an endocrine gland that protrudes from the bottom of the hypothalamus at the base of the brain. The pituitary gland secretes the hormones ACTH, TSH, PRL, GH, endorphins, FSH, LH, oxytocin, and antidiuretic hormone. The secretion of hormones from the anterior pituitary is under the strict control of hypothalamic hormones, and the posterior pituitary is essentially an extension of the hypothalamus, so that hypothalamus and pituitary gland may be regarded as a functional unit.

terms.name: Euthyroid multinodular goiter
terms.name_zh: 甲状腺功能正常性多结节性甲状腺肿

terms.name: Secondary hyperparathyroidism
terms.definition: Secondary hyperparathyroidism refers to the production of higher than normal levels of parathyroid hormone in the presence of hypocalcemia.

terms.name: Increased circulating prolactin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环催乳素浓度升高
terms.definition: The presence of abnormally increased levels of prolactin in the blood. Prolactin is a peptide hormone produced by the anterior pituitary gland that plays a role in breast development and lactation during pregnancy.

terms.name: Panhypopituitarism
terms.definition: A pituitary functional deficit affecting all the anterior pituitary hormones (growth hormone, thyroid-stimulating hormone, follicle-stimulating hormone, luteinizing hormone, adrenocorticotropic hormone, and prolactin).

terms.name: Hashimoto thyroiditis
terms.definition: A chronic, autoimmune type of thyroiditis associated with hypothyroidism.

terms.name: Diabetes insipidus
terms.definition: A state of excessive water intake and hypotonic (dilute) polyuria. Diabetes insipidus may be due to failure of vasopressin (AVP) release (central or neurogenic diabetes insipidus) or to a failure of the kidney to respond to AVP (nephrogenic diabetes insipidus).

terms.name: Oligomenorrhea
terms.definition: Infrequent menses (less than 6 per year or more than 35 days between cycles).

terms.name: Insulin-resistant diabetes mellitus at puberty
terms.name_zh: 青春期胰岛素抵抗性糖尿病

terms.name: 11 pairs of ribs
terms.definition: Presence of only 11 pairs of ribs.

terms.name: Short sternum
terms.definition: Decreased inferosuperior length of the sternum.

terms.name: Hypoplastic scapulae
terms.definition: Underdeveloped scapula.

terms.name: Thin ribs
terms.definition: Ribs with a reduced diameter.

terms.name: Broad ribs
terms.definition: Increased width of ribs

terms.name: Deformed rib cage
terms.definition: Malformation of the rib cage.

terms.name: Cupped ribs
terms.definition: Wide, concave rib end.

terms.name: Horizontal ribs
terms.definition: A horizontal (flat) conformation of the ribs, the long curved bones that form the rib cage and normally progressively oblique (slanted) from ribs 1 through 9, then less slanted through rib 12.

terms.name: Abnormal clavicle morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the clavicles (collar bones).

terms.name: Long clavicle
terms.definition: Increased length of the clavicles.

terms.name: Bifid ribs
terms.definition: A bifid rib refers to cleavage of the sternal end of a rib, usually unilateral. Bifid ribs are usually asymptomatic, and are often discovered incidentally by chest x-ray.

terms.name: Bulging of the costochondral junction
terms.definition: Abnormal outward curving (protuberance) of the junction of ribs and costal cartilage.

terms.name: Short clavicles
terms.definition: Reduced length of the clavicles.

terms.name: Lateral clavicle hook
terms.definition: An excessive upward convexity of the lateral clavicle.

terms.name: Rib exostoses
terms.definition: Multiple circumscribed bony excrescences located in the ribs.

terms.name: Rachitic rosary
terms.definition: A row of beadlike prominences at the junction of a rib and its cartilage (i.e., enlarged costochondral joints), resembling a rosary. Note that rachitic rosary would have one bead per rib (a swelling at the costochondral junction), while beaded ribs in the context of multiple rib fractures have multiple beads (fractures) along the same rib.

terms.name: Thickened ribs
terms.definition: Increased thickness (diameter) of ribs.

terms.name: Rib fusion
terms.definition: Complete or partial merging of adjacent ribs.

terms.name: Flaring of rib cage
terms.definition: The presence of wide, concave anterior rib ends.

terms.name: Progressive clavicular acroosteolysis
terms.definition: Progressive bone resorption in the distal part of the clavicle.

terms.name: Anterior rib cupping
terms.definition: Wide, concave anterior rib end.

terms.name: Flat glenoid fossa
terms.definition: Abnormally flat configuration of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.

terms.name: Sprengel anomaly
synonyms: Congenital, upward displacement of the scapula
terms.definition: A congenital skeletal deformity characterized by the elevation of one scapula (thus, one scapula is located superior to the other).

terms.name: Posterior rib fusion
terms.definition: Complete or partial merging of the posterior part of adjacent ribs.

terms.name: Shield chest
terms.definition: A broad chest.

terms.name: Pectus excavatum of inferior sternum
terms.definition: Pectus excavatum (defect of the chest wall characterized by depression of the sternum) affecting primarily the inferior region of the sternum.

terms.name: Broad clavicle
terms.definition: Increased width (cross-sectional diameter) of the clavicles.

terms.name: Superior pectus carinatum
terms.definition: Pectus carinatum affecting primarily the superior part of the sternum.

terms.name: Scapular exostoses
terms.definition: The presence of multiple exostoses on the scapula. An exostosis is a benign growth the projects outward from the bone surface. It is capped by cartilage.

terms.name: Abnormality of the costochondral junction
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the costochondral junction. The costochondral junctions are located between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.

terms.name: Enlargement of the costochondral junction
terms.definition: Abnormally increased size of the costochondral junctions, which are located between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.

terms.name: Missing ribs
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly with absence of one or more ribs.

terms.name: Posterior rib cupping
terms.definition: Wide, concave posterior rib end.

terms.name: Abnormality of the skeletal system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skeletal system.

terms.name: Abnormality of the vertebral column
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the vertebral column.

terms.name: Platyspondyly
terms.definition: A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates.

terms.name: Abnormality of skeletal maturation
terms.definition: The bones of the skeleton undergo a series of characteristic changes in size, shape, and calcification from fetal life until puberty. An abnormality of this process can include delayed or accelerated skeletal maturation, or deviation of some, but not all bones from the expected patterns of maturation.

terms.name: Abnormal skull morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skull, the bony framework of the head which is comprised of the neurocranium (with eight cranial bones) and the viscerocranium (facial skeleton) that comprises fourteen facial bones with the mandible as its largest bone.

terms.name: Elevated imprint of the transverse sinuses
synonyms: Elevated imprint of occipital bone over the transverse sinuses
Elevated imprint of posterior skull bones over the transverse sinuses
Thinning and bulging of occipital bone over the transverse sinuses
Thinning and bulging of posterior skull bones over the transverse sinuses

terms.name: Thinning and bulging of the posterior fossa bones
synonyms: Thinning and bulging of posterior fossa bones
Thinning and bulging of posterior skull bones

terms.name: Abnormal posterior cranial fossa morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the posterior cranial fossa
terms.definition: An abnormality of the fossa cranii posterior (the posterior fossa), which is made up primarily of the occipital bone and which surrounds to the foramen magnum.

terms.name: Posterior fossa cyst at the fourth ventricle
Chondrocalcinosis
terms.definition: Radiographic evidence of articular calcification that represent calcium pyrophosphate depositions in soft tissue surrounding joints and at the insertions of tendons near joints (Entheses/Sharpey fibers) .

terms.name: Thickened cortex of long bones
synonyms: Cortical thickening of the long bones
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of long bones.

terms.name: Osteopenia
terms.definition: Osteopenia is a term to define bone density that is not normal but also not as low as osteoporosis. By definition from the World Health Organization osteopenia is defined by bone densitometry as a T score -1 to -2.5.

terms.name: Osteoporosis
terms.definition: Osteoporosis is a systemic skeletal disease characterized by low bone density and microarchitectural deterioration of bone tissue with a consequent increase in bone fragility. According to the WHO criteria, osteoporosis is defined as a BMD that lies 2.5 standard deviations or more below the average value for young healthy adults (a T-score below -2.5 SD).

terms.name: Abnormal diaphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of shaft of long bone
Abnormality involving the diaphyses of the limbs
Abnormality of shaft of long bone of the limbs
Anomaly of the limb diaphyses morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the structure or form of the diaphysis, i.e., of the main or mid-section (shaft) of a long bone.

terms.name: Abnormal metaphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the wide portion of a long bone
terms.definition: An abnormality of one or more metaphysis, i.e., of the somewhat wider portion of a long bone that is adjacent to the epiphyseal growth plate and grows during childhood.

terms.name: Hypoplastic ilia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ilium.

terms.name: Dumbbell-shaped long bone
synonyms: Dumbbell widening of long bone metaphyses
terms.definition: An abnormal appearance of the long bones with resemblance to a dumbbell, a short bar with a weight at each end. That is, the long bone is shortened and displays flaring (widening) of the metaphyses.

terms.name: Abnormality of the skin
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skin.

terms.name: Jaundice
terms.definition: Yellow pigmentation of the skin due to bilirubin, which in turn is the result of increased bilirubin concentration in the bloodstream.

terms.name: Hyperpigmentation of the skin
terms.definition: A darkening of the skin related to an increase in melanin production and deposition.

terms.name: Single transverse palmar crease
terms.definition: The distal and proximal transverse palmar creases are merged into a single transverse palmar crease.

terms.name: Acanthosis nigricans
terms.definition: A dermatosis characterized by thickened, hyperpigmented plaques, typically on the intertriginous surfaces and neck.

terms.name: Cafe-au-lait spot
terms.definition: Cafe-au-lait spots are hyperpigmented lesions that can vary in color from light brown to dark brown with smooth borders and having a size of 1.5 cm or more in adults and 0.5 cm or more in children.

terms.name: Dry skin
terms.definition: Skin characterized by the lack of natural or normal moisture.

terms.name: Sacral dimple
terms.definition: A cutaneous indentation resulting from tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) of the intergluteal cleft.

terms.name: Cyanosis
terms.definition: Bluish discoloration of the skin and mucosa due to poor circulation or inadequate oxygenation of arterial or capillary blood.

terms.name: Hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Hyperkeratosis is a histopathological term defining a thickened stratum corneum and may be present in many different skin conditions, with many possible overlaps. Hyperkeratosis refers to the increased thickness of the stratum corneum, the outer layer of the skin. Hyperkeratosis is subclassified as orthokeratotic or parakeratotic. Orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis refers to the thickening of the keratin layer with preserved keratinocyte maturation, while parakeratotic hyperkeratosis shows retained nuclei as a sign of delayed maturation of keratinocytes.

terms.name: Thin skin
terms.definition: Reduction in thickness of the skin, generally associated with a loss of suppleness and elasticity of the skin.

terms.name: Eczematoid dermatitis
terms.definition: Eczema is a form of dermatitis that is characterized by scaly, pruritic, erythematous lesions located on flexural surfaces.

terms.name: Cutis marmorata
terms.definition: A reticular discoloration of the skin with cyanotic (reddish-blue appearing) areas surrounding pale central areas due to dilation of capillary blood vessels and stagnation of blood within the vessels. Cutis marmorata generally occurs on the legs, arms and trunk and is often more severe in cold weather.

terms.name: Hypohidrosis
terms.definition: Abnormally diminished capacity to sweat.

terms.name: Petechiae
terms.definition: Petechiae are pinpoint-sized reddish/purple spots, resembling a rash, that appear just under the skin or a mucous membrane when capillaries have ruptured and some superficial bleeding into the skin has happened. This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to developing petechiae.

terms.name: Ectodermal dysplasia
terms.definition: Ectodermal dysplasia is a group of conditions in which there is abnormal development of the skin, hair, nails, teeth, or sweat glands.

terms.name: Edema
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin, or in one or more cavities of the body.

terms.name: Anhidrosis
terms.definition: Inability to sweat.

terms.name: Abnormal sweat gland morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the sweat gland.

terms.name: Palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
synonyms: Hyperkeratosis of the palms and soles
Thickening of the outer layer of the skin of the palms and soles
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin localized to the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot.

terms.name: Cutis laxa
terms.definition: Wrinkled, redundant, inelastic and sagging skin.

terms.name: Hyperextensible skin
terms.definition: A condition in which the skin can be stretched beyond normal, and then returns to its initial position.

terms.name: Hyperhidrosis
terms.definition: Abnormal excessive perspiration (sweating) despite the lack of appropriate stimuli like hot and humid weather.

terms.name: Soft skin
terms.definition: Subjective impression of increased softness upon palpation of the skin.

terms.name: Bruising susceptibility
terms.definition: An ecchymosis (bruise) refers to the skin discoloration caused by the escape of blood into the tissues from ruptured blood vessels. This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to bruising. The corresponding phenotypic abnormality is generally elicited on medical history as a report of frequent ecchymoses or bruising without adequate trauma.

terms.name: Purpura
synonyms: Red or purple spots on the skin
terms.definition: Purpura (from Latin: purpura, meaning purple) is the appearance of red or purple discolorations on the skin that do not blanch on applying pressure. They are caused by bleeding underneath the skin. This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to developing purpura. Purpura are larger than petechiae.

terms.name: Pallor
terms.definition: Abnormally pale skin.

terms.name: Palmoplantar keratoderma
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin of the palms of the hands and the soles of the feet.

terms.name: Atypical scarring of skin
terms.definition: Atypically scarred skin .

terms.name: Skin rash
terms.definition: A red eruption of the skin.

terms.name: Pruritus
terms.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased disposition to experience pruritus.

terms.name: Xanthomatosis
synonyms: Yellow bumps of fatty deposits on skin
terms.definition: The presence of multiple xanthomas (xanthomata) in the skin. Xanthomas are yellowish, firm, lipid-laden nodules in the skin.

terms.name: Cutaneous photosensitivity
terms.definition: An increased sensitivity of the skin to light. Photosensitivity may result in a rash upon exposure to the sun (which is known as photodermatosis). Photosensitivity can be diagnosed by phototests in which light is shone on small areas of skin.

terms.name: Molluscoid pseudotumors
terms.definition: Bluish-grey, spongy nodules associated with scars over pressure points and easily traumatized areas like the elbows and knees.

terms.name: Melanocytic nevus
terms.definition: A oval and round, colored (usually medium-to dark brown, reddish brown, or flesh colored) lesion. Typically, a melanocytic nevus is less than 6 mm in diameter, but may be much smaller or larger.

terms.name: Facial capillary hemangioma
terms.definition: Hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells with small endothelial spaces, occurring in the face.

terms.name: Axillary freckling
terms.definition: The presence in the axillary region (armpit) of an increased number of freckles, small circular spots on the skin that are darker than the surrounding skin because of deposits of melanin.

terms.name: Hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Hypertrichosis is increased hair growth that is abnormal in quantity or location.

terms.name: Pyoderma
terms.definition: Any manifestation of a skin disease associated with the production of pus.

terms.name: Abnormal skin pigmentation
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pigmentation of the skin.

terms.name: Abnormality of subcutaneous fat tissue
synonyms: Abnormality of fatty tissue below the skin

terms.name: Multiple lentigines
terms.definition: Presence of an unusually high number of lentigines (singular: lentigo), which are flat, tan to brown oval spots.

terms.name: Lymphedema
synonyms: Swelling caused by excess lymph fluid under skin
terms.definition: Localized fluid retention and tissue swelling caused by a compromised lymphatic system.

terms.name: Hirsutism
terms.definition: Abnormally increased hair growth referring to a male pattern of body hair (androgenic hair).

terms.name: Accumulation of melanosomes in melanocytes
terms.name_zh: 黑素细胞黑素小体蓄积

terms.name: Telangiectasia
terms.definition: Telangiectasias refer to small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes, measuring between 0.5 and 1 millimeter in diameter. Telangiectasia are located especially on the tongue, lips, palate, fingers, face, conjunctiva, trunk, nail beds, and fingertips.

terms.name: Hypopigmentation of the skin
terms.definition: A reduction of skin color related to a decrease in melanin production and deposition.

terms.name: Multiple lipomas
terms.definition: The presence of multiple lipomas (a type of benign tissue made of fatty tissue).

terms.name: Eruptive xanthomas
terms.definition: Eruptive xanthomas are yellow-orange-to-red-brown papules that are often surrounded by an erythematous halo. They appear in crops on the buttocks, extensor surfaces of the extremities, and flexural creases. Acutely, variable amounts of pruritus and pain occur.

terms.name: Angiokeratoma
terms.definition: Angiokeratomas are hyperkeratotic papules that are characterized histologically by superficial ectatic (i.e., dilated) blood vessels with epidermal proliferation. Clinically, angiokeratoma presents as a small, raised, dark-red spot.

terms.name: Prominent superficial veins
terms.definition: A condition in which superficial veins (i.e., veins just under the skin) are more conspicuous or noticeable than normal.

terms.name: Anemic pallor
terms.definition: A type of pallor that is secondary to the presence of anemia.

terms.name: Abnormal palmar dermatoglyphics
terms.definition: An abnormality of the dermatoglyphs, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of palm of hand.

terms.name: Erythroderma
terms.definition: An inflammatory exfoliative dermatosis involving nearly all of the surface of the skin. Erythroderma develops suddenly. A patchy erythema may generalize and spread to affect most of the skin. Scaling may appear in 2-6 days and be accompanied by hot, red, dry skin, malaise, and fever.

terms.name: Albinism
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation (reduced or absent) of skin, hair and eye (iris and retina).

terms.name: Skin dimple over apex of long bone angulation
Urticaria
terms.definition: Raised, well-circumscribed areas of erythema and edema involving the dermis and epidermis. Urticaria is intensely pruritic, and blanches completely with pressure.

terms.name: Soft, doughy skin
terms.definition: A skin texture that is unusually soft (and may feel silky), and has a malleable consistency resembling that of dough.

terms.name: Hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma is a benign tumor characterized by blood-filled spaces lined by benign endothelial cells. A hemangioma characterized by large endothelial spaces (caverns) is called a cavernous hemangioma (in contrast to a hemangioma with small endothelial spaces, which is called capillary hemangioma).

terms.name: Poikiloderma
terms.definition: Poikiloderma refers to a patch of skin with (1) reticulated hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation, (2) wrinkling secondary to epidermal atrophy, and (3) telangiectasias.

terms.name: Fragile skin
terms.definition: Skin that splits easily with minimal injury.

terms.name: Subcutaneous lipoma
terms.definition: The presence of subcutaneous lipoma.

terms.name: Absent distal interphalangeal creases
terms.name_zh: 远端指间关节皱褶缺失
synonyms: Absence of skin creases over distal interphalangeal joints
Aplasia of the distal interphalangeal creases
terms.definition: Absence of the distal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fingers.

terms.name: Hypermelanotic macule
terms.definition: A hyperpigmented circumscribed area of change in normal skin color without elevation or depression of any size.

terms.name: Parakeratosis
terms.definition: Abnormal formation of the keratinocytes of the epidermis characterized by persistence of nuclei, incomplete formation of keratin, and moistness and swelling of the keratinocytes.

terms.name: Facial erythema
terms.definition: Redness of the skin of the face, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.

terms.name: Intermittent jaundice
terms.definition: Jaundice that is sometimes present, sometimes not.

terms.name: Atopic dermatitis
terms.definition: Atopic dermatitis (AD) or atopic eczema is an itchy, inflammatory skin condition with a predilection for the skin flexures. It is characterized by poorly defined erythema with edema, vesicles, and weeping in the acute stage and skin thickening (lichenification) in the chronic stage.

terms.name: Cavernous hemangioma
synonyms: Collection of dilated blood vessels that forms mass
terms.definition: The presence of a cavernous hemangioma. A hemangioma characterized by large endothelial spaces (caverns) is called a cavernous hemangioma.

terms.name: Absent dorsal skin creases over affected joints
terms.name_zh: 病变关节背侧皮肤皱褶缺失

terms.name: Seborrheic dermatitis
terms.definition: Seborrheic dermatitis is a form of eczema which is closely related to dandruff. It causes dry or greasy peeling of the scalp, eyebrows, and face, and sometimes trunk.

terms.name: Nevus flammeus
terms.definition: A congenital vascular malformation consisting of superficial and deep dilated capillaries in the skin which produce a reddish to purplish discolouration of the skin.

terms.name: Erysipelas
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to erysipelas, as manifested by a medical history of repeated episodes of erysipelas, which is a superficial infection of the skin, typically involving the lymphatic system.

terms.name: Milia
terms.definition: Presence of multiple small cysts containing keratin (skin protein) and presenting as tiny pearly-white bumps just under the surface of the skin.

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita
synonyms: Absence of part of skin at birth
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin in multiple or solitary non-inflammatory, well-demarcated, oval or circular ulcers with a diameter of about 1 to 2 cm. Aplasia cutis congenita most commonly occurs on the scalp, but may present in the face, trunk, or limbs.

terms.name: Poor wound healing
terms.definition: A reduced ability to heal cutaneous wounds.

terms.name: Pterygium
terms.definition: Pterygia are 'winglike' triangular membranes occurring in the neck, eyes, knees, elbows, ankles or digits.

terms.name: Axillary pterygium
terms.definition: Presence of a cutaneous membrane (flap) in the armpit.

terms.name: Acne
terms.definition: A skin condition in which there is an increase in sebum secretion by the pilosebaceous apparatus associated with open comedones (blackheads), closed comedones (whiteheads), and pustular nodules (papules, pustules, and cysts).

terms.name: Atypical nevus
terms.definition: A large pigmented lesion measuring 5-15 mm in diameter with irregular, notched, and ill defined border and with color that may range from tan to dark brown to pink.

terms.name: Acrocyanosis
synonyms: Persistent blue color of hands or feet
Persistent blue colour of hands or feet
terms.definition: Bluish discoloration of the skin of the hands or feet.

terms.name: Striae distensae
terms.definition: Thinned, erythematous, depressed bands of atrophic skin. Initially, striae appear as flattened and thinned, pinkish linear regions of the skin. Striae tend to enlarge in length and become reddish or purplish. Later, striae tend to appear as white, depressed bands that are parallel to the lines of skin tension. Striae distensae occur most often in areas that have been subject to distension such as the lower back, buttocks, thighs, breast, abdomen, and shoulders.

terms.name: Neurofibroma
terms.definition: A benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor that generally appears as a soft, skin-colored papule or small subcutaneous nodule. Individuals with neurofibromatosis can have numerous neurofibromas.

terms.name: Episodic hyperhidrosis
terms.definition: Intermittent episodes of abnormally increased perspiration.

terms.name: Mottled pigmentation
terms.definition: Patchy and irregular skin pigmentation.

terms.name: Angiokeratoma corporis diffusum
terms.name_zh: 弥漫性躯体血管角化瘤
terms.definition: Angiokeratoma corporis diffusum (ACD) is typically characterized by innumerable small red to black papules which occur in clusters and are situated symmetrically in the bathing trunks area. The number of lesions and the extension of the body increase steadily with time so that generalization and mucosal involvement are common. The single lesion begins with a minute reddish papule which enlarges to up to 10 mm in diameter, becomes dark red to black with a discrete keratotic overgrowth. Histologically, the papules are characterized by superficial dilated capillaries in papillary dermis with epidermal proliferation.

terms.name: Thickened skin
terms.definition: Laminar thickening of skin.

terms.name: Cigarette-paper scars
terms.definition: Thin (atrophic) and wide scars.

terms.name: Atypical nevi in non-sun exposed areas
Atrophic scars
synonyms: Sunken or indented skin due to damage
terms.definition: Scars that form a depression compared to the level of the surrounding skin because of damage to the collagen, fat or other tissues below the skin.

terms.name: Biliary tract abnormality
terms.definition: An abnormality of the biliary tree.

terms.name: Cholelithiasis
terms.definition: Hard, pebble-like deposits that form within the gallbladder.

terms.name: Cholecystitis
terms.definition: The presence of inflammatory changes in the gallbladder.

terms.name: Ectopia lentis
terms.definition: Dislocation or malposition of the crystalline lens of the eye. A partial displacement (or dislocation) of the lens is described as a subluxation of the lens, while a complete displacement is termed luxation of the lens. A complete displacement occurs if the lens is completely outside the patellar fossa of the lens, either in the anterior chamber, in the vitreous, or directly on the retina. If the lens is partially displaced but still contained within the lens space, then it is termed subluxation.

terms.name: Corneal arcus
terms.definition: A hazy, grayish-white ring about 2 mm in width located close to but separated from the limbus (the corneoscleral junction). Corneal arcus generally occurs bilaterally, and is related to lipid deposition in the cornea. Corneal arcus can occur in elderly persons as a part of the aging process but may be associated with hypercholesterolemia in people under the age of 50 years.

terms.name: Papilledema
terms.definition: Papilledema refers to edema (swelling) of the optic disc secondary to any factor which increases cerebral spinal fluid pressure.

terms.name: Developmental glaucoma
terms.definition: Glaucoma which forms during the early years of a child's life is called developmental or congenital glaucoma.

terms.name: Brushfield spots
terms.definition: The presence of whitish spots in a ring-like arrangement at the periphery of the iris.

terms.name: Iris atrophy
terms.definition: Loss of iris tissue (atrophy)

terms.name: Abnormally large globe
terms.definition: Diffusely large eye (with megalocornea) without glaucoma.

terms.name: Absent lacrimal punctum
terms.definition: No identifiable superior and/or inferior lacrimal punctum.

terms.name: Optic nerve dysplasia
terms.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the optic nerve.

terms.name: Iridocyclitis
terms.definition: A type of anterior uveitis, in which there is Inflammation of the iris and the ciliary body.

terms.name: Hypertensive retinopathy
terms.definition: Condition of the retina, secondary to severe systemic arterial hypertension which can be acute or longstanding. Features include one or several of the following: retinal vascular tortuosity, arteriovenous crossing signs, retinal cotton wool spot and intraretinal hemorrhages. It can be associated with optic disc swelling.

terms.name: Keratoconjunctivitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the cornea and conjunctiva.

terms.name: Keratoconjunctivitis sicca
terms.definition: Dryness of the eye related to deficiency of the tear film components (aqueous, mucin, or lipid), lid surface abnormalities, or epithelial abnormalities. Keratoconjunctivitis sicca often results in a scratchy or sandy sensation (foreign body sensation) in the eyes, and may also be associated with itching, inability to produce tears, photosensitivity, redness, pain, and difficulty in moving the eyelids.

terms.name: Abnormal fundus morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the fundus of the eye.

terms.name: Atrophic fundus lesion
terms.definition: Well-defined or diffused area or lesion of loss of normal retinal tissue; this is often illustrated by greyish discoloration of fundus and/or better visible choroidal vasculature on funduscopy.

terms.name: Heterochromia iridis
terms.definition: Heterochromia iridis is a difference in the color of the iris in the two eyes.

terms.name: Iritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the iris.

terms.name: Angioid streaks
terms.definition: Irregular lines in the outer retina and Bruch membrane that are typically configured in a radiating fashion and emanate from the optic disc. Angioid streaks are crack-like dehiscences in abnormally thickened and calcified Bruch membrane, resulting in atrophy of the overlying retinal pigment epithelium. They may be associated with a number of endocrine, metabolic, and connective tissue abnormalities but can be idiopathic. They can be associated with neovascular complexes (choroid).

terms.name: Abnormal macular morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the macula, a region that, in a clinical context, is typically used to describe the central part of the retina within the vascular arcades.

terms.name: Macular hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the macula lutea.

terms.name: Retinal atrophy
terms.definition: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells.

terms.name: Periorbital hyperpigmentation
synonyms: Idiopathic cutaneous hyperchromia at the orbital region
terms.definition: Increased pigmentation of the skin in the region surrounding the orbit of the eye.

terms.name: Ocular albinism
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation (reduced or absent) of the iris and retina.

terms.name: Leber optic atrophy
terms.definition: Degeneration of retinal ganglion cells and their axons.

terms.name: Xanthelasma
synonyms: Fatty deposits in skin around the eyes
terms.definition: The presence of xanthomata in the skin of the eyelid.

terms.name: Posterior polar cataract
terms.definition: A polar cataract that affects the posterior pole of the lens.

terms.name: Macular pseudocoloboma
terms.definition: A so-called macular coloboma is characterized by a sharply defined, usually excavated, area without neuroretina and RPE tissues in the central area of the fundus. This lesion is not related to classical colobomas associated with optic fissure closure defects.

terms.name: Sudden loss of visual acuity
terms.definition: Severe loss of visual acuity within hours or days. This is characteristic of Leber hereditary optic neuropathy.

terms.name: Juvenile cataract
terms.definition: A type of cataract that is not apparent at birth but that arises in childhood or adolescence.

terms.name: Keratoglobus
terms.definition: Limbus-to-limbus corneal thinning, often greatest in the periphery, with globular protrusion of the cornea.

terms.name: Abnormality of corneal size
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the size or morphology of the cornea.

terms.name: Visual field defect
synonyms: Partial loss of field of vision

terms.name: Transient unilateral blurring of vision
terms.definition: Transient blurring of vision associated with the aura phase of migraine.

terms.name: Cryptophthalmos
terms.definition: Cryptophthalmos is a condition of total absence of eyelids and the skin of forehead is continuous with that of cheek, in which the eyeball is completely concealed by the skin, which is stretched over the orbital cavity.

terms.name: Trichiasis
terms.definition: Inversion and rubbing of the eyelashes against the globe of the eye.

terms.name: Large central visual field defect
synonyms: Large central loss of field of vision

terms.name: Corneal dystrophy
terms.definition: The term corneal dystrophy embraces a heterogenous group of bilateral genetically determined non-inflammatory corneal diseases that are restricted to the cornea.

terms.name: Lens subluxation
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the lens of the eye.

terms.name: Constriction of peripheral visual field
terms.definition: An absolute or relative decrease in retinal sensitivity extending from edge (periphery) of the visual field in a concentric pattern. The visual field is the area that is perceived simultaneously by a fixating eye.

terms.name: Anterior polar cataract
terms.definition: A polar cataract that affects the anterior pole of the lens.

terms.name: Chorioretinal dystrophy
terms.name_zh: 脉络膜视网膜营养不良

terms.name: Retinal arteriolar tortuosity
terms.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the retinal arterioles.

terms.name: Alternating esotropia
terms.definition: Esotropia in which either eye may be used for fixation.

terms.name: Chorioretinal scalloped atrophy
terms.name_zh: 脉络膜视网膜扇形萎缩
terms.definition: Well-defined, pale patches in the fundus.

terms.name: Limbal dermoid
terms.definition: A benign tumor typically found at the junction of the cornea and sclera (limbal epibullar dermoid).

terms.name: Severely reduced visual acuity
terms.definition: Severe reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 6/60 but at least 3/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 20/200 but at least 20/400. On the decimal visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 0.1 but at least 0.05.

terms.name: Lenticonus
terms.definition: A conical projection of the anterior or posterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly.

terms.name: Orbital cyst
terms.definition: Presence of a cyst in the region of the periorbital tissues. Orbital cysts can be derived from epithelial or glandular tissue within or surrounding the orbit (lacrimal glands, salivary glands, conjunctival, oral, nasal, or sinus epithelium).

terms.name: Retinal exudate
terms.definition: Yellow-white intraretinal deposits in the retina typically associated with damaged inner blood-retina barrier and exudation of serous fluid and lipids from the retinal microvasculature.

terms.name: Lattice corneal dystrophy
terms.definition: The presence of fine, branching linear opacities in Bowman's layer in the central area that may spread to the periphery in the clinical course. The deep corneal stroma may be involved but the process does not reach Descemet's membrane. Recurrent corneal erosion may occur. Histologic examination reveals amyloid deposits in the collagen fibers of the cornea.

terms.name: Impaired horizontal smooth pursuit
terms.definition: An abnormality of ocular smooth pursuit characterized by an impairment of the ability to track horizontally moving objects.

terms.name: Saccadic smooth pursuit interruptions
terms.definition: An abnormality of tracking eye movements in which smooth pursuit is interrupted by an abnormally high number of saccadic movements.

terms.name: Septate vagina
terms.definition: The presence of a vaginal septum, thereby creating a vaginal duplication. The septum is longitudinal in the majority of cases.

terms.name: Abnormality of the hand
terms.definition: An abnormality affecting one or both hands.

terms.name: Brachydactyly
terms.definition: Digits that appear disproportionately short compared to the hand/foot. The word brachydactyly is used here to describe a series distinct patterns of shortened digits (brachydactyly types A-E). This is the sense used here.

terms.name: Syndactyly
terms.definition: Webbing or fusion of the fingers or toes, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as \

terms.name: Hand polydactyly
terms.definition: A kind of polydactyly characterized by the presence of a supernumerary finger or fingers.

terms.name: Postaxial hand polydactyly
terms.definition: Supernumerary digits located at the ulnar side of the hand (that is, on the side with the fifth finger).

terms.name: Arachnodactyly
terms.definition: Abnormally long and slender fingers (spider fingers).

terms.name: Abnormal finger morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of a finger.

terms.name: Broad palm
terms.definition: For children from birth to 4 years of age the palm width is more than 2 SD above the mean; for children from 4 to 16 years of age the palm width is above the 95th centile; or, the width of the palm appears disproportionately wide for the length.

terms.name: Split hand
terms.definition: A condition in which middle parts of the hand (fingers and metacarpals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic middle fingers over absent middle fingers as far as oligo- or monodactyl hands.

terms.name: Abnormal thumb morphology
terms.definition: An abnormal structure of the first digit of the hand.

terms.name: Preaxial hand polydactyly
terms.definition: Supernumerary digits located at the radial side of the hand. Polydactyly (supernumerary digits) involving the thumb occurs in many distinct forms of high variability and severity. Ranging from fleshy nubbins over varying degrees of partial duplication/splitting to completely duplicated or even triplicated thumbs or preaxial (on the radial side of the hand) supernumerary digits.

terms.name: Ulnar claw
terms.definition: An abnormal hand position characterized by hyperextension of the fourth and fifth fingers at the metacarpophalangeal joints and flexion of the interphalangeal joints of the same fingers such that they are curled towards the palm.

terms.name: Adducted thumb
terms.definition: In the resting position, the tip of the thumb is on, or near, the palm, close to the base of the fourth or fifth finger.

terms.name: Tapered finger
terms.definition: The gradual reduction in girth of the finger from proximal to distal.

terms.name: Hyperextensibility of the finger joints
terms.definition: The ability of the finger joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

terms.name: Hand clenching
terms.definition: An abnormal hand posture in which the hands are clenched to fists. All digits held completely flexed at the metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints. In prenatal sonography of the fetal clenched hand, the index finger overlaps a clenched fist formed by the other digits. The proximal interphalangeal articulation of the index finger is flexed and ulnarly deviated, and the thumb is adducted.

terms.name: Abnormal carpal morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality affecting the carpal bones of the wrist (scaphoid, lunate, triquetral, pisiform, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate).

terms.name: Ulnar deviation of the hand or of fingers of the hand
Abnormalities of placenta or umbilical cord
synonyms: Abnormalities of placenta or umbilical cord
terms.definition: An abnormality of the placenta (the organ that connects the developing fetus to the uterine wall) or of the umbilical cord (the cord that connects the fetus to the placenta).

terms.name: Single umbilical artery
synonyms: Only one artery in umbilical cord instead of two
terms.definition: Single umbilical artery (SUA) is the absence of one of the two umbilical arteries surrounding the fetal bladder and in the fetal umbilical cord.

terms.name: Short umbilical cord
terms.definition: Decreased length of the umbilical cord.

terms.name: Abnormality of prenatal development or birth
synonyms: Abnormality of prenatal development or birth
terms.definition: An abnormality of the fetus or the birth of the fetus, excluding structural abnormalities.

terms.name: Triphalangeal thumb
terms.definition: A thumb with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis. Thus, this term applies if the thumb has an accessory phalanx, leading to a digit like appearance of the thumb.

terms.name: Distal finger symphalangism
synonyms: Symphalangism affecting the distal phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: The term distal symphalangism refers to a bony fusion of the distal and middle phalanges of the digits of the hand, in other words the distal interphalangeal joint (DIJ) is missing which can be seen either on x-rays or as an absence of the distal interphalangeal finger creases.

terms.name: Abnormal fingertip morphology
terms.definition: An abnormal structure of the tip (end) of a finger.

terms.name: Prominent fingertip pads
terms.definition: A soft tissue prominence of the ventral aspects of the fingertips. The term \

terms.name: Camptodactyly of 2nd-5th fingers
terms.definition: The distal interphalangeal joint and/or the proximal interphalangeal joint of the second to fifth fingers cannot be extended to 180 degrees by either active or passive extension.

terms.name: Delayed ossification of carpal bones
terms.definition: Ossification of carpal bones occurs later than age-adjusted norms.

terms.name: Clubbing
terms.definition: Broadening of the soft tissues (non-edematous swelling of soft tissues) of the digital tips in all dimensions associated with an increased longitudinal and lateral curvature of the nails.

terms.name: Autoamputation
terms.definition: Auto-amputation is the spontaneous detachment of an appendage from the body due to long standing pathology.

terms.name: Interphalangeal joint contracture of finger
terms.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in an interphalangeal joint of a finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.

terms.name: Spatulate thumbs
terms.definition: Spoon-shaped, broad thumbs.

terms.name: Pointed proximal second through fifth metacarpals
