terms.definition: Neuronal degeneration in the cerebellum, pontine nuclei, and inferior olivary nucleus.

terms.name: Retrocollis
terms.definition: A form of torticollis in which the head is drawn back, either due to a permanent contractures of neck extensor muscles, or to a spasmodic contracture.

terms.name: Patchy demyelination of subcortical white matter
terms.definition: Patchy loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Parkinsonism with favorable response to dopaminergic medication
synonyms: Parkinsonism with favourable response to dopaminergic medication
terms.definition: Parkinsonism is a clinical syndrome that is a feature of a number of different diseases, including Parkinson disease itself, other neurodegenerative diseases such as progressive supranuclear palsy, and as a side-effect of some neuroleptic medications. Some but not all individuals with Parkinsonism show responsiveness to dopaminergic medication defined as a substantial reduction of amelioration of the component signs of Parkinsonism (including mainly tremor, bradykinesia, rigidity, and postural instability) upon administration of dopaminergic medication.

terms.name: Deficit in phonologic short-term memory
terms.definition: Impaired ability to repeat non-word sounds. The test for nonword repetition involves the repetition of nonsensical words of increasing length and complexity and is regarded as a measure of phonological (speech sound) processing and short-term memory

terms.name: Absent facial hair
terms.definition: Absence of facial hair.

terms.name: Trichodysplasia
terms.definition: Developmental dysplasia of the hair.

terms.name: Highly arched eyebrow
terms.definition: Increased height of the central portion of the eyebrow, forming a crescent, semicircular, or inverted U shape.

terms.name: Absent pubic hair
terms.definition: Absence of pubic hair.

terms.name: Hypoplastic nipples
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the nipple.

terms.name: Supernumerary nipple
terms.definition: Presence of more than two nipples.

terms.name: Absent nipple
terms.definition: Congenital failure to develop, and absence of, the nipple.

terms.name: Low-set nipples
terms.definition: Placement of the nipples at a lower than normal location.

terms.name: Constrictive pericarditis
terms.definition: Presence of a thickened, fibrotic pericardium that forms a non-compliant shell around the heart, and resulting from chronic inflammation of the pericardium.

terms.name: Intestinal malrotation
terms.definition: An abnormality of the intestinal rotation and fixation that normally occurs during the development of the gut. This can lead to volvulus, or twisting of the intestine that causes obstruction and necrosis.

terms.name: Steatorrhea
terms.definition: Greater than normal amounts of fat in the feces. This is a result of malabsorption of lipids in the small intestine and results in frothy foul-smelling fecal matter that floats.

terms.name: Achalasia
terms.definition: A disorder of esophageal motility characterized by the inability of the lower esophageal sphincter to relax during swallowing and by inadequate or lacking peristalsis in the lower half of the body of the esophagus.

terms.name: Episodic vomiting
terms.definition: Paroxysmal, recurrent episodes of vomiting.

terms.name: Hematochezia
terms.definition: The passage of fresh (red) blood per anus, usually in or with stools. Most rectal bleeding comes from the colon, rectum, or anus.

terms.name: Episodic abdominal pain
terms.definition: An intermittent form of abdominal pain.

terms.name: Tracheoesophageal fistula
terms.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the esophagus and the trachea.

terms.name: Intussusception
terms.definition: An abnormality of the intestine in which part of the intestine invaginates (telescopes) into another part of the intestine.

terms.name: Abnormal stomach morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the stomach.

terms.name: Gastroparesis
terms.definition: Decreased strength of the muscle layer of stomach, which leads to a decreased ability to empty the contents of the stomach despite the absence of obstruction.

terms.name: Gastrointestinal dysmotility
terms.definition: Abnormal intestinal contractions, such as spasms and intestinal paralysis, related to the loss of the ability of the gut to coordinate muscular activity because of endogenous or exogenous causes.

terms.name: Volvulus
terms.definition: Abnormal twisting of a portion of intestine around itself or around a stalk of mesentery tissue.

terms.name: Atrophic gastritis
terms.definition: Atrophic gastritis (AG) is a histopathological entity that is characterized by chronic inflammation of the gastric mucosa with loss of gastric glandular cells and replacement by intestinal-type epithelium, pyloric-type glands, and fibrous tissue.

terms.name: Colitis
terms.definition: Colitis refers to an inflammation of the colon and is often used to describe an inflammation of the large intestine (colon, cecum and rectum). Colitides may be acute and self-limited or chronic, and broadly fit into the category of digestive diseases.

terms.name: Intestinal bleeding
terms.definition: Bleeding from the intestines.

terms.name: Abnormal peritoneum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the peritoneum.

terms.name: Peritonitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the peritoneum.

terms.name: Projectile vomiting
terms.definition: Vomiting that ejects the gastric contents with great force.

terms.name: Duodenal ulcer
terms.definition: An erosion of the mucous membrane in a portion of the duodenum.

terms.name: Polyphagia
terms.definition: A neurological anomaly with gross overeating associated with an abnormally strong desire or need to eat.

terms.name: Gastric ulcer
terms.definition: An ulcer, that is, an erosion of an area of the gastric mucous membrane.

terms.name: Intestinal lymphangiectasia
terms.definition: Angiectasia of lymph vessels (i.e., dilatation of lymphatic vessels) in the intestines.

terms.name: Pancreatic hypoplasia
terms.definition: Hypoplasia of the pancreas.

terms.name: Ileus
terms.definition: Acute obstruction of the intestines preventing passage of the contents of the intestines.

terms.name: Abnormality of the vasculature
terms.definition: An abnormality of the vasculature.

terms.name: Head titubation
terms.definition: A head tremor of moderate speed (3 to 4 Hz) in the anterior-posterior direction.

terms.name: Hyporeflexia of lower limbs
terms.definition: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in the lower limbs. Reflexes are elicited by stretching the tendon of a muscle, e.g., by tapping.

terms.name: Paresis of extensor muscles of the big toe
Gastrointestinal telangiectasia
synonyms: Small, enlarged blood vessels near skin
terms.definition: Telangiectasia affecting the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Hepatic necrosis
terms.definition: The presence of cell death (necrosis) affecting the liver.

terms.name: Bowel incontinence
terms.definition: Involuntary fecal soiling in adults and children who have usually already been toilet trained.

terms.name: Celiac disease
terms.definition: Celiac disease (CD) is an autoimmune condition affecting the small intestine, triggered by the ingestion of gluten, the protein fraction of wheat, barley, and rye. Clinical manifestations of CD are highly variable and include both gastrointestinal and non-gastrointestinal features. The hallmark of CD is an immune-mediated enteropathy. This term is included because the occurrence of CD is seen as a feature of a number of other diseases.

terms.name: Congenital hepatic fibrosis
synonyms: Excessive buildup of connective tissue and scarring of liver at birth
terms.definition: The presence of fibrosis of that part of the liver with congenital onset.

terms.name: Biliary cirrhosis
terms.definition: Progressive destruction of the small-to-medium bile ducts of the intrahepatic biliary tree, which leads to progressive cholestasis and often end-stage liver disease.

terms.name: Hepatic periportal necrosis
terms.definition: A type of hepatic necrosis that is concentrated around the necrosis of hepatocytes localized around the intrahepatic branch of portal vein.

terms.name: Hypotension
terms.definition: Low Blood Pressure, vascular hypotension.

terms.name: Aortic root aneurysm
synonyms: Bulge in wall of root of large artery that carries blood away from heart
terms.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the aortic root.

terms.name: Vascular dilatation
synonyms: Wider than typical opening or gap
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the diameter of an artery or vein, either as a diffuse dilatation or as a localized, sac-like outpouching of the vessel wall (aneurysm).

terms.name: Varicose veins
terms.definition: Enlarged and tortuous veins.

terms.name: Atherosclerosis
terms.definition: A condition characterized by patchy atheromas or atherosclerotic plaques which develop in the walls of medium-sized and large arteries and can lead to arterial stenosis with reduced or blocked blood flow.

terms.name: Overriding aorta
terms.definition: An overriding aorta is a congenital heart defect where the aorta is positioned directly over a ventricular septal defect, instead of over the left ventricle. The result is that the aorta receives some blood from the right ventricle, which reduces the amount of oxygen in the blood. It is one of the four conditions of the Tetralogy of Fallot. The aortic root can be displaced toward the front (anteriorly) or directly above the septal defect, but it is always abnormally located to the right of the root of the pulmonary artery. The degree of override is quite variable, with 5-95% of the valve being connected to the right ventricle.

terms.name: Abnormal venous morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of vein.

terms.name: Deep venous thrombosis
synonyms: Blood clot in a deep vein
terms.definition: Formation of a blot clot in a deep vein. The clot often blocks blood flow, causing swelling and pain. The deep veins of the leg are most often affected.

terms.name: Venous varicosities of celiac and mesenteric vessels
synonyms: Venous varicosities of coeliac and mesenteric vessels
terms.definition: Elongated and tortuous mesenteric veins, which comprise the inferior mesenteric vein and the superior mesenteric vein.

terms.name: Right aortic arch with mirror image branching
terms.definition: The aortic arch crosses the right mainstem bronchus and not the left mainstem bronchus, but does not result in the creation of a vascular ring. The first branch is the left brachiocephalic artery which divides into the left carotid artery and left subclavian artery, the second branch is the right carotid artery, the third branch is the right subclavian artery.

terms.name: Gastrointestinal arteriovenous malformation
terms.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Fat malabsorption
terms.definition: Abnormality of the absorption of fat from the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Vasculitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of blood vessel.

terms.name: Arteriosclerosis
terms.definition: Sclerosis (hardening) of the arteries with increased thickness of the wall of arteries as well as increased stiffness and a loss of elasticity.

terms.name: Type IV atherosclerotic lesion
terms.definition: In type IV atherosclerotic lesions a dense accumulation of extracellular lipid occupies an extensive but well-defined region of the intima. This type of extracellular lipid accumulation is known as the lipid core. A fibrous tissue increase is not a feature, and complications such as defects of the lesion surface and thrombosis are not present. The type IV lesion is also known as atheroma. Type IV is the first lesion considered advanced in this classification because of the severe intimal disorganization caused by the lipid core. The characteristic core appears to develop from an increase and the consequent confluence of the small isolated pools of extracellular lipid that characterize type III lesions. The increase in lipid is believed to result from continued insudation from the plasma. Type IV lesions, when they first appear in younger people, are found in the same locations as adaptive intimal thickenings of the eccentric type. Thus, atheroma is, at least initially, an eccentric lesion.

terms.name: Dilatation of an abdominal artery
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in an artery that originates from the abdominal aorta.

terms.name: Cerebral ischemia
synonyms: Disruption of blood oxygen supply to brain
terms.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to the brain associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue.

terms.name: Superficial thrombophlebitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of a superficial vein associated with venous thrombosis (blood clot formation within the vein).

terms.name: Budd-Chiari syndrome
terms.definition: Budd-Chiari syndrome (BCS) is caused by obstruction of hepatic venous outflow at any level from the small hepatic veins to the junction of the inferior vena cava (IVC) with the right atrium, 1 and occurs in 1/100,000 of the general population worldwide. The most common presentation is with ascites, but can range from fulminant hepatic failure (FHF) to asymptomatic forms. Obstruction of hepatic venous outflow is mainly caused by primary intravascular thrombosis, which can occur suddenly or be repeated over time, accompanied by some revascularization, accounting for the variable parenchymal hepatic damage and histologic presentation. Budd-Chiari syndrome is thus a disease, but since it occurs as a manifestation of several other diseases, this term is kept for the present for convenience.

terms.name: Hypertension associated with pheochromocytoma
terms.name_zh: 嗜铬细胞瘤相关性高血压
terms.definition: A type of hypertension associated with pheochromocytoma.

terms.name: Arteriovenous fistulas of celiac and mesenteric vessels
terms.name_zh: 腹腔及肠系膜血管动静脉瘘
synonyms: Arteriovenous fistulas of coeliac and mesenteric vessels

terms.name: Neonatal respiratory distress
terms.definition: Respiratory difficulty as newborn.

terms.name: Abnormal pelvic girdle bone morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of pelvic girdle bone
Abnormality of pelvic girdle bone morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the bony pelvic girdle, which is a ring of bones connecting the vertebral column to the femurs.

terms.name: Wormian bones
synonyms: Islands of bone within cranial sutures
terms.definition: The presence of extra bones within a cranial suture. Wormian bones are irregular isolated bones which appear in addition to the usual centers of ossification of the cranium.

terms.name: Aortic dissection
synonyms: Tear in inner wall of large artery that carries blood away from heart
terms.definition: Aortic dissection refers to a tear in the intimal layer of the aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers of the aorta.

terms.name: Scoliosis
synonyms: Cobb angle greater than ten degrees
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormal lateral curvature of the spine.

terms.name: Skeletal dysplasia
terms.definition: A general term describing features characterized by abnormal development of bones and connective tissues.

terms.name: Bone pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to bone.

terms.name: Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia
terms.definition: A disorder of bone growth affecting the vertebrae and the ends of the long bones (epiphyses).

terms.name: Epiphyseal dysplasia
synonyms: Abnormal development of the ends of long bones in arms and legs

terms.name: Increased susceptibility to fractures
terms.definition: An abnormally increased tendency to fractures of bones caused by an abnormal reduction in bone strength that is generally associated with an increased risk of fracture.

terms.name: Painless fractures due to injury
terms.definition: An increased tendency to fractures following trauma, with fractures occurring without pain.

terms.name: Delayed epiphyseal ossification
synonyms: Delayed maturation of end part of long bone

terms.name: Neoplasm
terms.definition: An organ or organ-system abnormality that consists of uncontrolled autonomous cell-proliferation which can occur in any part of the body as a benign or malignant neoplasm (tumor).

terms.name: Lymphoma
terms.definition: A cancer originating in lymphocytes and presenting as a solid tumor of lymhpoid cells.

terms.name: Pheochromocytoma
terms.definition: Pheochromocytomas (also known as chromaffin tumors) produce, store, and secrete catecholamines. Pheochromocytomas usually originate from the adrenal medulla but may also develop from chromaffin cells in or about sympathetic ganglia. A common symptom of pheochromocytoma is hypertension owing to release of catecholamines.

terms.name: Nephroblastoma
terms.definition: The presence of a nephroblastoma, which is a neoplasm of the kidney that primarily affects children.

terms.name: Paraganglioma
terms.definition: A carotid body tumor (also called paraganglionoma or chemodectoma) is a tumor found in the upper neck at the branching of the carotid artery. They arise from the chemoreceptor organ (paraganglion) located in the adventitia of the carotid artery bifurcation.

terms.name: Osteosarcoma
terms.definition: A malignant bone tumor that usually develops during adolescence and usually affects the long bones including the tibia, femur, and humerus. The typical symptoms of osteosarcoma comprise bone pain, fracture, limitation of motion, and tenderness or swelling at the site of the tumor.

terms.name: Basal cell carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a basal cell carcinoma of the skin.

terms.name: Coxa valga
terms.definition: Coxa valga is a deformity of the hip in which the angle between the femoral shaft and the femoral neck is increased compared to age-adjusted values (about 150 degrees in newborns gradually reducing to 120-130 degrees in adults).

terms.name: Cloverleaf skull
terms.definition: Trilobar skull configuration when viewed from the front or behind.

terms.name: Small foramen magnum
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the foramen magnum.

terms.name: Abnormal sella turcica morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the sella turcica, a saddle-shaped depression in the sphenoid bone at the base of the human skull.

terms.name: J-shaped sella turcica
terms.definition: A deformity of the sella turcica whereby the sella extends further anterior than normal such that the anterior clinoid process appears to overhang it, giving the appearance of the letter J on imaging of the skull.

terms.name: Broad skull
terms.definition: Increased width of the skull.

terms.name: Abnormal calvaria morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the shape of calvarium
terms.definition: Abnormality of the morphology (structure) of the calvaria (skullcap), that is, of that part of the skull that is made up of the superior portions of the frontal bone, occipital bone, and parietal bones and covers the cranial cavity that contains the brain.

terms.name: Thickened calvaria
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally thick calvaria.

terms.name: Pregnancy history
terms.definition: Medical history of maternal diseases, exposures, or other relevant findings during the pregnancy of which the index person was the product.

terms.name: Abnormality of frontal sinus
terms.definition: An abnormality of the frontal sinus, one of the mucosa-lined, normally air-filled paranasal sinuses of the bones of the skull. The frontal sinus is located within the frontal bone.

terms.name: Absent frontal sinuses
terms.definition: Aplasia of frontal sinus.

terms.name: Absent paranasal sinuses
terms.definition: Aplasia of the paranasal sinuses.

terms.name: Large sella turcica
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement of the sella turcica.

terms.name: Platybasia
synonyms: Increased basal angle of skull base
Obtuse basal angle of skull base
terms.definition: A developmental malformation of the occipital bone and upper end of the cervical spine, in which the latter appears to have pushed the floor of the occipital bone upward such that there is an abnormal flattening of the skull base.

terms.name: Abnormal skull base morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the base of the skull, which forms the floor of the cranial cavity and separates the brain from other facial structures. The skull base is made up of five bones: the ethmoid, sphenoid, occipital, paired frontal, and paired parietal bones, and is subdivided into 3 regions: the anterior, middle, and posterior cranial fossae. The petro-occipital fissure subdivides the middle cranial fossa into 1 central component and 2 lateral components.

terms.name: Sclerosis of skull base
terms.definition: Increased bone density of the skull base without significant changes in bony contour.

terms.name: Abnormal parietal bone morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the parietal bone of skull
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the parietal bone of the skull.

terms.name: Parietal foramina
synonyms: Persistent foramina of the parietal bones
Symmetrical, oval defects in the parietal bone
terms.definition: The presence of symmetrical and circular openings (foramina) in the parietal bone ranging in size from a few millimeters to several centimeters wide.

terms.name: Abnormal foramen magnum morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the foramen magnum.

terms.name: Large foramen magnum
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the size of the foramen magnum.

terms.name: Abnormality of skull ossification
synonyms: Abnormality of bone calcification of calvarium
Abnormality of bone calcification of cranium
Abnormality of bone calcification of skull
Abnormality of bone formation of calvarium
Abnormality of bone formation of cranium
Abnormality of bone mineralization of calvarium
Abnormality of bone mineralization of cranium
Abnormality of bone mineralization of skull
terms.definition: An abnormality of the process of ossification of the skull.

terms.name: High, narrow palate
synonyms: Narrow, highly arched roof of mouth
terms.definition: The presence of a high and narrow palate.

terms.name: Palate telangiectasia
synonyms: Spider veins of the roof of the mouth
Telangiectasia of the roof of the mouth
terms.definition: The presence of small (ca. 0.5-1.0 mm) dilated blood vessels near the surface of the mucous membranes of the palate.

terms.name: Prominent median palatal raphe
synonyms: Prominent central ridge on roof of the mouth
terms.definition: Unusual prominence of the median palatal raphe, which is the ridge formed by the fusion of the two plates of the skull that form the hard palate.

terms.name: Commissural lip pit
synonyms: Lip pits at corners of the mouth
Pits at the corners of the lips
terms.definition: A depression located at an oral commissure.

terms.name: Exaggerated median tongue furrow
terms.definition: Increased depth of the median tongue furrow.

terms.name: Downturned corners of mouth
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of the mouth in which the angle of the mouth is downturned. The oral commissures are positioned inferior to the midline labial fissure.

terms.name: Abnormality of the immune system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the immune system.

terms.name: Lymphadenopathy
terms.definition: Enlargement (swelling) of a lymph node.

terms.name: Recurrent bacterial infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of bacterial infection.

terms.name: Recurrent infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to infections as manifested by repeated bouts of infection.

terms.name: Decreased circulating IgA concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白A浓度降低
terms.definition: Decreased levels of immunoglobulin A (IgA).

terms.name: Immunodeficiency
terms.definition: Failure of the immune system to protect the body adequately from infection, due to the absence or insufficiency of some component process or substance.

terms.name: Recurrent abscess formation
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to abscess formation, as manifested by a medical history of recurrent abscesses.

terms.name: Absence of bactericidal oxidative respiratory burst in phagocytes
terms.name_zh: 吞噬细胞杀菌性氧化呼吸爆发缺失
terms.definition: An absence of the phase of elevated metabolic activity, during which oxygen consumption increases, that occurs in neutrophils, monocytes, and macrophages shortly after phagocytosing material. An enhanced uptake of oxygen leads to the production, by an NADH dependent system, of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2), superoxide anions and hydroxyl radicals, which play a part in microbiocidal activity.

terms.name: Recurrent Aspergillus infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Aspergillus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Aspergillus infection.

terms.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus
terms.definition: A chronic, relapsing, inflammatory, and often febrile multisystemic disorder of connective tissue, characterized principally by involvement of the skin, joints, kidneys, and serosal membranes.

terms.name: Recurrent Staphylococcus aureus infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Staphylococcus aureus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Staphylococcus aureus infection.

terms.name: Recurrent mucocutaneous candidiasis
synonyms: Chronic candidiasis of mucosa, skin and nails
terms.definition: Recurrent or persistent superficial Candida infections of the skin, mucous membranes, and nails.

terms.name: Follicular hyperplasia
terms.definition: Lymphadenopathy (enlargement of lymph nodes) owing to hyperplasia of follicular (germinal) centers.

terms.name: Chronic noninfectious lymphadenopathy
terms.name_zh: 慢性非感染性淋巴结病
terms.definition: A chronic form of lymphadenopathy that is not related to infection.

terms.name: Decreased T cell apoptosis
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories.

terms.name: Lymph node hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the lymph nodes.

terms.name: Abnormal lymph node morphology
terms.definition: A structural lymph node abnormality.

terms.name: Thick skull base
synonyms: Increased thickness of bone of skull base

terms.name: Hypoplastic frontal sinuses
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of frontal sinus.

terms.name: Recurrent Escherichia coli infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Escherichia coli infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Escherichia coli infection.

terms.name: Recurrent Serratia infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Serratia infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Serratia infection.

terms.name: Recurrent Klebsiella infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Klebsiella infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Klebsiella infection.

terms.name: Recurrent enteroviral infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to enteroviral infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of enteroviral infection.

terms.name: Oral leukoplakia
terms.definition: A thickened white patch on the oral mucosa that cannot be rubbed off.

terms.name: Respiratory insufficiency due to muscle weakness
synonyms: Decreased lung function due to weak breathing muscles
Decreased respiratory function due to muscle weakness
Respiratory distress due to muscle weakness
Respiratory failure due to muscle weakness

terms.name: Rickets
terms.definition: Rickets is divided into two major categories including calcipenic and phosphopenic. Hypophosphatemia is described as a common manifestation of both categories. Hypophosphatemic rickets is the most common type of rickets that is characterized by low levels of serum phosphate, resistance to ultraviolet radiation or vitamin D intake. There are several issues involved in hypophosphatemic rickets such as calcium, vitamin D, phosphorus deficiencies. Moreover, other disorder can be associated with its occurrence such as absorption defects due to pancreatic, intestinal, gastric, and renal disorders and hepatobiliary disease. Symptoms are usually seen in childhood and can be varied in severity. Severe forms may be linked to bowing of the legs, poor bone growth, and short stature as well as joint and bone pain. Hypophosphatemic rickets are associated with renal excretion of phosphate, hypophosphatemia, and mineral defects in bones. The familial type of the disease is the most common type of rickets.

terms.name: Osteomalacia
terms.definition: Osteomalacia is a general term for bone weakness owing to a defect in mineralization of the protein framework known as osteoid. This defective mineralization is mainly caused by lack in vitamin D. Osteomalacia in children is known as rickets.

terms.name: Delayed skeletal maturation
terms.definition: A decreased rate of skeletal maturation. Delayed skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.

terms.name: Kyphoscoliosis
terms.definition: An abnormal curvature of the spine in both a coronal (lateral) and sagittal (back-to-front) plane.

terms.name: Thin bony cortex
terms.definition: Abnormal thinning of the cortical region of bones.

terms.name: Osteomyelitis
terms.definition: Osteomyelitis is an inflammatory process accompanied by bone destruction and caused by an infecting microorganism.

terms.name: Pathologic fracture
terms.definition: A pathologic fracture occurs when a bone breaks in an area that is weakened secondarily to another disease process such as tumor, infection, and certain inherited bone disorders. A pathologic fracture can occur without a degree of trauma required to cause fracture in healthy bone.

terms.name: Recurrent fractures
terms.definition: The repeated occurrence of bone fractures (implying an abnormally increased tendency for fracture).

terms.name: Osteoarthritis
terms.definition: Degeneration (wear and tear) of articular cartilage, i.e., of the joint surface. Joint degeneration may be accompanied by osteophytes (bone overgrowth), narrowing of the joint space, regions of sclerosis at the joint surface, or joint deformity.

terms.name: Generalized joint hypermobility
terms.definition: Joint hypermobility (ability of a joint to move beyond its normal range of motion) affecting many or all joints of the body. In individuals with Joint hypermobility at multiple sites (usually five or more), the term generalized joint hypermobility is preferred.

terms.name: Multiple exostoses
terms.definition: Presence of more than one exostosis. An exostosis is a benign growth the projects outward from the bone surface. It is capped by cartilage, and arises from a bone that develops from cartilage.

terms.name: Abnormal cartilage morphology
terms.definition: Any morphological abnormality of cartilage.

terms.name: Stippled chondral calcification
terms.definition: Punctate (speckled, dot-like) deposition of calcium of calcium salts in the articular cartilage (cartilage located in joints).

terms.name: Abnormal tracheal morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the trachea.

terms.name: Bronchomalacia
terms.definition: Weakness or softness of the cartilage in the walls of the bronchial tubes.

terms.name: Upper airway obstruction
terms.definition: Increased resistance to the passage of air in the upper airway.

terms.name: Recurrent lower respiratory tract infections
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to lower respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent lower respiratory tract infections.

terms.name: Tracheobronchomalacia
terms.definition: Weakness of the cartilage in the trachea and the bronchi, resulting in a floppy (non-rigid) airway. Affected persons may have difficulties to maintain patency of the airways.

terms.name: Tracheal calcification
terms.definition: Calcification (abnormal deposits of calcium) in the tracheal tissues.

terms.name: Recurrent upper respiratory tract infections
synonyms: Recurrent upper respiratory and lower respiratory infections
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections (running ears - otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).

terms.name: Tachypnea
synonyms: Increased respiratory rate or depth of breathing
terms.definition: Very rapid breathing.

terms.name: Hypoventilation
terms.definition: A reduction in the amount of air transported into the pulmonary alveoli by breathing, leading to hypercapnia (increase in the partial pressure of carbon dioxide).

terms.name: Reduced vital capacity
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction on the vital capacity, which is defined as the total lung capacity (volume of air in the lungs at maximal inflation) less the residual volume (i.e., volume of air in the lungs following maximal exhalation) of the lung.

terms.name: Abnormal pattern of respiration
terms.definition: An anomaly of the rhythm or depth of breathing.

terms.name: Abnormal respiratory system physiology
terms.name_zh: 呼吸系统生理功能异常
terms.definition: Abnormal function of the respiratory system.

terms.name: Osteolysis
terms.definition: Osteolysis refers to the destruction of bone through bone resorption with removal or loss of calcium.

terms.name: Congenital contracture
terms.definition: One or more flexion contractures (a bent joint that cannot be straightened actively or passively) that are present at birth.

terms.name: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita
terms.name_zh: 先天性多发性关节挛缩症
terms.definition: Multiple congenital contractures in different body areas.

terms.name: Kyphosis
terms.definition: Exaggerated anterior convexity of the thoracic vertebral column.

terms.name: Dumbbell-shaped metaphyses
synonyms: Dumbbell shaped wide portion of long bone

terms.name: Coxa vara
terms.definition: Coxa vara includes all forms of decrease of the femoral neck shaft angle (the angle between the neck and the shaft of the femur) to less than 120 degrees.

terms.name: Abnormal limb bone morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of bones of the arms or legs.

terms.name: Abnormality of the lower limb
terms.definition: An abnormality of the leg.

terms.name: Abnormality of the knee
terms.definition: An abnormality of the knee joint or surrounding structures.

terms.name: Genu recurvatum
terms.definition: An abnormally increased extension of the knee joint, so that the knee can bend backwards.

terms.name: Abnormality of the upper limb
terms.definition: An abnormality of the arm.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the radius
terms.definition: An abnormality of the radius.

terms.name: Abnormal femur morphology
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the femur.

terms.name: Caudal appendage
terms.definition: The presence of a tail-like skin appendage located adjacent to the sacrum.

terms.name: Halberd-shaped pelvis
terms.definition: An anomalous radiographic appearance of the developing pelvis, in which the greater ischiadic noth (incisura ischiadica major) is shallow and the pelvis takes on the appearance said to resemble a halberd (a weapon especially of the 15th and 16th centuries consisting typically of a battle-ax and pike mounted on a handle).

terms.name: Hip dislocation
terms.definition: Displacement of the femur from its normal location in the hip joint.

terms.name: Arthralgia
terms.definition: Joint pain.

terms.name: Calcific stippling
terms.definition: An abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) pattern of calcifications in soft tissues within or surrounding bones (as observed on radiographs).

terms.name: Cystic angiomatosis of bone
synonyms: Lytic cystic lesions in appendicular bones
terms.definition: Disseminated multifocal hemangiomatous or lymphangiomatous lesions of the skeleton. The lesions are lytic, well-defined, round or oval lesions within the medullary cavity, and they have an intact cortex, and manifest variable peripheral sclerosis and may exhibit endosteal scalloping.

terms.name: Aspiration
terms.definition: Inspiration of a foreign object into the airway.

terms.name: Bladder exstrophy
terms.definition: Eversion of the posterior bladder wall through the congenitally absent lower anterior abdominal wall and anterior bladder wall.

terms.name: Recurrent bronchitis
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to bronchitis as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchitis.

terms.name: Urinary bladder sphincter dysfunction
terms.definition: Abnormal function of a sphincter of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Lymphadenitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of a lymph node.

terms.name: Recurrent fungal infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to fungal infections as manifested by multiple episodes of fungal infection.

terms.name: Abnormal T cell morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of total or subset T cell count. T cells are commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, or their subpopulations, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, measured ex vivo. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

terms.name: Abnormal B cell morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of B cells.

terms.name: Impaired memory B cell generation
terms.definition: Impaired production of memory cells, the B cells that persist for years or an entire lifetime and which confer rapid and enhanced response to secondary challenge.

terms.name: Decreased specific anti-polysaccharide antibody concentration
terms.name_zh: 特异性抗多糖抗体浓度降低
synonyms: Depressed antibody response to polysaccharide antigens
terms.definition: The presence of normal overall immunoglobulin levels with deficiency of specific immunoglobulins directed against bacterial polysaccharides.

terms.name: Absence of lymph node germinal center
synonyms: Absence of lymph node germinal centre
terms.definition: Absence of germinal centers in lymph nodes. Germinal centers are the parts of lymph nodes in which B lymphocytes proliferate, differentiate, mutate through somatic hypermutation and class switch during antibody responses.

terms.name: Decreased circulating IgM concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白M浓度降低
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin M (IgM) in blood.

terms.name: Increased double-negative T cell number
synonyms: Elevated proportion of CD4-negative, CD8-negative T cells
Increased number of CD4-/CD8- T cells expressing alpha/beta T-cell receptors
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of double negative (DN) CD3+CD4-CD8- T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

terms.name: Increased HLA-DR+ CD4+ T cell proportion
terms.name_zh: HLA-DR阳性CD4阳性T细胞比例升高
synonyms: Increased HLA DR+ CD4+ T cell proportion
Increased HLA DR+ T cell proportion
Increased proportion of HLA DR+ T cells
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of the activated HLA-DR+ CD4+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Genu valgum
terms.definition: The legs angle inward, such that the knees are close together and the ankles far apart.

terms.name: Meningioma
terms.definition: The presence of a meningioma, i.e., a benign tumor originating from the dura mater or arachnoid mater.

terms.name: Squamous cell carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.

terms.name: Melanoma
terms.definition: The presence of a melanoma, a malignant cancer originating from pigment producing melanocytes. Melanoma can originate from the skin or the pigmented layers of the eye (the uvea).

terms.name: Bladder carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a carcinoma of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Myelodysplasia
terms.definition: Clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorders characterized by dysplasia (ineffective production) in one or more hematopoietic cell lineages, leading to anemia and cytopenia.

terms.name: Medullary thyroid carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a medullary carcinoma of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Hypoplastic iliac wing
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ilium ala.

terms.name: Abnormal ilium morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the ilium, the largest and uppermost bone of the pelvis.

terms.name: Narrow iliac wing
terms.definition: Decreased width of the wing (or ala) of the ilium (which is the large expanded portion which bounds the greater pelvis laterally).

terms.name: Flared iliac wing
terms.definition: Widening of the ilium ala, that is of the wing of the ilium, combined with external rotation, leading to a flared appearance of the iliac wing.

terms.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
terms.definition: Obstructive Sleep Apnea is a condition characterized by the obstruction of the airway and pauses in breathing during sleep, which occur multiple times throughout the night. It is related to the relaxation of muscle tone that typically happens during sleep, leading to a partial collapse of the soft tissues in the airway and causing airflow obstruction.

terms.name: Central apnea
terms.definition: Apnea resulting from depression of the respiratory centers in the medulla oblongata. There is a lack of respiratory effort rather than obstruction of airflow.

terms.name: Apneic episodes precipitated by illness, fatigue, stress
terms.name_zh: 疾病、疲劳、应激诱发的呼吸暂停发作
synonyms: Episodic apnea induced by febrile illness or stress
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of apnea that are precipitated by factors such as illness, fatigue, or stress.

terms.name: Exertional dyspnea
synonyms: Shortness of breathing upon physical activity
terms.definition: Perceived difficulty to breathe that occurs with exercise or exertion and improves with rest.

terms.name: Episodic tachypnea
terms.definition: Episodes of very rapid breathing.

terms.name: Nocturnal hypoventilation
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in alveolar ventilation occurring during sleep. This is characterized by a rise in arterial carbon dioxide.

terms.name: Respiratory failure
terms.definition: A severe form of respiratory insufficiency characterized by inadequate gas exchange such that the levels of oxygen or carbon dioxide cannot be maintained within normal limits.

terms.name: Anisospondyly
terms.definition: Abnormally increased variability of the size of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Sudden episodic apnea
terms.definition: Recurrent bouts of sudden, severe apnea that may be life-threatening.

terms.name: Hyperventilation
terms.definition: Hyperventilation refers to an increased pulmonary ventilation rate that is faster than necessary for the exchange of gases. Hyperventilation can result from increased frequency of breathing, an increased tidal volume, or both, and leads to an excess intake of oxygen and the blowing off of carbon dioxide.

terms.name: Hepatoblastoma
terms.definition: A kind of neoplasm of the liver that originates from immature liver precursor cells and macroscopically is composed of tissue resembling fetal or mature liver cells or bile ducts.

terms.name: Medulloblastoma
terms.definition: A rapidly growing embryonic tumor arising in the posterior part of the cerebellar vermis and neuroepithelial roof of the fourth ventricle in children. More rarely, medulloblastoma arises in the cerebellum in adults.

terms.name: Vagal paraganglioma
terms.definition: A tumor that develops in the retrostyloid compartment of the parapharyngeal space, arising from an island of paraganglion tissue derived from the neural crest that is located on the vagus nerve.

terms.name: Ependymoma
terms.definition: The presence of an ependymoma of the central nervous system.

terms.name: Thyroid carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a carcinoma of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
terms.definition: The presence of a leiomyosarcoma of the uterus.

terms.name: Pituitary adenoma
terms.definition: A benign epithelial tumor derived from intrinsic cells of the adenohypophysis (anterior pituitary).

terms.name: Neoplasm of the pancreas
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the pancreas.

terms.name: Papillary thyroid carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a papillary adenocarcinoma of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the liver
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the liver.

terms.name: Parathyroid adenoma
terms.definition: A benign tumor of the parathyroid gland that can cause hyperparathyroidism.

terms.name: Hypokalemia
terms.definition: The concentration of potassium(1+) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypocalcemia
terms.definition: The concentration of calcium in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyponatremia
terms.definition: The concentration of sodium in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyperbilirubinemia
terms.definition: An increased amount of bilirubin in the blood.

terms.name: Hyperphosphatemia
synonyms: Elevated phosphate ion level in blood
Increased phosphate ion level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of phosphate ion in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Microscopic hematuria
synonyms: Small amount of blood in urine
terms.definition: Microscopic hematuria detected by dipstick or microscopic examination of the urine.

terms.name: Generalized aminoaciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of all types of amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating hepatic transaminase concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环肝转氨酶浓度升高
terms.definition: Elevations of the levels of SGOT and SGPT in the serum. SGOT (serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase) and SGPT (serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase) are transaminases primarily found in the liver and heart and are released into the bloodstream as the result of liver or heart damage. SGOT and SGPT are used clinically mainly as markers of liver damage.

terms.name: Methylmalonic acidemia
synonyms: Elevated methylmalonic acid level in blood
Increased methylmalonic acid level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of methylmalonic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Myoglobinuria
terms.definition: Presence of myoglobin in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperchloriduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of chloride in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormality of chromosome segregation
terms.definition: An abnormality of chromosome segregation.

terms.name: Hypomagnesemia
terms.definition: The concentration of magnesium in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypermagnesemia
terms.definition: The concentration of magnesium in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Ketonuria
terms.definition: High levels of ketone bodies (acetoacetic acid, beta-hydroxybutyric acid, and acetone) in the urine. Ketone bodies are insignificant in the blood and urine of normal individuals in the postprandial or overnight-fasted state.

terms.name: Decreased circulating ACTH concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环促肾上腺皮质激素浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of corticotropin, also known as adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal cerebrospinal fluid morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Increased CSF protein concentration
terms.definition: Increased concentration of protein in the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Rheumatoid factor positive
terms.definition: The presence in the serum of an autoantibody directed against the Fc portion of IgG.

terms.name: Elevated circulating thyroid-stimulating hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血促甲状腺激素浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormality of thyroid physiology
terms.definition: An abnormal functionality of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Histidinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of histidine in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased activity of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
terms.name_zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物活性降低
synonyms: Decreased activity of the PDH complex

terms.name: Leydig cell insensitivity to gonadotropin
terms.name_zh: 莱迪希细胞促性腺激素不敏感

terms.name: Impaired sensitivity to thyroid hormone
terms.name_zh: 甲状腺激素敏感性减退
synonyms: Elevated serum levels of free thyroid hormone with nonsuppressed TSH
terms.definition: Reduced sensitivity of end organs to thyroid hormone characterized by elevated serum levels of free thyroid hormone with nonsuppressed thyroid stimulating hormone.

terms.name: Aldehyde oxidase deficiency
terms.definition: A reduction in aldehyde oxidase level.

terms.name: Ventral hernia
terms.definition: Ventral hernia refers to a condition in which abdominal contents protrude through a weakened portion of the abdominal wall.

terms.name: Distal sensory impairment
synonyms: Distal sensory impairment in lower limbs
Distal sensory impairment of the lower extremities
Distal sensory loss, upper and lower limbs
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in sensation in the distal portions of the extremities.

terms.name: Hemivertebrae
terms.definition: Absence of one half of the vertebral body.

terms.name: Lumbar hyperlordosis
synonyms: Excessive inward curvature of lower spine
terms.definition: An abnormal accentuation of the inward curvature of the spine in the lumbar region.

terms.name: Thoracic kyphosis
terms.definition: Over curvature of the thoracic region, leading to a round back or if sever to a hump.

terms.name: Intervertebral space narrowing
terms.definition: Decreased height of the intervertebral disk.

terms.name: Cervical kyphosis
terms.definition: Exaggerated convexity of the cervical vertebral column, causing the cervical spine to bow outwards and take on a rounded appearance.

terms.name: Vertebral fusion
terms.definition: A developmental defect leading to the union of two adjacent vertebrae.

terms.name: Fused cervical vertebrae
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more cervical vertebral bodies with one another.

terms.name: Partial absence of cerebellar vermis
terms.definition: Congenital absence of a part of the vermis of cerebellum.

terms.name: Vertebral compression fracture
synonyms: Compression fracture of a vertebral body

terms.name: Granulomatosis
terms.definition: A granulomatous inflammation leading to multiple granuloma formation, which is a specific type of inflammation. A granuloma is a focal compact collection of inflammatory cells, mononuclear cells predominating, usually as a result of the persistence of a non-degradable product and of active cell mediated hypersensitivity.

terms.name: Immune dysregulation
terms.definition: Altered immune function characterized by lymphoid proliferation, immune activation, and excessive autoreactivity often leading to autoimmune/inflammatory complications.

terms.name: Impaired Ig class switch recombination
terms.name_zh: 免疫球蛋白类别转换重组障碍
terms.definition: An impairment of the class-switch recombination process that normally leads B lymphocytes to produce IgG, IgA, or IgE.

terms.name: Autoimmunity
terms.definition: The occurrence of an immune reaction against the organism's own cells or tissues.

terms.name: Abnormal delayed hypersensitivity skin test
terms.name_zh: 迟发型超敏反应皮试异常
terms.definition: Delay in cutaneous immune reaction to specific antigens mediated not by antibodies but by cells. The delayed hypersensitivity test is an immune function test measuring the presence of activated T cells that recognize a specific antigen and is performed by injecting a small amount of the antigen into the skin. The area of the injection is examined 48-72 hours thereafter.

terms.name: Cutaneous anergy
synonyms: Absence of delayed hypersensitivity skin test
Lack of delayed skin hypersensitivity reaction
terms.definition: Inability to react to a delayed hypersensitivity skin test.

terms.name: Cubitus valgus
terms.definition: Abnormal positioning in which the elbows are turned out.

terms.name: Genu varum
terms.definition: A positional abnormality marked by outward bowing of the legs in which the knees stay wide apart when a person stands with the feet and ankles together.

terms.name: Absent microvilli on the surface of peripheral blood lymphocytes
terms.name_zh: 外周血淋巴细胞表面微绒毛缺如
terms.definition: Absence of the fingerlike protrusive, actin-dependent structures found on the surface of peripheral blood lymphocytes.

terms.name: Reduced delayed hypersensitivity
synonyms: Decreased reactivity to skin test antigens
terms.definition: Decreased ability to react to a delayed hypersensitivity skin test.

terms.name: Abnormal forearm morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the lower arm.

terms.name: Radioulnar synostosis
terms.definition: An abnormal osseous union (fusion) between the radius and the ulna.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the central nervous system
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of tissue in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Bowing of the legs
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature affecting a long bone of the leg.

terms.name: Femoral bowing
terms.definition: Bowing (abnormal curvature) of the femur.

terms.name: Abnormality of the calf
terms.definition: An abnormality of the calf, i.e. of the posterior part of the lower leg.

terms.name: Tibial bowing
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the tibia.

terms.name: Micromelia
synonyms: Smaller or shorter than typical limbs
terms.definition: The presence of abnormally small extremities.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the radius
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the radius.

terms.name: Radial bowing
synonyms: Bowing of outer large bone of the forearm
Bowing of radius bone of the forearm
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the radius.

terms.name: Elbow flexion contracture
synonyms: Fixed flexion at the elbow joint
terms.definition: An elbow contracture that limits the ability of the elbow joint to be extended (straightened), meaning that the elbow is fixed in an flexed (bent) position.

terms.name: Fibular aplasia
terms.definition: Absence of the fibula.

terms.name: Abnormal fibula morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the calf bone (fibula), one of the two bones of the calf.

terms.name: Abnormal tibia morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the tibia (shinbone).

terms.name: Patellar dislocation
terms.definition: The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar dislocation occurs if the patella fully dislocates out of the groove.

terms.name: Breast carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a carcinoma of the breast.

terms.name: Ganglioneuroma
terms.definition: A benign neoplasm that usually arises from the sympathetic trunk in the mediastinum, representing a tumor of the sympathetic nerve fibers arising from neural crest cells.

terms.name: Neuroblastoma
terms.definition: Neuroblastoma is a solid tumor that originate in neural crest cells of the sympathetic nervous system. Most neuroblastomas originate in the abdomen, and most abdominal neuroblastomas originate in the adrenal gland. Neuroblastomas can also originate in the thorax, usually in the posterior mediastinum.

terms.name: Enhanced neurotoxicity of vincristine
terms.name_zh: 长春新碱神经毒性增强

terms.name: Prolonged bleeding time
terms.definition: Prolongation of the time taken for a standardized skin cut of fixed depth and length to stop bleeding.

terms.name: Abnormality of the musculature
terms.definition: Abnormality originating in one or more muscles, i.e., of the set of muscles of body.

terms.name: Bulging epiphyses
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of epiphyses whereby they are abnormally outwardly curving (protuberant).

terms.name: Flared metaphysis
synonyms: Flared wide portion of long bone
marked metaphyseal flaring of long bones
terms.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of one or more long bones.

terms.name: Metaphyseal widening
synonyms: Broad wide portion of long bone
terms.definition: Abnormal widening of the metaphyseal regions of long bones.

terms.name: Abnormality of the wrist
terms.definition: Abnormality of the wrist, the structure connecting the hand and the forearm.

terms.name: Metaphyseal cupping
terms.definition: Metaphyseal cupping refers to an inward bulging of the metaphyseal profile giving the metaphysis a cup-like appearance.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the ulna
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ulna.

terms.name: Bowing of limbs due to multiple fractures
terms.name_zh: 多发性骨折致肢体弯曲
synonyms: Bowed limbs due to multiple fractures
terms.definition: Curvature of the shafts of the long bones due to multiple fractures.

terms.name: Metaphyseal irregularity
synonyms: Irregular wide portion of a long bone
terms.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of the metaphyses.

terms.name: Short long bone
terms.definition: One or more abnormally short long bone.

terms.name: Mesomelia
synonyms: Disproportionately short middle portion of limb
terms.definition: Shortening of the middle parts of the limbs (forearm and lower leg) in relation to the upper and terminal segments.

terms.name: Abnormality of the ankle
terms.definition: An anomaly of the joint that connects the foot with the leg.

terms.name: Ulnar bowing
terms.definition: Bending of the diaphysis (shaft) of the ulna.

terms.name: Diaphyseal sclerosis
synonyms: Increased bone density in shaft of long bone
terms.definition: An elevation in bone density in one or more diaphyses. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.

terms.name: Enlarged joints
terms.definition: Increase in size of one or more joints.

terms.name: Fibular hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the fibula.

terms.name: Humeroradial synostosis
synonyms: Fusion of upper and lower arm bones
terms.definition: An abnormal osseous union (fusion) between the radius and the humerus.

terms.name: Elbow dislocation
terms.definition: Dislocation of the distal humerus out of the elbow joint, where the radius, ulna, and humerus meet.

terms.name: Abnormal shoulder morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the shoulder, which is defined as the structures surrounding the shoulder joint where the humerus attaches to the scapula.

terms.name: Shoulder flexion contracture
terms.definition: Chronic reduction in active and passive mobility of the shoulder joint due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement.

terms.name: Abnormal patella morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the patella (knee cap).

terms.name: Radial head subluxation
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the head of the radius.

terms.name: Enlarged metaphyses
synonyms: Enlarged wide portion of a long bone
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of one or more metaphyses.

terms.name: Tetraamelia
terms.definition: Amelia of all four limbs.

terms.name: Patellar hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the patella.

terms.name: Limited knee extension
terms.definition: Reduced ability to extend (straighten) the knee joint.

terms.name: Madelung deformity
terms.definition: An anomaly related to partial closure, or failure of development of the ulnar side of the distal radial growth plate, which results in an arrest of epiphyseal growth of the medial and volar portions of the distal radius. This leads to shortening of the radius and relative overgrowth of the ulna.

terms.name: Flattened epiphysis
terms.definition: Abnormal flatness (decreased height) of epiphyses.

terms.name: Hypercalcemia
terms.definition: The concentration of calcium in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypoalbuminemia
terms.definition: The concentration of albumin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyperglycemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glucose in the blood.

terms.name: Hypoproteinemia
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of protein in the blood.

terms.name: Glycosuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glucose in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperlipidemia
terms.definition: An elevated lipid concentration in the blood.

terms.name: Defective DNA repair after ultraviolet radiation damage
terms.name_zh: 紫外线辐射损伤后DNA修复缺陷

terms.name: Hydroxyprolinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of 4-hydroxy-L-proline in the urine.

terms.name: Increased urinary potassium
terms.definition: An increased concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

terms.name: Dislocated radial head
terms.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint.

terms.name: Recurrent long bone fractures
terms.definition: An increased tendency to fractures of the long bones (Mainly, the femur, tibia, fibula, humerus, radius, and ulna).

terms.name: Long fibula
terms.definition: Disproportionately long fibulae.

terms.name: Acromesomelia
terms.definition: Small hands and feet.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the capital femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Underdevelopment of the innermost thighbone end part
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Trophic limb changes
terms.definition: Trophic changes occurring in a limb.

terms.name: Limited hip extension
terms.definition: Limitation of the extension of the hip, i.e., decreased ability to straighten the hip joint and thereby increase the angle between torso and thigh; moving the thigh or top of the pelvis backward.

terms.name: Short femur
terms.definition: An abnormal shortening of the femur.

terms.name: Fibular overgrowth
terms.definition: Relatively increased growth of the fibula compared to that of the tibia.

terms.name: Slender long bone
terms.definition: Reduced diameter of a long bone.

terms.name: Increased carrying angle
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the carrying angle, which is the angle he long axis of the extended forearm as it lies lateral to the long axis of the arm.

terms.name: Abnormal cortical bone morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of compact bone (also known as cortical bone), which forms the dense surface of bones.

terms.name: Protuberances at ends of long bones
synonyms: Protuberances at ends of long bones
terms.definition: The presence of multiple protuberances (bulges, or knobs) at the ends of the long bones.

terms.name: Subperiosteal bone resorption
terms.definition: Loss of bone mass occurring beneath the periosteum (the periosteum is the connective-tissue membrane that surrounds all bones except at the articular surfaces). This process may create a serrated and lace-like appearance in periosteal cortical bone.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating cholesterol concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cholesterol in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyperglycinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glycine in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperphosphaturia
terms.definition: An increased excretion of phosphates in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormality of urine homeostasis
terms.definition: An abnormality of the composition of urine or the levels of its components.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating electrolyte concentration
terms.definition: Abnormality of the homeostasis (concentration) of a monoatomic ion.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating amino acid concentration
synonyms: Abnormality of serum amino acid level
Abnormality of serum amino acid levels
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hypochloremia
terms.definition: The concentration of chloride in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal EKG
terms.definition: Abnormal rhythm of the heart.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating hormone concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of a hormone in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Increased circulating cortisol level
terms.name_zh: 血循环皮质醇水平升高
terms.definition: Overproduction of the hormone of cortisol by the adrenal cortex, resulting in a characteristic combination of clinical symptoms termed Cushing syndrome, with truncal obesity, a round, full face, striae atrophicae and acne, muscle weakness, and other features.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating lipid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a lipid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Limb joint contracture
terms.definition: A contracture (chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin) that prevent normal movement of one or more joints of the limbs.

terms.name: Hypercholesterolemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of cholesterol in the blood.

terms.name: Reduced factor VIII activity
terms.definition: Reduced activity of coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X.

terms.name: Low-molecular-weight proteinuria
terms.definition: Excretion in urine of proteins of a size smaller than albumin (molecular weight 69 kD).

terms.name: Hypocalciuria
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased calcium concentration in the urine.

terms.name: Lactic acidosis
terms.definition: An abnormal buildup of lactic acid in the body, leading to acidification of the blood and other bodily fluids.

terms.name: Abnormal peripheral myelination
terms.definition: An abnormality of the myelination of motor and sensory peripheral nerves. These are axons for motor nerves and dendrites for sensory nerves in the strict anatomic sense.

terms.name: Cystinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of cystine in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal spinocerebellar tract morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the spinocerebellar tracts, a set of axonal fibers originating in the spinal cord and terminating in the ipsilateral cerebellum. The spinocerebellar tract convey information to the cerebellum about limb and joint position (proprioception). They comprise the ventral spinocerebellar tract, the anterior spinocerebellar tract, and the posterior spinocerebellar tract.

terms.name: Abnormality of peripheral nerve conduction
synonyms: Sensory and motor nerve conduction abnormalities
terms.definition: An abnormality of the conduction of electrical impulses by peripheral (motor or sensory) nerves. This finding is elicited by a nerve conduction study (NCS).

terms.name: Prolinuria
terms.definition: Level of proline in the urine anove the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased blood urea nitrogen
terms.definition: An increased amount of nitrogen in the form of urea in the blood.

terms.name: Panhypogammaglobulinemia
terms.definition: A reduction in the circulating levels of all the major classes of immunoglobulin. is characterized by profound decreases in all classes of immunoglobulin with an absence of circulating B lymphocytes.

terms.name: T-wave inversion in the right precordial leads
Elevated circulating LDL-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 血低密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
Increased low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased serum serotonin
terms.definition: A increased concentration of serotonin in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating adenosylcobalamin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环腺苷钴胺浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of adenosylcobalam in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal. Adenosylcobalamin is one of the active forms of vitamin B12.

terms.name: Hypocholesterolemia
terms.definition: An decreased concentration of cholesterol in the blood.

terms.name: Hyperuricosuria
terms.definition: An abnormally high level of uric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Glutaric aciduria
terms.definition: The concentration of glutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Cystathioninuria
terms.definition: An elevated urinary concentration of cystathionine.

terms.name: Increased circulating ACTH level
terms.name_zh: 循环促肾上腺皮质激素水平升高
terms.definition: An abnormal increased in the concentration of corticotropin, also known as adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alkaline phosphatase concentration
terms.name_zh: 血碱性磷酸酶浓度升高
terms.definition: Abnormally increased serum levels of alkaline phosphatase activity.

terms.name: Hyposthenuria
terms.definition: An abnormally low urinary specific gravity, i.e., reduced concentration of solutes in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperoxaluria
synonyms: Increased level of oxalate in urine
terms.definition: Increased excretion of oxalates in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal isoelectric focusing of serum transferrin
terms.name_zh: 血清转铁蛋白等电聚焦异常
terms.definition: Glycosylated transferrin concentrations can be measured in serum as a marker of N-linked glycosylation fidelity. In the traditional nomenclature for congenital disorders of glycosylation, absence of entire glycans was designated type I, and loss of one or more monosaccharides as type II. These terms are retained for historical reasons but for new annotations the precise glycosylation defect should be recorded.

terms.name: 4-Hydroxyphenylpyruvic aciduria
terms.definition: Increased relative concentration of 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary delta-aminolevulinic acid
terms.definition: An increased concentration of 5-aminolevulinic acid (CHEBI:17549) in the urine.

terms.name: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone deficiency
terms.name_zh: 促性腺激素释放激素缺乏症
terms.definition: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) deficiency (IGD) is characterized by inappropriately low serum concentrations of the gonadotropins LH (luteinizing hormone) and FSH (follicle-stimulating hormone) in the presence of low circulating concentrations of sex steroids (primarily testosterone or estradiol). GnRH is not typically assayed directly because it is released in pulses from the hypothalamus, and its concentration can fluctuate rapidly and in a complex pattern that makes single blood measurements less informative than the pituitary's response.

terms.name: Elevated circulating parathyroid hormone level
terms.name_zh: 血甲状旁腺激素水平升高
terms.definition: An abnormal increased concentration of parathyroid hormone.

terms.name: Increased urinary taurine
terms.definition: Increased concentration of taurine in the urine.

terms.name: Carnosinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of carnosine in the urine.

terms.name: Dibasicaminoaciduria
terms.definition: An increased level of a dibasic amino acid in the urine. Dibasic amino acids are usually referred to simply as basic aminoacids because they contain basic side chains at neutral pH. These are arginine (Arg), lysine (Lys), and histidine (His).

terms.name: Abnormal acetabulum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the acetabulum, i.e., the Acetabular part of hip bone, which together with the head of the femur forms the hip joint.

terms.name: Abnormal pubic bone morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the the pubic bone, i.e., of the ventral and anterior of the three principal components (pubis, ilium, ischium) of the hip bone.

terms.name: Hypoplastic pubic bone
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the pubis, which together with the ilium and the ischium, is one of the three bones that make up the hip bone.

terms.name: Abnormal ischium morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the ischium, which forms the lower and back part of the hip bone.

terms.name: Hypoplastic ischia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ischium, which forms the lower and back part of the hip bone.

terms.name: Squared iliac bones
terms.definition: A shift from the normally round (convex) appearance of the iliac wing towards a square-like appearance.

terms.name: Protrusio acetabuli
terms.definition: Intrapelvic bulging of the medial acetabular wall.

terms.name: Flat acetabular roof
terms.definition: Flattening of the superior part of the acetabulum, which is a cup-shaped cavity at the base of the hipbone into which the ball-shaped head of the femur fits. The acetabular roof thereby appears horizontal rather than arched, as it normally does.

terms.name: Wide pubic symphysis
terms.definition: Abnormally increased width of the pubic symphysis is the midline cartilaginous joint uniting the superior rami of the left and right pubic bones.

terms.name: Decreased hip abduction
terms.definition: Reduced ability to move the femur outward to the side.

terms.name: Short greater sciatic notch
terms.definition: The sacroiliac joint in the bony pelvis connects the sacrum and the ilium of the pelvis, which are joined by strong ligaments. The notch is located directly superior to the joint. This term refers to a reduction in the height of the notch.

terms.name: Inverted nipples
terms.definition: The presence of nipples that instead of pointing outward are retracted inwards.

terms.name: Breast hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the breast.

terms.name: Long nose
terms.definition: Distance from nasion to subnasale more than two standard deviations above the mean, or alternatively, an apparently increased length from the nasal root to the nasal base.

terms.name: Cleft ala nasi
terms.definition: The presence of a notch in the margin of the ala nasi.

terms.name: Allergic rhinitis
terms.definition: It is characterized by one or more symptoms including sneezing, itching, nasal congestion, and rhinorrhea.

terms.name: Short nasal bridge
synonyms: Decreased length of bridge of nose
terms.definition: Decreased superior-inferior length of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose.

terms.name: Short nose
terms.definition: Distance from nasion to subnasale more than two standard deviations below the mean, or alternatively, an apparently decreased length from the nasal root to the nasal tip.

terms.name: Myopathy
terms.definition: A disorder of muscle unrelated to impairment of innervation or neuromuscular junction.

terms.name: Ragged-red muscle fibers
terms.definition: An abnormal appearance of muscle fibers observed on muscle biopsy. Ragged red fibers can be visualized with Gomori trichrome staining as irregular and intensely red subsarcolemmal zones, whereas the normal myofibrils are green. The margins of affect fibers appear red and ragged. The ragged-red is due to the accumulation of abnormal mitochondria below the plasma membrane of the muscle fiber, leading to the appearance of a red rim and speckled sarcoplasm.

terms.name: Rhabdomyolysis
terms.definition: Breakdown of muscle fibers that leads to the release of muscle fiber contents (myoglobin) into the bloodstream.

terms.name: Skeletal muscle atrophy
synonyms: Neurogenic muscle atrophy, especially in the lower limbs
terms.definition: The presence of skeletal muscular atrophy (which is also known as amyotrophy).

terms.name: Decreased neutrophil oxidative burst
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞氧化爆发降低
synonyms: Reduced reactive oxygen species production in neutrophils
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of neutrophil oxidative burst, commonly measured through oxidation of dihydrorhodamine (DHR) using flow cytometry or through nitroblue tetrazolium test (NBT) using optical microscopy, upon stimulation with phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA), E. coli or other ligands.

terms.name: Intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
terms.name_zh: 细胞内自发荧光脂色素贮积物堆积
terms.definition: The intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent storage material.

terms.name: Curvilinear intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
terms.name_zh: 曲线状细胞内自身荧光脂色素贮积物积聚
synonyms: Intracellular curvilinear profiles on ultrastructural analysis
terms.definition: An intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material in a curved pattern.

terms.name: Arterial calcification
terms.definition: Pathological deposition of calcium salts in one or more arteries.

terms.name: Fingerprint intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
terms.name_zh: 细胞内指纹样自身荧光脂色素贮积物堆积
terms.definition: An intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material in a trabecular or fingerprint-like pattern.

terms.name: Decreased pyruvate carboxylase activity
terms.name_zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶活性降低
terms.definition: A decreased rate of pyruvate carboxylase activity.

terms.name: Decreased methylmalonyl-CoA mutase activity
terms.name_zh: 甲基丙二酰辅酶A变位酶活性降低
terms.definition: An abnormality of Krebs cycle metabolism that is characterized by a decreased rate of methylmalonyl-CoA mutase activity.

terms.name: Increased circulating IgE concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased overall level of immunoglobulin E in blood.

terms.name: Deficient excision of UV-induced pyrimidine dimers in DNA
terms.name_zh: DNA中紫外线诱导的嘧啶二聚体切除缺陷

terms.name: Prolonged G2 phase of cell cycle
Dicarboxylic aciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of dicarboxylic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Generalized amyloid deposition
terms.name_zh: 全身性淀粉样物质沉积
terms.definition: A diffuse form of amyloidosis.

terms.name: Hyperglutaminemia
terms.definition: The concentration of glutamine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Oroticaciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of orotic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Ethylmalonic aciduria
terms.definition: The concentration of ethylmalonic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormality of chromosome stability
terms.definition: A type of chromosomal aberration characterized by reduced resistance of chromosomes to change or deterioration.

terms.name: Chromosomal breakage induced by crosslinking agents
terms.name_zh: 交联剂诱导的染色体断裂
synonyms: Chromosomal breakage induced by mitomycin C
terms.definition: Increased amount of chromosomal breaks in cultured blood lymphocytes or other cells induced by treatment with DNA cross-linking agents such as diepoxybutane and mitomycin C.

terms.name: Decreased circulating methylcobalamin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甲钴胺浓度降低
