terms.definition: The concentration of methylcobalamin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal. Methylcobalamin is a form of vitamin B12.

terms.name: Increased cellular sensitivity to UV light
terms.name_zh: 细胞对紫外线敏感性升高

terms.name: Reduced coagulation factor V activity
terms.definition: Decreased activity of coagulation factor V.

terms.name: Rectilinear intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
terms.definition: An intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material in a straight or rectilinear pattern.

terms.name: Hypernatremia
terms.definition: The concentration of sodium in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypertyrosinemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of tyrosine in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating HDL-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环高密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased high-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
Reduced high-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating carnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of carnitine in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypermethioninemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of methionine in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated circulating creatine kinase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环肌酸激酶活性升高
synonyms: Elevated creatine kinase level in blood
Increased creatine kinase level in blood
terms.definition: The activity of creatine kinase in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating IgG concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin G in blood.

terms.name: Hyperpepsinogenemia I
terms.definition: The concentration of pepsinogen I in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Phosphoethanolaminuria
synonyms: Increased level of O-phosphoethanolamine in urine
terms.definition: An increased level of phosphoethanolamine (synonym: O-phosphoethanolamine) in the urine.

terms.name: Increased phosphoribosylpyrophosphate synthetase level
terms.name_zh: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶水平升高
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated level of the enzyme phosphoribosyl pyrophosphatesynthetase, which catalyzes the synthesis of PP-ribose-P from ATP and ribose-5-phosphate.

terms.name: External genital hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of part or all of the external reproductive organs.

terms.name: Penile hypospadias
terms.definition: Location of the urethral opening on the inferior aspect of the penis.

terms.name: Prominent scrotal raphe
terms.definition: Increased size of the ridge of tissue that extends along the midline of the scrotum.

terms.name: Gonadal tissue inappropriate for external genitalia or chromosomal sex
terms.name_zh: 性腺组织与外生殖器或染色体性别不匹配

terms.name: Aplasia of the vagina
terms.definition: Aplasia of the vagina.

terms.name: Abnormality of DNA repair
terms.definition: An abnormality of the process of DNA repair, that is, of the process of restoring DNA after damage.

terms.name: Abnormality of the coagulation cascade
terms.definition: An abnormality of the coagulation cascade, which is comprised of the contact activation pathway (also known as the intrinsic pathway) and the tissue factor pathway (also known as the extrinsic pathway) as well as cofactors and regulators.

terms.name: Elevated circulating creatinine concentration
terms.definition: An increased amount of creatinine in the blood.

terms.name: Hydroxyprolinemia
terms.definition: The concentration of hydroxyproline in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating IgA concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin A in blood.

terms.name: Anti-smooth muscle antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence in serum of antibodies against smooth muscle.

terms.name: Deficiency of N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphotransferase
terms.name_zh: N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖-1-磷酸转移酶缺乏症

terms.name: Neonatal hyperbilirubinemia
synonyms: High blood bilirubin levels in neonate
terms.definition: A type of hyperbilirubinemia with neonatal onset.

terms.name: Reduced orotidine 5-prime phosphate decarboxylase level
terms.definition: An abnormal decrease in orotidine 5'-phosphate decarboxylase level.

terms.name: Argininuria
terms.definition: A increased concentration of arginine in the urine.

terms.name: Abdominal distention
terms.definition: Distention of the abdomen.

terms.name: Visceromegaly
terms.definition: Abnormal increased size of the viscera of the abdomen.

terms.name: Abnormal hip bone morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the hip bone.

terms.name: Hip contracture
terms.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the hip joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

terms.name: Hypoplastic acetabulae
terms.definition: Underdeveloped acetabulae.

terms.name: Narrow pelvis bone
terms.definition: Reduced side to side width of the pelvis.

terms.name: Pelvic bone exostoses
terms.definition: A benign growth the projects outward from the bone surface of the pelvis. Exostoses are capped by cartilage, and arise from a bone that develops from cartilage.

terms.name: Square pelvis bone
terms.definition: An abnormally squared appearance of the bony pelvis, a normally rounded or basin-shaped structure.

terms.name: Coxa magna
terms.definition: Widening of the femoral head and neck.

terms.name: Increased circulating ferritin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环铁蛋白浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of ferritin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating alkaline phosphatase activity
terms.name_zh: 循环碱性磷酸酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alkaline phosphatase outside the upper or lower limtis of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Cystathioninemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of cystathionine in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormality of mitochondrial metabolism
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of mitochondria.

terms.name: Mitochondrial propionyl-CoA carboxylase defect
terms.name_zh: 线粒体丙酰辅酶A羧化酶缺陷

terms.name: Decreased serum leptin
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of leptin in the blood.

terms.name: Hyperthreoninuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of threonine in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperlysinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of lysine in the urine.

terms.name: Spina bifida occulta
terms.definition: The closed form of spina bifida with incomplete closure of a vertebral body with intact overlying skin.

terms.name: Ovoid vertebral bodies
terms.definition: When viewed in lateral radiographs, vertebral bodies have a roughly rectangular configuration. This term applies if the vertebral body appears rounded or oval.

terms.name: Irregular vertebral endplates
terms.definition: An irregular surface of the vertebral end plates, which are normally relatively smooth.

terms.name: Spondylolisthesis
synonyms: Displacement of one backbone compared to another
terms.definition: Complete bilateral fractures of the pars interarticularis resulting in the anterior slippage of the vertebra.

terms.name: Spondylolysis
terms.definition: Spondylolysis is an osseous defect of the pars interarticularis, thought to be a developmental or acquired stress fracture secondary to chronic low-grade trauma.

terms.name: Block vertebrae
terms.definition: Congenital synostosis between two or more adjacent vertebrae (partial or complete fusion of adjacent vertabral bodies).

terms.name: Spinal rigidity
terms.definition: Reduced ability to move the vertebral column with a resulting limitation of neck and trunk flexion.

terms.name: Hyperlordosis
terms.definition: Abnormally increased curvature (anterior concavity) of the lumbar or cervical spine.

terms.name: Cervical subluxation
terms.definition: A partial dislocation of one or more intervertebral joints in the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: Abnormal odontoid process morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal structure of the odontoid process, which is a part of the C2 or axis vertebra and forms pivot of the structures forming the craniovertebral junction. The odontoid process is also known as the dens of the axis.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the odontoid process
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the dens of the axis.

terms.name: Abnormal vertebral body morphology
synonyms: Abnormal form of the vertebral bodies
terms.definition: Abnormal form of vertebral body, which is the central cylindrical portion of the vertebra that together with other structures such as the vertebral arch, pedicles, laminae, spinous process, transverse processes, and articular facets makes up a vertebra.

terms.name: Butterfly vertebrae
terms.definition: A butterfly vertebra (sagittal cleft vertebra or anterior rachischisis) is a sagittal defect in the vertebral body caused by failure of fusion of the two lateral chondrification centers during embryogenesis. The name is based on the appearance of the two hemivertebrae emerging as butterfly wings from the central cleft on x-ray.

terms.name: Abnormality of the cervical spine
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: C1-C2 subluxation
terms.definition: A partial dislocation of the atlantoaxial joints.

terms.name: Generalized muscle weakness
terms.definition: Generalized weakness or decreased strength of the muscles, affecting both distal and proximal musculature.

terms.name: Limb-girdle muscle weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the limb-girdle muscles (also known as the pelvic and shoulder girdles), that is, lack of strength of the muscles around the shoulders and the pelvis.

terms.name: Myalgia
terms.definition: Pain in muscle.

terms.name: Axial muscle weakness
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the axial musculature (i.e., of the muscles of the head and neck, spine, and ribs).

terms.name: Abnormal hairshaft morphology
terms.definition: An abnormal structure of the hairshaft, i.e., of the nongrowing portion of a hair that protrudes from the skin.

terms.name: Hair shafts flattened at irregular intervals and twisted through 180 degrees about their axes
terms.name_zh: 毛干不规则节段性扁平伴轴性180°扭转

terms.name: Abnormal bone structure
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the composite material or the layered arrangement of the bony skeleton.

terms.name: Absent primary metaphyseal spongiosa
terms.name_zh: 初级干骺端松质骨缺失

terms.name: Elevated circulating beta-hexosaminidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环β-己糖胺酶活性升高
terms.definition: The activity of beta-hexosaminidase in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating catecholamine level
terms.name_zh: 血循环儿茶酚胺水平升高
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in catecholamine concentration in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal enchondral ossification
terms.definition: An abnormality of the process of endochondral ossification, which is a type of replacement ossification in which bone tissue replaces cartilage.

terms.name: Reduced prothrombin consumption
terms.definition: The prothrombin consumption test measures the formation of intrinsic thromboplastin by determining the residual serum prothrombin after blood clotting is complete. If there is a defect in the process, less prothrombin will be converted to thrombin than normal (less prothrombin is consumed). This test may be abnormal with conditions including deficiency of factors VIII or IX, with circulating anticoagulants, thrombocytopenia.

terms.name: Focal necrosis of right ventricular muscle cells
terms.name_zh: 右室心肌细胞局灶性坏死

terms.name: Pyrimidine-responsive megaloblastic anemia
synonyms: Anaemia corrected by uridylic acid and cytidylic acid
Anemia corrected by uridylic acid and cytidylic acid
terms.definition: A type of megaloblastic anemia that improves upon administration of pyrimidine supplements such as uridylic acid and cytidylic acid.

terms.name: Lamina lucida cleavage
synonyms: Subepidermal blistering with cleavage in the lamina lucida
terms.definition: The formation of bullae (blisters) with cleavage in the lamina lucida layer of the skin.

terms.name: Reduced glutathione synthetase level
terms.definition: Reduced level of the enzyme glutathione synthetase, which catalyzes the last step in the synthesis of glutathione and a deficiency results in low levels of glutathione. Acidosis is due to reduced feedback inhibition of gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase in the gamma-glutamyl cycle, which ultimately leads to overproduction and accumulation of 5-oxoproline.

terms.name: 3-Methylglutaric aciduria
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary norepinephrine level
terms.name_zh: 尿去甲肾上腺素水平升高
terms.definition: The concentration of noradrenaline in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyperalaninemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of alanine in the blood.

terms.name: Low cholesterol esterification rate
terms.definition: A reduction in the rate of cholesterol esterification.

terms.name: Decreased circulating renin concentration
terms.definition: An decreased level of renin in the blood.

terms.name: Endopolyploidy on chromosome studies of bone marrow
terms.name_zh: 骨髓染色体检查示内多倍体
terms.definition: An increase in the number of chromosome sets per cell in bone marrow cells.

terms.name: Propionyl-CoA carboxylase deficiency
terms.definition: An abnormality of amino acid metabolism characterized by a decreased level of propionyl-CoA carboxylase.

terms.name: Hyperthreoninemia
terms.definition: The concentration of threonine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Aminoaciduria
synonyms: Increased levels of animo acids in urine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of an amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Thymic hormone decreased
terms.definition: A reduction in the level of thymic horomone.

terms.name: Elevated intracellular cystine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of cystine within cells. This finding can be demonstrated on leukocytes, but is not specific to blood cells.

terms.name: Decreased urinary sulfate
terms.definition: Decreased concentration of sulfate in the urine.

terms.name: Tryptophanuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of tryptophan in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating VLDL-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 血极低密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
Increased very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abdominal situs inversus
terms.definition: A left-right reversal (or mirror reflection) of the anatomical location of the viscera of the abdomen.

terms.name: Arthralgia of the hip
terms.definition: Joint pain affecting the hip.

terms.name: Abnormal femoral neck/head morphology
synonyms: Abnormal neck or head of thigh bone
Abnormality of the femoral neck or head region

terms.name: Abnormal femoral neck morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).

terms.name: Abnormal femoral head morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the femoral head.

terms.name: Flat capital femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Flat end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: An abnormal flattening of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Enlargement of the proximal femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Enlarged end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Narrow greater sciatic notch
terms.definition: A narrowing of the sacrosciatic notch, i.e., the deep indentation in the posterior border of the hip bone at the point of union of the ilium and ischium.

terms.name: Steppage gait
terms.definition: An abnormal gait pattern that arises from weakness of the pretibial and peroneal muscles due to a lower motor neuron lesion. Affected patients have footdrop and are unable to dorsiflex and evert the foot. The leg is lifted high on walking so that the toes clear the ground, and there may be a slapping noise when the foot strikes the ground again.

terms.name: Axonal degeneration/regeneration
terms.definition: A pattern of simultaneous degeneration and regeneration of axons (see comment).

terms.name: Decreased number of peripheral myelinated nerve fibers
terms.name_zh: 外周有髓神经纤维数量减少
synonyms: Decreased number of large and small myelinated fibers
Decreased number of large and small myelinated fibres
Decreased number of peripheral myelinated nerve fibres
terms.definition: A loss of myelinated nerve fibers in the peripheral nervous system (in general, this finding can be observed on nerve biopsy).

terms.name: Onion bulb formation
terms.definition: Repeated episodes of segmental demyelination and remyelination lead to the accumulation of supernumerary Schwann cells around axons, which is referred to as onion bulb formation. This finding affects peripheral nerves.

terms.name: Peripheral axonal atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophic changes of axons of the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Decreased number of large peripheral myelinated nerve fibers
terms.name_zh: 外周大有髓神经纤维数量减少
synonyms: Decreased number of large peripheral myelinated nerve fibres
Loss of larger myelinated nerve fibers
Loss of larger myelinated nerve fibres
terms.definition: A reduced number of large myelinated nerve fibers.

terms.name: Easy fatigability
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to fatigue.

terms.name: Sensory axonal neuropathy
terms.definition: An axonal neuropathy of peripheral sensory nerves.

terms.name: Gowers sign
terms.definition: A phenomenon whereby patients are not able to stand up without the use of the hands owing to weakness of the proximal muscles of the lower limbs.

terms.name: Thenar muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting of thenar muscles, which are located on palm of the hand at the base of the thumb.

terms.name: Muscle spasm
terms.definition: Sudden and involuntary contractions of one or more muscles.

terms.name: Syringomyelia
terms.definition: Dilated, glial-lined cavity in spinal cord. This cavity does not communicate with the central canal, and usually is between the dorsal columns unilaterally or bilaterally along the side of the cord.

terms.name: Generalized hypotonia due to defect at the neuromuscular junction
terms.name_zh: 神经肌肉接头缺陷致全身性肌张力减退
synonyms: Generalised hypotonia due to defect at the neuromuscular junction

terms.name: Abnormal synaptic transmission at the neuromuscular junction
terms.name_zh: 神经肌肉接头突触传递异常
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the neuromuscular junction, which is the synapse between the motor end plate of a motor neuron and the skeletal muscle fibers.

terms.name: Basal lamina onion bulb formation
synonyms: Basal lamina 'onion bulb' formations on nerve biopsy
terms.definition: A type of onion bulb formation prominently affecting the area of the basal lamina.

terms.name: Paresthesia
terms.definition: Abnormal sensations such as tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin with no apparent physical cause.

terms.name: Decreased miniature endplate potentials
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amplitude of the miniature endplate potentials, i.e. the postsynaptic response to transmitter released from an individual vesicle at the neuromuscular junction.

terms.name: EMG: decremental response of compound muscle action potential to repetitive nerve stimulation
terms.name_zh: 肌电图示重复神经刺激复合肌肉动作电位递减反应
synonyms: EMG: decremental response of CMAP to repetitive nerve stimulation
terms.definition: A compound muscle action potential (CMAP) is a type of electromyography (EMG). CMAP refers to a group of almost simultaneous action potentials from several muscle fibers in the same area evoked by stimulation of the supplying motor nerve and are recorded as one multipeaked summated action potential. This abnormality refers to a greater than normal decrease in the amplitude during the course of the investigation.

terms.name: Distal sensory impairment of all modalities
terms.name_zh: 远端所有感觉类型障碍
synonyms: Distal sensory loss to all modalities
terms.definition: Reduced ability to sense pain, temperature, touch, vibration stimuli in the distal regions of the extremities.

terms.name: Proximal femoral metaphyseal irregularity
terms.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of the proximal metaphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Atlantoaxial abnormality
terms.definition: An anomaly of the atlantoaxial joint, i.e., of the joint between the first (atlas) and second (axis) cervical vertebrae.

terms.name: Atlantoaxial dislocation
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the atlantoaxial joint.

terms.name: Spinal canal stenosis
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the spinal canal.

terms.name: Coronal cleft vertebrae
terms.definition: Frontal schisis (cleft or cleavage) of vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Back pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the back.

terms.name: Low back pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the lower back.

terms.name: Vertebral segmentation defect
terms.definition: An abnormality related to a defect of vertebral separation during development.

terms.name: CNS hypomyelination
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统髓鞘形成不足
terms.definition: Reduced amount of myelin in the central nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis.

terms.name: Decreased motor nerve conduction velocity
terms.name_zh: 运动神经传导速度降低
terms.definition: A type of decreased nerve conduction velocity that affects the motor neuron.

terms.name: Prolonged miniature endplate currents
terms.definition: An abnormal prolongation of the miniature endplate potentials, i.e. the postsynaptic response to transmitter released from an individual vesicle at the neuromuscular junction.

terms.name: Absent Achilles reflex
terms.definition: Absence of the Achilles reflex (also known as the ankle jerk reflex), which can normally be elicited by tapping the tendon is tapped while the foot is dorsiflexed.

terms.name: Decreased size of nerve terminals
terms.definition: A reduction in the size of nerve terminals.

terms.name: EMG: chronic denervation signs
terms.name_zh: 肌电图示慢性失神经征
terms.definition: Evidence of chronic denervation on electromyography.

terms.name: EMG: neuropathic changes
terms.name_zh: 肌电图示神经源性改变
terms.definition: The presence of characteristic findings of denervation on electromyography (fibrillations, positive sharp waves, and giant motor unit potentials).

terms.name: Axonal loss
terms.definition: A reduction in the number of axons in the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Decreased sensory nerve conduction velocity
terms.name_zh: 感觉神经传导速度减慢
terms.definition: Reduced speed of conduction of the action potential along a sensory nerve.

terms.name: Cold-induced muscle cramps
terms.definition: Sudden and involuntary contractions of one or more muscles brought on by exposure to cold temperatures.

terms.name: Axonal regeneration
terms.definition: The presence of axonal regeneration following a previous axonal lesion.

terms.name: Increased rate of premature chromosome condensation
terms.name_zh: 染色体提前凝缩率升高
terms.definition: An increased rate of premature chromosome condensation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating iron concentration
synonyms: Elevated iron cation level in blood
Increased iron cation level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of iron cation in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Antineutrophil antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗中性粒细胞抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against neutrophils.

terms.name: Platelet antibody positive
terms.definition: The presence in the serum of autoantibodies directed against thrombocytes.

terms.name: Elevated circulating long chain fatty acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环长链脂肪酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of long-chain fatty acids in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Low urinary cyclic AMP response to PTH administration
terms.name_zh: PTH给药后尿环磷酸腺苷反应降低

terms.name: EMG abnormality
terms.definition: Abnormal results of investigations using electromyography (EMG).

terms.name: EMG: myopathic abnormalities
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal electromyographic patterns indicative of myopathy, such as small-short polyphasic motor unit potentials.

terms.name: Polyclonal elevation of circulating IgM concentration
terms.definition: A heterogeneous increase in IgM immunoglobulins characterized by a diffuse band on serum electrophoresis.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgA concentration
terms.definition: Undetectable serum immunoglobulin A level at a value < 5 mg/dL (0.05 g/L).

terms.name: Increased urinary O-linked sialopeptides
terms.definition: Excretion of peptides conjugated to sialic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased extraneuronal autofluorescent lipopigment
terms.name_zh: 神经元外自身荧光脂色素增加
terms.definition: Lipofuscin, a generic term applied to autofluorescent lipopigment, is a mixture of protein and lipid that accumulates in most aging cells, particularly those involved in high lipid turnover (e.g., the adrenal medulla) or phagocytosis of other cell types (e g., the retinal pigment epithelium or RPE; macrophage). This term pertains if there is an increase in the extraneuronal accumulation of lipofuscin (also known as autofluorescent lipoprotein) more than expected for the age of the patient.

terms.name: Paradoxical increased cortisol secretion on dexamethasone suppression test
Atlantoaxial instability
terms.definition: Abnormally increased movement at the junction between the first cervical (atlas) and the second cervical (axis) vertebrae as a result of either a bony or ligamentous anomaly.

terms.name: Abnormal vertebral morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of one or more of the vertebrae.

terms.name: Peripheral dysmyelination
terms.definition: Defective structure and function of myelin sheaths. Dysmyelination is distinguished from demyleination where there is destruction or damage of previously normal myelination.

terms.name: Paralysis
terms.definition: Paralysis of voluntary muscles means loss of contraction due to interruption of one or more motor pathways from the brain to the muscle fibers. Although the word paralysis is often used interchangeably to mean either complete or partial loss of muscle strength, it is preferable to use paralysis or plegia for complete or severe loss of muscle strength, and paresis for partial or slight loss. Motor paralysis results from deficits of the upper motor neurons (corticospinal, corticobulbar, or subcorticospinal). Motor paralysis is often accompanied by an impairment in the facility of movement.

terms.name: Hypocalcemic tetany
terms.definition: Hyperexcitability of the neuromuscular system related to abnormally low level of calcium in the blood, resulting in carpopedal or generalized spasms.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness
synonyms: Generalised muscle weakness due to defect at the neuromuscular junction
Generalized muscle weakness due to defect at the neuromuscular junction
Proximal muscle weakness due to defect at the neuromuscular junction
terms.definition: A type of weakness that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Somatic sensory dysfunction
terms.definition: An abnormality of the primary sensation that is mediated by peripheral nerves (pain, temperature, touch, vibration, joint position). The word hypoesthesia (or hypesthesia) refers to a reduction in cutaneous sensation to a specific type of testing.

terms.name: Peripheral axonal neuropathy
terms.definition: An abnormality characterized by disruption of the normal functioning of peripheral axons.

terms.name: Segmental peripheral demyelination/remyelination
terms.definition: A segmental pattern of demyelination and regeneration (remyelination) affecting peripheral nerves.

terms.name: EMG: axonal abnormality
terms.definition: Electromyographic (EMG) findings characteristic of axonal neuropathy, with normal or slightly decreased nerve conduction velocities, normal or slightly prolonged distal latencies, but significantly reduced motor potentials and sensory amplitudes. There may be spontaneous activity upon needle EMG studies, such as increased insertional activity, positive sharp waves, and fibrillation potentials.

terms.name: Upper limb muscle weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the muscles of the arms.

terms.name: Babinski sign
terms.definition: Upturning of the big toe (and sometimes fanning of the other toes) in response to stimulation of the sole of the foot. If the Babinski sign is present it can indicate damage to the corticospinal tract.

terms.name: Acute episodes of neuropathic symptoms
terms.name_zh: 神经病理性症状急性发作

terms.name: Elevated urine pyrophosphate
terms.definition: An abnormally increased diphosphate(4-) concentration in the urine. Diphosphate(4-), as ester with two phosphate groups, is also known as pyrophosphate.

terms.name: High urinary gonadotropin level
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of a gonadotropin hormone (stimulating hormone or luteinizing hormone) in the urine, consistent with the diagnosis of primary hypogonadism.

terms.name: Antinuclear antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against nuclei or nuclear components.

terms.name: GM2-ganglioside accumulation
terms.definition: Cellular accumulation of GM2 gangliosides.

terms.name: Increased circulating IgM concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin M in blood.

terms.name: Disproportionate short stature
terms.definition: A kind of short stature in which different regions of the body are shortened to differing extents.

terms.name: Mild short stature
terms.definition: A mild degree of short stature, more than -2 SD but not more than -3 SD from mean corrected for age and sex.

terms.name: Proportionate short stature
terms.definition: A kind of short stature in which different regions of the body are shortened to a comparable extent.

terms.name: Severe short stature
terms.definition: A severe degree of short stature, more than -4 SD from the mean corrected for age and sex.

terms.name: Reduced ratio of renal calcium clearance to creatinine clearance
synonyms: Reduced ration of kidney calcium clearance to creatinine clearance
Reduced ration of renal Ca clearance to creatinine clearance
Reduced ration of renal Ca2+ to creatinine clearance
terms.definition: A reduction of the ratio of renal calcium clearance to creatinine clearance to below 0.01.

terms.name: Deficiency or absence of cytochrome b(-245)
synonyms: Deficiency or absence of cytochrome b

terms.name: Birth length greater than 97th percentile
terms.name_zh: 出生身长大于第97百分位

terms.name: Disproportionate short-trunk short stature
terms.name_zh: 短躯干型比例失调性矮小
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs.

terms.name: Decreased methionine synthase activity
terms.name_zh: 甲硫氨酸合酶活性降低
terms.definition: A reduction in methionine synthase activity.

terms.name: Orotic acid crystalluria
terms.definition: Formation of crystals owing to an increased concentration of orotic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperprostaglandinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of prostaglandin in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating calcitonin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环降钙素浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Parathormone-independent increased renal tubular calcium reabsorption
synonyms: Parathormone-independent increased renal tubular Ca reabsorption
Parathormone-independent increased renal tubular Ca2+ reabsorption
terms.definition: An increase in the reabsorption of calcium by the renal tubulus that is not associated with increased parathormone levels.

terms.name: Elevated circulating glutaric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环戊二酸浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glutaric acid in the blood.

terms.name: Ornithinuria
terms.definition: Level of ornithine in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced acetaldehyde dehydrogenase level
terms.definition: Decreased level of acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH). ALDH and alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) are the primary enzymes involved in alcohol metabolism.

terms.name: Reduced xanthine dehydrogenase level
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in xanthine dehydrogenase level.

terms.name: 3-Methylglutaconic aciduria
terms.definition: An increased amount of 3-methylglutaconic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased fumarate hydratase activity
terms.name_zh: 延胡索酸水合酶活性降低
terms.definition: An abnormality of Krebs cycle metabolism that is characterized by a decreased rate of fumarate hydratase activity.

terms.name: Hypouricemia
synonyms: Decreased uric acid level in blood
Reduced uric acid level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of uric acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased iduronate sulfatase level
terms.name_zh: 艾杜糖醛酸硫酸酯酶水平升高
terms.definition: An increased level of iduronate-2-sulfatase activity in the blood.

terms.name: Impaired platelet aggregation
terms.definition: An impairment in the rate and degree to which platelets aggregate after the addition of an agonist that stimulates platelet clumping. Platelet aggregation is measured using aggregometer to measure the optical density of platelet-rich plasma, whereby platelet aggregation causes the plasma to become more transparent.

terms.name: Urinary glycosaminoglycan excretion
terms.definition: Excretion of glycosaminoglycan in the urine. Glycosaminoglycans are long unbranched polysaccharides consisting of a repeating disaccharide unit.

terms.name: Increased circulating pyruvate concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环丙酮酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of pyruvate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Exercise intolerance
terms.definition: A functional motor deficit where individuals whose responses to the challenges of exercise fail to achieve levels considered normal for their age and gender.

terms.name: Shoulder girdle muscle weakness
terms.definition: The shoulder, or pectoral, girdle is composed of the clavicles and the scapulae. Shoulder-girdle weakness refers to lack of strength of the muscles attaching to these bones, that is, lack of strength of the muscles around the shoulders.

terms.name: Subsarcolemmal accumulations of abnormally shaped mitochondria
terms.definition: An abnormally increased number of mitochondria in the cytoplasma adjacent to the sarcolemma (muscle cell membrane), whereby the mitochondria also possess an abnormal morphology.

terms.name: Abnormality of connective tissue
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the soft tissues, including both connective tissue (tendons, ligaments, fascia, fibrous tissues, and fat).

terms.name: Predominantly lower limb lymphedema
terms.definition: Localized fluid retention and tissue swelling caused by a compromised lymphatic system, affecting mainly the legs.

terms.name: Difficulty climbing stairs
terms.definition: Reduced ability to climb stairs.

terms.name: Muscle stiffness
terms.definition: A condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm.

terms.name: Type 2 muscle fiber atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy (wasting) affecting primary type 2 muscle fibers. This feature in general can only be observed on muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Muscle fiber splitting
terms.definition: Fiber splitting or branching is a common finding in human and rat skeletal muscle pathology. Fiber splitting refers to longitudinal halving of the complete fiber, while branching originates from a regenerating end of a necrotic fiber as invaginations of the sarcolemma. In fiber branching, one end of the fiber remains intact as a single entity, while the other end has several branches.

terms.name: Increased variability in muscle fiber diameter
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维直径变异性增大
synonyms: Increased variability in muscle fiber size
Increased variability in muscle fibre diameter
Increased variability in muscle fibre size
Increased variation in muscle fiber size
Increased variation in muscle fibre size
terms.definition: An abnormally high degree of muscle fiber size variation. This phenotypic feature can be observed upon muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Viral infection-induced rhabdomyolysis
terms.definition: Rhabdomyolysis induced by a viral infection.

terms.name: Muscular dystrophy
terms.definition: The term dystrophy means abnormal growth. However, muscular dystrophy is used to describe primary myopathies with a genetic basis and a progressive course characterized by progressive skeletal muscle weakness and wasting, defects in muscle proteins, and histological features of muscle fiber degeneration (necrosis) and regeneration. If possible, it is preferred to use other HPO terms to describe the precise phenotypic abnormalities.

terms.name: Birth length less than 3rd percentile
terms.name_zh: 出生身长小于第3百分位

terms.name: Decreased circulating LDL-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环低密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
Reduced low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Folate-dependent fragile site at Xq28
terms.definition: The presence of a folate sensitive fragile site at chromosome Xq28.

terms.name: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate
terms.definition: An increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR). The ESR is a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. The ESR is a nonspecific finding. An elevation may indicate inflammation or may be caused by any condition that elevates fibrinogen.

terms.name: Increased serum prostaglandin E2
terms.definition: An increased concentration of prostaglandin E2 in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased glucosephosphate isomerase level
terms.name_zh: 磷酸葡萄糖异构酶水平降低
terms.definition: A decreased level of glucose-6-phosphate isomerase.

terms.name: Molybdenum cofactor deficiency
terms.definition: Absence of molybdenum cofactor(2-), a cofactor for enzymes including sulfite oxidase, xanthine oxidoreductase, and aldehyde oxidase.

terms.name: Propionic acidemia
terms.definition: Increased concentration of proprionic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Low plasma citrulline
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of citrulline in the blood.

terms.name: Increased total bilirubin
terms.definition: Increased concentration of total (conjugated and unconjugated) bilirubin in the blood.

terms.name: Positive regitine blocking test
terms.definition: A positive response to the regitine blocking test consisting of a substantial reduction in blood pressure following administration of regitine, indicative of the presence of increased levels of epinephrine and norepinephrine in the circulation, which is seen in pheochromocytoma-associated hypertension.

terms.name: Increased intracellular sodium
terms.definition: An abnormally increased sodium concentration in the cytosol.

terms.name: Congenital onset
terms.definition: A phenotypic abnormality that is present at birth.

terms.name: Adult onset
terms.definition: Onset of disease manifestations in adulthood, defined here as at the age of 16 years or later.

terms.name: Late onset
terms.definition: A type of adult onset with onset of symptoms after the age of 60 years.

terms.name: Insidious onset
terms.definition: Gradual, very slow onset of disease manifestations.

terms.name: Infantile onset
synonyms: Onset in first year of life
terms.definition: Onset of signs or symptoms of disease between 28 days to one year of life.

terms.name: Middle age onset
terms.definition: A type of adult onset with onset of symptoms at the age of 40 to 60 years.

terms.name: Absent urinary urothione
terms.definition: Lack of urothione (the urinary metabolite of molybdenum cofactor) in the urine.

terms.name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetic aciduria
terms.definition: Increased concentration of 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Foam cells with lamellar inclusion bodies
terms.name_zh: 含板层包涵体的泡沫细胞
terms.definition: The presence of foam cells that contain lamellar inclusion bodies.

terms.name: Fibroblast metachromasia
terms.definition: Increased cytoplasmic staining of fibroblasts with toluidine blue.

terms.name: Positive ferric chloride test
terms.definition: If positive, the ferric chloride test indicates an increased concentration of phenols in the urine or blood.

terms.name: Antiphospholipid antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of circulating autoantibodies to phospholipids.

terms.name: Trimethylaminuria
terms.definition: Increased concentration of trimethylamine in the urine.

terms.name: Juvenile onset
synonyms: Signs and symptoms begin before 15 years of age
terms.definition: Onset of signs or symptoms of disease between the age of 5 and 15 years.

terms.name: Neonatal onset
synonyms: Onset in first weeks of life
terms.definition: Onset of signs or symptoms of disease within the first 28 days of life.

terms.name: Amyoplasia
terms.definition: Congenital lack of development of the muscles, which are then replaced by a mixture of dense fat and fibrous tissue.

terms.name: Loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue in limbs
terms.name_zh: 四肢皮下脂肪组织缺失
synonyms: Loss of fat tissue below the skin in limbs
Loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue from extremities
terms.definition: Loss (disappearance) of previously present subcutaneous fat tissue in arm or leg.

terms.name: Reduced circulating 4-Hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary epinephrine level
terms.definition: The concentration of epinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: CNS foam cells
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统泡沫细胞
terms.definition: The presence of foam cells, a type of macrophage that localizes to fatty deposits on blood vessel walls, in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Hemoglobinuria
terms.definition: The presence of free hemoglobin in the urine.

terms.name: Type I transferrin isoform profile
synonyms: Abnormal isoelectric focusing of serum transferrin, type I pattern
Isoelectric focusing of serum transferrin consistent with CDG type I
terms.definition: Abnormal transferrin isoform profile consistent with a type I congenital disorder of glycosylation. In the traditional nomenclature for congenital disorders of glycosylation, absence of entire glycans was designated type I, and loss of one or more monosaccharides as type II.

terms.name: Sulfite oxidase deficiency
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced sulfite oxidase level.

terms.name: Prolonged partial thromboplastin time
terms.definition: Increased time to coagulation in the partial thromboplastin time (PTT) test, a measure of the intrinsic and common coagulation pathways. Phospholipid, and activator, and calcium are mixed into an anticoagulated plasma sample, and the time is measured until a thrombus forms.

terms.name: Bicarbonaturia
terms.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of hydrogencarbonate in the urine.

terms.name: Electron transfer flavoprotein-ubiquinone oxidoreductase defect
terms.name_zh: 电子转移黄素蛋白-泛醌氧化还原酶缺陷
terms.definition: A deficiency of the electron transfer flavoprotein-ubiquinone oxidoreductase.

terms.name: Lacticaciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of lactic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal glycosidase enzyme activity
terms.definition: Abnormality of glycosidase enzyme activity. Glycoside hydrolases (GHs), including glycosidases and transglycosidases. These enzymes constitute 113 protein families that are responsible for the hydrolysis and/or transglycosylation of glycosidic bonds.

terms.name: Foam cells
terms.definition: The presence of foam cells, a type of macrophage that localizes to fatty deposits on blood vessel walls, where they ingest low-density lipoproteins and become laden with lipids, giving them a foamy appearance.

terms.name: Recurrent myoglobinuria
terms.definition: Recurring episodes of myoglobinuria, i.e., of the presence of myoglobin in the urine. This is usually a consequence of rhabdomyolysis, i.e., of the destruction of muscle tissue.

terms.name: Cellular metachromasia
terms.definition: Metachromasia (also known as metachromacy) is a characteristic color change which certain aniline dyes exhibit when bound to particular substances or when concentrated in solution. For example, the basic dye toluidine blue becomes distinctly pink when bound to cartilage matrix. In the sense used here, the metachromasia refers to a change in color not observed with normal tissues, anomalous staining with the cationic dyes toluidine blue O and Alcian blue resulting from excessive amounts of the polyanionic glycosaminoglycans.

terms.name: Reduced dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase level
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (NADP+) level.

terms.name: Reduced level of N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase II
terms.definition: An abnormality of glycoprotein metabolism related to a decreased level of alpha-1,6-mannosylglycoprotein 2-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity.

terms.name: Decreased beta-glucocerebrosidase level
terms.name_zh: β-葡糖脑苷脂酶水平降低
terms.definition: Reduced level of the enzyme beta-glucosidase, an enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of glucosylceramide into ceramide and glucose.

terms.name: Vascular granular osmiophilic material deposition
terms.definition: Accumulation of granular osmiophilic material in blood vessel walls. Osmiophilic material becomes black upon staining with osmium tetroxide. Deposition of granular osmiophilic material (GOM) is the vascular pathological hallmark of CADASIL, which is the most prevalent hereditary small vessel disease and is caused by missense mutations in the NOTCH3 gene. GOM have been shown to contain NOTCH3 ectodomain (NOTCH3ECD) and extracellular matrix proteins, and can be visualized ultrastructurally in the tunica media of small arteries and capillaries. These electron dense GOM deposits are located in the basement membrane of mural cells, i.e. vascular smooth muscle cells and pericytes. In both manifest and pre-manifest CADASIL patients, GOM deposits are present not only in brain vessels, but also in vessels of other organs, such as the skin.

terms.name: Hypomethioninemia
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of methionine in the blood.

terms.name: Amyotrophy of the musculature of the pelvis
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting the muscles of the pelvis.

terms.name: Onset
terms.definition: The age group in which disease manifestations appear.

terms.name: Progressive
terms.definition: Applies to a disease manifestation that increases in scope or severity over the course of time, i.e., that worsens with age.

terms.name: Slowly progressive
synonyms: Signs and symptoms worsen slowly with time
terms.definition: Applies to a disease manifestation that only slowly increases in scope or severity over the course of time.

terms.name: Rapidly progressive
terms.definition: Applies to a disease manifestation that quickly increases in scope or severity over the course of time.

terms.name: Nonprogressive
terms.definition: Applies to a disease manifestation that does not increase in scope or severity over the course of time, i.e., that does not worsen with age.

terms.name: Variable progression rate
terms.definition: Applies to a disease manifestation that quickly increases in scope or severity with a rate that varies. For instance, progression may be slow in one time period and rapid in another.

terms.name: Centrally nucleated skeletal muscle fibers
terms.definition: An abnormality in which the nuclei of sarcomeres take on an abnormally central localization (or in which this feature is found in an increased proportion of muscle cells).

terms.name: Cytochrome C oxidase-negative muscle fibers
terms.name_zh: 细胞色素C氧化酶阴性肌纤维
synonyms: Cytochrome c oxidase deficiency in skeletal muscle
Decreased activity of cytochrome C oxidase in muscle tissue
Decreased skeletal muscle cytochrome c oxidase activity
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced activity of the enzyme cytochrome C oxidase in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Multiple mitochondrial DNA deletions
terms.definition: The presence of multiple deletions of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA).

terms.name: Limb muscle weakness
terms.definition: Reduced strength and weakness of the muscles of the arms and legs.

terms.name: Scapular winging
terms.definition: Abnormal protrusion of the scapula away from the surface of the back.

terms.name: Distal amyotrophy
synonyms: Distal amyotrophy, especially of the hands and feet
Distal muscle atrophy, upper and lower limbs
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting muscles in the distal portions of the extremities.

terms.name: Late-onset proximal muscle weakness
terms.definition: Lack of strength of the proximal musculature occurring late in the clinical course.

terms.name: Absent epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
terms.name_zh: 第五指远节指骨骨骺缺如
synonyms: Absent end part of the outermost bone of the little finger
Absent end part of the outermost bone of the pinkie finger
Absent end part of the outermost bone of the pinky finger
terms.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger.

terms.name: Scapuloperoneal amyotrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy in the distribution of shoulder girdle and peroneal muscles.

terms.name: Generalized amyotrophy
terms.definition: Generalized (diffuse, unlocalized) amyotrophy (muscle atrophy) affecting multiple muscles.

terms.name: Proximal muscle weakness
synonyms: Weakness in muscles of upper arms and upper legs
terms.definition: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles.

terms.name: Calf muscle pseudohypertrophy
terms.definition: Enlargement of the muscles of the calf due to their replacement by connective tissue or fat.

terms.name: Exercise-induced muscle cramps
terms.definition: Sudden and involuntary contractions of one or more muscles brought on by physical exertion.

terms.name: Skeletal muscle hypertrophy
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in muscle size and mass not due to training.

terms.name: Muscle fiber necrosis
terms.definition: Abnormal cell death involving muscle fibers usually associated with break in, or absence of, muscle surface fiber membrane and resulting in irreversible damage to muscle fibers.

terms.name: Myofibrillar myopathy
terms.definition: Myofibrillar structural changes characterized by abnormal intracellular accumulation of the intermediate filament desmin and other proteins.

terms.name: Generalized muscular appearance from birth
terms.name_zh: 出生即全身性肌肉外观

terms.name: Muscle mounding
terms.definition: Percussion-induced, local prolonged contractions (mounding) in muscle persisting for several seconds.

terms.name: Generalized muscle hypertrophy
synonyms: Generalised increase in muscle cell size
Generalized increase in muscle cell size
terms.definition: Hypertrophy (increase in size) of muscle tissue in a generalized (not localized) distribution.

terms.name: Neck flexor weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the muscles involved in neck flexion (sternocleidomastoid, longus capitus, longus colli, and scalenus anterior).

terms.name: Shoulder girdle muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Amyotrophy affecting the muscles of the shoulder girdle.

terms.name: Firm muscles
terms.definition: A state of increased firmness (i.e., a reduced tendency to yield to pressure) of skeletal muscle tissue. This finding is ascertained by palpation and is to be distinguished from increased muscle tone (abnormal elevation in the resting tension of a muscle, leading to stiffness and resistance to movement).

terms.name: Enteroviral dermatomyositis syndrome
terms.name_zh: 肠道病毒性皮肌炎综合征

terms.name: EMG: myotonic runs
terms.name_zh: 肌电图示肌强直电位串
terms.definition: Spontaneous, repetitive electrical activity demonstrated by electromyography (EMG).

terms.name: Quadriceps muscle weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the quadriceps muscle (that is, of the muscle fasciculus of quadriceps femoris).

terms.name: Thigh hypertrophy
terms.definition: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the thighs.

terms.name: Autophagic vacuoles
terms.definition: The lysosomal-vacuolar pathway has a role in the controlled intracellular digestion of macromolecules such as protein complexes and organelles. This feature refers to the presence of an abnormally increased number of autophagic vacuoles in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Mitochondrial myopathy
terms.definition: A type of myopathy associated with mitochondrial disease and characterized by findings on biopsy such as ragged red muscle fibers.

terms.name: Exercise-induced myalgia
terms.definition: The occurrence of an unusually high amount of muscle pain following exercise.

terms.name: Myotonia with warm-up phenomenon
terms.definition: Myotonia that occurs after a period of rest and decreases with continuing exercise.

terms.name: Genetic anticipation
terms.definition: A type of autosomal dominant inheritance involving a gene that exhibits anticipation, the increase in severity and/or an earlier age of onset in subsequent generations.

terms.name: Genetic anticipation with paternal anticipation bias
terms.definition: A type of genetic anticipation observed predominantly upon transmission from affected males.

terms.name: Sporadic
terms.definition: Cases of the disease in question occur without a previous family history, i.e., as isolated cases without being transmitted from a parent and without other siblings being affected.

terms.name: Pelvic girdle muscle weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the muscles of the pelvic girdle (also known as the hip girdle), that is, lack of strength of the muscles around the pelvis.

terms.name: Increased muscle fatiguability
terms.definition: An abnormal, increased fatiguability of the musculature.

terms.name: Episodic flaccid weakness
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of muscle flaccidity, a type of paralysis in which a muscle becomes soft and yields to passive stretching.

terms.name: Type 1 fibers relatively smaller than type 2 fibers
synonyms: Type 1 fibres relatively smaller than type 2 fibres
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal muscle fiber size such that type 1 fibers are smaller than type 2 fibers.

terms.name: Reduced subcutaneous adipose tissue
synonyms: Reduced fat tissue below the skin
terms.definition: A reduced amount of fat tissue in the lowest layer of the integument. This feature can be appreciated by a reduced skinfold thickness.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of lymphatic vessels
terms.definition: Congenital underdevelopment of lymph vessels.

terms.name: Percussion-induced rapid rolling muscle contractions
terms.definition: Mechanical percussion (i.e., striking a muscle with a reflex hammer) leads to spreading waves of muscle contractions that begin proximally and spread laterally across the muscle.

terms.name: Calcinosis
synonyms: Calcium buildup in soft tissues of body
terms.definition: Formation of calcium deposits in any soft tissue.

terms.name: Uterus didelphys
terms.definition: A malformation of the uterus in which the uterus is present as a paired organ as a result of the failure of fusion of the mullerian ducts during embryogenesis.

terms.name: Bruxism
terms.definition: Bruxism is characterized by the grinding of the teeth including the clenching of the jaw and typically occur during sleep.

terms.name: Nevus
terms.definition: A nevus is a type of hamartoma that is a circumscribed stable malformation of the skin.

terms.name: Psoriasiform dermatitis
terms.definition: A skin abnormality characterized by redness and irritation, with thick, red skin that displays flaky, silver-white patches (scales).

terms.name: Periodic paralysis
terms.definition: Episodes of muscle weakness.

terms.name: Pulp calcification
terms.definition: Pulp calcifications may appear as punctate calcifications, irregular, roughly spherical mineralized masses in any part of the pulp. It may occur isolated or associated to calcifications elsewhere such as the carotid arteries and kidneys. The diagnosis pulp calcifications can be established using radiological studies.

terms.name: Stage 5 chronic kidney disease
terms.definition: A degree of kidney failure severe enough to require dialysis or kidney transplantation for survival characterized by a severe reduction in glomerular filtration rate (less than 15 ml/min/1.73 m2) and other manifestations including increased serum creatinine.

terms.name: Pili torti
terms.definition: Pili (from Latin pilus, hair) torti (from Latin tortus, twisted) refers to short and brittle hairs that appear flattened and twisted when viewed through a microscope.

terms.name: Short mandibular rami

terms.definition: Excessive production of saliva.

terms.name: Eunuchoid habitus

terms.name: Type 1 and type 2 muscle fiber minicore regions
synonyms: Type 1 and type 2 muscle fibre minicore regions
terms.definition: Multiple small zones of sarcomeric disorganization and lack of oxidative activity (known as minicores) in type 1 and type 2 muscle fibers.

terms.name: Minicore myopathy
terms.definition: Multiple small zones of sarcomeric disorganization and lack of oxidative activity (known as minicores) in muscle fibers.

terms.name: Irregular iliac crest

terms.name: Limb-girdle muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting the muscles of the limb girdle.

terms.name: Nemaline bodies
terms.definition: Nemaline rods are abnormal bodies that can occur in skeletal muscle fibers. The rods can be observed on histological analysis of muscle biopsy tissue or upon electron microscopy, where they appear either as extensions of sarcomeric Z-lines, in random array without obvious attachment to Z-lines (often in areas devoid of sarcomeres) or in large clusters localized at the sarcolemma or intermyofibrillar spaces.

terms.name: Muscle abnormality related to mitochondrial dysfunction
Type 1 muscle fiber predominance
terms.definition: An abnormal predominance of type I muscle fibers (in general, this feature can only be observed on muscle biopsy).

terms.name: Rimmed vacuoles
terms.definition: Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. On histological staining with hematoxylin and eosin, rimmed vacuoles are popcorn-like clear vacuoles with a densely blue rim. The vacuoles are often associated with cytoplasmic and occasionally intranuclear eosinophilic inclusions.

terms.name: Reduced intrathoracic adipose tissue
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced amount of adipose tissue in the thoracic cavity.

terms.name: Neonatal death
terms.definition: Death within the first 28 days of life.

terms.name: Phenotypic variability
synonyms: Highly variable phenotype, even within families
terms.definition: A variability of phenotypic features.

terms.name: Death in childhood
terms.definition: Death in during childhood, defined here as between the ages of 2 and 10 years.

terms.name: Stillbirth
terms.definition: Death of the fetus in utero after at least 22 weeks of gestation.

terms.name: Variable expressivity
terms.definition: A variable severity of phenotypic features.

terms.name: Typified by incomplete penetrance
terms.definition: Description of conditions in which not all individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease. Penetrance is the proportion that develop disease given a lifespan of 80 years.

terms.name: Typified by age-related disease onset
terms.definition: Description of conditions in which age of onset is typically later in life and in which penetrance is dependent on the age of the subject.

terms.name: Shoulder dislocation

terms.definition: The presence of more than the normal number of carpal bones.

terms.name: Advanced ossification of carpal bones
terms.definition: Ossification of carpal bones at an abnormally early age.

terms.name: Bone-in-a-bone appearance of carpal bones
terms.definition: The bone-in-bone sign is a radiographic finding produced by increased sclerosis (abnormally dense bone) occurring intermittently with zones of relatively normal bone density. This term should be used to describe such a finding in the carpal bones.

terms.name: Irregular carpal bones
terms.definition: Carpal bones with irregular or fragmented margins.

terms.name: Large carpal bones
terms.definition: Increased size of carpal bones.

terms.name: Stippled calcification in carpal bones
terms.definition: Point-shaped (punctate) calcifications affecting the carpal bones.

terms.name: Abnormal scaphoid morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the scaphoid. The scaphoid is the largest bone of the proximal row of carpal bones. It is located on the same side as the thumb.

terms.name: Accessory scaphoid
terms.definition: Variations in the development of carpal bones are uncommon, with the scaphoid bone typically forming from the fusion of the os centrale carpi and the radial chondrification center during embryogenesis. A bipartite scaphoid is a rare congenital disorder that occurs when these ossification centers fail to fuse.

terms.name: Delayed ossification of the scaphoid
terms.definition: Formation of bone tissue of scaphoid is less than expected for age.

terms.name: Small scaphoid
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the scaphoid.

terms.name: Abnormal lunate bone morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the lunate bone, which is located in the proximal row of carpal bones.

terms.name: Lunate-triquetral fusion
terms.definition: Osseous fusion of the lunate and triquetrum.

terms.name: Abnormal trapezium morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the trapezium, which is the carpal bone located at the base of the thumb.

terms.name: Delayed ossification of the trapezium
terms.definition: Formation of bone tissue of trapezium is less than expected for age.

terms.name: Small trapezium
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the trapezium.

terms.name: Abnormal trapezoid bone morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the trapezoid bone, which is the smallest bone in the distal row of carpal bones.

terms.name: Delayed ossification of the trapezoid bone
synonyms: Delayed maturation of the trapezoid bone
terms.definition: Formation of bone tissue of trapezoid is less than expected for age.

terms.name: Small trapezoid bone
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the trapezoid.

terms.name: Abnormal hamate bone morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the hamate bone, which is the ulnar-most bone located within the distal row of carpal bones, neighboured by the capitate bone radially.

terms.name: Abnormal capitate bone morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the capitate bone, which is the largest of the carpal bones in the human hand.

terms.name: Narrow small joints of the hand
synonyms: Narrow small joints of the hand

terms.name: Osteoarthritis of the small joints of the hand
Subluxation of the small joints of the hand
synonyms: Partial dislocation of small joints of hand
terms.definition: A partial dislocation of some or all of the small joints of the hand.

terms.name: Cupped metaphyses of hand bones
terms.name_zh: 手骨干骺端杯口状改变
synonyms: Cupped wide portion of hand bones

terms.name: Exostoses of hand bones
terms.definition: Abnormal formation of new bone on the surface of a bone of the hand.

terms.name: Synostosis involving bones of the hand
terms.definition: An abnormal union between bones or parts of bones of the hand.

terms.name: Short palm
terms.definition: Short palm.

terms.name: Narrow palm
terms.definition: For children from birth to 4 years of age, the palm width is more than 2 SD below the mean; for children from 4 to 16 years of age the palm width is below the 5th centile; or, the width of the palm appears disproportionately narrow for its length.

terms.name: Patchy sclerosis of hand bones
synonyms: Uneven increase in bone density in hand bones

terms.name: Sclerosis of hand bones with transverse striations
Synostosis of second metacarpal-trapezoid
terms.definition: Fusion of the second metacarpal-trapezoid.

terms.name: Subluxation of metacarpal phalangeal joints
terms.definition: A partial dislocation affecting some or all of the metacarpophalangeal joints.

terms.name: Abnormal gastric mucosa morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the mucous membrane layer of stomach
terms.definition: An abnormality of the gastric mucous membrane.

terms.name: Abnormality of the biliary system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the biliary system.

terms.name: Abnormal abdominal wall morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of external features of the abdomen
terms.definition: The presence of any abnormality affecting the abdominal wall.

terms.name: Hernia of the abdominal wall
terms.definition: The presence of a hernia in the abdominal wall.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the skeletal muscle cell. Muscle fibers are subdivided into two types. Type I fibers are fatigue-resistant and rich in oxidative enzymes (they stain light with the myosin ATPase reaction), and type II fibers are fast-contracting, fatigue-prone, and rich in glycolytic enzymes (these fibers stain darkly). Normal muscle tissue has a random distribution of type I and type II fibers.

terms.name: Involuntary movements
terms.definition: Involuntary contractions of muscle leading to involuntary movements of extremities, neck, trunk, or face.

terms.name: Abnormal endocardium morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the endocardium.

terms.name: Abnormal anatomic location of the heart
terms.definition: Developmental defect characterized by an anomalous anatomic location of the heart.

terms.name: Ventricular preexcitation
terms.definition: An abnormality in which the cardiac ventricles depolarize too early as a result of an abnormality of cardiac conduction pathways such as an accessory pathway.

terms.name: Abnormal macrophage morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of macrophages.

terms.name: Abnormal reticulocyte morphology
terms.definition: A reticulocyte abnormality.

terms.name: Decreased circulating immunoglobulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环免疫球蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin in blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating IgG concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白G浓度降低
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating aldosterone concentration
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced levels of aldosterone.

terms.name: Vaginal fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula of the vagina.

terms.name: Bladder fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula connecting the urinary bladder to another organ or the skin. The fistula can involve the bowel, the vagina, or rarely, the skin.

terms.name: Short stature
terms.definition: A height below that which is expected according to age and gender norms. Although there is no universally accepted definition of short stature, many refer to \

terms.name: Abnormality of body weight
terms.definition: An abnormal increase or decrease of weight or an abnormal distribution of mass in the body.

terms.name: Increased body weight
terms.definition: Abnormally increased body weight.

terms.name: Decreased body weight
terms.definition: Abnormally low body weight.

terms.name: Cachexia
terms.definition: Severe weight loss, wasting of muscle, loss of appetite, and general debility related to a chronic disease.

terms.name: Abnormal vitreous humor morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the vitreous body.

terms.name: Abnormal anterior eye segment morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the anterior segment of the eye
Abnormality of the anterior segment of the eyeball
Abnormality of the anterior segment of the globe
terms.definition: An abnormality of the anterior segment of the eyeball (which comprises the structures in front of the vitreous humor: the cornea, iris, ciliary body, and lens).

terms.name: Abnormal posterior eye segment morphology
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the posterior segment of the globe
Abnormality of the posterior segment of the eye
Abnormality of the posterior segment of the eyeball
Abnormality of the posterior segment of the globe

terms.name: Increased skull ossification
terms.definition: An increase in the magnitude or amount of ossification of the skull.

terms.name: Decreased skull ossification
terms.definition: A reduction in the magnitude or amount of ossification of the skull.

terms.name: Abnormal lymphocyte morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of cells of the lymphoid lineage
terms.definition: An abnormality of lymphocytes.

terms.name: Bone-marrow foam cells
synonyms: Large vacuolated foam cells ('NP cells') on bone marrow biopsy
Large vacuolated foam cells on bone marrow biopsy
terms.definition: The presence of foam cells in the bone marrow, generally demonstrated by bone-marrow aspiration or biopsy. Foam cells have a vacuolated appearance due to the presence of complex lipid deposits, giving them a foamy or soap-suds appearance.

terms.name: Dermal atrophy
terms.definition: Partial or complete wasting (atrophy) of the skin.

terms.name: Myelin outfoldings
synonyms: Excessive focal folding of myelin sheaths
terms.definition: The presence of excessive redundant myelin in the peripheral nerve sheath.

terms.name: Abnormality of amino acid metabolism
terms.definition: Abnormality of an amino acid metabolic process.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating aromatic amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血芳香族氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating aromatic amino acid concentration
Abnormality of aromatic amino acid family metabolism
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of aromatic amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating sulfur-containing amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环含硫氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating sulfur amino acid concentration
Abnormal circulating sulphur amino acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of sulfur-containing amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin B concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of one or more B vitamins is outside the reference range.

terms.name: Abnormal vitamin B12 concentration
synonyms: Abnormality of the vitamin B12 metabolism
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B12 (or one of its metabolites) in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal galactosidase enyzme activity
terms.definition: Abnormality of galactoside metabolism. A galactoside is a glycoside (a sugar moiety bound to some other moiety) containing galactose.

terms.name: Abnormal glycosphingolipid metabolism
terms.definition: An abnormality of glycosphingolipid metabolism.

terms.name: Ganglioside accumulation
terms.definition: Defects in the lysosomal glycosidases or specific co-activators, result in accumulation of the substrates, such as glycosphingolipids, including gangliosides in GM1 gangliosidosis (Tay-Sachs disease) and GM2 gangliosidosis (Sandhoff disease).

terms.name: Weakness of muscles of respiration
terms.definition: Reduced function of the muscles required to generate subatmospheric pressure in the thoracic cavity during breathing: the diaphragm, the external intercostal and the interchondral part of the internal intercostal muscles.

terms.name: Abnormality of bone mineral density
synonyms: Abnormality of bone mineralisation and ossification
terms.definition: This term applies to all changes in bone mineral density which (depending on severity) can be seen on x-rays as a change in density and or structure of the bone. Changes may affect all bones of the organism, just certain bones or only parts of bones and include decreased mineralisation as may be seen in osteoporosis or increased mineralisation and or ossification as in osteopetrosis, exostoses or any kind of atopic calicfications of different origin and distribution. The overall amount of mineralization of the bone-organ can be measured as the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones, usually measured by densitometry of the lumbar spine or hip. The measurements are usually reported as g/cm3 or as a Z-score (the number of standard deviations above or below the mean for the patient's age and sex). Note that measurement with this method does not reflect local changes in other bones, and as such might not be correct with regard the hole bone-organ.

terms.name: Reduced bone mineral density
synonyms: Decreased bone mineral density Z score
Low solidness and mass of the bones
terms.definition: A reduction of bone mineral density, that is, of the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating purines concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of purines in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating pyrimidine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a pyrimidine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating carboxylic acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of carboxylic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating leucine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of leucine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating fatty acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of fatty acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormality of acid-base homeostasis
terms.definition: An abnormality of the balance or maintenance of the balance of acids and bases in bodily fluids, resulting in an abnormal pH.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating leptin concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of leptin in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal enteric ganglion morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the enteric nervous system, which comprises two types of ganglia, the myenteric (Auerbach's) and submucosal (Meissner's) plexuses. The enteric nervous system functions to control gut movement, fluid exchange between the gut and its lumen, and local blood flow.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating calcium concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of calcium in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating nitrogen compound concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环含氮化合物浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of nitrogen compound in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating tryptophan concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of tryptophan in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating purine concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of purines in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating purines concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of purines in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormality of temperature regulation
terms.definition: An abnormality of temperature homeostasis.

terms.name: Abnormality of glycosaminoglycan metabolism
terms.definition: Abnormality of glycosaminoglycan metabolism.

terms.name: Reduced consciousness
terms.definition: Abnormally diminished level of attention, responsiveness, or wakefulness.

terms.name: Focal dystonia
terms.definition: A type of dystonia that is localized to a specific part of the body.

terms.name: Hemiplegia/hemiparesis
synonyms: Paralysis or weakness of one side of body
terms.definition: Loss of strength in the arm, leg, and sometimes face on one side of the body. Hemiplegia refers to a severe or complete loss of strength, whereas hemiparesis refers to a relatively mild loss of strength.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the nervous system
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the nervous system.

terms.name: Neuroblastic tumor
terms.definition: A family of tumors arising in the embryonal remnants of the sympathetic nervous system, which includes neuroblastoma, ganglioneuroblastoma, and ganglioneuroma.

terms.name: Hematological neoplasm
terms.definition: Neoplasms located in the blood and blood-forming tissue (the bone marrow and lymphatic tissue).

terms.name: Abnormality of the anus
terms.definition: Abnormality of the anal canal.

terms.name: Abnormality of alkaline phosphatase level
terms.definition: An abnormality of alkaline phosphatase level.

terms.name: Aortic valve calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the aortic valve.

terms.name: Supravalvular aortic stenosis
terms.definition: A pathological narrowing in the region above the aortic valve associated with restricted left ventricular outflow.

terms.name: Mitral valve calcification
terms.definition: Abnormal calcification of the mitral valve.

terms.name: Hypoplastic left ventricle
terms.definition: A severe congenital heart defect characterized by underdevelopment of the left ventricle.

terms.name: Type I truncus arteriosus
terms.definition: Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) with a short pulmonary trunk arises from the truncus arteriosus, giving rise to both pulmonary arteries.

terms.name: Gastrointestinal inflammation
terms.definition: Inflammation of the alimentary part of the gastrointestinal system.

terms.name: Enterocolitis
terms.definition: An inflammation of the colon and small intestine. However, most conditions are either categorized as Enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine) or Colitis (inflammation of the large intestine).

terms.name: Microcolon
terms.definition: A colon of abnormally small caliber.

terms.name: Intestinal pseudo-obstruction
terms.definition: A functional rather than mechanical obstruction of the intestines, associated with manifestations that resemble those caused by an intestinal obstruction, including distension, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, constipation or diarrhea, in an individual in whom a mechanical blockage has been excluded.
