terms.name: Hamartomatous polyposis
terms.definition: Polyp-like protrusions which are histologically hamartomas. These can occur throughout the gastrointestinal tract. Hamartomatous polyps are composed of the normal cellular elements of the gastrointestinal tract, but have a markedly distorted architecture.

terms.name: Prune belly
terms.definition: A kind of congenital defect of the anterior abdominal wall in which the intestines are evident through the thin, lax, and protruding abdominal wall in affected infants.

terms.name: Malnutrition
terms.definition: A deficiency in the intake of energy and nutrients.

terms.name: Poor appetite
terms.definition: A reduced desire to eat.

terms.name: Ectopic anus
terms.definition: Abnormal displacement or malposition of the anus.

terms.name: Peptic ulcer
synonyms: Sore in the lining of gastrointestinal tract
terms.definition: The term peptic ulcer refers to acid peptic injury of the digestive tract, resulting in mucosal break reaching the submucosa. Peptic ulcers are usually located in the stomach or proximal duodenum, but they can also be found in the esophagus or Meckel's diverticulum. Infection with Helicobacter pylori and the use of non steroidal antiinflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) or aspirin are the main risk factors of both gastric and duodenal peptic ulcers.

terms.name: Congenital pyloric atresia
terms.definition: Congenital atresia of the pylorus.

terms.name: Abnormality of the pylorus
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pylorus.

terms.name: Meconium ileus
terms.definition: Obstruction of the intestine due to abnormally thick meconium.

terms.name: Abnormal nipple morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the nipple.

terms.name: Abnormality of the sense of smell
synonyms: Abnormality of the sense of smell
terms.definition: An anomaly in the ability to perceive and distinguish scents (odors).

terms.name: Hyposmia
terms.definition: A decreased sensitivity to odorants (that is, a decreased ability to perceive odors).

terms.name: Deviated nasal septum
terms.definition: Positioning of the nasal septum to the right or left in contrast to the normal midline position of the nasal septum.

terms.name: Abnormality of the pulmonary artery
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Pulmonary artery stenosis
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.

terms.name: Intermittent claudication
terms.definition: Intermittent claudication is a symptom of peripheral arterial occlusive disease. After having walked over a distance which is individually characteristic, the patients experience pain or cramps in the calves, feet or thighs which typically subsides on standing still.

terms.name: Thrombophlebitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of a vein associated with venous thrombosis (blood clot formation within the vein).

terms.name: Recurrent thrombophlebitis
terms.definition: Repeated episodes of inflammation of a vein associated with venous thrombosis (blood clot formation within the vein).

terms.name: Arterial thrombosis
terms.definition: The formation of a blood clot inside an artery.

terms.name: Elevated systolic blood pressure
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in systolic blood pressure.

terms.name: Biparietal narrowing
terms.definition: A narrowing of the biparietal diameter (i.e., of the transverse distance between the protuberances of the two parietal bones of the skull).

terms.name: Cranium bifidum occultum
terms.definition: Cranium bifidum occultum, also known as Catlin mark, is a congenital midline skull defect presenting as an enlarged posterior fontanelle in the upper posterior angle of the parietal bone close to the intersection of the sagittal and lambdoid sutures. Cranium bifidum occultum occurs due to a defect in intramembranous ossification, a process through which skull bones (frontal, parietal, squamous temporal and occipital bones superior to the mendosal suture) ossify under a vascularized membrane toward the midline to cover the brain. Unlike cranium bifidum cysticum, cranium bifidum occultum does not have herniation of intracranial contents. As the skull grows, the midline cranium bifidum occultum defect is separated into bilateral enlarged parietal foramina (EPF) by a midline osseous bridge.

terms.name: Flat forehead
terms.definition: A forehead with abnormal flatness.

terms.name: Abnormal cheek morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cheek- one of two bilateral soft tissue facial structures in the region of the face inferior to the eyes and between the nose and the ear. \

terms.name: Elfin facies
terms.definition: This is a description previously used to describe a facial form characterized by a short, upturned nose, wide mouth, widely spaced eyes, and full cheeks. Because of the imprecision in this definition it is preferable to describe these features precisely. This term is retained because it was often used in the past, but it should not be used for new annotations.

terms.name: Recurrent viral infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral infection.

terms.name: Severe combined immunodeficiency
terms.definition: A type of primary immune deficiency that is characterized by a more severe defect in both the T- and B-lymphocyte systems.

terms.name: Reduced circulating complement concentration
terms.definition: An immunodeficiency defined by the absent or suboptimal functioning of one of the complement system proteins.

terms.name: Agammaglobulinemia
terms.definition: A lasting absence of total IgG and total IgA and total IgM in the blood circulation, whereby at most trace quantities can be measured.

terms.name: Decreased secretory IgA concentration
terms.definition: Deficiency of secretory IgA (polymers of 2-4 IgA monomers are linked by two additional chains) and is the primary antibody response at the mucosal level, where it forms immune complexes with pathogens and allergens.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C8 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C8 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Cranial hyperostosis
terms.definition: Excessive growth of the bones of cranium, i.e., of the skull.

terms.name: Hyperostosis frontalis interna
synonyms: Excessive growth of inner surface of the frontal bone
Hyperostosis of the internal surface of the frontal bone
Overgrowth of the inner surface of the frontal bone
terms.definition: Bony overgrowth of the internal (endosteal) surface of the frontal bone.

terms.name: Craniofacial dysostosis
terms.definition: A characteristic appearance resulting from defective ossification of craniofacial bones.

terms.name: Coronal craniosynostosis
terms.definition: Premature closure of the coronal suture of skull.

terms.name: Sagittal craniosynostosis
synonyms: Early closure of midline skull joint
terms.definition: A kind of craniosynostosis affecting the sagittal suture.

terms.name: Lambdoidal craniosynostosis
terms.definition: A kind of craniosynostosis affecting the lambdoidal suture.

terms.name: Spherocytosis
terms.definition: The presence of erythrocytes that are sphere-shaped.

terms.name: Elliptocytosis
terms.definition: The presence of elliptical, cigar-shaped erythrocytes on peripheral blood smear.

terms.name: Stomatocytosis
terms.definition: The presence of erythrocytes with a mouth-shaped (stoma) area of central pallor on peripheral blood smear.

terms.name: Poikilocytosis
terms.definition: The presence of abnormally shaped erythrocytes.

terms.name: Fulminant hepatic failure
terms.definition: Hepatic failure refers to the inability of the liver to perform its normal synthetic and metabolic functions, which can result in coagulopathy and alteration in the mental status of a previously healthy individual. Hepatic failure is defined as fulminant if there is onset of encephalopathy within 4 weeks of the onset of symptoms in a patient with a previously healthy liver.

terms.name: Preauricular skin furrow
synonyms: Skin groove in front of the ear
Skin sulcus in front of the ear
terms.definition: A groove of the skin immediately in front of the ear.

terms.name: Postauricular skin tag
terms.definition: A rudimentary tag of ear tissue often containing a core of cartilage and located just in back of the auricle (outer part of the ear).

terms.name: Abnormality of the middle ear ossicles
terms.definition: An abnormality of the middle-ear ossicles (three small bones called malleus, incus, and stapes) that are contained within the middle ear and serve to transmit sounds from the air to the fluid-filled labyrinth (cochlea).

terms.name: Overfolding of the superior helices
terms.definition: A condition in which the superior portion of the helix is folded over to a greater degree than normal.

terms.name: Dilatated internal auditory canal
terms.definition: The presence of a dilated inner part of external acoustic meatus.

terms.name: Exostosis of the external auditory canal
terms.definition: A benign bony growth projecting outward from a bone surface within the external auditory canal.

terms.name: Congenital earlobe sinuses
terms.definition: Pits in the earlobes at the location where ears are typically pierced for earrings.

terms.name: Absent brainstem auditory responses
terms.definition: Lack of measurable response to stimulation of auditory evoked potentials.

terms.name: Postauricular pit
terms.definition: Benign congenital lesion of the postauricular soft tissue consisting of a blind-ending narrow tube or pit.

terms.name: Delayed brainstem auditory evoked response conduction time
terms.name_zh: 脑干听觉诱发电位传导时间延迟
terms.definition: An abnormal increase (delay) in the conduction time of the brainstem auditory-evoked response.

terms.name: Preauricular pit
synonyms: Pit in front of the ear
terms.definition: Small indentation anterior to the insertion of the ear.

terms.name: Anomalous tracheal cartilage
terms.definition: An abnormality of the C-shaped rings of hyaline cartilage, normally 16 to 20 in number, that occupy the anterior two-thirds of the circumference of the trachea (the posterior portion of the ring is completed by fibrous and smooth muscle tissue).

terms.name: Chronic bronchitis
terms.definition: Chronic inflammation of the bronchi.

terms.name: Atretic occipital cephalocele
terms.definition: A congenital defect in the occipital region of the skull, covered by skin of the scalp and containing meninges or remnants of glial or neural tissues.

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita over the scalp vertex
terms.name_zh: 头顶先天性皮肤发育不全
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin on the scalp vertex, often just lateral to the midline.

terms.name: Mandibular hyperostosis
terms.definition: Hyperostosis (bony overgrowth) of the mandible.

terms.name: Persistent open anterior fontanelle
terms.definition: The anterior fontanelle generally ossifies by around the 18th month of life. A persistent open anterior fontanelle is diagnosed if closure is delayed beyond this age.

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita over parietal area
terms.name_zh: 顶区先天性皮肤发育不全
synonyms: Absent cutis congenita over parietal area
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin on the scalp in the parietal area.

terms.name: Progressive macrocephaly
terms.definition: The progressive development of an abnormally large skull.

terms.name: Relative macrocephaly
terms.definition: A relatively mild degree of macrocephaly in which the head circumference is not above two standard deviations from the mean, but appears dysproportionately large when other factors such as body stature are taken into account.

terms.name: Craniofacial asymmetry
terms.definition: Asymmetry of the bones of the skull and the face.

terms.name: Cessation of head growth
terms.definition: Stagnation of head growth seen as flattening of the head circumference curve.

terms.name: Acrobrachycephaly
terms.definition: An abnormality of head shape characterized by the presence of a short, wide head as well as a pointy or conical form of the top of the head owing to premature closure of the coronal and lambdoid sutures.

terms.name: Macrocephaly at birth
synonyms: Head circumference large for gestational age
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally large skull with onset at birth.

terms.name: Calvarial hyperostosis
terms.definition: Excessive growth of the calvaria.

terms.name: Large posterior fontanelle
terms.definition: An enlargement of the posterior fontanelle relative to age-dependent norms.

terms.name: Widely patent fontanelles and sutures
terms.definition: An abnormally increased width of the cranial fontanelles and sutures.

terms.name: Craniofacial hyperostosis
synonyms: Excessive bone growth of the skull and face
terms.definition: Excessive growth of the craniofacial bones.

terms.name: Chronic rhinitis due to narrow nasal airway
terms.name_zh: 鼻气道狭窄性慢性鼻炎
synonyms: Chronic nasal inflammation due to narrow nasal airway

terms.name: Bilateral choanal atresia
synonyms: Bilateral blockage of the rear opening of the nasal cavity
Bilateral obstruction of the rear opening of the nasal cavity
terms.definition: Bilateral absence (atresia) of the posterior nasal aperture (choana).

terms.name: Pancreatic islet-cell hyperplasia
terms.definition: Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans, i.e., of the regions of the pancreas that contain its endocrine cells.

terms.name: Long eyebrows
terms.definition: Increased length of the hairs of the eyebrows.

terms.name: Temporal hypotrichosis
synonyms: Reduced hair growth in temporal region
terms.definition: Reduced or lacking hair growth in the temporal region (i.e., around the temples on the side of the skull).

terms.name: Large clumps of pigment irregularly distributed along hair shaft
terms.name_zh: 毛干不规则分布大色素团块
synonyms: Large clumps of pigment irregularly distributed along hair shaft

terms.name: Generalized hypotrichosis
terms.definition: Reduced or lacking hair growth in a generalized distribution.

terms.name: Sacral hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the sacral region.

terms.name: Anterior cervical hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Anterior cervical hypertrichosis (ACH) or 'hairy throat' refers to the presence of a tuft of terminal hair on the anterior neck, just above the laryngeal prominence.

terms.name: Congenital, generalized hypertrichosis
terms.definition: A confluent, generalized overgrowth of silvery blonde to gray lanugo hair at birth.

terms.name: Scarring alopecia of scalp
synonyms: Hair loss on scalp from scarring condition

terms.name: Generalized hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Generalized excessive, abnormal hairiness.

terms.name: Cervical platyspondyly
terms.definition: A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates affecting the cervical spine.

terms.name: Increased spinal bone density
terms.definition: Increased bone density affecting the bones of the spine (vertebral column).

terms.name: Pear-shaped vertebrae
terms.definition: Bulbous appearance of the anterior vertebral bodies, such that the vertebral bodies have the greatest vertical height anteriorly as well as bulbous anterior superior-inferior contours.

terms.name: Beaking of vertebral bodies
terms.definition: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Increased vertebral height
terms.definition: Increased top to bottom height of vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Anterior wedging of T11
synonyms: Anterior wedging of the 11th thoracic vertebra
terms.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the thoracic vertebra T11 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

terms.name: Fusion of midcervical facet joints
terms.name_zh: 颈椎中段关节突关节融合

terms.name: Sclerotic vertebral endplates
terms.definition: Sclerosis (increased density) affecting vertebral end plates.

terms.name: Anterior scalloping of vertebral bodies
terms.definition: An excessive concavity of the anterior surface of one or more vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Biconcave vertebral bodies
terms.definition: Exaggerated concavity of the anterior or posterior surface of the vertebral body, i.e., the upper and lower vertebral endplates are hollowed inward.

terms.name: Hypoplastic sacrum
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by undergrowth of the sacrum, which is a large, triangular bone at the base of the spine that forms by the fusing of the sacral vertebrae (S1-S5).

terms.name: Thoracic platyspondyly
terms.definition: A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates affecting the thoracic spine.

terms.name: Hump-shaped mound of bone in central and posterior portions of vertebral endplate
terms.name_zh: 椎体终板中央及后部驼峰状骨隆起

terms.name: Supernumerary vertebral ossification centers
terms.definition: Three ossification sites are present in typical vertebral bodies (C3-L5): a single ossification center in the vertebral body, and one each in the two neural arches. This term applies if there are additional vertebral ossification centers present during the development and maturation of the spine.

terms.name: Absent or minimally ossified vertebral bodies
Spina bifida occulta at L5
terms.definition: The closed form of spina bifida with incomplete closure of the vertebra L5 with intact overlying skin.

terms.name: Cervical C2/C3 vertebral fusion
terms.definition: Fusion of cervical vertebrae at C2 and C3, caused by a failure in the normal segmentation or division of the cervical vertebrae during the early weeks of fetal development, leading to a short neck with a low hairline at the back of the head, and restricted mobility of the upper spine.

terms.name: Absent vertebral body mineralization
terms.definition: A lack of bone mineralization of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Unossified vertebral bodies
terms.definition: A lack of ossification of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Anterior beaking of lower thoracic vertebrae
terms.definition: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the lower thoracic vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Anteriorly placed odontoid process
terms.definition: Anterior mislocalization of the dens of the axis.

terms.name: Lumbar spinal canal stenosis
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the lumbar spinal canal.

terms.name: Spina bifida occulta at S1
terms.definition: The closed form of spina bifida with incomplete closure of S1 with intact overlying skin.

terms.name: Cleft vertebral arch
terms.definition: A discontinuity of the vertebral arch, i.e., of the posterior part of a vertebra.

terms.name: Butterfly vertebral arch
terms.definition: Butterfly vertebrae have a cleft through the body of the vertebrae and a funnel shape at the ends.

terms.name: Enlarged vertebral pedicles
terms.definition: Increased size of the vertebral pedicle.

terms.name: Progressive intervertebral space narrowing
terms.definition: A progressive form of decreased height of the intervertebral disk.

terms.name: Biconvex vertebral bodies
terms.definition: Presence of abnormal convexity of the upper and lower end plates of the vertebrae, i.e., an exaggerated bulging out of the upper and lower vertebral end plates.

terms.name: Small cervical vertebral bodies
terms.definition: Reduced size of cervical vertebrae.

terms.name: Anterior beaking of thoracic vertebrae
terms.definition: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of thoracic vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Decreased cervical spine flexion due to contractures of posterior cervical muscles
terms.name_zh: 颈后肌挛缩致颈椎屈曲受限

terms.name: Cervical segmentation defect
terms.definition: An abnormality related to a defect of vertebral separation of cervical vertebrae during development.

terms.name: Lower thoracic kyphosis
terms.definition: Over curvature of the lower thoracic region, leading to a round back or if sever to a hump.

terms.name: Cervical C5/C6 vertebrae fusion
terms.definition: Fusion of the C5 and C6 cervical vertebrae.

terms.name: Elevated amniotic fluid alpha-fetoprotein concentration
terms.name_zh: 羊水甲胎蛋白浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated amniotic fluid alpha fetal protein
Elevated amniotic fluid alpha foetal protein
terms.definition: An elevation of alpha-feto protein measured in the amniotic fluid.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the nasal bone
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the nasal bone.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of facial musculature
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).

terms.name: Frontalis muscle weakness
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the frontalis muscle (which is located on the forehead).

terms.name: Facial midline hemangioma
terms.definition: Hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, occurring in the midline region of the face.

terms.name: Decreased facial expression
terms.definition: A reduced degree of voluntary and involuntary facial movements involved in responded to others or expressing emotions.

terms.name: Deep longitudinal plantar crease
terms.definition: Narrow, paramedian longitudinal depressions in the plantar skin of the forefoot.

terms.name: Talipes valgus
terms.definition: Outward turning of the heel, resulting in clubfoot with the person walking on the inner part of the foot.

terms.name: Short third metatarsal
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the Third metatarsal bone leading to a short (hypoplastic) third metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Short fourth metatarsal
terms.definition: Short fourth metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Thickened Achilles tendon
terms.definition: An abnormal thickening of the Achilles tendon.

terms.name: 2-3 toe syndactyly
synonyms: Syndactyly of second and third toes
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes two and three.

terms.name: 4-5 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes four and five.

terms.name: Calcaneal epiphyseal stippling
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the calcaneus.

terms.name: Osteoporotic metatarsal
terms.definition: Decrease in mass and density of the metatarsal bones.

terms.name: Short fifth metatarsal
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone
terms.definition: Short (hypoplastic) fifth metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Renal malrotation
terms.definition: An abnormality of the normal developmental rotation of the kidney leading to an abnormal orientation of the kidney.

terms.name: Reversible renal failure
terms.definition: Acute renal failure with resolution of manifestations.

terms.name: Axial malrotation of the kidney
terms.definition: An abnormality of the normal developmental rotation of the kidney leading to an abnormal axial orientation of the kidney.

terms.name: Hyperechogenic kidneys
synonyms: Increased echogenicity of the renal parenchyma
terms.definition: An increase in amplitude of waves returned in ultrasonography of the kidney, which is generally displayed as increased brightness of the signal.

terms.name: Thickened glomerular basement membrane
synonyms: Thickening of the glomerular basement membrane
terms.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM), reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) of the basal lamina of the glomerulus of the kidney.

terms.name: Calcium nephrolithiasis
terms.definition: The presence of calcium-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

terms.name: Impaired renal concentrating ability
terms.definition: A defect in the ability to concentrate the urine.

terms.name: Acute tubulointerstitial nephritis
terms.name_zh: 急性肾小管间质性肾炎
terms.definition: Acute inflammation of the kidney affecting the interstitium of the kidneys surrounding the tubules.

terms.name: Impaired renal uric acid clearance
terms.definition: A reduction in the ability of the kidneys to remove uric acid from the serum.

terms.name: Renal cortical microcysts
terms.definition: Cysts of microscopic size confined to the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Crossed fused renal ectopia
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly in which the kidneys are fused and localized on the same side of the midline. This anomaly is thought to result from disruption of the normal embryologic migration of the kidneys.

terms.name: Global glomerulosclerosis
terms.definition: Obliteration of the glomerular capillary lumen by increased collagenous matrix, with or without hyalinosis or foam cells. Sclerosis involves 100% of the glomerular tuft. Relative to other patent glomeruli in the sample, glomerular size is preserved, or increased/decreased by no more than 50%.

terms.name: Abnormal renal collecting system morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the renal collecting system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the renal collecting system.

terms.name: Chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis
terms.name_zh: 慢性肾小管间质性肾炎
terms.definition: Chronic inflammation of the kidney affecting the interstitium of the kidneys surrounding the tubules.

terms.name: Glomerular subendothelial electron-dense deposits
terms.name_zh: 肾小球内皮下电子致密物沉积
terms.definition: Electron dense deposits at the glomerular basement membrane,

terms.name: Atrial flutter
terms.definition: A type of atrial arrhythmia characterized by atrial rates of between 240 and 400 beats per minute and some degree of atrioventricular node conduction block. Typically, the ventricular rate is half the atrial rate. In the EKG; atrial flutter waves are observed as sawtooth-like atrial activity. Pathophysiologically, atrial flutter is a form of atrial reentry in which there is a premature electrical impulse creates a self-propagating circuit.

terms.name: Paroxysmal ventricular tachycardia
terms.definition: Episodes of ventricular tachycardia that have a sudden onset and ending.

terms.name: Congenital atrioventricular dissociation
terms.definition: A form of atrioventricular (AV) dissociation (i.e., the atria and the ventricles are under the control of two separate pacemakers) with congenital onset.

terms.name: Permanent atrial fibrillation
terms.definition: Atrial fibrillation (AF) that cannot be successfully terminated by cardioversion, and longstanding (more than 1 year) AF, where cardioversion is not indicated or has not been attempted, is termed permanent.

terms.name: Supraventricular tachycardia
terms.definition: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) is an abnormally increased heart rate (over 100 beats per minute at rest) with origin above the level of the ventricles.

terms.name: Ventricular tachycardia
terms.definition: A tachycardia originating in the ventricles characterized by rapid heart rate (over 100 beats per minute) and broad QRS complexes (over 120 ms).

terms.name: Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
terms.definition: Episodes of atrial fibrillation that typically last for several hours up to one day and terminate spontaneously.

terms.name: Effort-induced polymorphic ventricular tachycardia
terms.name_zh: 劳力诱发多形性室性心动过速
terms.definition: Polymorphic ventricular arrhythmias of varying morphologythat do not exist under resting conditions but appear only upon physical exercise or catecholamine administration.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of right ventricle
terms.definition: Underdevelopment or reduced size of the heart right ventricle, often due to a reduced number of cells.

terms.name: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
terms.definition: An episodic form of supraventricular tachycardia with abrupt onset and termination.

terms.name: Myxomatous mitral valve degeneration
terms.definition: Myxomatous mitral valve is defined as the presence of excess leaflet tissue and leaflet thickening greater than 5 mm, resulting in a prolapse greater than 2 mm into the left atrium on parasternal long axis view.

terms.name: Sparse anterior scalp hair
synonyms: Sparse scalp hair at front of head
Thin scalp hair at front of head
terms.definition: Decreased number of head hairs per unit area on the anterior region of the scalp.

terms.name: Brittle scalp hair
terms.definition: Fragile, easily breakable scalp hair.

terms.name: Elbow hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the elbow region.

terms.name: Duodenal polyposis
terms.definition: Presence of multiple polyps in the duodenum.

terms.name: Juvenile gastrointestinal polyposis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple juvenile polyps in the stomach and intestine. The term juvenile polyps refer to a special histopathology and not the age of onset as the polyp might be diagnosed at all ages. The juvenile polyp has a spherical appearance and is microscopically characterized by overgrowth of an oedematous lamina propria with inflammatory cells and cystic glands. Juvenile polyps are a specific type of hamartomatous polyps.

terms.name: Malrotation of colon
terms.definition: An anatomical anomaly that results from an abnormal rotation of the gut as it returns to the abdominal cavity during embryogenesis.

terms.name: Fulminant hepatitis
terms.definition: Acute hepatitis complicated by acute liver failure with hepatic encephalopathy occurring less than 8 weeks after the onset of jaundice.

terms.name: Intestinal lymphedema
terms.definition: Fluid retention and edema in the intestine caused by a compromised lymphatic system.

terms.name: Lactose intolerance
terms.definition: An inability to digest lactose.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the small intestine
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the small intestine.

terms.name: Esophageal ulceration
terms.definition: Defect in the epithelium of the esophagus, essentially an open sore in the lining of the esophagus.

terms.name: Rectoperineal fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula between the perineum and the rectum.

terms.name: Malrotation of small bowel
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal rotation of the midgut during embryologic development with mislocalization of the small bowel.

terms.name: Hamartomatous stomach polyps
terms.definition: Polyp-like protrusions which are histologically hamartomas located in the stomach.

terms.name: Multiple small bowel atresias
terms.definition: The presence of multiple areas of atresia affecting the small intestine.

terms.name: Recurrent infection of the gastrointestinal tract
synonyms: Recurrent infection of the GI tract
Recurrent infection of the gastrointestinal tract
terms.definition: Recurrent infection of the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Episodic hemolytic anemia
terms.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia that occurs in repeated episodes.

terms.name: Congenital hemolytic anemia
terms.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia with congenital onset.

terms.name: Acute myeloid leukemia
terms.definition: A form of leukemia characterized by overproduction of an early myeloid cell.

terms.name: Neonatal alloimmune thrombocytopenia
terms.definition: Low platelet count associated with maternal platelet-specific alloantibodies.

terms.name: Congenital hypoplastic anemia
terms.name_zh: 先天性再生不良性贫血
terms.definition: A type of hypoplastic anemia with congenital onset.

terms.name: B Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
terms.definition: A type of ALL characterized by elevated levels of B-cell lymphoblasts in the bone marrow and the blood.

terms.name: Post-transfusion thrombocytopenia
terms.definition: Sudden onset of thrombocytopenia (reduced platelet count) within 5-10 days of the transfusion of blood products. The clinical presentation is post-transfusion purpura (PTP), wigth severe thrmbocytopenia, epistaxis, and hemorrhages.

terms.name: Fava bean-induced hemolytic anemia
terms.name_zh: 蚕豆诱发的溶血性贫血
synonyms: Hemolytic anaemia following ingestion of fava beans
Hemolytic anemia following ingestion of fava beans
terms.definition: A kind of hemolytic anemia that is induced by the ingestion of fava beans.

terms.name: Drug-sensitive hemolytic anemia
terms.name_zh: 药物敏感性溶血性贫血
terms.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia that is triggered by ingestion of certain drugs.

terms.name: Normocytic hypoplastic anemia
terms.definition: A type of hypoplastic anemia in which the erythrocytes have a normal cell volume (the mean corpuscular volume is within normal limits).

terms.name: Acute myelomonocytic leukemia
terms.name_zh: 急性粒单核细胞白血病
terms.definition: An acute leukemia characterized by the proliferation of both neutrophil and monocyte precursors.

terms.name: Hypersegmentation of neutrophil nuclei
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞核分叶过多
synonyms: Hypersegmentation of neutrophil nuclei in peripheral blood
terms.definition: An excessive division of the lobes of the nucleus of a neutrophil.

terms.name: Atypical elliptocytosis
terms.name_zh: 非典型椭圆形红细胞增多症

terms.name: Anisopoikilocytosis
terms.definition: A type of poikilocytosis characterized by the presence in the blood of erythrocytes of varying sizes and abnormal shapes.

terms.name: Increased hemoglobin oxygen affinity
terms.name_zh: 血红蛋白氧亲和力升高
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the binding affinity of hemoglobin for oxygen.

terms.name: Folate-unresponsive megaloblastic anemia
terms.name_zh: 叶酸无反应性巨幼细胞性贫血
terms.definition: A type of megaloblastic anemia that does not improve upon administration of folate. Since vitamin B12 acts by promoting recycling of folate, administration of vitamin B12 also does not improve this type of anemia.

terms.name: Refractory anemia with ringed sideroblasts
terms.definition: A type of myelodysplastic syndrome characterized by less than 5% myeloblasts in the bone marrow, but with 15% or greater red cell precursors in the marrow being abnormal iron-stuffed cells called ringed sideroblasts.

terms.name: Recurrent thromboembolism
terms.definition: Repeated episodes of obstruction of blood flow due to an embolus, i.e., blood clot that has traveled from its point of origin within the blood stream.

terms.name: Microspherocytosis
terms.definition: The presence of erythrocytes that are sphere-shaped and reduced in size.

terms.name: Acute promyelocytic leukemia
terms.name_zh: 急性早幼粒细胞白血病
terms.definition: A type of acute myeloid leukemia in which abnormal promyelocytes predominate.

terms.name: Pyropoikilocytosis
terms.definition: A form of severe hemolytic anemia characterized by erythrocyte morphology reminiscent of that seen in patients after a thermal burn.

terms.name: Hypochromic microcytic anemia
terms.definition: A type of anemia characterized by an abnormally low concentration of hemoglobin in the erythrocytes and lower than normal size of the erythrocytes.

terms.name: Reduced factor XII activity
terms.definition: Decreased activity of coagulation factor XII. Factor XII (fXII) is part of the intrinsic coagulation pathway and binds to exposed collagen at site of vessel wall injury, activated by high-MW kininogen and kallikrein, thereby initiating the coagulation cascade.

terms.name: Coombs-positive hemolytic anemia
terms.name_zh: 库姆斯试验阳性溶血性贫血
terms.definition: A type of hemolytic anemia in which the Coombs test is positive.

terms.name: Acute monocytic leukemia
terms.definition: The accumulation of transformed primitive hematopoietic blast cells, which lose their ability of normal differentiation and proliferation.

terms.name: Prolonged bleeding after surgery
terms.definition: Bleeding that persists longer than the normal time following a surgical procedure.

terms.name: Ph-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia
terms.definition: A subset of acute lymphoblastic leukemia that results from a reciprocal translocation between the ABL-1 oncogene and a breakpoint cluster region (BCR), resulting in a fusion gene, BCR-ABL, that encodes an oncogenic protein with constitutively active tyrosine kinase activity.

terms.name: Recurrent deep vein thrombosis
terms.definition: Repeated episodes of the formation of a blot clot in a deep vein.

terms.name: Folate-responsive megaloblastic anemia
terms.name_zh: 叶酸反应性巨幼细胞性贫血
terms.definition: A type of megaloblastic anemia (i.e., anemia characterized by the presence of erythroblasts that are larger than normal) that improves upon the administration of folate.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
terms.definition: Decreased alkaline phosphatase measured within leukocytes.

terms.name: Intermittent thrombocytopenia
terms.definition: Reduced platelet count that occurs sporadically, i.e., it comes and goes.

terms.name: Reduced protein S activity
terms.definition: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of vitamin K-dependent protein S. Protein S is a cofactor of protein C.

terms.name: Normochromic microcytic anemia
terms.definition: A type of anemia characterized by an normal concentration of hemoglobin in the erythrocytes and lower than normal size of the erythrocytes.

terms.name: Hyperchromic macrocytic anemia
terms.definition: A type of anemia characterized by abnormally large erythrocytes with abnormally high amounts of hemoglobin.

terms.name: Amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia
terms.name_zh: 无巨核细胞性血小板减少症
terms.definition: Thrombocytopenia related to lack of or severe reduction in the count of megakaryocytes.

terms.name: Thiamine-responsive megaloblastic anemia
terms.definition: A type of megaloblastic anemia (i.e., anemia characterized by the presence of erythroblasts that are larger than normal) that improves upon the administration of thiamine.

terms.name: Elevated bone marrow ring sideroblast count
terms.name_zh: 骨髓环形铁粒幼细胞计数升高
terms.definition: Count of ring sideroblasts in the bone marrow above the upper limit of normal. Ring sideroblasts are nucleated erythroblasts with a pathologic accumulation of iron granules in the mitochondrial matrix. They can be detected by Prussian blue staining as blue perinuclear aggregates in bone marrow aspirate erythroblasts.

terms.name: Impaired ADP-induced platelet aggregation
terms.definition: Abnormal platelet response to ADP as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ADP.

terms.name: Chronic hemolytic anemia
terms.definition: An chronic form of hemolytic anemia.

terms.name: Perineal fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula between the bowel and the perineum.

terms.name: Incisional hernia
terms.definition: An abdominal hernia that occurs at a site of weakness in the abdominal wall resulting from an incompletely-healed surgical wound.

terms.name: Spontaneous neonatal pneumothorax
terms.definition: Pneumothorax occurring neonatally without traumatic injury to the chest or lung.

terms.name: Intercostal muscle weakness
terms.definition: Lack of strength of the intercostal muscles, i.e., of the muscle groups running along the ribs that create and move the chest wall.

terms.name: Intermittent hyperventilation
terms.definition: Episodic hyperventilation.

terms.name: Respiratory infections in early life
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to respiratory infections in early life, as manifested by recurrent episodes of respiratory infections.

terms.name: Respiratory failure requiring assisted ventilation
terms.definition: A state of respiratory distress that requires a life saving intervention in the form of gaining airway access and instituting positive pressure ventilation.

terms.name: Intermittent episodes of respiratory insufficiency due to muscle weakness
terms.name_zh: 肌无力致间歇性呼吸功能不全发作

terms.name: Elevated pulmonary artery pressure
terms.definition: An abnormally elevated blood pressure in the circulation of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Recurrent infections due to aspiration
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to infections due to aspiration, as manifested by recurrent episodes of infections due to aspiration.

terms.name: Stress/infection-induced lactic acidosis
terms.definition: A form of lactic acidemia that occurs in relation to stress or infection.

terms.name: Persistent lactic acidosis
terms.definition: A continuous form of lactic acidemia.

terms.name: Severe lactic acidosis
terms.definition: A severe form of lactic acidemia.

terms.name: Exercise-induced lactic acidemia
terms.definition: A form of lactic acidemia that occurs following exercise or exertion.

terms.name: Congenital lactic acidosis
terms.definition: A form of lactic acidemia with congenital onset.

terms.name: Maturity-onset diabetes of the young
terms.name_zh: 青少年发病的成人型糖尿病
synonyms: Maturity onset diabetes of the young
terms.definition: The term Maturity-onset diabetes of the young (MODY) was initially used for patients diagnosed with fasting hyperglycemia that could be treated without insulin for more than two years, where the initial diagnosis was made at a young age (under 25 years). Thus, MODY combines characteristics of type 1 diabetes (young age at diagnosis) and type 2 diabetes (less insulin dependence than type 1 diabetes). The term MODY is now most often used to refer to a group of monogenic diseases with these characteristics. Here, the term is used to describe hyperglycemia diagnosed at a young age with no or minor insulin dependency, no evidence of insulin resistance, and lack of evidence of autoimmune destruction of the beta cells.

terms.name: Reduced circulating vitamin A concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of vitamin A below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hypokalemic hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis
terms.name_zh: 低钾低氯性代谢性碱中毒

terms.name: Bicarbonate-wasting renal tubular acidosis
terms.name_zh: 碳酸氢盐消耗性肾小管酸中毒

terms.name: Episodic metabolic acidosis
terms.definition: Repeated transient episodes of metabolic acidosis, that is, of the buildup of acid or depletion of base due to accumulation of metabolic acids.

terms.name: Intermittent lactic acidemia
terms.definition: An intermittent (discontinuous) form of lactic acidemia.

terms.name: Recurrent infantile hypoglycemia
synonyms: Recurrent low blood sugar in infant
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of decreased concentration of glucose in the blood occurring during the infantile period.

terms.name: Impairment of galactose metabolism
terms.definition: An impairment of galactose metabolism.

terms.name: Generalized distal tubular acidosis
terms.name_zh: 全身性远端肾小管酸中毒

terms.name: Hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis
terms.definition: A form of metabolic acidosis with increased serum chloride levels.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating magnesium concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of magnesium in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Atypical hyperphenylalaninemia
terms.name_zh: 非典型高苯丙氨酸血症

terms.name: Hyperphenylalaninemia
terms.definition: The concentration of L-phenylalanine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal oral glucose tolerance
terms.definition: An abnormal resistance to glucose, i.e., a reduction in the ability to maintain glucose levels in the blood stream within normal limits following oral administration of glucose.

terms.name: Chronic lactic acidosis
terms.definition: A chronic form of lactic acidemia.

terms.name: Orthostatic hypotension due to autonomic dysfunction
Pulmonary artery dilatation
terms.definition: An abnormal widening of the diameter of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Abnormality of the pulmonary vasculature
synonyms: Abnormality of the lung blood vessels

terms.name: Arteriosclerosis of small cerebral arteries
terms.definition: Arteriosclerosis (increased thickness, increased stiffness, loss of elasticity) of the small arteries of the brain.

terms.name: Ascending aortic dissection
terms.definition: A separation of the layers within the wall of the ascending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.

terms.name: Vascular calcification
terms.definition: Abnormal calcification of the vasculature.

terms.name: Pulmonary artery atresia
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly with a narrowing or complete absence of the opening between the right ventricle and the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Venous thrombosis
terms.definition: Formation of a blood clot (thrombus) inside a vein, causing the obstruction of blood flow.

terms.name: Pulmonary artery aneurysm
terms.definition: An aneurysm (severe localized balloon-like outward bulging) in the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Tortuous cerebral arteries
terms.definition: Excessive bending, twisting, and winding of a cerebral artery.

terms.name: Generalized arterial calcification
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts, affecting arteries distributed throughout the body.

terms.name: Extrahepatic portal hypertension
terms.definition: Increased pressure in the pre-hepatic portal vein.

terms.name: Aortic aneurysm
synonyms: Bulge in wall of large artery that carries blood away from heart
terms.definition: Aortic dilatation refers to a dimension that is greater than the 95th percentile for the normal person age, sex and body size. In contrast, an aneurysm is defined as a localized dilation of the aorta that is more than 150 percent of predicted (ratio of observed to expected diameter 1.5 or more). Aneurysm should be distinguished from ectasia, which represents a diffuse dilation of the aorta less than 50 percent of normal aorta diameter.

terms.name: Accelerated atherosclerosis
terms.definition: Atherosclerosis which occurs in a person with certain risk factors (e.g., SLE, diabetes, smoking, hypertension, hypercholesterolaemia, family history of early heart disease) at an earlier age than would occur in another person without those risk factors.

terms.name: Dilatation of the cerebral artery
terms.definition: The presence of a localized dilatation or ballooning of a cerebral artery.

terms.name: Extracranial internal carotid artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the extracranial portion of the internal carotid artery wall.

terms.name: Arteriovenous fistula
terms.definition: An abnormal connection between an artery and vein.

terms.name: Vascular tortuosity
terms.definition: Abnormal twisting of arteries or veins.

terms.name: Peripheral arterial stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing of peripheral arteries with reduction of blood flow to the limbs. This feature may be quantified as an ankle-brachial index of less than 0.9, and may be manifested clinically as claudication.

terms.name: Pulmonary arteriovenous fistulas
terms.definition: A rare vascular anomaly with a direct communication between pulmonary artery and pulmonary vein without an intervening capillary bed.

terms.name: Generalized arterial tortuosity
terms.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of arteries affecting most or all arteries.

terms.name: Descending thoracic aorta aneurysm
terms.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta.

terms.name: Absent pulmonary artery
terms.definition: A congenital defect with aplasia (absence) of one of the right or left pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Pulmonary artery sling
terms.definition: An anomalous origin of the left pulmonary artery, such that it arises from the posterior aspect of the right pulmonary artery and passes between the trachea and esophagus to reach the left hilum.

terms.name: Thoracic aorta calcification
terms.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the thoracic aorta.

terms.name: Calcification of the aorta
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the aorta.

terms.name: Pulmonary arterial medial hypertrophy
synonyms: Hypertrophy of the pulmonary artery wall
terms.definition: Increase in mass of the tunica media of the arteries in the pulmonary circulation.

terms.name: Medial calcification of large arteries
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of large (conduit) arteries.

terms.name: Recurrent cerebral hemorrhage
terms.definition: Recurrent bleeding into the parenchyma of the brain.

terms.name: Peripheral pulmonary artery stenosis
terms.definition: Stenosis of a peripheral branch of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Ascending tubular aorta aneurysm
synonyms: Aneurysm of the ascending tubular aorta
Bulging of wall of large artery located above heart
terms.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the tubular part of the ascending aorta.

terms.name: Pulmonary artery hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Elevated mean arterial pressure
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the average blood pressure in an individual during a single cardiac cycle.

terms.name: Coarctation of abdominal aorta
terms.definition: Coarctation of the aorta is a narrowing or constriction of a segment of the abdominal aorta.

terms.name: Erlenmeyer flask deformity of the femurs
terms.name_zh: 股骨厄伦美厄烧瓶样畸形
synonyms: Erlenmeyer flask deformity of distal femur
terms.definition: Flaring of distal femur.

terms.name: Bilateral radial aplasia
terms.definition: Missing radius bone on both sides associated with congenital failure of development.

terms.name: Metaphyseal sclerosis
synonyms: Increased bone density in wide portion of long bone
terms.definition: Abnormally increased density of metaphyseal bone.

terms.name: Metaphyseal rarefaction
terms.definition: Reduction in density of metaphyseal bony tissue.

terms.name: Mesomelic leg shortening
terms.definition: Shortening of the middle parts of the leg in relation to the upper and terminal segments.

terms.name: Rhizomelic arm shortening
terms.definition: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the arm (i.e. the humerus).

terms.name: Slender long bones with narrow diaphyses
synonyms: Slender long bones with narrow shaft
terms.definition: Reduced diameter of a long bone with a more pronounced reduction of the diameter of the diaphysis of the long bones.

terms.name: Multicentric ossification of proximal humeral epiphyses
terms.name_zh: 肱骨近端骨骺多中心骨化

terms.name: Recurrent patellar dislocation
terms.definition: Patellar dislocation occurring repeated times.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the capital femoral epiphysis
terms.name_zh: 股骨头骨骺发育不全/缺如
synonyms: Absent/small end part of innermost thighbone
Absent/underdeveloped end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Flattened proximal radial epiphyses
terms.definition: An abnormally flat form of the proximal epiphysis of the radius.

terms.name: Femoral bowing present at birth, straightening with time
terms.name_zh: 出生时股骨弯曲，随时间变直
synonyms: Bowing of thighbone at birth, straightening with time
terms.definition: Congenital onset bending or abnormal curvature of the femur that normalizes with age.

terms.name: Dumbbell-shaped humerus
synonyms: Dumbbell-shaped long bone in upper arm
terms.definition: The humerus is shortened and displays flaring (widening) of the metaphyses.

terms.name: Osteomyelitis leading to amputation due to slow healing fractures
Mesomelic arm shortening
terms.definition: Shortening of the middle parts of the arm in relation to the upper and terminal segments.

terms.name: Dysplastic distal radial epiphyses
terms.name_zh: 桡骨远端骨骺发育不良
terms.definition: Abnormally developed (dysplastic) distal epiphysis of the radius.

terms.name: Diaphyseal undertubulation
synonyms: Thickening of shaft or central part of long bones
terms.definition: Tubulation refers to the size and shape of tubular bones. In children and adolescents, the modeling process regulates normal bone growth. Final shaft (tube) diameter depends on appositional bone growth and the equilibrium between periosteal and endosteal bone resorption and formation. Undertubulation refers to a broad, widened form of the shafts (diaphyses) of long bones.

terms.name: Hypoplastic distal humeri
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the distal portion of the humerus.

terms.name: Mesomelic/rhizomelic limb shortening
terms.name_zh: 肢中部/肢根部肢体短缩

terms.name: Widened proximal tibial metaphyses
synonyms: Wide innermost wide portion of shankbone bone
Wide innermost wide portion of shinbone bone

terms.name: Distal ulnar hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the distal portion of the ulna.

terms.name: Shortening of all phalanges of the toes
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia (shortening) of all phalanges of the foot.

terms.name: Unilateral ulnar hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ulna on only one side.

terms.name: Proximal radio-ulnar synostosis
terms.definition: An abnormal osseous union (fusion) between the proximal portions of the radius and the ulna.

terms.name: Multiple long-bone exostoses
synonyms: Multiple exostoses of long tubular bones
terms.definition: Multiple exostoses originating in long bones.

terms.name: Irregular capital femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Irregular end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: Irregular surface of the normally relatively smooth capital femoral epiphysis.

terms.name: Irregular, rachitic-like metaphyses
terms.name_zh: 不规则佝偻病样干骺端

terms.name: Proximal humeral metaphyseal irregularity
terms.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of the metaphysis at the proximal end of the humerus (at the shoulder).

terms.name: Diaphyseal cortical sclerosis
terms.definition: An elevation in bone density of the cortex of one or more diaphyses. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.

terms.name: Anterolateral radial head dislocation
terms.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an anterolateral direction.

terms.name: Metaphyseal spurs
terms.definition: Bony outgrowths that extend laterally from the margin of the metaphysis.

terms.name: Fragmented, irregular epiphyses
synonyms: Fragmented, irregular end part of bone

terms.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses fused within their metaphyses
terms.name_zh: 骨骺锥形融合于干骺端
synonyms: Cone-shaped end part of long bone fused within their wide portion of wide bone

terms.name: Proximal fibular overgrowth
synonyms: Overgrowth of innermost part of calf bone
terms.definition: Overgrowth of the proximal part of the fibula.

terms.name: Proximal radial head dislocation
terms.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an proximal direction.

terms.name: Wrist hypermobility
terms.definition: The ability of the wrist joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

terms.name: Anterior radial head dislocation
terms.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an anterior direction.

terms.name: Limited knee flexion/extension
terms.definition: A limited ability of the knee joint to perform extension and flexion.

terms.name: Abnormal metaphyseal trabeculation
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pattern of trabecula (small interconnecting rods of bone) in a metaphyseal region of bone.

terms.name: Lateral femoral bowing
terms.definition: A lateral bending or abnormal curvature of the femur.

terms.name: Streaky metaphyseal sclerosis
synonyms: Streak increase in bone density in wide portion of wide bone
terms.definition: The presence of streaks (bands) of abnormally increased density of metaphyseal bone.

terms.name: Absent proximal radial epiphyses
terms.definition: Absence of the proximal radial epiphysis.

terms.name: Distal femoral bowing
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the distal portion of the femur.

terms.name: Premature birth following premature rupture of fetal membranes
synonyms: Premature birth following premature rupture of foetal membranes

terms.name: High-frequency hearing impairment
terms.definition: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the higher frequencies of sound (3,000 to 6,000 Hz).

terms.name: Cochlear degeneration
terms.definition: Deterioration or loss of the tissues of the cochlea.

terms.name: Calcification of the auricular cartilage
terms.definition: Ossification affecting the external ear cartilage.

terms.name: Hypoplastic nasal septum
synonyms: Decreased size of septum of nose
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the nasal septum.

terms.name: Abnormality of the vertebral endplates
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the vertebral end plates, which are the top and bottom portions of the vertebral bodies that interface with the vertebral disks.

terms.name: Abnormal sacrum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the sacral bone.

terms.name: Abnormal intervertebral disk morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the intervertebral disk.

terms.name: Abnormal Achilles tendon morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Achilles tendon.

terms.name: Atrial fibrillation
synonyms: Quivering upper heart chambers resulting in irregular heartbeat
terms.definition: An atrial arrhythmia characterized by disorganized atrial activity without discrete P waves on the surface EKG, but instead by an undulating baseline or more sharply circumscribed atrial deflections of varying amplitude an frequency ranging from 350 to 600 per minute.

terms.name: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
terms.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the abdominal aorta.

terms.name: Aortic arch aneurysm
terms.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the aortic arch.

terms.name: Supraventricular arrhythmia
terms.definition: A type of arrhythmia that originates above the ventricles, whereby the electrical impulse propagates down the normal His Purkinje system similar to normal sinus rhythm.

terms.name: Arterial tortuosity
terms.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of arteries.

terms.name: Elevated diastolic blood pressure
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in diastolic blood pressure.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac atrium morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of a cardiac atrium.

terms.name: Posterior scalloping of vertebral bodies
terms.definition: An excessive concavity of the posterior surface of one or more vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Pericardial constriction
terms.definition: Compression of the heart caused by rigid, thickened, or fused pericardial membranes.

terms.name: Right ventricular dilatation
terms.definition: Enlargement of the chamber of the right ventricle, which can be defined echocardiographically as a right ventricular to left ventricular ratio greater than 1:1.

terms.name: Absence of the pulmonary valve
terms.definition: Refers to the specific combination of defects with a severely dysplastic pulmonary valve and massively dilated branch pulmonary arteries.

terms.name: Abnormal T-wave
terms.definition: An abnormality of the T wave on the electrocardiogram, which mainly represents the repolarization of the ventricles.

terms.name: Mitral annular calcification
terms.definition: Mitral annular calcification (MAC) results from progressive calcium deposition along and beneath the mitral valve annulus.

terms.name: Anomalous origin of right pulmonary artery from ascending aorta
terms.name_zh: 右肺动脉异常起源于升主动脉
terms.definition: The right pulmonary artery originates from the ascending aorta in the presence of a pulmonary valve and main pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Ventricular septal hypertrophy
terms.definition: The dividing wall between left and right sides of the heart, thickens and bulges into the left ventricle.

terms.name: Coronary artery stenosis
terms.definition: Abnormal narrowing of the coronary artery.

terms.name: Cardiac valve calcification
terms.definition: Abnormal calcification of a cardiac valve.

terms.name: Pulmonary valve defects
terms.definition: Any defect in the valve connecting the heart and the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Abnormal atrioventricular conduction
terms.definition: An impairment of the electrical continuity between the atria and ventricles.

terms.name: Preductal coarctation of the aorta
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized proximal to the ductus arteriosus, i.e., to the preductal region of aortic arch.

terms.name: Histiocytoid cardiomyopathy
terms.definition: A type of cardiomyopathy characterized pathologically by hamartomatous lesions of cardiac Purkinje cells.

terms.name: Ventricular escape rhythm
terms.definition: A ventricular escape rhythm occurs whenever higher-lever pacemakers in AV junction or sinus node fail to control ventricular activation. Escape rate is usually 20-40 bpm, often associated with broad QRS complexes (at least 120 ms).

terms.name: Hypoplastic left atrium
terms.definition: Underdeveloped, small left heart atrium

terms.name: Concentric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
terms.definition: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with an symmetrical and concentric pattern of hypertrophy.

terms.name: Total anomalous pulmonary venous return
terms.definition: Total anomalous pulmonary venous return refers to a congenital malformation in which all four pulmonary veins do not connect normally to the left atrium, but instead drain abnormally to the right atrium.

terms.name: Abnormal left ventricular function
terms.definition: Inability of the left ventricle to perform its normal physiologic function. Failure is either due to an inability to contract the left ventricle or the inability to relax completely and fill with blood during diastole.

terms.name: Dysplastic pulmonary valve
terms.definition: A congenital malformation of the pulmonary valve characterized by leaflet deformation.

terms.name: Shortened PR interval
terms.definition: Reduced time for the PR interval (beginning of the P wave to the beginning of the QRS complex). In adults, normal values are 120 to 200 ms long.

terms.name: Elevated right atrial pressure
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in magnitude of the pressure in the right atrium.

terms.name: Complete heart block with broad QRS complexes
terms.name_zh: 宽QRS波群完全性心脏传导阻滞
terms.definition: A type of third degree heart block in which the escape rhythm arises at a relatively low part of the conduction system (below the atrioventricular node), which produces a wide QRS complex.

terms.name: Left posterior fascicular block
terms.definition: Conduction block in the posterior division of the left bundle branch of the bundle of His.

terms.name: Membranous subvalvular aortic stenosis
terms.definition: Subvalvular stenosis is caused by a diaphragm-like membrane. The stenosis is clinically manifested like any other form of aortic stenosis but is often associated with some aortic insufficiency.

terms.name: Dysplastic aortic valve
terms.definition: A congenital malformation of the aortic valve characterized by leaflet deformation.

terms.name: Premature arteriosclerosis
terms.definition: Arteriosclerosis occurring at an age that is younger than usual.

terms.name: Complete heart block with narrow QRS complexes
terms.name_zh: 窄QRS波群完全性心脏传导阻滞
terms.definition: A type of third degree heart block in which the escape rhythm arises at the atrioventricular node, which produces a narrow QRS complex.

terms.name: Tricuspid regurgitation
terms.definition: Failure of the tricuspid valve to close sufficiently upon contraction of the right ventricle, causing blood to regurgitate (flow backward) into the right atrium.

terms.name: Premature coronary artery atherosclerosis
terms.definition: Reduction of the diameter of the coronary arteries as the result of an accumulation of atheromatous plaques within the walls of the coronary arteries before age of 45.

terms.name: Bicuspid pulmonary valve
terms.definition: The presence of a bicuspid pulmonary valve.

terms.name: Pericardial lymphangiectasia
terms.definition: An abnormal dilatation of lymph vessels in the pericardium.

terms.name: Prolonged QTc interval
terms.definition: A longer than normal interval (corrected for heart rate) between the Q and T waves in the heart's cycle. Prolonged QTc can cause premature action potentials during late phase depolarizations thereby leading to ventricular arrhythmias and ventricular fibrillations.

terms.name: Global systolic dysfunction
terms.definition: A reduced ejection fraction and an enlarged left ventricle chamber, the latter by an increased resistance to filling with increased filling pressures. Systolic dysfunction is clinically associated with left ventricular failure in the presence of marked cardiomegaly.

terms.name: Synovial lining hyperplasia
terms.definition: Synovial hyperplasia involves proliferation of mesenchymal stromal/stem cells and leads to synovial thickening, which can be observed radiographically.

terms.name: Flattened metatarsal heads
synonyms: Flattened head of long bone of foot
terms.definition: Abnormally flat shape of the heads of the metatarsal bones.

terms.name: Generalized morning stiffness
terms.definition: A sensation of stiffness in the joints that occurs following waking up in the morning.

terms.name: Stiff interphalangeal joints
terms.definition: Interphalangeal joint stiffness is a perceived sensation of tightness in the interphalangeal joints when attempting to move them after a period of inactivity.

terms.name: Aplasia of the abdominal wall musculature
terms.name_zh: 腹壁肌肉组织发育不全
terms.definition: Absence of the abdominal musculature.

terms.name: Helicobacter pylori infection
terms.definition: A recurrent infection of the GI tract with helicobacter pylori, a gram-negative, microaerophilic bacterium usually found in the stomach.

terms.name: Spontaneous esophageal perforation
terms.definition: The occurrence of the full-thickness tear (perforation) of the wall of the esophagus.

terms.name: Pancreatic pseudocyst
terms.definition: Cyst-like space not lined by epithelium and contained within the pancreas. Pancreatic pseudocysts are often associated with pancreatitis.

terms.name: Gastric hypertrophy
terms.definition: Hypertrophy of the stomach.

terms.name: Secretory diarrhea
terms.definition: Watery voluminous diarrhea resulting from an imbalance between ion and water secretion and absorption.

terms.name: Intrahepatic bile duct cysts
terms.definition: The presence of cyst of the intrahepatic bile duct.

terms.name: Hypoplastic colon
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the colon.

terms.name: Anal mucosal leukoplakia
terms.definition: Leukoplakia is a precancerous dermatosis of mucous membranes analogous Leukoplakia is basically a chronic inflammatory hypertrophy in which anaplasia and malignant dyskeratosis may develop and subsequently advance to an invasive squamous cell cancer. The clinical diagnosis of primary anal leukoplakia is indicated by single or multiple slightly raised,irregular, marginated, grayish-white keratinized' patches in the anal canal. Tissue biopsy is necessary for confirmation.

terms.name: Pancreatic calcification
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition lesions in the pancreas.

terms.name: Intestinal obstruction
terms.definition: Blockage or impairment of the normal flow of the contents of the intestine towards the anal canal.

terms.name: Frequent Giardia lamblia infestation
terms.name_zh: 蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫反复感染
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Giardia lamblia infection of the intestine, as manifested by a medical history of multiple episodes of Giardia lamblia intestinal infection.

terms.name: Impaired mastication
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the ability to masticate (chew), i.e., in the ability to crush and ground food in preparation for swallowing.

terms.name: Abdominal organ duplication
terms.definition: A congenital malformation characterized by the development of an additional organ or organ-like structure, i.e., an extra copy of the organ normally located in the abdomen.

terms.name: Anoperineal fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula (abnormal tunnel) between the anal canal and the perineum.

terms.name: Absence of intrinsic factor
synonyms: Intrinsic factor absent from gastric juice
terms.definition: Absence of gastric intrinsic factor, which is normally produced by the parietal cells of the stomach, and is required for the absorption of vitamin B12.

terms.name: Multiple intestinal neurofibromatosis
terms.name_zh: 多发性肠道神经纤维瘤病

terms.name: Bowel diverticulosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple diverticula of the intestine.

terms.name: Rectal abscess
terms.definition: A collection of pus in the area of the rectum.

terms.name: Intestinal edema
terms.definition: Accumulation of cell free, noninflammatony fluid within the wall of the intestinal tract producing uniform thickening of the mucosal folds.

terms.name: Adenomatous colonic polyposis
terms.definition: Presence of multiple adenomatous polyps in the colon.

terms.name: Biliary tract obstruction
terms.definition: Obstruction affecting the biliary tree.

terms.name: Chronic gastritis
terms.definition: A chronic form of gastritis.

terms.name: Pancreatic dysplasia
terms.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the pancreas.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the gallbladder
terms.definition: The presence of a hypoplastic gallbladder.

terms.name: Jejunal atresia
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the jejunum.

terms.name: Chronic calcifying pancreatitis
terms.definition: A form of chronic pancreatitis that is characterized by calcification.

terms.name: Degenerative liver disease
terms.definition: The presence of degenerative changes of the liver.

terms.name: Total intestinal aganglionosis
terms.definition: A congenital defect characterized by the lack of ganglion cells in the entire intestine, i.e., the aganglionic segment comprises the entire large and small bowel.

terms.name: Extrahepatic biliary duct atresia
terms.definition: Atresia in the extrahepatic bile duct.

terms.name: Partial abdominal muscle agenesis
terms.definition: Failure to form of portions of the abdominal musculature.

terms.name: Gastrointestinal infarctions
synonyms: Death of digestive organ tissue due to poor blood supply

terms.name: Intestinal hypoplasia
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the intestine.

terms.name: Giant hypertrophic gastritis
terms.definition: A type of gastritis characterized by excessive proliferation of the gastric mucosa and diffuse thickening of the gastric mucosal folds.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the abdominal wall musculature
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the abdominal musculature.

terms.name: Intrahepatic biliary atresia
terms.definition: Atresia in the intrahepatic bile duct.

terms.name: Absence of pectoralis minor muscle
terms.definition: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the pectoralis minor.

terms.name: Unilateral absence of pectoralis major muscle
synonyms: Unilateral aplasia of pectoralis major muscle
terms.definition: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the pectoralis minor on only one side of the chest.

terms.name: Abnormal facility in opposing the shoulders
terms.definition: Increased range of shoulder movement related to aplasia or hypoplasia of the clavicles that results in the ability to approximate the shoulders in front of the chest.

terms.name: Joint hemorrhage
terms.definition: Hemorrhage occurring within a joint.

terms.name: Abnormal synovial membrane morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the synovium, which is a membrane that lines the cavity of synovial joints and consists of a lining layer of macrophage-like synoviocytes and fibroblast-like synoviocytes, as well as a sublining of connective tissue. Synovial cells are thought to contribute to joint homeostasis by secreting various factors such as hyaluronic acid and lubricin important for joint lubrication and function, as well as disposing of the waste products.

terms.name: Gastritis
terms.definition: The presence of inflammation of the gastric mucous membrane.

terms.name: Abnormality of the gallbladder
terms.definition: An abnormality of the gallbladder.

terms.name: Abnormal jejunum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the jejunum, i.e., of the middle section of the small intestine.

terms.name: Intestinal polyp
terms.definition: A discrete abnormal tissue mass that protrudes into the lumen of the intestine and is attached to the intestinal wall either by a stalk, pedunculus, or a broad base.

terms.name: Premature delivery because of cervical insufficiency or membrane fragility
Miscarriage
terms.definition: A pregnancy that ends at a stage in which the fetus is incapable of surviving on its own, defined as the spontaneous loss of a fetus before the 22th week of pregnancy.

terms.name: Prominent nasolabial fold
terms.definition: Exaggerated bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion, or commissure).

terms.name: Absent nasal septal cartilage
terms.definition: Lack of the cartilage of the nasal septum.

terms.name: Hypoplastic nasal tip
synonyms: Decreased size of tip of nose

terms.name: Depressed nasal bridge
terms.definition: Posterior positioning of the nasal root in relation to the overall facial profile for age.

terms.name: Hypoplastic nasal bridge
synonyms: Decreased size of bridge of nose

terms.name: Abnormal nostril morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the nostril.

terms.name: Internal carotid artery hypoplasia
synonyms: Decreased size of internal carotid artery

terms.name: Intimal thickening in the coronary arteries
Arterial dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of an artery.

terms.name: Pseudocoarctation of the aorta
terms.definition: Pseudocoarctation is a congenital anomaly of kinking, or buckling, of the aorta without a pressure gradient across the lesion. It is characterized by elongation and kinking of the aorta at the level of the ligamentum arteriosum.

terms.name: Premature occlusive vascular stenosis
terms.definition: Peripheral arterial stenosis with onset before the age of 50 years.

terms.name: Persistent left superior vena cava
terms.definition: A rare congenital vascular anomaly that results when the left superior cardinal vein caudal to the innominate vein fails to regress.

terms.name: Carotid artery tortuosity
terms.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the carotid arteries.

terms.name: Aortic arch calcification
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the arch of aorta.

terms.name: Cerebral venous thrombosis
terms.definition: Formation of a blood clot (thrombus) inside a cerebral vein, causing the obstruction of blood flow.

terms.name: Capillary hemangioma
terms.definition: The presence of a capillary hemangioma, which are hemangiomas with small endothelial spaces.

terms.name: Large vessel vasculitis
terms.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) affecting large arteries such as the aorta and branches of the aorta.

terms.name: Agenesis of pulmonary vessels
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the lack of formation of the pulmonary blood vessels.

terms.name: Pulmonary aterial intimal fibrosis
terms.definition: Formation of excess fibrous connective tissue in the tunica intima (innermost layer) of arteries in the pulmonary circulation.

terms.name: Arterial fibromuscular dysplasia
terms.definition: An arterial lesion that is characterized by either intimal fibroplasia, with neointimal lesions of cells and matrix deposition, or medial fibroplasia, in which there is loss of smooth muscle cells and increased deposition of collagen and proteoglycans in the medial layer.

terms.name: Anomalous branches of internal carotid artery
Increased pulmonary vascular resistance
terms.definition: Pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) more than 3 wood units, as defined by the current definition of pulmonary hypertension. 95% of individuals have a PVR of less than 2.4 wood units.

terms.name: Cerebral vasculitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the blood vessels within the brain.

terms.name: Lack of facial subcutaneous fat
synonyms: Lack of facial fat below the skin

terms.name: Mandibulofacial dysostosis
terms.definition: A type of craniofacial dysostosis associated with abnormalities of the external ears, mirognathia, macrostomia, coloboma of the lower eyelid, and cleft palate. This is a bundled term that is left in the HPO now for convenience with legacy annotations but should not be used for new annotations.

terms.name: Hemifacial hypertrophy
synonyms: Increase in size of half of face
terms.definition: Unilateral overgrowth of facial tissues, including muscles, bones and skin.

terms.name: Disturbance of facial expression
terms.definition: An abnormality of the gestures or movements executed with the facial muscles with which emotions such as fear, joy, sadness, surprise, and disgust can be expressed.

terms.name: Extension of hair growth on temples to lateral eyebrow
terms.name_zh: 颞部毛发延伸至眉外侧
synonyms: Unusual hairline with hair growth on temples extending to lateral eyebrow
terms.definition: A pattern of hair growth in which there is hair extending from the temples to the lateral eyebrows.

terms.name: Hypoplastic philtrum
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the philtrum.

terms.name: Progeroid facial appearance
terms.definition: A degree of wrinkling of the facial skin that is more than expected for the age of the individual, leading to a prematurely aged appearance.

terms.name: Recurrent mandibular subluxations
terms.definition: Recurrent partial dislocations of the mandible.

terms.name: Sparse lateral eyebrow
synonyms: Limited hair on end of eyebrow
terms.definition: Decreased density/number and/or decreased diameter of lateral eyebrow hairs.

terms.name: Abnormality of complement system
terms.definition: An abnormality of the complement system.

terms.name: Autonomic bladder dysfunction
terms.name_zh: 自主神经源性膀胱功能障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal bladder function (increased urge or frequency of urination or urge incontinence) resulting from abnormal functioning of the autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the bladder
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Abnormal carotid artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the carotid arteries, including the common carotid artery and its' arterial branches.

terms.name: Abnormal vena cava morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the structure of the veins that return deoxygenated blood from the body into the heart, i.e., the superior vena cava and the inferior vena cava.

terms.name: Tracheal cartilaginous sleeve
terms.definition: Tracheal cartilaginous sleeve (TCS) is a rare congenital airway malformation in which distinct tracheal rings are replaced by a continuous cartilaginous segment. Vertically fused C- or O-shaped cartilaginous rings can extend from the subglottis to the carina or bronchus with little to no pars membranacea posteriorly. Comment:Tracheal cartilaginous sleeve has been associated with various craniosynostosis syndromes.

terms.name: Inspiratory stridor
terms.definition: Inspiratory stridor is a high pitched sound upon inspiration that is generally related to laryngeal abnormalities.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the epiglottis
terms.definition: Hypoplasia of the epiglottis.

terms.name: Severe T-cell immunodeficiency
terms.definition: A primary immune deficiency that is characterized by defects or deficiencies of T-lymphocytes that causes specific susceptibility to intracellular micro-organisms.

terms.name: Recurrent herpes
