terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to herpesvirus, as manifested by recurrent episodes of herpesvirus.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement factor I concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环补体因子I浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component factor I in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Defective B cell differentiation
terms.definition: Reduced functionality of the process in which a precursor cell type acquires the specialized features of a B cell. A B cell is a lymphocyte of B lineage with the phenotype CD19-positive and capable of B cell mediated immunity.

terms.name: Aplasia of the thymus
terms.definition: Absence of the thymus. This feature may be appreciated by the lack of a thymic shadow upon radiographic examination.

terms.name: Susceptibility to chickenpox
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to chicken pox, as manifested by recurrent episodes of chicken pox.

terms.name: Humoral immunodeficiency
terms.definition: A general term referring to a defect in immunity resulting from impaired antibody production.

terms.name: Recurrent streptococcus pneumoniae infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to streptococcus pneumoniae infections as manifested by a history of recurrent infections by streptococcus pneumoniae.

terms.name: Abnormality of humoral immunity
terms.definition: An abnormality of the humoral immune system, which comprises antibodies produced by B cells as well as the complement system.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement factor H concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环补体因子H浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component factor H in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal B cell physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the physiological functioning of B cells.

terms.name: Cellular immunodeficiency
terms.definition: An immunodeficiency characterized by defective cell-mediated immunity or humoral immunity.

terms.name: Recurrent Haemophilus influenzae infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Haemophilus influenzae infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Haemophilus influenzae infection.

terms.name: Recurrent Neisseria meningitidis infection
synonyms: Increased susceptibility to neisseria meningitidis infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Neisseria meningitidis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Neisseria meningitidis infection.

terms.name: Defective B cell activation
terms.definition: A reduced ability of a B cell to become activated, i.e., the change in morphology and behavior of

terms.name: Recurrent protozoan infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to protozoan infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of protozoan infection.

terms.name: Combined immunodeficiency
terms.definition: A group of phenotypically heterogeneous genetic disorders characterized by profound deficiencies of T- and B-cell function, which predispose the patients to both infectious and noninfectious complications.

terms.name: Depletion of components of the alternative complement pathway
terms.name_zh: 旁路补体途径成分耗竭
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the components of the alternative complement pathway, such as the C3 protein or its cleavage products.

terms.name: Recurrent opportunistic infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to opportunistic infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection by opportunistic agents, i.e., by microorganisms that do not usually cause disease in a healthy host, but are able to infect a host with a compromised immune system.

terms.name: Susceptibility to coronavirus 229e
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to coronavirus 229e, as manifested by recurrent episodes of coronavirus 229e.

terms.name: Reduction of neutrophil motility
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction of the cell motility of neutrophils.

terms.name: Recurrent Candida infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to Candida infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Candida infection.

terms.name: Decreased total T cell count
synonyms: Decreased absolute count of circulating T cells
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease in the absolute number of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, per microliter of blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

terms.name: Increased total B cell count
terms.definition: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is above the upper limit of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

terms.name: Recurrent bacterial skin infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial infections of the skin, as manifested by recurrent episodes of infectious dermatitis.

terms.name: Chronic intestinal candidiasis
terms.definition: Persistent overgrowth of Candida albicans in the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alpha-globulin concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of alpha-globulin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased total CD8+ T cell proportion
synonyms: Decreased proportion of CD8+ T cells
Decreased proportion of CD8-positive T cells
Decreased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement factor B concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环补体因子B浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component factor B in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased T cell activation
terms.definition: Decreased or impaired activation of T cells in response to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific.

terms.name: Recurrent gram-negative bacterial infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection by gram-negative bacteria, as manifested by a medical history of repeated or frequent infections by these agents.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C3 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C3 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Absence of CD8+ T cells
terms.definition: Lack of detectible CD8-positive T cells

terms.name: Dysfunctional alternative complement pathway
terms.name_zh: 补体旁路途径功能异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the functioning of any aspect of the alternative complement pathway.

terms.name: Absent specific antibody response
terms.definition: Inability of the immune system to produce targeted, protective antibodies (immunoglobulins) against specific pathogens or vaccines in the setting of normal or near-normal serum levels of total IgG, IgA, and IgM and normal absolute counts of B cells and T cells.

terms.name: Recurrent sinopulmonary infections
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to infections involving both the paranasal sinuses and the lungs, as manifested by a history of recurrent sinopulmonary infections.

terms.name: Recurrent systemic pyogenic infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to systemic pyogenic infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of systemic pyogenic infections.

terms.name: Recurrent Neisserial infections
terms.definition: Recurrent infections by bacteria of the genus Neisseria, including N. meningitidis (one of the most common causes of bacterial meningitis).

terms.name: Transient hypogammaglobulinemia of infancy
terms.definition: At birth, newborns are endowed with maternal antibodies. IgG production normally begins at the age of two months. A delay in recovery from this physiological hypogammaglobulinemia between the 3rd and the 6th month of life, and of recovery period between 18 and 36 months defines transient hypogammaglobulinemia of infancy.

terms.name: Recurrent infections in infancy and early childhood
terms.definition: Recurrent infections at an early age with improvement in later childhood.

terms.name: Maxillozygomatic hypoplasia
synonyms: Decreased projection of zygomaticomaxillary bone complex
Decreased size of zygomaticomaxillary bone complex
terms.definition: Hypoplasia of the maxillozygomatic complex.

terms.name: Sclerotic cranial sutures
terms.definition: An increased density in the cranial sutures following obliteration.

terms.name: Widely patent coronal suture
terms.definition: The presence of a coronal suture (the cranial suture that separates the frontal and parietal bones) that is not ossified but rather wide open at an age when it is normally closed.

terms.name: Enlarged posterior fossa
terms.definition: Abnormal increased size of the posterior cranial fossa.

terms.name: Obtuse angle of mandible
terms.definition: Abnormally flat (obtuse) angle of the mandible. The angle of the mandibular, located at the junction between the body and the ramus of the mandible, is normally close to being a right angle. This terms describes an abnormal increase of this angle such that the mandible appears flatter than normal.

terms.name: Calvarial osteosclerosis
terms.definition: An increase in bone density affecting the calvaria (roof of the skull).

terms.name: Absent/hypoplastic paranasal sinuses
terms.definition: Aplasia or hypoplasia of the paranasal sinuses.

terms.name: Absent ethmoidal sinuses
synonyms: Failure of development of ethmoid sinuses
terms.definition: Lack (aplasia) of the ethmoidal sinus.

terms.name: Premature closure of fontanelles
terms.definition: Normally, the posterior and lateral fontanelles are obliterated by about six months after birth, the anterior fontanelle closes by about the middle of the second year. This term refers to the situation in which the fontanelles close at an inappropriately early time point.

terms.name: Calcification of falx cerebri
terms.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in the falx cerebri.

terms.name: Craniofacial osteosclerosis
terms.definition: Abnormally increased density of craniofacial bone tissue.

terms.name: Facial hyperostosis
synonyms: Increase in size of the facial bones
terms.definition: Excessive growth (overgrowth) of the facial bones, that is of the facial skeleton.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the frontal bone
synonyms: Decreased size of bone of forehead
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the frontal bone.

terms.name: Flat occiput
terms.definition: Reduced convexity of the occiput (posterior part of skull).

terms.name: Fusion of middle ear ossicles
terms.definition: Bony fusion of malleus, incus, and stapes.

terms.name: Decreased calvarial ossification
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in ossification of the calvaria (roof of the skull consisting of the frontal bone, parietal bones, temporal bones, and occipital bone).

terms.name: Widely patent sagittal suture
terms.definition: The presence of a sagittal suture (the cranial suture that separates the left and right parietal bones) that is not ossified but rather wide open at an age when it is normally closed.

terms.name: Progressive sclerosis of skull base
terms.definition: Progressively increasing bone density of the skull base without significant changes in bony contour.

terms.name: Decreased circulating IgE concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白E浓度降低
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin E (IgE) in blood.

terms.name: Abnormality of the alternative complement pathway
terms.definition: A deviation in any aspect of the alternative complement pathway.

terms.name: Abnormal epiglottis morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the epiglottis.

terms.name: Secondary microcephaly
terms.definition: Head circumference which falls below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender because of insufficient head growth after birth.

terms.name: Small fontanelle
terms.definition: A fontanelle that is small for age.

terms.name: Prominent metopic ridge
terms.definition: Vertical bony ridge positioned in the midline of the forehead.

terms.name: Postnatal macrocephaly
terms.definition: The postnatal development of an abnormally large skull (macrocephaly).

terms.name: Metopic suture patent to nasal root
terms.definition: The frontal suture divides the two halves of the frontal bone in infants and usually fuses by the age of six years. The suture runs from the bregma (the point on the skull at which the coronal suture is intersected perpendicularly by the sagittal suture) to the nasion or nasal root. This term applies if the suture is widely patent from bregma to nasal root.

terms.name: Midline skin dimples over anterior/posterior fontanelles
Chronic myelogenous leukemia
terms.definition: A myeloproliferative disorder characterized by increased proliferation of the granulocytic cell line without the loss of their capacity to differentiate.

terms.name: Hemoglobin Barts
terms.definition: Normal adult hemoglobin is composed of two chains each of alpha and beta globin. Hb Barts (Hemoglobin Barts) is a tetramer with four gamma globin chains, and is essentially pathognomonic for one or another form of alpha thalassemia. Hb Barts has an extremely high affinity for oxygen, resulting in almost no oxygen delivery to the tissues.

terms.name: Monoclonal elevation of circulating IgM concentration
terms.definition: Presence of a monoclonal immunoglobulin M protein in the serum.

terms.name: Transient erythroblastopenia
synonyms: Transient decrease in blood erythrocyte number
terms.definition: A transient reduction in the number of erythroblasts in the circulation.

terms.name: Heinz body anemia
terms.definition: Anemia characterized by abnormal intracellular inclusions, composed of denatured hemoglobin, found on the membrane of red blood cells.

terms.name: Increased megakaryocyte count
terms.definition: Increased megakaryocyte number, i.e., of platelet precursor cells, present in the bone marrow.

terms.name: T-cell lymphoma/leukemia
terms.definition: A type of T-cell lymphoma in which cancerous T-cells may present in the blood (leukemia), lymph nodes (lymphoma), skin or in multiple areas.

terms.name: Increased mean corpuscular volume
terms.definition: Larger than normal size of erythrocytes.

terms.name: Chronic disseminated intravascular coagulation
terms.name_zh: 慢性弥散性血管内凝血
terms.definition: A chronic form of disseminated intravascular coagulation in which a persistent weak or intermittent activating stimulus is present and destruction and production of coagulation factors and platelets are balanced.

terms.name: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
terms.definition: Disseminated intravascular coagulation is characterized by the widespread activation of coagulation, which results in the intravascular formation of fibrin and ultimately thrombotic occlusion of small and midsize vessels.

terms.name: Pyridoxine-responsive sideroblastic anemia
terms.definition: A type of sideroblastic anemia that is alleviated by pyridoxine (vitamin B-6) treatment.

terms.name: Lymphoid leukemia
terms.definition: A malignant lymphocytic neoplasm of B-cell or T-cell lineage involving primarily the bone marrow and the peripheral blood. This category includes precursor or acute lymphoblastic leukemias and chronic leukemias.

terms.name: Reduced kininogen activity
terms.definition: Amount or activity of kininogen is below the lower limit of normal. Kininogen functions as a cofactor in the contact phase of the intrinsic blood coagulation cascade.

terms.name: Bone marrow hypocellularity
terms.definition: A reduced number of hematopoietic cells present in the bone marrow relative to marrow fat.

terms.name: Biphenotypic acute leukemia
terms.definition: A type of actue leukemia with features characteristic of both the myeloid and lymphoid lineages. These leukemias are for this reason are designated mixed-lineage, hybrid or biphenotypic acute leukemias.

terms.name: Macrocytic dyserythropoietic anemia
terms.name_zh: 大细胞性红细胞生成异常性贫血

terms.name: Transient myeloproliferative syndrome
terms.definition: A unique clonal neoplastic disorder that is linked to trisomy 21, is restricted to neonatal period, and spontaneously regresses. It often has characteristics of megakaryocytic lineage and is associated with GATA1 mutations in myeloblasts.

terms.name: Exercise-induced hemolysis
terms.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia that can be triggered by exertion.

terms.name: Decreased mean platelet volume
terms.definition: Average platelet volume below the lower limit of the normal reference interval.

terms.name: T cell chronic lymphocytic lymphoma/leukemia
terms.definition: A form of lymphoid leukemia or lymphoma in which too many T-cell lymphoblasts are found in the blood, bone marrow, and tissues. Leukemia or lymphoma classification depends on which feature is more prominent.

terms.name: Congenital agranulocytosis
terms.definition: Persistent absence of detectable circulating granulocytes in the blood with no detected secondary cause. Usually a value of less than 50 granulocytes per microliter is considered to be an absence.

terms.name: Prolonged whole-blood clotting time
terms.definition: An abnormal prolongation (delay) in the time required by whole blood to produce a visible clot.

terms.name: Reduced protein C activity
terms.definition: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of vitamin K-dependent protein C. Protein C is activated to protein Ca by thrombin bound to thrombomodulin. Activated protein C degrades factors VIIIa and Va.

terms.name: Increased red cell osmotic resistance
terms.name_zh: 红细胞渗透抵抗性增加

terms.name: Myeloproliferative disorder
terms.definition: Proliferation (excess production) of hemopoietically active tissue or of tissue which has embryonic hemopoietic potential.

terms.name: Megakaryocytopenia
terms.definition: A reduced count of megakaryocytes.

terms.name: Chronic lymphatic leukemia
terms.definition: A chronic lymphocytic/lymphatic/lymphoblastic leukemia (CLL) is a neoplastic disease characterized by proliferation and accumulation (blood, marrow and lymphoid organs) of morphologically mature but immunologically dysfunctional lymphocytes. A CLL is always a B-cell lymphocytic leukemia as there are no reports of cases of T-cell lymphocytic leukemias.

terms.name: Abnormality of the metopic suture
terms.definition: The frontal suture divides the two halves of the frontal bone of the skull in infants and children and generally undergoes fusion by the age of six. A persistent frontal suture is referred to as a \

terms.name: Abnormal zygomatic arch morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the zygomatic arch, also known as the cheek bone.

terms.name: Chronic leukemia
terms.definition: A slowly progressing leukemia characterized by a clonal (malignant) proliferation of maturing and mature myeloid cells or mature lymphocytes. When the clonal cellular population is composed of myeloid cells, the process is called chronic myelogenous leukemia. When the clonal cellular population is composed of lymphocytes, it is classified as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, hairy cell leukemia, or T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia.

terms.name: Abnormal kinin-kallikrein system component activity
terms.name_zh: 激肽释放酶-激肽系统组分活性异常
terms.definition: The activity or concentration of a component of the kinin-kallikrein system is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Imbalanced hemoglobin synthesis
terms.definition: Normal hemoglobin synthesis is characterized by production of equal amounts of alpha and beta globins. This term refers to a deviation from this pattern and is the main characteristic of the various forms of thalassemia.

terms.name: Abnormal bone marrow cell morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of bone marrow cell morphology
Anomaly of the bone marrow cells
terms.definition: An anomaly of the form or number of cells in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Multiple renal cysts
terms.definition: The presence of many cysts in the kidney.

terms.name: Decreased numbers of nephrons
terms.definition: A reduction in the count of nephrons per kidney.

terms.name: Absence of renal corticomedullary differentiation
terms.definition: A lack of differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.

terms.name: Reduced renal corticomedullary differentiation
synonyms: Loss of definition of corticomedullary differentiation
terms.definition: Reduced differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.

terms.name: Renal magnesium wasting
terms.definition: High urine magnesium in the presence of hypomagnesemia.

terms.name: Increased renal tubular phosphate reabsorption
synonyms: Increased percent tubular reabsorption of phosphorus

terms.name: Decreased renal tubular phosphate excretion
terms.name_zh: 肾小管磷酸盐排泄减少

terms.name: Non-acidotic proximal tubulopathy
terms.definition: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption without bicarbonate loss.

terms.name: Hemolytic-uremic syndrome
terms.definition: A thrombotic microangiopathy with presence of non-immune, intravascular hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia and acute kidney injury. A vicious cycle of complement activation, endothelial cell damage, platelet activation, and thrombosis is the hallmark of the disease.

terms.name: Tubulointerstitial fibrosis
terms.definition: A progressive detrimental connective tissue deposition (fibrosis) on the kidney parenchyma involving the tubules and interstitial tissue of the kidney. Tubulointerstitial injury in the kidney is complex, involving a number of independent and overlapping cellular and molecular pathways, with renal interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (IF/TA) as the final common pathway. However, IF and TA are separable, as shown by the profound TA in renal artery stenosis, which characteristically has little or no fibrosis (or inflammation). For new annotations it is preferable to annotate to the specific HPO terms for Renal interstitial fibrosis and/or Renal tubular atrophy.

terms.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of chloride
terms.name_zh: 肾小管氯化物重吸收障碍
terms.definition: Any impairment of reabsorption of chloride by the kidney.

terms.name: Duplication of renal pelvis
terms.definition: A duplication of the renal pelvis.

terms.name: Tubular basement membrane disintegration
synonyms: Disintegration of the tubular basement membrane
terms.definition: DIsruption and breaking up of the basement membrane of the tubules of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal cell carcinoma
synonyms: Cancer starting in small tubes in kidneys
terms.definition: A type of carcinoma of the kidney with origin in the epithelium of the proximal convoluted renal tubule.

terms.name: Patchy palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: A focal type of palmoplantar keratoderma in which only certain areas of the palms and soles are affected.

terms.name: Giant melanosomes in melanocytes
terms.name_zh: 黑素细胞巨大黑素小体
terms.definition: The presence of large spherical melanosomes (1 to 6 micrometer in diameter) in the cytoplasm of melanocytes.

terms.name: Macular hypopigmented whorls, streaks, and patches
terms.name_zh: 黄斑色素减退性涡纹、条纹及斑片

terms.name: Congenital alopecia totalis
terms.definition: Loss of all scalp hair with congenital onset.

terms.name: Facial telangiectasia in butterfly midface distribution
terms.name_zh: 面中部蝶形分布毛细血管扩张
terms.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin in a butterfly midface distribution.

terms.name: Congenital giant melanocytic nevus
terms.name_zh: 先天性巨大黑素细胞痣
terms.definition: The giant congenital nevus is greater than 8 cm in size, pigmented and often hairy. A giant congenital nevus is smaller in infants and children, but it usually continues to grow with the child.

terms.name: Large cafe-au-lait macules with irregular margins
terms.name_zh: 边缘不规则大咖啡牛奶斑
terms.definition: Large hypermelanotic macules with jagged borders.

terms.name: Bilobate gallbladder
terms.definition: The presence of a bilobed gallbladder, related to a duplication of the gallbladder primordium.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the femur
terms.name_zh: 股骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the femur.

terms.name: Accelerated skeletal maturation
synonyms: Premature fusion of the epiphyseal growth plate
terms.definition: An abnormally increased rate of skeletal maturation. Accelerated skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.

terms.name: Thoracolumbar kyphosis
terms.definition: Hyperconvexity of the thoracolumbar spine producing a rounded or humped appearance.

terms.name: Hypermobility of interphalangeal joints
terms.definition: The ability of the interphalangeal joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

terms.name: Trapezoidal vertebral body
terms.definition: An anomalous trapezoidal appearance of a vertebral body. A trapezoid is a four-sided shape that has two sides that are parallel and two sides that are not parallel. In this case, the two lateral sides of the vertebra are parallel, and the top and the bottom are slanted with respect to each other such that the vertebra is shorter in the front or back than on the other side.

terms.name: Broad long bones
terms.definition: Increased cross-section (diameter) of the long bones. Note that widening may primarily affect specific regions of long bones (e.g., diaphysis or metaphysis), but this should be coded separately.

terms.name: Absent ossification of calvaria
terms.definition: Acalvaria is an extremely rare congenital malformation characterized by an absence of flat bones of skull, dura mater, and associated muscles in the presence of normal cranial contents and facial bones.

terms.name: Osteoporosis of vertebrae
terms.definition: Osteoporosis affecting predominantly the vertebrae.

terms.name: Posterior fusion of lumbosacral vertebrae
terms.definition: Bony fusion of the posterior part of the L5 vertebral body with the sacrum.

terms.name: Type D brachydactyly
terms.definition: This type of brachydactyly is characterized by short and broad terminal phalanges of the thumbs and big toes.

terms.name: Decreased anterioposterior diameter of lumbar vertebral bodies
Hyperextensible hand joints
terms.definition: The ability of the joints of the hand to move beyond their normal range of motion.

terms.name: Short 3rd toe
terms.definition: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the third toe.

terms.name: Intervertebral disk calcification
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition of the intervertebral disk.

terms.name: Bilateral ulnar hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ulna on both sides.

terms.name: 2-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second to the fifth fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: Cortical sclerosis
terms.definition: Sclerosis (abnormal hardening) of cortical bone, characterized by increased radiodensity.

terms.name: Moderate generalized osteoporosis
terms.definition: Moderate osteoporosis.

terms.name: Multiple digital exostoses
terms.definition: Multiple exostoses originating in the fingers and toes.

terms.name: Positional foot deformity
terms.definition: A foot deformity resulting due to an abnormality affecting the muscle and soft tissue. In contrast if the bones of the foot are affected the term structural foot deformity applies.

terms.name: Salmonella osteomyelitis
terms.definition: Osteomyelitis caused by infection with the bacteria, salmonella.

terms.name: Massively thickened long bone cortices
terms.definition: Extreme thickening of the cortex of long bones.

terms.name: Os odontoideum
terms.definition: Separation of the odontoid process from the body of the axis.

terms.name: Bilateral intracerebral calcifications
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts on both sides of the cerebrum.

terms.name: Dupuytren contracture
terms.definition: An abnormality of the hand resulting from contracture of the palmar fascia with a fixed flexion deformity of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints and the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints.

terms.name: Tongue-like lumbar vertebral deformities
terms.definition: A tongue-like protusion from the anterior aspect of lumbar vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Distal arthrogryposis
terms.definition: An inherited primary limb malformation disorder characterized by congenital contractures of two or more different body areas and without primary neurologic and/or muscle disease that affects limb function.

terms.name: Patchy osteosclerosis
synonyms: Patchy increase of bone mineral density
terms.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.

terms.name: Deformed humeral heads
synonyms: Deformed head of long bone in upper arm

terms.name: Dysplastic distal thumb phalanges with a central hole
terms.name_zh: 拇指远节指骨发育不良伴中央孔

terms.name: Partial fusion of proximal row of carpal bones
Postaxial polydactyly type A
terms.definition: Supernumerary digits located at the ulnar side of the hand with a complete extra finger and extra metacarpal.

terms.name: Increased bone density with cystic changes
Bilateral triphalangeal thumbs
terms.definition: A bilateral form of triphalangeal thumb.

terms.name: 2-3 toe cutaneous syndactyly
synonyms: Complete cutaneous syndactyly of second and third toes
Cutaneous syndactyly of second and third toes

terms.name: Flattened knee epiphyses
synonyms: Flattened end part of knee bone

terms.name: Shortening of all metacarpals
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in length of all metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Hyperextensible thumb
terms.definition: The ability of the thumb joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

terms.name: Nonopposable triphalangeal thumb
terms.definition: A form of triphalangeal thumb that cannot be placed opposite the fingers of the same hand.

terms.name: Cortical irregularity
terms.definition: An abnormal irregularity of cortical bone.

terms.name: Spinal stenosis with reduced interpedicular distance
synonyms: Spinal stenosis due to short pedicles
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the spinal canal related to a reduction in the interpedicular distance (i.e., the distance measured between the pedicles on frontal [coronal] imaging).

terms.name: Short tibia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment (reduced size) of the tibia.

terms.name: Posterior subluxation of radial head
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the head of the radius in the posterior direction.

terms.name: Avascular necrosis of the capital femoral epiphysis
terms.name_zh: 股骨头骨骺缺血性坏死
terms.definition: Avascular necrosis of the proximal epiphysis of the femur occurring in growing children and caused by an interruption of the blood supply to the head of the femur close to the hip joint. The necrosis is characteristically associated with flattening of the femoral head, for which reason the term coxa plana has been used to refer to this feature in the medical literature.

terms.name: Osteosclerosis of the base of the skull
terms.definition: An increase in bone density affecting the basicranium (base of the skull).

terms.name: Easily subluxated first metacarpophalangeal joints
terms.name_zh: 第一掌指关节易半脱位

terms.name: Lower-limb joint contracture
synonyms: Contractures of the joints of the lower limbs
terms.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint of the lower limb resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin.

terms.name: Neonatal epiphyseal stippling
synonyms: Speckled calcifications in bone end parts in neonates
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more epiphyses during the neonatal period.

terms.name: Basilar impression
terms.definition: Abnormal elevation of the floor of the posterior fossa including occipital condyles and foramen magnum.

terms.name: Small flat posterior fossa
synonyms: Small and flat posterior fossa of skull
Small and flat posterior skull bones
terms.definition: An abnormally small and flat configuration of the posterior cranial fossa.

terms.name: 2-4 toe cutaneous syndactyly
synonyms: Soft tissue syndactyly of toes 2, 3, and 4
Webbed second, third and fourth toes
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 2, 3, and 4.

terms.name: Fifth finger distal phalanx clinodactyly
terms.definition: Bending or curvature of the distal phalanx of little finger in the radial direction (i.e., towards the 4th finger).

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tibia
terms.name_zh: 胫骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the tibia.

terms.name: Short forearm
synonyms: Hypoplasia of both radius and ulna
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of both forearm bones, the ulna and the radius, resulting in a shortened forearm.

terms.name: Absent fourth finger distal interphalangeal crease
terms.name_zh: 第四指远侧指间关节褶缺如
synonyms: No fourth finger distal interphalangeal crease
terms.definition: Absence of the distal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fourth finger.

terms.name: Lumbar platyspondyly
terms.definition: A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates affecting the lumbar spine.

terms.name: Generalized osteosclerosis
terms.definition: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density with generalized involvement of the skeleton.

terms.name: Short mandibular condyles
synonyms: Bilateral hypoplasia of condylar process of mandible
Bilateral hypoplasia of mandibular condylar head
Bilateral hypoplasia of mandibular condylar neck
Decreased height of condylar process of mandible
Decreased length of condylar process of mandible

terms.name: Cortical thickening of long bone diaphyses
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the diaphyseal region of long bones.

terms.name: Short humerus
synonyms: Short long bone of upper arm
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the humerus.

terms.name: Shortening of all distal phalanges of the toes
synonyms: Shortening of all outermost bone of the toes
terms.definition: Abnormally short distal phalanx of toe of all toes.

terms.name: Posterior radial head dislocation
terms.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an posterior direction.

terms.name: Supernumerary ribs
terms.definition: The presence of more than 12 rib pairs.

terms.name: Postaxial polysyndactyly of foot
terms.definition: Combined syndactyly and polydactyly of the foot on the lateral side (i.e., on the side of the little toe).

terms.name: Short middle phalanx of finger
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the middle phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Short (hypoplastic) middle phalanx of finger, affecting one or more fingers.

terms.name: Clinodactyly of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Bending or curvature of a second toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

terms.name: Mixed sclerosis of humeral metaphyses
terms.name_zh: 肱骨骨干骺端混合性硬化

terms.name: Flexion contracture of toe
terms.definition: One or more bent (flexed) toe joints that cannot be straightened actively or passively.

terms.name: Dysharmonic delayed bone age
terms.definition: A type of dysharmonic skeletal maturation in which there is a delay in skeletal maturation whose degree differs markedly in different bones.

terms.name: Calcific stippling of infantile cartilaginous skeleton
Rounded middle phalanx of finger
terms.definition: An abnormally round shape of the middle phalanx of the finger.

terms.name: Diffuse cerebral calcification
terms.definition: Generalized deposition of calcium salts within the cerebrum.

terms.name: Multiple prenatal fractures
synonyms: Numerous multiple fractures present at birth
Numerous multiple fractures that are present at birth
terms.definition: The presence of bone fractures in the prenatal period that are diagnosed at birth or before.

terms.name: Ulnar radial head dislocation
terms.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an ulnar direction.

terms.name: Type E brachydactyly
terms.definition: In type E brachydactyly, shortening of the fingers is mainly in the metacarpals and metatarsals.

terms.name: Pseudoarthrosis
terms.definition: A pathologic entity characterized by a developmental defect in a long bone leading to bending and pathologic fracture, with inability to form a normal bony callus with subsequent fibrous nonunion, leading to the pseudarthrosis (or \

terms.name: Opposable triphalangeal thumb
terms.definition: A form of triphalangeal thumb that can be placed opposite the fingers of the same hand.

terms.name: 4-5 metacarpal synostosis
synonyms: Ring finger and little finger metacarpal synostosis
Synostosis of the fourth and fifth metacarpal bones

terms.name: Metaphyseal enchondromatosis
terms.definition: An enchondroma is a benign growth of cartilage that develops within the medullary cavity of bone. Enchondromatosis refers to the presence of multiple enchondromas, and this term refers to the presence of multiple enchondromas within the medulla of metaphyseal bone. Radiographically an enchondroma presents a an oval, linear, or pyramidal osteolytic (radiolucent) lesion with well defined margins.

terms.name: Metaphyseal chondrodysplasia
terms.definition: An abnormality of skeletal development characterized by a disturbance of the metaphysis and its histological structure with relatively normal epiphyses and vertebrae.

terms.name: Brachytelomesophalangy
synonyms: Progressive brachydactyly of middle and distal phalanges
Short middle and distal phalanges of digits ii through v
terms.definition: Disproportionately short middle and distal phalanges compared to the hand/foot.

terms.name: Polysyndactyly of hallux
terms.definition: Combined syndactyly and polydactyly of the great toe.

terms.name: Progressive flexion contractures
terms.definition: Progressively worsening joint contractures.

terms.name: Enlarged sagittal diameter of the cervical canal
Congenital finger flexion contractures
terms.definition: Multiple bent (flexed) finger joints that cannot be straightened actively or passively.

terms.name: Metacarpophalangeal synostosis
synonyms: Fused long bone of hand with innermost finger bone
terms.definition: Fusion of a metacarpal bone with the proximal phalanx of the finger distal to it across the corresponding metacarpophalangeal joint.

terms.name: Absent ossification of cervical vertebral bodies
terms.definition: A lack of bone mineralization of one or more body of cervical vertebra.

terms.name: Aphalangy of the hands
terms.definition: Absence of a digit or of one or more phalanges of a finger.

terms.name: Hyperostosis cranialis interna
synonyms: Excessive growth of inner surface of the skull bones
Hyperostosis of the internal surface of the cranial bone
Hyperostosis of the internal surface of the cranial bones
Overgrowth of the inner surface of the skull bones
terms.definition: Bony overgrowth of the internal (endosteal) surface of the calvaria and the base of skull.

terms.name: Progressive forearm bowing
terms.definition: Progressive bending or abnormal curvature of the forearm skeleton.

terms.name: Proximal tibial and fibular fusion
synonyms: Fusion of innermost shinbone and calf bone
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the abnormal fusion of the proximal tibia and fibula.

terms.name: Double first metacarpals
terms.definition: Duplication of the metacarpal I bones.

terms.name: Radial deviation of thumb terminal phalanx
Severe generalized osteoporosis
terms.definition: Severe degree of osteoporosis.

terms.name: Fifth metacarpal with ulnar notch
synonyms: Fifth metacarpal notched on ulnar side
terms.definition: Presence of an angular or V -shaped indentation on the ulnar side of the fifth metacarpal bone (i.e., on the sides towards the fifth finger).

terms.name: Abnormal cervical curvature
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormal curvature of the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: Delayed pneumatization of the mastoid process
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced degree of pneumatization (i.e., formation of air cells) in the mastoid process with respect to age-dependent norms.

terms.name: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th finger middle phalanx
synonyms: Rhomboid or triangular shaped fifth finger middle phalanx
terms.definition: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th (little) finger middle phalanx.

terms.name: Biliary atresia
terms.definition: Atresia of the biliary tree.

terms.name: Abnormal metacarpal epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of end part of long bone of hand

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the metacarpal bones
terms.name_zh: 掌骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Abnormal metacarpal morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of long bones of hand
terms.definition: Any abnormal shape or structure of the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Supernumerary metacarpal bones
terms.definition: The presence of more than the normal number of metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Abnormal finger phalanx morphology
synonyms: Abnormal form of phalanges of the hand
Abnormality of the phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Abnormalities affecting the phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Abnormal epiphysis morphology of the phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand. Note that this includes the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal. In contrast to the metacarpals 2-5, the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5 (whereas the proximal phalanx of the thumb is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits).

terms.name: Abnormal hand morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hand.

terms.name: Abnormal hand metaphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormalities of the metaphyses of the hand
Abnormality of the wide portion of the hand bone

terms.name: Abnormal hand epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the hand bone
Abnormality of the end part of the hand bones
Abnormality of the epiphyses of the fingers
Abnormality of the epiphyses of the hand
Abnormality of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphyses of the phalanges or metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Abnormal hand diaphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormalities of shaft of long bone of the hand
Abnormalities of the diaphyses of the hand

terms.name: Abnormal hand cortical bone morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the cortex of hand bones
terms.definition: An anomaly of the outer shell (cortex) of a hand bone.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the hand
terms.name_zh: 手骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the bones of the hand.

terms.name: Synostosis involving the fibula
synonyms: Bone fusion involving the calf bones

terms.name: Abnormal epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of end part of bone
terms.definition: An anomaly of epiphysis, which is the expanded articular end of a long bone that developes from a secondary ossification center, and which during the period of growth is either entirely cartilaginous or is separated from the shaft by a cartilaginous disk.

terms.name: Abnormal renal corticomedullary differentiation
terms.definition: An abnormality of corticomedullary differentiation (CMD) on diagnostic imaging such as magnetic resonance imaging, computer tomography, or sonography. CMD is a difference in the visualization of cortex and medulla.

terms.name: Abnormal respiratory motile cilium morphology
terms.name_zh: 呼吸道运动纤毛形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal arrangement of the structures of the motile cilium.

terms.name: Desquamative interstitial pneumonitis
synonyms: Filling of the alveoli with alveolar macrophages
Filling of the alveoli with desquamated epithelial cells
terms.definition: Diffuse filling of the distal airspaces of the lungs, the alveoli, with macrophages. Desquamative interstitial pneumonitis (DIP) is characterized additionally by thickened alveolar septa and by a sparse inflammatory infiltrate that often includes plasma cells and occasional eosinophils. The alveoli are lined by plump cuboidal pneumocytes. Lymphoid aggregates may be present.

terms.name: Bilateral lung agenesis
terms.definition: Bilateral lack of development of the lungs.

terms.name: Laryngeal obstruction
terms.definition: Blockage of the upper airway at the level of the larynx often accompanied by respiratory distress.

terms.name: Ventilator dependence with inability to wean
Decreased sensitivity to hypoxemia
terms.definition: Reduced tendency to respond to a reduced concentration of oxygen in the blood by increasing respiration.

terms.name: Multiple pulmonary cysts
terms.definition: The presence of multiple lung cysts.

terms.name: Apneic episodes in infancy
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of apnea occurring during infancy.

terms.name: Laryngeal web
terms.definition: A membrane-like structure that extends across the laryngeal lumen close to the level of the vocal cords.

terms.name: Anteroposteriorly shortened larynx
terms.definition: Abnormal shortening of the larynx in the anteroposterior (front to back) axis.

terms.name: Impaired gluconeogenesis
terms.definition: An impairment of gluconeogenesis.

terms.name: Hypoargininemia
terms.definition: The concentration of arginine in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Intermittent hypothermia
terms.definition: Episodes of reduced body temperature.

terms.name: Mixed respiratory and metabolic acidosis
terms.name_zh: 混合性呼吸代谢性酸中毒

terms.name: Temperature instability
terms.definition: Disordered thermoregulation characterized by an impaired ability to maintain a balance between heat production and heat loss, with resulting instability of body temperature.

terms.name: Respiratory acidosis
terms.definition: Acidosis because of respiratory retention of carbon dioxide.

terms.name: Fructose intolerance
terms.definition: Reduced intestinal absorption of fructose. Breath testing after ingestion of fructose has been widely adopted as a standard method of identifying fructose malabsorption and intolerance. A dose of 25 g of fructose dissolved in a 10% solution is generally accepted as the appropriate dose of fructose for clinical use of H2 and CH4 breath testing. High levels of hydrogen in exhaled breath subsequent hours indicate fructose intolerance. Presence of malabsorption and reproduction of symptoms during a breath test provides the best objective evidence and symptom correlation for fructose intolerance.

terms.name: Episodic ketoacidosis
terms.definition: Intermittent episodes of ketoacidosis.

terms.name: Type II diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: A type of diabetes mellitus initially characterized by insulin resistance and hyperinsulinemia and subsequently by glucose interolerance and hyperglycemia.

terms.name: Metabolic ketoacidosis
terms.definition: A metabolic acidosis due to accumulation of ketone bodies generally observed in the setting of poor nutritional intake.

terms.name: Reduced phenylalanine hydroxylase level
terms.definition: A reduction in phenylalanine 4-monooxygenase level.

terms.name: Multinodular goiter
terms.definition: Enlargement of the thyroid gland related to multiple nodules in the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Congenital muscular torticollis
terms.definition: A congenital form of torticollis resulting from shortening of the sternocleidomastoid muscle and leading to a limited range of motion in both rotation and lateral bending.

terms.name: Redundant neck skin
terms.definition: Excess skin around the neck, often lying in horizontal folds.

terms.name: Thyroid hypoplasia
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Limited neck flexion
terms.definition: Reduced ability to lower the chin towards the chest by bending the neck.

terms.name: Nodular goiter
terms.definition: Enlargement of the thyroid gland related to one or more nodules in the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Decreased adipose tissue around neck
synonyms: Loss of adipose tissue around the neck
terms.definition: Reduced amount of adipose tissue in the region of the neck.

terms.name: Neck joint contracture
synonyms: Restricted neck mobility due to contractures
Restricted neck movement due to contractures

terms.name: Ureteral atresia
terms.definition: A developmental defect defined by the failure of the formation of the lumen (tube) of the ureter.

terms.name: Ureteral obstruction
terms.definition: Obstruction of the flow of urine through the ureter.

terms.name: Hypotrophy of the small hand muscles
Broad phalanx
terms.definition: Increased side-to-side width of one or more phalanges of the fingers or toes.

terms.name: Cuboidal metacarpal
synonyms: Short, cube shaped long bone of hand
terms.definition: Severely shortened metacarpal with a cuboidal appearance.

terms.name: Widened metacarpal shaft
synonyms: Broad shaft of long bone of hand

terms.name: Delayed phalangeal epiphyseal ossification
synonyms: Delayed bone maturation of end part of digital bone
terms.definition: Delay in the process of formation and maturation of the epiphysis of one or more phalanx.

terms.name: Metaphyseal cupping of metacarpals
terms.name_zh: 掌骨干骺端杯口状改变
synonyms: Cupping of wide portion of long bone of hand
terms.definition: Metaphyseal cupping affecting the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of phalanges 2 to 5
synonyms: Cone-shaped end part of digital bones 2 to 5

terms.name: Y-shaped metacarpals
terms.definition: Y-shaped metacarpals are the result of a partial fusion of two metacarpal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metacarpals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.

terms.name: Distal widening of metacarpals
synonyms: Wide outermost end of long bone
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in width of the distal region of the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Cone-shaped metacarpal epiphyses
synonyms: Cone-shaped end part of long bone
terms.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the metacarpal bones, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphyses are located at the distal ends of the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Multiple carpal ossification centers
terms.definition: A delay in the process of formation and maturation of the epiphysis of one or more long bones.

terms.name: Metacarpophalangeal joint contracture
terms.definition: A chronic loss of joint motion in metacarpophalangeal joints due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement.

terms.name: Absent proximal finger flexion creases
terms.definition: Absence of the proximal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fingers.

terms.name: Malaligned carpal bone
terms.definition: Malalignement of carpal bone angles either with respect to each other, to the corresponding metacarpals or with respect to the wrist (radius and ulna).

terms.name: Wide tufts of distal phalanges
synonyms: Wide tips of outermost digital bone

terms.name: 3-4 finger osseus syndactyly
terms.definition: Fusion of the third (middle) and fourth (ring) finger, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones.

terms.name: Metacarpophalangeal joint hyperextensibility
terms.definition: Increased mobility of one ore more metacarpophalangeal joint.

terms.name: Finger syndactyly
terms.definition: Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as \

terms.name: Fingerpad telangiectases
synonyms: Small dilated blood vessels in fingerpads
terms.definition: Telangiectasia (small dilated blood vessels) located in the fingerpads at the tips of the fingers.

terms.name: Tapered metacarpals
terms.definition: Metacarpal that becomes thinner toward the distal end.

terms.name: Absent phalangeal crease
terms.definition: Absence of one or more interphalangeal creases (i.e., of the transverse lines in the skin between the phalanges of the fingers).

terms.name: Shortening of all middle phalanges of the fingers
terms.definition: Short, hypoplastic middle phalanx of finger, affecting all fingers.

terms.name: Expanded phalanges with widened medullary cavities
Multiple palmar creases
terms.definition: The presence of multiple creases on the palm of the hand (more than the normal three major creases (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, and thenar crease).

terms.name: Shortening of all distal phalanges of the fingers
synonyms: Shortening of all outermost bones of the fingers
terms.definition: Hypoplasia of all of the distal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Proximal tapering of metacarpals
synonyms: Pointed innermost long bone of hand
terms.definition: Some or all of the metacarpal bones (i.e., metacarpal II to V) have a pointed proximal appearance.

terms.name: Acral ulceration
terms.definition: A type of digital ulcer that manifests as an open sore on the surface of the skin at the tip of a finger or toe.

terms.name: Long proximal phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Increased length of the proximal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Drumstick terminal phalanges
terms.definition: Rounding and broadening of the tufts of the distal phalanges.

terms.name: Enlarged metacarpal epiphyses
synonyms: Enlarged end part of long bone of hand
terms.definition: Abnormally large size of one or more growth plates (epiphyses) of the metacarpal bones (i.e., the tubular bones of the hand between the carpus and the phalanges).

terms.name: Premature fusion of phalangeal epiphyses
synonyms: Premature fusion of end part of digital bone
terms.definition: Fusion of the epiphysis and metaphysis of one or more phalanges prior to the normal age or stage of growth.

terms.name: Abnormal finger flexion crease
terms.definition: Anomalous flexion crease (i.e., a transverse line that crosses the skin of a finger).

terms.name: Shortening of all proximal phalanges of the fingers
synonyms: Shortening of all innermost bones of the fingers
terms.definition: Congenital hypoplasia of proximal phalanx of finger or all fingers.

terms.name: Central Y-shaped metacarpal
synonyms: Y-shaped central long bones of hand
terms.definition: A central Y-shaped metacarpal is the result of a partial fusion of two central metacarpals (i.e., metacarpals 2-4) of the hand, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Central Y-shaped metacarpals may be seen as a result of a central polydactyly with partial fusion of the duplicated metacarpal.

terms.name: Broad metacarpal epiphyses
synonyms: Broad end part of long bone of hand
terms.definition: Increased side-to-side width of the metacarpal epiphyses.

terms.name: Swan neck-like deformities of the fingers
terms.definition: A swan neck deformity describes a finger with a hyperextended PIP joint and a flexed DIP joint. The most common cause for a swan neck-like deformity is a disruption of the end of the extensor tendon. Conditions that loosen the PIP joint and allow it to hyperextend, for example conditions that weaken the volar plate, can produce a swan neck deformity of the finger. One example is rheumatoid arthritis. Another cause are conditions that tighten up the small (intrinsic) muscles of the hand and fingers, for example hand trauma or nerve disorders, such as cerebral palsy, Parkinson's disease, or stroke.

terms.name: Proximal finger symphalangism
terms.definition: The term proximal symphalangism refers to a bony fusion of the middle and proximal phalanges of the digits of the hand, in other words the proximal interphalangeal joint (PIJ) is missing which can be seen either on x-rays or as an absence of the proximal interphalangeal finger creases.

terms.name: Long phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Increased length of multiple or a single phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Ulnar deviation of thumb
terms.definition: Bending or curvature of a thumb towards the ulnar side (towards the ring finger).

terms.name: Mesoaxial hand polydactyly
terms.definition: The presence of a supernumerary finger (not a thumb) involving the third or fourth metacarpal with associated osseous syndactyly.

terms.name: Irregular metacarpals
terms.definition: Irregular morphology of one or more metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Short metacarpals with rounded proximal ends
synonyms: Short long bone of hand with rounded innermost ends

terms.name: Soft tissue swelling of interphalangeal joints
synonyms: Soft tissue swelling of hinge joints

terms.name: Tubular metacarpal bones
synonyms: Cylindrical shaped long bones of hand

terms.name: Chess-pawn distal phalanges
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of distal phalanges such that they have the appearance of chess pawns.

terms.name: Flattened, squared-off epiphyses of tubular bones
synonyms: Flattened, squared-off end part of tubular bones

terms.name: Metacarpal diaphyseal endosteal sclerosis
terms.name_zh: 掌骨干骺端骨内膜硬化
terms.definition: Increase in bone density in the diaphyseal (shaft) region of a metacarpal bone.

terms.name: Two carpal ossification centers present at birth
synonyms: Two carpal ossification centres present at birth

terms.name: Pseudoepiphyses of second metacarpal
synonyms: Extra bone on end of second long bone of hand

terms.name: Decreased palmar creases
terms.definition: Poorly defined or shallow palmar creases.

terms.name: Deep palmar crease
terms.definition: Excessively deep creases of the palm.

terms.name: Tapered phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Phalanges of the fingers becoming thinner toward the distal end.

terms.name: Thimble-shaped middle phalanges of hand
terms.definition: The middle phalanx of finger resembles a thimble, a small metal cap to protect the finger while sewing that has a broad (proximal) base and narrower top, whereby both base and top are flat.

terms.name: Hypermobility of distal interphalangeal joints
terms.name_zh: 远端指间关节过度活动
synonyms: Increased mobility of outermost hinge joint

terms.name: Decreased movement range in interphalangeal joints
terms.name_zh: 指间关节活动范围减小
synonyms: Decreased range of movement range in hinge joints

terms.name: Irregular phalanges
terms.definition: Alteration of the normally smooth radiographic contour of phalanges producing an irregular appearance.

terms.name: Hypersegmentation of proximal phalanx of second finger
terms.name_zh: 第二指近节指骨分叶过多
terms.definition: Presence of an additional phalanx-like bone, producing an extra, wedge-shaped bone at the base of the proximal phalanx of the second finger.

terms.name: Metaphyseal cupping of proximal phalanges
terms.name_zh: 近节指骨干骺端杯口状改变
terms.definition: Metaphyseal cupping affecting the proximal phalanges.

terms.name: Thin proximal phalanges with broad epiphyses of the hand
synonyms: Thin innermost bone with broad end part of the hand bone

terms.name: Single interphalangeal crease of fifth finger
terms.definition: Presence of only one (instead of two, as normal) interphalangeal crease of the fifth finger.

terms.name: Limited mobility of proximal interphalangeal joint
terms.name_zh: 近端指间关节活动受限
synonyms: Limited mobility of innermost hinge joint

terms.name: Tapering pointed ends of distal finger phalanges
terms.definition: A reduction in diameter of the distal phalanx of finger towards the distal end such that the tip of the phalanx comes to a point (this feature can be observed on radiograms).

terms.name: Osteoarthritis of the first carpometacarpal joint
Expanded metacarpals with widened medullary cavities
Osteoarthritis of the distal interphalangeal joint
Osteolysis involving tarsal bones
terms.definition: An increased resorption of bone matrix by osteoclasts leading to bony defects involving the tarsal bones.

terms.name: Slender metacarpals
terms.definition: Decreased width of the metacarpal bones (that is, reduced diameter).

terms.name: Shortening of all middle phalanges of the toes
synonyms: Shortening of all the middle bones of the toes
terms.definition: Abnormal shortening of all middle phalanges of toes.

terms.name: Limited wrist movement
terms.definition: An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the wrist.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal phalangeal joint morphology of the hand
synonyms: Abnormality of phalangeal joints of the hand
Abnormality of the small joints of the hand

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 5th finger
terms.definition: A small/hypoplastic or absent/aplastic 5th finger.

terms.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the index finger bone
terms.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, middle, and distal phalanges of the 2nd finger.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 2nd finger
terms.definition: A small/hypoplastic or absent/aplastic 2nd finger.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of fingers
terms.name_zh: 手指发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Small/hypoplastic or absent/aplastic fingers.

terms.name: Small placenta
terms.definition: Reduced size of the placenta.

terms.name: Large placenta
terms.definition: Increased size of the placenta.

terms.name: Fluctuating splenomegaly
terms.definition: Intermittently increased size of the spleen.

terms.name: Hypoplastic spleen
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the spleen.

terms.name: Pancreatic lymphangiectasis
terms.definition: The presence of lymphangiectasis in the pancreas.

terms.name: Reduced pancreatic beta cells
terms.definition: Reduced number of beta cells in the pancreatic islets of Langerhans.

terms.name: Pancreatic hyperplasia
terms.definition: Hyperplasia of the pancreas.

terms.name: Ectopic pancreatic tissue
terms.definition: The presence of pancreatic tissue outside the normal pancreas, in many cases along the foregut and proximal midgut.

terms.name: Chronic pancreatitis
terms.definition: A chronic form of pancreatitis.

terms.name: Generalized hypoplasia of dental enamel
terms.name_zh: 全身性牙釉质发育不全
terms.definition: A generalized form of developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.

terms.name: Multiple unerupted teeth
synonyms: Failure of eruption of multiple teeth
terms.definition: The presence of multiple embedded tooth germs which have failed to erupt.

terms.name: Enamel hypomineralization
synonyms: White spot lesions of tooth enamel
terms.definition: A decreased amount of enamel mineralization. Hypomineralized enamel has a brown discoloration and brittle aspect.

terms.name: Advanced eruption of teeth
terms.definition: Premature tooth eruption, which can be defined as tooth eruption more than 2 SD earlier than the mean eruption age.

terms.name: Agenesis of central incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of central incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of one or more central incisors, i.e., of lower secondary incisor, lower primary incisor, upper secondary incisor, or of upper central primary incisor.

terms.name: Discolored lateral incisors
terms.definition: The presence of discolored lateral incisors.

terms.name: Marked delay in eruption of permanent teeth
synonyms: Severe delay of eruption of adult teeth
Severe delay of eruption of permanent teeth
Very late eruption of adult teeth
Very late eruption of permanent teeth

terms.name: Abnormality of dental eruption
terms.definition: An abnormality of tooth eruption.

terms.name: Agenesis of maxillary central incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of maxillary central incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of upper secondary incisor or of upper central primary incisor.

terms.name: Enamel hypoplasia
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.

terms.name: Prolonged bleeding after dental extraction
terms.definition: Prolonged bleeding post dental extraction sufficient to require medical intervention.

terms.name: Dagger-shaped pulp calcifications
terms.definition: Dagger-shaped calcifications in the dental pulp.

terms.name: Atrophy of alveolar ridges
synonyms: Atrophy of alveolar processes of jaw
Flattening of alveolar processes of jaw
Resorption of alveolar processes of jaw

terms.name: Generalized microdontia
terms.definition: A generalized form of microdontia.

terms.name: Widely spaced primary teeth
terms.definition: Increased space between the primary teeth. Note this phenotype should be distinguished from increased space due purely to microdontia.

terms.name: Solitary median maxillary central incisor
terms.definition: A single maxillary central incisor positioned in the midline with morphological symmetry of the crown and bordered by lateral incisors.

terms.name: Irregularly spaced teeth
terms.definition: Irregular distribution of the teeth along the dental arch, i.e., and irregular spatial pattern of teeth.

terms.name: Multiple non-erupting secondary teeth
synonyms: Failure of eruption of multiple adult teeth
Failure of eruption of multiple permanent teeth

terms.name: Premature loss of primary teeth
terms.definition: Loss of the primary (also known as deciduous) teeth before the usual age.

terms.name: Buried teeth encased in mucopolysaccharide
synonyms: Failure of dental eruption due to mucopolysaccharidoses
Failure of tooth eruption due to mucopolysaccharidoses

terms.name: Alveolar process hypoplasia
synonyms: Decreased size of alveolar process of jaw
Deficiency of alveolar process of jaw
Underdevelopment of alveolar process of jaw
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the alveolar process (also known as alveolar bone).

terms.name: Supernumerary maxillary incisor
terms.definition: The presence of a supernumerary, i.e., extra, maxillary incisor, either the primary maxillary incisor or the permanent maxillary incisor.

terms.name: Crowded maxillary incisors
terms.definition: A type of dental misalignment with crowded central incisors, i.e., of maxillary secondary incisor, or of maxillary central primary incisor.

terms.name: Persistence of primary teeth
terms.definition: Persistence of the primary teeth beyond the age by which they normally are shed and replaced by the permanent teeth.

terms.name: Short dental root
terms.definition: Tooth root length more than 2 SD below mean, or subjectively apparently decreased tooth root length.

terms.name: Premature eruption of permanent teeth
terms.definition: Premature tooth eruption of the permanent dentition.

terms.name: Malformation of mandibular premolar
terms.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of secondary premolar tooth.

terms.name: Conical mandibular incisor
terms.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of the primary or permanent mandibular incisors.

terms.name: Peg-shaped maxillary lateral incisors
terms.definition: A tooth crown with its mesial and distal sides converging or tapering toward the incisal edge causing severe reduction of mesiodistal diameter

terms.name: Abnormal primary molar morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of shape of baby molar
Abnormality of shape of primary molar
terms.definition: An abnormality of morphology of primary molar.

terms.name: Screwdriver-shaped incisors
terms.definition: An abnormality of morphology of the incisor tooth in which the tooth is shaped like a screwdriver blade, i.e., having a rhomboid shape.

terms.name: Microdontia of primary teeth
terms.definition: Decreased size of the primary teeth.

terms.name: Agenesis of permanent teeth
synonyms: Failure of development of permanent teeth
Failure of development of secondary teeth
terms.definition: A congenital defect characterized by the absence of one or more permanent teeth, including oligodontia, hypodontia, and adontia of the of permanent teeth.

terms.name: Pulp obliteration
synonyms: Reduced size of pulp chamber of tooth
terms.definition: Mineralized substance filling the entire dental pulp space.

terms.name: Failure of eruption of permanent teeth
synonyms: Failure of eruption of adult teeth
terms.definition: Lack of tooth eruption of the secondary dentition.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the tooth germ
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the tooth germ, i.e., of the structure that forms in odontogenesis that will develop into a tooth.

terms.name: Agenesis of mandibular central incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of mandibular central incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of lower secondary incisor or lower primary incisor.

terms.name: Premature loss of permanent teeth
terms.definition: Premature loss of the permanent teeth.

terms.name: Shovel-shaped maxillary central incisors
terms.definition: A tooth with a crown with marked lingual or palatal marginal ridges causing scooped lingual or palatal surfaces.

terms.name: Crumpled long bones
terms.definition: An crumpled radiographic appearance of the long bones, as if the long bone had been crushed together producing irregularities. This feature is the result of multiple fractures and repeated rounds of ineffective healing, as can be seen for instance in severe forms of osteogenesis imperfecta.

terms.name: Irregular patellae
terms.definition: An alteration of the normally relatively smooth margins of the kneecap in radiographic images leading to an irregular contour.

terms.name: Distal ulnar epiphyseal stippling
terms.name_zh: 尺骨远端骨骺点状钙化
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the distal epiphysis of the ulna.

terms.name: Broad long bone diaphyses
terms.definition: Increased width of the diaphysis of long bones.

terms.name: Dumbbell-shaped femur
terms.definition: The femur is shortened and displays flaring (widening) of the metaphyses.

terms.name: Knee flexion contracture
terms.definition: A type of knee joint contracture in which the knee is in a fixed bent (flexed) configuration such that it cannot be straightened actively or passively.

terms.name: Rudimentary fibula
terms.definition: Absent or nearly absent fibula. (Does not include aplastic)

terms.name: Progressive bowing of long bones
terms.definition: Progressive bending or abnormal curvature of a long bone.

terms.name: Club-shaped distal femur
terms.definition: An abnormal conformation of the femur that becomes gradually enlarged towards the distal end. This feature affects the distal femoral metaphysis and epiphysis.

terms.name: Short lower limbs
terms.definition: Shortening of the legs related to developmental hypoplasia of the bones of the leg.

terms.name: Hypoplastic distal radial epiphyses
terms.name_zh: 桡骨远端骨骺发育不全
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the distal epiphysis of the radius.

terms.name: Wide distal femoral metaphysis
synonyms: Broad outermost wide portion of thighbone
terms.definition: Increased width of the distal part of the shaft (metaphysis) of the femur.

terms.name: Limited knee flexion
terms.definition: Reduced ability to flex (bend) the knee joint.

terms.name: Anterior tibial bowing
terms.definition: An abnormal anterior bending or curvature of the tibia.

terms.name: Overtubulated long bones
terms.definition: Overconstriction, or narrowness of the diaphysis and metaphysis of long bones.

terms.name: Increased density of long bones
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the bone density of the long bones.

terms.name: Limited pronation/supination of forearm
terms.definition: A limitation of the ability to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces anteriorly (supination) and to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces posteriorly (pronation).

terms.name: Flat distal femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Flat end part of outermost thighbone
terms.definition: An abnormal flattening of the distal epiphysis of femur.

terms.name: Club-shaped proximal femur
terms.definition: An abnormal conformation of the femur that becomes gradually enlarged towards the proximal end. This feature affects the proximal femoral metaphysis and epiphysis.

terms.name: Irregular distal femoral epiphysis
terms.definition: Anomaly of the contour of the Distal epiphysis of femur such that its normally smooth appearance is irregular.

terms.name: Distal tapering femur
synonyms: Tapering of outermost end of thighbone

terms.name: Progressive leg bowing
terms.definition: Progressive bending or abnormal curvature of the leg.

terms.name: Distal tibial bowing
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the distal portion of the tibia.

terms.name: Cortically dense long tubular bones
terms.definition: Increased density of the compact bone of long bone.

terms.name: Wide femoral metaphysis
synonyms: Broad wide portion of thigh bone

terms.name: Peg-like central prominence of distal tibial metaphyses
Elongated radius
terms.definition: Increased length of the radius.

terms.name: Broad femoral neck
terms.definition: An abnormally wide femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).

terms.name: Abnormal proximal femoral metaphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 股骨近端干骺端形态异常
synonyms: Abnormal wide portion of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: An anomaly of the metaphysis of the proximal femur (close to the hip).

terms.name: Radial ray deficiency
terms.definition: Radial dysplasia, also known as radial longitudinal deficiency, includes radial clubhand and is a disfiguring, and potentially disabling, congenital limb anomaly. The entire upper limb may be involved, although the defect is most evident in the forearm and hand. Affected children suffer a variable degree of hypoplasia or absence of the preaxial skeleton and soft tissues, in particular the thumb, radius, and dorsoradial soft tissues. The hand is usually radially deviated and subluxated off the distal aspect of the ulna, the ulna may be shortened and have a bow-shaped deformity, and there is no true wrist (radiocarpal) joint in Bayne2 type-III and IV radial dysplasia.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of proximal radius
terms.definition: Proximal radial shortening owing to a congenital defect of development.

terms.name: Disproportionate prominence of the femoral medial condyle
Enlargement of the distal femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Enlargement of the outermost thighbone end part
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement of the distal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Radioulnar dislocation
terms.definition: A dislocation is a separation of the radius and ulna bones where they normally meet. The radioulnar joints are two locations, proximal and distal, in which the radius and ulna articulate in the forearm. Both can dislocate.

terms.name: Increased density of long bone diaphyses
synonyms: Increased density of shaft of long bone

terms.name: Hypoplasia of proximal fibula
synonyms: Small innermost upper end of calf bone
Underdeveloped innermost upper end of calf bone
terms.definition: Underdevelopment or shortening of the end of the fibula (calf bone) nearest the knee.

terms.name: Patellar aplasia
terms.definition: Absence of the patella.

terms.name: Distal radial epiphyseal osteolysis
terms.name_zh: 桡骨远端骨骺骨质溶解

terms.name: Multicentric ossification of proximal femoral epiphyses
terms.name_zh: 股骨近端骨骺多中心骨化

terms.name: Lateral displacement of the femoral head
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly with lateral displacement of the femoral head.

terms.name: Delayed patellar ossification
synonyms: Delayed bone maturation of the knee cap
terms.definition: Formation of bone in the patella later than normal.

terms.name: Irregular proximal tibial epiphyses
terms.definition: Anomaly of the contour of the proximal epiphysis of the tibia such that its normally smooth appearance is irregular.

terms.name: Dorsal subluxation of ulna
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the ulna in the dorsal direction.

terms.name: Ankle hypermobility
terms.definition: The ankle joint can move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along its physiological axes.

terms.name: Proximal femoral epiphysiolysis
synonyms: Slipped end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis is defined as a posterior and inferior slippage of the proximal epiphysis of the femur onto the metaphysis (femoral neck), occurring through the physeal plate during the early adolescent growth spurt.

terms.name: Generalized bone demineralization
terms.definition: A generalized decrease in bone mineral density.

terms.name: Periosteal thickening of long tubular bones
terms.definition: Thickening of the periosteum of long bone.

terms.name: Limited shoulder movement
terms.definition: A limitation of the range of movement of the shoulder joint.

terms.name: Thin long bone diaphyses
terms.definition: Decreased width of the diaphysis of long bones.

terms.name: Anterior bowing of long bones
terms.definition: An abnormal anterior curvature of a long bone.

terms.name: Abnormality of the pancreatic islet cells
terms.definition: An abnormality of the islet of Langerhans, i.e., of the regions of the pancreas that contain its endocrine cells. These are the alpha cells, which produce glucagon, the beta cells, which produce insulin and amylin, the delta cells, which produce somatostatin, the PP cells, which produce pancreatic polypeptide, and the epsilon cells, which produce ghrelin.

terms.name: Abnormal alveolar ridge morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of alveolar processes of jaw
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the alveolar ridges (on the upper or lower jaws). The alveolar ridges contain the sockets (alveoli) of the teeth.

terms.name: Abnormal dental pulp morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the dental pulp.

terms.name: Premature loss of teeth
terms.definition: Exfoliation of a tooth more than 2 SD earlier than the normal age for the deciduous teeth and not related to traume or neglect. Exfoliation of a permanent tooth is per se abnormal.

terms.name: Abnormal primary tooth morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the primary tooth.

terms.name: Abnormal dental morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of the tooth.

terms.name: Abnormal number of teeth
terms.definition: The presence of an altered number of of teeth.

terms.name: Agenesis of incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of incisor.

terms.name: Abnormal dental root morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the dental root.

terms.name: Bowing of the long bones
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of a long bone.

terms.name: Bowing of the arm
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature affecting a long bone of the arm.

terms.name: Abnormal femoral metaphysis morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the femoral metaphysis.

terms.name: Abnormal lower-limb metaphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the wide portion of the lower-limb bone

terms.name: Abnormal tibial metaphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 胫骨骨干骺端形态异常

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fibula
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the fibula.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the lower limbs
terms.name_zh: 下肢骨发育不全/发育不良
