terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the bones of the lower limbs.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving bones of the feet
terms.name_zh: 足骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ulna
terms.name_zh: 尺骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Hypoplasia or unilateral/bilateral absence of ulna
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the ulna.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the upper limbs
terms.name_zh: 上肢骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Absent/small bones of the upper limbs
Absent/underdeveloped bones of the upper limbs
terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the bones of the upper limbs.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the patella
terms.name_zh: 髌骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the patella.

terms.name: Abnormal femoral epiphysis morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of a growth plate of a femur.

terms.name: Abnormal lower limb epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of end part of lower limb end bone
Abnormality involving the epiphyses of the lower limbs
Abnormality of lower limb epiphysis morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of one or more epiphyses of one or both legs.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the radius
terms.name_zh: 桡骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Absence or underdevelopment of the radius bone of the arm
terms.definition: A small/hypoplastic or absent/aplastic radius.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the carpal bones
terms.name_zh: 腕骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the carpal bones.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving forearm bones
terms.name_zh: 前臂骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of one or more forearm bones.

terms.name: Abnormal limb epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of end part of limb bones
Abnormality involving the epiphyses of the limbs
terms.definition: An anomaly of one or more epiphyses of a limb.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the humerus
terms.name_zh: 肱骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Absent/small long bone in upper arm
Absent/underdeveloped long bone in upper arm
terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the humerus.

terms.name: Abnormality of tibial epiphyses
synonyms: Abnormality of end part of shinbone

terms.name: Diverticulosis of trachea
terms.definition: Tracheal diverticula are blind-ended outpouchings arising from the trachea. They are usually an incidental finding. Occasionally they can mimic pneumomediastinum. Tracheal diverticula are either congenital or acquired, in the latter case the most common causes are prolonged increased intraluminal pressure, e.g. chronic cough, COPD, tracheomalacia, and iatrogenic (e.g. post-surgical).

terms.name: Chronic pulmonary obstruction
terms.definition: An anomaly that is characterized progressive airflow obstruction that is only partly reversible, inflammation in the airways, and systemic effects or comorbities.

terms.name: Laryngeal stridor
terms.definition: An abnormal high-pitched noisy sound, occurring during inhalation or exhalation caused by the incomplete obstruction in the throat.

terms.name: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis
terms.definition: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis involves inhalation of an antigen. This leads to an exaggerated immune response and a following inflammation of the alveoli within the lungs. The main feature of chronic hypersensitivity pneumonitis on lung biopsies is expansion of the interstitium by lymphocytes accompanied by an occasional multinucleated giant cell or loose granuloma. After exposure to the provoking antigen, following symptoms can be seen: fever, chills, malaise, cough, hemoptysis, chest tightness, dyspnea, rash, swelling and headache and can be completely reversible, based on the duration of the illness, categorized as acute (HP:0011009), subacute (HP:0011011), and chronic (HP:0011010).

terms.name: Intraalveolar phospholipid accumulation
synonyms: Detection of PAS-positive extracellular material in broncho-alveolar lavage
terms.definition: Accumulation of amorphous PAS-positive material in the space between alveolar macrophages, sometimes as condensed form (oval bodies) are typically found in alveolar proteinosis.

terms.name: Pulmonary venous occlusion
terms.definition: Substantial narrowing or blockage of small pulmonary veins as a result of disorganized smooth muscle hypertrophy and collagen matrix deposition.

terms.name: Alveolar cell carcinoma
terms.definition: Adenocarcinoma of the Bronchus.

terms.name: Pulmonary lymphangiectasia
terms.definition: Abnormal dilatation of the pulmonary lymphatic vessels. Lymphatic fluid in the lung is derived from normal leakage of fluid out of the blood capillaries in the lung. In pulmonary lymphangiectasia, the pulmonary lymphatics are not properly connected and become dilated with fluid.

terms.name: Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia
terms.name_zh: 淋巴细胞性间质性肺炎
terms.definition: Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis is a benign lymphoproliferative disorder of the lung that is characterized by the presence of a dense, predominantly lymphocytic interstitial infiltrate (lymphocytes, plasma cells, other elements of the lymphoreticular system) that expands the alveolar septa.

terms.name: Chronic lung disease
terms.definition: According to the definitions of the American and British Thoracic Societies, including pulmonary functional tests, X-rays, and CT scans for items such as fibrosis, bronchiectasis, bullae, emphysema, nodular or lymphomatous abnormalities.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary lymphatics
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary lymphatic chain.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary interstitial morphology
synonyms: Abnormality in area between air sacs in lung
terms.definition: Abnormality of the lung parenchyma extending to the pulmonary interstitium and leading to diffuse pulmonary fibrosis.

terms.name: Recurrent pneumonia
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to pneumonia as manifested by a history of recurrent episodes of pneumonia.

terms.name: Recurrent intrapulmonary hemorrhage
terms.definition: A recurrent hemorrhage occurring within the lung.

terms.name: Airway obstruction
terms.definition: Obstruction of conducting airways of the lung.

terms.name: Recurrent bronchopulmonary infections
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to bronchopulmonary infections as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchopulmonary infections.

terms.name: Extrapulmonary lobar sequestration
terms.definition: A type of pulmonary sequestration that is completely enclosed in its own pleural sac, occurring above, within, or below the diaphragm, and without communication with the tracheobronchial tree.

terms.name: Pulmonary arteriovenous malformation
terms.definition: Pulmonary arteriovenous malformation, a condition most commonly associated with hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, is an abnormal communication between the pulmonary artery and pulmonary vein without an intervening capillary communication. HRCT images usually show a coarse spidery appearance of the peripheral vascular markings in the lungs. More specific findings are obtained in the pulmonary angiogram where the normally invisible capillary phase is replaced by irregular vascular channels bridging the peripheral branches of pulmonary arteries and veins.

terms.name: Acute hepatic failure
terms.definition: Hepatic failure refers to the inability of the liver to perform its normal synthetic and metabolic functions, which can result in coagulopathy and alteration in the mental status of a previously healthy individual. Hepatic failure is defined as acute if there is onset of encephalopathy within 8 weeks of the onset of symptoms in a patient with a previously healthy liver.

terms.name: Diffuse hepatic steatosis
terms.definition: A diffuse form of hepatic steatosis.

terms.name: Decreased mitochondrial complex III activity in liver tissue
terms.name_zh: 肝组织线粒体复合物III活性降低
terms.definition: Decreased activity of complex III of the mitochondrion in the liver.

terms.name: Hepatic calcification
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition in the liver.

terms.name: Biliary hyperplasia
terms.definition: Hyperplasia of the biliary tree, as manifested by increased size of bile ducts, dilated lumen, and histologically by an increased number of epithelial cells or hyperplasia.

terms.name: Viral hepatitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the liver due to infection with a virus.

terms.name: Malformation of the hepatic ductal plate
Fluctuating hepatomegaly
terms.definition: Intermittently increased size of the liver.

terms.name: Increased hepatocellular lipid droplets
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of intracellular lipid droplets in hepatocytes.

terms.name: Increased hepatic glycogen content
terms.definition: An increase in the amount of glycogen stored in hepatocytes compared to normal.

terms.name: Reduced number of intrahepatic bile ducts
terms.definition: The presence of reduced numbers of intrahepatic bile duct than normal.

terms.name: Acute hepatic steatosis
terms.definition: An acute form of hepatic steatosis.

terms.name: Intrahepatic cholestasis with episodic jaundice
terms.name_zh: 肝内胆汁淤积伴发作性黄疸

terms.name: Macronodular cirrhosis
terms.definition: A type of cirrhosis characterized by the presence of large regenerative nodules.

terms.name: Prolonged neonatal jaundice
synonyms: Prolonged yellowing of skin in newborn
terms.definition: Neonatal jaundice refers to a yellowing of the skin and other tissues of a newborn infant as a result of increased concentrations of bilirubin in the blood. Neonatal jaundice affects over half of all newborns to some extent in the first week of life. Prolonged neonatal jaundice is said to be present if the jaundice persists for longer than 14 days in term infants and 21 days in preterm infants.

terms.name: Portal fibrosis
terms.definition: Fibroblast proliferation and fiber expansion from the portal areas to the lobule.

terms.name: Depletion of mitochondrial DNA in liver
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the number of mitochondria in hepatocytes.

terms.name: Reye syndrome-like episodes
terms.definition: Repeated occurrences of acute noninflammatory encephalopathy and fatty degenerative liver failure.

terms.name: Congenital pseudoarthrosis of the clavicle
terms.definition: The two portions of the clavicle (corresponding to the two primary ossification centers of the clavicle) are connected by a fibrous bridge that is contiguous with the periosteum, and a synovial membrane develops, resulting in a clavicle with a bipartite appearance radiographically. Congenital pseudarthrosis of the clavicle generally presents as a painless mass or swelling over the clavicle.

terms.name: Straight clavicle
terms.definition: An abnormally straight configuration of the clavicle, a tubular bone which normally is doubly curved .

terms.name: Premature sternal synostosis
terms.definition: Prematurely closed sternal sutures.

terms.name: Absent glenoid fossa
terms.definition: Lack of development of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.

terms.name: Scapulohumeral synostosis
synonyms: Fusion of shoulder blade to long bone in upper arm
terms.definition: Bony fusion between the humerus and scapula, leading to an impairment in mobility of the affected shoulder joint.

terms.name: Diaphragmatic paralysis
terms.definition: The presence of a paralyzed diaphragm.

terms.name: Irregular ossification at anterior rib ends
Irregular chondrocostal junctions
terms.definition: Irregular surface of the normally relatively smooth border between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.

terms.name: Precocious costochondral ossification
terms.definition: Early ossification of the costochondral junction, which is the joint between the ribs and costal cartilage in the front of the rib cage.

terms.name: Midclavicular hypoplasia
synonyms: Underdeveloped middle portion of the collarbone
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the middle portion of the clavicle.

terms.name: Wide intermamillary distance
terms.definition: A larger than usual distance between the left and right nipple.

terms.name: Decreased number of sternal ossification centers
terms.name_zh: 胸骨骨化中心数量减少
synonyms: Decreased number of sternal ossification centres
terms.definition: A less than normal number of sternal ossification centers. The sternum is initially formed from bilateral sternal plates that chondrify and begin to fuse with ribs at 10 weeks gestational age. Ossification starts in the manubrium and upper part of the sternal body at the 6th month, in the middle of the sternal body at the 7th month, in the lower part of the body during the 1st postnatal year and in the xiphoid process between years 5 and 18. The number of ossification centers vary up to six, and it is the ossification centers that are visualized by prenatal ultrasound. This term describes a reduction in the number of ossification centers compared with age-related norms.

terms.name: Absent in utero rib ossification
terms.definition: Lack of formation and mineralization of the ribs in utero.

terms.name: Anterior rib punctate calcifications
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in point-like foci within the anterior portion of one or more ribs.

terms.name: Costochondral joint sclerosis
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in density of the tissue at the costochondral junctions.

terms.name: Multifocal breast carcinoma
terms.definition: Breast carcinoma that is bilateral or otherwise multifocal.

terms.name: Absent sternal ossification
terms.definition: Lack of formation of mineralized bony tissue of the sternum.

terms.name: Hypoplastic distal segments of scapulae
synonyms: Small distal segments of the shoulder blade
Underdeveloped outermost segments of shoulder blade

terms.name: Glenoid fossa hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the glenoid fossa, which is the cavity in the lateral part of the scapula which articulates with the head of the humerus.

terms.name: Osteosclerosis of ribs
terms.definition: Osteosclerosis of ribs (increased density related to increased bone mass).

terms.name: Midclavicular aplasia
terms.definition: Developmental defect resulting in congenital absence of the middle portion of the clavicle.

terms.name: Multiple rib fractures
terms.definition: More than one fracture of the ribs. Callus formation around multiple rib fractures can produce a row of multiple rounded expansions (beadlike prominences) giving the appearance of beaded ribs. Note that rachitic rosary would have one bead per rib (a swelling at the costochondral junction), while beaded ribs in the context of multiple rib fractures have multiple beads (fractures) along the same rib.

terms.name: Thin clavicle
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced diameter (cross section) of the clavicles.

terms.name: Costal cartilage calcification
terms.definition: Calcification of the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage found at the anterior ends of the ribs which serve to prolong the ribs forward and contribute to the elasticity of the walls of the thorax.

terms.name: Costochondral pain
terms.definition: Chest wall pain in the area of the costochondral junctions.

terms.name: Thickening of the lateral border of the scapula
synonyms: Thickening of the lateral border of the shoulder blade

terms.name: Aplastic clavicle
terms.definition: Absence of the clavicles as a developmental defect.

terms.name: Coat hanger sign of ribs
terms.definition: An abnormal morphology of the ribs consisting of shorted, abnormally curved ribs. On posteroanterior chest radiography, the ribs show a curvature resembling that of a coat hanger (clothes hanger).

terms.name: Prolonged QRS complex
terms.definition: Increased time for the complex comprised of the Q wave, R wave, and S wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).. In adults, normal values are 0.06 - 0.10 sec.

terms.name: Granulomatous coronary arteritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the coronary arteries involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.

terms.name: Premature ventricular contraction
terms.definition: Premature ventricular contractions (PVC) or ventricular extrasystoles are premature contractions of the heart that arise in response to an impulse in the ventricles rather than the normal impulse from the sinoatrial (SA) node.

terms.name: Abnormal ventricular filling
terms.definition: An abnormality of filling of a ventricle with blood during diastole.

terms.name: Ventricular preexcitation with multiple accessory pathways
terms.definition: A form of ventricular preexcitation due to the presence of multiple accessory pathways for cardiac conduction.

terms.name: Endocardial fibrosis
terms.definition: The presence of excessive connective tissue in the endocardium.

terms.name: Aortic tortuosity
terms.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the aorta.

terms.name: Bacterial endocarditis
terms.definition: A bacterial infection of the endocardium, the inner layer of the heart, which usually involves the heart valves.

terms.name: Myocardial calcification
terms.definition: Calcium deposition in the myocardium.

terms.name: Pulmonic valve myxoma
terms.definition: A benign tumor of connective tissue containing mucous or gelatinous material (myxoma) localized in the pumonic valve.

terms.name: Short chordae tendineae of the tricuspid valve
terms.definition: Abnormally short chordae tendineae of the tricuspid valve.

terms.name: Myocardial steatosis
terms.definition: Steatosis in the myocardium.

terms.name: Early progressive calcific cardiac valvular disease
terms.name_zh: 早发性进展性钙化性心脏瓣膜病

terms.name: Atrioventricular canal defect
terms.definition: A defect of the atrioventricular septum of the heart.

terms.name: Dilatation of the ventricular cavity
terms.definition: A localized outpouching of ventricular cavity that is generally associated with dyskinesia and paradoxical expansion during systole.

terms.name: Premature atrial contractions
terms.definition: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites.

terms.name: Coronary artery dissection
terms.definition: Acute occurrence of a dissection (tear within the tunica intima and entry of blood into the tunica media) of a coronary artery.

terms.name: Abnormal coronary artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the coronary arteries.

terms.name: Abnormal atrioventricular valve morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of an atrioventricular valve.

terms.name: Abnormality of the hepatic vasculature
terms.definition: An abnormality of the hepatic vasculature.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nipples
terms.name_zh: 乳头发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the clavicles
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the clavicles (collar bones).

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving bones of the thorax
terms.name_zh: 胸廓骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ribs
terms.name_zh: 肋骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the scapulae
terms.name_zh: 肩胛骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sternum
terms.name_zh: 胸骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal carcinoma
terms.name_zh: 遗传性非息肉病性结直肠癌

terms.name: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
terms.definition: A form of acute leukemia characterized by excess lympoblasts.

terms.name: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of an adenocarcinoma of the pancreas.

terms.name: T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemias
terms.definition: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia of T-cell origin. It comprises about 15% of childhood cases and 25% of adult cases. It is more common in males than females.

terms.name: Retroperitoneal paraganglioma
terms.definition: A paraganglioma (previously referred to as chemodectoma) located in the retroperitoneal space. Paragangliomas (also known as extra-adrenal pheochromocytomas) are rare tumors that arise from extra-adrenal chromaffin cells. Paragangliomas are characterized by secretions of excessive catecholamines, including epinephrine, norepinephrine and dopamine, which may lead to clinical symptoms, including episodic hypertension, tachycardia and diaphoresis. However, between 40 and 50% of paragangliomas are non-functional.

terms.name: Follicular thyroid carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of an follicular adenocarcinoma of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma type 2
terms.definition: A type of papillary renal cell carcinoma in which the papillae are covered by large eosinophilic cells with pleomorphic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and nuclear pseudostratification.

terms.name: Acute megakaryocytic leukemia
terms.definition: A rare subtype of acute myeloid leukemia evolving from primitive megakaryoblasts.

terms.name: Renal cortical adenoma
terms.definition: The presence of an adenoma in the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Extraadrenal pheochromocytoma
terms.definition: Pheochromocytoma not originating from the adrenal medulla but from another source such as from chromaffin cells in or about sympathetic ganglia.

terms.name: Squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
terms.definition: Squamous cell carcinoma of the skin is a malignant tumor of squamous epithelium.

terms.name: Transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder
terms.definition: The presence of a carcinoma of the urinary bladder with origin in a transitional epithelial cell.

terms.name: Adrenocortical carcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant neoplasm of the adrenal cortex that may produce hormones such as cortisol, aldosterone, estrogen, or testosterone.

terms.name: Adrenal pheochromocytoma
terms.definition: Pheochromocytoma originating from the adrenal medulla.

terms.name: Paraspinal neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized adjacent to the spine.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the stomach
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the stomach.

terms.name: Cutaneous leiomyosarcoma
terms.definition: The presence of leiomyosarcoma of the skin.

terms.name: Malignant genitourinary tract tumor
terms.definition: The presence of a malignant neoplasm of the genital system.

terms.name: Renal pelvic carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a carcinoma in the renal pelvis.

terms.name: Chondrosarcoma
terms.definition: A slowly growing malignant neoplasm derived from cartilage cells.

terms.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of renal cell carcinoma in the renal papilla.

terms.name: Pituitary prolactin cell adenoma
terms.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma originating in prolactin secreting cells. This kind of adenoma is characterized by overproduction of prolactin, and may cause loss of menstrual periods and breast milk production in women.

terms.name: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
terms.definition: A subtype of renal cell carcinoma thought to originate from mature renal tubular cells in the proximal tubule of the nehpron.

terms.name: Duodenal adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the duodenum.

terms.name: Renal angiomyolipoma
terms.definition: A benign renal neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.

terms.name: Ovarian papillary adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: The presence of a papillary adenocarcinoma of the ovary.

terms.name: Multiple myeloma
terms.definition: A malignant plasma cell tumor growing within soft tissue or within the skeleton.

terms.name: Benign genitourinary tract neoplasm
terms.definition: A non-malignant neoplasm of the genitourinary system.

terms.name: Parathyroid carcinoma
terms.definition: A malignancy of the parathyroid glands. Parathyroid carcinoma usually secretes parathyroid hormone, leading to hyperparathyroidism.

terms.name: Hurthle cell thyroid adenoma
terms.name_zh: 许特莱细胞甲状腺腺瘤
terms.definition: A kind of thyroid adenoma characterized by the presence of oxyphil cells.

terms.name: Malignant eosinophil proliferation
terms.name_zh: 恶性嗜酸性粒细胞增殖

terms.name: Paranasal sinus hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the paranasal sinuses.

terms.name: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy
terms.definition: Muscular dystrophy affecting the muscles of the limb girdle (the hips and shoulders).

terms.name: Loss of ability to walk in first decade
synonyms: Loss of ability to walk in first decade

terms.name: Basal ganglia cysts
synonyms: Cystic lesions in the basal ganglia

terms.name: Abnormal anterior horn cell morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the anterior horn cells
Anomaly of the anterior horn cells
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the anterior horn cell.

terms.name: Vivid hallucination
terms.definition: Perceptual experiences that are vivid, intense, and sensory in nature occur in the absence of corresponding stimuli from the external environment.

terms.name: Cerebral hypomyelination
terms.definition: Reduced amount of myelin in the nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis in the white matter of the central nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormal posterior periventricular white matter morphology
terms.name_zh: 脑室周围后部白质形态异常
synonyms: White matter abnormalities in the posterior periventricular region
terms.definition: An anomaly of the white matter of the brain localized in the region posterior to the cerebral ventricles.

terms.name: Focal hemiclonic seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal clonic seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking rapidly involves one side of the body at seizure onset.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis
terms.name_zh: 小脑蚓部发育不全/缺如
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the vermis of cerebellum.

terms.name: 4-layered lissencephaly
terms.definition: A form of lissencephaly in which the cortex is thickened and has four more or less disorganized layers rather than six normal layers resulting from incomplete neuronal migration during brain development. At neuropathological examination, a 4-layered cortex consists of an upper molecular layer, a second thin cellular layer containing pyramidal neurons usually observed in layer V, a third pale poorly cellular layer and a fourth thick deep layer made up of neurons which had failed to migrate. Radiologocally would manifest as agyria or pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm.

terms.name: Frontal polymicrogyria
terms.definition: A type of polymicrogyria with a gradient of severity (anterior more severe than posterior) extending from frontal poles posteriorly to precentral gyrus and inferiorly to frontal operculum.

terms.name: Pallor of dorsal columns of the spinal cord
terms.definition: An abnormally pale appearance of the dorsal portion of the gray substance of the spinal cord. This finding can be observed by histological examination.

terms.name: Severe muscular hypotonia
terms.definition: A severe degree of muscular hypotonia characterized by markedly reduced muscle tone.

terms.name: Developmental stagnation at onset of seizures
terms.name_zh: 癫痫发作起病时发育停滞
terms.definition: A cessation of the development of a child in the areas of motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and/or emotional skills, following the onset of epilepsy.

terms.name: Congenital Horner syndrome
terms.definition: A type of Horner syndrome with congenital onset.

terms.name: Absent patellar reflexes
terms.definition: Absence of the knee jerk reflex, which can normally be elicited by tapping the patellar tendon with a reflex hammer just below the patella.

terms.name: Hypodysplasia of the corpus callosum
terms.definition: Developmental defect characterized by a small and malformed corpus callosum.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the ventral pons
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ventral portion of the pons.

terms.name: Symmetric spinal nerve root neurofibromas
synonyms: Spinal nerve root neurofibromas, symmetric, multiple
terms.definition: Multiple neurofibromas of the spinal nerve roots with a symmetric distribution.

terms.name: Episodic generalized hypotonia
terms.name_zh: 发作性全身肌张力低下
terms.definition: The occurrence of repeated episodes of generalized muscular hypotonia.

terms.name: Cerebellar vermis atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting (atrophy) of the vermis of cerebellum.

terms.name: Impaired distal proprioception
terms.definition: A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position occurring at distal joints.

terms.name: Severe expressive language delay
terms.definition: A severe delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.

terms.name: Sensorimotor polyneuropathy affecting arms more than legs
Midline central nervous system lipomas
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统中线脂肪瘤

terms.name: Lobar holoprosencephaly
terms.definition: A type of holoprosencephaly in which most of the right and left cerebral hemispheres and lateral ventricles are separated but the most rostral aspect of the telencephalon, the frontal lobes, are fused, especially ventrally.

terms.name: Cerebral hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the cerebrum.

terms.name: Symmetrical progressive peripheral demyelination
terms.definition: A symmetric and progressive loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Pontocerebellar atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy affecting the pons and the cerebellum.

terms.name: Cerebellar hemangioblastoma
terms.definition: A hemangioblastoma of the cerebellum.

terms.name: Diffuse peripheral demyelination
terms.name_zh: 弥漫性周围神经脱髓鞘
terms.definition: A diffuse loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Impaired distal vibration sensation
terms.definition: A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration in the distal portions of the limbs.

terms.name: Borderline intellectual disability
terms.definition: Borderline intellectual disability is defined as an intelligence quotient (IQ) in the range of 70-85.

terms.name: Frontotemporal cerebral atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decrease in size of cells or tissue) affecting the frontotemporal cerebrum.

terms.name: Hypnopompic hallucination
terms.definition: Hallucinations occurring during the transition from sleep to wakefulness.

terms.name: Abducens palsy
terms.definition: Malfunction of the abducens nerve as manifested by impairment of the ability of the affected eye to be moved outward. Patients who develop abducens nerve palsy often present with binocular horizontal diplopia, which is a double vision when looking at objects side by side. There will be a notable weakness of the ipsilateral lateral rectus muscle leading to a deficit in of eye abduction on the affected side. Some patients may present with a constant head turning movement to maintain binocular fusion and to lessen the degree of diplopia.

terms.name: Congenital intracerebral calcification
terms.definition: The presence of calcium deposition within brain structures that is present already at the time of birth.

terms.name: Frontal cortical atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the frontal cortex.

terms.name: Inability to walk by childhood/adolescence
terms.name_zh: 儿童/青少年期不能行走

terms.name: Intraaxonal accumulation of curvilinear autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
terms.name_zh: 轴突内曲线形自发荧光脂色素贮积物堆积
terms.definition: Curvilinear intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material within axons.

terms.name: Axial muscle stiffness
terms.definition: Stiffness (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) of the axial musculature.

terms.name: Unilateral polymicrogyria
terms.definition: Excessive number of small gyri (convolutions) on the surface of one side of the brain.

terms.name: Hypoglycemic encephalopathy
terms.definition: Brain damage related to a lowering of blood glucose below a critical level (around 30 mg/dl), which may lead to confusion, lethargy and delirium followed by seizures and coma. Prolonged hypoglycemia may lead to irreversible brain damage.

terms.name: Frontoparietal cortical dysplasia
terms.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the cortex of frontal lobe and the cortex of parietal lobe.

terms.name: Pericallosal lipoma
terms.definition: Pericallosal lipomas are congenital soft masses of adipose cells encapsulated by a thin layer of fibrous tissue, appearing adjacent to the corpus callosum of the brain.

terms.name: Transient psychotic episodes
terms.definition: Relatively short-lived periods of psychosis are characterized by the sudden onset of severe disturbances in perception, thinking, and behavior. These episodes typically last for a brief duration, generally ranging from a few days to a few weeks, and are often triggered by a significant stressor or traumatic event.

terms.name: Congenital nystagmus
terms.definition: Nystagmus dating from or present at birth.

terms.name: Impaired distal tactile sensation
terms.definition: A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation) on the skin of the distal limbs. This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.

terms.name: Impaired vibration sensation at ankles
terms.definition: A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration at the ankles. Clinically, this is usually tested with a tuning fork which vibrates at 128 Hz and is applied to the malleoli of the ankles.

terms.name: Diffuse spongiform leukoencephalopathy
terms.name_zh: 弥漫性海绵状白质脑病

terms.name: Abolished vibration sense
terms.definition: A complete loss of the ability to perceive vibration.

terms.name: Recurrent meningitis
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to meningitis as manifested by a medical history of recurrent episodes of meningitis.

terms.name: Olivopontocerebellar hypoplasia
terms.definition: Hypoplasia of the cerebellum, pontine nuclei, and inferior olivary nucleus.

terms.name: Abnormal auditory evoked potentials
terms.definition: An abnormality of the auditory evoked potentials, which are used to trace the signal generated by a sound, from the cochlear nerve, through the lateral lemniscus, to the medial geniculate nucleus, and to the cortex.

terms.name: Proximal spinal muscular atrophy
terms.definition: Proximal spinal muscular atrophy, i.e., muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.

terms.name: Choroid plexus calcification
terms.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in the choroid plexus.

terms.name: Gait instability, worse in the dark
synonyms: Unstable walking, worse in the dark

terms.name: Periventricular leukomalacia
terms.definition: Periventricular leukomalacia is characterized by diffuse injury of deep cerebral white matter, accompanied in its most severe form by focal necrosis. The neuropathologic hallmarks of PVL are microglial activation and focal and diffuse periventricular depletion of premyelinating oligodendroglia.

terms.name: Necrotizing encephalopathy
terms.definition: A type of encephalopathy (brain disease, damage, or malfunction accompanied by an altered mental state) that is characterized by evidence of necrosis of brain tissue.

terms.name: Deficit in grammar
terms.definition: Deficit in grammar, including syntax and morphology.

terms.name: Dysmyelinating leukodystrophy
terms.name_zh: 髓鞘形成不良性脑白质营养不良

terms.name: Sleep-wake cycle disturbance
terms.definition: Any abnormality of an individual's circadian rhythm that affects the timing of sleeping and being awake is referred to as a sleep-wake disorder.

terms.name: Progressive leukoencephalopathy
terms.definition: Leukoencephalopathy that gets more severe with time.

terms.name: Alobar holoprosencephaly
terms.definition: A type of holoprosencephaly characterized by the presence of a single ventricle and no separation of the cerebral hemisphere. The single midline ventricle is often greatly enlarged.

terms.name: Dysplastic corpus callosum
terms.definition: Dysplasia and dysgenesis of the corpus callosum are nonspecific descriptions that imply defective development of the corpus callosum. The term dysplasia is applied when the morphology of the corpus callosum is altered as a congenital trait. For instance, the corpus callosum may be hump-shaped, kinked, or a striped corpus callosum that lacks an anatomically distinct genu and splenium.

terms.name: Myelin-dependent gliosis
terms.definition: A type of gliosis that occurs in the vicinity of injured neurons.

terms.name: Basal ganglia gliosis
terms.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the basal ganglia.

terms.name: Loss of Purkinje cells in the cerebellar vermis
terms.name_zh: 小脑蚓部浦肯野细胞缺失

terms.name: Motor axonal neuropathy
terms.definition: Progressive impairment of function of motor axons with muscle weakness, atrophy, and cramps. The deficits are length-dependent, meaning that muscles innervated by the longest nerves are affected first, so that for instance the arms are affected at a later age than the onset of deficits involving the lower leg.

terms.name: Cavitation of the basal ganglia
terms.definition: The formation of small cavities in the tissue of the basal ganglia.

terms.name: Poor fine motor coordination
terms.definition: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of small muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Fine motor skills are required to mediate movements of the wrists, hands, fingers, feet, and toes.

terms.name: Fourth cranial nerve palsy
terms.definition: Paralysis of the fourth cranial (trochlear) nerve manifested as weakness of the superior oblique muscle which causes vertical diplopia that is maximal when the affected eye is adducted and directed inferiorly.

terms.name: Poor gross motor coordination
terms.definition: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of large muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Gross motor skills are required to mediate movements of the arms, legs, and other large body parts.

terms.name: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
terms.definition: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) manifests at age 2-3 years or by first grade at the latest. The main symptoms are distractibility, impulsivity, hyperactivity, and often trouble organizing tasks and projects, difficulty going to sleep, and social problems from being aggressive, loud, or impatient.

terms.name: Pain insensitivity
terms.definition: Inability to perceive painful stimuli.

terms.name: Antenatal intracerebral hemorrhage
terms.definition: Cerebral hemorrhage that occurs before birth.

terms.name: Pseudobulbar paralysis
terms.definition: Bilateral impairment of the function of the cranial nerves 9-12, which control musculature involved in eating, swallowing, and speech. Pseudobulbar paralysis is characterized clinically by dysarthria, dysphonia, and dysphagia with bifacial paralysis, and may be accompanied by Pseudobulbar behavioral symptoms such as enforced crying and laughing.

terms.name: Poorly formed metencephalon
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of the metencephalon.

terms.name: Cerebral berry aneurysm
terms.definition: A small, sac-like aneurysm (outpouching) of a cerebral blood vessel.

terms.name: Cerebellar dysplasia
terms.definition: Cerebellar dysplasia (abnormal growth or development) is defined by abnormal cerebellar foliation, white matter arborization, and gray-white matter junction. Cerebellar dysplasia is a neuroimaging finding that describes abnormalities of both the cerebellar cortex and white matter and is associated with variable neurodevelopmental outcome. Dysplasia may globally involve the cerebellum or affect only one cerebellar hemisphere. In addition, cerebellar dysplasia may be associated with cortical/subcortical cysts.

terms.name: Anterior encephalocele
terms.definition: A type of congenital malformation in which brain tissue protrudes through a defect in the anterior (front) part of the skull.

terms.name: Symmetric T2-signal increase with T1-signal decrease in the putamen
terms.definition: A symmetric magnetic resonance imaing (MRI) abnormality of the basal ganglia characterized by an increase of signal intensity in T2-weighted images and a corresponding signal decrease on T1-weighted images.

terms.name: Chronic lymphocytic meningitis
terms.name_zh: 慢性淋巴细胞性脑膜炎
terms.definition: Meningitis that persists for more than 4 weeks, and lymphocytes are present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Atrophy of the dentate nucleus
terms.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of dentate nucleus.

terms.name: Large basal ganglia
terms.definition: Increased size of the basal ganglia.

terms.name: Proximal hyperreflexia
terms.definition: Hyperactive stretch reflexes of muscles that move proximal joints (elbow, knee).

terms.name: Generalized cerebral atrophy/hypoplasia
terms.name_zh: 全身性脑萎缩/发育不全
terms.definition: Generalized atrophy or hypoplasia of the cerebrum.

terms.name: Aplasia of the inferior half of the cerebellar vermis
terms.name_zh: 小脑蚓部下半发育不全
synonyms: Absent inferior half of the cerebellar vermis

terms.name: Progressive language deterioration
terms.definition: Progressive loss of previously present language abilities.

terms.name: Disorganization of the anterior cerebellar vermis
synonyms: Disorganisation of the anterior cerebellar vermis

terms.name: Proximal limb muscle stiffness
terms.definition: Stiffness of the limbs (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) occurring in the proximal limb muscle.

terms.name: Distal peripheral sensory neuropathy
terms.definition: Peripheral sensory neuropathy affecting primarily distal sensation.

terms.name: Inferior cerebellar vermis hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.

terms.name: Thick corpus callosum
terms.definition: Increased vertical dimension of the corpus callosum. This feature can be visualized by sagittal sections on magnetic resonance tomography imaging of the brain.

terms.name: Extrapyramidal muscular rigidity
terms.definition: Muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement).

terms.name: Decreased amplitude of sensory action potentials
terms.name_zh: 感觉动作电位波幅降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the amplitude of sensory nerve action potential. This feature is measured by nerve conduction studies.

terms.name: Dilated third ventricle
terms.definition: An increase in size of the third ventricle.

terms.name: Facial-lingual fasciculations
terms.definition: Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the face.

terms.name: Paroxysmal choreoathetosis
terms.definition: Episodes of choreoathetosis that can occur following triggers such as quick voluntary movements.

terms.name: Chiari type I malformation
terms.definition: Arnold-Chiari type I malformation refers to a relatively mild degree of herniation of the posteroinferior region of the cerebellum (the cerebellar tonsils) into the cervical canal with little or no displacement of the fourth ventricle. It is characterized by one or both pointed (not rounded) cerebellar tonsils that project 5 mm below the foramen magnum, measured by a line drawn from the basion to the opisthion (McRae Line)

terms.name: Hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.definition: A darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter.

terms.name: Infantile encephalopathy
terms.definition: Encephalopathy with onset in the infantile period.

terms.name: Segmental peripheral demyelination
terms.definition: A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers from segments of the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Demyelinating peripheral neuropathy
terms.definition: Demyelinating neuropathy is characterized by slow nerve conduction velocities with reduced amplitudes of sensory/motor nerve conduction and prolonged distal latencies.

terms.name: Temporal cortical atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the temporal cortex.

terms.name: Naso-orbital encephalocele
terms.definition: A type of encephalocele that occurs along the medial orbit wall at the level of the frontal process of the maxilla and the ethmoid-lacrimal bone junction.

terms.name: Subcortical dementia
terms.definition: A particular type of dementia characterized by a pattern of mental defects consisting prominently of forgetfulness, slowness of thought processes, and personality or mood change.

terms.name: Proximal amyotrophy
synonyms: Wasting of muscles near the body
terms.definition: Amyotrophy (muscular atrophy) affecting the proximal musculature.

terms.name: Acute demyelinating polyneuropathy
terms.name_zh: 急性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病
terms.definition: Acute progressive areflexic weakness and mild sensory changes resulting from myelin breakdown and axonal degeneration.

terms.name: Pallidal degeneration
terms.definition: Neurodegeneration involving the globus pallidus,a part of the basal ganglia that is involved in the regulation of voluntary movement.

terms.name: Sensorimotor neuropathy
synonyms: Nerve damage causing decreased feeling and movement

terms.name: Distal upper limb amyotrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy of distal arm muscles.

terms.name: Asymmetric limb muscle stiffness
terms.definition: Stiffness of the limbs (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) occurring in an asymmetric pattern.

terms.name: Progressive extrapyramidal muscular rigidity
terms.definition: A progressive degree of muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement).

terms.name: Fluctuations in consciousness
terms.definition: Changes in one's level of awareness and responsiveness to their environment.

terms.name: Diffuse demyelination of the cerebral white matter
terms.definition: A diffuse loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Periventricular heterotopia
terms.definition: A form of gray matter heterotopia were the mislocalized gray matter is typically located periventricularly, also sometimes called subependymal heterotopia. Periventricular means beside the ventricles. This is by far the most common location for heterotopia. Subependymal heterotopia present in a wide array of variations. There can be a small single node or a large number of nodes, can exist on either or both sides of the brain at any point along the higher ventricle margins, can be small or large, single or multiple, and can form a small node or a large wavy or curved mass.

terms.name: Paroxysmal dyskinesia
terms.definition: Episodic bouts of involuntary movements with dystonic, choreic, ballistic movements, or a combination thereof. There is no loss of consciousness during the attacks.

terms.name: Absent smooth pursuit
terms.definition: A complete lack of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.

terms.name: Interosseus muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the interosseus muscles (including the palmar interossei that lie on the anterior aspect of the metacarpals, the dorsal interosseus muscles of the hand, which lie between the intercarpals, the plantar interosseus muscles, which lie underneath the metatarsal bones, and the dorsal interossei, which are located between the metatarsal bones.

terms.name: Peripheral hypomyelination
terms.definition: Reduced amount of myelin in the nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis in the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Focal T2 hyperintense basal ganglia lesion
terms.name_zh: 基底节局灶性T2高信号病变
synonyms: Hyperintense lesions in the basal ganglia on MRI
terms.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the basal ganglia.

terms.name: Loss of consciousness
terms.definition: Loss of awareness of oneself or one's surroundings, involving (i) a loss of normal motor control is evident as flaccidity or stiffness, either of which can be accompanied by jerking movements, and postural control is lost so that patients fall if they are in an upright position; (ii) normal responsiveness is lost; and (iii) the patient experiences amnesia for the event. Loss of consciousness my be transitory (e.g., syncope) or prolonged.

terms.name: Focal lissencephaly
terms.definition: A congenital absence of the convolutions of the cerebral cortex and a poorly formed sylvian fissure that affects a particular part of the cortex.

terms.name: Congenital facial diplegia
terms.definition: Facial diplegia (that is, bilateral facial palsy) with congenital onset.

terms.name: Neuronal loss in the cerebral cortex
Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure on awakening
terms.name_zh: 觉醒期双侧强直-阵挛发作
terms.definition: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure of either generalized or focal onset occurring on or soon after wakening (typically within 90 minutes of waking, regardless of the time of day).

terms.name: Episodic hypersomnia
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of hypersomnia (sleeping 16 or more hours a day) over a period of days or weeks.

terms.name: Cerebral artery atherosclerosis
terms.definition: The formation of the formation of fibrofatty lesions in the wall of an artery located in the brain.

terms.name: Hemimegalencephaly
terms.definition: Enlargement of all or parts of one cerebral hemisphere.

terms.name: Photosensitive tonic-clonic seizure
terms.definition: Generalized-onset tonic-clonic seizures that are provoked by flashing or flickering light.

terms.name: Irregular myelin loops
terms.definition: Presence of irregular redundant loops of focally folded myelin in a peripheral nerve.

terms.name: Facial paralysis
terms.definition: Complete loss of ability to move facial muscles innervated by the facial nerve (i.e., the seventh cranial nerve).

terms.name: Lower limb amyotrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting the lower limb.

terms.name: Periodic hyperkalemic paralysis
terms.definition: Episodes of muscle weakness associated with elevated levels of potassium in the blood.

terms.name: Demyelinating motor neuropathy
terms.definition: Demyelination of peripheral motor nerves.

terms.name: Intracerebral periventricular calcifications
terms.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in the cerebral white matter surrounding the cerebral ventricles.

terms.name: Decreased distal sensory nerve action potential
terms.name_zh: 远端感觉神经动作电位降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the amplitude of sensory nerve action potential in distal nerve segments. This feature is measured by nerve conduction studies.

terms.name: Spinocerebellar tract disease in lower limbs
Clusters of axonal regeneration
terms.definition: Groups of small caliber axons in peripheral nerve biospies indicative of axonal regeneration.

terms.name: Progressive gait ataxia
terms.definition: A type of gait ataxia displaying progression of clinical severity.

terms.name: Decreased number of small peripheral myelinated nerve fibers
terms.name_zh: 外周小有髓神经纤维数量减少
synonyms: Decreased number of small peripheral myelinated nerve fibres

terms.name: Recurrent external ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: Alternating and recurrent weakness of the external ocular muscles.

terms.name: Abnormal pyramidal sign
terms.definition: Functional neurological abnormalities related to dysfunction of the pyramidal tract.

terms.name: Severe demyelination of the white matter
terms.definition: A severe loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Type II lissencephaly
terms.definition: A form of lissencephaly characterized by an uneven cortical surface with a so called 'cobblestone' appearace. There are no distinguishable cortical layers.

terms.name: Symmetric peripheral demyelination
terms.definition: A symmetric loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Spinocerebellar atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy affecting the cerebellum and the spinocerebellar tracts of the spinal cord.

terms.name: Absent mesencephalon
terms.definition: Agenesis of the midbrain.

terms.name: Cerebral dysmyelination
terms.definition: Defective structure and function of myelin sheaths of the white matter of the brain.

terms.name: Chronic axonal neuropathy
terms.definition: An abnormality characterized by chronic impairment of the normal functioning of the axons.

terms.name: Spinal muscular atrophy
terms.definition: Muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.

terms.name: Atypical absence seizure
terms.definition: An atypical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by interruption of ongoing activities and reduced responsiveness. In comparison to a typical absence seizure, changes in tone may be more pronounced, onset and/or cessation may be less abrupt, and the duration of the ictus and post-ictal recovery may be longer. Although not always available, an EEG often demonstrates slow (<3 Hz), irregular, generalized spike-wave activity.

terms.name: Recurrent bacterial meningitis
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to bacterial meningitis as manifested by a medical history of recurrent episodes of bacterial meningitis.

terms.name: Paucity of anterior horn motor neurons
Acute infantile spinal muscular atrophy
terms.name_zh: 急性婴儿型脊髓性肌萎缩症

terms.name: Developmental stagnation
terms.definition: A cessation of the development of a child in the areas of motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and/or emotional skills.

terms.name: Facial palsy secondary to cranial hyperostosis
terms.name_zh: 颅骨肥厚致面神经麻痹
synonyms: Facial palsy caused by enlargement of cranial bones
Facial palsy caused by excessive growth of facial bones
Facial palsy caused by overgrowth of cranial bones
Facial palsy secondary to hypertrophy of cranial bones
terms.definition: Paralysis of the facial nerves on the basis of overgrowth of the cranial bones causing impingement upon the seventh cranial nerve.

terms.name: Horizontal jerk nystagmus
terms.definition: Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements, in which the movement in one direction is faster than in the other.

terms.name: Limb fasciculations
terms.definition: Fasciculations affecting the musculature of the arms and legs.

terms.name: Posterior fossa cyst
terms.definition: A discrete posterior fossa cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) collection that does not communicate directly with the fourth ventricle.

terms.name: Chaotic rapid conjugate ocular movements
terms.name_zh: 紊乱性快速共轭眼球运动

terms.name: Dysfunction of lateral corticospinal tracts
terms.name_zh: 皮质脊髓侧束功能障碍

terms.name: Oromotor apraxia
terms.definition: Oral-motor apraxia is the inability to volitionally sequence oral movements of the speech structure for nonspeech tasks in the absence of neuromuscular deficits such as paralysis or muscle weakness. Oral-motor apraxia is diagnosed when, despite intact sensory motor function an individual is unable to use these effector systems under voluntary control.

terms.name: Bipolar affective disorder
terms.definition: Bipolar disorder is an illness of mood characterized by alternating episodes of elevated and depressed moods, which are interspersed with euthymic periods.

terms.name: CNS demyelination
terms.definition: A loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Rapid neurologic deterioration
terms.definition: Loss of neurological function in a time frame that is considered relatively quick, for instance, loss of a develomental milestone or substantial exacerbation of neurological complications such as seizures or feeding difficulties within a few months.

terms.name: Deep white matter hypodensities
terms.definition: Multiple areas of darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the deep cerebral white matter.

terms.name: Generalized dystonia
terms.definition: A type of dystonia that affects all or most of the body.

terms.name: Mixed demyelinating and axonal polyneuropathy
terms.name_zh: 混合性脱髓鞘轴索性多发性神经病

terms.name: Impaired pain sensation
terms.definition: Reduced ability to perceive painful stimuli.

terms.name: Frontoethmoidal encephalocele
terms.definition: A type of anterior encephalocele in which there is a protrusion of the contents of the skull through a breach at the point where the frontal and ethmoidal bones meet. Frontoethmoidal encephalocele can be divided further into three distinct categories: nasofrontal, nasoethmoidal, and nasoorbital.

terms.name: Focal hemifacial clonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性偏侧面肌阵挛发作
terms.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the frontal lobes
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the frontal lobe of the cerebrum.

terms.name: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with focal onset
terms.name_zh: 局灶起始双侧强直-阵挛发作
synonyms: Generalised tonic-clonic seizure with focal onset
Generalised tonic-clonic seizure with partial onset
Generalised tonic-clonic seizures with focal onset
Generalized tonic-clonic seizure with focal onset
Generalized tonic-clonic seizure with partial onset
Generalized tonic-clonic seizures with focal onset
terms.definition: A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with focal onset is a focal-onset seizure which progresses into a bilateral tonic-clonic phase.

terms.name: Recurrent encephalopathy
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of brain dysfunction that may be triggered by factors such as metabolic disturbances or infections.

terms.name: Hypermetric saccades
terms.definition: A saccade that overshoots the target with the dynamic saccade.

terms.name: Lower limb muscle weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the muscles of the legs.

terms.name: Diffuse swelling of cerebral white matter
Abnormal morphology of the limbic system
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the limbic system, a set of midline structures surrounding the brainstem of the mammalian brain, originally described anatomically, e.g., hippocampal formation, amygdala, hypothalamus, cingulate cortex. Although the original designation was anatomical, the limbic system has come to be associated with the system in the brain subserving emotional functions. As such, it is very poorly defined and doesn't correspond closely to the anatomical meaning any longer. [BirnLex].

terms.name: Atrophy/Degeneration involving the spinal cord
synonyms: Atrophic and degenerative changes in the spinal cord

terms.name: Upper limb hyperreflexia
terms.definition: Increased intensity of the a reflex in the arm.

terms.name: Upper limb postural tremor
terms.definition: A type of tremors that is triggered by holding an arm in a fixed position.

terms.name: Focal-onset seizure
synonyms: Seizure affecting one half of brain
terms.definition: A focal-onset seizure is a type of seizure originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. They may be discretely localized or more widely distributed, and may originate in subcortical structures.

terms.name: Abnormal pons morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the pons.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the pyramidal tract
terms.name_zh: 锥体束发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the corticospinal tracts
terms.name_zh: 皮质脊髓束发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Atrophy/Degeneration affecting the central nervous system
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统萎缩/变性

terms.name: Atrophy/Degeneration affecting the cerebrum
terms.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebrum, also known as the telencephalon, the largest and most highly developed part of the human brain.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the corpus callosum
synonyms: Complete or partial absence of the corpus callosum
Hypoplasia or absence of the corpus callosum
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the corpus callosum.

terms.name: Corpus callosum atrophy
terms.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the corpus callosum.

terms.name: Motor neuron atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting involving the motor neuron.

terms.name: Abnormal septum pellucidum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the septum pellucidum, which is a thin, triangular, vertical membrane separating the lateral ventricles of the brain.

terms.name: Abnormal choroid plexus morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the choroid plexus, which is the area in the cerebral ventricles in which cerebrospinal fluid is produced by modified ependymal cells.

terms.name: Abnormality of somatosensory evoked potentials
terms.definition: An abnormality of somatosensory evoked potentials (SSEP), i.e., of the electrical signals of sensation going from the body to the brain in response to a defined stimulus. Recording electrodes are placed over the scalp, spine, and peripheral nerves proximal to the stimulation site. Clinical studies generally use electrical stimulation of peripheral nerves to elicit potentials. SSEP testing determines whether peripheral sensory nerves are able to transmit sensory information like pain, temperature, and touch to the brain. Abnormal SSEPs can result from dysfunction at the level of the peripheral nerve, plexus, spinal root, spinal cord, brain stem, thalamocortical projections, or primary somatosensory cortex.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the gastrointestinal tract
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the genitourinary tract
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the genitourinary system.

terms.name: Facial telangiectasia
terms.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin of the face.

terms.name: Congenital localized absence of skin
terms.name_zh: 先天性局限性皮肤缺损

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita of scalp
terms.name_zh: 头皮先天性皮肤发育不全
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin on the scalp.

terms.name: Hypoplastic sweat glands
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the sweat glands.

terms.name: Postnatal-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma
terms.definition: A type of ichthyosiform erythroderma with postnatal onset.

terms.name: Early cutaneous photosensitivity
synonyms: Sun sensitivity occurring early in life
terms.definition: Photosensitivity of the skin occurring early in life.

terms.name: Axillary apocrine gland hypoplasia
terms.name_zh: 腋窝顶泌汗腺发育不全
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the apocrine sweat glands in the region of the axilla.

terms.name: Asymmetric, linear skin defects
terms.name_zh: 不对称性线状皮肤缺损

terms.name: Macular atrophy
terms.definition: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells in the macula.

terms.name: Areas of hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation that do not follow Blaschko lines
terms.name_zh: 不沿Blaschko线分布的色素减退及色素沉着区

terms.name: Nonepidermolytic palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin on the palms and soles charactersized by hyperkeratosis of the stratum corneum with no evidence of epidermolysis characteristic of epidermolytic hyperkeratosis.

terms.name: Excessive skin wrinkling on dorsum of hands and fingers
terms.name_zh: 手背及手指皮肤皱纹过多
synonyms: Excessive skin wrinkling on back of hands and fingers

terms.name: Tegumentary leishmaniasis susceptibility
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection by the protozan parasite of the genus Leishmania.

terms.name: Palmoplantar hyperhidrosis
synonyms: Excessive sweating of palms and soles
terms.definition: An abnormally increased perspiration on palms and soles.

terms.name: Nevus flammeus of the forehead
terms.definition: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the forehead.

terms.name: Neonatal wrinkled skin of hands and feet
synonyms: Wrinkled skin of hands and feet in newborn

terms.name: Discoid lupus rash
terms.definition: Cutaneous lesion that develops as a dry, scaly, red patch that evolves to an indurated and hyperpigmented plaque with adherent scale. Scarring may result in central white patches (loss of pigmentation) and skin atrophy.

terms.name: Alopecia totalis
terms.definition: Loss of all scalp hair.

terms.name: Spontaneous hematomas
terms.definition: Spontaneous development of hematomas (hematoma) or bruises without significant trauma.

terms.name: Telangiectases of the cheeks
terms.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin of the cheeks.

terms.name: Telangiectasia of the oral mucosa
synonyms: Angioectasia of the oral mucous membrane
Spider veins of the oral mucosa
Telangiectasia of the oral mucous membrane
terms.definition: Telangiectasia (that is, the presence of small dilated superficial blood vessels) of the oral mucosa.

terms.name: Few cafe-au-lait spots
terms.definition: The presence of two to five cafe-au-lait macules.

terms.name: Generalized edema
terms.definition: Generalized abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin, or in one or more cavities of the body.

terms.name: Congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma
terms.name_zh: 先天性鱼鳞病样红皮病
terms.definition: An ichthyosiform abnormality of the skin with congenital onset.

terms.name: Intermittent generalized erythematous papular rash
terms.name_zh: 间歇性泛发性红斑丘疹

terms.name: Plaque-like facial hemangioma
terms.definition: Hemangioma is a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells. This term refers to facial hemangiomas that have a plaque-like morphology.

terms.name: Multiple cutaneous leiomyomas
terms.definition: The presence of multiple leiomyomas of the skin.

terms.name: Mottled pigmentation of the trunk and proximal extremities
terms.name_zh: 躯干及近端肢体斑驳样色素沉着

terms.name: Partial albinism
synonyms: Congenital partial albinism on face, trunk, or limbs
terms.definition: Absence of melanin pigment in various areas, which is found at birth and is permanent. The lesions are known as leucoderma and are often found on the face, trunk, or limbs.

terms.name: Palmoplantar blistering
terms.definition: A type of blistering that affects the skin of the palms of the hands and the soles of the feet.

terms.name: Diffuse palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Diffuse abnormal thickening of the skin on the palms and soles.

terms.name: Increased groin pigmentation with raindrop depigmentation
terms.name_zh: 腹股沟色素沉着伴雨点样色素脱失

terms.name: Ipsilateral lack of facial sweating
terms.definition: Inability to sweat on the same side of the face that is affected by ptosis and miosis. This is a feature of Horner syndrome.

terms.name: Flexural lichenification
terms.definition: Lichenification affecting primarily flexural areas of the skin.

terms.name: Prominent veins on trunk
terms.definition: Prominent thoracic and abdominal veins.

terms.name: Autoamputation of digits
terms.definition: The spontaneous detachment of a digit (finger or toe) from the body due to long standing pathology.

terms.name: Bitot spots of the conjunctiva
terms.definition: Keratinization of the bulbar conjunctiva near the limbus (corneoscleral junction), resulting in a raised spot.

terms.name: Sparse facial hair
terms.definition: Reduced number or density of facial hair.

terms.name: Honeycomb palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin on the palms and soles with an honeycomb pattern.

terms.name: Perifollicular hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Increased amount of keratin (visible as white scales) surrounding hair follicles.

terms.name: Palmoplantar cutis gyrata
synonyms: Cutis gyrata of palms and soles
terms.definition: Cutis gyrata of palms and soles.

terms.name: Periarticular subcutaneous nodules
terms.definition: Subcutaneous nodules that are located in the vicinity of joints.

terms.name: Axillary and groin hyperpigmentation and hypopigmentation
terms.name_zh: 腋窝腹股沟色素沉着及减退

terms.name: Congenital bullous ichthyosiform erythroderma
terms.name_zh: 先天性大疱性鱼鳞病样红皮病
terms.definition: An ichthyosiform abnormality of the skin that presents at birth or shortly thereafter with generalized erythema, blistering, erosions, and peeling. In the subsequent months, erythema and blistering improves but patients go on to develop hyperkeratotic scaling that is especially prominent along the joint flexures, neck, hands and feet.

terms.name: Anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia
terms.name_zh: 无汗性外胚层发育不良

terms.name: Abnormal dermatoglyphics
terms.definition: An abnormality of dermatoglyphs (fingerprints), which are present on fingers, palms, toes, and soles.

terms.name: Congenital nonbullous ichthyosiform erythroderma
terms.name_zh: 先天性非大疱性鱼鳞病样红皮病
terms.definition: The term collodion baby applies to newborns who appear to have an extra layer of skin (known as a collodion membrane) that has a collodion-like quality. It is a descriptive term, not a specific diagnosis or disorder (as such, it is a syndrome). Affected babies are born in a collodion membrane, a shiny waxy outer layer to the skin. This is shed 10-14 days after birth, revealing the main symptom of the disease, extensive scaling of the skin caused by hyperkeratosis. With increasing age, the scaling tends to be concentrated around joints in areas such as the groin, the armpits, the inside of the elbow and the neck. The scales often tile the skin and may resemble fish scales.

terms.name: Decreased sweating due to autonomic dysfunction
terms.name_zh: 自主神经功能障碍性出汗减少

terms.name: Depigmentation/hyperpigmentation of skin
terms.name_zh: 皮肤色素减退/色素沉着

terms.name: Absence of subcutaneous fat
synonyms: Lack of fatty tissue below the skin
terms.definition: Lack of subcutaneous adipose tissue.

terms.name: Diffuse telangiectasia
terms.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) with a diffuse localization.

terms.name: Linear arrays of macular hyperkeratoses in flexural areas
terms.name_zh: 屈侧部位线状斑状角化过度

terms.name: Discrete 2 to 5-mm hyper- and hypopigmented macules
terms.name_zh: 散在2-5mm色素沉着与减退斑

terms.name: Focal friction-related palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
terms.name_zh: 局灶性摩擦相关性掌跖角化过度
terms.definition: Hyperkeratosis affecting the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot in areas exposed to friction.

terms.name: Recurrent staphylococcal infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to staphylococcal infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of staphylococcal infections.

terms.name: Decreased number of sweat glands
terms.definition: The presence of fewer than normal sweat glands.

terms.name: Streaks of hyperkeratosis along each finger onto the palm
Follicular hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: A skin condition characterized by excessive development of keratin in hair follicles, resulting in rough, cone-shaped, elevated papules resulting from closure of hair follicles with a white plug of sebum.

terms.name: Congenital absence of skin of limbs
synonyms: Missing skin on limbs since birth

terms.name: Punctate palmar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Tiny bumps of thickened skin (hyperkeratosis) on the palms of the hands.

terms.name: Focal dermal aplasia/hypoplasia
terms.name_zh: 局灶性皮肤发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Mottled pigmentation of photoexposed areas
terms.name_zh: 光暴露部位斑驳样色素沉着

terms.name: Edema of the dorsum of hands
synonyms: Oedema of the dorsum of hands
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the hands.

terms.name: Hypoplastic pilosebaceous units
terms.name_zh: 毛囊皮脂腺单位发育不全

terms.name: Redundant skin on fingers
terms.definition: Loose and sagging skin of the fingers.

terms.name: Palmoplantar cutis laxa
synonyms: Excessive wrinkled skin of palms and soles
Increased wrinkles of palms and soles
Wrinkled skin of hands and feet
terms.definition: Loose, wrinkled skin of hands and feet.

terms.name: Yellow subcutaneous tissue covered by thin, scaly skin
Hypopigmented skin patches on arms
synonyms: Patchy loss of skin color on arms
Patchy loss of skin colour on arms

terms.name: Hidrotic ectodermal dysplasia
terms.name_zh: 出汗性外胚层发育不良

terms.name: Congenital posterior occipital alopecia
terms.definition: Loss of hair in the occipital region of the scalp with congenital onset.

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita of midline scalp vertex
terms.name_zh: 中线头顶先天性皮肤发育不全

terms.name: Severe photosensitivity
terms.definition: A severe degree of photosensitivity of the skin.

terms.name: Frontal cutaneous lipoma
terms.definition: Presence of a cutaneous lipoma on the forehead.

terms.name: Absent pigmentation of the ventral chest
terms.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the anterior chest.

terms.name: Piebald skin depigmentation
terms.definition: Congenital large depigmented (white) macule of irergular rhomboid shape. Piebald skin depigmentation generally presents with multiple such macules in the affected individual. There may be smaller (5-15mm), discrete, skin-colored and hyperpigmented macules interspersed within the depigmented macules.

terms.name: Congenital palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin on the palms and soles that is present at birth.

terms.name: Desquamation of skin soon after birth
Hypohidrosis or hyperhidrosis
synonyms: Lack of sweating or excessive sweating

terms.name: Abnormal subcutaneous fat tissue distribution
terms.name_zh: 皮下脂肪组织分布异常
synonyms: Abnormal fat tissue distribution below the skin

terms.name: Congenital symmetrical palmoplantar keratosis
terms.name_zh: 先天性对称性掌跖角化病

terms.name: Confetti hypopigmentation pattern of lower leg skin
terms.name_zh: 小腿皮肤纸屑样色素减退模式
synonyms: Confetti hypopigmentation pattern of lower leg skin

terms.name: Plantar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Hyperkeratosis affecting the sole of the foot.

terms.name: Localized epidermolytic hyperkeratosis
terms.name_zh: 局限性表皮松解性角化过度

terms.name: Multiple cafe-au-lait spots
terms.definition: The presence of six or more cafe-au-lait spots.

terms.name: Generalized seborrheic dermatitis
terms.definition: Seborrheic dermatitis that is not localized to any one particular region.

terms.name: Hyperkeratosis lenticularis perstans
terms.name_zh: 持久性豆状角化过度症
terms.definition: Hyperkeratosis lenticularis perstans (HLP), also known as Flegel disease, is a keratinization abnormality characterized by small, asymptomatic erythematous papules that leave characteristic punctate bleeding when they become detached. The lesions generally occur symmetrically along the top of the foot and on the legs, appearing more rarely on the arms, forearms, palms, and soles, and even on the oral mucosa.

terms.name: Late onset atopic dermatitis
terms.definition: A form of atopic dermatitis with onset in adulthood characterized by atopic red face, chronic lichenified eczema on the trunk, subacute or psoriasiform dermatitis.

terms.name: Generalized bronze hyperpigmentation
terms.name_zh: 全身性青铜色色素沉着

terms.name: Palmar neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the palm of the hand.

terms.name: Mediosternal, longitudinal streak of hypopigmentation
terms.name_zh: 胸骨正中纵向色素减退条纹

terms.name: Reticular hyperpigmentation
terms.definition: Increased pigmentation of the skin with a netlike (reticular) pattern.

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita on trunk or limbs
terms.name_zh: 躯干或四肢先天性皮肤发育不全
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin on the trunk or the limbs.

terms.name: Aplasia cutis congenita over posterior parietal area
terms.name_zh: 顶后区先天性皮肤发育不全

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the eccrine sweat glands
terms.name_zh: 外泌汗腺发育不全/缺如
terms.definition: Absence or developmental hypoplasia of the eccrine sweat glands.

terms.name: Painful subcutaneous lipomas
synonyms: Painful noncancerous fat tissue tumor under the skin
Painful noncancerous fat tissue tumour under the skin
terms.definition: The presence of multiple subcutaneous lipoma that cause pain.

terms.name: Bilateral single transverse palmar creases
terms.definition: The distal and proximal transverse palmar creases are merged into a single transverse palmar crease on both hands.

terms.name: Generalized reticulate brown pigmentation
terms.name_zh: 全身性网状棕色色素沉着

terms.name: Hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia
terms.name_zh: 少汗性外胚层发育不良

terms.name: Hypoproteinemic edema
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin, or in one or more cavities of the body because of decreased osmotic pressure of plasma (hypoproteinemia).

terms.name: Spinous keratoses of palms and soles
Nevus flammeus nuchae
terms.definition: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the neck. This is one of the most common birthmarks and present in approximately 25% of all newborns.

terms.name: Subcutaneous calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in subcutaneous tissue (i.e., the the lowermost layer of the integument).

terms.name: Cutaneous leiomyoma
terms.definition: The presence of leiomyoma of the skin.

terms.name: Mandibular osteomyelitis
terms.definition: Osteomyelitis of the lower jaw.

terms.name: Mandibular condyle aplasia
synonyms: Agenesis of condylar head of mandible
Agenesis of condylar neck of mandible
Agenesis of condylar process of mandible
Underdevelopment of condylar process of mandible

terms.name: Mandibular condyle hypoplasia
synonyms: Decreased size of condylar process of mandible
Hypoplasia of condylar process of mandible
Hypoplasia of subcondylar region of mandible

terms.name: Bilateral microphthalmos
synonyms: Abnormally small eyeball on both sides
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of both eyes.

terms.name: Nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
terms.definition: An acute condition characterized by sudden visual loss (usually discovered in the morning), optic disc edema at onset, optic disc-related visual field defects. Nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy can be associated with flame hemorrhages on the swollen disk or nearby neuroretinal layer, and sometimes with nearby cotton-wool exudates.

terms.name: Dyschromatopsia
terms.definition: A form of colorblindness in which only two of the three fundamental colors can be distinguished due to a lack of one of the retinal cone pigments.

terms.name: Early-onset non-progressive night blindness
terms.definition: A usually nonprogressive (i.e., stationary) form of night blindness with early (presumed to be congenital) onset.

terms.name: Peripheral tractional retinal detachment
synonyms: Tractional retinal detachment at the periphery of the retina
terms.definition: Tractional retinal detachment at the periphery of the retina.

terms.name: Absent lower eyelashes
synonyms: Failure of development of lower eyelashes
terms.definition: Lack of eyelashes on the lower lid.

terms.name: Congenital extraocular muscle anomaly
terms.definition: Congenital abnormality of the extraocular muscles.
