terms.name: Punctate cataract
terms.definition: A type of cataract with punctate opacities of the lens.

terms.name: Congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
terms.name_zh: 先天性视网膜色素上皮肥厚
terms.definition: Sharply demarcated, congenital hyperpigmentation of the retinal pigment epithelium. It can be solitary, clustered or multifocal, uni- or bilateral.

terms.name: Eversion of lateral third of lower eyelids
Lacrimal gland aplasia
terms.definition: A congenital defect of development characterized by absence of the lacrimal gland.

terms.name: Diffuse nuclear cataract
terms.definition: Opacity of the entire lens nucleus.

terms.name: Abnormality of chorioretinal pigmentation
terms.name_zh: 脉络膜视网膜色素沉着异常

terms.name: Curly eyelashes
terms.definition: Abnormally curly or curved eyelashes.

terms.name: Peripheral cystoid retinal degeneration
terms.definition: Degenerative changes of the peripheral retina consisting of close-packed tiny cystic spaces at the outer plexiform/inner nuclear retinal level. The degeneration is common in adult eyes and starts adjacent to the ora serrata and extends circumferentially and posteriorly.

terms.name: Abnormal vestibulo-ocular reflex
terms.definition: An abnormality of the vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR). The VOR attempts to keep the image stable on the retina. Ideally passive or active head movements in one direction are compensated for by eye movements of equal magnitude.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the iris
terms.definition: Congenital underdevelopment of the iris.

terms.name: Vitelliform macular lesion
terms.definition: Egg yolk-like (vitelliform) maculopathy is a lesion caused by the accumulation of material, often lipofuscin, in the subretinal space underlying the macula. Lesions may be singular or multiple, and may be either sharply or poorly demarcated.

terms.name: Lacrimal duct stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing of a tear duct (lacrimal duct).

terms.name: Avascular peripheral retina
terms.definition: Incomplete peripheral vascular development.

terms.name: Abnormal pupillary function
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of the pupil.

terms.name: Unilateral ptosis
terms.definition: A unilateral form of ptosis.

terms.name: Undetectable light- and dark-adapted electroretinogram
synonyms: Absent cone and rod functions by electroretinogram
Absent rod-and cone-mediated responses on ERG
terms.definition: Absence of the combined rod-and-cone response on electroretinogram.

terms.name: Map-dot-fingerprint corneal dystrophy
terms.name_zh: 地图-点状-指纹状角膜营养不良

terms.name: Abnormal pupillary light reflex
terms.definition: An abnormality of the reflex that controls the diameter of the pupil, in response to the intensity of light that falls on the retina of the eye.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the lower eyelids
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the lower eyelid.

terms.name: Ocular anterior segment dysgenesis
terms.definition: Abnormal development (dysgenesis) of the anterior segment of the eye globe. These structures are mainly of mesenchymal origin.

terms.name: Abnormal retinal pigmentation
synonyms: Abnormality of the retinal pigment epithelium
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal pigmentation of the retina.

terms.name: Paroxysmal involuntary eye movements
terms.definition: Sudden-onset episode of abnormal, involuntary eye movements.

terms.name: Congenital aphakia
terms.definition: Absence of the crystalline lens of the eye as a result of a developmental defect.

terms.name: Band-shaped corneal dystrophy
terms.definition: A type of genetically determined disease of the cornea with corneal lesions with a band-like shape.

terms.name: Uveal melanoma
terms.definition: A malignant melanoma originating within the eye. The tumor originates from the melanocytes in the uvea (which comprises the iris, ciliary body, and choroid).

terms.name: Chronic irritative conjunctivitis
terms.definition: A chronic irritative conjunctivitis, which commonly presents with general irritation and redness of the eyes, with a burning, dry, or foreign-body sensation of the eyes.

terms.name: Flat cornea
terms.definition: Cornea plana is an abnormally flat shape of the cornea such that the normal protrusion of the cornea from the sclera is missing. The reduced corneal curvature can lead to hyperopia, and a hazy corneal limbus and arcus lipoides may develop at an early age.

terms.name: Saccular conjunctival dilatations
terms.definition: Presence of multiple dilatations (sac-like outpouchings) in the blood vessels of the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Retinal pigment epithelial atrophy
terms.definition: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE).

terms.name: Opacification of the corneal epithelium
terms.definition: Lack of transparency of the corneal epithelium.

terms.name: Congenital miosis
terms.definition: Abnormal (non-physiological) constriction of the pupil of congenital onset.

terms.name: Iris hypopigmentation
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation of the iris.

terms.name: Chorioretinal dysplasia
terms.name_zh: 脉络膜视网膜发育不良
terms.definition: Abnormal development of the choroid and retina.

terms.name: Lacrimal gland hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the lacrimal gland.

terms.name: Enlarged lacrimal glands
terms.definition: Abnormally big lacrimal glands.

terms.name: Spicular pigmentation of the retina
synonyms: Bone spicule pigmentation of the retina
terms.definition: Pigment migration into the retina in a bone-spicule configuration (resembling the nucleated cells within the lacuna of bone).

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the fovea
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the fovea centralis.

terms.name: Macular dystrophy
terms.definition: Macular dystrophy is a nonspecific term for retinal degeneration, generally confined to the macula, usually presumed of genetic origin.

terms.name: Juvenile epithelial corneal dystrophy
terms.name_zh: 幼年型角膜上皮营养不良

terms.name: Opacification of the corneal stroma
terms.definition: Reduced transparency of the stroma of cornea.

terms.name: Pericentral scotoma
terms.definition: A scotoma (area of diminished vision within the visual field) that surrounds the central fixation point.

terms.name: Retinal telangiectasia
terms.definition: Localized, irregular dilatation of small tortuous intraretinal blood vessels.

terms.name: Deep anterior chamber
terms.definition: Increased depth of the anterior chamber, i.e., the anteroposterior distance between the cornea and the iris is increased.

terms.name: Optic disc hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the optic disc, that is of the optic nerve head, where ganglion cell axons exit the eye to form the optic nerve.

terms.name: Central retinal vessel vascular tortuosity
terms.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of retinal blood vessels (arteries, arterioles, veins, venules).

terms.name: Peripheral retinal degeneration
terms.definition: Progressive loss of peripheral retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and/or neurosensory retinal cells.

terms.name: Impaired smooth pursuit
terms.definition: An impairment of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.

terms.name: Vitreoretinopathy
terms.definition: Ocular abnormality characterized by premature degeneration of the vitreous and the retina that may be associated with increased risk of retinal detachment.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the ciliary body
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ciliary body.

terms.name: Chorioretinal scar
terms.definition: Fibrous connective tissue resulting from incomplete healing of a wound (i.e., a scar) located in the choroid and retina or the eye.

terms.name: Posterior retinal neovascularization
synonyms: Neovascularization of peripheral and posterior retina
terms.definition: A type of retinal neovascularization that affects the posterior pole of the retina.

terms.name: Cortical pulverulent cataract
terms.definition: A type of cataract characterized by punctate, dust-like opacities within the cortical region of the lens.

terms.name: Posterior subcapsular cataract
synonyms: Posterior subcapsular opacities of the lens
terms.definition: A type of cataract affecting the posterior pole of lens immediately adjacent to ('beneath') the Lens capsule.

terms.name: Patchy atrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium
terms.definition: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) that occurs in small, isolated areas.

terms.name: Granular macular appearance
terms.definition: Mottled (spotted or blotched with different shades) pigmentary abnormality of the macula.

terms.name: Anterior cortical cataract
terms.definition: A cataract that affects the anterior part of the cortex of the lens.

terms.name: Developmental retinal vascular malformation
terms.name_zh: 发育性视网膜血管畸形
terms.definition: A group of development abnormalities of retinal blood vessels.

terms.name: Conjunctival whitish salt-like deposits
terms.definition: The presence of whitish deposits in the conjunctiva resembling salt. May be related to calcinosis.

terms.name: Increased axial length of the globe
synonyms: Increased front to back length of eyeball
terms.definition: Abnormal largeness of the eye with an axial length > 2.5 standard deviations from population mean.

terms.name: Granular corneal dystrophy
terms.definition: The presence of central, fine, whitish granular lesions in the stroma of the cornea. This type of corneal dystrophy is usually asymptomatic and begins in childhood and shows a slow progression. Later in the course, the corneal epithelium and Bowman's layer may be affected. Histologically, the cornea shows a uniform deposition of hyaline material.

terms.name: Monochromacy
terms.definition: Complete color blindness, a complete inability to distinguish colors. Affected persons cannot perceive colors, but only shades of gray.

terms.name: Horizontal pendular nystagmus
terms.definition: Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements of equal velocity.

terms.name: Herpetiform corneal ulceration
terms.definition: The presence of one or more dendritic corneal epithelial ulcers characterized by a treelike branching linear pattern with feathery edges and terminal bulbs. Herpetiform corneal ulcers can be identified by fluorescein staining.

terms.name: Nongranulomatous uveitis
terms.definition: A form of uveitis that is not associated with the formation of granulomas.

terms.name: Retinal pigment epithelial mottling
synonyms: Focal hypopigmentation of the retinal pigment epithelium
terms.definition: Mottling (spots or blotches of different shades) of the retinal pigment epithelium, i.e., localized or generalized fundus pigment granularity associated with processes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium.

terms.name: Horizontal supranuclear gaze palsy
terms.definition: A supranuclear gaze palsy is an inability to look in a horizontal direction as a result of cerebral impairment. There is a loss of the voluntary aspect of eye movements, but, as the brainstem is still intact, all the reflex conjugate eye movements are normal.

terms.name: Central heterochromia
terms.definition: The presence of distinct colors in the central (pupillary) zone of the iris than in the mid-peripheral (ciliary) zone.

terms.name: Presenile cataracts
terms.definition: Presenile cataract is a kind of cataract that occurs in early adulthood, that is, at an age that is younger than usual.

terms.name: Lacrimal punctal atresia
terms.definition: Congenital absence or closure of the opening of the lacrimal punctum.

terms.name: Total ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: Paralysis of both the extrinsic and intrinsic ocular muscles.

terms.name: Adult-onset night blindness
terms.definition: Inability to see well at night or in poor light with onset in adulthood.

terms.name: Nonprogressive restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: Nonprogressive restriction of movement of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position. Residual eye movements are significantly limited.

terms.name: Progressive cataract
terms.definition: A kind of cataract that progresses with age.

terms.name: Mosaic corneal dystrophy
terms.name_zh: 马赛克样角膜营养不良

terms.name: Progressive ptosis
terms.definition: A progressive form of ptosis.

terms.name: Long upper eyelashes
terms.definition: Increased length of the upper eyelashes.

terms.name: Amyloid deposition in the vitreous humor
synonyms: Amyloid deposition in the vitreous humour
terms.definition: Deposition of hyaline extracellular material (amyloid) into the vitreous humor, which can manifest as vitreous opacities and reduced visual acuity.

terms.name: Attenuation of retinal blood vessels
synonyms: Narrowing of blood vessels in back of eye
terms.definition: Narrowing of the retinal blood vessels, both arterioles and venules.

terms.name: Punctate opacification of the cornea
terms.definition: Punctate opacification (reduced transparency) of the corneal stroma.

terms.name: Chorioretinal lacunae
terms.definition: Punched out lesions in the pigmented layer of the retina.

terms.name: Congenital horizontal nystagmus
terms.name_zh: 先天性水平性眼球震颤
terms.definition: Horizontal nystagmus dating from or present at birth.

terms.name: Retinal calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the retina.

terms.name: Restrictive partial external ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: Fibrosis of only some of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position.

terms.name: Choroidal hemangioma
terms.definition: Benign choroidal tumour, seen in the fundus as a reddish or orange choroidal lesion and usually associated with cystoid edema, and less commonly with Subretinal fluid.

terms.name: Almond-shaped palpebral fissure
terms.definition: A shape created by an acute downward arching of the upper eyelid and upward arching of the lower eyelid, toward the medial canthus, which gives the outline of the palpebral fissures the configuration of an almond. Thus, the maximum distance between the fissures is offset from, and medial to, the center point.

terms.name: Congenital blindness
terms.definition: Blindness with onset at birth.

terms.name: Allergic conjunctivitis
terms.definition: Allergic Conjunctivitis is an allergic inflammation of the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Slowed horizontal saccades
terms.definition: An abnormally slow velocity of horizontal saccadic eye movements.

terms.name: Absent extraocular muscles
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the extraocular muscles.

terms.name: Iridescent posterior subcapsular cataract
terms.definition: A type of posterior subcapsular cataract characterized by an iridescent color.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the lacrimal punctum
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the lacrimal puncta.

terms.name: Fundus hypopigmentation
terms.definition: Generalized or focal reduced pigmentation of the fundus, evaluated in the context of skin and hair color. Fundoscopy may reveal a low level pigment.

terms.name: Retinal nonattachment
terms.definition: Retinal nonattachment is a developmental (congenital) condition in which persistent fetal blood vessels appear to proliferate more dramatically during infancy, causing complete perinatal detachment of the retina. This may occur during or shortly after neurogenesis, since the pathology is apparent at birth, and it may have a tractional basis, involving fibrovascular strands between the retina, posterior lens and hyaloid vessels.

terms.name: Vitreous hemorrhage
terms.definition: Bleeding within the vitreous compartment of the eye.

terms.name: Paravenous chorioretinal atrophy
terms.definition: Chorioretinal atrophy along the retinal veins.

terms.name: Ocular hypertension
terms.definition: Intraocular pressure that is 2 standard deviations above the population mean.

terms.name: Congenital bilateral ptosis
synonyms: Congenital drooping of both upper eyelids

terms.name: Reticular retinal dystrophy
terms.definition: A type of of patterned retinal dystrophy that shows a reticular pattern of pigmentation.

terms.name: Polymorphous posterior corneal dystrophy
terms.definition: This corneal dystrophy affects the posterior limiting membrane of the cornea and is characterized by polymorphous plaques of calcium deposits in the deep stromal layers of the cornea, and occasionally by vesicular lesions of the endothelium and edema of the deep corneal stroma.

terms.name: Tractional retinal detachment
terms.definition: A type of retinal detachment arising due to a combination of contracting retinal membranes, abnormal vitreoretinal adhesions, and vitreous changes, in the absence of a full-thickness retinal defect.

terms.name: Hypermyelinated retinal nerve fibers
terms.name_zh: 视网膜神经纤维髓鞘过度
terms.definition: Myelinated retinal nerve fiber (MRNF) layer is a rare and mostly benign congenital anomaly in which the retinal nerve fibers anterior to the lamina cribrosa have a myelin sheath.

terms.name: Slow decrease in visual acuity
synonyms: Slow decrease in sharpness of vision

terms.name: Lacrimal duct aplasia
terms.definition: A congenital defect resulting in absence of the lacrimal duct.

terms.name: Abnormal flash visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 闪光视觉诱发电位异常
terms.definition: Anomaly of the visual evoked potentials elicited by a flash stimulus, generally a flash of light subtending an angle of at least 20 degrees of the visual field and presented in a dimly lit room.

terms.name: Peripheral retinal detachment
terms.definition: Separation of the inner layers of the retina (neural retina) from the pigment epithelium occurring near the outer limit (periphery) of the retina.

terms.name: Bilateral congenital mydriasis
terms.definition: Congenital abnormal dilation of the pupil on both sides.

terms.name: Broad lateral eyebrow
terms.definition: Regional increase in the width (height) of the lateral eyebrow.

terms.name: Juvenile posterior subcapsular lenticular opacities
terms.name_zh: 幼年型后囊下晶状体混浊

terms.name: Restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: Fibrosis of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position. Residual eye movements are significantly limited.

terms.name: Reticular pigmentary degeneration
terms.definition: A pattern of peripheral netlike retinal pigmentation that forms a polygonal arrangement of hyperpigmented lines forming geometric patterns in the fundus.

terms.name: Blue cone monochromacy
terms.definition: A form of monochromacy in which vision is derived from the remaining preserved blue (S) cones and rod photoreceptors.

terms.name: Limited extraocular movements
terms.definition: Limited mobility of the eye within its socket.

terms.name: Internal ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: Paralysis of the iris and ciliary apparatus.

terms.name: Congenital stapes ankylosis
terms.definition: A form of stapes ankylosis with congenital onset.

terms.name: Intermittent microsaccadic pursuits
terms.name_zh: 间歇性微扫视性追随运动

terms.name: Unilateral narrow palpebral fissure
synonyms: Unequal size of opening between the eyelids
terms.definition: A fixed reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids with short palpebral fissures on one side only.

terms.name: Pericentral retinitis pigmentosa
terms.definition: A subtype of retinitis pigmentosa in which, instead of the pathology starting in the mid-periphery like typical retinitis pigmentosa, the disease starts in the near periphery closer to the vascular arcades and tends to spare the far periphery.

terms.name: Dense posterior cortical cataract
terms.definition: A type of posterior cortical cataract characterized by dense lenticular opacities.

terms.name: Peripapillary chorioretinal atrophy
terms.definition: Chorioretinal atrophy concentrated around the optic papilla (i.e., the optic nerve head).

terms.name: Corneal opacity
synonyms: Scarring or clouding of the cornea of the eye
terms.definition: A reduction of corneal clarity.

terms.name: Optic atrophy from cranial nerve compression
Pattern dystrophy of the retina
terms.definition: A spectrum of fundoscopic appearances characterized by the development of a variety of patterns of deposits predominantly in the macular area. The deposits are typically bilateral, relatively symmetrical, yellow/white and associated with changes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium. With time, retinal atrophy may occur. A number of pattern dystrophy subtypes have been described including butterfly-shaped dystrophy, reticular dystrophy (net-like pattern) and fundus pulverulentus (granular, mottled pigmentation).

terms.name: Degenerative vitreoretinopathy
terms.name_zh: 变性性玻璃体视网膜病变

terms.name: Remnants of the hyaloid vascular system
synonyms: Persistent posterior fetal fibrovascular sheath of the lens
Persistent posterior foetal fibrovascular sheath of the lens
terms.definition: Persistence of the hyaloid artery, which is the embryonic artery that runs from the optic disc to the posterior lens capsule may persist; the site of attachment may form an opacity. The hyaloid artery is a branch of the ophthalmic artery, and usually regresses completely before birth. This features results from a failure of regression of the hyaloid vessel, which supplies the primary vitreous during embryogenesis and normally regresses in the third trimester of pregnancy, leading to a particular form of posterior cataract.

terms.name: Lamellar cataract
terms.definition: A congenital cataract in which opacity is limited to layers of the lens external to the nucleus (i.e., the perinuclear region), i.e., between the nuclear and cortical layers of the lens.

terms.name: Retinal dysplasia
terms.definition: Abnormal growth and differentiation, structure and appearance of the retina present from birth.

terms.name: Hypometric horizontal saccades
terms.definition: Saccadic undershoot of horizontal saccadic eye movements, i.e., a horizontal saccadic eye movement that has less than the magnitude that would be required to gain fixation of the object.

terms.name: Cerulean cataract
terms.definition: Cerulean cataracts are a kind of congenital cataract having peripheral bluish and white opacifications in concentric layers with occasional central lesions arranged radially. Although the opacities may be observed during fetal development and childhood, usually visual acuity is only mildly reduced until adulthood, when lens extraction is generally necessary.

terms.name: Gaze-evoked horizontal nystagmus
terms.name_zh: 凝视诱发性水平眼球震颤
terms.definition: Horizontal nystagmus made apparent by looking to the right or to the left.

terms.name: Absent retinal pigment epithelium
terms.definition: Discrete areas of pallor in which the pigment epithelium, choriocapillaris and choroidal pigment are absent.

terms.name: ERG: Reduced dark-adapted b-wave amplitude
terms.name_zh: 视网膜电图示暗适应b波振幅降低
synonyms: Reduced amplitude of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram b-wave
terms.definition: A dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram in which the b-wave that is of markedly lower amplitude than the associated a-wave.

terms.name: Retinal arteriolar occlusion
terms.definition: Blockage of retinal arteriole, generally associated with interruption of blood flow and oxygen delivery to affected regions of the retina. This can affect the inner or mid-retinal structures.

terms.name: Macular hypopigmentation
terms.definition: Decreased amount of pigmentation in the macula.

terms.name: Intraretinal exudate
terms.definition: Retinal exudate within the retinal tissue itself.

terms.name: Hypoplastic iris stroma
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the stroma of iris.

terms.name: Lattice retinal degeneration
terms.definition: A pattern of white lines and dots in the far periphery of the retina.

terms.name: Malformed lacrimal duct
terms.definition: Congenital malformation of the lacrimal duct associated with incomplete development of the bony nasolacrimal canal or craniofacial anomalies.

terms.name: Peripheral visual field loss
terms.definition: Loss of peripheral vision with retention of central vision, resulting in a constricted circular tunnel-like field of vision.

terms.name: Decreased corneal reflex
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced response to stimulation of the cornea (by touch, foreign body, blowing air). The corneal reflex (also known as the blink reflex, normally results in an involuntary blinking of the eyelids.

terms.name: Foveal hyperpigmentation
terms.definition: Increased amount of pigmentation in the fovea.

terms.name: Abnormal macular pigmentation
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal, uniform distribution or appearance of pigment within the macular region of the retina.

terms.name: Peripheral opacification of the cornea
terms.definition: Reduced transparency of the peripheral region of the cornea.

terms.name: Superior lens subluxation
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the lens in a superior direction.

terms.name: Cone dystrophy
terms.definition: Inherited progressive cone degeneration.

terms.name: Cystoid macular degeneration
terms.definition: A form of macular degeneration characterized by the presence of multiple cystoid spaces in the macula.

terms.name: Posterior Y-sutural cataract
terms.definition: A type of sutural cataract in which the opacity follows the posterior Y suture.

terms.name: Abnormal iris pigmentation
terms.definition: Abnormal pigmentation of the iris.

terms.name: Absent anterior chamber of the eye
terms.definition: Absence of the anterior chamber of the eye owing to a developmental defect.

terms.name: Aplastic/hypoplastic lacrimal glands
terms.name_zh: 泪腺发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the lacrimal gland.

terms.name: Focal retinal arteriolar constriction
terms.name_zh: 局灶性视网膜小动脉收缩
terms.definition: Focal decreased retinal arteriolar diameters, which may decrease blood flow and slow oxygen delivery to regions of the retina.

terms.name: Enlarged flash visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 闪光视觉诱发电位增大

terms.name: Abnormal retinal vascular morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of retinal vasculature.

terms.name: Abnormality of the vasculature of the eye
Abnormal line of Schwalbe morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the line of Schwalbe
terms.definition: An abnormality of the line of Schwalbe.

terms.name: Abnormality of the extraocular muscles
terms.definition: An abnormality of an extraocular muscle.

terms.name: Abnormality of the palpebral fissures
synonyms: Abnormality of the opening between the eyelids
terms.definition: An anomaly of the space between the medial and lateral canthi of the two open eyelids.

terms.name: Retinal fold
terms.definition: A wrinkle of retinal tissue projecting outward from the surface of the retina and visible as a line on fundoscopy.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the iris
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the iris.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the conjunctival vasculature
terms.name_zh: 结膜脉管系统形态异常
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the conjunctiva vasculature
Abnormal vasculature of the conjunctiva morphology
Abnormality of the vasculature of the conjunctiva
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the blood vessels of the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia affecting the uvea
terms.name_zh: 葡萄膜发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the uvea, the pigmented middle layer of the eye consisting of the iris and ciliary body together with the choroid.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia affecting the fundus
terms.name_zh: 眼底发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of development or underdevelopment of the fundus/fovea.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the optic nerve
terms.name_zh: 视神经发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the macula
terms.name_zh: 黄斑发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fovea
terms.definition: Congenital absence or underdevelopment of the fovea.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the retina
terms.name_zh: 视网膜发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia affecting the anterior segment of the eye
terms.name_zh: 眼前段发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the anterior segment of the eye.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the lens
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the lens.

terms.name: Ichthyosis
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skin characterized the presence of excessive amounts of dry surface scales on the skin resulting from an abnormality of keratinization.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the skin
terms.name_zh: 皮肤发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Abnormal blistering of the skin
terms.definition: The presence of one or more bullae on the skin, defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls.

terms.name: Abnormally lax or hyperextensible skin
terms.name_zh: 皮肤异常松弛或过度伸展

terms.name: Neoplasm of the skin
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the skin.

terms.name: Sparse hair
terms.definition: Reduced density of hairs.

terms.name: Maternal hypertension
terms.definition: Increased blood pressure during a pregnancy.

terms.name: Maternal virilization in pregnancy
terms.definition: Virilization (deepening of voice, facial hirsutism and scalp hair loss) with onset during pregnancy (usually towards the end of the first trimester) and regression several months post-partum.

terms.name: Low maternal circulating estriol concentration
terms.name_zh: 母体循环雌三醇浓度降低
terms.definition: An abnormally low concentration of serum conjugated estriol as compared to normal values for gestational-age.

terms.name: Osteoporotic tarsals
terms.definition: Reduction in bone mineral density affecting any or all of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

terms.name: Absent fifth metatarsal
synonyms: Aplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone
terms.definition: A developmental abnormality characterized by the absence of the fifth metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Hallux varus
terms.definition: Medial deviation of the great toe owing to a deformity of the great toe joint causing the hallux to deviate medially.

terms.name: Pes valgus
terms.definition: An outward (valgus) deviation of the calcaneus relative to the longitudinal axis of the lower leg at the talocalcaneal (subtalar) joint, such that the heel is everted.

terms.name: 2nd-5th toe middle phalangeal hypoplasia
terms.name_zh: 第2-5趾中节趾骨发育不全

terms.name: Nonossified fifth metatarsal
terms.definition: The presence of a fifth metatarsal bone that has not undergone ossification at an age when ossification is usually visible.

terms.name: Abnormality of the fifth metatarsal bone
synonyms: Abnormality of the 5th long bone of foot
terms.definition: An anomaly of the fifth metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Short 4th toe
terms.definition: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the fourth toe.

terms.name: Widely spaced toes
terms.definition: An overall widening of the spaces between the digits.

terms.name: Osteolysis of talus
terms.definition: Osteolysis affecting the talus.

terms.name: Medially deviated second toe
terms.definition: Medial deviation of the second toe.

terms.name: Expanded metatarsals with widened medullary cavities
Delayed tarsal ossification
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

terms.name: Plantar crease between first and second toes
terms.definition: The presence of unusually deep creases (ridges/wrinkles) on the skin of sole of foot located between the first and second toe.

terms.name: Advanced tarsal ossification
terms.definition: Precocious (accelerated) maturation and calcification of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

terms.name: Plantar flexion contracture
terms.definition: A type of contracture in which the plantar flexion muscles are contracted.

terms.name: Metatarsal diaphyseal endosteal sclerosis
terms.name_zh: 跖骨干骺端骨内膜硬化
terms.definition: Osteosclerosis of the endosteal surface of the diaphyses (shafts) of the metatarsal bones.

terms.name: Clinodactyly of the 3rd toe
terms.definition: Bending or curvature of a third toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

terms.name: Flexion limitation of toes
terms.definition: Limitation of the ability to bend the toes.

terms.name: Calcaneonavicular fusion
terms.definition: Synostosis of the calcaneus with the navicular bone.

terms.name: Talipes calcaneovarus
terms.definition: A congenital deformity characterized by a dorsiflexed, inverted, and adducted foot, i.e., a combination of talipes calcaneus and talipes varus.

terms.name: Bipartite calcaneus
synonyms: Delayed coalescence of calcaneal ossification centers
Delayed coalescence of calcaneal ossification centres
terms.definition: A two-part calcaneus, a finding that probably results from delayed coalescence of two primary calcaneal centers of ossification.

terms.name: Tarsal stippling
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more tarsal bones.

terms.name: Medial rotation of the medial malleolus
terms.definition: Hindfoot valgus (posterior part of the foot turns outward) in combination with forefoot abduction (front part of the foot (the forefoot) is angled outwards away from the midline of the body, relative to the hindfoot) and lowering of the midfoot.

terms.name: Irregular tarsal ossification
terms.definition: Defective ossification in an irregular pattern of the seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

terms.name: Equinus calcaneus
terms.definition: Abnormal plantar flexion of the calcaneus relative to the longitudinal axis of the tibia. This results in the angle between the long axis of the tibia and the long axis of the heel bone (calcaneus) being greater than 90 degrees.

terms.name: Delayed calcaneal ossification
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the calcaneus.

terms.name: Impaired epinephrine-induced platelet aggregation
terms.name_zh: 肾上腺素诱导血小板聚集障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal response to epinephrine as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of epinephrine.

terms.name: Elevated serum transaminases during infections
terms.name_zh: 感染时血清转氨酶升高
terms.definition: Elevations of the levels of SGOT (serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase) and SGPT (serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase) that occur during infections.

terms.name: Prolonged prothrombin time
terms.definition: Increased time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the World Health Organization (WHO) using the formula: INR is equal to Patient PT divided by Control PT.

terms.name: Periodic hypokalemic paresis
terms.definition: Episodes of muscle weakness associated with reduced levels of potassium in the blood.

terms.name: Mucopolysacchariduria
terms.definition: Excessive amounts of mucopolysaccharide in the urine.

terms.name: Hyperapobetalipoproteinemia
terms.name_zh: 高载脂蛋白β脂蛋白血症
terms.definition: Hyperapobetalipoproteinemia is defined as the combination of a normal low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol in the face of an increased LDL apolipoprotein B (apoB) protein.

terms.name: 3-hydroxydicarboxylic aciduria
terms.definition: The concentration of 2-hydroxydicarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Absent leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
terms.name_zh: 白细胞碱性磷酸酶缺如
terms.definition: Alkaline phosphatase levels measured within leukocytes is below detectable levels.

terms.name: Asymptomatic hyperammonemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of ammonia in the blood not associated with symptoms such as encephalopathy.

terms.name: Decreased circulating cortisol level
terms.name_zh: 血循环皮质醇水平降低
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced concentration of cortisol in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased beta-galactosidase activity
synonyms: Beta-galactosidase deficiency in fibroblasts and white blood cells
terms.definition: Abnormally decreased rate of beta-galactosidase activity. Beta-galactosidase activity can be measured in leukocyte, fibroblast, or plasma.

terms.name: Very long chain fatty acid accumulation
Reduced factor VII activity
terms.definition: Reduced activity of coagulation factor VII. Factor VII is part of the extrinsic coagulation pathway, which is initiated at the site of injury in response to the release of tissue factor (fIII). Tissue factor and activated factor VII catalyze the activation of factor X.

terms.name: Decreased Arden ratio of electrooculogram
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the Arden ratio, which is the ratio between the light peak and the dark trough of the smoothed (physiologic) EOG record.

terms.name: Abetalipoproteinemia
terms.definition: An absence of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.

terms.name: Precocious puberty in males
synonyms: Early onset of puberty in males
terms.definition: The onset of puberty before the age of 9 years in boys.

terms.name: Adrenocortical cytomegaly
terms.definition: The presence of large polyhedral cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and enlarged nuclei in the adrenal cortex.

terms.name: Absence of secondary sex characteristics
synonyms: No secondary sexual characteristics at puberty
terms.definition: No secondary sexual characteristics are present at puberty.

terms.name: Thyroid dysgenesis
terms.definition: Thyroid dysgenesis is a descriptive term that should be avoided if more precise information is available. However, the HPO keeps retains this term because it is commonly used in the medical literature. In humans, the process of thyroid morphogenesis occurs from the 3rd to 16th week of gestation. Alterations occurring during this period may result in a thyroid gland that is absent (thyroid agenesis or athyreosis), hypoplastic (thyroid hypoplasia), or located in an unusual position (thyroid ectopy). All these entities are grouped under the term thyroid dysgenesis.

terms.name: Insulin insensitivity
terms.definition: Decreased sensitivity toward insulin.

terms.name: Thyroid agenesis
terms.definition: The congenital absence of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Multiple pancreatic beta-cell adenomas
terms.definition: The presence of multiple pancreatic islet cell adenomas.

terms.name: Congenital hypoparathyroidism
terms.name_zh: 先天性甲状旁腺功能减退症
terms.definition: Deficiency of parathyroid hormone with congenital onset.

terms.name: Primary hyperparathyroidism
terms.definition: A type of hyperparathyroidism caused by a primary abnormality of the parathyroid glands (e.g., adenoma, carcinoma, hyperplasia). Primary hyperparathyroidism is associated with hyercalcemia.

terms.name: Reduced circulating prolactin concentration
terms.definition: A reduced level of prolactin in the blood circulation. Prolactin is a protein hormone that is secreted by lactotrophs in the anterior pituitary and that stimulates mammary gland development and milk production.

terms.name: Precocious puberty with Sertoli cell tumor
synonyms: Precocious puberty with Sertoli cell tumour

terms.name: Insulin-dependent but ketosis-resistant diabetes
terms.name_zh: 胰岛素依赖性抗酮症糖尿病
terms.definition: Ketosis-resistant diabetes is a synonym for type II diabetes. This term thus refers to a form of type II diabetes in which patients are dependent on insulin.

terms.name: Primary adrenal insufficiency
terms.definition: Insufficient production of steroid hormones (primarily cortisol) by the adrenal glands as a result of a primary defect in the glands themselves.

terms.name: Parathyroid hyperplasia
terms.definition: Hyperplasia of the parathyroid gland.

terms.name: Premature ovarian insufficiency
terms.definition: Amenorrhea due to loss of ovarian function before the age of 40. Primary ovarian insuficiency (POI) is a state of female hypergonadotropic hypogonadism. It can manifest as primary amenorrhea with onset before menarche or secondary amenorrhea.

terms.name: Parathyroid agenesis
terms.definition: Aplasia of the parathyroid gland.

terms.name: Gonadotropin deficiency
terms.definition: A reduced ability to secrete gonadotropins, which are protein hormones secreted by gonadotrope cells of the anterior pituitary gland, including the hormones follitropin (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH).

terms.name: Decreased serum estradiol
terms.definition: A reduction below normal concentration of estradiol in the circulation.

terms.name: Adrenal gland dysgenesis
terms.definition: Abnormal development of the adrenal gland.

terms.name: Adrenal hyperplasia
terms.definition: Enlargement of the adrenal gland.

terms.name: Compensated hypothyroidism
terms.name_zh: 代偿性甲状腺功能减退
terms.definition: Condition associated with a raised serum concentration of thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) but a normal serum free thyroxine (FT4).

terms.name: Androgen insufficiency
terms.definition: Insufficient amount of androgenic activity.

terms.name: Pituitary resistance to thyroid hormone
terms.definition: A condition in which the pituitary gland is partially resistant to thyroid hormone, so that it continues to secrete thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) until the blood level of thyroid hormone rises higher than normal.

terms.name: Thyroid lymphangiectasia
terms.definition: The presence of lymphangiectasis of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Elevated circulating follicle stimulating hormone level
terms.name_zh: 血循环促卵泡激素水平升高
synonyms: Increased circulating follicle stimulating hormone level
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of follicle-stimulating hormone in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating progesterone
terms.definition: An reduced concentration of progesterone in the blood.

terms.name: Hypothalamic hypothyroidism
terms.name_zh: 下丘脑性甲状腺功能减退症
terms.definition: A type of hypothyroidism that results from a defect in thyrotropin-releasing hormone activity.

terms.name: Adrenal medullary hypoplasia
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the adrenal medulla.

terms.name: Pseudohypoaldosteronism
terms.definition: A state of renal tubular unresponsiveness or resistance to the action of aldosterone.

terms.name: Congenital adrenal hypoplasia
terms.name_zh: 先天性肾上腺发育不良
terms.definition: A type of adrenal hypoplasia with congenital onset.

terms.name: Pituitary hypothyroidism
synonyms: Low thyroid gland function due to abnormal pituitary gland
terms.definition: A type of hypothyroidism that results from a defect in thyroid-stimulating hormone secretion.

terms.name: Euthyroid hyperthyroxinemia
terms.name_zh: 甲状腺功能正常型高甲状腺素血症
terms.definition: Increased levels of thyroxine without evidence of clinical thyroid disease.

terms.name: Thyroid hyperplasia
terms.definition: Hyperplasia of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Congenital goiter
terms.definition: An enlargement of the thyroid gland with congenital onset.

terms.name: Adrenocortical adenoma
terms.definition: Adrenocortical adenomas are benign tumors of the adrenal cortex.

terms.name: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia
terms.name_zh: 先天性肾上腺皮质增生症
terms.definition: A type of adrenal hyperplasia with congenital onset.

terms.name: Adrenocorticotropin receptor defect
terms.name_zh: 促肾上腺皮质激素受体缺陷
terms.definition: Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in the ACTH receptor.

terms.name: Pancreatic islet cell adenoma
terms.definition: The presence of an adenoma of the pancreas with origin in a pancreatic B cell.

terms.name: Thyroid defect in oxidation and organification of iodide
Neutrophil inclusion bodies
terms.definition: The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neutrophils. Cytoplasmic neutrophil inclusions (oval, basophilic) are also known as Doehle bodies.

terms.name: Mitochondrial lysine transport defect
terms.name_zh: 线粒体赖氨酸转运缺陷

terms.name: Increased red cell hemolysis by shear stress
terms.name_zh: 剪切应力致红细胞溶血增加

terms.name: Abnormal cartilage collagen
terms.definition: Abnormal morphology of collagen fibers in cartilage. In cartilage, collagen II, actually a collagen II:IX:XI heterofibril, is by far the most important type of collagen. A number of abnormalities may be appreciated by electron micrography or biochemical investigations, including sparse collagen fibers in the cartilage matrix.

terms.name: Abnormal light-adapted electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应视网膜电图异常

terms.name: Abnormal circulating zinc concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of zinc in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Cerebellar cortical atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy (wasting) of the cerebellar cortex.

terms.name: Acute hyperammonemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of ammonia in the blood with sudden onset.

terms.name: Unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia
terms.definition: An increased amount of unconjugated (indirect) bilurubin in the blood.

terms.name: Fasting hyperinsulinemia
synonyms: High blood insulin levels while fasting
terms.definition: An increased concentration of insulin in the blood in the fasting state, i.e., not as the response to food intake.

terms.name: Partial complement factor H deficiency
terms.definition: A partial reduction in level of the complement component Factor H in circulation.

terms.name: Pituitary corticotropic cell adenoma
terms.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma that produces adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH).

terms.name: Long-chain dicarboxylic aciduria
terms.definition: An increase in the level of long-chain dicarboxylic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Transient hyperphenylalaninemia
terms.definition: A condition of not having consistently high levels of phenylalanine in the blood but of experiencing temporary hyperphenylalaninemia following ingestion of large quantities of phenylalanine (for instance, following an oral loading test with phenylalanine).

terms.name: Dermatan sulfate excretion in urine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of dermatan sulfate in the urine.

terms.name: Olivary degeneration
terms.definition: Degeneration of the olivary bodies, prominent oval structures in the medulla oblongata.

terms.name: Exercise-induced myoglobinuria
terms.definition: Presence of myoglobin in the urine following exercise.

terms.name: Medium chain dicarboxylic aciduria
terms.definition: An increase in the level of medium chain dicarboxylic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Spinal cord dorsal column hypomyelination
synonyms: Spinal cord posterior columns myelin loss
terms.definition: Lower than normal amount of myelin in the dorsal (posterior) tract of the spinal cord white matter.

terms.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex II
terms.name_zh: 线粒体复合物II活性降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

terms.name: Decreased plasma free carnitine
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of free (unbound) carnitine in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal mitochondria in muscle tissue
terms.definition: An abnormality of the mitochondria in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Elevated leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
terms.name_zh: 白细胞碱性磷酸酶升高
terms.definition: Increased alkaline phosphatase measured within leukocytes.

terms.name: Impaired collagen-induced platelet aggregation
terms.name_zh: 胶原诱导血小板聚集障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal response to collagen or collagen-mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition collagen or collagen-mimetics.

terms.name: Reduced factor X activity
terms.definition: Reduced activity of coagulation factor X. The extrinsic and intrinsic pathways converge at factor X (fX). The extrinsic pathway activates fX by means of d factor VII with its cofactor, tissue factor. The intrinsic pathway activates fX by means of the tenase complex (Ca2+ and factors VIIIa, IXa and X) on the surface of activated platelets. Factor Xa in turn activates prothrombin (factor II) to thrombin (factor IIa).

terms.name: Abnormal mitochondrial morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the mitochondria.

terms.name: Abnormal light- and dark-adapted electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应及暗适应视网膜电图异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the combined rod-and-cone response on electroretinogram.

terms.name: Reduced circulating vitamin B6 circulating
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Microscopic nephrocalcinosis
terms.definition: The presence of microscopic crystalline calcium precipitates in the form of oxalate and/or phosphate in the renal parenchyma.

terms.name: Reduced von Willebrand factor activity
terms.definition: Decreased activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.

terms.name: Partial functional complement factor D deficiency
terms.definition: A partial reduction in level of the complement component Factor D in circulation.

terms.name: Diaminoaciduria
terms.definition: An increased urine level of any amino acid carrying two amino groups (Asparagine, glutamine and lysine, cystine, ornithine).

terms.name: Distal renal tubular acidosis
terms.definition: A type of renal tubular acidosis characterized by a failure of acid secretion by the alpha intercalated cells of the cortical collecting duct of the distal nephron. The urine cannot be acidified below a pH of 5.3, associated with acidemia and hypokalemia.

terms.name: Elevated circulating branched chain amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环支链氨基酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of a branched chain amino acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the iris dilator muscle
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the pupil dilator muscle
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the dilatator pupillae.

terms.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex IV
terms.name_zh: 线粒体复合物IV活性降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

terms.name: Decreased circulating IgG2 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白G2浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG2 subclass in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Impaired platelet adhesion
terms.definition: An abnormality of adhesion of thrombocytes. Normally, platelets adhere to collagen in the vascular subendothelium within seconds of injury via a receptor made up of glycoprotein Ia and IIa and GPVI and to vWF via receptor GPIb/IX/V. The adherent platelets then release granules that lead to platelet activation and aggregation.

terms.name: Neutral hyperaminoaciduria
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally increased concentration of neutral amino acids in the urine. The neutral amino acids are tryptophan, alanine, asparagine, glutamine, histidine, isoleucine, leucine, phenylalanine, serine, threonine, tyrosine and valine.

terms.name: Factor X activation deficiency
terms.definition: Reduced ability to transform factor X into its activated form factor Xa.

terms.name: Reduced factor XIII activity
terms.definition: Decreased activity of coagulation factor XIII (also known as fibrin stabilizing factor). Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.

terms.name: Hyperprolinemia
terms.definition: The concentration of proline in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Neonatal hypoproteinemia
terms.definition: A neonatal decreased concentration of proteins in the blood.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the hallux
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the big toe.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tarsal bones
terms.name_zh: 跗骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the tarsal bones.

terms.name: Abnormality of the calcaneus
terms.definition: An abnormality of the calcaneus, also known as the heel bone, one of the or heel bone, one of the components of the tarsus of the foot which make up the heel.

terms.name: Abnormal talus morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the talus.

terms.name: Foot joint contracture
synonyms: Contractures involving the joints of the feet
Joint contractures involving the joints of the feet
terms.definition: Contractures of one or more joints of the feet meaning chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.

terms.name: Tarsal synostosis
terms.definition: Synostosis (bony fusion) involving one or more bones of the tarsus (calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, cuneiiform bones).

terms.name: Abnormal tarsal ossification
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

terms.name: Abnormal metatarsal ossification
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of long bone of foot
terms.definition: Any abnormal process of ossification of the metatarsal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metatarsal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metatarsal I). The ossification process begins in the center of the body about the ninth week, and extends toward either extremity. The center for the base of the first metatarsal appears about the third year, and the centers for the heads of the other bones between the fifth and eighth years. They join the bodies between the eighteenth and twentieth years.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin A concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of vitamin A in the blood circulation outside limits of normal.

terms.name: Slow-growing nails
terms.definition: Nails whose growth is slower than normal.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nails
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the nail.

terms.name: Abnormal toenail morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the toenail.

terms.name: Recurrent loss of toenails and fingernails
synonyms: Recurrent loss of toenails and fingernails
Recurrent shedding of toenails and fingernails
terms.definition: Repeated loss, or shedding, of the nails of the fingers and toes.

terms.name: Dystrophic fingernails
terms.definition: The presence of misshapen or partially destroyed nail plates, often with accumulation of soft, yellow keratin between the dystrophic nail plate and nail bed, resulting in elevation of the nail plate.

terms.name: Subungual hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: A thickening of the stratum corneum in the region beneath the nails.

terms.name: Congenital curved nail of fourth toe
Chronic monilial nail infection
terms.definition: Chronic infection of the nails by Candida species.

terms.name: Hypoplastic fifth fingernail
terms.definition: A nail of the fifth finger that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped nail of little finger.

terms.name: Circumungual hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: A thickening of the stratum corneum, the outer layer of the skin, in the region surrounding the nails.

terms.name: Onycholysis of distal fingernails
terms.definition: Detachment of the distal fingernails from the nail bed.

terms.name: Onychogryphosis of toenails
terms.definition: Thickened toenails.

terms.name: Ridged fingernail
terms.definition: Longitudinal, linear prominences in the fingernail plate.

terms.name: Nail dystrophy
terms.definition: Onychodystrophy (nail dystrophy) refers to nail changes apart from changes of the color (nail dyschromia) and involves partial or complete disruption of the various keratinous layers of the nail plate.

terms.name: Vertebral hypoplasia
terms.definition: Small, underdeveloped vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Intervertebral disk degeneration
terms.definition: The presence of degenerative changes of intervertebral disk.

terms.name: Punctate vertebral calcifications
terms.definition: The presence of punctiform calcification of the bone of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Vertebral wedging
terms.definition: An abnormal shape of the vertebral bodies whereby the vertebral bodies are thick on one side and taper to a thin edge at the other.

terms.name: Spinal dysplasia
terms.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the vertebral column.

terms.name: Vertebral clefting
terms.definition: Schisis (cleft or cleavage) of vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Anterior beaking of lumbar vertebrae
synonyms: Anterior tongue-like protrusion of lumbar vertebral bodies
terms.definition: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the vertebral bodies of the lumbar spine.

terms.name: Anterior wedging of L1
terms.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the lumbar vertebra L1 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

terms.name: Absent in utero ossification of vertebral bodies
Vertebral arch anomaly
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of the vertebral arch, i.e., of the posterior part of a vertebra.

terms.name: Lumbar hemivertebrae
terms.definition: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the lumbar spine.

terms.name: C1-C2 vertebral abnormality
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the atlas and the axis.

terms.name: Herniation of intervertebral nuclei
terms.definition: The presence of one or more herniated nucleus pulposus of intervertebral disk.

terms.name: Vertebral hyperostosis
terms.definition: Excessive growth of the bones of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Neuropathic spinal arthropathy
terms.definition: A progressive disorder of vertebral joint degeneration that occurs in the setting of any condition characterized by decreased afferent innervation, involving loss of deep pain and proprioceptive sensation in the vertebral column. Patients most commonly present with symptoms of lower back pain, sitting imbalance, progressive spinal deformity (usually kyphosis), and an audible clicking sound on changing postures.

terms.name: Posterior wedging of vertebral bodies
terms.definition: An abnormality of the shape of vertebrae, such that they are wedge-shaped (narrow towards the back).

terms.name: Cervical spinal canal stenosis
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the cervical spinal canal.

terms.name: Narrow vertebral interpedicular distance
terms.definition: A reduction of the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.

terms.name: Lumbar kyphosis
terms.definition: Over curvature of the lumbar region.

terms.name: Dysplastic sacrum
synonyms: Absence of some of the sacral and coccygeal bones
terms.definition: A developmental defect of the sacrum characterized by partial or disordered development of the sacrum in which portions of the sacrum, which normally is formed by fusion of five sacral vertebrae S1-S5, fail to form or fail to form normally.

terms.name: C2-C3 subluxation
terms.definition: A partial dislocation of the intervertebral joint between the second and third cervical vertebrae.

terms.name: Caudal interpedicular narrowing
terms.definition: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column. Note that normally, the interpedicular distances get progressively wider as one proceeds down the spine.

terms.name: Progressive congenital scoliosis
terms.definition: A progressive form of scoliosis with congenital onset.

terms.name: Cervical vertebral agenesis
terms.definition: Agenesis of one or more vertebrae of the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: Cervical vertebral facet hypoplasia
terms.name_zh: 颈椎椎小关节发育不良

terms.name: Absent spinous processes of lower thoracic and lumbar vertebrae
terms.name_zh: 下胸椎及腰椎棘突缺失

terms.name: Absent vertebra
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Thoracic hemivertebrae
terms.definition: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the thoracic spine.

terms.name: Abnormal sacral segmentation
terms.definition: An abnormality related to a defect of vertebral separation of sacral vertebrae during development.

terms.name: Cervical vertebral dysplasia
terms.definition: Dysplasia of the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: Lower thoracic interpediculate narrowness
terms.name_zh: 下胸椎椎弓根间距狭窄
synonyms: Narrowness of interpediculate distances in lower thoracic regions
terms.definition: A reduction of the distance between the lower thoracic vertebral pedicles.

terms.name: Narrow anterio-posterior vertebral body diameter
synonyms: Reduced anterior-posterior diameter of vertebral bodies
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction of the anterioposterior diameter of the vertebral body.

terms.name: Poorly ossified cervical vertebrae
terms.definition: Decreased ossification of the cervical vertebral bodies, i.e., of the Cervical vertebrae set.

terms.name: Cervical spondylosis
terms.definition: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: Cervical vertebral bodies with decreased anteroposterior diameter
Thoracolumbar interpediculate narrowness
terms.definition: A reduction of the distance between thoracolumbar vertebral pedicles.

terms.name: Lumbar interpedicular narrowing
terms.definition: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between lumbar vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column.

terms.name: Spondylolisthesis at L5-S1
terms.definition: Complete bilateral fractures of the pars interarticularis resulting in the anterior slippage of the fifth lumbar vertebral body (L5) onto the sacrum (level S1).

terms.name: Premature anterior fontanel closure
terms.definition: Early closure (ossification) of the anterior fontanelle, which generally undergoes closure around the 18th month of life.

terms.name: Inferior lens subluxation
terms.definition: Partial displacement of the lens in the inferior direction.

terms.name: Congenital craniofacial dysostosis
terms.name_zh: 先天性颅面骨发育不全

terms.name: High hypermetropia
terms.definition: A severe form of hypermetropia with over +5.00 diopters.

terms.name: Moderate sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 中度感音神经性听力障碍
terms.definition: The presence of a moderate form of sensorineural hearing impairment.

terms.name: Central posterior corneal opacity
terms.definition: Reduced transparency of the central posterior portion of the corneal stroma.

terms.name: Bilateral conductive hearing impairment
terms.definition: A bilateral type of conductive hearing impairment.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the vertebrae
terms.name_zh: 椎骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Abnormality of the vertebral spinous processes
Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sacrum
terms.name_zh: 骶骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the sacral bone.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the vertebral column
terms.name_zh: 脊柱发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Abnormal coccyx morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the coccyx.

terms.name: Posterior helix pit
synonyms: Indentation in back of outer ear
Pits in posterior aspect of ear helices
terms.definition: Permanent indentation on the posteromedial aspect of the helix that may be sharply or indistinctly delineated.

terms.name: Congenital sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 先天性感音神经性听力障碍
terms.definition: A type of hearing impairment caused by an abnormal functionality of the cochlear nerve with congenital onset.

terms.name: Long hairs growing from helix of pinna
synonyms: Long hairs growing from helix of ear

terms.name: Absence of acoustic reflex
synonyms: Absence of acoustic middle ear muscle reflexes
terms.definition: Absence of the acoustic reflex, an involuntary contraction of the stapedius muscle that occurs in response to high-intensity sound stimuli.

terms.name: Cleft at the superior portion of the pinna
synonyms: Cleft at the superior portion of the ear

terms.name: Low-frequency hearing loss
terms.definition: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the low frequencies of sound (125 Hz to 1000 Hz).

terms.name: Abnormally folded helix
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the border of the helix, which usually forms a rolled rim but is highly variable in shape.

terms.name: Microtia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the external ear.

terms.name: Cochlear malformation
terms.definition: The presence of a malformed cochlea.

terms.name: Absent vestibular function
terms.definition: Complete lack of functioning of the vestibular apparatus.

terms.name: Vestibular areflexia
terms.definition: Vestibular areflexia can be measured as the absence of the caloric nystagmus response in electronystagmography.

terms.name: Microtia, second degree
terms.definition: Median longitudinal length of the ear more than two standard deviations below the mean in the presence of some, but not all, parts of the normal ear.

terms.name: Low-frequency sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 低频感音神经性听力损害
terms.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects primarily the lower frequencies.

terms.name: Underfolded helix
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the helix that either affects the entire helix, or is localized.

terms.name: Underfolded superior helices
terms.definition: A condition in which the superior portion of the helix is folded over to a lesser degree than normal.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the cochlea
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the cochlea.

terms.name: Mild neurosensory hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 轻度感音神经性听力障碍
terms.definition: The presence of a mild form of sensorineural hearing impairment.

terms.name: Slit-like opening of the exterior auditory meatus
terms.definition: A type of stenosis of the external auditory meatus in which the opening of the external auditory meatus appears as a vertical slit.

terms.name: Hypoplastic helices
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the helix, i.e., of the outer rim of the pinna.

terms.name: Congenital conductive hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 先天性传导性听力障碍
terms.definition: A type of conductive deafness with congenital onset.

terms.name: Prominent antitragus
terms.definition: Increased anterosuperior prominence of the area between the bottom of the incisura and the inner margin of the antihelix.

terms.name: Postlingual sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment with onset after the acquisition of speech.

terms.name: Mild conductive hearing impairment
terms.definition: A mild form of conductive hearing impairment.

terms.name: Unilateral external ear deformity
synonyms: Deformed external ear on one side

terms.name: Supraauricular pit
terms.definition: Benign congenital lesion of the supraauricular soft tissue consisting of a blind-ending narrow tube or pit.

terms.name: Progressive conductive hearing impairment
terms.definition: A progressive type of conductive deafness.

terms.name: Abnormal middle ear morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the middle ear
terms.definition: An abnormality of the morphology or structure of the middle ear.

terms.name: Infantile sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 婴儿感音神经性听力损害
terms.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment with infantile onset.

terms.name: Adult onset sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 成人起病感音神经性听力障碍
terms.definition: The presence of sensorineural deafness with late onset.

terms.name: Bilateral sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.name_zh: 双侧感音神经性听力障碍
terms.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects both ears.

terms.name: Severe sensorineural hearing impairment
terms.definition: A severe form of sensorineural hearing impairment.

terms.name: Abnormal stapes morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the stapes, a stirrup-shaped ossicle in the middle ear.

terms.name: Pulsatile tinnitus
terms.definition: Pulsatile tinnitus is generally classified a kind of objective tinnitus, meaning that it is not only audible to the patient but also to the examiner on auscultation of the auditory canal and/or of surrounding structures with use of an auscultation tube or stethoscope. Usually, pulsatile tinnitus is heard as a lower pitched thumping or booming, a rougher blowing sound which is coincidental with respiration, or as a clicking, higher pitched rhythmic sensation.

terms.name: Ureteral dysgenesis
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly of the ureter.

terms.name: Agonadism
terms.definition: Absence of sex glands (gonads are the organs that produce gametes; testis in males and ovary in females).

terms.name: Urinary bladder wall hypertrophy
synonyms: Hypertrophy of the urinary bladder wall
terms.definition: Increase in thickness of the wall of the urinary bladder. This finding may be seen in conditions such as bladder outlet obstruction and may be accompanied by increased trabeculation of the bladder wall musculature.

terms.name: Nephroblastomatosis
terms.definition: Presence of persistent islands of renal blastema in the postnatal kidney. Nephroblastomatosis represents a complex abnormality of nephrogenesis and has been defined as the persistence of metanephricblastema into infancy and childhood.

terms.name: Uric acid urolithiasis independent of gout
Autonomic erectile dysfunction
terms.name_zh: 自主神经性勃起功能障碍
terms.definition: Impotence (inability to develop or maintain an erection) resulting from abnormal functioning of the autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Crescentic glomerulonephritis
terms.definition: A type of extracapillary glomerulonephritis characterized by the formation of crescent-like cellular proliferation.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fallopian tube
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the fallopian tube.

terms.name: Incomplete male pseudohermaphroditism
terms.name_zh: 不完全性男性假两性畸形

terms.name: Multiple small medullary renal cysts
terms.definition: The presence of many cysts in the medulla of the kidney.

terms.name: Renotubular dysgenesis
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence or poor development of proximal renal tubules.

terms.name: Urethral stenosis
terms.definition: Abnormal narrowing of the urethra.

terms.name: Renal sarcoma
terms.definition: A sarcoma of the kidney.

terms.name: Clitoral hypertrophy
terms.definition: Hypertrophy of the clitoris.

terms.name: Impaired histidine renal tubular absorption
terms.name_zh: 肾小管组氨酸吸收障碍

terms.name: Gonadal dysgenesis, male
terms.definition: Unusual gonadal development in a person with a 46,XY male karyotype, leading to an unassigned sex differentiation.

terms.name: Abnormal spermatogenesis
terms.definition: Incomplete maturation or aberrant formation of the male gametes.

terms.name: Calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis
terms.definition: The presence of calcium- and oxalate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

terms.name: Congenital megaureter
terms.definition: A developmental disturbance with extreme ureteral dilatation.

terms.name: Congenital nephrotic syndrome
terms.definition: Nephrotic syndrome with onset within the first three months of life.

terms.name: Renal hypoplasia/aplasia
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial necrosis
terms.definition: Coagulative necrosis of tubular epithelial cells, defined as cells with increased cytoplasmic eosinophilia and nucleus that has a condensed chromatin pattern with fuzzy nuclear contour or has barely visible nuclear basophilic staining. The extent of cortical tubular necrosis is scoredsemiquantitatively as none, mild (less than 25% tubules with necrosis), moderate (25-50 percent), and severe (over 50%).

terms.name: Enlarged labia minora
terms.definition: Increase in size of the folds of skin between the outer labia.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the uterus
terms.name_zh: 子宫发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or developmental hypoplasia of the uterus.

terms.name: Bilateral cryptorchidism
terms.definition: Absence of both testes from the scrotum owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.

terms.name: Solitary bladder diverticulum
terms.definition: Presence of a single diverticulum (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Renal hamartoma
terms.definition: A disordered proliferation of mature tissues that are native to the kidneys.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the fallopian tube
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the fallopian tube.

terms.name: Gonadal calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in gonadal tissue.

terms.name: Absent scrotum
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the scrotum.

terms.name: Partial development of the penile shaft
terms.definition: A congenital condition of the external male genitalia in which the shaft of the penis fails to fully develop.

terms.name: Benign prostatic hyperplasia
terms.definition: The presence of non-malignant hyperplasia of the prostate.

terms.name: Urethrovaginal fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula between the vagina and the urethra.

terms.name: Unilateral renal atrophy
terms.definition: A unilateral form of atrophy of the kidney.

terms.name: Unilateral renal dysplasia
terms.definition: A unilateral form of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.

terms.name: Urethral diverticulum
terms.definition: The presence of a diverticulum (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urethra.

terms.name: Gonadal dysgenesis with female appearance, male
terms.name_zh: 男性表型女性性腺发育不全
terms.definition: Unusual gonadal development in a person with a 46,XY male karyotype, leading to a more female sex differentiation.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the ovary
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the ovary.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the vagina
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the vagina.

terms.name: Female external genitalia in individual with 46,XY karyotype
terms.definition: The presence of female external genitalia in a person with a male karyotype.

terms.name: Renal hypophosphatemia
terms.definition: Renal hypophosphatemia is defined as reduced serum phosphate (e.g., below 0.70 mmol/l) and an inappropriately high renal phosphate excretion.

terms.name: Dysplastic testis
terms.definition: A descriptive term denoting a developmental anomaly of the male gonad characterized by architectural disorganization of the testicular parenchyma, which may include irregular or poorly formed seminiferous tubules, a thinned tunica albuginea, and increased or fibrotic interstitial tissue. Macroscopically, the testis may range from near-normal in size and appearance to a small, firm, or streak-like structure.

terms.name: Decreased testicular size
terms.definition: Reduced volume of the testicle (the male gonad).

terms.name: Partially duplicated kidney
terms.definition: The presence of a partially duplicated kidney.

terms.name: Longitudinal vaginal septum
terms.definition: The presence of a longitudinal vaginal septum, thereby creating a vaginal duplication.

terms.name: Coronal hypospadias
terms.definition: A mild form of hypospadias in which the urethra opens just under the corona glandis, that is, where the head of the penis meets the shaft.

terms.name: Abnormal aryepiglottic fold morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the aryepiglottic fold.

terms.name: Cartilaginous ossification of larynx
terms.definition: Ossification affecting the set of cartilages of larynx.

terms.name: Laryngeal hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the larynx.

terms.name: Laryngeal atresia
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the lumen of the larynx. Laryngeal atresia is a rare condition. If the laryngeal opening fails to develop, fluid secreted by the lungs cannot be expelled. In a fetus with laryngeal atresia, the lungs are either normal or hyperplastic, not hypoplastic. Mortality is reported as 100%. At obstetric US examination, views of the fetal neck demonstrate a dilated trachea filled with trapped fluid. Views of the fetal chest show enlarged, hyperechoic lungs, with dilated fluid-filled bronchi. Fetal ascites is usually present.

terms.name: Laryngeal cleft
terms.definition: Presence of a gap in the posterior laryngotracheal wall with a continuity between the larynx and the esophagus.

terms.name: Laryngeal cartilage malformation
synonyms: Vocal impairment, severe, due to laryngeal cartilage abnormalities
terms.definition: A malformation of the laryngeal cartilage.

terms.name: Aplasia of the epiglottis
terms.definition: Absence of the epiglottis.

terms.name: Laryngeal calcification
terms.definition: Calcification (abnormal deposits of calcium) in the laryngeal tissues.

terms.name: Bowing of the vocal cords
terms.definition: Bowing (abnormal curvature) of the vocal folds.

terms.name: Unilateral vocal cord paralysis
synonyms: Unilateral paralysis of the vocal cord
terms.definition: A loss of the ability to move the vocal fold on one side.

terms.name: Violent behavior
terms.definition: Conduct and/or behavior, both verbal and non-verbal, including but not limited to verbal and/or physical aggression, attacks, threats, harassment, intimidation, and other disruptive behaviors in any form or through any medium, that cause or have the potential to cause a reasonable person to fear physical harm from any individual(s) or group(s) towards any person(s) or property. This is commonly defined as a violent act characterized by the use of physical force, anger, or sudden intense activity.

terms.name: No social interaction
terms.definition: Lack of intentional participation in interactions with another person.

terms.name: Auditory hallucination
terms.definition: Perception of sounds without auditory stimulus.

terms.name: Self-mutilation of tongue and lips due to involuntary movements
synonyms: Self-mutilation of tongue and lips due to involuntary movements
terms.definition: Uncontrolled movements result in tissue damage to the tongue and lips.

terms.name: Abnormal sexual behavior
terms.definition: A deviation of sexual behaviors from the personal norms of the individual in the context of socially and culturally recognized patterns of human sexual behaviors.

terms.name: Obsessive-compulsive trait
terms.definition: The presence of one or more obsessive-compulsive personality traits. Obsessions refer to persistent intrusive thoughts, and compulsions to intrusive behaviors, which the affected person experiences as involuntary, senseless, or repugnant.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ear
terms.definition: The presence of aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the ear.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the external ear
