terms.definition: The presence of aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of all or part of the external ear.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle ear
terms.name_zh: 中耳发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of all or part of the middle ear.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the inner ear
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the inner ear.

terms.name: Abnormal prostate morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the prostate.

terms.name: Abnormal renal artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the renal artery.

terms.name: Abnormal vocal cord morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the vocal cord.

terms.name: Congenital bilateral hip dislocation
terms.name_zh: 先天性双侧髋关节脱位

terms.name: Wide proximal femoral metaphysis
terms.definition: Increased width of the proximal part of the shaft (metaphysis) of the femur.

terms.name: Wide capital femoral epiphyses
synonyms: Wide end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: Abnormally wide morphology of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Delayed ossification of pubic rami
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the rami (branches) of the pubic bone.

terms.name: Iliac crest serration
terms.definition: Irregularities of the iliac crest that produce the appearance of a lace border around it.

terms.name: Delayed pubic bone ossification
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the pubic bone.

terms.name: Cone-shaped capital femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Cone-shaped end part of innermost thighbone
terms.definition: A cone-shaped deformity of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Dysplastic iliac wing
terms.definition: A general term that describes a congenital defect in the iliac wing resulting from abnormal development.

terms.name: Femoral retroversion
terms.definition: An abnormal backward rotation of the hip relative to the knee such that the hips are externally rotated with the foot pointed outward instead of straight ahead (out-toeing).

terms.name: Early ossification of capital femoral epiphyses
terms.definition: Developmental acceleration of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Widened greater sciatic notch
terms.definition: The sacroiliac joint in the bony pelvis connects the sacrum and the ilium of the pelvis, which are joined by strong ligaments. The notch is located directly superior to the joint. This term refers to a increase in the lateral dimension of the notch.

terms.name: Limited hip movement
terms.definition: A decreased ability to move the femur at the hip joint associated with a decreased range of motion of the hip.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the lesser trochanter
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the lesser trochanter.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the femoral head
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the femoral head.

terms.name: Broad femoral head
terms.definition: Increased width of the femoral head.

terms.name: Acetabular dysplasia
synonyms: Decreased femoral head coverage by acetabulum
terms.definition: A smaller than normal acetabulum that has insufficient femoral head coverage leading to abnormal hip joint contact pressures, instability and pain.

terms.name: High iliac wing
terms.definition: Increased height of the wing (or ala) of the ilium (which is the large expanded portion which bounds the greater pelvis laterally).

terms.name: Flattened femoral head
terms.definition: An abnormally flattened femoral head.

terms.name: Aplastic pubic bone
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of development of the pubis bone.

terms.name: Large iliac wing
terms.definition: Increased size of the ilium ala.

terms.name: Narrow femoral neck
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced diameter of the femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).

terms.name: Absent ossification of capital femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Absent ossification of femoral capital epiphyses
terms.definition: Lack of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Hypoplastic ischiopubic ramus
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ischiopubic ramus, which is comprised of the inferior pubic ramus and the inferior ramus of the ischium.

terms.name: Inferior pubic ramus hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the lower branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).

terms.name: Hypoplastic iliac body
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the body of ilium.

terms.name: Delayed proximal femoral epiphyseal ossification
terms.name_zh: 股骨近端骨骺骨化延迟
synonyms: Delayed ossification of the proximal femoral epiphysis
terms.definition: Developmental delay of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Delayed femoral head ossification
synonyms: Delayed maturation of the head of the thigh bone
terms.definition: Delayed ossification of the femoral head.

terms.name: Hypoplastic pubic ramus
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of a ramus (branch) of the pubic bone.

terms.name: Multicentric femoral head ossification
terms.definition: There is normally one ossification center in the head of the femur. This term applies if there are multiple such centers.

terms.name: Stippled calcification proximal humeral epiphyses
synonyms: Speckled calcifications in end part of innermost long bone of upper arm

terms.name: Hypoplastic pelvis
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the bony pelvis.

terms.name: Mesomelic short stature
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by disproportionate shortening of the medial parts of the extremities (forearm or lower leg).

terms.name: Severe intrauterine growth retardation
terms.definition: Intrauterine growth retardation that is 4 or more standard deviations below average, corrected for sex and gestational age.

terms.name: Moderately short stature
terms.definition: A moderate degree of short stature, more than -3 SD but not more than -4 SD from mean corrected for age and sex.

terms.name: Severe postnatal growth retardation
terms.definition: Severely slow or limited growth after birth, being four standard deviations or more below age- and sex-related norms.

terms.name: Moderate postnatal growth retardation
terms.definition: A moderate degree of slow or limited growth after birth, being between three and four standard deviations below age- and sex-related norms.

terms.name: Neonatal short-trunk short stature
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with congenital onset recognizable at birth.

terms.name: Failure to thrive secondary to recurrent infections
terms.name_zh: 反复感染致生长发育迟缓
synonyms: Faltering weight secondary to recurrent infections
Weight faltering secondary to recurrent infections
terms.definition: Insufficient weight gain or inappropriate weight loss for a child, that is attributed to an endogenous recurrent infections.

terms.name: Feeding difficulties in infancy
terms.definition: Impaired feeding performance of an infant as manifested by difficulties such as weak and ineffective sucking, brief bursts of sucking, and falling asleep during sucking. There may be difficulties with chewing or maintaining attention.

terms.name: Disproportionate short-limb short stature
terms.name_zh: 短肢型比例失调性矮小
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short limbs but an average-sized trunk.

terms.name: Mild intrauterine growth retardation
terms.definition: Intrauterine growth retardation that is at least 2 standard deviations (SD) below average, but not as low as 3 SD, corrected for sex and gestational age.

terms.name: Adipose tissue loss
terms.definition: A reduction in the amount of adipose tissue (fat) compared with the amount previously present in an individual.

terms.name: Postnatal growth retardation
terms.definition: Slow or limited growth after birth.

terms.name: Rhizomelia
synonyms: Disproportionately short upper portion of limb
terms.definition: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of limbs (i.e. the femur and humerus).

terms.name: Lethal short-limbed short stature
terms.name_zh: 致死性短肢型身材矮小

terms.name: Childhood-onset truncal obesity
terms.definition: Truncal obesity with onset during childhood, defined as between 2 and 10 years of age.

terms.name: Neonatal short-limb short stature
synonyms: Short limb dwarfism recognisable at birth
Short limb dwarfism recognizable at birth
terms.definition: A type of short-limbed dwarfism that is manifest beginning in the neonatal period.

terms.name: Childhood-onset short-trunk short stature
terms.name_zh: 儿童期起病短躯干型矮小身材
synonyms: Disproportionate short-trunk short stature, identifiable in childhood
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with onset in childhood.

terms.name: Generalized neonatal hypotonia
terms.name_zh: 新生儿全身性肌张力减退
synonyms: Generalised low muscle tone in neonate
Generalized low muscle tone in neonate
terms.definition: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) manifesting in the neonatal period and affecting the entire musculature.

terms.name: Axial hypotonia
terms.definition: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) affecting the musculature of the trunk.

terms.name: Generalized lymphadenopathy
synonyms: Swollen lymph nodes affecting all regions of the body
terms.definition: A generalized form of lymphadenopathy.

terms.name: Acute rhabdomyolysis
terms.definition: An acute form of rhabdomyolysis.

terms.name: Distal lower limb amyotrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy of distal leg muscles.

terms.name: Loss of ability to walk in early childhood
Pelvic girdle amyotrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the muscles of the pelvic girdle (also known as hip girdle), i.e., the gluteal muscles, the lateral rotators, the adductors, the psoas major and the iliacus muscle.

terms.name: Floppy infant
terms.definition: Floppiness/hypotonia is defined as reduced resistance to passive movement of joints. Physical examination of floppy/hypotonic infants shows head lag, lack of shoulder and elbow muscle contraction on traction response, inability to tighten the shoulder girdle muscles (or slipping through) when held under the axillae, scarf sign (when the arm is pulled to the opposite side, the arm wraps around the neck with the elbow crossing midline), hyperdorsiflexion of the feet, easy apposition of the thumb against the forearm, feet touching the cheek with ease and without discomfort, frog leg position, and inverted U sign on ventral suspension (head, arms, and legs hanging down without elbow or knee flexion and the trunk rounded in a dome shape).

terms.name: Proximal upper limb amyotrophy
synonyms: Proximal muscle atrophy in upper limbs
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting proximally located muscles of the arms.

terms.name: Shoulder muscle hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of muscles of the shoulder.

terms.name: Pectoralis major hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the pectoralis major.

terms.name: Intrinsic hand muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the intrinsic muscle groups of the hand, comprising the thenar and hypothenar muscles; the interossei muscles; and the lumbrical muscles.

terms.name: Progressive distal muscular atrophy
terms.definition: Progressive muscular atrophy affecting muscles in the distal portions of the extremities.

terms.name: Proximal lower limb amyotrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting proximally located muscles of the legs, i.e., of the thigh.

terms.name: Distal upper limb muscle weakness
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the distal musculature of the arms.

terms.name: Calf muscle hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the muscuklature of the calf.

terms.name: Tibialis muscle weakness
terms.definition: Muscle weakness affecting the tibialis anterior muscle.

terms.name: Nonprogressive muscular atrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy that does not display a progression in severity with time.

terms.name: Exercise-induced muscle stiffness
terms.definition: A type of muscle stiffness that occurs following physical exertion.

terms.name: Muscle hypertrophy of the lower extremities
terms.definition: Muscle hypertrophy primarily affecting the legs.

terms.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
terms.name_zh: 线粒体呼吸链活性降低
synonyms: Decreased activities of mitochondrial-encoded respiratory chain complexes
Decreased activity of mitochondrial respiratory complexes
terms.definition: Decreased activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.

terms.name: Calf muscle hypertrophy
synonyms: Muscular hypertrophy of the calf muscles
terms.definition: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the calf muscles.

terms.name: Neck muscle hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of muscles of the neck.

terms.name: Increased intramuscular fat
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of intramuscular fat tissue.

terms.name: Agenesis of the diaphragm
terms.definition: Congenital lack, i.e., aplasia of the diaphragm.

terms.name: Pelvic girdle muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting the muscles that attach to the pelvic girdle (the gluteal muscles, the lateral rotators, adductor magnus, adductor brevis, adductor longus, pectineus, and gracilis muscles).

terms.name: Exercise-induced leg cramps
terms.definition: Sudden and involuntary contractions of one or more muscles of the leg brought on by physical exertion.

terms.name: Increased intraabdominal fat
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of intraabdominal fat tissue.

terms.name: Proximal lower limb muscle weakness
synonyms: Proximal muscle weakness in lower limbs
terms.definition: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles of the legs.

terms.name: Proximal upper limb muscle weakness
synonyms: Proximal muscle weakness in upper limbs
terms.definition: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles of the arms.

terms.name: Pectoralis hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the pectoral muscle.

terms.name: Loss of truncal subcutaneous adipose tissue
terms.name_zh: 躯干皮下脂肪组织缺失
synonyms: Loss of fat tissue in trunk
Loss of subcutaneous truncal adipose tissue
terms.definition: Loss (reduction of previously present) of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the region of the trunk.

terms.name: Increased subcutaneous truncal adipose tissue
terms.name_zh: 躯干皮下脂肪组织增多
synonyms: Increased fat below the skin in trunk
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally increased amount of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the trunk of the body.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the musculature
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the musculature.

terms.name: Weakness of the intrinsic hand muscles
Biceps hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the biceps muscle.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of serratus anterior muscle
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the serratus anterior muscle, which is involved in abduction, upward Rotation, and elevation of the scapula.

terms.name: Upper limb muscle hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of muscles of the arm.

terms.name: Loss of gluteal subcutaneous adipose tissue
terms.name_zh: 臀部皮下脂肪组织缺失
synonyms: Loss of fat tissue below the skin in gluts
terms.definition: Loss (reduction of previously present) of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the gluteal region.

terms.name: Progressive loss of facial adipose tissue
synonyms: Loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue from face, progressive
Progressive loss of facial subcutaneous adipose tissue
Progressive loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue from face

terms.name: Exercise-induced muscle fatigue
terms.definition: An abnormally increased tendency towards muscle fatigue induced by physical exercise.

terms.name: Abdominal wall muscle weakness
terms.definition: Decreased strength of the abdominal musculature.

terms.name: Increased connective tissue
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally increased amount of connective tissue.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of latissimus dorsi muscle
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the latissimus dorsi muscle, which is involved in adduction, extension, internal rotation, and transverse extension of the shoulder and assists in movement of the scapula.

terms.name: Foot dorsiflexor weakness
terms.definition: Weakness of the muscles responsible for dorsiflexion of the foot, that is, of the movement of the toes towards the shin. The foot dorsiflexors include the tibialis anterior, the extensor hallucis longus, the extensor digitorum longus, and the peroneus tertius muscles.

terms.name: Generalized weakness of limb muscles
terms.definition: Generalized weakness of the muscles of the arms and legs.

terms.name: Amyotrophy of ankle musculature
terms.definition: Atrophy of the muscles of the ankle.

terms.name: Exercise-induced rhabdomyolysis
terms.definition: Rhabdomyolysis induced by exercise.

terms.name: Difficulty running
terms.definition: Reduced ability to run.

terms.name: Peroneal muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the peroneous muscles, peroneus longus (also known as Fibularis longus), Peroneus brevis (also known as fibularis brevis, and Peroneus tertius (also known as fibularis tertius).

terms.name: Quadriceps muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Muscular atrophy involving the quadriceps muscle.

terms.name: Increased muscle glycogen content
terms.definition: An increased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Distal lower limb muscle weakness
synonyms: Distal muscle weakness in lower limbs
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the distal musculature of the legs.

terms.name: Generalized limb muscle atrophy
synonyms: Generalised muscle atrophy, proximal and distal
Generalized muscle atrophy, proximal and distal
terms.definition: Generalized (unlocalized) atrophy affecting muscles of the limbs in both proximal and distal locations.

terms.name: Loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue from upper limbs
terms.name_zh: 上肢皮下脂肪组织缺失
synonyms: Loss of fat tissue below the skin from upper limbs

terms.name: Increased muscle lipid content
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of lipids in skeletal muscle.

terms.name: Congenital generalized lipodystrophy
terms.name_zh: 先天性全身性脂肪营养不良

terms.name: Scapular muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the muscles that are responsible for moving the scapula, which are the levator scapulae, the infraspinatus muscle, the teres major, the teres minor, and the supraspinatus muscle.

terms.name: Progressive distal muscle weakness
terms.definition: Progressively reduced strength of the distal musculature.

terms.name: Generalized lipodystrophy
terms.definition: Generalized degenerative changes of the fat tissue.

terms.name: Progressive spinal muscular atrophy
terms.definition: Progressive spinal muscular atrophy, i.e., muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.

terms.name: Lethal infantile mitochondrial myopathy
terms.name_zh: 致死性婴儿型线粒体肌病

terms.name: Inflammatory myopathy
terms.definition: Chronic muscle inflammation accompanied by muscle weakness.

terms.name: Decreased Achilles reflex
terms.definition: Decreased intensity of the Achilles reflex (also known as the ankle jerk reflex), which can be elicited by tapping the tendon is tapped while the foot is dorsiflexed.

terms.name: Progressive proximal muscle weakness
terms.definition: Lack of strength of the proximal muscles that becomes progressively more severe.

terms.name: Weakness of long finger extensor muscles

Midline notch of maxillary alveolar ridge
Midline notch of upper gum ridge

synonyms: Hyperplasia of alveolar process of jaw

terms.name: Speech articulation difficulties
terms.definition: Impairment in the physical production of speech sounds.

terms.name: Progressive alveolar ridge hypertrophy
synonyms: Progressive hypertrophy of alveolar process of jaw

terms.name: Recurrent oral thrush
terms.definition: Chronic accumulation and overgrowth of the fungus Candida albicans on the mucous membranes of the mouth, generally manifested as associated with creamy white lesions on the tongue or inner cheeks, occasionally spreading to the gums, tonsils, palate or oropharynx.

terms.name: Median cleft palate
terms.definition: Cleft palate of the midline of the palate.

terms.name: Thick anterior alveolar ridges
synonyms: Thick anterior alveolar process of jaw

terms.name: Submucous cleft lip
terms.definition: A cleft of the lip with overlying mucous membrane.

terms.name: Anterior open-bite malocclusion
synonyms: Absence of overlap of anterior upper and lower teeth
Anterior open bite between upper and lower teeth
Gap between upper and lower front teeth when biting
terms.definition: Anterior open bite is a malocclusion characterized by a gap between the anterior teeth (incisors), that is, by a deficiency in the normal vertical overlap between antagonist incisal edges when the posterior teeth are in occlusion.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the pelvis
terms.name_zh: 骨盆发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the pubic bone
terms.name_zh: 耻骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the pubic bone.

terms.name: Abnormal ossification of the pubic bone
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of the pubic bone
terms.definition: Abnormal ossification (bone tissue formation) affecting the pubic bone, also known as the pubis.

terms.name: Abnormal pelvis bone ossification
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of the pelvis bone
Abnormal ossification involving the bones of the pelvis
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any bone of the bony pelvis.

terms.name: Abnormal ossification involving the femoral head and neck
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of thigh bone head and neck

Absent/underdeveloped head and neck of thighbone

terms.name: Denervation of the diaphragm
terms.definition: Interruption of the innervation of the diaphragm.

terms.name: Diaphragmatic eventration
terms.definition: A congenital failure of muscular development of part or all of one or both hemidiaphragms, resulting in superior displacement of abdominal viscera and altered lung development.

terms.name: Aplasia of the left hemidiaphragm
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the left half of the diaphragm.

terms.name: Diaphragmatic weakness
terms.definition: A decrease in the strength of the diaphragm.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving the skeleton
terms.name_zh: 骨骼发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving bones of the skull
terms.name_zh: 颅骨发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the maxilla
terms.name_zh: 上颌骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the maxilla.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the mandible
terms.name_zh: 下颌骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the mandible.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the frontal sinuses
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of frontal sinus.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the sinuses
terms.name_zh: 鼻窦发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of a cranial sinus or sinuses.

terms.name: Abnormal axial skeleton morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the axial skeleton, which comprises the skull, the vertebral column, the ribs and the sternum.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia affecting bones of the axial skeleton
terms.name_zh: 中轴骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of bones of the axial skeleton.

terms.name: Mixed hypo- and hyperpigmentation of the skin
terms.name_zh: 皮肤混合性色素减退与沉着

terms.name: Abnormal adipose tissue morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of adipose tissue, which is loose connective tissue composed of adipocytes.

terms.name: Lipodystrophy
synonyms: Inability to make and keep healthy fat tissue
terms.definition: Degenerative changes of the fat tissue.

terms.name: Increased adipose tissue
terms.definition: An increase in adipose tissue mass by hyperplastic growth (increase in the number of adipocytes) or by hypertrophic growth (increase in the size of adipocytes occurring primarily by lipid accumulation within the cell).

terms.name: Abnormal appendicular muscle morphology
synonyms: Muscle issues in the arms and/or legs
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the appendicular musculature, comprising muscles of the upper limb and pectoral girdle as well as muscles of the lower limb and pelvic girdle.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the musculature of the extremities
terms.name_zh: 四肢肌肉组织发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Abnormality of the musculature of the thorax

Synostosis involving bones of the feet

terms.name: Vestibular schwannoma
terms.definition: A vestibular schwannoma (also known as acoustic neuroma, acoustic neurinoma, or acoustic neurilemoma) is a benign, usually slow-growing tumor that develops from the VIIIth cranial nerve supplying the inner ear.

terms.name: Bilateral vestibular schwannoma
terms.definition: A bilateral vestibular schwannoma (acoustic neurinoma).

terms.name: Unilateral vestibular schwannoma
terms.definition: A unilateral vestibular schwannoma (acoustic neurinoma).

terms.name: Abnormal vestibulocochlear nerve morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the VIIIth cranial nerve
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the vestibulocochlear nerve. The vestibulocochlear nerve consists of the vestibular and cochlear nerves, also known as cranial nerve eight (CN VIII). Each nerve has distinct nuclei within the brainstem. The vestibular nerve is primarily responsible for maintaining body balance and eye movements, while the cochlear nerve is responsible for hearing.

terms.name: Astrocytoma
terms.definition: Astrocytoma is a neoplasm of the central nervous system derived from astrocytes. Astrocytes are a type of glial cell, and thus astrocytoma is a subtype of glioma.

terms.name: Peripheral schwannoma
terms.definition: The presence of a peripheral schwannoma.

terms.name: Retinal hamartoma
terms.definition: A hamartoma (a benign, focal malformation consisting of a disorganized mixture of cells and tissues) of the retina.

terms.name: Second ray metacarpophalangeal synostosis
synonyms: Fused innermost bone of index finger with 2nd long bone of hand
terms.definition: Congenital fusion of the second metacarpal bone with the proximal phalanx of the second finger.

terms.name: Abnormality of thumb epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of end part of thumb long bone
Abnormality of the epiphyses of the thumb
terms.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, and distal phalanges of the thumb and/or the 1st metacarpal.

terms.name: Thumb contracture
terms.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the thumb joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin. The term camptodactyly is used if the distal and/or proximal interphalangeal joints are affected.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thumb
terms.name_zh: 拇指发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Hypoplastic/small or absent thumb.

terms.name: Abnormality of thumb phalanx
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of one or more phalanges of the thumb.

terms.name: Deviation of the thumb
terms.definition: Displacement of the thumb from its normal position.

terms.name: Complete duplication of distal phalanx of the thumb
terms.name_zh: 拇指远节指骨完全重复畸形
synonyms: Complete duplication of outermost bone of the thumb
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the thumb. On x-ray two separate bones appear side to side.

terms.name: Complete duplication of proximal phalanx of the thumb
terms.name_zh: 拇指近节指骨完全重复畸形
synonyms: Complete duplication of the innermost bone of the thumb
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. On x-ray two separate bones appear side to side. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.

terms.name: Duplication of the 1st metacarpal
synonyms: Partial/complete duplication of the 1st long bone of hand
terms.definition: Partail or complete duplication of the first metacarpal bone.

terms.name: Bifid distal phalanx of the thumb
synonyms: Notched outermost bone of the thumb
terms.definition: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx) to a partially fused appearance of the two bones.

In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.

terms.name: Carpometacarpal thumb joint contracture
synonyms: Contracture of the carpometacarpal joint of the thumb
terms.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the carpometacarpal joint of the thumb due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. This joint is formed by the first metacarpal and the trapezial bone and is also called Articulatio carpometacarpalis pollicis, carpometacarpal articulation of thumb, carpometacarpal joint of thumb or first carpometacarpal articulation. Seldom referred to as thumb saddle joint.

terms.name: Interphalangeal thumb joint contracture

terms.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb

The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.

terms.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb

terms.name: Chilblains
terms.definition: Chilblains, also called perniosis, are an inflammatory skin condition related to an abnormal vascular response to the cold. We are unaware of a reliable estimate of incidence. It typically presents as tender, pruritic red or bluish lesions located symmetrically on the dorsal aspect of the fingers, toes, ears and nose. Less commonly, reports describe involvement of the thighs and buttocks. The lesions present hours after exposure to cold and usually resolve spontaneously in one to three weeks.

terms.name: Cortical tubers

terms.name: Subependymal giant-cell astrocytoma
terms.definition: A demarcated, largely intraventricular tumor in the region of the foramen of Monro composed of spindle to large plump or ganglion-like cells with eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and somewhat pleomorphic nuclei with occasional prominent nucleoli. These tumors are almost always associated with tuberous sclerosis.

Shagreen patches are oval-shaped and nevoid, skin-colored or occasionally pigmented, smooth or crinkled. The word shagreen refers to a type of roughened untanned leather.

terms.definition: A congenital fistula in the neck resulting from incomplete closure of a branchial cleft.

terms.name: Branchial cyst
terms.definition: A branchial cyst is a remnant of embryonic development resulting from a failure of obliteration of a branchial cleft and consists of a subcutaneous cystic mass. Cysts are located anterior or posterior to the ear or in the submandibular region.

terms.name: Cholesteatoma
terms.definition: Cholesteatoma is a benign but potentially destructive growth consisting of keratinizing epithelium located in the middle ear and/or mastoid process. In cholesteatoma, a skin cyst grows into the middle ear and mastoid. The cyst is not cancerous but can erode tissue and cause destruction of the ear.

terms.name: Euthyroid goiter
terms.name_zh: 甲状腺功能正常性甲状腺肿
terms.definition: A goiter that is not associated with functional thyroid abnormalities.

terms.name: Supernumerary spleens
terms.definition: The presence of two or more accessory spleens.

terms.name: Maternal diabetes
terms.definition: Maternal diabetes can either be a gestational, mostly type 2 diabetes, or a type 1 diabetes. Essential is the resulting maternal hyperglycemia as a non-specific teratogen, imposing the same risk of congenital malformations to pregnant women with both type 1 and type2 diabetes.

terms.name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Absent finger bone of the hand
terms.definition: Absence of one or more of the phalanges of the hand.

terms.name: Short phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Short (hypoplastic) phalanx of finger, affecting one or more phalanges.

terms.name: Tooth agenesis
synonyms: Failure of development of some teeth
terms.definition: The absence of one or more teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop

terms.name: Low-output congestive heart failure
terms.name_zh: 低输出量充血性心力衰竭
terms.definition: A form of heart failure characterized by reduced cardiac output. This may be seen in patients with heart failure owing to ischemic heart disease, hypertension, cardiomyopathy, and other causes.

terms.name: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus
terms.definition: A form of diabetes insipidus caused by failure of the kidneys to respond to vasopressin (AVP).

terms.name: Anomaly of the upper limb diaphyses
synonyms: Abnormality involving the diaphyses of the upper limbs
Abnormality of shaft of long bone of the upper limbs
Diaphyseal abnormality of the upper limbs
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of a diaphysis of the arm.

terms.name: Abnormal upper limb metaphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the wide portion of upper limb bone
Metaphyseal abnormality of the upper limbs
terms.definition: An anomaly of one or more metaphyses of the arms.

terms.name: Abnormality of upper limb joint
synonyms: Abnormality of the joints of the upper limbs

terms.name: Abnormality of the elbow
terms.definition: An anomaly of the joint that connects the upper and the lower arm.

terms.name: Amelia involving the upper limbs
terms.definition: Amelia of one or both upper limbs.

terms.name: Upper limb phocomelia
terms.definition: Missing or malformed long bones of the upper limbs with the distal parts (the hands) connected to the variably shortened or even absent upper extremity, leading to a flipper-like appearance, as opposed to other forms of limb malformations were either the whole limb is missing (such as amelia), or the distal part of a limb is absent (peromelia).

terms.name: Upper limb peromelia
terms.definition: Peromelia affecting only the upper limbs. That is, the distal parts of the arm are missing leading to stump formation.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the extremities
terms.name_zh: 四肢发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the extremities.

terms.name: Lower limb undergrowth
synonyms: Hypoplasia involving bones of the lower limbs
terms.definition: Leg shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the lower extremity.

terms.name: Aplasia involving bones of the lower limbs
synonyms: Absent bones of the lower limbs

terms.name: Amelia involving the lower limbs
terms.definition: Complete or near-complete absence of a leg.

terms.name: Lower limb phocomelia
terms.definition: Phocomelia affecting only the lower limbs.

terms.name: Lower limb peromelia
terms.definition: Peromelia affecting only the lower limbs. That is, the distal parts of the leg are missing leading to stump formation.

terms.name: Forearm undergrowth
terms.definition: Forearm shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the forearm.

terms.name: Aplasia involving bones of the upper limbs
synonyms: Absent bones of the upper limbs

terms.name: Upper limb undergrowth
synonyms: Hypoplasia involving bones of the upper limbs
terms.definition: Arm shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the upper extremity.

terms.name: Aplasia involving bones of the extremities
Limb undergrowth
synonyms: Hypoplasia involving bones of the extremities
terms.definition: Limb shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the extremities.

terms.name: Amelia
terms.definition: Congenital absence (aplasia) of one or more limbs.

terms.name: Peromelia
terms.definition: The distal parts of the limbs are missing leading to a stump formation.

terms.name: Phocomelia
terms.definition: Missing or malformed long bones of the extremities with the distal parts (such as hands and/or feet) connected to the variably shortened or even absent extremity, leading to a flipper-like appearance, as opposed to other forms of limb malformations were either the entire limb is missing (such as amelia), or the distal part of a limb is absent (peromelia).

terms.name: Peripheral neuropathy
terms.definition: Peripheral neuropathy is a general term for any disorder of the peripheral nervous system. The main clinical features used to classify peripheral neuropathy are distribution, type (mainly demyelinating versus mainly axonal), duration, and course.

terms.name: Mononeuropathy
terms.definition: A focal lesion of a single peripheral nerve. Damage to a sensory nerve is accompanied by sensory impairment of all modalities in the affected anatomic distribution.

terms.name: Abnormal distal phalanx morphology of finger
terms.name_zh: 手指远节指骨形态异常
synonyms: Abnormal terminal phalanges of the hand
Abnormality of the distal phalanges of the hand
Abnormality of the distal phalanx of finger
Abnormality of the outermost finger bone
terms.definition: Any anomaly of distal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Abnormal middle phalanx morphology of the hand
synonyms: Abnormality of the middle finger bones of the hand
Abnormality of the middle phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: An anomaly of middle phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Abnormal proximal phalanx morphology of the hand
terms.name_zh: 手部近节指骨形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the innermost finger bones of the hand
Abnormality of the proximal phalanges of the hand

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanges of the hand
terms.name_zh: 手指远节指骨发育不全/缺如
synonyms: Absent/small outermost finger bone of the hand
Absent/underdeveloped outermost finger bone of the hand
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the distal phalanges.

terms.name: Broad distal phalanx of finger
synonyms: Broad distal phalanges of the hand
Broad, square ends of distal phalanges
terms.definition: Abnormally wide (broad) distal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Bullet-shaped outermost finger bone of the hand
terms.definition: Short and wide distal phalanges that taper distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.

terms.name: Curved distal phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Curved outermost finger bone of the hand

terms.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Osteolytic defects of the outermost finger bone of the hand

terms.name: Patchy sclerosis of distal phalanx of finger
synonyms: Patchy sclerosis of the distal phalanges of the hand
Uneven increase in bone density in outermost finger bone
terms.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the distal phalanges of the hand.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanges of the hand
terms.name_zh: 手中节指骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Absent/small middle finger bone of the hand
Absent/underdeveloped middle finger bone of the hand

terms.name: Broad middle phalanx of finger
synonyms: Broad middle phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Increased width of the middle phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Bullet-shaped middle phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Any of the middle phalanges with short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.

terms.name: Curved middle phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Curved middle finger bonds of the hand

terms.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanges of the hand
Patchy sclerosis of middle phalanx of finger
synonyms: Patchy sclerosis of the middle phalanges of the hand
Uneven increase in bone density in the middle finger bones of the hand
terms.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the middle phalanges of the hand.

terms.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Triangular shaped middle finger bones of the hand

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanges of the hand
terms.name_zh: 手近节指骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Absent/small innermost finger bones of the hand
Absent/underdeveloped innermost finger bones of the hand

terms.name: Broad proximal phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Broad innermost finger bones of the hand
Wide innermost finger bones of the hand
terms.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanges of the finger.

terms.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanges of the hand
terms.name_zh: 手部近节指骨子弹头样畸形
synonyms: Bullet-shaped innermost finger bones of the hand
terms.definition: Short and wide proximal phalanges that taper distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.

terms.name: Curved proximal phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Curved innermost finger bones of the hand

terms.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanges of the hand
Patchy sclerosis of proximal phalanx of finger
synonyms: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanges of the hand
Uneven increase in bone density in innermost finger bone
terms.definition: Uneven increase in bone density of the proximal phalanges of the hand.

terms.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanges of the hand
Triangular shaped distal phalanges of the hand
synonyms: Triangular shaped outermost bone of the hand

terms.name: Cerebellar ataxia associated with quadrupedal gait
terms.name_zh: 伴四足步态的小脑性共济失调
terms.definition: The presence of cerebellar signs and symptoms such as lack of balance associated with quadrupedal gait (locomotion on all four extremities with a 'bear-like' gait with the legs held straight).

terms.name: Simplified gyral pattern
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cerebral cortex with fewer gyri but with normal cortical thickness. This pattern is usually often associated with congenital microcephaly.

terms.name: Broad distal phalanges of all fingers
terms.name_zh: 所有手指远节指骨增宽
terms.definition: Abnormally wide (broad) distal phalanx of finger of all fingers.

terms.name: Aplasia of distal finger phalanx
synonyms: Absent distal phalanges of the hand
Aplasia of the distal phalanges of the hand

terms.name: Short distal phalanx of finger
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the distal phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: Short distance from the end of the finger to the most distal interphalangeal crease or the distal interphalangeal joint flexion point. That is, hypoplasia of one or more of the distal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of hand
terms.name_zh: 手指远节指骨重复畸形
synonyms: Duplication of the outermost bone of hand
Partial/complete duplication of the distal phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: This term applies if one or more of the distal phalanges of the hand are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.

terms.name: Tapered distal phalanges of finger
synonyms: Tapered distal phalanges of the hand
terms.definition: A reduction in diameter of the distal phalanx of finger towards the distal end.

terms.name: Trichorrhexis nodosa
terms.definition: Trichorrhexis nodosa is the formation of nodes along the hair shaft through which breakage readily occurs. It is thus a focal defect in the hair fiber that is characterized by thickening or weak points (nodes) that cause the hair to break off easily. The result is defective, abnormally fragile hair.

terms.name: Abnormality of hair pigmentation
terms.definition: An abnormality of hair pigmentation (color).

terms.name: Abnormality of secondary sexual hair
terms.definition: Abnormality of the growth of secondary sexual hair, which normally ensues during puberty. In males, secondary sexual hair usually comprises body hair, including underarm, abdominal, chest, and pubic hair. In females, secondary sexual hair usually comprises a lesser degree of body hair, most prominently underarm and pubic hair.

terms.name: Localized hirsutism
terms.definition: Abnormally increased hair growth with a localized distribution.

terms.name: High anterior hairline
terms.definition: Distance between the hairline (trichion) and the glabella (the most prominent point on the frontal bone above the root of the nose), in the midline, more than two SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased distance between the hairline and the glabella.

terms.name: Underdeveloped supraorbital ridges
terms.definition: Flatness of the supraorbital portion of the frontal bones.

terms.name: Anotia
terms.definition: Complete absence of any auricular structures.

terms.name: Telangiectasia of the ear
terms.definition: The presence of telangiectasia of the ear.

terms.name: Thickened ears
terms.definition: Increased thickness of the external ear.

terms.name: Abnormality of the crus of the helix
synonyms: Abnormality of the crus of the ear
terms.definition: An abnormality of the crus of the helix, which is the horizontal piece of cartilage located outside the ear canal that divides the upper and lower parts of the ear.

terms.name: Abnormal antitragus morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the antitragus, which is a small tubercle opposite to the tragus of the ear. The antitragus and the tragus are separated by the intertragic notch.

terms.name: Horizontal crus of helix
synonyms: Horizontal orientation of the crus of helix
Horizontal orientation of the ear crus
terms.definition: An abnormal horizontal axis orientation of the crus of the helix. That is, the main axis of the crus of the helix is perpendicular to the medial longitudinal axis of the ear, instead of sloping inferoposteriorly.

terms.name: Underdeveloped crus of the helix
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the crus of the ear
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the crus of the helix. That is, flatter and/or shorter crus helix than average.

terms.name: Prominent crus of helix
synonyms: Abnormal prominence of the crus of the ear
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally prominent of the crus of the helix. That is, development of the crus helix to the same degree as an average antihelix stem or helix.

terms.name: Unilateral deafness
terms.definition: A unilateral absence of sensory perception of sound.

terms.name: Crumpled ear
terms.definition: Distortion of the course of the normal folds of the ear and the appearance of supernumerary crura and folds.

terms.name: Cleft helix
terms.definition: A notched form of the helix of the ear. That is, a defect in the continuity of the helix, which may occur at any point along its length.

terms.name: Conjunctival nodule
terms.definition: Presence of nodules in the conjunctiva of the eye.

terms.name: Prominent ear helix
terms.definition: Abnormally prominent ear helix.

terms.name: Thin ear helix
terms.definition: Decreased thickness of the helix of the ear.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the earlobes
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the ear lobes.

terms.name: Attached earlobe
terms.definition: Attachment of the lobe to the side of the face at the lowest point of the lobe without curving upward.

terms.name: Anterior creases of earlobe
terms.definition: Sharply demarcated, typically linear and approximately horizontal, indentations in the outer surface of the ear lobe.

terms.name: Uplifted earlobe
terms.definition: An abnormal orientation of the earlobes such that they point out- and upward. That is, the lateral surface of ear lobe faces superiorly.

terms.name: Aplasia of the middle ear ossicles
terms.definition: Absence of the middle ear ossicles, malleus, incus, and stapes.

terms.name: Abnormal temporal bone morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the temporal bone of the skull, which is situated at the sides and base of the skull roughly underlying the region of the face known as the temple.

terms.name: Abnormal tragus morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the tragus.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tragus
terms.name_zh: 耳屏发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the tragus.

terms.name: Cyclopia
terms.definition: Cyclopia is a congenital abnormality in which there is only one eye. That eye is centrally placed in the area normally occupied by the root of the nose.

terms.name: Corneal asymmetry
terms.definition: The presence of a size difference between the left and right cornea.

terms.name: Anisocoria
terms.definition: Anisocoria, or unequal pupil size, may represent a benign physiologic variant or a manifestation of disease.

terms.name: Persistent pupillary membrane
terms.definition: The presence of remnants of a fetal membrane that persist as strands of tissue crossing the pupil.

terms.name: Ectopia pupillae
terms.definition: A malposition of the pupil owing to a developmental defect of the iris.

terms.name: Retinoblastoma
terms.definition: A tumor of the eye originating from cells of the retina.

terms.name: Nevus of Ota
terms.definition: A dermal melanocytic hamartoma that presents as bluish hyperpigmentation on the face along the first or second branches of the trigeminal nerve. Nevus of Ota may involve the sclera.

terms.name: Duane anomaly
synonyms: Globe retraction and deviation on adduction
Limited eye motility from Duane anomaly
Limited eye movement from Duane anomaly
terms.definition: A condition associated with a limitation of the horizontal ocular movement with retraction of the globe and narrowing of the palpebral fissure on adduction

terms.name: Vascular remnant arising from the disk
terms.definition: Persistence of the hyaloid artery, which is the embryonic artery that runs from the optic disc to the posterior lens capsule may persist; the site of attachment may form an opacity. The hyaloid artery is a branch of the ophthalmic artery, and usually regresses completely before birth.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the nose
terms.definition: Underdevelopment or absence of the nose or parts thereof.

terms.name: Epiphora
terms.definition: Abnormally increased lacrimation, that is, excessive tearing (watering eye).

terms.name: Aplasia of the nose
terms.definition: Complete absence of all nasal structures.

terms.name: Thick nasal alae
terms.definition: Increase in bulk of the ala nasi.

terms.name: Abnormal columella morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the columella.

terms.name: Asymmetry of the nares
terms.definition: Asymmetry or size difference between the left and right nostril.

terms.name: Enlarged naris
terms.definition: Increased aperture of the nostril.

terms.name: Single naris
terms.definition: The presence of only a single nostril.

terms.name: Narrow naris
terms.definition: Slender, slit-like aperture of the nostril.

terms.name: Supernumerary naris
terms.definition: The presence of more than two nostrils.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nasal septum
terms.name_zh: 鼻中隔发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasal septum.

terms.name: Narrow nasal septum
terms.definition: Abnormally narrow nasal septum.

terms.name: Facial hirsutism
terms.definition: Excess facial hair.

terms.name: Sunken cheeks
terms.definition: Lack or loss of the soft tissues between the zygomata and mandible.

terms.name: Mandibular aplasia
synonyms: Aplasia of the lower jaw bone
Failure of development of lower jaw
terms.definition: Absence of the mandible.

terms.name: Asymmetry of the mandible
synonyms: Lower jaw shifted to one side
terms.definition: Lack of symmetry between the left and right mandible.

terms.name: Asymmetry of the mouth
terms.definition: The presence of an asymmetric mouth.

terms.name: Duplication of thumb phalanx
synonyms: Complete/partial duplication of phalanges of the thumb
terms.definition: Complete or partial duplication of the phalanges of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx), a partially fused appearance of the two bones (bifid), two separate bones appearing side to side, or completely duplicated phalanges (proximal and distal phalanx of the thumb and/or 1st metacarpal). In contrast to the phalanges of the digits 2-5 (proximal, middle and distal), the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.

terms.name: Complete duplication of thumb phalanx
synonyms: Complete duplication of the phalanges of the thumb
terms.definition: A complete duplication affecting one or more of the phalanges of the thumb. As opposed to a partial duplication were there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones, a complete duplication leads to two separate bones appearing side to side (radio-ulnar axis) as seen on x-rays. A duplication leading to an accessory bone appearing in the proximo-distal axis on x-rays, this is actually a different entity called a Pseudoepiphyses (see according terms) sometimes also referred to as Hyperphalangism.

terms.name: Partial duplication of thumb phalanx
synonyms: Partial duplication of the phalanges of the thumb
Partial duplication of the thumb bones
terms.definition: A partial duplication, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance, affecting one or more of the phalanges of the thumb. As opposed to a complete duplication there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones.

terms.name: Duplication of phalanx of 2nd finger
synonyms: Duplication of the bones of index finger
Partial/complete duplication of phalanges of the 2nd finger
terms.definition: This term applies if one or more of the phalanges of the 2nd finger are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.

terms.name_zh: 第2指近节指骨重复畸形
synonyms: Duplication of the proximal bone of the index finger
Partial/complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
terms.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the second proximal phalanx of hand.

terms.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
terms.name_zh: 第2指远节指骨重复畸形
synonyms: Partial/complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
Partial/complete duplication of the outermost bone of the index finger

terms.name: Duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
terms.name_zh: 第2指中节指骨重复畸形
synonyms: Partial/complete duplication of the middle bone of the index finger

terms.name_zh: 第二指远节指骨完全重复畸形
synonyms: Complete duplication of the outermost bone of the index finger
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of index finger.

synonyms: Bifid terminal phalanx of the 2nd finger
Notched outermost bone of the index finger
Partial duplication of the outermost bone of the 2nd finger
terms.definition: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of index finger, seen on x-rays as a broad and/or bifid phalanx.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
terms.name_zh: 第二指中节指骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the middle bone of the index finger
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of index finger.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
synonyms: Partial duplication of the middle bone of the index finger
terms.definition: Partial duplication of the middle phalanx of index finger, seen on x-rays as a broad and/or bifid phalanx.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
terms.name_zh: 第二指近节指骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the proximal bone of the index finger
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the second proximal phalanx of hand.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
synonyms: Partial duplication of the proximal bones of the index finger
terms.definition: Partial duplication of the second proximal phalanx of hand, seen on x-rays as a broad and/or bifid phalanx.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the phalanges of the 2nd finger
synonyms: Partial duplication of the bones of the index finger
terms.definition: A partial duplication, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance, affecting one or more of the phalanges of the 2nd finger. As opposed to a complete duplication there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the phalanges of the 2nd finger
synonyms: Complete duplication of the bones of the index finger
terms.definition: A complete duplication affecting one or more of the phalanges of the 2nd finger. As opposed to a partial duplication were there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones, a complete duplication leads to two separate bones appearing side to side (radio-ulnar axis) as seen on x-rays. A duplication leading to an accessory bone appearing in the proximo-distal axis on x-rays, is a different entity called a Pseudoepiphyses (see according terms) sometimes also referred to as Hyperphalangism.

terms.name: Duplication of phalanx of 3rd finger
synonyms: Partial/complete duplication of phalanges of the 3rd finger
terms.definition: This term applies if one or more of the phalanges of the 3rd finger are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the phalanges of the 3rd finger
synonyms: Complete duplication of middle finger bones
terms.definition: A complete duplication affecting one or more of the phalanges of the 3rd finger. As opposed to a partial duplication were there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones, a complete duplication leads to two separate bones appearing side to side (radio-ulnar axis) as seen on x-rays. A duplication leading to an accessory bone appearing in the proximo-distal axis on x-rays, this is actually a different entity called a Pseudoepiphyses (see according terms) sometimes also referred to as Hyperphalangism.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the phalanges of the 3rd finger
synonyms: Partial duplication of middle finger bones
terms.definition: A partial duplication, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance, affecting one or more of the phalanges of the 3rd finger. As opposed to a complete duplication there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones.

terms.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.name_zh: 第3指远节指骨重复畸形
synonyms: Partial/complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
Partial/complete duplication of the outermost bone of the middle finger

terms.name: Duplication of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger

synonyms: Duplication of the middle bone of the middle finger
Partial/complete duplication of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the middle phalanx of middle finger.

terms.name: Duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.name_zh: 第3指近节指骨重复畸形
synonyms: Duplication of the proximal bone of the middle finger
Partial/complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the third proximal phalanx of hand.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.name_zh: 第三指远节指骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the outermost bone of the 3rd finger
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of middle finger

terms.name: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.name_zh: 第三指中节指骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the middle bone of the middle finger
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of middle finger.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
terms.name_zh: 第三指近节指骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the innermost bone of the 3rd finger
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the third proximal phalanx of hand.

synonyms: Bifid terminal phalanx of the 3rd finger
Notched outermost bone of the middle finger

terms.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the 1st long bone of hand
terms.definition: In contrast to the metacarpals 2-5, the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5 (whereas the proximal phalanx of the thumb is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits). The epiphysis of the first metacarpal is localized at the proximal end (as seen in the proximal phalanges of the other digits), whereas the epiphyses of the other metacarpal bones are located at the distal end. This term applies if the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal is in any way abnormal, referring to age and gender depending norms, as seen on x-rays.

synonyms: Absent end part of the 1st long bone of hand

terms.name: Bracket epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
synonyms: Bracket shaped end part of 1st long bone of hand
terms.definition: An epiphysis that curves around from its transverse orientation to a longitudinal one from proximal to distal along one side of the phalanx, thus resembling the letter 'C' and forming a bracket around the diaphysis. This results in a so called delta phalanx characterized by a triangular or trapezoidal shaped bone with a C-shaped epiphyseal plate.

terms.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal

terms.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance.

terms.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal

terms.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the 1st metacarpal with respect to age-dependent norms.

terms.name: Irregular epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal

terms.name: Ivory epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal

terms.definition: The epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal appears hard and dense like ivory. An ivory epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.

terms.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
terms.definition: The epiphysis of the first metacarpal is localized at the proximal end of the metacarpal bone although an accessory epiphysis may be located at the distal end of the metacarpal.

terms.name: Stomatitis
terms.definition: Stomatitis is an inflammation of the mucous membranes of any of the structures in the mouth.

terms.name: Cleft lower lip
terms.definition: A gap in the lower lip.

terms.name: Thin lower lip vermilion
synonyms: Decreased height of lower lip vermilion
Decreased volume of lower lip vermilion
Thin vermilion border of lower lip
terms.definition: Height of the vermilion of the medial part of the lower lip more than 2 SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently reduced height of the vermilion of the lower lip in the frontal view (subjective).

terms.name: Intra-oral hyperpigmentation
terms.definition: Increased pigmentation, either focal or generalized, of the mucosa of the mouth.

terms.name: Oral synechia
terms.definition: Fibrous band between the mucosal surfaces of the upper and lower alveolar ridges.

terms.name: Abnormal salivary gland morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the salivary glands, the exocrine glands that produce saliva.

terms.name: Abnormality of the submandibular glands
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the submandibular glands, which are the salivary glands that are located beneath the floor of the mouth, superior to the digastric muscles.

terms.name: Abnormality of the sublingual glands
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the sublingual glands, which are the salivary glands that are located beneath the floor of the mouth anterior to the submandibular glands.

terms.name: Cleft maxillary alveolar ridge
synonyms: Cleft of alveolar ridge of maxilla
terms.definition: A gap (cleft) affecting one of the alveolar ridges, which are the protuberances in the mouth that contain the sockets (alveoli) of the teeth. An alveolar cleft can affect all structures of the alveolar ridge, including the gingiva, other mucosa, periosteum, alveolar bone, and teeth. Alveolar cleft occurs in response to divergence from normal development during frontonasal prominence growth, contact, and fusion. The most common alveolar portion of the cleft is located between the lateral incisor and the canine.

terms.name: Short hard palate
terms.definition: Distance between the labial point of the incisive papilla to the midline junction of the hard and soft palate more than 2 SD below the mean (objective) or apparently decreased length of the hard palate (subjective).

terms.name: Prominent palatine ridges
terms.definition: Increased size and/or number of soft tissue folds on the palatal side of the maxillary alveolar ridge.

terms.name: Absent uvula
terms.definition: Lack of the uvula.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the uvula
terms.name_zh: 悬雍垂发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Underdevelopment or absence of the uvula.

terms.name: Palate fistula
terms.definition: A fistula which connects the oral cavity and the pharyngeal area via the aspects of the soft palate.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tongue
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the tongue.

terms.name: Ankyloglossia
terms.definition: Short or anteriorly attached lingual frenulum, associated with limited mobility of the tongue.

terms.name: Bifid tongue
terms.definition: Tongue with a median apical indentation or fork.

terms.name: Smooth tongue
terms.definition: Glossy appearance of the entire tongue surface.

terms.name: Abnormal dentin morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of dentin.

terms.name: Abnormally low-pitched voice
terms.definition: A persistent (minutes to hours) abnormal decrease in the pitch of the voice for the context or social situation or significantly different from the baseline of the individual.

terms.name: Spinal dysraphism
synonyms: Incomplete closure of the vertebral arch
terms.definition: A heterogeneous group of congenital spinal anomalies that result from defective closure of the neural tube early in fetal life.

terms.name: Spinal cord tumor
terms.definition: A neoplasm affecting the spinal cord.

terms.name: Abnormal spinal meningeal morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the spinal meninges, the system of membranes (dura mater, the arachnoid mater, and the pia mater) which envelops the spinal cord.

terms.name: Spinal meningeal diverticulum
terms.definition: An outpouching of the spinal meninges.

terms.name: Absence of the sacrum
terms.definition: Absence (aplasia) of the sacrum.

terms.name: Short thorax
synonyms: Shorter than typical length between neck and abdomen
terms.definition: Reduced inferior to superior extent of the thorax.

terms.name: Stridor
terms.definition: Stridor is a high pitched sound resulting from turbulent air flow in the upper airway.

terms.name: Asternia
terms.definition: The congenital absence of the sternum.

terms.name: Bifid sternum
terms.definition: The sternal cleft is a rare congenital anomaly resulting from a fusion failure of the sternum.

terms.name: Chylothorax
terms.definition: Accumulation of excessive amounts of lymphatic fluid (chyle) in the pleural cavity.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the breasts
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the breasts.

terms.name: Asymmetry of the breasts
terms.definition: The presence of asymmetrical breasts.

terms.name: Breast hypertrophy
terms.definition: The presence of hypertrophy of the breast.

terms.name: Premature thelarche
terms.definition: Premature development of the breasts.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the diaphragm
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the diaphragm.

terms.name: Ebstein anomaly of the tricuspid valve
synonyms: Ebstein's anomaly of the tricuspid valve
terms.definition: Ebstein's anomaly refers to an abnormally placed and deformed tricuspid valve characterized by apical displacement of the septal and posterior tricuspid valve leaflets, leading to atrialization of the right ventricle with a variable degree of malformation and displacement of the anterior leaflet.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Partial duplication of the innermost 2nd toe bone
Partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of the second toe
terms.definition: Partial duplication of proximal phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd toe
terms.name_zh: 第二趾远节趾骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the outermost bone of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Partial duplication of the outermost bone of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd toe
terms.name_zh: 第二趾中节趾骨完全重复
synonyms: Complete duplication of the middle bone of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Complete duplication of middle phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Partial duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Partial duplication of the middle bone of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Partial duplication of middle phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Partial duplication of phalanx of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Partial duplication of a phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Complete duplication of the phalanges of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Complete duplication of the 2nd toe bones
terms.definition: Complete duplication of a phalanx of second toe.

terms.name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the 2nd toe
Short phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Short phalanx of the second toe
terms.definition: Reduced length of one or more phalanx of second toe as a result of developmental hypoplasia.

terms.name: Absent distal phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Absent distal phalanx of the second toe
Absent outermost bone of the 2nd toe
Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Absence of distal phalanx of the second toe as a result of developmental aplasia.

terms.name: Short distal phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Hypoplastic/small distal phalanx of the 2nd toe
Short distal phalanx of the second toe
Short outermost bone of the 2nd toe
terms.definition: Reduced length of the distal phalanx of the second toe as a result of developmental hypoplasia.

terms.name: Aplasia of the middle phalanx of the 2nd toe
terms.name_zh: 第二趾中节趾骨发育不全

terms.name: Short middle phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Hypoplastic/small middle phalanx of the 2nd toe
Short middle phalanx of the second toe
terms.definition: Reduced length of the middle phalanx of second toe as a result of developmental hypoplasia.

terms.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd toe
terms.name_zh: 第二趾近节趾骨发育不全

terms.name: Short proximal phalanx of the 2nd toe
synonyms: Hypoplastic/small proximal phalanx of the 2nd toe
Short proximal phalanx of the second toe
terms.definition: Reduced length of the proximal phalanx of second toe as a result of developmental hypoplasia.

terms.name: Abnormal ventricular septum morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the interventricular septum.

terms.name: Ectopic accessory toe-like appendage
terms.definition: In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the fibular side of the foot, next top the little toe), preaxial (on the tibial side of the foot, next to the big toe) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between big and little toe), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).

terms.name: Ectopic accessory finger-like appendage
terms.definition: In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the ulnar side of the hand, next to the little finger), preaxial (on the radial side of the hand, next to the thumb) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between thumb and little finger), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).

terms.name: Polydactyly
synonyms: More than five fingers or toes on hands or feet
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of supernumerary fingers or toes.

terms.name: Bifid femur
terms.definition: A bifid or bifurcated appearance of the femur as seen on x-rays, possible appearing as a more or less severe bowing of the upper leg. Might be associated with hip dysplasia on the affected side.

terms.name: Pulmonic regurgitation
terms.definition: The retrograde (backwards) flow of blood through the pulmonary valve into the right ventricle during diastole.

terms.name: Primum atrial septal defect
terms.definition: An ostium primum atrial septal defect is located in the most anterior and inferior aspect of the atrial septum. The ostium primum refers to an anterior and inferior opening (ostium) within the septum primum, which divides the rudimentary atrium during fetal development. The ostium primum is normally sealed by fusion of the superior and inferior endocardial cushions around 5 weeks' gestation. Ostium primum defects result from a failure of the fusion of the embryologic endocardial cushion and septum primum.

terms.name: Tricuspid stenosis
terms.definition: A narrowing of the orifice of the tricuspid valve of the heart.

terms.name: Anal fistula
terms.definition: An abnormal connection between the epithelialised surface of the anal canal and the perianal skin.

terms.name: Colonic atresia
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the colon. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the colon.

terms.name: Esophageal stenosis
terms.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the lumen of the esophagus.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the spleen
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the spleen.

terms.name: Ectopia of the spleen
terms.definition: An abnormal (non-anatomic) location of the spleen.

terms.name: Pelvic bone asymmetry
terms.definition: Pelvic asymmetry refers to asymmetric positioning of landmarks on the two sides of the pelvis and may have a structural or functional etiology.

terms.name: Acetabular spurs
terms.definition: The presence of osteophytes (bone spurs), i.e., of bony projections originating from the acetabulum.

terms.name: Steep acetabular roof
terms.definition: An exaggeration of the normal arched form of the acetabular roof such that it takes on a steep appearance.

terms.name: Abnormal greater sciatic notch morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the greater sacrosciatic notch
terms.definition: An abnormality of the sacrosciatic notch, i.e., the deep indentation in the posterior border of the hip bone at the point of union of the ilium and ischium.

terms.name: Female pseudohermaphroditism
terms.definition: Hermaphroditism refers to a discrepancy between the morphology of the gonads and that of the external genitalia. In female pseudohermaphroditism, the genotype is female (XX) and the gonads are ovaries, but the external genitalia are virilized.

terms.name: True hermaphroditism
terms.definition: The presence of both ovarian and testicular tissues either in the same or in opposite gonads. Affected persons have ambiguous genitalia and may have 46,XX or 46,XY karyotypes or 46,XX/XY mosaicism.

terms.name: Abnormality of the female genitalia
terms.definition: Abnormality of the female genital system.

terms.name: Abnormality of the male genitalia
terms.definition: Abnormality of the male genital system.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ovary
terms.name_zh: 卵巢发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the ovary.

terms.name: Aplasia of the ovary
terms.definition: Aplasia, that is failure to develop, of the ovary.

terms.name: Streak ovary
terms.definition: A developmental disorder characterized by the progressive loss of primordial germ cells in the developing ovaries of an embryo, leading to hypoplastic ovaries composed of wavy connective tissue with occasional clumps of granulosa cells, and frequently mesonephric or hilar cells.

terms.name: Precocious puberty in females
terms.definition: The onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the testes
terms.name_zh: 睾丸发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the testes.

terms.name: Absent testis
terms.definition: Testis not palpable in the scrotum or inguinal canal.

terms.name: Supernumerary testes
terms.definition: The presence of more than two testes.

terms.name: Oligosacchariduria
terms.definition: Increased urinary excretion of oligosaccharides (low molecular weight carbohydrate chains composed of at least three monosaccharide subunits), derived from a partial degradation of glycoproteins.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating porphyrin concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of porphyrins in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Porphyrinuria
terms.definition: Abnormally increased excretion of porphyrins in the urine.

terms.name: Bladder stones
terms.definition: Buildups of minerals that form in the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Cloacal exstrophy
terms.definition: Cloacal exstrophy is a severe anterior abdominal wall defect in which the two hemibladders are visible and are separated by a midline intestinal plate, an omphalocele, and an imperforate anus.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the bladder
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Aplasia of the bladder
terms.definition: Aplasia (absence) of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Abnormality of the urachus
terms.definition: Abnormality of the urachus.

terms.name: Patent urachus
terms.definition: Persistence of the urachal canal resulting in a canal between the bladder and the umbilicus.

terms.name: Urethral fistula
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormal connection between the urethra and another organ or the skin.

terms.name: Urethral valve
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormal membrane obstructing the urethra.

terms.name: Acromelia of the upper limbs
terms.definition: Shortening of the arms predominantly affecting terminal parts of the arm in relation to the upper and middle limb segments.

terms.name: Amniotic constriction rings of arms
terms.definition: Amniotic constriction rings affecting the arms.

terms.name: Hypertrophy of the upper limb
