terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the upper limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).

terms.name: Hyperextensibility at elbow
terms.definition: The ability of the elbow joint to move beyond its normal range of motion.

terms.name: Abnormality of the hypothenar eminence
terms.definition: An abnormality of the hypothenar eminence, i.e., of the muscles on the ulnar side of the palm of the hand (i.e., on the side of the little finger).

terms.name: Small hypothenar eminence
terms.definition: Reduced muscle mass on the ulnar side of the palm, that is, reduction in size of the hypothenar eminence.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the palmar creases
terms.name_zh: 掌纹发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the palmar creases.

terms.name: Absent palmar crease
terms.definition: The absence of the major creases of the palm (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, or thenar crease).

terms.name: Abnormality of the palmar creases
terms.definition: An abnormality of the creases of the skin of palm of hand.

terms.name: Digital constriction ring
terms.definition: A narrow segment of significantly reduced circumference of a digit.

terms.name: Osseous finger syndactyly
terms.definition: Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones.

terms.name: Long metacarpals
terms.definition: An abnormally increased length of the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Acromelia of the lower limbs
terms.definition: Shortening of the legs predominantly affecting terminal parts of the leg in relation to the upper and middle arm segments.

terms.name: Amniotic constriction rings of legs
terms.definition: Amniotic constriction rings affecting the legs.

terms.name: Hypertrophy of the lower limb
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the lower limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).

terms.name: Sirenomelia
terms.definition: A developmental defect in which the legs are fused together.

terms.name: Bipartite patella
terms.definition: A developmental defect that occurs if the two halves of the patella fail to fuse in early childhood.

terms.name: Patellar subluxation
terms.definition: The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar subluxation refers to an unstable kneecap that does not slide centrally within its groove, i.e., a partial dislocation of the patella.

terms.name: Hyperextensibility of the knee
terms.definition: The ability of the knee joint to extend beyond its normal range of motion (the lower leg is moved beyond a straight position with respect to the thigh).

terms.name: Limitation of knee mobility
terms.definition: An abnormal limitation of knee joint mobility.

terms.name: Fibular bowing
terms.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the fibula.

terms.name: Fibular duplication
terms.definition: Duplication of the fibula. This may occur as a part of diplopodia (accessory tarsal or metatarsal bone). Diplopodia with double fibula is an extremely rare condition.

terms.name: Increased length of the tibia
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the length of the tibia.

terms.name: Limitation of movement at ankles
terms.definition: An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the ankle joint.

terms.name: Abnormal plantar dermatoglyphics
terms.definition: An abnormality of dermatoglyphs on the toes and soles, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of sole of foot.

terms.name: Foot asymmetry
terms.definition: A difference in size or shape between the left and right foot.

terms.name: Metatarsus valgus
terms.definition: A condition in which the anterior part of the foot rotates outward away from the midline of the body and the heel remains straight.

terms.name: Aplasia of the tarsal bones
terms.definition: Absence of the tarsal bones.

terms.name: Hypermobility of toe joints
terms.definition: An ability of the toe joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

terms.name: Long toe
terms.definition: Toes that appear disproportionately long compared to the foot.

terms.name: Adrenal calcification
terms.definition: Calcification within the adrenal glands.

terms.name: Pituitary calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Hyperpituitarism
terms.definition: Hypersecretion of one or more pituitary hormones. This can occur in conditions in which deficiency in the target organ leads to decreased hormonal feedback, or as a primary condition most usually in connection with a pituitary adenoma.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thymus
terms.name_zh: 胸腺发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the thymus.

terms.name: Thymus hyperplasia
terms.definition: Enlargement of the thymus.

terms.name: Ectopic thymus tissue
terms.definition: The presence of ectopic thymus tissue. Normally, cells of the ventral bud of the third pharyngeal pouch detach and migrate in the eighth gestational week caudally and medially towards the location of the mature thyroid. They migrate further retrosternally into the superior mediastinum. There are two main ways ectopic thymus tissue can develop. Either cells detach along the descensus path and proliferate, thereby forming accessory thymus tissue, or the entire gland fails to descend.

terms.name: Thyroglossal cyst
terms.definition: An abnormality of the thyroid gland owing to the presence of a fibrous cyst resulting from the persistence of the thyroglossal duct.

terms.name: Increased fetal movement
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in quantity or strength of fetal movements.

terms.name: Gait apraxia
terms.definition: Gait apraxia affecting the ability to make walking movements with the legs.

terms.name: Dyslexia
terms.definition: A learning disorder characterized primarily by difficulties in learning to read and spell. Dyslectic children also exhibit a tendency to read words from right to left and to confuse letters such as b and d whose orientation is important for their identification. Children with dyslexia appear to be impaired in phonemic skills (the ability to associate visual symbols with the sounds they represent).

terms.name: Alexia
terms.definition: An acquired type of sensory aphasia where damage to the brain leads to the loss of the ability to read.

terms.name: Disturbed sensory perception
terms.definition: Alteration or impairment in the processing or interpretation of sensory information can lead to abnormal perceptions or experiences.

terms.name: Finger agnosia
terms.definition: The examiner identified the inability to name, move, or touch specific fingers.

terms.name: Dysgraphia
terms.definition: A writing disability in the absence of motor or sensory deficits of the upper extremities, resulting in an impairment in the ability to write regardless of the ability to read and not due to intellectual impairment.

terms.name: Astereognosis
terms.definition: Tactile agnosia refers to the inability to recognize objects by touch, while the inability to discriminate shape and size by touch is also a related condition.

terms.name: Prosopagnosia
terms.definition: Inability to recognize faces of familiar persons.

terms.name: Echolalia
terms.definition: Echolalia is the automatic imitative repetition of sounds, words, or phrases in the absence of explicit awareness. The repeated words or phrases are typically odd or used in a non-social manner. These can be words or phrases that the affected individual has heard or invented.

terms.name: Palatal tremor
terms.definition: Palatal tremor (PT) is an involuntary, rhythmic and oscillatory movement of the soft palate. PT is a rare type of tremor involving the soft palate. It can be unilateral or bilateral.

terms.name: Spinal myoclonus
terms.definition: Spinal myoclonus is generally due to a tumor, infection, injury, or degenerative process of the spinal cord, and is characterized by involuntary rhythmic muscle contractions, usually at a rate of more than one per second. Myoclonus occurs synchronously in several muscles and can be increased in severity and frequency by fatigue or stress, but is usually unaffected by sensory stimuli. Spinal myoclonus ceases during sleep or anesthesia.

terms.name: Paroxysmal vertigo
terms.definition: Paroxysmal episodes of vertigo.

terms.name: Spasmus nutans
terms.definition: The combination of pendular nystagmus, head nodding, and torticollis.

terms.name: Transient global amnesia
terms.definition: A paroxysmal, transient loss of memory function with preservation of immediate recall and remote memory but with a severe impairment of memory for recent events and ability to retain new information.

terms.name: Sleep apnea
terms.definition: An intermittent cessation of airflow at the mouth and nose during sleep is known as sleep apnea. Apneas that last at least 10 seconds are considered significant, but individuals with sleep apnea may experience apneas lasting from 20 seconds up to 2 or 3 minutes. Patients may have up to 15 events per hour of sleep.

terms.name: Central sleep apnea
terms.definition: Sleep apnea results from a temporary loss of the central drive to the muscles responsible for breathing.

terms.name: Wide cranial sutures
terms.definition: An abnormally increased width of the cranial sutures for age-related norms (generally resulting from delayed closure).

terms.name: Small sella turcica
terms.definition: An abnormally small sella turcica.

terms.name: Thin calvarium
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally thin calvarium.

terms.name: Advanced pneumatization of cranial sinuses
terms.definition: A degree of pneumatization that is increased compared to age-related norms.

terms.name: Cutis gyrata of scalp
synonyms: Furrows in thickened skin on top of scalp
Thickened folds on top of scalp
terms.definition: The presence of convoluted folds and furrows formed from thickened skin of the scalp, resembling cerebriform pattern. The scalp has convoluted and elevated folds, 1 to 2 cm in thickness. The convolutions generally cannot be flattened by traction.

terms.name: Vestibular nystagmus
terms.definition: Nystagmus due to disturbance of the vestibular system; eye movements are rhythmic, with slow and fast components.

terms.name: Opsoclonus
terms.definition: Bursts of large-amplitude multidirectional saccades without intersaccadic interval

terms.name: Vertical nystagmus
terms.definition: Vertical nystagmus may present with either up-beating or down-beating eye movements or both. When present in the straight-ahead position of gaze it is referred to as upbeat nystagmus or downbeat nystagmus.

terms.name: Downbeat nystagmus
terms.definition: Downbeat nystagmus is a type of fixation nystagmus with the fast phase beating in a downward direction. It generally increases when looking to the side and down and when lying prone.

terms.name: Muscle fibrillation
terms.definition: Fine, rapid twitching of individual muscle fibers with little or no movement of the muscle as a whole as ascertained by electromyography (EMG). If a motor neuron or its axon is destroyed, the muscle fibers it innervates undergo denervation atrophy. This leads to hypersensitivity of individual muscle fibers to acetyl choline so that they may contract spontaneously. Isolated activity of individual muscle fibers is generally so fine it cannot be seen through the intact skin, although it can be recorded as a short-duration spike in the EMG.

terms.name: Muscle flaccidity
terms.definition: A type of paralysis in which a muscle becomes soft and yields to passive stretching, which results from loss of all or practically all peripheral motor nerves that innervated the muscle. Muscle tone is reduced and the affected muscles undergo extreme atrophy within months of the loss of innervation.

terms.name: Percussion myotonia
synonyms: Transient swelling of muscle induced by percussion
terms.definition: A localized myotonic contraction in a muscle in reaction to percussion (tapping with the examiner's finger, a rubber percussion hammer, or a similar object).

terms.name: Weakness due to upper motor neuron dysfunction
synonyms: Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts
terms.definition: Paralysis of voluntary muscles means loss of contraction due to interruption of one or more motor pathways from the brain to the muscle fibers. Although the word paralysis is often used interchangeably to mean either complete or partial loss of muscle strength, it is preferable to use paralysis or plegia for complete or severe loss of muscle strength, and paresis for partial or slight loss. Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts is related to a lesion in the corticospinal, corticobulbar or brainstem descending (subcorticospinal) neurons.

terms.name: Paraplegia
terms.definition: Severe or complete weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities.

terms.name: Paraplegia/paraparesis
terms.definition: Weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities. Paraplegia refers to a severe or complete loss of strength, whereas paraparesis refers to a relatively mild loss of strength.

terms.name: Oculogyric crisis
terms.definition: An acute dystonic reaction with blepharospasm, periorbital twitches, and protracted fixed staring episodes. There may be a maximal upward deviation of the eyes in the sustained fashion. Oculogyric crisis can be triggered by a number of factors including neuroleptic medications.

terms.name: Cutaneous finger syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal joint of the adjacent fingers.

terms.name: Overlapping fingers
terms.definition: A finger resting on the dorsal surface of an adjacent digit when the hand is at rest.

terms.name: Abnormality of the clivus
terms.definition: An abnormality of the clivus, which is the inclined bony region of the posterior cranial fossa located between the sella turcica and the foramen magnum.

terms.name: Vertical clivus
terms.definition: An abnormal vertical orientation of the clivus (which normally forms a kind of slope from the sella turcica down to the region of the foramen magnum).

terms.name: Undulate clavicle
terms.definition: An abnormally wavy surface or edge of the clavicles.

terms.name: Undulate ribs
terms.definition: An abnormally wavy surface or edge of the ribs.

terms.name: Bifid epiglottis
terms.definition: A midline anterior-posterior cleft of the epiglottis that involves at least two-thirds of the epiglottic leaf. It is a useful feature for clinical diagnosis because it appears to be very rare in syndromes other than Pallister-Hall-Syndrome and is also rare as an isolated malformation.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the Epiglottis
terms.definition: This term applies if the Epiglottis is absent or hypoplastic.

terms.name: Hamartoma
terms.definition: A disordered proliferation of mature tissues that is native to the site of origin, e.g., exostoses, nevi and soft tissue hamartomas. Although most hamartomas are benign, some histologic subtypes, e.g., neuromuscular hamartoma, may proliferate aggressively such as mesenchymal cystic hamartoma, Sclerosing epithelial hamartoma, Sclerosing metanephric hamartoma.

terms.name: Y-shaped metatarsals
terms.definition: Y-shaped metatarsals are the result of a partial fusion of two metatarsal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metatarsals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.

terms.name: Hamartoma of the eye
terms.definition: A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) which can originate from any tissue of the eye.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血7-脱氢胆固醇浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Low maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
terms.name_zh: 母体循环甲胎蛋白浓度低
terms.definition: An abnormally low concentration of serum alpha-fetoprotein as compared to normal values for gestational-age.

terms.name: Elevated circulating phytanic acid concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal elevation of phytanic acid.

terms.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the femoral head
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the innermost thighbone
Abnormality of the proximal femoral epiphysis
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Dysplasia of the femoral head
terms.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the femoral head.

terms.name: Intracranial cystic lesion
terms.definition: A cystic lesion originating within the brain.

terms.name: Bracket epiphyses
synonyms: Bracket shaped end part of long bone

terms.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis
terms.definition: Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery.

terms.name: Enlarged epiphyses
terms.definition: Increased size of epiphyses.

terms.name: Irregular epiphyses
synonyms: Irregular end part of long bone
terms.definition: An alteration of the normally smooth contour of the epiphysis leading to an irregular appearance.

terms.name: Ivory epiphyses
synonyms: Increased bone density in end part of bone
terms.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.

terms.name: Small epiphyses
terms.definition: Reduction in the size or volume of epiphyses.

terms.name: Triangular epiphysis
terms.definition: Longitudinal epiphyseal bracket or bracket epiphysis is an uncommon disorder of growth. Alternatively known as a delta phalanx, it is due to an anomalous secondary ossification center that extends longitudinally along the diaphysis. Although rare, longitudinal epiphyseal bracket most commonly manifests in the hands as clinodactyly and in the feet as hallux varus.

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at each end of a long bone, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Abnormality of the distal femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the outermost thighbone
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Abnormality of the proximal tibial epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of innermost shankbone
Abnormality of the end part of innermost shinbone
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the tibia.

terms.name: Abnormality of the distal tibial epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of outermost shankbone
Abnormality of the end part of outermost shinbone

terms.name: Abnormal fibular epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the calf bone

terms.name: Abnormality of the proximal fibular epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of the innermost end part of calf bone
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the fibula.

terms.name: Abnormality of the distal fibular epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of the outermost end part of calf bone
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the fibula.

terms.name: Abnormal proximal radial epiphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 桡骨近端骨骺形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the proximal radial epiphysis
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the radius.

terms.name: Abnormality of the distal radial epiphysis
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the radius.

terms.name: Abnormality of the proximal humeral epiphysis
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the innermost long bone in upper arm
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the humerus.

terms.name: Abnormal distal humeral epiphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 肱骨远端骨骺形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the distal humeral epiphysis
Abnormality of the end part of the outermost long bone in upper arm
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the humerus.

terms.name: Abnormal distal ulnar epiphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 尺骨远端骨骺形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the distal ulnar epiphysis
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the ulna.

terms.name: Abnormal proximal ulnar epiphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 尺骨近端骨骺形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the proximal ulnar epiphysis
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the ulna.

terms.name: Type 2 muscle fiber predominance
terms.definition: An abnormal predominance of type II muscle fibers (in general, this feature can only be observed on muscle biopsy).

terms.name: Odontogenic keratocysts of the jaw
terms.definition: A benign uni- or multicystic, intraosseous tumor of odontogenic origin, with a characteristic lining of parakeratinized stratified squamous epithelium and potential for aggressive, infiltrative behavior.

terms.name: Chalazion
terms.definition: A chronic epithelioid cell granulomatous inflammation of the meibomian gland caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland. A chalazion or meibomian cyst appears as a painless tuberous swelling in the upper lid without loss of eyelashes.

terms.name: Hordeolum
terms.definition: An acute purulent infection of the sebaceous glands of Zeis at the base of the eyelashes, of the apocrine sweat glands of Moll or the meibomian sebacious glands often caused by staphylococcus infections. Hordeola can either occur as Hordeola externa affecting the sebaceous glands of Zeis or the apocrine sweat glands of Moll or as Hordeola interna affecting the meibomian sebacious glands. In contrast to chalazia, hordeola are extremely painful and can cause extreme local swelling.

terms.name: Hordeolum externum
terms.definition: Hordeola externa are acute purulent infections affecting the sebaceous glands of Zeis or the apocrine sweat glands of Moll, often caused by staphylococcus infections. In contrast to chalazia, hordeola are extremely painfull and can cause extreme local swelling.

terms.name: Hordeolum internum
terms.definition: Hordeola interna are acute purulent infections affecting the meibomian sebacious glands, often caused by staphylococcus infections. In contrast to chalazia (chronic epithelioid cell granulomatous inflammation of the meibomian gland caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland), hordeola are extremely painfull and can cause extreme local swelling.

terms.name: Skin tags
terms.definition: Cutaneous skin tags also known as acrochorda or fibroepithelial polyps are small benign tumors that may either form secondarily over time primarily in areas where the skin forms creases, such as the neck, armpit or groin or may also be present at birth, in which case they usually occur in the periauricular region.

terms.name: Plantar pits
terms.definition: The presence of multiple pits (small, pinpoint-large indentations on the surface of the skin) located on the skin of sole of foot.

terms.name: Fibroma
terms.definition: Benign tumors that are composed of fibrous or connective tissue. They can grow in all organs, arising from mesenchyme tissue. The term \

terms.name: Angiofibromas
terms.definition: Angiofibroma consist of many often dilated vessels.

terms.name: Lung fibroma
terms.definition: The presence of a lung fibroma, a benign neoplasm that can present as a mass causing airway obstruction, cough, and hemoptysis, or present without symptoms as a solitary pulmonary nodule.

terms.name: Cardiac fibroma
terms.definition: A fibroma of the heart.

terms.name: Ovarian fibroma
terms.definition: The presence of a fibroma of the ovary.

terms.name: Fibroadenoma of the breast
terms.definition: A benign biphasic tumor of the breast with epithelial and stromal components.

terms.name: Malar prominence
terms.definition: Prominence of the malar process of the maxilla and infraorbital area appreciated in profile and from in front of the face.

terms.name: Cutaneous syndactyly of toes
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between adjacent foot digits that involves at least half of the proximodistal length of one of the two involved digits; or, a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits of the foot that does not meet the prior objective criteria.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the skeletal system
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the skeleton.

terms.name: Aplastic/hypoplastic toenail
terms.name_zh: 趾甲发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the toenail.

terms.name: Anterior pituitary dysgenesis
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the anterior pituitary gland, also known as the adenohypophysis.

terms.name: Anterior pituitary agenesis
terms.definition: Absence of the anterior pituitary gland resulting from a developmental defect.

terms.name: Anterior pituitary hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the anterior pituitary gland.

terms.name: Facial palsy
synonyms: Facial muscle weakness of muscles innervated by CN VII
terms.definition: Facial nerve palsy is a dysfunction of cranial nerve VII (the facial nerve) that results in inability to control facial muscles on the affected side with weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure. This can either be present in unilateral or bilateral form.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the cortex of the humerus
terms.definition: Any abnormality affecting the cortex of the humerus.

terms.name: Abnormal metatarsal epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of end part of long bone of foot
Abnormality of the epiphyses of the metatarsals
terms.definition: Any abnormality of a metatarsal bone epiphysis.

terms.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the feet
synonyms: Abnormality of the end part of the foot bone
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphyses of the feet.

terms.name: Total anosmia
terms.definition: Inability to detect any qualitative olfactory sensation.

terms.name: Partial anosmia
terms.definition: Inability to perceive certain odorants (implies that the sense of smell is maintained for other classes of odorants).

terms.name: Total hyposmia
terms.definition: Reduced ability to detect any qualitative olfactory sensation.

terms.name: Partial hyposmia
terms.definition: Reduced ability to perceive certain odorants (implies that the sense of smell is maintained for other classes of odorants).

terms.name: Schizencephaly
terms.definition: The presence of a cleft in the cerebral cortex unilaterally or bilaterally, usually located in the frontal area.

terms.name: Conjunctival amyloidosis
terms.definition: A form of amyloidosis that affects the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of hepatic origin
terms.name_zh: 肝源性碱性磷酸酶升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of liver isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of bone origin
terms.name_zh: 骨源性碱性磷酸酶升高
synonyms: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of bone origin
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of bone isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal nasal cavity morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the nasal cavity (the cavity includes and starts at the nares and reaches all the way through to the and includes the choanae, the posterior nasal apertures).

terms.name: Abnormality of the midnasal cavity
terms.definition: Abnormality of the midnasal cavity which includes the cavity between the nares and the choanae.

terms.name: Midnasal atresia
terms.definition: Absence or abnormal closure of the midnasal cavity.

terms.name: Midnasal stenosis
terms.definition: Abnormal narrowing (stenosis) of the midnasal cavity, i.e., of the middle nasal meatus, which in neonates can cause respiratory distress.

terms.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanges of the toes
synonyms: Absent outermost bone of the toes
terms.definition: Absence of the distal phalanges of the toes.

terms.name: Cervical spine instability
terms.definition: An abnormal lack of stability of the cervical spine.

terms.name: Abnormal elasticity of skin
terms.definition: Any abnormal increase or reduction in skin elasticity.

terms.name: Dermal translucency
terms.definition: An abnormally increased ability of the skin to permit light to pass through (translucency) such that subcutaneous structures such as veins display an increased degree of visibility.

terms.name: Flat nasal alae
terms.definition: An abnormal degree of flatness of the Ala of nose, which can be defined as a reduced nasal elevation index (lateral depth of the nose from the tip of the nose to the insertion of the nasal ala in the cheek x 100 divided by the side-to-side breadth of the nasal alae).

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the premaxilla
synonyms: Decreased size of the primary palate bone
Hypoplasia of the primary palate bone
Underdevelopment of the primary palate bone
terms.definition: An abnormality of the premaxilla (the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla) causing it to appear relatively small in size compared to the other parts of the maxilla or other facial structures.

terms.name: Abnormal meningeal morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Meninges, including any abnormality of the Dura mater, the Arachnoid mater, and the Pia mater.

terms.name: Abnormal dura mater morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Dura mater.

terms.name: Abnormality of the falx cerebri
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Falx cerebri.

terms.name: Aplasia of the falx cerebri
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by aplasia of the Falx cerebri.

terms.name: Epiphyseal stippling
synonyms: Speckled calcifications in end part of bone
terms.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more epiphyses.

terms.name: Abnormal epiphyseal ossification
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of the end part of a bone
Abnormality of the mineralisation or ossification of the epiphyses
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of an epiphysis.

terms.name: Patchy reduction of bone mineral density
terms.definition: Patchy (irregular) reduction in bone density. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.

terms.name: Patchy changes of bone mineral density
terms.definition: Patchy (irregular) changes in bone mineral density. These changes can either be patchy reduction or increase of mineral density as seen on x-rays. Depending on the pathomechanism and the underlying disease, these changes can either appear solely as reduction or increase or as a combination of both (patches of bone showing an increased density while others are affected by reduction of mineral density).

terms.name: Patchy variation in bone mineral density
synonyms: Patchy increased and decreased bone mineral density
terms.definition: Patchy (irregular) changes in bone mineral density with patches of bone showing an increased density side to side with patches that are affected by reduction of mineral density. This is sometimes referred to as a moth-eaten appearance on x-rays.

terms.name: Abnormal hand bone ossification
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of the hand bones
Abnormality of the mineralisation and ossification of bones of the hand
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any bone of the skeleton of hand.

terms.name: Absence of the third cerebral ventricle
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the absence of the third ventricle.

terms.name: Abnormal diencephalon morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Diencephalon, which together with the cerebrum (telencephalon) makes up the forebrain.

terms.name: Abnormal thalamus morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the thalamus.

terms.name: Fusion of the left and right thalami
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by fusion of the left and right halves of the thalamus.

terms.name: Bilateral coxa valga
terms.definition: The presence of bilateral coxa valga.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the anterior nasal spine
synonyms: Decreased projection of anterior nasal spine
Decreased size of anterior nasal spine
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the anterior nasal spine of maxilla.

terms.name: Aplasia of the maxilla
synonyms: Aplasia of the upper jaw bones
terms.definition: A congenital defect characterized by absence of the Maxilla.

terms.name: Abnormal zygomatic bone morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the zygomatic bone.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the zygomatic bone
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the zygomatic bone. That is, a reduction in size of the zygomatic bone, including the zygomatic process of the temporal bone of the skull, which forms part of the zygomatic arch.

terms.name: Abnormality of the third metatarsal bone
synonyms: Abnormality of the 3rd long bone of foot
terms.definition: An abnormality of the third metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Abnormal curvature of the vertebral column
synonyms: Abnormality of the curvature of the vertebral column
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormal curvature of the vertebral column.

terms.name: Abnormal foot bone ossification
synonyms: Abnormal ossification involving bones of the feet
Abnormality of the mineralisation and ossification of bones of the feet
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any bone of the skeleton of foot.

terms.name: Enuresis nocturna
terms.definition: Enuresis occurring during sleeping hours.

terms.name: Enuresis diurna
terms.definition: Enuresis occurring during waking hours of the day.

terms.name: Elevated tissue non-specific alkaline phosphatase
terms.name_zh: 组织非特异性碱性磷酸酶升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of renal origin
terms.name_zh: 肾源性碱性磷酸酶升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of kidney isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated intestinal alkaline phosphatase
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of alkaline phosphatase, intestinal type in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated placental alkaline phosphatase
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of alkaline phosphatase, placental type in the blood.

terms.name: Low tissue non-specific alkaline phosphatase
terms.name_zh: 组织非特异性碱性磷酸酶降低
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.

terms.name: Low alkaline phosphatase of bone origin
terms.name_zh: 骨源性碱性磷酸酶降低
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of bone isoforms of alkaline phosphatase in the blood.

terms.name: Low alkaline phosphatase of renal origin
terms.name_zh: 肾源性碱性磷酸酶降低
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of kidney isoforms of alkaline phosphatase in the blood.

terms.name: Low alkaline phosphatase of hepatic origin
terms.name_zh: 肝源性碱性磷酸酶降低
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of liver isoforms of alkaline phosphatase in the blood.

terms.name: Low intestinal alkaline phosphatase
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase, intestinal type in the blood.

terms.name: Low placental alkaline phosphatase
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase, placental type in the blood.

terms.name: Mirror image polydactyly
terms.definition: A hand or foot with more than five digits that has a recognizable A/P axis of symmetry. The axis can lie within a normally formed or partially duplicated digit resembling a middle finger, index finger, thumb, toe, or hallux. Alternatively, the axis can be in an interdigital space with a flanking pair of digits that resemble a middle finger, index finger, thumb, toe or hallux. The most lateral digits on each side of the hand/foot typically resemble fifth fingers/toes.

terms.name: Mirror image hand polydactyly
terms.definition: Mirror image duplication of digits affecting the hands only.

terms.name: Mirror image foot polydactyly
terms.definition: Mirror image duplication of digits affecting the feet.

terms.name: Pulverulent cataract
terms.definition: A kind of congenital cataract that is characterized by a hollow sphere of punctate opacities involving the fetal nucleus and that usually occurs bilaterally.

terms.name: Lamellar pulverulent cataract
terms.definition: A Lamellar cataract with a pulverulent (punctate, \

terms.name: Sutural cataract
terms.definition: A type of congenital cataract in which the opacity follows the anterior or posterior Y suture.

terms.name: Polar cataract
terms.definition: A type of Congenital cataract in which the opacities occupy the subcapsular cortex at the anterior or posterior pole of the lens.

terms.name: Anterior pyramidal cataract
terms.definition: A type of anterior polar cataract which projects as a conical opacity into the anterior chamber.

terms.name: Nuclear pulverulent cataract
terms.definition: A type of nuclear cataract involving congenital dust-like (pulverulent) opacity of the embryonal and fetal nucleus.

terms.name: Triangular nuclear cataract
terms.definition: A nuclear cataract with a triangular form.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating immunoglobulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in blood.

terms.name: Increased circulating immunoglobulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环免疫球蛋白浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased level of gamma globulin (immunoglobulin) in the blood.

terms.name: 1-2 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the index finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: 4-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the fourth (ring) to the fifth (little) finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: 1-3 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the middle finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: 1-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the ring finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: 1-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the little finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints (complete syndactyly of all fingers of the hand).

terms.name: 2-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
synonyms: Syndactyly of second to fourth fingers
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second (index) to the fourth (ring) finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: 3-5 finger syndactyly
synonyms: Webbed third, fourth and fifth toes
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the middle to little fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: 1-2 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes one and two.

terms.name: 1-4 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to four.

terms.name: 1-5 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to five (complete syndactyly of all toes of the foot).

terms.name: 2-4 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes two to four.

terms.name: 2-5 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes two to five.

terms.name: 3-5 toe syndactyly
terms.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes three to five.

terms.name: Osseous syndactyly of toes
terms.definition: Webbing or fusion of the toes, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual bones of the toes. Bony fusions are referred to as \

terms.name: Abnormality of hair texture
terms.definition: An abnormality of the texture of the hair.

terms.name: Abnormal hair pattern
terms.definition: An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.

terms.name: Abnormal hair whorl
terms.definition: An abnormal hair whorl (that is, a patch of hair growing in the opposite direction of the rest of the hair).

terms.name: Asymmetry of the ears
terms.definition: An asymmetriy, i.e., difference in size, shape or position between the left and right ear.

terms.name: Advanced pneumatization of the mastoid process
terms.definition: An abnormally advanced degree of pneumatization (i.e., formation of air cells) in the mastoid process with respect to age-dependent norms.

terms.name: Prominent corneal nerve fibers
terms.definition: Abnormal prominence of the corneal nerve fibers.

terms.name: Spontaneous rupture of the globe
terms.definition: Rupture of the eyeball not due to trauma.

terms.name: Aplasia of the retina
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence of the retina.

terms.name: Cherry red spot of the macula
terms.definition: Pallor of the perifoveal macula of the retina with appearance of a small circular reddish choroid shape as seen through the fovea centralis due to relative transparency of the macula.

terms.name: Double eyebrow
terms.definition: This may present as a partial or complete duplication of the eyebrows.

terms.name: Extension of eyebrows towards upper eyelid
synonyms: Extension of eyebrows towards upper eyelid
terms.definition: The eyebrows extend towards - or even all the way down to - the margin of the upper eyelid.

terms.name: Nodular changes affecting the eyelids
terms.definition: Nodular changes affecting the eyelids may have many different causes such as cystic lesions (chalaziae, hordeolae), lipogranulomas, melanomas, infectious diseases (Molluscum contagiosum) and many more.

terms.name: Naevus flammeus of the eyelid
terms.definition: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the eyelid.

terms.name: Fibrous dysplasia of the bones
terms.definition: Tumor-like growths that consist of replacement of the medullary bone with fibrous tissue, causing the expansion and weakening of the areas of bone involved. Especially when involving the skull or facial bones, the lesions can cause externally visible deformities. The skull is often, but not necessarily, affected, and any other bone or bones may be involved. Fibrous dysplasia can either effect isolated bones (Monostotic fibrous dysplasia) or also generalized all bones of the body (Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia).

terms.name: Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia
terms.definition: Fibrous dysplasia of the bones were lesions are localized in many bones throughout of the body. Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia is a cardinal feature of McCune-Albright syndrome.

terms.name: Monostotic fibrous dysplasia
terms.definition: Fibrous dysplasia of the bones were lesions are localized in only one bone.

terms.name: Osteopoikilosis
terms.definition: Osteopoikilosis is a benign, asymptomatic sclerotic dysplasia of the bones. It affects both male and female and may be seen at any age. Radiographically sclerotic circular or ovoid lesions are usually symmetrically distributed in a periarticular location. Lesions can increase or decrease in size and number in serial radiographs or even disappear and do not have increased bone radiotracer uptake.

terms.name: Osteopathia striata
terms.definition: A lamellar pattern visible on radiographs and mainly localized at the metaphyses of the long tubular bones. Pathologic-anatomical studies revealed that these benign signs on x-rays are the result of a juvenile metaphyseal bone necrosis. Calcifications in the necrotic marrow lead to this lamellar or lattice-like appearance.

terms.name: Pedal edema
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of excess fluid in the lower extremity resulting in swelling of the feet and extending upward to the lower leg.

terms.name: Edema of the upper limbs
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin of the arms.

terms.name: Short metatarsal
terms.definition: Diminished length of a metatarsal bone, with resultant proximal displacement of the associated toe.

terms.name: Absent metatarsal bone
terms.definition: A developmental abnormality characterized by the absence (aplasia) of a metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the toes
terms.definition: Absence of a digit or of one or more phalanges of a toe.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the toes
Medial flaring of the eyebrow
terms.definition: An abnormal distribution of eyebrow hair growth in the medial direction.

terms.name: Ectopic lacrimal punctum
synonyms: Abnormal position of the lacrimal punctum
terms.definition: Positioning of a lacrimal punctum other than at the medial margins of the eyelid.

terms.name: Blepharochalasis
terms.definition: Blepharochalasis is characterized by recurrent, non-painful, nonerythematous episodes of eyelid edema. It has been divided into hypertrophic and atrophic forms. In the hypertrophic form recurrent edema results in orbital fat herniation through a weakened orbital septum. Most patients who have blepharochalasis present in an atrophic condition with atrophy of redundant eyelid skin and superior nasal fat pads.

terms.name: Dermatochalasis
terms.definition: Loss of elasticity of the upper and lower eyelids causing the skin to sag and bulge.

terms.name: Dimple chin
terms.definition: A persistent midline depression of the skin over the fat pad of the chin.

terms.name: Cleft mandible
terms.definition: Midline deficiency of the mandible and some or all overlying tissues.

terms.name: Abnormality of the temporomandibular joint
terms.definition: An anomaly of the temporomandibular joint.

terms.name: Asymmetry of the maxilla
synonyms: Asymmetry of right and left side of the maxilla
terms.definition: Asymmetry between the left and right sides of the maxilla.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the premaxilla
terms.name_zh: 前上颌骨发育不全/发育不良
synonyms: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the primary palate bone
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the premaxilla.

terms.name: Aplasia of the premaxilla
synonyms: Absence of the primary palate bone
Aplasia of the primary palate bone
Failure of development of the primary palate bone
terms.definition: Absence of the premaxilla, which is the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla.

terms.name: Abnormality of the premaxilla
synonyms: Abnormality of the intermaxillary segment of the maxilla
Abnormality of the primary palate bone
terms.definition: An abnormality of the premaxilla, the most anterior part of the maxilla that usually bears the central and lateral incisors and includes the anterior nasal spine and inferior aspect of the piriform rim. The premaxilla contains the bone and teeth of the primary palate.

terms.name: Prominence of the premaxilla
synonyms: Anterior position of the primary palate bone
Prominence of the primary palate bone
terms.definition: Prominent positioning of the premaxilla in relation to the rest of the maxilla, the facial skeleton, or mandible. Not necessarily caused by an increase in size (hypertrophy of) the premaxilla.

terms.name: Absent toe
terms.definition: Aplasia of a toe. That is, absence of all phalanges of a non-hallux digit of the foot and the associated soft tissues.

terms.name: Broad columella
terms.definition: Increased width of the columella.

terms.name: Chordoma
terms.definition: A chordoma is a tumor that arises from embryonic remnants of the notochord along the length of the neuraxis. Chordomas generally occur in the sacrum, intracranially at the clivus, or along the spinal axis.

terms.name: Low insertion of columella
terms.definition: Insertion of the posterior columella below the nasal base.

terms.name: Short eyelashes
terms.definition: Decreased length of the eyelashes (subjective).

terms.name: Palmar hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin localized to the palm of the hand.

terms.name: Ectopic calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in a tissue or location in which calcification does not normally occur.

terms.name: Sacrococcygeal pilonidal abnormality
terms.definition: The presence of a cyst, fistula, or abscess in the sacrococcygeal region (gluteal crease) characteristically accompanied by hair and skin folds.

terms.name: Pilonidal sinus
terms.definition: A sinus in the coccygeal region (the region of the intergluteal cleft). A pilonidal sinus often contains hair and skin debris.

terms.name: Pilonidal abscess
terms.definition: A hair-containing cyst or sinus usually in the coccygeal region.

terms.name: Anomalous pulmonary venous return
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by abnormal connection of one or more pulmonary veins to the superior or inferior vena cava, the right atrium, or the coronary sinus, resulting in a left-to-right shunt of oxygenated blood.

terms.name: Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return
terms.definition: A form of anomalous pulmonary venous return in which not all pulmonary veins drain abnormally. Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return frequently involves one or both of the veins from one lung.

terms.name: Cor triatriatum
terms.definition: The presence of an additional membrane in the left or right cardiac atrium which results in the subdivision of the affected atrium (and thus in total three atria, whence the name).

terms.name: Vascular ring
terms.definition: A developmental defect of the aortic arch system in which the trachea and esophagus are completely encircled by connected segments of the aortic arch and its branches. This occurs if the normal process of regression and persistence of the bilateral embryonic aortic arches fails.

terms.name: Tracheobronchmegaly
terms.definition: Marked widening of the trachea and major bronchi that may be predispose to chronic respiratory tract infection.

terms.name: Bronchomegaly
terms.definition: Marked widening of the major bronchi that may be predispose to chronic respiratory tract infection.

terms.name: Tracheomegaly
terms.definition: Marked widening of the trachea.

terms.name: Large pelvis bone
terms.definition: The presence of an abnormally large pelvis.

terms.name: Hyperacusis
terms.definition: Over-sensitivity to certain frequency ranges of sound.

terms.name: Skin dimple
terms.definition: Skin dimples are cutaneous indentations that are the result of tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) causing an indentation.

terms.name: Shoulder dimple
terms.definition: A subtype of skin dimples occurring in the shoulder region.

terms.name: Erythema
synonyms: Redness of skin or mucous membrane
terms.definition: Redness of the skin, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.

terms.name: Uterine neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the uterus.

terms.name: Gonadal neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of a gonad.

terms.name: Urinary tract neoplasm
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the urinary system.

terms.name: Genital neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the genital system.

terms.name: Testicular neoplasm
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the testis.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the Leydig cells
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone.

terms.name: Hyperplasia of the Leydig cells
terms.definition: Hypertrophy or overdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone.

terms.name: Bifid nail
terms.definition: A digit with two nails, with at least some soft tissue between them.

terms.name: Impaired visuospatial constructive cognition
terms.definition: Reduced ability affecting mainly visuospatial cognition which may be tested using pattern construction (for example by Differential Ability Scales, which test a person's strengths and weaknesses across a range of intellectual abilities).

terms.name: Cerebellar glioma
terms.definition: A glioma affecting the cerebellum.

terms.name: Brainstem glioma
terms.definition: A glioma affecting the brainstem.

terms.name: Hemangioblastoma
terms.definition: A hemangioblastoma is a benign vascular neoplasm that arises almost exclusively in the central nervous system. Hemangioblastomas consist of a tightly packed cluster of small blood vessels forming a mass of up to 1 or 2 cm in diameter.

terms.name: Lip freckle
terms.definition: Increased focal pigmentation of the vermilion of the lips.

terms.name: Pinealoma
terms.definition: A neoplasm of the pineal gland.

terms.name: Absent cupid's bow
synonyms: Failure of development of cupid's bow
terms.definition: Lack of paramedian peaks and median notch of the upper lip vermilion.

terms.name: Underdeveloped nasolabial fold
terms.definition: Reduced bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion or commissure).

terms.name: Perioral hyperpigmentation
synonyms: Darkening of skin around the mouth
terms.definition: Increased pigmentation, either focal or generalized, of the skin surrounding the vermilion of the lips.

terms.name: Everted upper lip vermilion
terms.definition: Inner aspect of the upper lip vermilion (normally apposing the teeth) visible in a frontal view, i.e., the presence of an everted upper lip.

terms.name: Tented upper lip vermilion
terms.definition: Triangular appearance of the oral aperture with the apex in the midpoint of the upper vermilion and the lower vermilion forming the base.

terms.name: Upturned corners of mouth
terms.definition: Oral commissures positioned superior to the midline labial fissure.

terms.name: U-Shaped upper lip vermilion
terms.definition: Gentle upward curve of the upper lip vermilion such that the center is placed well superior to the commissures.

terms.name: Open bite
synonyms: Absence of overlap of upper and lower teeth
Open bite between upper and lower teeth
terms.definition: Visible space between the dental arches in occlusion.

terms.name: Protruding tongue
terms.definition: Tongue extending beyond the alveolar ridges or teeth at rest.

terms.name: Broad uvula
terms.definition: Increased width of the uvula (subjective finding).

terms.name: Long uvula
terms.definition: Increased length of the uvula.

terms.name: Narrow uvula
terms.definition: Decreased width of the uvula.

terms.name: Short uvula
terms.definition: Decreased length of the uvula.

terms.name: Abnormal number of hair whorls
terms.definition: More than two clockwise hair whorls.

terms.name: Abnormal position of hair whorl
terms.definition: Hair growth from a single point on the scalp in any location other than lateral to the midline and close to the vertex of the skull.

terms.name: Nevus sebaceous
terms.definition: A congenital, hairless plaque consisting of overgrown epidermis, sebaceous glands, hair follicles, apocrine glands and connective tissue. They are a variant of epidermal naevi. Sebaceous naevi most often appear on the scalp, but they may also arise on the face, neck or forehead. At birth, a sevaceous nevus typically appears as a solitary, smooth, yellow-orange hairless patch. Sebaceous naevi become more pronounced around adolescence, often appearing bumpy, warty or scaly.

terms.name: Epidermal nevus
terms.definition: Epidermal naevi are due to an overgrowth of the epidermis and may be present at birth (50%) or develop during childhood.

terms.name: Linear nevus sebaceous
terms.definition: A type of nevus sebaceous with a linear form, raised borders and yellowish color.

terms.name: Generalized tonic seizure
terms.definition: A generalized tonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening without a subsequent clonic phase. The tonic activity can be a sustained abnormal posture, either in extension or flexion, sometimes accompanied by tremor of the extremities.

terms.name: Atonic seizure
terms.definition: Atonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1 to 2 seconds, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with crying
terms.name_zh: 伴哭泣的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with crying (dacrystic) is characterized by the presence of stereotyped crying, this may be accompanied by lacrimation, sad facial expression and sobbing. The subjective emotion of sadness may or may not be present.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with laughing
terms.name_zh: 伴发笑的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with laughing (gelastic) is characterized by bursts of laughter or giggling, usually without appropriate related emotion of happiness, and described as 'mirthless'.

terms.name: Scintillating scotoma
terms.definition: A scintillating scotoma is a common visual aura that can precede a migraine, whereby a spot of flickering light near the center of the visual fields occurs. The spot prevents vision, and is thus termed scotoma. The scotoma can extend into one or more shimmering arcs of white or colored flashing lights.

terms.name: Ridged cranial sutures
terms.definition: An overlap of the bony plates of the skull in an infant, with or without early closure.

terms.name: Abnormal fifth cranial nerve morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve.

terms.name: Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve
terms.definition: Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve.

terms.name: Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve
terms.definition: Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve.

terms.name: Abnormal seventh cranial physiology
terms.name_zh: 第七颅神经生理功能异常
terms.definition: Abnormality of the seventh cranial nerve sometimes also referred to as the facial nerve.

terms.name: Hemifacial spasm
synonyms: Spasms on one side of the face
terms.definition: Intermittent clonic or tonic contraction of muscles supplied by facial nerve. Muscles are relaxed in between contractions.

terms.name: Impaired temperature sensation
terms.definition: A reduced ability to discriminate between different temperatures.

terms.name: Impaired tactile sensation
terms.definition: A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation). This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.

terms.name: Impaired proprioception
terms.definition: A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position.

terms.name: Abnormality of pain sensation
terms.definition: Pain is an unpleasant sensation that can range from mild, localized discomfort to agony, whereby the physical part of pain results from nerve stimulation and is often accompanied by an emotional component. This term groups abnormalities in pain sensation presumed to result from abnormalities related to the specific nerve fibers that carry the pain impulses to the brain.

terms.name: Spontaneous pain sensation
terms.definition: Spontaneous pain is a kind of neuropathic pain which occurs without an identifiable trigger.

terms.name: Trophic changes related to pain
terms.definition: Trophic changes is a term used to describe abnormalities in the area of pain that include primarily wasting away of the skin, tissues, or muscle, thinning of the bones, and changes in how the hair or nails grow, including thickening or thinning of hair or brittle nails.

terms.name: Dissociated sensory loss
terms.definition: A pattern of sensory loss with selective loss of touch sensation and proprioception without loss of pain and temperature, or vice-versa.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating copper concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of copper cation in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环铜蓝蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: High nonceruloplasmin-bound serum copper
terms.name_zh: 血清非铜蓝蛋白结合铜升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of non ceruloplasmin bound copper in the blood.

terms.name: Increased urinary copper concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of copper in the urine.

terms.name: Multifocal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: An abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG) and being identified at multiple locations (foci).

terms.name: EEG with focal slow activity
terms.definition: Focal (localized) slow activity reflects focal dysfunction, not diffuse dysfunction (i.e., encephalopathy).

terms.name: EEG with multifocal slow activity
terms.definition: Multifocal slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with generalized slow activity
terms.definition: Diffuse slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with persistent abnormal rhythmic activity
terms.name_zh: 持续性异常节律活动脑电图

terms.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (<2.5 Hz)
terms.definition: The presence of complexes of slow spikes and slow waves (<2.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (2.5-3.5 Hz)
terms.definition: The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (2.5-3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (>3.5 Hz)
terms.definition: The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (>3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes
terms.definition: Complexes of spikes (<70 ms) and sharp waves (70-200 ms), which are sharp transient waves that have a strong association with epilepsy, in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with burst suppression
terms.definition: The burst suppression pattern in electroencephalography refers to a characteristic periodic pattern of low voltage (<10 microvolts) suppressed background and a relatively shorter pattern of higher amplitude slow, sharp, and spiking complexes.

terms.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response
terms.definition: EEG abnormalities (epileptiform discharges) evoked by flashing lights or black and white striped patterns.

terms.name: EEG with periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 周期性偏侧样放电脑电图
terms.definition: Periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges (PLEDs)are periodic, lateralized, and epileptiform. PLEDs show a relatively constant interval between discharges (0.5 to 3 seconds).

terms.name: EEG with generalized low amplitude activity
terms.name_zh: 脑电图全面性低波幅活动
synonyms: EEG with generalised low amplitude activity
terms.definition: An abnormal generalized reduction in amplitude of the cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with localized low amplitude activity
terms.name_zh: 脑电图局限性低波幅活动
synonyms: EEG with localised low amplitude activity
terms.definition: An abnormal localized reduction in amplitude of the cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with periodic complexes
terms.definition: Periodically occurring generalized periodic complexes.

terms.name: EEG with periodic abnormalities
terms.definition: Periodically recurring abnormalities in the EEG.

terms.name: EEG with hyperventilation-induced epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图过度换气诱发痫样放电
terms.definition: Epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: Frank breech presentation
terms.definition: A kind of breech presentation in which the hips are flexed and the knees are extended.

terms.name: Complete breech presentation
terms.definition: A kind of breech presentation in which the hips are flexed and the knees are flexed.

terms.name: Incomplete breech presentation
terms.definition: A kind of breech presentation in which one or both hips are extended and one or both of the fetus' feet are pointing down and entering the birth canal.

terms.name: Delayed fine motor development
terms.definition: A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the fingers and hands.

terms.name: Receptive language delay
terms.definition: A delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.

terms.name: Severe intellectual disability
terms.definition: Severe intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by severely sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 20-34.

terms.name: Oppositional defiant disorder
terms.definition: An enduring pattern of uncooperative, defiant, and hostile behavior towards authority figures that does not involve major antisocial violations, is not accounted for by the child's developmental stage, and results in significant functional impairment. A certain level of oppositional behavior is common in children and adolescents.

terms.name: Abdominal wall defect
terms.definition: An incomplete closure of the abdominal wall.

terms.name: Dyssynergia
terms.definition: A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed. With dyssynergia, a voluntary movement appears broken down into its component parts.

terms.name: Ocular dyssynergia
terms.definition: A type of dyssynergia affecting eye movements and characterized by the inability to smoothly follow a visual target across the visual field.

terms.name: Asynergia
terms.definition: A type of dyssynergy characterized by the lack of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed.

terms.name: Sensory ataxia
terms.definition: Incoordination of movement caused by a deficit in the sensory nervous system. Sensory ataxia can be distinguished from cerebellar ataxia by asking the patient to close his or her eyes. Persons with cerebellar ataxia show only a minimal worsening of symptoms, whereas persons with sensory ataxia show a marked worsening of symptoms.

terms.name: T-wave inversion
terms.definition: An inversion of the T-wave (which is normally positive).

terms.name: Cervical spinal cord atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the cervical segment of the spinal cord.

terms.name: Tendon xanthomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of xanthomas (intra-and extra-cellular accumulations of cholesterol) extensor tendons (typically over knuckles, Achilles tendon, knee, and elbows).

terms.name: Chaddock reflex
terms.definition: A diagnostic reflex elicited by stimulation of the skin over the surface of the lateral malleolus of the foot. The Chaddock refelx is present if there is extension of one or more or all of the toes with or without fanning of them when the external inframalleolar skin is stimulated. The Chaddock sign, similar to the Babinski sign, is taken to be an indication of disease of the spinocortical (pyramidal) tract.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating protein concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal level of a circulating protein in the blood.

terms.name: Monocular strabismus
terms.definition: A type of strabismus in which the fixating eye is always the same one, while the other eye is constantly deviated. Monocular strabismus is to be distinguished from alternating strabismus, in which either of the eyes 'squints' at different times.

terms.name: Fetal cystic hygroma
terms.definition: The presence during the prenatal period of a cystic mass with multiple septa with multiple, asymmetric, thin-walled cysts near the posterior aspect of the neck. Fetal cystic hygroma can be defined as nuchal translucency with or without septations measuring greater than 3.0 mm. Increased NT refers to a measurement above the 95th centile, and the term is used irrespective of whether the collection of fluid is septated or not, and whether it is confined to the neck or envelopes the whole fetus. After 14 weeks, increased NT usually resolves, but in some cases it evolves into nuchal edema or cystic hygromas.

terms.name: Increased nuchal translucency
terms.definition: Nuchal translucency is the sonographic appearance of subcutaneous accumulation of liquid in the back of the fetal neck in the first trimester of pregnancy (11-14 gestational weeks of pregnancy).

terms.name: Abnormality of the umbilical cord
terms.definition: An abnormality of the umbilical cord, which is the cord connecting the developing embryo or fetus to the placenta.

terms.name: Pulmonary valve atresia
terms.definition: A congenital disorder of the pulmonary valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop.

terms.name: Aortic valve atresia
terms.definition: A congenital disorder of the aortic valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop.

terms.name: Acromelia
terms.definition: Shortening of the extremities affecting primarily the distal parts of the limbs (hands and feet) in relation to the other segments of the limbs.

terms.name: Avascular necrosis
synonyms: Death of bone due to decreased blood supply
terms.definition: A disease where there is cellular death (necrosis) of bone components due to interruption of the blood supply.

terms.name: Osteochondritis dissecans
terms.definition: A joint disorder caused by blood deprivation in the subchondral bone causing the subchondral bone to die in a process called avascular necrosis. The bone is then reabsorbed by the body, leaving the articular cartilage it supported prone to damage. The result is fragmentation (dissection) of both cartilage and bone, and the free movement of these osteochondral fragments within the joint space, causing pain and further damage.

terms.name: Morbus Koehler
terms.definition: Morbus Koehler is a Juvenile aseptic necrosis affecting the Os naviculare pedis.

terms.name: Morbus Kienboeck
terms.definition: Morbus Kienboeck is a Juvenile aseptic necrosis affecting the Os lunatum.

terms.name: Morbus Osgood-Schlatter
terms.definition: Morbus Osgood-Schlatter is a Juvenile aseptic necrosis affecting the Tuberositas tibiae.

terms.name: Morbus Scheuermann
terms.definition: A developmental growth retardation of the vertebral end plates that may lead to secondary destruction of the vertebral end plates and protrusion of the nucleus pulposus into the vertebral body (so called Schmorl's nodes as seen on x-rays).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating branched chain amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血支链氨基酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a branched chain family amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating phenylalanine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环苯丙氨酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of phenylalanine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating serine family amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环丝氨酸族氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating serine family amino acid concentration
Abnormal serine family amino acid level
Abnormality of serine family amino acid metabolism
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of serine family amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating glycine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of glycine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hypersarcosinemia
terms.definition: An elevated plasma concentration of sarcosine.

terms.name: Hypersarcosinuria
terms.definition: An elevated urinary concentration of sarcosine.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating sarcosine concentration
terms.definition: An deviation from the normal concentration of sarcosine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating aspartate family amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血天冬氨酸族氨基酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of an aspartate family amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating threonine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of threonine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating methionine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环甲硫氨酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of methionine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating glutamine family amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环谷氨酰胺族氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating glutamine family amino acid concentration
Abnormal glutamine family amino acid level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of glutamine family amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating glutamine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环谷氨酰胺浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of glutamine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating histidine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of histidine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyperhistidinemia
terms.definition: The concentration of histidine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating proline concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of proline in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating lysine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of lysine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating arginine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of arginine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hypervalinemia
terms.definition: The concentration of valine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyperleucinemia
terms.definition: The concentration of leucine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating isoleucine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环异亮氨酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of isoleucine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyperisoleucinemia
terms.definition: The concentration of isoleucine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating valine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of valine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating pyruvate family amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环丙酮酸族氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating pyruvate family amino acid concentration
Abnormal pyruvate family amino acid level
Abnormality of pyruvate family amino acid metabolism
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of pyruvate family amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating alanine concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality of an alanine metabolic process.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating tyrosine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of tyrosine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating cysteine concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality of a cysteine metabolic process.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating homocysteine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环同型半胱氨酸浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of a homocysteine metabolic process.

terms.name: Zonular cataract
terms.definition: Zonular cataracts are defined to be cataracts that affect specific regions of the lens.

terms.name: Coralliform cataract
terms.definition: A 'coral-like' pattern of opacity in the lens of the eye. That is, a cataract with an irregular, stellate form.

terms.name: Membranous cataract
terms.definition: A form of cataract in which the lens substance has shrunk, leaving a collapsed, flattened capsule with little or no cortex or epithelium on the lens.

terms.name: Anterior subcapsular cataract
terms.definition: A type of cataract affecting the anterior pole of lens immediately adjacent to ('beneath') the lens capsule.

terms.name: Posterior cortical cataract
terms.definition: A cataract that affects the posterior part of the cortex of the lens.

terms.name: Aculeiform cataract
terms.definition: A kind of nuclear cataract characterized by fiberglasslike or needlelike crystals projecting in different directions, through or close to the axial region of the lens.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating inorganic divalent cation concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环无机二价阳离子浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormality of divalent inorganic cation homeostasis
terms.definition: An abnormality of divalent inorganic cation homeostasis.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating inorganic cation concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环无机阳离子浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of inorganic cation in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating monovalent inorganic cation concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环一价无机阳离子浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal blood monovalent inorganic cation concentration
Abnormality of monovalent inorganic cation homeostasis
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of monovalent inorganic cation in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating sodium concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of sodium in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating nucleobase concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality of a nucleobase metabolic process.

terms.name: Hyperxanthinemia
terms.definition: An increased level of xanthine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Xanthinuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of xanthine in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormality of the upper urinary tract
synonyms: Abnormality of the upper urinary tract
terms.definition: An abnormality of the upper urinary tract.

terms.name: Abnormality of the lower urinary tract
terms.definition: An abnormality of the lower urinary tract.

terms.name: Abnormal nasal skeleton morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the nasal skeleton.

terms.name: Abnormal external nose morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the external nose.

terms.name: Abnormal nasal bone morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the nasal bone, comprising the left nasal bone and the right nasal bone.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nasal bone
terms.name_zh: 鼻骨发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasal bone.
