terms.name: Aplasia of the nasal bone
synonyms: Failure of development of the nasal bone
Lack of development of the nasal bone
terms.definition: Absence of the nasal bone.

terms.name: Echogenic intracardiac focus
terms.definition: A finding of a focus of increased echogenicity upon prenatal ultrasound examination of the fetus. The foci may be present in one or both ventricles. Echogenic intracardiac focus (EICF) is defined as a focus of echogenicity comparable to bone, in the region of the papillary muscle in either or both ventricles of the fetal heart.

terms.name: Echogenic fetal bowel
terms.definition: Echogenic bowel is defined as fetal bowel with homogenous areas of echogenicity that are equal to or greater than that of surrounding bone.

terms.name: Abnormal renal pelvis morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the renal pelvis.

terms.name: Fetal pyelectasis
terms.definition: Mild pyelectasis is defined as a hypoechoic spherical or elliptical space within the renal pelvis that measures at least 5mm and not more than 10 mm. The measurement is taken on a transverse section through the fetal renal pelvis using the maximum anterior-to-posterior measurement.

terms.name: Dilatation of the renal pelvis
terms.definition: The presence of dilatation of the renal pelvis.

terms.name: Abnormality of ductus venosus blood flow
terms.definition: A first-trimester prenatal ultrasound finding of abnormal blood flow in the ductus venosus.

terms.name: Abnormal fetal cardiovascular morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the fetal cardiovascular system
Abnormality of the fetal circulation system
Abnormality of the foetal cardiovascular system
Abnormality of the foetal circulation system
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the fetal circulation system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.

terms.name: Abnormality of umbilical vein blood flow
terms.definition: A first-trimester prenatal ultrasound finding of abnormal blood flow in the umbilical vein.

terms.name: Abnormal fourth ventricle morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the fourth ventricle.

terms.name: Abnormal third ventricle morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the third ventricle.

terms.name: Mild fetal ventriculomegaly
terms.definition: A kind of ventriculomegaly occurring in the fetal period and usually diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound. Cerebral ventriculomegaly is defined by atrial measurements 10 mm or more. Mild ventriculomegaly (MVM) is defined as measurements between 10 and 15 mm. Measurements are obtained from an axial plane at the level of the thalamic nuclei just below the standard image to measure the BPD (PMID:16100637).

terms.name: Noncommunicating hydrocephalus
terms.definition: A form of hydrocephalus in which the flow of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) within the cerebral ventricular system or in the outlets of the CSF to the arachnoid space is obstructed.

terms.name: Hypoplastic right ventricle
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the right ventricle.

terms.name: Dilatation of the bladder
terms.definition: The presence of a dilated urinary bladder.

terms.name: Fetal megacystis
terms.definition: Fetal megacystis is an abnormally enlarged bladder identified at any gestational age.

terms.name: Congenital posterior urethral valve
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in an obstructing membrane in the posterior male urethra.

terms.name: Bilateral renal agenesis
terms.definition: A bilateral form of agenesis of the kidney.

terms.name: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation
synonyms: Congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation of the lung
Congenital cystic disease of the lung
terms.definition: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM) - previously known as congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation (CCAM) - is a relatively rare developmental malformation of the lower respiratory tract. It is a hamartomatous, dysplastic developmental abnormality of the lung characterized by abnormal airway patterning during lung branching morphogenesis and is formed by abnormal branching of the immature bronchioles.

terms.name: Absence of stomach bubble on fetal sonography
terms.name_zh: 胎儿超声检查胃泡未显示
synonyms: Absence of stomach bubble on foetal sonography
terms.definition: By the 14th week of gestation it is nearly always possible to visualized the fluid-filled fetal stomach bubble on prenatal sonography. This term refers to the absence of a normal fetal stomach bubble on fetal ultrasonography performed at around 16 to 20 weeks' gestation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating long-chain fatty-acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环长链脂肪酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a long-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating phytanic acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of phytanic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating fatty acid anion concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环脂肪酸阴离子浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating fatty acid anion concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of fatty acid anion in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating carnitine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of carnitine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormality of liposaccharide metabolism
terms.definition: An abnormality of liposaccharide metabolism.

terms.name: Abnormality of glycolipid metabolism
terms.definition: An abnormality of glycolipid metabolism.

terms.name: Blood group antigen abnormality
terms.definition: An abnormality of an erythrocyte cell surface molecule.

terms.name: Absence of Lutheran antigen on erythrocytes
terms.definition: Absence of the Lutheran antigen (a type I integral membrane glycoprotein) from the surface of red blood cells.

terms.name: Anemia of inadequate production
terms.definition: A kind of anemia characterized by inadequate production of erythrocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal myeloid leukocyte morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of myeloid leukocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal total B cell count
terms.definition: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is outside the limits of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

terms.name: Decreased total B cell count
terms.definition: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is below the lower limit of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

terms.name: Abnormal phagocytosis
terms.definition: An abnormal functioning of phagocytosis. Phagocytosis is an elegant but complex process for the ingestion and elimination of pathogens, but it is also important for the elimination of apoptotic cells and hence fundamental for tissue homeostasis. Phagocytosis can be divided into four main steps: (i) recognition of the target particle, (ii) signaling to activate the internalization machinery, (iii) phagosome formation, and (iv) phagolysosome maturation.

terms.name: Abnormality of immune system physiology
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of the immune system.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating lipoprotein cholesterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环脂蛋白胆固醇浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the level of lipoprotein cholesterol
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyperlipoproteinemia
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the level of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.

terms.name: Hypolipoproteinemia
terms.definition: An abnormal decrease in the level of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.

terms.name: Polygenic inheritance
terms.definition: A mode of inheritance that depends on a mixture of major and minor genetic determinants possibly together with environmental factors. Diseases inherited in this manner are termed complex diseases.

terms.name: Oligogenic inheritance
terms.definition: A type of multifactorial inheritance governed by the simultaneous action of a few gene loci. It is recommended this term be used for traits governed by three loci, although it is noted that usage of this term in the literature is not uniform.

terms.name: Digenic inheritance
terms.definition: A type of multifactorial inheritance governed by the simultaneous action of two gene loci.

terms.name: Abnormal cellular immune system morphology
terms.name_zh: 细胞免疫系统形态异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the morphology or counts of the cells that make up the immune system.

terms.name: Abnormality of the extrinsic pathway
terms.definition: An abnormality of the extrinsic pathway (also known as the tissue factor pathway) of the coagulation cascade.

terms.name: Abnormality of the intrinsic pathway
terms.definition: An abnormality of the intrinsic pathway (also known as the contact activation pathway) of the coagulation cascade.

terms.name: Abnormality of the common coagulation pathway
terms.definition: An abnormality of blood coagulation, common pathway.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the abdominal musculature
terms.name_zh: 腹部肌肉组织形态异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the abdominal musculature.

terms.name: Stress urinary incontinence
terms.definition: Involuntary urine leakage synchronous with exertion, or actions such as sneezing, or coughing.

terms.name: Abnormal cerebral subcortex morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cerebral subcortex.

terms.name: Abnormal corpus striatum morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the striatum, which is the largest nucleus of the basal ganglia, comprising the caudate, putamen and ventral striatum, including the nucleus accumbens.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating dicarboxylic acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of dicarboxylic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating monocarboxylic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环一元羧酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of monocarboxylic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chromosomal breakage induced by ionizing radiation
terms.name_zh: 电离辐射诱导的染色体断裂
synonyms: Chromosomal breakage induced by ionising radiation
terms.definition: Increased amount of chromosomal breaks in cultured blood lymphocytes or other cells induced by treatment with ionizing radiation.

terms.name: Increased susceptibility to spontaneous sister chromatid exchange
terms.name_zh: 自发性姐妹染色单体交换易感性增加
terms.definition: An increase in the number of spontaneous sister chromatid exchanges observed in cell culture of lymphocytes or other cells.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the optic tract
terms.name_zh: 视束发育不全/发育不良

terms.name: Increased bone mineral density
terms.definition: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density, that is, of the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones which is often referred to as osteosclerosis. Osteosclerosis can be detected on radiological examination as an increased whiteness (density) of affected bones.

terms.name: Osteopetrosis
terms.definition: Abnormally increased formation of dense trabecular bone tissue. Despite the increased density of bone tissue, osteopetrotic bones tend to be more fracture-prone than normal.

terms.name: High myopia
terms.definition: A severe form of myopia with greater than -6.00 diopters.

terms.name: Abnormal systemic arterial morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the systemic arterial tree
terms.definition: An abnormality of the systemic arterial tree, which consists of the aorta and other systemic arteries.

terms.name: Mixed cirrhosis
terms.definition: A type of cirrhosis characterized by the presence of regenerative nodules of a variety of sizes.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the musculature of the neck
terms.name_zh: 颈部肌肉组织形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the musculature of the neck
terms.definition: An abnormality of the neck musculature.

terms.name: Temporal pattern
terms.definition: The speed at which disease manifestations appear and develop.

terms.name: Acute
terms.definition: Sudden appearance of disease manifestations over a short period of time.

terms.name: Chronic
terms.definition: Slow, creeping onset, slow progress and long continuance of disease manifestations.

terms.name: Subacute
terms.definition: Somewhat rapid onset and change of disease manifestations.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating polysaccharide concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a polysaccharide in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating carbohydrate concentration
terms.name_zh: 血碳水化合物浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a carbohydrate in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal glucose homeostasis
terms.definition: Abnormality of glucose homeostasis.

terms.name: Abnormal blood glucose concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of glucose in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal cellular physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality in a cellular process.

terms.name: Abnormality of the cell cycle
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cell cycle.

terms.name: Abnormality of chromosome condensation
terms.definition: An abnormality of chromosome condensation.

terms.name: Abnormality of mucopolysaccharide metabolism
terms.definition: An abnormality of the metabolism of mucopolysaccharide.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating enzyme concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of an enzyme in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating unsaturated fatty acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环不饱和脂肪酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating unsaturated fatty acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of unsaturated fatty acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating prostaglandin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环前列腺素浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of prostaglandin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
terms.definition: An abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiovascular system physiology
terms.definition: Abnormal functionality of the cardiovascular system.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the vagina
terms.name_zh: 阴道发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the vagina.

terms.name: Abnormal fallopian tube morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the fallopian tube.

terms.name: Abnormality of blood circulation
terms.definition: An abnormality of blood circulation.

terms.name: Internal hemorrhage
terms.definition: The presence of hemorrhage within the body.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating transition element cation concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环过渡元素阳离子浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal blood transition element cation concentration
Abnormality of transition element cation homeostasis
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of transition element cation in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormality of iron homeostasis
terms.definition: An abnormality of the homeostasis (concentration) of iron cation.

terms.name: Abnormality of fluid regulation
terms.definition: An abnormality of the regulation of body fluids.

terms.name: Impairment of fructose metabolism
terms.definition: An impairment of a fructose metabolic process.

terms.name: Amyloid deposition
terms.definition: Pathologic deposits of specific fibrillar protein aggregates with distinct microscopic properties, particularly affinity for the dye Congo red with typical birefringence.

terms.name: Abnormal renal cortex morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormality of renal excretion
terms.definition: An altered ability of the kidneys to void urine and/or specific substances.

terms.name: Decreased urine output
terms.definition: A decreased rate of urine production.

terms.name: Abnormal renal tubular resorption
terms.definition: An abnormality of renal absorption.

terms.name: Abnormal helix morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the helix. The helix is the outer rim of the ear that extends from the insertion of the ear on the scalp (root) to the termination of the cartilage at the earlobe.

terms.name: Abnormal intrahepatic bile duct morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the intrahepatic bile duct
terms.definition: An abnormality of the intrahepatic bile duct.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cervical spine
terms.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the cervical vertebral column.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating potassium concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of potassium(1+) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating adrenocorticotropin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血促肾上腺皮质激素浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormality of circulating adrenocorticotropic hormone level
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of corticotropin in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal number of permanent teeth
terms.definition: The presence of an altered number of of permanent teeth.

terms.name: Agenesis of permanent maxillary central incisor
synonyms: Absence of permanent maxillary central incisor
Absence of permanent upper central incisor
Absence of permanent upper front tooth
Agenesis of adult maxillary central incisor
Failure of development of permanent maxillary central incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of upper secondary incisor.

terms.name: Agenesis of primary maxillary central incisor
synonyms: Absence of deciduous maxillary central incisor
Absence of primary maxillary central incisor
Absence of upper front baby tooth
Agenesis of deciduous maxillary central incisor
Failure of development of deciduous maxillary central incisor
Failure of development of primary maxillary central incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of upper central primary incisor.

terms.name: Agenesis of primary mandibular central incisor
synonyms: Absence of deciduous mandibular central incisor
Absence of primary mandibular central incisor
Agenesis of deciduous lower central incisor
Agenesis of primary lower central incisor
Failure of development of deciduous mandibular central incisor
Failure of development of primary mandibular central incisor
Missing lower central incisor milk tooth
terms.definition: Agenesis of lower primary incisor.

terms.name: Agenesis of permanent mandibular central incisor
synonyms: Absence of permanent lower central incisor
Absence of permanent lower front tooth
Absence of permanent mandibular central incisor
Agenesis of adult mandibular central incisor
Failure of development of permanent mandibular central incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of lower secondary incisor.

terms.name: Agenesis of primary maxillary lateral incisor
synonyms: Absence of deciduous maxillary lateral incisor
Absence of primary maxillary lateral incisor
Agenesis of deciduous maxillary lateral incisor
Failure of development of deciduous maxillary lateral incisor
Failure of development of primary maxillary lateral incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of one or more maxillary lateral incisor, comprising the maxillary lateral primary incisor.

terms.name: Agenesis of permanent maxillary lateral incisor
synonyms: Absence of permanent maxillary lateral incisor
Agenesis of permanent upper lateral incisor
Failure of development of permanent maxillary lateral incisor
Failure of development of permanent upper lateral incisor
terms.definition: Agenesis of one or more upper lateral secondary incisor.

terms.name: Agenesis of premolar
terms.definition: Agenesis of premolar tooth.

terms.name: Agenesis of maxillary premolar
synonyms: Failure of development of maxillary bicuspid
Failure of development of maxillary premolar
terms.definition: Agenesis of maxillary premolar.

terms.name: Agenesis of mandibular premolar
synonyms: Failure of development of mandibular premolar
terms.definition: Agenesis of mandibular premolar.

terms.name: Agenesis of molar
terms.definition: Agenesis of molar tooth.

terms.name: Agenesis of permanent molar
synonyms: Failure of development of permanent molar
Failure of development of secondary molar
terms.definition: Agenesis of secondary molar tooth.

terms.name: Agenesis of first permanent molar tooth
synonyms: Failure of development of first permanent molar
Failure of development of six year molar
terms.definition: Agenesis of either maxillary first permanent molar or mandibular first permanent molar or both.

terms.name: Agenesis of second permanent molar
synonyms: Failure of development of second permanent molar
Failure of development of twelve year molar
terms.definition: Agenesis of either mandibular second permanent molar or maxillary second permanent molar.

terms.name: Generalized periodontitis
terms.definition: A generalized form of periodontitis.

terms.name: Localized periodontitis
terms.definition: A localized form of periodontitis.

terms.name: Dentinogenesis imperfecta limited to primary teeth
terms.name_zh: 局限于乳牙的牙本质形成不全
terms.definition: Developmental dysplasia of dentin affecting only the primary dentition.

terms.name: Abnormality of dental structure
terms.definition: An abnormality of the structure or composition of the teeth.

terms.name: Misalignment of incisors
terms.definition: Misaligned incisor.

terms.name: Abnormal incisor morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of morphology of the incisor tooth.

terms.name: Abnormal number of incisors
terms.definition: The presence of an altered number of the incisor teeth.

terms.name: Conical incisor
terms.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of the incisor tooth.

terms.name: Mesiodens
terms.definition: A supernumerary tooth in the midline between the maxillary central incisors.

terms.name: Odontoma
terms.definition: The presence of an odontoma.

terms.name: Supernumerary tooth
terms.definition: The presence of one or more teeth additional to the normal number.

terms.name: Abnormal molar morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of morphology of molar tooth.

terms.name: Abnormal permanent molar morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of shape of adult molar
Abnormality of shape of permanent molar
terms.definition: An abnormality of morphology of permanent molar.

terms.name: Rootless teeth
synonyms: Tooth with dentin dysplasia type i

terms.name: Abnormality of dental color
terms.definition: A developmental defect of tooth color.

terms.name: Localized hypoplasia of dental enamel
terms.name_zh: 局限性牙釉质发育不全
terms.definition: A localized form of developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.

terms.name: Green teeth
terms.definition: A green staining of teeth.

terms.name: Abnormality of premolar
terms.definition: An abnormality of premolar tooth.

terms.name: Abnormality of molar
terms.definition: An abnormality of molar tooth.

terms.name: Abnormality of canine
terms.definition: An abnormality of canine tooth.

terms.name: Impacted tooth
terms.definition: A tooth that has not erupted because of local impediments (overcrowding or fibrous gum overgrowth).

terms.name: Abnormal premolar morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of morphology of premolar tooth.

terms.name: Incisor macrodontia
terms.definition: Increased size of the incisor tooth.

terms.name: Conical primary incisor
terms.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of the primary incisor.

terms.name: Conical maxillary incisor
terms.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of either maxillary primary incisor tooth or maxillary permanent incisor tooth or both.

terms.name: Hypocalcification of dental enamel
terms.definition: A form of hypomineralization of enamel characterized by reduced calcification.

terms.name: Hypomature dental enamel
terms.definition: A form of hypomineralization of enamel characterized by a chalky appearance of the enamel with orange, brown, or white color.

terms.name: Dentinogenesis imperfecta of primary and permanent teeth
terms.name_zh: 乳牙及恒牙牙本质形成不全
synonyms: Dentinogenesis imperfecta of adult and baby teeth
Dentinogenesis imperfecta of both sets of teeth
terms.definition: Developmental dysplasia of dentin or both the primary dentition and the permanent dentition.

terms.name: Talon cusp
terms.definition: Talon cusp is an accessory cusp located near the cingulum (the portion of the lingual or palatal aspect of the tooth that forms a convex protuberance at the cervical third of the anatomic crown).

terms.name: Dens in dente
terms.definition: An abnormality of the incisor characterized by invagination of the enamel, giving a radiographic appearance that suggests a tooth within a tooth.

terms.name: Double tooth
terms.definition: Fusion of two adjacent teeth.

terms.name: Fused teeth
terms.definition: The union of two separately developing tooth germs typically leading to one less tooth than normal in the affected dental arch.

terms.name: Gemination
terms.definition: The development of two teeth from a single tooth bud, leading to a larger fused tooth.

terms.name: Mulberry molar
terms.definition: Mulberry molars are irregular teeth generally affecting the first molars and are characterized by a grossly deformed crown imitating, as the name implies, the surface of a mulberry.

terms.name: Molarization of premolar
terms.definition: Increased size and molar morphology of premolar tooth.

terms.name: Increased overbite
synonyms: Increased overlap of upper and lower incisors
terms.definition: Maxillary teeth cover the mandibular teeth when biting to an increased degree. The feature is defined as a vertical overlap of the maxillary incisors over the mandibular incisors that exceeds 2 mm.

terms.name: Overjet
synonyms: Protrusion of upper teeth in front of lower teeth
terms.definition: An abnormal anteroposterior extension of the maxillary teeth beyond the plane of the mandibular teeth upon jaw closure.

terms.name: Peripheral demyelination
terms.definition: A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Epileptic spasm
terms.definition: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: Grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. Epileptic spasms frequently occur in clusters. Infantile spasms are the best known form, but spasms can occur at all ages

terms.name: Speech apraxia
terms.definition: A type of apraxia that is characterized by difficulty or inability to execute speech movements because of problems with coordination and motor problems, leading to incorrect articulation. An increase of errors with increasing word and phrase length may occur.

terms.name: Spastic hemiparesis
terms.definition: Unilateral paresis (weakness) with spasticity of the affected muscles and increased tendon reflexes.

terms.name: Intestinal atresia
terms.definition: An abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the intestine.

terms.name: Ileal atresia
terms.definition: An abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the ileum.

terms.name: Abnormal left ventricular outflow tract morphology
terms.name_zh: 左心室流出道形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the left ventricular outflow tract
terms.definition: An abnormality of the outflow tract of the left ventricle.

terms.name: Abnormality of blood volume homeostasis
terms.definition: An abnormality in the amount of volume occupied by intravascular blood.

terms.name: Hypervolemia
terms.definition: An increase in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.

terms.name: Hypovolemia
terms.definition: An decrease in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.

terms.name: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of ulceration of the oral mucosa, typically presenting as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border.

terms.name: Recurrent sinusitis
terms.definition: A recurrent form of sinusitis.

terms.name: Chronic sinusitis
terms.definition: A chronic form of sinusitis.

terms.name: Recurrent tonsillitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the tonsils that has occurred repeatedly. The definition of recurrent may vary somewhat, but the criteria used recently as a measure of severity were five or more episodes of true tonsillitis per year, symptoms recurring for at least a year, and episodes that are disabling and that prevent normal functioning. In some cases recurrent tonsillitis may be related to immunosusceptibility. Evidence exists for a genetic predisposition for recurrent tonsillitis.

terms.name: Abnormal immune serum protein physiology
terms.name_zh: 免疫血清蛋白生理功能异常
synonyms: Abnormality of immune serum protein physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the concentration or function of circulating immune proteins.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating cytokine concentration
terms.definition: Abnormality of the cytokine levels in the blood, i.e., an abnormality of any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells.

terms.name: Abnormality of cytokine secretion
terms.definition: An abnormality in the production or cellular release of a cytokine (i.e., any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells).

terms.name: Defective production of NFKB1-dependent cytokines
terms.name_zh: NFKB1依赖性细胞因子生成缺陷
terms.definition: An impairment in the production by leukocytes of NFKB1-dependent cytokines such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha and interferon-alpha.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating chemokine concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality in the production or cellular release of a chemokine (a class of cytokines).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interferon concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of an interferon is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素浓度异常
terms.definition: The concentration of an interleukin (a class of cytokines) is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Abnormality of tumor necrosis factor secretion
terms.name_zh: 肿瘤坏死因子分泌异常
synonyms: Abnormality of tumour necrosis factor secretion
terms.definition: An abnormality in the production or cellular release of tumor necrosis factor.

terms.name: Abnormal nasal dorsum morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the dorsum of nose
terms.definition: An abnormality of the nasal dorsum, also known as the nasal ridge.

terms.name: Concave nasal ridge
terms.definition: Nasal ridge curving posteriorly to an imaginary line that connects the nasal root and tip.

terms.name: Abnormal skin morphology
terms.definition: Any morphological abnormality of the skin.

terms.name: Abnormal skin physiology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the physiological function of the skin.

terms.name: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin
synonyms: Abnormal tendency to infections of the skin
terms.definition: The presence of inflammation of the skin. That is, an abnormality of the skin resulting from the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal epidermal morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of the epidermis.

terms.name: Abnormal dermal melanosome morphology
terms.name_zh: 真皮黑素小体形态异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the melanosomes, i.e., of the cellular organelles in which melanin pigments are synthesized and stored within melanocytes (the cells that produce pigment in the dermis).

terms.name: Nephroptosis
terms.definition: A significant descent of the kidney as the patient moves from the supine to the erect position.

terms.name: Perioral eczema
terms.definition: A type of eczema that occurs in the lips and perioral area.

terms.name: Acute esophageal necrosis
terms.definition: A condition characterized by necrosis of the mucosal and submucosal layers of the esophagus not related to ingestion of caustic or other injurious agents. Endoscopically, there is a dark lesion ('black esophagus') distributed in a circumferential manner in the distal one-third of the esophagus with or without exudates. There is involvement of the distal esophagus ending sharply at the gastroesophageal junction.

terms.name: Bilateral fetal pyelectasis
terms.definition: A bilateral form of fetal pyelectasis.

terms.name: Abnormal renal calyx morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the morphology of the major calices or minor calices of the kidney.

terms.name: Perianal dermatitis
terms.definition: The presence of a rash (change of color and texture) of the perianal skin.

terms.name: Chronic furunculosis
terms.definition: A furuncle (boil) is a skin infection involving an entire hair follicle and nearby skin tissue. Chronic furunculosis refers to recurrent episodes of furuncles, often caused by recurrent staphylococcus infection.

terms.name: Increased sensitivity to ionizing radiation
terms.definition: An abnormally increased sensitivity to the effects of ionizing radiation.

terms.name: Low-grade fever
terms.definition: Mild fever that does not exceed 38.5 degrees centigrade.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sweat glands
terms.name_zh: 汗腺发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or developmental hypoplasia of the sweat glands.

terms.name: Aplasia of the sweat glands
terms.definition: Absence of the sweat glands.

terms.name: Non-pruritic urticaria
terms.definition: Pale reddish slightly elevated papules and plaques of 0.5-3 cm in diameter and not accompanied by pruritus.

terms.name: Abnormal skin adnexa morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skin adnexa (skin appendages), which are specialized skin structures located within the dermis and focally within the subcutaneous fatty tissue, comprising three histologically distinct structures: (1) the pilosebaceous unit (hair follicle and sebaceous glands); (2) the eccrine sweat glands; and (3) the apocrine glands.

terms.name: Gastric duplication
terms.definition: Gastric duplication is a usually cystic malformation of gastrointestinal tract, usually attached to the greater curvature of the stomach and has no communication with the stomach.

terms.name: Gastrointestinal duplication
terms.definition: A spherical hollow structure with a smooth muscle coat, lined by a mucous membrane, and attached to any part of the gastrointestinal tract, from the base of the tongue to the anus.

terms.name: Age-related cataract
synonyms: Clouding of the lens of the eye with age
terms.definition: A type of cataract (opacification of the lens) that forms during the course of aging.

terms.name: Age-related nuclear cataract
terms.name_zh: 年龄相关性核性白内障
terms.definition: A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the nucleus of the lens.

terms.name: Age-related cortical cataract
terms.name_zh: 年龄相关性皮质性白内障
terms.definition: A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the cortex of the lens.

terms.name: Age-related posterior subcapsular cataract
terms.name_zh: 年龄相关性后囊下白内障
terms.definition: A type of age-related cataract consisting of granular opacities occurring mainly in the central posterior cortex just under the posterior capsule.

terms.name: Symptomatic seizures
terms.definition: A seizure that occurs in the context of a brain insult (systemic, toxic, or metabolic) and may not recur when the underlying cause has been removed or the acute phase has elapsed.

terms.name: Dialeptic seizure
synonyms: Behavioral arrest seizure with impairment of awareness irrespective of onset
Behavioural arrest seizure with impairment of awareness irrespective of onset
Unknown onset behavioral arrest seizure with impairment of awareness
Unknown onset behavioural arrest seizure with impairment of awareness
terms.definition: A dialeptic seizure is a type of seizure characterized predominantly by reduced responsiveness or awareness and with subsequent at least partial amnesia of the event.

terms.name: Typical absence seizure
terms.definition: A typical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by its sudden onset, interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare, possibly a brief upward deviation of the eyes. Usually the patient will be unresponsive when spoken to. Duration is a few seconds to half a minute with very rapid recovery. Although not always available, an EEG would usually show 3 Hz generalized epileptiform discharges during the event.

terms.name: Absence seizure with eyelid myoclonia
terms.definition: An absence with eyelid myoclonia seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by forced upward jerking of the eyelids during an absence seizure.

terms.name: Myoclonic absence seizure
terms.definition: Myoclonic absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by an interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare and rhythmic three-per-second myoclonic movements, causing ratcheting abduction of the upper limbs leading to progressive arm elevation, and associated with 3 Hz generalized spike-wave discharges on the electroencephalogram. Duration is typically 10-60 s. Whilst impairment of consciousness may not be obvious the ILAE classified this seizure as a generalized non-motor seizure in 2017.

terms.name: Atypical absence status epilepticus
terms.name_zh: 非典型失神癫痫持续状态
terms.definition: Atypical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged atypical absence seizure.

terms.name: Early onset absence seizures
terms.definition: Typical absence seizures starting before the age of 4 years.

terms.name: Focal motor seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by a motor sign as its initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: An autonomic seizure is a type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by alteration of autonomic nervous system function as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure is a type seizure beginning with a subjective sensation.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with auditory features
terms.name_zh: 伴听觉特征的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary auditory phenomena including buzzing, ringing, drumming or single tones as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation/nausea/vomiting/other gastrointestinal phenomena
terms.name_zh: 伴上腹部不适/恶心/呕吐/其他胃肠道症状的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by symptoms or signs pertaining to the gastrointestinal system as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with gustatory features
terms.name_zh: 伴味觉特征的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with olfactory features
terms.name_zh: 伴嗅觉特征的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: Seizures characterized by olfactory phenomena as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features
terms.name_zh: 伴躯体感觉特征的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with visual features
terms.name_zh: 伴视觉特征的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colors, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction(s) of muscles(s) or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.

terms.name: Focal tonic seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained increase in muscle contraction, lasting a few seconds to minutes.

terms.name: Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia
terms.name_zh: 伴眼睑肌阵挛的局灶性发作
terms.definition: Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia, not eyelid myoclonias in the context of absence seizures.

terms.name: Generalized clonic seizure
terms.definition: Generalized clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by sustained bilateral jerking, either symmetric or asymmetric, that is regularly repetitive and involves the same muscle groups.

terms.name: Generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 全身性肌阵挛-失张力发作
terms.definition: A generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a myoclonic jerk followed by an atonic motor component.

terms.name: Simple febrile seizure
terms.definition: A short generalized seizure, of a duration of <15 min, not recurring within 24 h, occurring during a febrile episode not caused by an acute disease of the nervous system intracranial infection or severe metabolic disturbance.

terms.name: Complex febrile seizure
terms.definition: A febrile seizure that has any of the following features: focal semiology (or associated with post-ictal neurologic abnormalities beyond drowsiness, such as a Todd's paresis), prolonged seizure beyond 15 minutes, or recurring (occurring more than once) in a 24 hour period.

terms.name: Focal behavior arrest seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by an arrest or pause of activities, freezing, or immobilization as the predominant semiological feature throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal hyperkinetic seizure
terms.definition: A focal seizure characterized at onset by predominantly proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements, such as pedaling, pelvic thrusting, thrashing, rocking movements.

terms.name: Focal motor seizure with version
terms.name_zh: 伴偏转的局灶性运动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained, forced conjugate ocular, cephalic, and/or truncal rotation or lateral deviation from the midline as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: EEG with constitutional variants
terms.definition: An EEG with constitutional variants contains waves that are rare or unusual but not generally pathologic.

terms.name: EEG with 4-5/second background activity
terms.definition: EEG background activity at 4-5/second.

terms.name: Alpha-EEG
terms.definition: EEG dominated by diffuse alpha-waves (8-13Hz).

terms.name: Beta-EEG
terms.definition: EEG dominated by diffuse beta-waves (>13 Hz).

terms.name: Partial beta-EEG
terms.definition: EEG dominated by diffuse beta waves (>13 Hz) with occipitally localized alpha waves (8-13 Hz).

terms.name: Low voltage EEG
terms.definition: EEG with an amplitude less than 30 microvolts without observable occipital alpha rhythm (8-13 Hz).

terms.name: Interictal epileptiform activity
terms.definition: Epileptiform activity refers to distinctive EEG waves or complexes distinguished from background activity found in in a proportion of human subjects with epilepsy, but which can also be found in subjects without seizures. Interictal epileptiform activity refers to such activity that occurs in the absence of a clinical or subclinical seizure.

terms.name: EEG with hyperventilation-induced focal epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图过度换气诱发局灶痫样放电
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with hyperventilation-induced generalized epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图过度换气诱发全面性痫样放电
synonyms: EEG with hyperventilation-induced generalised epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Generalized epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: EEG with focal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: EEG discharges recorded in particular areas of a localized (focal) abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

terms.name: Focal epileptiform discharges with limited propagation to contralateral hemisphere
terms.name_zh: 伴向对侧半球有限传播的局灶性痫样放电
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges with spreading to contralateral hemisphere but without secondary generalization.

terms.name: Focal EEG discharges with propagation to ipsilateral hemisphere
terms.name_zh: 局灶性脑电放电向同侧半球传播
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges with spreading to the hemisphere on the same side of the brain.

terms.name: Focal EEG discharges with secondary generalization
terms.name_zh: 局灶性脑电放电继发全面化
synonyms: Focal EEG discharges with secondary generalisation
terms.definition: Focal EEG discharges that secondarily spread to both hemispheres and can then be recorded over the entire scalp.

terms.name: Bilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 双侧多灶性癫痫样放电
terms.definition: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in both hemispheres.

terms.name: Uni- and bilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Epileptiform discharges identified at multiple locations temporarily in both hemispheres and temporarily in one hemisphere.

terms.name: Unilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in one hemisphere.

terms.name: Polymorphic focal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges of different shapes and frequencies.

terms.name: EEG with focal spikes
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

terms.name: EEG with series of focal spikes
terms.definition: Focal spikes occurring for several seconds.

terms.name: EEG with focal sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with focal sharp waves
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

terms.name: EEG with focal spike waves
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with generalized epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图全面性痫样放电
terms.definition: EEG discharges recorded on the entire scalp typically seen in persons with epilepsy.

terms.name: EEG with generalized sharp slow waves
synonyms: EEG with generalised sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with generalized polymorphic epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图全面性多形性痫样放电
synonyms: EEG with generalised polymorphic epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Generalized epileptiform discharges of different shapes and frequencies.

terms.name: EEG with changes in voltage
terms.definition: EEG with abnormal amplitude.

terms.name: EEG with diffuse acceleration
terms.name_zh: 脑电图弥漫性活动加速
terms.definition: EEG frequency is abnormally increased.

terms.name: EEG with abnormally slow frequencies
terms.definition: EEG with abnormally slow frequencies.

terms.name: EEG with continuous slow activity
terms.definition: EEG showing diffuse slowing without interruption.

terms.name: EEG with intermittent slow activity
terms.definition: Non-continuous diffuse slowing of electroencephalographic patterns.

terms.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 1
terms.name_zh: 脑电图1级全面性慢活动
synonyms: EEG with generalised slow activity grade 1
terms.definition: Slowing at frequencies between 7.5 and 8.5 Hz.

terms.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 2
terms.name_zh: 脑电图2级全面性慢活动
synonyms: EEG with generalised slow activity grade 2
terms.definition: Generalized slowing of EEG activity at frequencies between 4-7 Hz.

terms.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 3
terms.name_zh: 脑电图3级全面性慢活动
synonyms: EEG with generalised slow activity grade 3
terms.definition: Generalized slowing of EEG activity at frequencies between 0.5-3 Hz.

terms.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 4
terms.name_zh: 脑电图4级全面性慢活动
synonyms: EEG with generalised slow activity grade 4
terms.definition: EEG without electrical activity.

terms.name: EEG with occipital slowing
terms.definition: Slowing in occipital areas of the scalp EEG.

terms.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade I
terms.name_zh: Ⅰ级光阵发性反应脑电图
terms.definition: Occurrence of epileptiform discharges in occipital regions during photic stimulation.

terms.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade II
terms.name_zh: Ⅱ级光阵发性反应脑电图
terms.definition: Occurrence of epileptiform discharges in occipital and central regions during photic stimulation.

terms.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade III
terms.name_zh: Ⅲ级光阵发性反应脑电图
terms.definition: Occurrence of epileptiform discharges in occipital, central, temporal and parietal regions during photic stimulation.

terms.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade IV
terms.name_zh: Ⅳ级光阵发性反应脑电图
terms.definition: Occurrence of generalized epileptiform discharges during photic stimulation.

terms.name: Hemihypsarrhythmia
terms.definition: Hypsarrhythmia occurring in one hemisphere.

terms.name: Abnormal shape of the occiput
synonyms: Abnormal shape of the back of the skull
terms.definition: An abnormal shape of occiput.

terms.name: Abnormal shape of the frontal region
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the frontal region
terms.definition: An abnormal shape of the frontal part of the head.

terms.name: Short face
terms.definition: Facial height (length) is more than two standard deviations below the mean (objective); or an apparent decrease in the height (length) of the face (subjective).

terms.name: Prominent forehead
terms.definition: Forward prominence of the entire forehead, due to protrusion of the frontal bone.

terms.name: Vertical forehead creases
terms.definition: Vertical soft tissue creases in the midline of the forehead, often extending from the hairline to the brow, and seen with facial expression or when the face is at rest.

terms.name: Depressed glabella
terms.definition: Posterior positioning of the glabella, i.e., of the midline forehead between the supraorbital ridges.

terms.name: Metopic depression
terms.definition: Linear vertical groove in the midline of the forehead, extending from hairline to glabella.

terms.name: Ablepharon
terms.definition: Absent eyelids.

terms.name: Epiblepharon
terms.definition: Redundant eyelid skin pressing the eyelashes against the cornea and/or conjunctiva.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the eyelid
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the eyelid.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C-reactive protein concentration
synonyms: Elevated C-reactive protein level in blood
Increased C-reactive protein level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of C-reactive protein in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Horizontal eyebrow
terms.definition: An eyebrow that extends straight across the brow, without curve.

terms.name: Broad eyebrow
terms.definition: Regional increase in the width (height) of the eyebrow.

terms.name: Laterally extended eyebrow
terms.definition: An eyebrow that extends laterally beyond the orbital rim rather than turning gently downward at that location.

terms.name: Prominent eyelashes
terms.definition: Eyelashes that draw the attention of the viewer due to increased density and/or length and/or curl without meeting the criteria of trichomegaly.

terms.name: Infra-orbital fold
terms.definition: Elevated ridge(s) of skin starting well below the medial aspect of the lower lid that curves gradually upward toward and/or across the nasal bridge.

terms.name: Antihelical shelf
terms.definition: Antihelix protrusion directed more anteriorly than laterally, forming a shelf overlying the posterior concha.

terms.name: Absent antihelix
terms.definition: No discernible ridge between concha and triangular fossa and helix.

terms.name: Additional crus of antihelix
terms.definition: Supernumerary ridge or crus of the ear arising from the antihelix.

terms.name: Angulated antihelix
terms.definition: Antihelical ridge that forms an acute angle between the antitragus and its bifurcation (stem) instead of a gently curving arc.

terms.name: Broad inferior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: Increased width of the inferred cross-section of the inferior crus.

terms.name: Prominent inferior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: Increased protrusion of the inferior crus relative to the prominence of the antihelix stem.

terms.name: Underdeveloped inferior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: Decreased protrusion of the inferior crus relative to the prominence of the antihelix stem.

terms.name: Prominent stem of antihelix
terms.definition: Increased protrusion of the antihelical ridge, proximal to its bifurcation, relative to the prominence of the helix.

terms.name: Serpiginous stem of antihelix
terms.definition: Posterior curving of the antihelix from its origin at the antitragus, traveling initially almost perpendicular to the descending helix and obscuring some of the concha.

terms.name: Underdeveloped stem of antihelix
terms.definition: Decreased protrusion of the antihelical ridge, proximal to its bifurcation, relative to the prominence of a normal helix.

terms.name: Abnormality of inferior crus of antihelix
synonyms: Abnormality of anterior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: An abnormality of the inferior crus of the antihelix is the lower cartilaginous ridge arising at the bifurcation of the antihelix that ends beneath the fold of the ascending helix, and separates the concha from the triangular fossa.

terms.name: Abnormality of stem of antihelix
terms.definition: An abnormality of the stem of the antihelix, which is the part below the bifurcation of the antihelix into the inferior and superior crura.

terms.name: Abnormality of superior crus of antihelix
synonyms: Abnormality of posterior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: An abnormality of the superior crus of the antihelix is the upper cartilaginous ridge arising at the bifurcation of the antihelix that ends beneath the fold of the ascending helix, and separates the concha from the triangular fossa.

terms.name: Underdeveloped superior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: Decreased protrusion of the superior crus relative to the prominence of a normal antihelix stem.

terms.name: Prominent superior crus of antihelix
terms.definition: Increased protrusion of the superior crus relative to the prominence of a normal antihelix stem.

terms.name: Everted antitragus
terms.definition: Positioning of the antitragus at an angle perpendicular to the plane of the ear (oriented away from the plane of the ear).

terms.name: Absent antitragus
terms.definition: Absence of the anterosuperior prominence of the area between the bottom of the incisura and the inner margin of the antihelix.

terms.name: Bifid antitragus
terms.definition: Double rather than single peak of the antitragus.

terms.name: Underdeveloped antitragus
terms.definition: Reduction in the anterosuperior prominence of the area between the bottom of the incisura and the inner margin of the antihelix.

terms.name: Cryptotia
terms.definition: Invagination of the superior part of the auricle under a fold of temporal skin.

terms.name: Type I cryptotia
terms.definition: A type of cryptotia associated with reduction in size of the antihelix and superior crus.

terms.name: Type II cryptotia
terms.definition: A type of cryptotia associated with reduction in size of the antihelix and inferior crus that are affected.

terms.name: Absent crus of helix
terms.definition: Continuum between the tragus and ascending helix, without any evidence of a posterior extension (crus) towards the concha.

terms.name: Crus of helix connected to antihelix
terms.definition: Extension of the ridge of the crus helix across the ear and connection of the crus to the antihelix.

terms.name: Serpiginous crus of helix
terms.definition: Curving course of the crus of the helix, approaching or joining the antitragus.

terms.name: Tragal bridge of crus of helix
terms.definition: The anterior origin of the crus encompasses the superior margin of the tragus, the crus overrides the upper portion of the conchal cavum and ends at the antihelix.

terms.name: Expanded terminal portion of crus of helix
terms.definition: Widening, rather than tapering, of the crus at its posterior border near the antihelix.

terms.name: Darwin notch of helix
terms.definition: Small defect of the helical fold that lies at the junction of the superior and descending portions of the helix.

terms.name: Darwin tubercle of helix
terms.definition: Small expansion of the helical fold at the junction of the superior and descending portions of the helix.

terms.name: Crimped helix
terms.definition: Linear, circumferential indentation in the convexity of the outer surface of the helix.

terms.name: Forward facing earlobe
terms.definition: Positioning of the anterior surface of the ear lobe in a more coronal plane than the remainder of the ear.

terms.name: Discontinuous ascending root of helix
terms.definition: Interruption between the ascending helix and the crus helix, allowing the ascending helix to be attached directly to the mastoid.

terms.name: Cleft earlobe
terms.definition: Discontinuity in the convexity of the inferior margin of the lobe.

terms.name: Microtia, first degree
terms.definition: Presence of all the normal ear components and the median longitudinal length more than two standard deviations below the mean.

terms.name: Microtia, third degree
terms.definition: Presence of some auricular structures, but none of these structures conform to recognized ear components.

terms.name: Absent tragus
terms.definition: Lack of convexity or prominence of the contour of the ridge between the bottom of the incisura and the confluence of the ascending helix and crus helix.

terms.name: Bifid tragus
terms.definition: Increased height of the tragal ridge with a shallow indentation at the apex, giving the appearance of a double peak.

terms.name: Duplicated tragus
terms.definition: A complete or partial duplication of the tragus; expected to lie anterior to the normal tragus.

terms.name: Prominent tragus
terms.definition: Increase posterolateral protrusion of the tragus.

terms.name: Underdeveloped tragus
terms.definition: Decreased posterolateral protrusion of the tragus.

terms.name: Anisocytosis
synonyms: Unequal size of red blood cells
terms.definition: Abnormally increased variability in the size of erythrocytes.

terms.name: Recurrent mycobacterial infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of mycobacterial infection.

terms.name: Recurrent mycobacterium avium complex infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial avium complex infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of mycobacterial infection.

terms.name: Abnormality of the urinary system physiology
Intrapulmonary lobar sequestration
terms.definition: A type of pulmonary sequestration that occurs within the visceral pleura of normal lung tissue, usually without communication with the tracheobronchial tree.

terms.name: Abnormality of urine bicarbonate level
terms.definition: An abnormal amount of hydrogencarbonate in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormality of urine calcium concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality of calcium concentration in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormality of urine catecholamine level
terms.definition: An abnormal amount of urinary catecholamine concentration.

terms.name: Abnormal hindbrain morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the hindbrain, also known as the rhombencephalon.

terms.name: Abnormal metencephalon morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the metencephalon. The metencephalon is the part of the hindbrain that consists of the pons and the cerebellum.

terms.name: Short-segment aganglionic megacolon
terms.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment does not extend beyond the upper sigmoid.

terms.name: Long-segment aganglionic megacolon
terms.name_zh: 长段无神经节性巨结肠
terms.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment extends proximal to the sigmoid.

terms.name: Total colonic aganglionosis
terms.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment comprises the entire colon.

terms.name: EEG with occipital sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the occipital region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with parietal sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the parietal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with temporal sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the temporal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with frontal sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the frontal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with central sharp slow waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the central region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with occipital sharp waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the occipital region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

terms.name: EEG with central sharp waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the central region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

terms.name: EEG with frontal sharp waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the frontal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

terms.name: EEG with parietal sharp waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the parietal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

terms.name: EEG with temporal sharp waves
terms.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the temporal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

terms.name: Abnormal digit morphology
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of a digit, i.e., of a finger or toe.

terms.name: Prominent digit pad
terms.definition: A soft tissue prominence of the ventral aspects of the fingertips or toe tips.

terms.name: Partial absence of finger
terms.definition: The absence of a phalangeal segment of a finger.

terms.name: Broad fingertip
terms.definition: Increased width of the distal segment of a finger.

terms.name: Absent foot
terms.definition: The total absence of the foot, with no bony elements distal to the tibia or fibula.

terms.name: Long palm
terms.definition: For children from birth to 16 years of age the length of the palm is more than the 97th centile; or, the length of the palm appears relatively long compared to the finger length or the limb length.

terms.name: Convex contour of sole
terms.definition: The contour of the foot in lateral profile has a convex shape.

terms.name: Broad thumb
terms.definition: Increased thumb width without increased dorso-ventral dimension.

terms.name: Partial absence of toe
terms.definition: The absence of a phalangeal segment of a toe or hallux.

terms.name: Splayed toes
terms.definition: Divergence of digits along the anteroposterior axis (in the plane of the sole).

terms.name: Slender toe
terms.definition: Toes that are disproportionately narrow (reduced girth) for the hand/foot size or build of the individual.

terms.name: Tapered toe
terms.definition: The gradual reduction in girth of the toe from proximal to distal.

terms.name: Bridged palmar crease
terms.definition: A crease that connects the proximal and distal transverse palmar creases.

terms.name: Sydney crease
terms.definition: Extension of the proximal transverse crease (five finger crease) to the ulnar edge of the palm.

terms.name: Fused nails
terms.definition: A nail plate that has a longitudinal separation with partially separated nails, each with a separate lateral radius of curvature.

terms.name: Narrow nail
terms.definition: Decreased width of nail.

terms.name: Abnormal long bone morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of size or shape of the long bones.

terms.name: Unicoronal synostosis
terms.definition: Synostosis affecting only one of the coronal sutures.

terms.name: Left unicoronal synostosis
terms.definition: Synostosis affecting only the left coronal suture.

terms.name: Right unicoronal synostosis
terms.definition: Unicoronal synostosis affecting only the right coronal suture.

terms.name: Bicoronal synostosis
terms.definition: Synostosis affecting the right and the left coronal suture.

terms.name: Bilambdoid synostosis
terms.definition: Premature synostosis of both lambdoid sutures.

terms.name: Unilambdoid synostosis
terms.definition: Premature synostosis of only one lambdoid suture.

terms.name: Left unilambdoid synostosis
terms.definition: Premature synostosis of only the left lambdoid suture.

terms.name: Right unilambdoid synostosis
terms.definition: Premature synostosis of only the right lambdoid suture.

terms.name: Cleft of chin
terms.definition: Incomplete fusion of the chin, resulting from a developmental defect and manifesting as a midline cleft or fissure of the chin.

terms.name: Multiple suture craniosynostosis
terms.definition: Craniosynostosis involving at least 2 cranial sutures, where the exact pattern of sutures fused has not been precisely specified.

terms.name: Pansynostosis
terms.definition: Craniosynostosis of all calvarial sutures.

terms.name: Anterior plagiocephaly
terms.definition: Asymmetry of the anterior part of the skull.

terms.name: Posterior plagiocephaly
terms.definition: Asymmetry of the posterior part of the skull.

terms.name: Abnormal fontanelle morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the fontanelle.

terms.name: Abnormality of cranial sutures
terms.definition: Any anomaly of a cranial suture, that is one of the six membrane-covered openings in the incompletely ossified skull of the fetus or newborn infant.

terms.name: Metopic synostosis
terms.definition: Premature fusion of the metopic suture.

terms.name: Hemifacial atrophy
synonyms: Atrophy of one side of the face
terms.definition: Unilateral atrophy of facial tissues, including muscles, bones and skin.

terms.name: Hemifacial hypoplasia
synonyms: Decrease in size of half of face
Decrease in size of one side of the face
Decreased size of half of the face
Decreased size of one side of the face
Shrinking of one side of the face
terms.definition: Unilateral underdevelopment of the facial tissues, including muscles and bones.

terms.name: Asymmetric crying face
synonyms: Hypoplasia of depressor angula oris muscle
terms.definition: Asymmetry observed in the face of a neonate or infant whose face appears symmetric at rest and asymmetric during crying as the mouth is pulled downward on one side while not moving on the other side.

terms.name: Frontal hirsutism
terms.definition: Excessive amount of hair growth on forehead.

terms.name: Bitemporal forceps marks
synonyms: Congenital ectodermal dysplasia of the face
terms.definition: Bilateral temporal scarlike defects, which are said to resemble forceps marks.

terms.name: Abnormality of mouth shape
terms.definition: An abnormality of the outline, configuration, or contour of the mouth.

terms.name: Abnormality of upper lip vermillion
terms.definition: An abnormality of the vermilion border, the sharp demarcation between the lip (red colored) and the adjacent normal skin.

terms.name: Incomplete cleft of the upper lip
synonyms: Incomplete cleft of the upper lip
Notched cleft of the upper lip
Partial cleft of the upper lip
terms.definition: Cleft of the upper lip that does not go all the way from the bottom of the upper lip until the nasal cavity.

terms.name: Long upper lip
synonyms: Increased vertical length of upper lip
terms.definition: Increased width of the upper lip.

terms.name: Mild global developmental delay
terms.definition: A mild delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

terms.name: Moderate global developmental delay
terms.definition: A moderate delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

terms.name: Severe global developmental delay
terms.definition: A severe delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

terms.name: Moderate expressive language delay
terms.name_zh: 中度表达性语言发育迟缓
terms.definition: A moderate delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.

terms.name: Mild expressive language delay
terms.name_zh: 轻度表达性语言发育迟缓
terms.definition: A mild delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.

terms.name: Abnormality of ocular abduction
terms.definition: An abnormality involving the movement of the eye outwards.

terms.name: Abnormal sixth cranial nerve morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the sixth cranial nerve
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the abducens nerve.

terms.name: Mild receptive language delay
terms.name_zh: 轻度感受性语言发育迟缓
terms.definition: A mild delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.

terms.name: Moderate receptive language delay
terms.name_zh: 中度感受性语言发育迟缓
terms.definition: A moderate delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.

terms.name: Severe receptive language delay
terms.definition: A severe delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.

terms.name: Arterial intimal fibrosis
terms.definition: Formation of excess fibrous connective tissue in the tunica intima (innermost layer) of arteries.

terms.name: Generalized abnormality of skin
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skin that is not localized to any one particular region.

terms.name: Localized skin lesion
terms.definition: A lesion of the skin that is located in a specific region rather than being generalized.

terms.name: Regional abnormality of skin
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skin that is restricted to a particular body region.

terms.name: Generalized hypopigmentation of hair
terms.definition: Reduced pigmentation of hair diffusely.

terms.name: Dry hair
terms.definition: Hair that lacks the luster (shine or gleam) of normal hair.

terms.name: Acquired abnormal hair pattern
terms.definition: An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth that is acquired during the course of life.

terms.name: Congenital abnormal hair pattern
terms.definition: A congenital abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.

terms.name: Abnormal hair quantity
terms.definition: An abnormal amount of hair.

terms.name: Abnormality of hair growth rate
synonyms: Abnormality of pace of hair growth
Abnormality of speed of hair growth
terms.definition: Hair whose growth rate deviates from the norm.

terms.name: White hair
terms.definition: Hypopigmented hair that appears white.

terms.name: Patchy hypopigmentation of hair
terms.definition: Reduced pigmentation of hair in patches.

terms.name: Yellow nails
terms.definition: Yellowish discoloration of the nails.

terms.name: Epidermal thickening
terms.definition: Thickening of the epidermal layer of the skin.

terms.name: Mongolian blue spot
terms.definition: Congenital deep dermal melanosis in the sacral area.

terms.name: Recurrent cutaneous fungal infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to cutaneous fungal infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of cutaneous fungal infections.

terms.name: Recurrent viral skin infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral skin infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral skin infections.

terms.name: Aplasia of the inner ear
terms.definition: Absence of the inner ear due to a developmental defect.

terms.name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea
terms.definition: Incomplete formation of the cochlear partition. The scala vestibuli and scala tympani separated by the cochlear partition, except in the apical turn where the two scalae are in continuity via the helicotrema.

terms.name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea type I
terms.definition: Incomplete partition I is also known as cystic cochleovestibular malformation, where the cochlea has no bony modiolus, resulting in an empty cystic cochlea. This is accompanied by a dilated cystic vestibule with developmental arrest at the fifth week of gestation.

terms.name: Cochlear aplasia
terms.definition: Absence of the cochlea, a spiral shaped cavity in the inner ear, owing to a developmental defect.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the vestibule of the inner ear
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the vestibule of the inner ear
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality of the vestibule, the central part of the osseous labyrinth that is situated medial to the tympanic cavity, behind the cochlea, and in front of the semicircular canals.

terms.name: Aplasia of the vestibule
terms.definition: Complete absence of the vestibule of the inner ear.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the vestibule of the inner ear
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the vestibule of the inner ear.

terms.name: Dilated vestibule of the inner ear
terms.definition: Dilatation of the vestibule of the inner ear.

terms.name: Abnormal semicircular canal morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the semicircular canal
terms.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of the semicircular canal.

terms.name: Aplasia of the semicircular canal
terms.definition: Absence of the semicircular canal.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the semicircular canal
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the semicircular canal.

terms.name: Enlarged semicircular canal
terms.definition: Increased size of the semicircular canal.

terms.name: Abnormality of the internal auditory canal
synonyms: Abnormality of the internal acoustic meatus
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Internal acoustic meatus, i.e., of the canal in the petrous part of the temporal bone through which the cranial nerve VII and cranial nerve VIII traverse.

terms.name: Absent internal auditory canal
terms.definition: Aplasia of the internal auditory canal.

terms.name: Narrow internal auditory canal
terms.definition: Reduction in diameter of the internal auditory canal.

terms.name: Enlarged vestibular aqueduct
terms.definition: Increased size of the vestibular aqueduct.

terms.name: Enlarged cochlear aqueduct
terms.definition: Increased size of the cochlear duct, i.e., of a duct that communicates between the perilymphatic space and the subarachnoid space, and transmits a vein from the cochlea to join the internal jugular.

terms.name: Functional abnormality of the inner ear
synonyms: Functional abnormality of the inner ear
terms.definition: An abnormality of the function of the inner ear.

terms.name: Abnormal inner ear morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the inner ear
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the internal part of the ear.

terms.name: Abnormal inner ear nerve morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the nerves of the inner ear

terms.name: Aplasia of the vestibular nerve
synonyms: Aplasia of the eighth cranial nerve
terms.definition: Absence of the vestibular nerve

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the vestibular nerve
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the eighth cranial nerve
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the vestibular nerve.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cochlea
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the cochlea, a spiral shaped cavity in the inner ear, owing to a developmental defect.

terms.name: Abnormality of the cochlear nerve
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the cohclear nerve, which is the part of the vestibulocochlear nerve that is responsible for transmitting auditory signals from the inner ear to the cochlear nuclei within the brainstem and ultimately to the primary auditory cortex within the temporal lobe.

terms.name: Abnormal spinal cord dorsal column morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the dorsal column of the spinal cord
terms.definition: An abnormality of the dorsal columns, i.e., of the dorsal portion of the gray substance of the spinal cord. The dorsal column consists of the fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus and itself is part of the dorsal funiculus.

terms.name: Tibialis anterior muscle atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting of the tibialis anterior muscle.

terms.name: Abnormal CNS myelination
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统髓鞘形成异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of myelination of nerves in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Delayed peripheral myelination
terms.definition: Delayed myelination in the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Demyelinating sensory neuropathy
terms.definition: Demyelination of peripheral sensory nerves.

terms.name: Abnormal umbilical cord blood vessel morphology
Lethal short-trunk short stature
terms.name_zh: 致死性短躯干型身材矮小
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs that is lethal at birth.

terms.name: Childhood onset short-limb short stature
terms.name_zh: 儿童期起病短肢型矮小身材

terms.name: Infancy onset short-trunk short stature
terms.name_zh: 婴儿期起病短躯干矮小身材
terms.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with onset in infancy.

terms.name: Moderate intrauterine growth retardation
terms.definition: Intrauterine growth retardation that is at least 3 standard deviations (SD) below average, but not as low as 4 SD, corrected for sex and gestational age.

terms.name: Abnormal placental membrane morphology
terms.definition: Structural anomaly of the fetal membranes (also known as the amniochorionic or placental membranes), which comprise a vital intrauterine compartment, where they perform mechanical, immune, and endocrine functions to promote growth of the fetus and protection from environmental adversity. Amniochorionic membranes anatomically consist of a single layer of cuboidal amnion epithelial cells, chorionic trophoblasts, and scattered fibroblasts connected by a layer of type IV collagen-rich extracellular matrix.

terms.name: Caesarean section
terms.definition: Delivery of a fetus through surgical incisions made through the abdominal wall (laparotomy) and the uterine wall (hysterotomy).

terms.name: Ventouse delivery
