terms.name: Renal oncocytoma
terms.definition: A renal tumor originating from an oncocyte, which is an epithelial cell characterized by an excessive amount of mitochondria, resulting in an abundant acidophilic, granular cytoplasm.

terms.name: Midface retrusion
terms.definition: Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle.

terms.name: Enlargement of parotid gland
terms.definition: Increased size of the parotid gland.

terms.name: Hamartoma of tongue
terms.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the tongue.

terms.name: Bifid nose
synonyms: Indentation or clefting of the nose
terms.definition: Visually assessable vertical indentation, cleft, or depression of the nasal bridge, ridge and tip.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle physiology
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

terms.name: Abnormal skeletal muscle morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

terms.name: Type 1 muscle fiber atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy (wasting) affecting primary type 1 muscle fibers. This feature in general can only be observed on muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Decreased patellar reflex
terms.definition: Decreased intensity of the patellar reflex (also known as the knee jerk reflex).

terms.name: Paradoxical myotonia
terms.definition: A type of myotonia that worsens with repeated muscle contractions.

terms.name: Impaired two-point discrimination
terms.definition: A reduced ability to distinguish tactile sensations at points that are very close to one another. This can be tested by using special calipers whose points can be set from 2mm to several centimeters apart.

terms.name: Impaired touch localization
terms.definition: A reduced ability to identify precisely the site of a touch. This test is usually carried out by asking a patient, whose eyes are closed or covered, to touch the same site with a fingertip.

terms.name: Agraphesthesia
terms.definition: Impaired ability to recognize letters or numbers drawn by an examiner's fingertip on the patient's skin (the patients eyes are closed or covered throughout this examination).

terms.name: Increased cerebral lipofuscin
terms.definition: Lipofuscin (age pigment) is a brown-yellow, electron-dense, autofluorescent material that accumulates progressively over time in lysosomes of postmitotic cells, such as neurons and cardiac myocytes. This term pertains if there is an increase in the accumulation of lipofuscin (also known as autofluorescent lipoprotein) more than expected for the age of the patient.

terms.name: Increased urinary hypoxanthine level
terms.definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Cephalocele
terms.definition: A congenital defect in the skull, whereby there is a protrusion of part of the cranial contents through a congenital defect in the cranium, usually covered with skin or mucous membrane. The term encephalocele refers to a subclass of these lesions in which brain tissue protrudes through the defect.

terms.name: Parietal encephalocele
terms.definition: An encephalocele located between bregma and lambda.

terms.name: Basal encephalocele
terms.definition: Basal encephalocele is an encephalocele that occurs along the cribriform plate or through the sphenoid bone. The mass may appear in the nasal cavity, nasopharynx, epipharynx, sphenoid sinus, posterior orbit, or pterygopalatine fossa. The important distinction from other types is that no external tumor is visible except in those rare instances of herniations so large that they protrude through the mouth or nares.

terms.name: Submucous cleft soft palate
terms.definition: A cleft of the muscular (soft) portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane. Soft-palate submucous clefts are characterized by a midline deficiency or lack of muscle tissue.

terms.name: Membranous choanal atresia
terms.definition: Absence of the normal opening of the choana (the posterior nasal aperture) as a result of an obstructing choanal membrane that may be thin and strandlike or thick and pluglike.

terms.name: Abnormal facial skeleton morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of one or more of the set of bones that make up the facial skeleton.

terms.name: Broad chin
terms.definition: Increased width of the midpoint of the mandible (mental protuberance) and overlying soft tissue.

terms.name: Chin with horizontal crease
terms.definition: Horizontal crease or fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin, with the face at rest.

terms.name: Chin with H-shaped crease
terms.definition: H-shaped crease in the fat pad of the chin.

terms.name: Tented philtrum
terms.definition: Prominence of a triangular soft tissue area of the philtrum with the apex to the columella.

terms.name: Philtrum with midline raphe
terms.definition: Narrow ridge in the midline of the philtral groove.

terms.name: Malaligned philtral ridges
terms.definition: Absence of the usual parallel position of philtral ridges.

terms.name: Midline sinus of philtrum
terms.definition: Pit in the midline of the philtral groove.

terms.name: Narrow philtrum
terms.definition: Distance between the philtral ridges, measured just above the vermilion border, more than 2 standard deviations below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between the ridges of the philtrum.

terms.name: Abnormal oral mucosa morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the oral mucosa.

terms.name: Deviated nasal tip
terms.definition: Nasal tip positioned to one side of the midline.

terms.name: Narrow nasal tip
terms.definition: Decrease in width of the nasal tip.

terms.name: Overhanging nasal tip
terms.definition: Positioning of the nasal tip inferior to the nasal base.

terms.name: Moyamoya phenomenon
terms.definition: A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial carotid arteries owing to the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the circle of Willis.

terms.name: Absent scaphoid
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the scaphoid..

terms.name: Delayed talus ossification
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the talus.

terms.name: Sclerodactyly
terms.definition: Localized thickening and tightness of the skin of the fingers or toes.

terms.name: Abnormal total T cell number
terms.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number (either count per volume or proportion of total lymphocytes) of T cells or of a subset of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

terms.name: Abnormal T cell physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of T cells.

terms.name: Ventricular flutter
terms.definition: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia characterized by an extremely rapid, hemodynamically unstable ventricular tachycardia (150-300 beats/min) with a large oscillating sine-wave appearance.

terms.name: Abnormal skeletal morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the form, structure, or size of the skeletal system.

terms.name: Abnormal musculoskeletal physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the function of the skeletal system.

terms.name: Abnormal appendicular skeleton morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the appendicular skeletal system, consisting of the of the limbs, shoulder and pelvic girdles.

terms.name: Short second metatarsal
terms.definition: Short (hypoplastic) second metatarsal bone.

terms.name: Osteoblastoma
terms.definition: A benign, painful, tumor of bone characterized by the formation of osteoid tissue, primitive bone and calcified tissue.

terms.name: Giant cell tumor of bone
terms.definition: A bone tumor composed of cellular spindle-cell stroma containing scattered multinucleated giant cells resembling osteoclasts.

terms.name: Abdominal colic
terms.definition: A type of abdominal pain that comes and goes in waves, most often starting and ending suddenly and being of severe intensity.

terms.name: Abnormal bone ossification
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the formation of bone or of a bony substance, or the conversion of fibrous tissue or of cartilage into bone or a bony substance.

terms.name: Parotitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the parotid gland.

terms.name: Hemopericardium
terms.definition: Accumulation of blood within the pericardial sac.

terms.name: Chylopericardium
terms.definition: Accumulation of chyle (the whitish fluid taken up by the lacteals in the intestine, consisting of an emulsion of lymph and triglyceride fat thatpasses into the veins by the thoracic duct) in the pericardium. Chylopericardium is generally caused by obstruction of or trauma to the thoracic duct.

terms.name: Serous pericardial effusion
terms.definition: Accumulation of serous fluid (pale yellow and transparent fluid) in the pericardial sac.

terms.name: Hemoperitoneum
terms.definition: Accumulation of blood in the peritoneal cavity owing to internal hemorrhage.

terms.name: Pharyngeal edema
terms.definition: Abnormal accumulation of fluid leading to swelling of the pharynx.

terms.name: Pica
terms.definition: An appetite for and the persistent ingestion of non-food substances such as clay. In order to diagnose pica, this behavior must have persisted over a period of at least one month.

terms.name: Plasmacytoma
terms.definition: A discrete mass of neoplastic monoclonal plasma cells either in the bone marrow or in an extramedullary location.

terms.name: Reduced factor IX activity
terms.definition: Decreased activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

terms.name: Punctate keratitis
terms.definition: A type of keratitis characterized by inflammation in pinpoint areas of the corneal epithelium.

terms.name: Metaphyseal dappling
terms.definition: The presence of spots or rounded patches of abnormally increased density of metaphyseal bone.

terms.name: Bilateral trilobed lung
terms.definition: Both lungs have three lobes. Normally, the left lung has two lobes, whereas the right lung has three lobes.

terms.name: Abnormal bone collagen fibril morphology
terms.name_zh: 骨胶原原纤维形态异常
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of bone tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

terms.name: Abnormal sternal ossification
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the formation of the bony substance of the sternum.

terms.name: Elevated plasma pyrophosphate
terms.definition: An abnormally increased diphosphate(4-) concentration in the blood. Diphosphate(4-), as ester with two phosphate groups, is also known as pyrophosphate.

terms.name: Abnormal iliac wing morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the wing of the ilium
terms.definition: An anomaly of the ilium ala. This is the large expanded portion of the ilum which bounds the greater pelvis laterally.

terms.name: Sciatica
terms.definition: Pain in the lower back and hip radiating in the distribution of the sciatic nerve.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet function
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the function of thrombocytes.

terms.name: Impaired arachidonic acid-induced platelet aggregation
terms.name_zh: 花生四烯酸诱导血小板聚集障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal response to arachidonic acid as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of arachidonic acid.

terms.name: Impaired ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation
terms.name_zh: 瑞斯托霉素诱导的血小板聚集障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin.

terms.name: Impaired thrombin-induced platelet aggregation
terms.name_zh: 凝血酶诱导的血小板聚集障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal response to thrombin or thrombin mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thrombin (or thrombin mimetics).

terms.name: Abnormal platelet count
terms.definition: Abnormal number of platelets per volume of blood. In a healthy adult, a normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 per microliter of blood.

terms.name: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia
terms.name_zh: 肝素诱导性血小板减少症
terms.definition: Low platelet count following administration of unfractionated or (less commonly) low-molecular weight heparin.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly in platelet form, ultrastructure, or intracellular organelles.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet volume
terms.definition: Anomalous size of platelets. Most normal sized platelets are 1.5 to 3 micrometers in diameter. Large platelets are 4 to 7 micrometers. Giant platelets are larger than 7 micrometers and usually 10 to 20 micrometers.

terms.name: Increased mean platelet volume
terms.definition: Average platelet volume above the upper limit of the normal reference interval.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet membrane protein expression
terms.name_zh: 血小板膜蛋白表达异常
terms.definition: Presence of reduced amount of a membrane protein on the cell membrane of platelets. This feature is typically measured by flow cytometry.

terms.name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein Ib-IX-V
terms.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of the glycoprotein complex Ib-IX-V.

terms.name: Acute disseminated intravascular coagulation
terms.name_zh: 急性弥散性血管内凝血
terms.definition: An acute form of disseminated intravascular coagulation. Acute DIC can occur following sudden exposure of blood to procoagulants, with the compensatory hemostatic mechanisms becoming overwhelmed.

terms.name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein VI
terms.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein VI.

terms.name: Decreased platelet P2Y12 receptor
terms.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of P2Y12 receptor.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet granules
terms.definition: An anomaly of alpha or dense granules or platelet lysosomes.

terms.name: Abnormal umbilical stump bleeding
terms.definition: Abnormal bleeding of the umbilical stump following separation of the cord at approximately 7-10 days after birth.

terms.name: Hemorrhage of the eye
terms.definition: Bleeding from vessels of the various tissues of the eye.

terms.name: Hyphema
terms.definition: Bleeding in the anterior chamber of the eye.

terms.name: Choroid hemorrhage
terms.definition: Hemorrhage from the vessels of the choroid.

terms.name: Bleeding requiring red cell transfusion
terms.definition: Bleeding sufficiently severe as to require red cell transfusion (WHO Grade 3 or 4).

terms.name: Bleeding with minor or no trauma
synonyms: Bleeding with minor or no trauma
terms.definition: Significant bleeding or hemorrhage without significant precipitating factor.

terms.name: Prolonged bleeding following procedure
terms.definition: Prolonged or protracted bleeding following an invasive procedure or intervention.

terms.name: Post-partum hemorrhage
terms.definition: Significant maternal hemorrhage/blood loss following deilvery of a child.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin K concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin K in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal leukocyte count
terms.definition: Number of leukocytes per volume of blood beyond normal limits.

terms.name: Impaired thromboxane A2 agonist-induced platelet aggregation
terms.name_zh: 血栓烷A2激动剂诱导的血小板聚集障碍
terms.definition: Abnormal response to thromboxane as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thromboxane A2 receptor agonists.

terms.name: Anemia due to reduced life span of red cells
terms.name_zh: 红细胞寿命缩短性贫血
synonyms: Anaemia due to reduced life span of red cells
terms.definition: A type of anemia related to a reduction in the average life span of red blood cells in the peripheral circulation, which is normally around 120 days.

terms.name: Subconjunctival hemorrhage
terms.definition: Bleeding beneath the mucous membrane that lines the inner surface of the eyelid.

terms.name: Increased total neutrophil count
terms.name_zh: 总中性粒细胞计数升高
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Abnormality of circulating fibrinogen
terms.definition: An abnormality of the level of activity of circulating fibrinogen.

terms.name: Hyperfibrinogenemia
terms.definition: Increased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

terms.name: Hypofibrinogenemia
terms.definition: Decreased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

terms.name: Dysfibrinogenemia
terms.definition: Qualitatively abnormal fibrinogen.

terms.name: Abnormal hemoglobin
terms.definition: Anomaly in the level or the function of hemoglobin, the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes.

terms.name: HbH hemoglobin
terms.definition: Hemoglobin H (HbH) contains four beta-globin chains. It is normally not present at all in blood, but may make up about 1-40 percent of all hemoglobin in HbH disease, a subform of alpha thalassemia.

terms.name: Persistence of hemoglobin F
terms.definition: Hemoglobin F (HbF) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin gamma chains. It is the main form of hemoglobin in the fetus during the last seven months of intrauterine development and in the half year of postnatal life. In adults it normally makes up less than one percent of all hemoglobin. This term refers to an increase in HbF above this limit. In beta thalassemia major, it may represent over 90 percent of all hemoglobin, and in beta thalassemia minor it may make up between 0.5 to 4 percent.

terms.name: Reduced hemoglobin A
terms.definition: Hemoglobin A (HbA) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin beta chains. HbA is normally the main adult hemoglobin, representing about 96-98 percent of all hemoglobin. This term represents a decreased in the proportion of HbA below this limit, and can be seen in various forms of thalassemia.

terms.name: Reduced beta/alpha synthesis ratio
terms.definition: A reduction in the ratio of production of beta globin to that of alpha globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of beta thalassemia.

terms.name: Reduced alpha/beta synthesis ratio
terms.definition: A reduction in the ratio of production of alpha globin to that of beta globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of alpha thalassemia.

terms.name: Unilateral radial aplasia
terms.definition: Missing radius bone on one side only associated with congenital failure of development.

terms.name: Flattened metacarpal heads
synonyms: Flattened head of long bone of hand
terms.definition: Abnormally flat shape of the heads of the metacarpal bones.

terms.name: Shortening of all phalanges of fingers
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in length affecting all phalanges.

terms.name: Abnormal metacarpophalangeal joint morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of a metacarpophalangeal joint.

terms.name: Abnormality of the glenoid fossa
terms.definition: An anomaly of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.

terms.name: Lumbar hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the lumbar region.

terms.name: Thoracic hypertrichosis
terms.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the thoracic region.

terms.name: Cardiovascular calcification
terms.definition: Abnormal calcification in the cardiovascular system.

terms.name: Toe extensor amyotrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the extensor digitorum longus muscles, which mediate extension of the toes.

terms.name: Short 5th toe
terms.definition: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the fifth toe.

terms.name: Clinodactyly of the 4th toe
terms.definition: Bending or curvature of a fourth toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

terms.name: Pleural empyema
terms.definition: Accumulation of pus in the pleural cavity.

terms.name: Transudative pleural effusion
terms.definition: A type of pleural effusion with a transudate (extravascular fluid with low protein content and a low specific gravity). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH.

terms.name: Exudative pleural effusion
terms.definition: A type of pleural effusion with a exudate (extravascular fluid that has exuded out of a tissue or its capillaries due to injury or inflammation). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH.

terms.name: Abnormal activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
terms.name_zh: 线粒体呼吸链活性异常
terms.definition: An increased or decreased activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.

terms.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex I
terms.name_zh: 线粒体复合物I活性降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex I, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

terms.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex III
terms.name_zh: 线粒体复合物III活性降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

terms.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial ATP synthase complex
terms.name_zh: 线粒体ATP合酶复合物活性降低
synonyms: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex V
terms.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, which makes ATP via oxidative phosphorylation, and is sometimes described as Complex V of the electron transport chain.

terms.name: Proximal placement of hallux
terms.definition: Proximal mislocalization of the big toe from its normal position.

terms.name: Short digit
terms.definition: One or more digit that appears disproportionately short compared to the hand/foot, whereby either the entire digit or a specific phalanx is shortened.

terms.name: Short proximal phalanx of toe
terms.definition: Developmental hypoplasia (shortening) of proximal phalanx of toe.

terms.name: Hypersegmentation of proximal phalanx of third finger
terms.name_zh: 第三指近节指骨分叶过多
terms.definition: Presence of an additional phalanx-like bone, producing an extra, wedge-shaped bone at the base of the proximal phalanx of the third finger.

terms.name: Abnormal cerebellar peduncle morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the cerebellar peduncles. The superior, middle, and inferior cerebellar peduncles emerge from the cerebellum. The superior cerebellar penduncles connect the cerebellum to the midbrain, the middle cerebellar peduncles connect the cerebellum to the pons, and the inferior cerebellar peduncle connects the medulla spinalis and medulla oblongata with the cerebellum.

terms.name: Abnormal superior cerebellar peduncle morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the superior cerebellar peduncle
terms.definition: An anomaly of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

terms.name: Elongated superior cerebellar peduncle
terms.definition: Increased length of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

terms.name: Dilatation of mesenteric artery
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the inferior mesenteric artery or superior mesenteric artery .

terms.name: Decreased urinary urate
terms.definition: Decreased concentration of urate in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased plasma total carnitine
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of total carnitine in the blood.

terms.name: Hypoplastic fifth toenail
terms.definition: Underdeveloped nails of the fifth toes.

terms.name: 3-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between fingers 3 and 4.

terms.name: Anterior wedging of T12
synonyms: Anterior wedging of the 12th thoracic vertebra
terms.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the thoracic vertebra T12 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

terms.name: Anterior wedging of L2
terms.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the lumbar vertebra L2 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

terms.name: Increased urinary sulfite level
terms.definition: The concentration of SO3(2-), i.e., sulfite, in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urinary thiosulfate
terms.definition: Increased concentration of thiosulfate(2-) in the urine.

terms.name: Small vessel vasculitis
terms.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects blood vessels that are smaller than arteries, i.e., arterioles, venules, and capilllaries.

terms.name: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia
terms.name_zh: 闭塞性细支气管炎伴机化性肺炎
terms.definition: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP) is and interstitial lung abnormalitiy characterized histopathologically by plugs of granulation tissue lying within small airways, alveolar ducts, and alveoli and by chronic inflammatory cell infiltration in alveolar walls. Patients with BOOP generally present with subacute illness, including shortness of breath, fever, malaise, and weight loss.

terms.name: Bronchiolitis obliterans
terms.definition: Inflammation and fibrosis of the bronchioles leading to partial or complete obstruction of these airways.

terms.name: Respiratory tract infection
terms.definition: An infection of the upper or lower respiratory tract.

terms.name: Recurrent acute respiratory tract infection
terms.definition: A history of repeated acute infections of the upper or lower respiratory tract.

terms.name: Acute infectious pneumonia
terms.definition: Acute inflammation of the lung due to an infection.

terms.name: Unusual bronchiolitis
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to bronchiolitis (inflammation of the bronchioles) as manifested by recurrent or severe epsiodes of bronchiolitis.

terms.name: Aspiration pneumonia
terms.definition: Pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

terms.name: Acute aspiration pneumonia
terms.definition: An acute episode of pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

terms.name: Pulmonary lymphoma
terms.definition: Lung parenchymal involvement with lymphoma.

terms.name: Nodular regenerative hyperplasia of liver
terms.definition: Diffuse benign transformation of the hepatic parenchyma into small regenerative nodules with minimal or no fibrosis.

terms.name: Hepatic granulomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the liver as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

terms.name: Intestinal lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
terms.definition: A lymphoproliferative abnormality of the intestine characterized by numerous visible mucosal nodules measuring up to, and rarely exceeding, 0.5 cm in diameter Histologically, hyperplastic lymphoid follicles with large germinal centers are seen in the lamina propria and superficial submucosa. There is enlargement of the mucosal B cell follicles caused by hyperplasia of the follicle centers; surrounded by a normal appearing mantle zone. Disease may involve the stomach, the entire small intestine, and the large intestine.

terms.name: Abnormal pectoral muscle morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pectoral muscle, comprising the pectoralis major, a thick, fan-shaped muscle of the anterior chest and the pectoralis minor, a thin, triangular muscle situated underneath the pectoralis major.

terms.name: Retinal perforation
terms.definition: A hole through the whole thickness of the retina, associated with trauma.

terms.name: Unilateral hypoplasia of pectoralis major muscle
synonyms: Small pec muscle on one side
Underdeveloped pec muscle on one side
terms.definition: Hypoplasia (underdevelopment) of the pectoralis minor on only one side of the chest.

terms.name: Substantia nigra gliosis
terms.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the substantia nigra.

terms.name: Non-obstructive azoospermia
terms.definition: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from a defect in the production of spermatozoa in the testes. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.

terms.name: Obstructive azoospermia
terms.definition: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from post-testicular obstruction or retrograde ejaculation. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.

terms.name: Pretesticular azoospermia
terms.definition: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, due to a hypothalamic or pituitary abnormality diagnosed with hypo-gonadotropic-hypogonadism. The diagnosis is made on the basis of low LH and FSH levels and low or normal testosterone levels.

terms.name: Intermittent painful muscle spasms
terms.definition: History of repeated intermittent involuntary muscle contractions that were painful.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating citrulline concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of citrulline in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated plasma citrulline
terms.definition: An increased concentration of citrulline in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating copper concentration
synonyms: Decreased copper cation level in blood
Reduced copper cation level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of copper cation in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Feeding difficulties
terms.definition: Impaired ability to eat related to problems gathering food and getting ready to suck, chew, or swallow it.

terms.name: Elevated circulating luteinizing hormone level
terms.name_zh: 血循环促黄体生成素水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of luteinizing hormone in the blood.

terms.name: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy
terms.definition: Amyloid deposition in the walls of leptomeningeal and cortical arteries, arterioles, and less often capillaries and veins of the central nervous system.

terms.name: Dermatographic urticaria
terms.definition: An exaggerated whealing tendency when the skin is stroked, that is, formation of red, itchy bumps and lines on the skin as a result of pressure on the skin (for instance, stroking the skin with a pen or tongue depressor).

terms.name: Hypoglycorrhachia
synonyms: Low glucose levels in cerebral spinal fluid
terms.definition: Abnormally low glucose concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Paroxysmal lethargy
terms.definition: Repeated episodes of sudden-onset and transient lethargy.

terms.name: Myelofibrosis
terms.definition: Replacement of bone marrow by fibrous tissue.

terms.name: Aminoglycoside-induced hearing loss
terms.name_zh: 氨基糖苷类诱导性听力损失
terms.definition: Partial or complete loss of hearing following ingestion of aminoglycoside antibiotics.

terms.name: Elevated urinary catecholamine level
terms.definition: The concentration of a catecholamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary homovanillic acid
terms.definition: An increased concentration of homovanillic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary vanillylmandelic acid
terms.definition: An increased concentration of vanillylmandelic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary dopamine level
terms.definition: The concentration of dopamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Cholesterol gallstones
terms.definition: Gallstones composed primarily of cholesterol, usually about 2-3 cm in length with an oval form and a yellow or green/brown color.

terms.name: Pigment gallstones
terms.definition: Gallstones composed primarily of bilirubin and calcium salts (calcium bilirubinate) with a low cholesterol concentration.

terms.name: Black pigment gallstones
terms.definition: A type of pigment gallstone that is hard and black, containing calcium carbonate and calcium phosphates.

terms.name: Brown pigment gallstones
terms.definition: A type of pigment gallstone that is brown, containing calcium fatty acids. These stones are softer than black pigment gallstones.

terms.name: Atretic gallbladder
terms.definition: Failure of formation of the lumen of the gallbladder, often associated with gallbladder hypoplasia.

terms.name: Acholic stools
terms.definition: Clay colored stools lacking bile pigment.

terms.name: Ectopic ossification
terms.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue, i.e., the presence of bone in soft tissue where bone normally does not exist.

terms.name: Ectopic ossification in muscle tissue
terms.definition: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within muscle tissue.

terms.name: Ectopic ossification in tendon tissue
terms.definition: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within tendon tissue.

terms.name: Ectopic ossification in ligament tissue
terms.definition: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within ligament tissue.

terms.name: Abnormal neutrophil physiology
terms.definition: Any functional abnormality of neutrophils.

terms.name: Abnormal total neutrophil count
terms.name_zh: 总中性粒细胞计数异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal range of neutrophil cell counts in the circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal neutrophil morphology
terms.definition: An abnormal form or size of neutrophils.

terms.name: Impaired neutrophil bactericidal activity
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞杀菌活性障碍
terms.definition: A reduction in the ability of neutrophils to kill bacteria.

terms.name: Abnormal atrial septum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the interatrial septum.

terms.name: Atrial septal dilatation
terms.definition: A bulging of the interatrial septum towards one side. In adults, atrial septal aneurysm can be defined as a protrusion of the aneurysm of >10 mm beyond the plane of the atrial septum as measured by transesophageal echocardiography.

terms.name: Elevated coagulation factor V activity
terms.definition: Increased activity of coagulation factor V, Factor V, which is activated to factor Va by means of minute amounts of thrombin (and inactivated by larger amounts of thrombin). Activated factor V (fVa) is a cofactor in the formation of the prothrombinase complex.

terms.name: Postprandial hyperlactemia
terms.definition: Abnormally increased level of blood lactate following a meal.

terms.name: Postprandial hyperglycemia
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glucose in the blood following a meal.

terms.name: Paranoia
terms.definition: The feeling and belief that one is being targeted or is a focus of negative or untoward actions, overt or covert, from others. The affected individual expresses a concern that people are in general against the individual and are engaging in subtle behaviors to make things difficult for them. The origins of such thinking may arise from real events and become amplified over time. Paranoia may also arise in the absence of any action or interaction between the person and their environment.

terms.name: EEG with generalized spikes
terms.definition: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

terms.name: EEG with generalized polyspikes
terms.definition: EEG with repetitive generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

terms.name: Experiential epileptic aura
terms.definition: Affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual auras with subjective qualities similar to those experienced in life but are recognized by the subject as occurring outside of actual context.

terms.name: Affective epileptic aura
terms.definition: Affective auras with subjective qualities similar to those experienced in life but are recognized by the subject as occurring outside of actual context.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
terms.name_zh: 伴似曾相识/陌生感的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by memory phenomena such as feelings of familiarity (deja vu) and unfamiliarity (jamais vu) as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Deja vu aura
terms.definition: A subjective feeling that an experience which is occurring for the first time has been experienced before.

terms.name: Jamais vu aura
terms.definition: A subjective feeling that an experience which has occurred before is being experienced for the first time.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with hallucination
terms.name_zh: 伴幻觉的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by hallucination as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with illusion
terms.name_zh: 伴错觉的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by an alteration of actual perception involving visual, auditory, somatosensory, olfactory, and/or gustatory phenomena as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: EEG with central focal spike waves
terms.name_zh: 脑电图中央区局灶棘波
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the central region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with frontal focal spike waves
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the frontal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with occipital focal spike waves
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the occipital region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with parietal focal spike waves
terms.name_zh: 顶区局灶棘慢波脑电图
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the parietal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with temporal focal spike waves
terms.name_zh: 颞区局灶棘慢波脑电图
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the temporal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: EEG with central focal spikes
terms.name_zh: 脑电图中央区局灶棘波
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the central region.

terms.name: EEG with frontal focal spikes
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the frontal region.

terms.name: EEG with occipital focal spikes
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the occipital region.

terms.name: EEG with parietal focal spikes
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the parietal region.

terms.name: EEG with temporal focal spikes
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the temporal region.

terms.name: Lens luxation
terms.definition: Complete dislocation of the lens of the eye.

terms.name: Right aortic arch
terms.definition: Aorta descends on right instead of on the left.

terms.name: Persistent patent ductus venosus
terms.definition: Persistence of blood flow through the ductus venosus for longer than the normal time after birth.

terms.name: Congenital portosystemic venous shunt
terms.definition: A congenital defect of the vasculature such that there is a shunt (by-pass) of blood directly from the portal vein to the vena cava (i.e., the blood from the portal vein is not filtered through the liver).

terms.name: Galactosuria
terms.definition: Elevated concentration of galactose in the urine.

terms.name: Hypergalactosemia
terms.definition: The concentration of galactose in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating ornithine concentration
terms.definition: Deviation from the normal concentration of ornithine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyperornithinemia
terms.definition: Increased concentration of ornithine in the blood.

terms.name: Laryngeal edema
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tissues of the larynx.

terms.name: Hepatocellular adenoma
terms.definition: A benign tumor of the liver of presumably epithelial origin.

terms.name: Abnormal urine steroid level
terms.definition: The amount of an steroid metabolite in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Increased urinary cortisol level
terms.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of cortisol in the urine.

terms.name: Lipoma
terms.definition: Benign neoplasia derived from lipoblasts or lipocytes of white or brown fat. May be angiomatous or hibernomatous.

terms.name: Sacral lipoma
terms.definition: Presence of a lipoma in the region of the sacrum.

terms.name: Liposarcoma
terms.definition: Malignant neoplasms which probably originate in primitive mesenchymal stem cell populations differentiating down a lipomatous pathway.

terms.name: Steatocystoma multiplex
terms.definition: Multiple, localized or widespread, asymptomatic or inflammatory dermal cysts involving the pilosebaceous units. Lesions can appear anywhere on the body, but steatocystoma multiplex is more commonly involved with those areas of the skin with a high density of developed pilosebaceous units (e.g., the axilla, groin, neck, and proximal extremities).

terms.name: Sternocleidomastoid amyotrophy
terms.definition: Wasting of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, the muscle in the anterior part of the neck that acts to flex and rotate the head.

terms.name: Pectoralis amyotrophy
terms.definition: Wasting of the pectoral muscles, i.e., of the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor. This finding is often manifested by prominent axillary creases or double axillary creases.

terms.name: Corneal guttata
terms.definition: Corneal guttata are droplet-like accumulations of non-banded collagen on the posterior surface of Descemet's membrane. The presence of focal thickenings of Descemet's membrane histologically named guttae. Cornea guttata can be easily diagnosed in vivo and ex vivo by means of specular microscopy as it gives dark areas where no endothelial cells are visible.

terms.name: Descemet Membrane Folds
terms.definition: Presence of folds in the Descemet membrane, which is the basement membrane of the endothelial (inner) cell layer of the cornea. Descemet membrane folds are generally a manifestation of inflammation or edema of the cornea.

terms.name: Corneal stromal edema
terms.definition: Abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling of the stroma of cornea.

terms.name: Aspirin-induced asthma
terms.definition: A type of asthma in which aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) that inhibit cyclooxygen-ase 1 (COX-1) exacerbate bronchoconstriction.

terms.name: Pendular nystagmus
terms.definition: Rhythmic, involuntary sinusoidal oscillations of one or both eyes. The waveform of pendular nystagmus may occur in any direction.

terms.name: Seesaw nystagmus
terms.definition: Seesaw nystagmus is a type of pendular nystagmus where a half cycle consists of the elevation and intorsion of one eye, concurrently with the depression and extortion of the fellow eye. In the other half cycle, there is an inversion of the ocular movements.

terms.name: Retinal flecks
terms.definition: Presence of multiple yellowish-white lesions of various size and configuration on the retina not related to vascular lesions.

terms.name: Areflexia of upper limbs
terms.definition: Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the upper limbs.

terms.name: Hemeralopia
terms.definition: A visual defect characterized by the inability to see as clearly in bright light as in dim light. The word hemeralopia literally means day blindness.

terms.name: Oromandibular dystonia
terms.definition: A kind of focal dystonia characterized by forceful contractions of the face, jaw, and/or tongue causing difficulty in opening and closing the mouth and often affecting chewing and speech.

terms.name: Laryngeal dystonia
terms.definition: A form of focal dystonia that affects the vocal cords, associated with involuntary contractions of the vocal cords causing interruptions of speech and affecting the voice quality and often leading to patterned, repeated breaks in speech.

terms.name: Anasarca
terms.definition: An extreme form of generalized edema with widespread and massive edema due to effusion of fluid into the extracellular space.

terms.name: Reactive hypoglycemia
synonyms: Low blood sugar after a meal
terms.definition: Hypoglycermia following a meal (or more generally, after intake of glucose).

terms.name: Decreased circulating calcitriol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环骨化三醇浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of calcitriol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating calcifediol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环骨化二醇浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as calcidiol, 25-hydroxycholecalciferol and 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3.

terms.name: Choroidal melanoma
terms.definition: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the choroid. The classic appearance of choroidal melanoma is a pigmented dome-shaped or collar button-shaped tumor with an associated exudative retinal detachment. Choroidal melanoma is usually pigmented, but can be variably pigmented and even amelanotic (non-pigmented).

terms.name: Ciliary body melanoma
terms.definition: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the ciliary body.

terms.name: Cutaneous melanoma
terms.definition: The presence of a melanoma of the skin.

terms.name: Superficial spreading melanoma
terms.definition: A type of melanoma that is flat and irregular in shape and color, with different shades of black and brown.

terms.name: Nodular melanoma
terms.definition: A type of melanoma that starts as a raised area that is usually dark blackish-blue or bluish-red but may not have any color.

terms.name: Lentigo maligna melanoma
terms.definition: A subtype of melanoma in situ that typically develops on sun-damaged skin. The lesion is typically a large, irregularly pigmented macule that has developed from an ordinary lentigo (a small pigmented spot on the skin with a clearly-defined edge). Change to a malignant lentigo typically takes place over 20 years or more, and many patients accept the change as a consequence of aging.

terms.name: Acral lentiginous melanoma
terms.definition: A type of cutaneous melanoma localized to the palm, sole, or beneath the nail (subungual melanoma). Acral lentiginous melanoma starts as a slowly-enlarging flat patch of discolored skin and usually displays a size above 6 mm and often several centimeters or more in diameter upon diagnosis and variable pigmentation with a mixutre of colors including brown, and blue-grey, black and red. The surface of the lesion is initially smooth but later in the course may become thicker and irregular, and may ulcerate or bleed.

terms.name: Urinary excretion of sialylated oligosaccharides
terms.definition: Excretion of oligosaccharides conjugated to sialic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Bone cyst
terms.definition: A fluid filled cavity that develops with a bone.

terms.name: Aneurysmal bone cyst
terms.definition: Radiographic features include a dilated, radiolucent lesion typically located eccentrically within the metaphyseal portion of the bone, with fluid levels visible on magnetic resonance imaging.

terms.name: Unicameral bone cyst
terms.definition: A benign fluid filled simple cyst of bone filled with serous fluid.

terms.name: Multiple bony cystic lesions
terms.definition: Presence of multiple cystic changes in multiple areas or multiple bones.

terms.name: Increased urinary disaccharide excretion
terms.definition: Increased concentration of disaccharide in the urine.

terms.name: Glycopeptiduria
terms.definition: Increased excretion of glycopeptides in the urine. Glycopeptides are peptides with carbohydrate moieties covalently attached to the side chains of the amino acid residues.

terms.name: Aspartylglucosaminuria
terms.definition: Excretion of excess amounts of aspartylglucosamine in the urine.

terms.name: Keratan sulfate excretion in urine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of keratan sulfate in the urine.

terms.name: Chondroitin sulfate excretion in urine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of chondroitin sulfate (CHEBI:37397) in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an acylcarnitine, which is produced by reversible esterification of the 3-hydroxyl group of carnitine.

terms.name: Aciduria
terms.definition: Excretion of urine with an acid pH, i.e., having an increased hydrogen ion concentration.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary acylglycine profile
terms.definition: An abnormal distribution of N-acylglycines in the urine. There are numerous different N-acylglycines, and this term refers to pathological alterations in their level or distribution.

terms.name: Tonic pupil
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pupillary light reaction characterized by a marked slowing of the light reaction of usually just one pupil. The pupil tends to be relatively dilated, and there is reduced accommodation.

terms.name: Personality disorder
terms.definition: A personality disorder is a deeply ingrained pattern of behavior of a specified kind that deviates markedly from the norms of generally accepted behavior. It is typically apparent by the time of adolescence and causes long-term difficulties in personal relationships or functioning in society.

terms.name: Borderline personality disorder
terms.definition: A personality disorder characterized by impulsive behavior and unpredictable, capricious mood. Affected individuals show a tendency to have outbursts of emotion and an inability to control these behavioral explosions. They generally experience an intense fear of abandonment or instability and also struggle with feelings of emptiness.

terms.name: Histrionic personality disorder
terms.definition: A personality disorder characterized by shallow and labile affectivity, self-dramatization, theatricality, exaggerated expression of emotions, suggestibility, egocentricity, self-indulgence, lack of consideration for others, easily hurt feelings, and continuous seeking for appreciation, excitement and attention.

terms.name: Motor conduction block
terms.definition: Blockade of impulses at a focal site along the course of a motor axon.

terms.name: Abnormality of central motor conduction
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the conduction of motor nerve impulses in the central nervous system.

terms.name: Cerebellar granular layer atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the granular cell layer.

terms.name: Enlarged cerebellum
terms.definition: An abnormally increased size of the cerebellum compared to other brain structures.

terms.name: Cerebellar Purkinje layer atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the Purkinje cell layer.

terms.name: Ubiquitin-positive cerebral inclusion bodies
terms.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates that show positive staining with antibodies against ubiquitin within cells of the brain.

terms.name: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
synonyms: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fibre size
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the size of the skeletal muscle cell.

terms.name: Pyuria
terms.definition: The presence of 10 or more white cells per cubic millimeter in a urine specimen, 3 or more white cells per high-power field of unspun urine, a positive result on Gram staining of an unspun urine specimen, or a urinary dipstick test that is positive for leukocyte esterase.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary color
terms.definition: An abnormal color of the urine, that is, the color of the urine appears different from the usual straw-yellow color.

terms.name: Abnormal mitochondrial shape
terms.definition: An anomaly in the surface contour of mitochondria.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary odor
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal odor of the urine.

terms.name: Arteritis
terms.definition: Arterial inflammation.

terms.name: Abnormality of pancreas physiology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the function of the pancreas.

terms.name: Abnormality of exocrine pancreas physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the acinar gland portion of the pancreas that secretes digestive enzymes.

terms.name: Abnormality of endocrine pancreas physiology
terms.definition: A function abnormality of the endocrine pancreas.

terms.name: Abnormal pancreas size
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal size of the pancreas.

terms.name: Multiple joint dislocation
terms.definition: Dislocation of many joints.

terms.name: Intracranial epidermoid cyst
terms.definition: A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from ectodermal cells that normally form skin cells being left behind in the nervous system during development.

terms.name: Intracranial dermoid cyst
terms.definition: A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from the inclusion of ectodermally committed cells at the time of neural tube closure (3rd-5th week of embryogenesis). The capsule of dermoid cysts consists of simple epithelium supported by collagen. In thicker parts, the lining is supplemented with dermis containing hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and apocrine glands.

terms.name: Edema of the dorsum of feet
synonyms: Oedema of the dorsum of feet
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating catecholamine concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal catecholamine concentration in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating creatinine concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of creatinine in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased serum creatinine
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced amount of creatinine in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal mitochondrial number
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal number of mitochondria per cell.

terms.name: Abnormality of the mitochondrion
terms.definition: An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration.

terms.name: Parietal cortical atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the parietal cortex.

terms.name: Occipital cortical atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the occipital cortex.

terms.name: Rhizomelic leg shortening
terms.definition: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the leg (i.e. the femur).

terms.name: Increased fibular diameter
terms.definition: Increased width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula.

terms.name: Open angle glaucoma
terms.definition: A type of glaucoma defined by an open, normal appearing anterior chamber angle and raised intraocular pressure,

terms.name: Angle closure glaucoma
terms.definition: A type of glaucomatous optic neuropathy in an eye that has evidence of angle closure (i.e. significant iridotrabecular contact).

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the pons
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the pons.

terms.name: Abnormality of circulating glucocorticoid level
terms.name_zh: 循环糖皮质激素水平异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of a glucocorticoid in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating corticosterone level
terms.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of corticosterone in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating creatine concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of creatine in the blood circulation. Creatine is a derivative of glycine having methyl and amidino groups attached to the nitrogen. Creatine is naturally produced from amino acids, primarily in liver and kidney, and acts as an energy source for cells, primarily for muscle cells.

terms.name: Endometrial carcinoma
terms.definition: A carcinoma of the endometrium, the mucous lining of the uterus.

terms.name: Hepatitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the liver.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating albumin concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of albumin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyperalbuminemia
terms.definition: The concentration of albumin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Laryngeal carcinoma
terms.definition: A carcinoma of the larynx.

terms.name: Methemoglobinemia
terms.definition: Abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood. In this form of hemoglobin, there is an oxidized ferric iron (Fe +3) rather than the reduced ferrous form (Fe 2+) that is normally found in hemoglobin. Methemoglobin has a reduced affinity for oxygen, resulting in a reduced ability to release oxygen to tissues.

terms.name: Methylmalonic aciduria
terms.definition: Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Panuveitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which inflammation affects the anterior chamber, vitreous, retina or choroid.

terms.name: Anterior uveitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the anterior chamber.

terms.name: Posterior uveitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the retina or choroid.

terms.name: Intermediate uveitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the vitreous.

terms.name: Prostate cancer
terms.definition: A cancer of the prostate.

terms.name: Stomach cancer
terms.definition: A cancer arising in any part of the stomach.

terms.name: Uraciluria
terms.definition: Increased concentration of uracil in the urine.

terms.name: Basal ganglia necrosis
terms.definition: Death of cells in the basal ganglia. This finding can be confirmed by autopsy. It can be suspected with hyperintensities within the basal ganglia on FLAIR and T2-sequences on magnetic resonance imaging.

terms.name: Abnormality of bone marrow stromal cells
Abnormal erythroid lineage cell morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of cells of the erythroid lineage
terms.definition: An anomaly of erythroid lineage cells, that is, of the erythropoietic cells in the lineage leading to and including erythrocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal number of erythroid precursors
terms.name_zh: 红系前体细胞数目异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Erythroid hyperplasia
synonyms: Bone marrow biopsy shows erythroid hyperplasia
Bone marrow smear shows erythroid hyperplasia
terms.definition: Increased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Erythroid hypoplasia
synonyms: Erythroid hypoplasia in the bone marrow
terms.definition: Decreased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Abnormal granulocytopoietic cell morphology
terms.name_zh: 粒细胞生成细胞形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of cells of the granulocytic lineage
terms.definition: An anomaly of cells involved in the formation of a granulocytes, that is, of the granulocytopoietic cell.

terms.name: Abnormal number of granulocyte precursors
terms.name_zh: 粒系前体细胞数目异常

terms.name: Granulocytic hypoplasia
terms.definition: Decreased number of granulocyte precursors in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Pancreatic squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: Squamous cell carcinoma of the pancreas
terms.definition: A subtype of ductal pancreatic carcinoma that is thought to originate from squamous metaplasia of pancreatic ductal epithelium.

terms.name: Abnormal megakaryocyte morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of cells of the megakaryocyte lineage
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of megakaryocytes. Mature blood platelets are released from the cytoplasm of megakaryocytes, which are bone-marrow resident cells.

terms.name: Abnormal monocyte morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of a myeloid mononuclear recirculating leukocyte that can act as a precursor of tissue macrophages, osteoclasts and some populations of tissue dendritic cells.

terms.name: Abnormality of multiple cell lineages in the bone marrow
Abnormality of von Willebrand factor
terms.name_zh: 血管性血友病因子异常
terms.definition: Decreased quantity or activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.

terms.name: Reduced quantity of Von Willebrand factor
terms.definition: Decreased quantity of von Willebrand factor.

terms.name: Multiple lineage myelodysplasia
terms.definition: Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two or more of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.

terms.name: Bilineage myelodysplasia
terms.definition: Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.

terms.name: Single lineage myelodysplasia
terms.definition: Abnormality/dysplasia of a single myeloid cell (erythroid, granulocytic, or megakaryocytic).

terms.name: Hemothorax
terms.definition: The presence of blood in the pleural space.

terms.name: Foveoschisis
terms.definition: Splitting of the retinal layers in the macula and involving the fovea.

terms.name: Hypotriglyceridemia
terms.definition: An decrease in the level of triglycerides in the blood.

terms.name: Anhedonia
synonyms: Loss of ability to enjoy things
Loss of interest in pleasurable activities
terms.definition: Decreased ability or inability to experience, feel, or anticipate pleasure from activities, experiences, or stimuli that are typically found pleasurable by the individual. This may involve diminished enjoyment of previously rewarding experiences (e.g., hobbies, social interactions, or sexual activity) or reduced pleasure in response to stimuli processed through the senses (e.g., music, food, or tactile contact). Anhedonia is a disruption in the capacity to derive emotional reward and is not due to primary sensory deficits or medical conditions (e.g., anosmia from viral illness). The phenomenon involves altered affective processing rather than impaired sensory perception.

terms.name: Decreased corneal sensation
terms.definition: Reduced ability of the cornea to respond to stimulation.

terms.name: Hemophagocytosis
terms.definition: Phagocytosis by macrophages of erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets, and their precursors in bone marrow and other tissues.

terms.name: Subcortical cerebral atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the cerebral subcortical white and gray matter, termed subcortical atrophy, reflects loss of nerve cells in the basal ganglia or fibers in the deep white matter.

terms.name: Carotid artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the carotid artery wall.

terms.name: Internal carotid artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the internal carotid artery wall.

terms.name: Intracranial internal carotid artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the intracranial portion of the internal carotid artery wall.

terms.name: External carotid artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the external carotid artery wall.

terms.name: Common carotid artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the common carotid artery wall.

terms.name: Carotid artery dilatation
terms.definition: A dilatation (balooning or bulging out of the vessel wall) of a carotid artery.

terms.name: Asterixis
terms.definition: A clinical sign indicating a lapse of posture and is usually manifest by a bilateral flapping tremor at the wrist, metacarpophalangeal, and hip joints.

terms.name: Oligodactyly
terms.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of digits.

terms.name: Skin-picking
terms.definition: Repetitive and compulsive picking of skin which results in tissue damage.

terms.name: Hair-pulling
terms.definition: A phenomenon in which persons repetitively pull out their own hair, resulting in noticeable hair loss.

terms.name: Head-banging
terms.definition: Habitual striking of one's own head against a surface such as a mattress or wall of a crib.

terms.name: Self-biting
terms.definition: Habitual biting of one's own body.

terms.name: Nail-biting
terms.definition: Habitual biting of one's own fingernails.

terms.name: Stereotypical hand wringing
terms.definition: Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.

terms.name: Stereotypical body rocking
terms.definition: Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.

terms.name: Orthostatic tachycardia
terms.definition: An increase in heart rate with standing of 30 beats per minute or more.

terms.name: Glioblastoma multiforme
terms.definition: A tumor arising from glia in the central nervous system with macroscopic regions of necrosis and hemorrhage. Microscopically, glioblastoma multiforme is characterized by regions of pseudopalisading necrosis, pleomorphic nuclei and cells, and microvascular proliferation.

terms.name: Resistance to activated protein C
terms.definition: Poor anticoagulant response to activated protein C. A plasma is termed 'APC resistant' when the addition of exogenous APC fails to prolong its clotting time in an activated partial thromboplastin time assay.

terms.name: Abnormal natural killer cell morphology
terms.name_zh: 自然杀伤细胞形态异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the natural killer cell, which is a lymphocyte that can spontaneously kill a variety of target cells without prior antigenic activation via germline encoded activation receptors. It also regulates immune responses via cytokine release and direct contact with other cells.

terms.name: Abnormal natural killer cell physiology
terms.name_zh: 自然杀伤细胞生理异常
terms.definition: Abnormal response of natural killer (NK) cells to stimuli.

terms.name: Craniofacial dystonia
terms.definition: A form of focal dystonia affecting the face and especially the jaw that is induced by the act of speaking. It is an involuntary contraction of the masticatory muscles, resulting in dysarthria or dysphagia.

terms.name: Cystic medial necrosis
terms.definition: A disorder of large arteries, in particular the aorta, characterized by an accumulation of basophilic ground substance in the media with cyst-like lesions associated with degenerative changes of collagen, elastin and the vascular smooth muscle cells.

terms.name: Entrapment neuropathy
terms.definition: Malfunction of a peripheral nerve resulting from mechanical compression of the nerve roots from internal or external causes and leading to a conduction block or axonal loss.

terms.name: Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
terms.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the oropharnyx.

terms.name: Hyperplastic colonic polyposis
terms.definition: Presence of multiple hyperplastic polyps in the colon. Hyperplastic polyps are generally about 5 mm in size and show hyperplastic mucosal proliferation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating HDL-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 血高密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated high-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
Increased high-density lipoprotein cholesterol level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Constrictive median neuropathy
terms.definition: Injury to the median nerve caused by its entrapment at the wrist as it traverses through the carpal tunnel. Clinically, constrictive median neuropathy is characterized by pain, paresthesia, and weakness in the median nerve distribution of the hand.

terms.name: Entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve at elbow
terms.name_zh: 肘部尺神经卡压性神经病
terms.definition: An entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve in the cubital tunnel (in the elbow) characterized by numbness in the ring and little fingers and weakness of the intrinsic muscles in the hand.

terms.name: Increased erythrocyte protoporphyrin concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞原卟啉浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of protoporphyrins in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyperemesis gravidarum
terms.definition: Excessive vomiting in early pregnancy, leading to the loss of 5% or more of body weight.

terms.name: Hodgkin lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.

terms.name: T-cell lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of lymphoma that originates in T-cells.

terms.name: B-cell lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of lymphoma that originates in B-cells.

terms.name: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of T-cell lymphoma that exhibits malignant infiltration of the skin.

terms.name: Anaplastic large-cell lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of T-cell lymphoma that is characterized by so-called hallmark cells with a pleomorphic appearance that express the CD30 antigen, are lobulated, and have indented nuclei.

terms.name: Episodic hemiplegia
terms.definition: Transient episodes of weakness of the arm, leg, and in some cases the face on one side of the body.

terms.name: Irregular respiration
terms.definition: Uneven rhythm of breathing.

terms.name: Cheyne-Stokes respiration
terms.definition: An abnormal pattern of respiration characterized by cycles of respiration that are increasingly deeper then shallower with possible periods of apnea. Affected patients may display a 10 to 20 second episode of hypoventilation or apnea, followed by respiration of increased depth and frequency over the course of about one minute. The cycle repeats every 45 seconds to 3 minutes.

terms.name: Insulinoma
terms.definition: A type of tumor of the pancreatic beta cells that secretes excess insulin and can result in hypoglycemia.

terms.name: Juvenile colonic polyposis
terms.definition: The presence of more than 5 juvenile polyps of the colon. The term juvenile polyps refer to a special histopathology and not the age of onset as the polyp might be diagnosed at all ages. The juvenile polyp has a spherical appearance and is microscopically characterized by overgrowth of an oedematous lamina propria with inflammatory cells and cystic glands.

terms.name: Cluster headache
terms.definition: A type of headache characterized by repeated attacks of unilateral pain lasting 15 to 180 minutes and associated with local autonomic signs.

terms.name: Abnormality of prothrombin
terms.definition: An anomaly of clotting factor II, which is known as prothrombin, a vitamin K-dependent proenzyme that functions in the blood coagulation cascade.

terms.name: Increased serum bile acid concentration
terms.definition: An increase in the concentration of bile acid in the blood.

terms.name: Unusual fungal nail infection
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to fungal infection of the nail apparatus (onychomycosis), as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the nail plate, nail bed, or nail matrix caused by fungal organisms. Causative agents include dermatophytes (Trichophyton species) and Candida species.

terms.name: Recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis
terms.definition: Recurrent infection involving the vulva, vagina, and adjacent crural areas, whereby the causative agent belongs to the genus Candida.

terms.name: Globozoospermia
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the acrosome resulting in a round sperm head.

terms.name: Abnormal sperm motility
terms.definition: An anomaly of the mobility of ejaculated sperm.

terms.name: Reduced sperm motility
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the mobility of ejaculated sperm.

terms.name: Immotile sperm
terms.definition: A lack of mobility of ejaculated sperm.

terms.name: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
terms.name_zh: 幼年型粒单核细胞白血病
terms.definition: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) is a lethal myeloproliferative disease of young childhood characterized clinically by overproduction of myelomonocytic cells and by the in vitro phenotype of hematopoietic progenitor hypersensitivity to granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor.

terms.name: Abnormal renal morphology
synonyms: Structural anomalies of the renal tract
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal renal physiology
terms.definition: An abnormal functionality of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular filtration rate
terms.definition: An abnormally increased or reduced amount of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

terms.name: Decreased glomerular filtration rate
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the volume of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

terms.name: Increased glomerular filtration rate
terms.definition: An abnormal rise in the volume of water filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

terms.name: Testicular microlithiasis
terms.definition: The deposition of calcium phosphate microliths within the seminiferous tubules.

terms.name: Entrapment neuropathy of suprascapular nerve
terms.name_zh: 肩胛上神经卡压性神经病
terms.definition: An entrapment neuropathy of the suprascapular nerve, presenting with shoulder weakness confined to the supraspinatus muscle (this muscle initiates shoulder abduction) or to the infraspinatus (this muscle externally rotates the arm), as well as with pain in the posterior part of the shoulder and upper periscapular region.

terms.name: Increased urinary porphobilinogen
terms.definition: The concentration of porphobilinogen in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Alveolar soft part sarcoma
terms.definition: A type of soft tissue sarcoma with a histological appearance reminiscent of alveoli because of its reticulated fibrous stroma enclosing groups of sarcoma cells, which resemble epithelial cells and are enclosed in alveoli walled with connective tissue.

terms.name: Erythema nodosum
terms.definition: An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral.

terms.name: Non-caseating epithelioid cell granulomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple epithelioid cell granulomas consist of highly differentiated mononuclear phagocytes (epithelioid cells and giant cells) and lymphocytes, not exhibiting caseation (a form of necrosis in which the tissue changes into a dry, amorphous mass said to resemble cheese).

terms.name: Pretibial blistering
terms.definition: A type of blistering that affects the skin of the tibial region.

terms.name: Arachnoid hemangiomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple hemangiomas in the arachnoid.

terms.name: Splenic rupture
terms.definition: A breach of the capsule of the spleen.

terms.name: Circulating immune complexes
terms.definition: Persistence of immune complexes in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Oligodontia of primary teeth
synonyms: Failure of development of some deciduous teeth
Failure of development of some primary teeth
terms.definition: Reduced number of primary teeth.

terms.name: Ovarian teratoma
terms.definition: The presence of a teratoma in the ovary.

terms.name: Urethral stricture
terms.definition: Narrowing of the urethra associated with inflammation or scar tissue.

terms.name: Tension-type headache
terms.definition: A type of headache that last hours with continuous pain of mild or moderate intensity, bilateral location, a pressing/tightening (non-pulsating) quality and that is not aggravated by routine physical activity such as walking or climbing stairs.

terms.name: CSF pleocytosis
terms.definition: An increased white blood cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
terms.definition: A type of retinal detachment associated with a full-thickness defect in the retina that allows fluid to pass from the vitreous space into the subretinal space between the sensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.

terms.name: Serous retinal detachment
terms.definition: A type of retinal detachment such that fluid is present in the subretinal space and separate the neurosensory retina from the retinal pigment epithelium. It is not associated with a full-thickness break nor a tractional component. Due to breakdown of outer blood-retina barrier or increased exudation from abnormal vasculature or defective outflow.

terms.name: Shortened QT interval
terms.definition: Decreased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).

terms.name: Intramuscular hematoma
terms.definition: Blood clot formed within muscle tissue following leakage of blood into the tissue.

terms.name: Absence of circulating granulocytes
terms.definition: Absence of detectable circulating granulocytes in the blood. Usually a value of less than 50 cells per microliter is considered to be an absence.

terms.name: Drug-induced agranulocytosis
terms.definition: Absence of detectable circulating granulocytes in the blood caused by an exposure to a drug. Usually a value of less than 50 granulocytes per microliter is considered to be an absence.

terms.name: Elevated sweat chloride
terms.definition: An increased concentration of chloride in the sweat.

terms.name: Urocanic aciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of urocanic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased circulating chylomicron concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环乳糜微粒浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased plasma concentrations of chylomicrons, the large lipid droplet (up to 100 mm in diameter) of reprocessed lipid synthesized in epithelial cells of the small intestine and containing triacylglycerols, cholesterol esters, and several apolipoproteins.

terms.name: Atransferrinemia
terms.definition: Absence of transferrin, a protein that transports iron, in the blood.

terms.name: Increased intramyocellular lipid droplets
