terms.definition: An abnormal increase in intracellular lipid droplets In a muscle. The number and size of these drops can increase with somd disorders of lipid metabolism affecting muscle. See PMID 20691590 for histological images.

terms.name: Levator palpebrae superioris atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the levator palpebrae superioris, the extraocular muscle that elevates the superior eyelid.

terms.name: Superior rectus atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the superior rectus, the extraocular muscle whose primary function is to elevate the globe.

terms.name: Abnormal reproductive system morphology
terms.definition: A structural or developmental anomaly of any of the tissues involved in the genital system.

terms.name: Abnormal sex determination
terms.definition: Anomaly of primary or secondary sexual development or characteristics.

terms.name: Sex reversal
terms.definition: Development of the reproductive system is inconsistent with the chromosomal sex.

terms.name: Oculomotor nerve palsy
terms.definition: Reduced ability to control the movement of the eye associated with damage to the third cranial nerve (the oculomotor nerve).

terms.name: Specific anosmia
terms.definition: Anosmia for one particular odor.

terms.name: Prolonged PR interval
terms.definition: Increased time for the PR interval (beginning of the P wave to the beginning of the QRS complex).

terms.name: Abnormal ST segment
terms.definition: An electrocardiographic anomaly of the ST segment, which is the segment that connects the QRS complex and the T wave. The ST segment normally has a duration of 80 to 120 ms, is flat and at the same level (isoelectric) as the PR and TP segment.

terms.name: ST segment depression
terms.definition: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located inferior to the isoelectric line.

terms.name: ST segment elevation
terms.definition: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located superior to the isoelectric line.

terms.name: Abnormal respiratory system morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the respiratory system.

terms.name: Abnormal respiratory epithelium morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the pseudostratified ciliated epithelium that lines much of the conducting portion of the airway, including part of the nasal cavity and larynx, the trachea, and bronchi.

terms.name: Ewing sarcoma
terms.definition: A malignant tumor of the bone which always arises in the medullary tissue, occurring more often in cylindrical bones.

terms.name: Dynein arm defect of respiratory motile cilia
terms.name_zh: 呼吸道运动纤毛动力蛋白臂缺陷
terms.definition: An anomaly of the dynein arms of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

terms.name: Absent outer dynein arms
terms.definition: Absence of the outer dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, which normally are situated outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

terms.name: Absent inner dynein arms
terms.definition: Absence of the inner dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, which normally are situated within the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

terms.name: Abnormal axonemal organization of respiratory motile cilia
terms.name_zh: 呼吸道运动纤毛轴丝结构异常
synonyms: Abnormal axonemal organisation of respiratory motile cilia
terms.definition: Abnormal arrangement of the structures of the axoneme, which is the cytoskeletal structure that forms the inner core of the motile cilium and displays a canonical 9+2 microtubular pattern of motile cilia studded with dynein arms.

terms.name: Absent inner and outer dynein arms
terms.definition: Complete absence of the dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, that is, absence of the inner and the outer dynein arms, which normally are situated inside and outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

terms.name: Abnormal central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilia
terms.name_zh: 呼吸道运动纤毛中央微管对形态异常
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the two central microtubules of motile cilia with a 9+2 microtubuluar configuration.

terms.name: Abnormal respiratory motile cilium physiology
terms.name_zh: 呼吸道运动纤毛生理功能异常
terms.definition: Any functional anomaly of the respiratory motile cilia.

terms.name: Abnormal ciliary motility
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the normal motility of motile cilia. Evaluation of ciliary beat frequency and ciliary beat pattern requires high-speed videomicroscopy of freshly obtained ciliary biopsies that are maintained in culture media under controlled conditions.

terms.name: Absent central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilia
terms.name_zh: 呼吸道运动纤毛中央微管对形态缺失
terms.definition: Absence of the two central microtubules of motile cilia with a 9+2 microtubuluar configuration.

terms.name: Ciliary dyskinesia
synonyms: Lack of coordinated beating of respiratory cilia
terms.definition: A deviation from the normally well coordinated pattern of intracellular and intercellular synchrony of motile cilia. Dyskinetic cilia usually beat out of synchrony relative to neighboring cilia.

terms.name: T-wave alternans
terms.definition: A periodic beat-to-beat variation in the amplitude or shape of the T wave in an EKG.

terms.name: Absent respiratory ciliary axoneme radial spokes
terms.name_zh: 呼吸纤毛轴丝放射辐缺失
terms.definition: Absence of the radial spokes of the axoneme of the respiratory cilium.

terms.name: Myxoid liposarcoma
terms.definition: A liposarcoma that contains myxomatous tissue.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle glycogen content
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Decreased muscle glycogen content
terms.definition: A decreased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Episodic upper airway obstruction
terms.definition: Intermittent episodes of increased resistance to the passage of air in the upper airway.

terms.name: J wave
terms.definition: The J wave is a positive convex deflection that occurs at the junction of the QRS complex and ST segment, the J-point.

terms.name: Increased carotid artery intimal medial thickness
terms.name_zh: 颈动脉内膜中层厚度增加
terms.definition: An increase in the combined thickness of the intima and media of the carotid artery.

terms.name: Autosomal dominant inheritance with paternal imprinting
terms.name_zh: 父系印记常染色体显性遗传
terms.definition: A type of autosomal dominant inheritance involving a gene that is imprinted with paternal silencing.

terms.name: Autosomal dominant inheritance with maternal imprinting
terms.name_zh: 母系印记常染色体显性遗传
terms.definition: A type of autosomal dominant inheritance involving a gene that is imprinted with maternal silencing.

terms.name: Digital flexor tenosynovitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the flexor digitorum tendon, often associated with the Kanavel signs: (i) finger held in slight flexion, (ii) fusiform swelling, (iii) tenderness along the flexor tendon sheath, and (iv) pain with passive extension of the digit.

terms.name: Hypoglycinemia
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of glycine in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating serine concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of serine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Hyposerinemia
terms.definition: Reduced concentration of serine in the blood.

terms.name: Hepatic amyloidosis
terms.definition: A form of amyloidosis that affects the liver.

terms.name: Chylous ascites
terms.definition: Extravasation of chyle into the peritoneal cavity.

terms.name: Morbilliform rash
terms.definition: An exanthema consisting of widespread pink-to-red macules (flat spots of 2-10 mm in diameter) or papules (red bumps) that blanch with pressure. The macules and papules may cluster and merge to form sheets over several days.

terms.name: Small distal femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Small end part of outermost thighbone
terms.definition: Reduced size of the Distal epiphysis of femur.

terms.name: Small proximal tibial epiphyses
synonyms: Small end part of innermost shankbone
Small end part of innermost shinbone
terms.definition: Reduced size of the proximal epiphysis of the tibia.

terms.name: Abnormal hypothalamus physiology
terms.definition: An abnormal functionality of the hypothalamus.

terms.name: Abnormal hypothalamus morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hypothalamus.

terms.name: Hypothalamic luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone deficiency
terms.name_zh: 下丘脑促黄体生成素释放激素缺乏
terms.definition: Decreased secretion of luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone by the hypothalamus.

terms.name: Neoplasm of head and neck
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the head and neck region with origin in the lip, oral cavity, nasal cavity, paranasal sinuses, pharynx, or larynx.

terms.name: Facial neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the face.

terms.name: Fusion of gums
synonyms: Upper and lower gums fused together
terms.definition: A congenital defect with an abnormal joining of the gums of the upper and lower jaw.

terms.name: Abnormal genital pigmentation
terms.definition: An abnormal pigmentation pattern of the external genitalia.

terms.name: Abnormal occipital bone morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of the occipital bone of the skull.

terms.name: Slender middle phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Reduced diameter of the middle phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Slender distal phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Reduced diameter of the distal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Slender proximal phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Reduced diameter of the proximal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Long middle phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Increased length of the middle phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Long distal phalanx of finger
terms.definition: Increased length of the distal phalanx of finger.

terms.name: Ureteral agenesis
terms.definition: Failure of the ureter to undergo development.

terms.name: Type II transferrin isoform profile
synonyms: Abnormal isoelectric focusing of serum transferrin, type 2 pattern
Abnormal isoelectric focusing of serum transferrin, type II pattern
Isoelectric focusing of serum transferrin consistent with CDG type II
terms.definition: Abnormal transferrin isoform profile consistent with a type II congenital disorder of glycosylation.

terms.name: HSV encephalitis
terms.definition: Infection of the brain parenchyma with herpes simplex virus, resulting in inflammation of the brain parenchyma with neurologic dysfunction.

terms.name: Abnormal aortic arch morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the arch of aorta.

terms.name: Hypoplastic aortic arch
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the arch of aorta.

terms.name: Coarctation of the descending aortic arch
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized to the region of the descending trunk of arch of aorta.

terms.name: Abnormal rib ossification
terms.definition: An anomaly of the process of rib bone formation.

terms.name: Spatulate ribs
terms.definition: Ribs that are increased in width and taper to the posterior ends.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C9 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C9 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Cutaneous amyloidosis
terms.definition: The presence of amyloid deposition in the superficial dermis.

terms.name: Abnormal monocyte count
terms.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of total monocytes, or their phenotype, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, measured ex vivo.

terms.name: Increased total monocyte count
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of absolute number of monocytes in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Decreased total monocyte count
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of absolute number of monocytes in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Heberden node
terms.definition: Bony swelling of the distal interphalangeal joint (DIP) associated with the formation of osteophytes (calcific spurs) of the articular (joint) cartilage that are visible radiographically.

terms.name: Bouchard node
terms.definition: Bony swelling of the proximal interphalangeal joint (PIP) associated with the formation of osteophytes (calcific spurs) of the articular (joint) cartilage that are visible radiographically.

terms.name: Histiocytoma
terms.definition: A neoplasm containing histiocytes.

terms.name: Fibrous tissue neoplasm
terms.definition: Any neoplasm composed of fibrous tissue.

terms.name: Sacroiliac arthritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the sacroiliac joint, generally accompanied by lower back pain.

terms.name: Occipital neuralgia
terms.definition: A distinct type of headache characterized by piercing, throbbing, or electric-shock-like chronic pain in the upper neck, back of the head, and behind the ears, usually on one side.

terms.name: Absent pigmentation of the abdomen
terms.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the abdomen.

terms.name: Absent pigmentation of the limbs
terms.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the arms and legs.

terms.name: D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of 2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Perifolliculitis
terms.definition: Inflammation surrounding hair follicles.

terms.name: Sleep myoclonus
terms.definition: Myoclonus that occurs during the initial phases of sleep.

terms.name: Myeloid leukemia
terms.definition: A leukemia that originates from a myeloid cell, that is the blood forming cells of the bone marrow.

terms.name: Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
terms.name_zh: 慢性粒单核细胞白血病
terms.definition: A myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm which is characterized by persistent monocytosis, absence of a Philadelphia chromosome and BCR/ABL fusion gene, fewer than 20 percent blasts in the bone marrow and blood, myelodysplasia, and absence of PDGFRA or PDGFRB rearrangement.

terms.name: Abnormal celiac artery morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the celiac artery.

terms.name: Celiac artery compression
terms.definition: Compression of the celiac artery.

terms.name: Cementoma
terms.definition: An odontogenic tumor of the cementum of tooth.

terms.name: Tufted angioma
terms.definition: A vascular tumor of the skin and subcutaneous tissues and characterized by slow angiomatous proliferation.

terms.name: Pyelonephritis
terms.definition: An inflammation of the kidney involving the parenchyma of kidney, the renal pelvis and the kidney calices.

terms.name: Abnormal autonomic nervous system morphology
terms.name_zh: 自主神经系统形态异常
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormal autonomic nervous system physiology
terms.name_zh: 自主神经系统生理功能异常
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormal sudomotor regulation
terms.definition: An abnormal regulation of the sweat glands by the sympathetic nervous system associated with abnormal perspiration.

terms.name: Extrahepatic cholestasis
terms.definition: Impairment of bile flow due to obstruction in large bile ducts outside the liver.

terms.name: Abnormal homeostasis
terms.definition: An anomaly in the processes involved in the maintenance of an internal equilibrium.

terms.name: Abnormal energy expenditure
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the utilization of energy (calories).

terms.name: Increased resting energy expenditure
terms.definition: An increase in the number of calories used per unit time.

terms.name: Decreased resting energy expenditure
terms.definition: A reduction in the number of calories used per unit time.

terms.name: Microprolactinoma
terms.definition: A pituitary prolactin cell adenoma of less than 10 mm diameter.

terms.name: Macroprolactinoma
terms.definition: A pituitary prolactin cell adenoma of more than 10 mm diameter.

terms.name: Decreased circulating ferritin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环铁蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced concentration of ferritin, a ubiquitous intracellular protein that stores iron, in the blood.

terms.name: Morphea
terms.definition: Isolated patches of hardened skin (scleroderma).

terms.name: Abnormal glycosylation
terms.definition: An anomaly of a glycosylation process, i.e., a process involved in the covalent attachment of a glycosyl residue to a substrate molecule.

terms.name: Abnormal protein glycosylation
terms.definition: An anomaly of a protein glycosylation process, i.e., of a protein modification process that results in the addition of a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit to a protein amino acid, e.g. the addition of glycan chains to proteins.

terms.name: Abnormal protein N-linked glycosylation
terms.name_zh: 蛋白质N-连接糖基化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of protein N-linked glycosylation, i.e., an abnormality of the protein glycosylation process in which a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit is added to a protein via a nitrogen atom in an amino acid residue in a protein.

terms.name: Decreased galactosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化半乳糖基化降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the amount of galactose residues of N-glycans.

terms.name: Abnormal sialylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化唾液酸化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the addition of sialic acids to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Decreased sialylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化唾液酸化降低
terms.definition: Decreased addition of sialic acids to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Increased sialylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化唾液酸化增加
terms.definition: Increased addition of sialic acids to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Abnormal fucosylation of protein N-linked glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化岩藻糖基化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the addition of fucose sugar units to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Decreased fucosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化岩藻糖基化降低
terms.definition: Decreased addition of fucose sugar units to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Increased fucosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化岩藻糖基化增加
terms.definition: Increased addition of fucose sugar units to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Abnormal mannosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化甘露糖基化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the addition of mannose to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Decreased mannosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化甘露糖基化降低
terms.definition: Reduced addition of mannose to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Increased mannosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: N-连接蛋白糖基化甘露糖基化增加
terms.definition: Increased addition of mannose to N-linked glycans.

terms.name: Abnormal protein O-linked glycosylation
terms.name_zh: 蛋白质O-连接糖基化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of protein O-linked glycosylation, i.e., of the process in which a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit is added to a protein via the hydroxyl group of a serine or threonine residue.

terms.name: Abnormal fucosylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: O-连接蛋白糖基化岩藻糖基化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the addition of fucose sugar units to O-linked glycans.

terms.name: Decreased fucosylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: O-连接蛋白糖基化岩藻糖基化降低
terms.definition: A reduction of the addition of fucose sugar units to O-linked glycans.

terms.name: Increased fucosylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: O-连接蛋白糖基化岩藻糖基化增加
terms.definition: Increased addition of fucose sugar units to O-linked glycans.

terms.name: Abnormal sialylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: O连接蛋白糖基化唾液酸化异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the addition of sialic acids to O-linked glycans.

terms.name: Decreased sialylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
terms.name_zh: O-连接蛋白糖基化唾液酸化降低
terms.definition: An reduced addition of sialic acids to O-linked glycans.

terms.name: Decreased urinary potassium
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

terms.name: Hypophosphaturia
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased phosphate concentration in the urine.

terms.name: Basilar invagination
terms.definition: Projection of the tip of the dens more than 5 mm above a line joining the hard palate to the posterior lip of the foramen magnum (Chamberlain's line) or the tip of the dens is greater than 7 mm above McGregor's line (the back of the hard palate to the lowest point of the occipital squama).

terms.name: Extra fontanelles
terms.definition: Bony defects situated along the cranial suture lines or at the junction of the bone plates of the skull.

terms.name: Flat face
terms.definition: Absence of concavity or convexity of the face when viewed in profile.

terms.name: Prominence of the zygomatic bone
terms.definition: Large or prominent malar surface of the zygomatic bone of the skull, which is convex and forms the prominence of the 'cheek bones'.

terms.name: Hyperplasia of midface
terms.definition: Abnormally anterior positioning of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased convexity of the face, or increased nasolabial angle. The midface includes the maxilla, the cheeks, the zygomas, and the infraorbital and perialar regions of the face

terms.name: Abnormal eye morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the globe of the eye, or bulbus oculi.

terms.name: Abnormal eye physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the eye.

terms.name: Chemosis
terms.definition: Edema (swelling) of the bulbar conjunctiva.

terms.name: Microphakia
terms.definition: Abnormal smallness of the lens.

terms.name: Hemianopia
terms.definition: Partial or complete loss of vision in one half of the visual field of one or both eyes.

terms.name: Fatigue
terms.definition: A subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating enzyme concentration or activity
terms.name_zh: 循环酶浓度或活性异常
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced tissue carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase 2 activity
terms.definition: Reduced carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase (CPT II; EC 2.3.1.21) activity or level, leading to a reduced activity of the reaction: palmitoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = CoA + L-palmitoylcarnitine. (CPT II activity can be measured in tissues including fibroblasts, lymphoblasts, and skeletal muscle.

terms.name: Delayed self-feeding during toddler years
terms.definition: A delay in the development of skills required to feed oneself in the toddler period (between one and three years of age).

terms.name: Left-to-right shunt
terms.definition: Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from the left side of the heart to the right.

terms.name: Bidirectional shunt
terms.definition: Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from both right side of the heart to the left and vice versa.

terms.name: Rhinitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the nasal mucosa with nasal congestion.

terms.name: Camptodactyly
synonyms: Permanent flexion of the finger or toe
terms.definition: The distal interphalangeal joint and/or the proximal interphalangeal joint of the fingers or toes cannot be extended to 180 degrees by either active or passive extension.

terms.name: Absent hallux
terms.definition: Aplasia of the hallux, that is, a development defect such that the big toe does not develop.

terms.name: Bronchitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the large airways in the lung including any part of the bronchi from the primary bronchi to the tertiary bronchi.

terms.name: Acute bronchitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the large airways of the lung with rapid onset and short course usually associated with cough, mucus production, shortness of breath, wheezing, and chest tightness.

terms.name: Appendicular hypotonia
terms.definition: Muscular hypotonia of one or more limbs.

terms.name: Anal fissure
terms.definition: A small tear in the thin, moist tissue (mucosa) that lines the anus. It appears as a crack or slit in the mucous membrane of the anus.

terms.name: Hyporeflexia of upper limbs
terms.definition: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in the upper limbs. Reflexes are elicited by stretching the tendon of a muscle, e.g., by tapping.

terms.name: Jaw hyporeflexia
terms.definition: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in jaw.

terms.name: Allergy
terms.definition: An allergy is an immune response or reaction to substances that are usually not harmful.

terms.name: Iodine contrast allergy
terms.definition: Allergy to iodine contrast media used in radiological studies.

terms.name: Seasonal allergy
terms.definition: An allergy experienced at a particular time of year when trees or grasses pollinate and elicit an allergic reaction.

terms.name: Biliary dyskinesia
terms.definition: A motility disorder characterized by biliary colic in the absence of gallstones with a reduced gallbladder ejection fraction.

terms.name: Aortic atherosclerotic lesion
terms.definition: The presence of atheromas or atherosclerotic plaques in the aorta.

terms.name: Peripheral edema
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of interstitial fluid in the soft tissues of the limbs.

terms.name: Pressure ulcer
terms.definition: A type of ulcer that is caused when an area of skin is subject to pressure over a prolonged period of time, ranging in range in severity from patches of discolored skin to open wounds that expose the underlying bone or muscle. The most common sites are the sacrum, coccyx, heels and the hips.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating aldolase concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of aldolase in the serum. Aldolase is an enzyme responsible for converting fructose 1,6-bisphosphate into the triose phosphates dihydroxyacetone phosphate and glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate.

terms.name: Abnormal urine alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
synonyms: Abnormality of urine alpha ketoglutarate concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from normal of the concentration of 2-oxoglutaric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased urine alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
terms.definition: A greater than normal concentration of 2-oxoglutaric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased urine alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
terms.definition: A lower than normal concentration of 2-oxoglutaric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal urine citrate concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from normal of the concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.

terms.name: Hypocitraturia
terms.definition: A lower than normal concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.

terms.name: Hypercitraturia
terms.definition: A greater than normal concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.

terms.name: Scissor gait
terms.definition: A type of spastic paraparetic gait in which the muscle tone in the adductors is marked. It is characterized by hypertonia and flexion in the legs, hips and pelvis accompanied by extreme adduction leading to the knees and thighs hitting, or sometimes even crossing, in a scissors-like movement. The opposing muscles (abductors) become comparatively weak from lack of use.

terms.name: Medullary nephrocalcinosis
terms.definition: The deposition of calcium salts in the parenchyma of the renal medulla (innermost part of the kidney).

terms.name: Cortical nephrocalcinosis
terms.definition: The deposition of calcium salts in the parenchyma of the renal cortex (the outer portion of the kidney between the renal capsule and the renal medulla).

terms.name: Pure red cell aplasia
terms.definition: A type of anemia resulting from suppression of erythropoiesis with little or no abnormality of leukocyte or platelet production. Erythroblasts are virtually absent in bone marrow; however, leukocyte and platelet production show little or no reduction.

terms.name: Premature pubarche
terms.definition: The onset of growth of pubic hair at an earlier age than normal.

terms.name: Premature adrenarche
terms.definition: Onset of adrenarche at an earlier age than usual.

terms.name: Notched primary central incisor
terms.definition: The presence of a V-shaped indentation (notch) in the primary central incisor.

terms.name: Duodenal atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting or decrease in size of all or part of the duodenum.

terms.name: Abnormal blood gas level
terms.definition: An abnormality of the partial pressure of oxygen or carbon dioxide in the arterial blood.

terms.name: Hypercapnia
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level.

terms.name: Hypocapnia
synonyms: Reduced carbon dioxide in the blood
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level.

terms.name: Hypoxemia
terms.definition: An abnormally low level of blood oxygen.

terms.name: Hyperoxemia
terms.definition: An abnormally high level of blood oxygen.

terms.name: Meconium stained amniotic fluid
terms.definition: Amniotic fluid containing the earliest stools of a mammalian infant.

terms.name: Congenital absence of foreskin
terms.definition: Congenital lack of the skin of prepuce of penis, that is, of the double-layered fold of skin and mucous membrane that covers the glans penis.

terms.name: Villous hypertrophy of choroid plexus
synonyms: Diffuse villous hypertrophy of choroid plexus
terms.definition: Overgrowth of the choroid plexus.

terms.name: Colonic inertia
terms.definition: The inability of the colon to modify stool to an acceptable consistency and move the stool from the cecum to the rectosigmoid area at least once every three days.

terms.name: Chorioretinitis
terms.definition: An inflammation of the choroid and retina.

terms.name: Stercoral ulcer
terms.definition: An ulcer of the colon due to pressure and irritation from retained fecal masses.

terms.name: Optic disc drusen
terms.definition: Optic disc drusen are acellular, calcified deposits within the optic nerve head. Optic disc drusen are congenital and developmental anomalies of the optic nerve head, representing hyaline-containing bodies that, over time, appear as elevated, lumpy irregularities on the anterior portion of the optic nerve.

terms.name: Increased femoral anteversion
terms.definition: An increased degree of femoral version, which is defined as the angular difference between axis of femoral neck and transcondylar axis of the knee. Thus, femoral anteversion is an inward twisting of the femur that causes the knees and feet to turn inward.

terms.name: Prominent calcaneus
terms.definition: Protruding heel bone, or calcaneus.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cerebral white matter
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.

terms.name: Cerebral white matter hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.

terms.name: Episodic fatigue
terms.definition: Intermittent and recurrent bouts of a subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.

terms.name: Chronic fatigue
terms.definition: Subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation that persists for six months or longer.

terms.name: Abnormal social behavior
terms.definition: An abnormality of actions or reactions of a person exhibited during social interactions with other individuals.

terms.name: Delayed early-childhood social milestone development
terms.name_zh: 幼儿期社交里程碑发育延迟
terms.definition: A failure to meet one or more age-related milestones of social behavior.

terms.name: Ventral shortening of foreskin
terms.definition: Reduction in length of the ventral (lower) skin of prepuce of penis.

terms.name: Nonocclusive coronary artery atherosclerosis
terms.definition: Coronary disease that has not progressed to the point of causing significant occlusion (blockage) of the coronary arteries.

terms.name: Abnormal gallbladder morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the gallbladder.

terms.name: Abnormal gallbladder physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the gallbladder.

terms.name: Abnormal biliary tract physiology
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of the biliary tree.

terms.name: Abnormal biliary tract morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the biliary tree.

terms.name: Sphincter of Oddi dyskinesia
terms.definition: Reduced motility through the sphincter of Oddi, resulting in impedance of bile and pancreatic juice flow from the common bile duct into the duodenum.

terms.name: Gallbladder dyskinesia
terms.definition: Reduced motility of the gallbladder with reduced emptying fraction.

terms.name: Abnormal brain morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the brain, which has as its parts the forebrain, midbrain, and hindbrain.

terms.name: Brain atrophy
terms.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of brain tissue that was once present.

terms.name: Decreased CSF 5-methyltetrahydrofolate concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液5-甲基四氢叶酸浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate(2-) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). 5-methyltetrahydrofolate is the active folate metabolite.

terms.name: Abnormal myelination
terms.definition: Any anomaly in the process by which myelin sheaths are formed and maintained around neurons.

terms.name: Delayed myelination
terms.definition: Delayed myelination.

terms.name: Sacroiliac joint synovitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the synovial membrane of the sacroiliac joint.

terms.name: Chronic constipation
terms.definition: Constipation for longer than three months with fewer than 3 bowel movements per week, straining, lumpy or hard stools, and a sensation of anorectal obstruction or incomplete defecation.

terms.name: Acute constipation
terms.definition: Constipation of sudden onset and lasting for less than three months.

terms.name: Restless legs
terms.definition: An irresistible urge to move the legs, usually accompanied by unpleasant sensations deep within the limbs. Symptoms typically begin or worsen during periods of rest or inactivity, are most pronounced in the evening or at night, and are temporarily relieved by movement such as walking or stretching. The disturbance often interferes with the initiation or maintenance of sleep.

terms.name: Bilateral wrist flexion contracture
terms.definition: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on the right and left sides.

terms.name: Unilateral wrist flexion contracture
terms.definition: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on one side only.

terms.name: Medial arterial calcification
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of arteries.

terms.name: Medial calcification of medium-sized arteries
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of medium-sized (muscular or distributive) arteries.

terms.name: Medial calcification of small arteries
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of small arteries.

terms.name: Hypnic headache
terms.definition: A headache disorder that occurs exclusively at night, waking the affected individual from sleep.

terms.name: Dysmorphic inferior cerebellar vermis
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.

terms.name: Bacteriuria
terms.definition: The presence of bacteria in the urine.

terms.name: Chin myoclonus
terms.definition: Involuntary and irregular twitches of the chin.

terms.name: Elevated transferrin saturation
terms.definition: An above normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.

terms.name: Decreased transferrin saturation
terms.definition: A below normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.

terms.name: Elevated hepatic iron concentration
terms.definition: An increased level of iron in liver tissues.

terms.name: Chronic respiratory acidosis
terms.definition: Longstanding impairment in ventilation such that the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) is elevated above the upper limit of the reference range (more than 45 mm Hg), with a normal or near-normal pH secondary to renal compensation and an elevated serum bicarbonate levels (more than30 mEq/L).

terms.name: Acute respiratory acidosis
terms.definition: Sudden onset of impairment in ventilation such that the removal of carbon dioxide by the respiratory system is less than the production of carbon dioxide in the tissues, leading to an elevation of the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) above the normal limits (more than 45 mm Hg) with an accompanying acidemia (pH less than 7.35).

terms.name: Chronic acidosis
terms.definition: Longstanding abnormal acid accumulation or depletion of base.

terms.name: Infantile spasms
terms.definition: Infantile spasms represent a subset of \

terms.name: Setting-sun eye phenomenon
terms.definition: An ophthalmologic sign in young children resulting from upward-gaze paresis. In this condition, the eyes appear driven downward, the sclera may be seen between the upper eyelid and the iris, and part of the lower pupil may be covered by the lower eyelid.

terms.name: Thick vermilion border
terms.definition: Increased width of the skin of vermilion border region of upper lip.

terms.name: Eclabion
terms.definition: A turning outward of the lip or lips, that is, eversion of the lips.

terms.name: Tongue atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting of the tongue.

terms.name: Carotid artery occlusion
terms.definition: Complete obstruction of a carotid artery.

terms.name: Impaired specific antibody response
synonyms: Decreased circulating level of specific antibodies
terms.definition: Reduced ability of the immune system to produce targeted, protective antibodies (immunoglobulins) against specific pathogens or vaccines in the setting of normal or near-normal serum levels of total IgG, IgA, and IgM and normal absolute counts of B cells and T cells.

terms.name: Decreased circulating specific pneumococcal antibody concentration
terms.name_zh: 血肺炎球菌特异性抗体浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration in the blood circulation of specific immunoglobulins directed against pneumococci is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Vocal tremor
terms.definition: A wavering, unsteady voice that reflects involuntary and approximately sinusoidal oscillation of motor unit firings of laryngeal muscles. Vocal tremor results in low frequency modulations of voice frequency or amplitude and intermittent voice instability.

terms.name: Temporomandibular joint ankylosis
terms.definition: Bony fusion of the mandibular condyle to the base of the skull, resulting in limitation of jaw opening.

terms.name: Temporomandibular joint crepitus
terms.definition: Noises from the temporomandibular joint during mandibular movement (e.g., chewing). Temporomandibular joint crepitus is often described as a clicking, popping, grating sound.

terms.name: Abnormal cerebral vein morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of cerebral veins.

terms.name: Cerebral venous angioma
terms.definition: A congenital malformation of veins which drain normal brain characterized by a caput medusae or an umbrellalike convergence of multiple venules on a single, or occasionally multiple, enlarged parenchymal or medullary vein, like the trunk of a tree or the shank of an umbrella. This dilated terminal vein penetrates the cortex to drain either (a) superficially to cortical veins or sinuses, (b) deeply to subependymal veins of the lateral ventricle and then into the galenic system, (c) to the fourth ventricle and then to the pontomesencephalic vein, or (d) to the precentral cerebellar vein and into the galenic system.

terms.name: Frontal venous angioma
terms.definition: A venous angioma of the frontal lobe of the brain.

terms.name: Abnormal alpha granules
terms.definition: Defective structure, size or content of alpha granules, platelet organelles that contain several growth factors destined for release during platelet activation at sites of vessel wall injury.

terms.name: Abnormal dense granules
terms.definition: Defective structure, size or content of dense granules, platelet organelles that contain granules proaggregatory factors such as adenosine diphosphate (ADP), adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ionized calcium, histamine and serotonin.

terms.name: Abnormal surface-connected open canalicular system
terms.name_zh: 表面连通开放小管系统异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the invaginations of the surface membrane that form the open canalicular system (OCS). The OCS serve as the pathway for transport of substances into the cells and as conduits for the discharge of alpha granule products secreted during the platelet release reaction.

terms.name: Myelitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the spinal cord.

terms.name: Cerebellopontine angle arachnoid cyst
terms.definition: An arachnoid cyst located at the margin of the cerebellum and pons.

terms.name: Intraventricular arachnoid cyst
terms.definition: An arachnoid cyst located within the ventricular system.

terms.name: Suprasellar arachnoid cyst
terms.definition: An arachnoid cyst that progressively enlarges from an abnormality in the membrane of Liliequist or in the interpeduncular cistern, and typically, expands from the prepontine space, displacing the floor of the third ventricle upwards, the pituitary stalk and optic chiasm upwards and forwards, and the mammillary bodies upwards and backwards.

terms.name: Panniculitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of subcutaneous adipose tissue.

terms.name: Abnormal dense tubular system
terms.definition: An anomaly of the intracellular membrane complexes known as the dense tubular system.

terms.name: Cerebral artery stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of a cerebral artery.

terms.name: Middle cerebral artery stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the middle cerebral artery.

terms.name: Anterior cerebral artery stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the anterior cerebral artery.

terms.name: Posterior cerebral artery stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the posterior cerebral artery.

terms.name: Reduced maximal inspiratory pressure
terms.definition: A decrease in the maximum amount of negative pressure a person can generate during an inhalation.

terms.name: Reduced maximal expiratory pressure
terms.definition: A decrease in the maximum amount of pressure of expired air achieved by a person after a full inspiration.

terms.name: Nuchal cord
terms.definition: A complication of pregnancy and delivery in which the umbilical cord wraps around the fetal neck once or multiple times.

terms.name: Descending aortic dissection
terms.definition: A separation of the layers within the wall of the descending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.

terms.name: Verrucous papule
terms.definition: A wartlike (with multiple small elevated projections) papule.

terms.name: Abnormal brainstem white matter morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the brainstem white matter
terms.definition: An anomaly of the white matter of brainstem.

terms.name: Abnormality of the internal capsule
terms.definition: An anomaly of the internal capsule, which is an area of white matter in the brain that separates the caudate nucleus and the thalamus from the putamen and the globus pallidus.

terms.name: Abnormal pituitary gland morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Abnormal size of pituitary gland
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal size of the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Enlarged pituitary gland
terms.definition: An abnormally increased size of the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Small pituitary gland
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased size of the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Weakness of orbicularis oculi muscle
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the orbicularis oculi, the circumorbital muscle in the face that closes the eyelid.

terms.name: Metamorphopsia
terms.definition: A visual anomaly in which images appear distorted. A grid of straight lines appears wavy and parts of the grid may appear blank.

terms.name: Extra-axial cerebrospinal fluid accumulation
terms.definition: An increased amount of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in the subarachnoid space.

terms.name: Temporal optic disc pallor
terms.definition: A pale yellow discoloration of the temporal (lateral) portion of the optic disc.

terms.name: Diffuse optic disc pallor
terms.definition: A pale yellow discoloration of the entire optic disc.

terms.name: Upper limb pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the arm.

terms.name: Lower limb pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the leg.

terms.name: Hip flexor weakness
terms.definition: Reduced ability to flex the femur, that is, to pull the knee upward.

terms.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia
terms.definition: An extreme form of tetralogy of Fallot characterized by absence of flow from the right ventricle to the pulmonary arteries.

terms.name: Reduced circulating catalase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of catalase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circle of Willis morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the cerebral arterial circle
terms.definition: An anomaly of the circle of Willis, also known as the cerebral arterial circle.

terms.name: Hypoplastic posterior communicating artery
terms.definition: A developmental anomnaly characterized by underdevelopment of the posterior communicating artery.

terms.name: Dilation of Virchow-Robin spaces
terms.definition: Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. Perivascular spaces are commonly microscopic, and not visible on conventional neuroimaging. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually magnetic resonance imaging). The dilatations are regular cavities that always contain a patent artery.

terms.name: Optic nerve aplasia
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the optic nerve.

terms.name: Spider hemangioma
terms.definition: A form of telangiectasis characterized by a central elevated red dot the size of a pinhead, representing an arteriole, with numerous small blood vessels that radiate out thereby resembling the legs of a spider. Characteristically, compression of the central arteriole causes the entire lesion to blanch, and the lesion quickly refills once the compression is released.

terms.name: Oral aversion
terms.definition: Reluctance or refusal of a child to be breastfed or eat, manifested as gagging, vomiting, turning head away from food, or avoidance of sensation in or around the mouth (i.e. toothbrushing or face-washing).

terms.name: Abnormal platelet shape
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal discoid platelet shape.

terms.name: Abnormal alpha granule distribution
terms.definition: An anomalous location and arrangement of platelet alpha granules.

terms.name: Absence of alpha granules
terms.definition: A lack of platelet alpha granules. This typically results in the gray appearance of platelets in giemsa stained blood smears.

terms.name: Abnormal alpha granule content
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain hemostatic proteins such as fibrinogen, von Willebrand factor, and growth factors such as platelet-derived growth factor.

terms.name: Abnormal number of alpha granules
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal count of alpha granules per thrombocyte.

terms.name: Abnormal dense granule content
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain adenosine triphosphate (ATP), adenosine diphosphate (ADP), serotonin, calcium, and pyrophosphate, which are secreted when platelets are activated.

terms.name: Abnormal number of dense granules
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal count of dense granules per thrombocyte.

terms.name: Pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.

terms.name: Chronic pain
terms.definition: Persistent pain, usually defined as pain that has lasted longer than 3 to 6 months.

terms.name: Allodynia
terms.definition: Pain due to a stimulus that does not normally provoke pain.

terms.name: Dysesthesia
terms.definition: Painful sensations elicited by a nonpainful cutaneous stimulus such as a light touch or gentle stroking over affected areas of the body. Sometimes referred to as hyperpathia or hyperalgesia. Often perceived as an intense burning, dyesthesias may outlast the stimulus by several seconds.

terms.name: Abnormal synaptic transmission
terms.definition: An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse. This is a four step process, comprising (i) synthesis and storage of neurotransmitters; (ii) neurotransmitter release; (iii) activation of postsynaptic receptors by the neurotransmitter; and (iv) inactivation of the neurotransmitter. Thus, this term is defined as an anomaly of neurotransmitter metabolic process.

terms.name: Maternal anticardiolipin antibody positive
terms.name_zh: 母体抗心磷脂抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of circulating autoantibodies to anticardiolipin in the mother.

terms.name: Food intolerance
terms.definition: A detrimental reaction to a food, beverage, food additive, or compound found in foods that produces symptoms in one or more body organs and systems that is not mediated by an immune reaction.

terms.name: Gluten intolerance
terms.definition: A detrimental reaction to the presence of gluten in food, which may include abdominal pain, fatigue, headaches and paresthesia, or celiac disease.

terms.name: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by the absence of multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.

terms.name: Axillary epidermoid cyst
terms.definition: An epidermoid cyst in the armpit.

terms.name: Cephalohematoma
terms.definition: Hemorrhage between the skull and periosteum of a newborn resulting from rupture of blood vessels that cross the periosteum.

terms.name: Onychauxis
terms.definition: Thickened nails without deformity.

terms.name: Hemosiderinuria
terms.definition: The presence of hemosiderin in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating aldolase concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating aldolase concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Skewed maternal X inactivation
terms.definition: A deviation from equal (50%) inactivation of each parental X chromosome in maternal cells.

terms.name: Abnormal involuntary eye movements
terms.definition: Anomalous movements of the eyes that occur without the subject wanting them to happen.

terms.name: Fatty replacement of skeletal muscle
terms.definition: Muscle fibers degeneration resulting in fatty replacement of skeletal muscle fibers

terms.name: Conjunctival lipoma
terms.definition: A lipoma (a benign tumor composed of adipose tissue) located in the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Colonic varices
terms.definition: The presence of varices (enlarged and convoluted blood vessels) in the colon.

terms.name: Absent neutrophil specific granules
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞特异性颗粒缺如
terms.definition: Lack of specific granules in neutrophils.

terms.name: Increased neutrophil nuclear projections
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞核突起增多
terms.definition: Presence of an elevated number of projections from nuclei of neutrophils. These projections can have the shape of hooks, tags, or clubs.

terms.name: Hypoplastic thumbnail
terms.definition: A thumbnail that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped thumb nail.

terms.name: Absent thumbnail
terms.definition: Absence of thumb nail.

terms.name: Absent nail of hallux
terms.definition: Absent nail of big toe.

terms.name: Hyperbeta-alaninemia
terms.definition: Increased concentration of beta-alanine in the blood.

terms.name: EEG with centrotemporal focal spike waves
terms.name_zh: 脑电图中央颞区局灶棘波
terms.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the centrotemporal region of the brain (also known as the central sulcus), i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

terms.name: Abnormal T3/T4 ratio
terms.name_zh: 三碘甲状腺原氨酸/甲状腺素比值异常
terms.definition: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that deviates from normal.

terms.name: Increased T3/T4 ratio
terms.name_zh: 三碘甲状腺原氨酸/甲状腺素比值升高
terms.definition: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is higher than normal.

terms.name: Decreased T3/T4 ratio
terms.definition: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is lower than normal.

terms.name: Unicuspid aortic valve
terms.definition: The presence of an aortic valve with one instead of the normal three cusps (flaps).

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in hand
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the hand, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in foot
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the foot, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in tibia
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the tibia, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in fibula
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the fibula, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in radius
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the radius, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in ulna
terms.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the ulna, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

terms.name: Lower eyelid edema
terms.definition: Edema in the region of the Lower eyelid.

terms.name: Delayed menarche
terms.definition: First period after the age of 15 years.

terms.name: Synovial sarcoma
terms.definition: A type of mesenchymal tissue cell tumor that exhibits epithelial differentiation, which most frequently arises in the extremities.

terms.name: Ureter fissus
terms.definition: A partial duplication of the ureter where the duplicated ureters fuse to a single ureter before their insertion into the bladder.

terms.name: Ureter duplex
terms.definition: A complete duplication of the ureter, where the duplicated ureters have separate insertions into the bladder.

terms.name: Global proximal tubulopathy
terms.definition: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption with bicarbonate loss and resulting acidosis.

terms.name: Mesangial hypercellularity
terms.definition: Increased numbers of mesangial cells per glomerulus, defined as more than 3 nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in one or more mesangial areas, not including perihilar region, on a standard 3-micron-thick tissue section, best evaluated on periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain.

terms.name: Abnormal nephron morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the nephron.

terms.name: Glomerular C3 deposition
terms.definition: The presence of complement 3 deposits in the glomerulus.

terms.name: Thin glomerular basement membrane
terms.definition: Decreased thickness of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to a decrease in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations less than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals. May be focal or diffuse, although the term thin GBMs generally implies thinning of over 50% of GBMs.

terms.name: Membranous nephropathy
terms.definition: A type of glomerulonephropathy characterized by thickening of the basement membrane and deposition of immune complexes in the subepithelial space.

terms.name: Minimal change glomerulonephritis
terms.name_zh: 微小病变性肾小球肾炎
terms.definition: The presence of minimal changes visible by light microscopy but flattened and fused podocyte foot processes on electron microscopy in a person with nephrotic range proteinuria.

terms.name: Calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis
terms.definition: The presence of calcium- and phosphate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

terms.name: Simple renal cyst
terms.definition: An isolated cyst of the kidney.

terms.name: Bilateral renal dysplasia
terms.definition: A bilateral form of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.

terms.name: Unilateral renal hypoplasia
terms.definition: One sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

terms.name: Bilateral renal hypoplasia
terms.definition: Two sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the kidney.

terms.name: Bilateral renal atrophy
terms.definition: A two-sided form of atrophy of the kidney.

terms.name: Macroscopic hematuria
terms.definition: Hematuria that is visible upon inspection of the urine.

terms.name: Steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome
terms.definition: A form of nephrotic syndrome that does not respond to treatment with steroid medication, defined as persistent proteinuria despite 60mg/m2 or 2mg/kg for 8 weeks, after insuring no infection or non-adherence to medication.

terms.name: Multidrug-resistant nephrotic syndrome
terms.definition: A form of nephrotic syndrome that does not respond to any immunosuppresive treatment.

terms.name: Abnormal urine output
terms.definition: An abnormal amount of urine production.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary electrolyte concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality in the concentration of electrolytes in the urine.

terms.name: Albuminuria
terms.definition: Increased concentration of albumin in the urine.

terms.name: Nephrotic range proteinuria
terms.definition: Severely increased amount of excretion of protein in the urine, defined as 3.5 grams per day or more in adults and 40 mg per meter-squared body surface area per hour in children.

terms.name: Moderate albuminuria
terms.definition: The presence of moderately increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as and albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) of 30 to 299 mg/gm (3.4 to 34 mg/mmol).

terms.name: Mild proteinuria
terms.definition: Mildly increased levels of protein in the urine (150-500 mg per day in adults).

terms.name: Moderate proteinuria
terms.definition: Moderately increased levels of protein in the urine (500-1000 mg per day in adults).

terms.name: Heavy proteinuria
terms.definition: Severely increased levels of protein in the urine (1000-3000 mg per day in adults).

terms.name: Abnormal urine potassium concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal urine phosphate concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal phosphate concentration in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal urine chloride concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of chloride in the urine.

terms.name: Hypochloriduria
terms.definition: An decreased concentration of chloride in the urine.

terms.name: Renal chloride wasting
terms.definition: High urine chloride in the presence of hypochloridemia.

terms.name: Abnormal urine sodium concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of sodium in the urine.

terms.name: Hyponatriuria
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased sodium concentration in the urine.

terms.name: Hypernatriuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of sodium(1+) in the urine.

terms.name: Renal sodium wasting
terms.definition: An abnormally increased sodium concentration in the urine in the presence of hyponatremia.

terms.name: Abnormal urine magnesium concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of magnesium the urine.

terms.name: Hypermagnesiuria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of magnesium the urine.

terms.name: Hypomagnesiuria
terms.definition: An decreased concentration of magnesium the urine.

terms.name: Abnormality of urinary uric acid level
terms.definition: Abnormal amount of urate in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary sulfate concentration
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration of sulfate in the urine.

terms.name: Increased urinary sulfate
terms.definition: Elevated concentration of SO4(2-), i.e., sulfate, in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal urine cytology
terms.definition: An anomalous finding in the examination of the urine for cells.

terms.name: Cylindruria
terms.definition: The presence of renal casts (cylindrical, cigar-shaped structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.

terms.name: Leukocyte cylindruria
terms.definition: Presence of leukocyte casts (cylindrical structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.

terms.name: Erythrocyte cylindruria
terms.definition: Presence of erythrocyte casts (cylindrical structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.

terms.name: Urachal cyst
terms.definition: A cyst located along the allantois canal.

terms.name: Multiple bladder diverticula
terms.definition: Presence of a many diverticula (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Cloacal abnormality
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly associated with the failure of rectum, vagina, and bladder to separate.

terms.name: Persistent cloaca
terms.definition: Developmental anomaly in which the vagina, bladder, and rectum fuse resulting in a common channel.

terms.name: Chronic kidney disease
terms.definition: Functional anomaly of the kidney persisting for at least three months.

terms.name: Stage 1 chronic kidney disease
terms.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with normal or increased glomerular filtration rate (GFR at least 90 mL/min/1.73 m2).

terms.name: Stage 2 chronic kidney disease
terms.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with mildly reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 60-89 mL/min/1.73 m2).

terms.name: Stage 3 chronic kidney disease
terms.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with moderately reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 30-59 mL/min/1.73 m2).

terms.name: Stage 4 chronic kidney disease
terms.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with severely reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 15-29 mL/min/1.73 m2).

terms.name: Pseudoexfoliation
terms.definition: Deposition of fibrillar material that can be found on all anterior segment structures bathed by aqueous humor.

terms.name: Abnormal suspensory ligament of lens morphology
terms.name_zh: 晶状体悬韧带形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of the suspensory ligament of lens
terms.definition: An anomaly of the suspensory ligament of lens, also known as the ciliary zonule. These ligaments represent a series of fibers connecting the ciliary body and lens of the eye, holding the lens in place.

terms.name: Phakodonesis
terms.definition: Tremulousness (trembling) of the lens of the eye.

terms.name: Abnormal trabecular meshwork morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the trabecular meshwork, which is the porelike structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber at the base of the cornea and near the ciliary body. The trabecular mesh work is responsible for draining the aqueous humor into the canal of Schlemm.

terms.name: Pigment deposition in the trabecular meshwork
terms.definition: Accumulation of abnormal amounts of pigment within the trabecular meshwork.

terms.name: Abnormal intraocular pressure
terms.definition: An anomaly in the amount of force per unit area exerted by the intraocular fluid within the eye.

terms.name: Asymmetry of intraocular pressure
terms.definition: A difference in the amount of intraocular pressure in the right and left eye.

terms.name: Iris pigment dispersion
terms.definition: Shedding of the pigment granules that normally adhere to the back of the iris into the aqueous humor.

terms.name: Iris hypoperfusion
terms.definition: Reduction in the amount of blood flow to the iris.

terms.name: Retinal venous occlusion
terms.definition: Blockage of a retinal vein or venule, occurring typically at an arteriovenous crossing. Typically presenting with dilated veins, retinal hemorrhages and in some cases non-perfusion.

terms.name: Renal calcium wasting
terms.definition: High urine calcium in the presence of hypocalcemia.

terms.name: Abnormal nervous system physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormal nervous system morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormality of intracranial pressure
terms.definition: A deviation from the norm of the intracranial pressure.

terms.name: Decreased intracranial pressure
terms.definition: A reduction of the pressure inside the cranium (skull) and thereby in the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Cerebellar agenesis
terms.definition: Cerebellar agenesis is defined by the near complete absence of cerebellar tissue with only remnants of the anterior vermis, flocculus, and/or middle cerebellar peduncles.

terms.name: Foveal hypopigmentation
terms.definition: Decreased amount of pigmentation in the fovea.

terms.name: Increased caudate lactate level
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of lactate in the caudate nucleus. This finding can be elicited by magnetic resonance spectroscopy imaging.

terms.name: Enlarged peripheral nerve
terms.definition: Increase in size of a peripheral nerve. This finding can be appreciated by palpation along the axis of the nerve.

terms.name: Retractile testis
terms.definition: A testis that is located at the upper scrotum or lower inguinal canal and that can be made to descend completely into the scrotum without resistance by manual reduction but returns to its original position by the cremasteric reflex.

terms.name: Abnormal inflammatory response
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the inflammatory response, a response to injury or infection characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages.

terms.name: Decreased inflammatory response
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.

terms.name: Increased inflammatory response
terms.definition: A abnormal increase in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.

terms.name: Perisylvian polymicrogyria
terms.definition: Polymicrogyria (an excessive number of small gyri or convolutions) that is maximal in perisylvian regions (the regions that surround the Sylvian fissures), which may be symmetric or asymmetric and may extend beyond perisylvian regions. The Sylvian fissures often extend posteriorly and superiorly.

terms.name: Abasia
terms.definition: A severe form of gait ataxia such that an affected person cannot walk at all.

terms.name: Exercise-induced asthma
terms.definition: Asthma attacks following exercise.

terms.name: Status asthmaticus
terms.definition: Severe asthma unresponsive to repeated courses of beta-agonist therapy such as inhaled albuterol, levalbuterol, or subcutaneous epinephrine.

terms.name: Abnormal CSF dopamine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液多巴胺浓度异常
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Elevated CSF dopamine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液多巴胺浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Reduced CSF dopamine concentration
terms.definition: Decreased concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Abnormal brain positron emission tomography
terms.name_zh: 脑正电子发射断层显像异常
terms.definition: A functional brain anomaly detectable by positron emission tomography (PET). PET scanning is a method for functional brain imaging, and its measurements reflect the amount of brain activity in the various regions of the brain.

terms.name: Abnormal brain FDG positron emission tomography
terms.name_zh: 脑氟代脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层显像异常
terms.definition: An anomaly detectable in [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography (PET) brain scans. Glucose uptake measured with FDG-PET is a marker of neuronal metabolic activity.

terms.name: Prefrontal hypometabolism in FDG PET
terms.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the prefrontal cortex as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

terms.name: Thalamic hypometabolism in FDG PET
terms.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the thalamus as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

terms.name: Hypothalamic hypometabolism in FDG PET
terms.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the hypothalamus as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

terms.name: Parietal hypometabolism in FDG PET
terms.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the parietal cortex as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

terms.name: Mildly reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
terms.name_zh: 左心室射血分数轻度降低
terms.definition: A small reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle. The normal range in adults is at least 50 percent, and a mild reduction is defined as 40-49 percent.

terms.name: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
terms.definition: A diminution of the volumetric fraction of blood pumped out of the ventricle with each cardiac cycle.

terms.name: Moderately reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
terms.name_zh: 左心室射血分数中度降低
terms.definition: A medium reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle, defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction of 30-39 percent.

terms.name: Severely reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
terms.definition: A large reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle. The normal range in adults is at over 50 percent, and a severe reduction is defined as less than 30 percent.

terms.name: Regional left ventricular wall motion abnormality
terms.definition: An abnormal motion of a segment of the left ventricle during the cardiac cycle.

terms.name: Vasovagal syncope
terms.definition: A vasovagal episode or vasovagal syncope is the most common form of reflex syncope. Reflex syncope is a general term used to describe types of syncope resulting from a failure in autoregulation of blood pressure, and ultimately, in cerebral perfusion pressure resulting in transient loss of consciousness. The mechanisms responsible for this are complex and involve both depression of cardiac output as well as a decrease in vascular tone.

terms.name: Carotid sinus syncope
terms.definition: An exaggerated response to carotid sinus baroreceptor stimulation resulting in syncope from transient diminished cerebral perfusion.

terms.name: Orthostatic syncope
terms.definition: Syncope following a quick change in position from lying down to standing.

terms.name: Abulia
terms.definition: Abulia is characterized by difficulty in initiating and sustaining spontaneous movements; the person often appears frozen but will move hesitantly on request. There are frequently substantial reductions in emotional responsiveness, spontaneous speech, and social interaction. The individual appears to be content to remain still and inactive with minimal movement, but moves or reacts hesitantly in response to interactions.

terms.name: Akinetic mutism
terms.definition: The combined absence of spontaneous movement (akinesia) and speech (mutism). There may be eye movements consistent with visual tracking and the person may remember the events occurring at the time of the experience of stupor.

terms.name: Aplasia of the upper vagina
terms.definition: A failure to develop of the upper vagina.

terms.name: Aplasia of the lower vagina
terms.definition: A failure to develop of the lower part of the vagina.

terms.name: Iron accumulation in brain
terms.definition: An abnormal build up of iron (Fe) in brain tissue.

terms.name: Copper accumulation in brain
terms.definition: An anomalous build up of copper (Cu) in the brain.

terms.name: Iron accumulation in substantia nigra
terms.definition: An anomalous build up of iron (Fe) in the substantia nigra.

terms.name: Widened interpedicular distance
terms.definition: An increase in the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.

terms.name: Abnormality of the pineal gland
terms.definition: An anomaly of the pineal gland,a small endocrine gland in the brain that produces melatonin.

terms.name: Abnormal pineal morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the pineal gland.

terms.name: Pineal gland calcification
terms.definition: Accumulation of calcium salts in the pineal gland.

terms.name: Pineal cyst
terms.definition: A glial uniloculated or multiloculated fluid-filled sac that either reside within or completely replace the pineal gland.

terms.name: Abnormal pineal volume
terms.definition: An abnormal increase or decrease in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

terms.name: Decreased pineal volume
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

terms.name: Increased pineal volume
terms.definition: An abnormal elevation in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

terms.name: Agenesis of pineal gland
terms.definition: Failure to develop of the pineal gland, defined clinically as the absence of the pineal gland with no indication of the pineal gland even having been present.

terms.name: Abnormality of pineal physiology
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of the pineal gland.

terms.name: Abnormal pineal melatonin secretion
terms.name_zh: 松果体褪黑素分泌异常
terms.definition: An anomaly in the amount or timing of melatonin secretion by the pineal gland. Note that melatonin is also synthesized by multiple tissues outside of the pineal gland.

terms.name: T2 hypointense thalamus
terms.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting the entire thalamus.

terms.name: Focal T2 hypointense thalamic lesion
terms.name_zh: 丘脑局灶性T2低信号病变
terms.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.

terms.name: Focal T2 hyperintense thalamic lesion
terms.name_zh: 丘脑局灶性T2高信号病变
terms.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.

terms.name: Abnormal thalamic size
terms.definition: Deviation from the normal range of size of the thalamus.

terms.name: Enlarged thalamic volume
terms.definition: An increase in the quantity of space occupied by the thalamus.

terms.name: Decreased thalamic volume
terms.definition: A reduction in the quantity of space occupied by the thalamus.

terms.name: Abnormal thalamic MRI signal intensity
terms.definition: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus.

terms.name: Small basal ganglia
terms.definition: Decreased size of the basal ganglia.

terms.name: Cerebellar gliosis
terms.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the cerebellum.

terms.name: Anomaly of lower limb diaphyses
synonyms: Anomaly of shaft of long bone of lower limb
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of a diaphysis of the leg.

terms.name: Abnormal large intestine physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the large intestine.

terms.name: Bowel urgency
terms.definition: A sudden, irresistible need to have a bowel movement.

terms.name: Tenesmus
terms.definition: A repeated, painful urge to defecate without excreting stool.

terms.name: Abnormal subarachnoid space morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality in the space in the meninges beneath the arachnoid membrane and above the pia mater that contains the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Widened subarachnoid space
terms.definition: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater.

terms.name: Abnormal metabolic brain imaging by MRS
terms.definition: An anomaly of metabolism in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Elevated brain choline level by MRS
terms.definition: An increase in the level of choline-containing compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Elevated brain lactate level by MRS
terms.definition: An increase in the level of lactate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Reduced brain N-acetyl aspartate level by MRS
synonyms: MR Spectroscopy: N-acetylaspartate low in brain
Reduced brain N-acetyl aspartate level by magnetic resonance spectroscopy
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of N-acetyl aspartate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Abnormal brain choline/creatine ratio by MRS
terms.name_zh: 磁共振波谱示脑胆碱/肌酸比值异常
