Alpha-dystroglycan is a heavily glycosylated peripheral-membrane component of the dystrophin-associated glycoprotein complex (DAPC), which, in addition to laminin alpha2, binds perlecan and agrin in the extracellular matrix, whereas beta-dystroglycan, derived from the same gene, is a transmembrane protein that links to dystrophin intracellularly.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber alpha sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of alpha sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber alpha sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Lack of alpha sarcoglycan in muscle. Immunohistochemistry reveals absent alpha sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber alpha sarcoglycan
terms.definition: A decreased amount of alpha sarcoglycan in muscle. Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced alpha sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber beta sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of beta sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber gamma sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of gamma sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber delta sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of delta sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber beta sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of beta sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber beta sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced beta sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber gamma sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced gamma sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber gamma sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of gamma sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber delta sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of delta sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber delta sarcoglycan
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced amount of delta sarcoglycan in muscle.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber alpha dystroglycan
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维α-肌营养不良蛋白聚糖异常
terms.definition: A deviation from normal of muscle alpha-dystroglcan expression. Alpha-dystroglycan is a heavily glycosylated peripheral-membrane component of the dystrophin-associated glycoprotein complex (DAPC), which, in addition to laminin alpha2, binds perlecan and agrin in the extracellular matrix, whereas beta-dystroglycan, derived from the same gene, is a transmembrane protein that links to dystrophin intracellularly.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber dysferlin
terms.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of dysferlin in muscle tissue. Dysferlin is an ubiquitous 230-kDa transmembrane protein involved in calcium-mediated sarcolemma resealing.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber dysferlin
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of dysferlin protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber dysferlin
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced dysferlin protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber emerin
terms.definition: A deviation from normal of the amount of the inner nuclear membrane protein emerin in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber emerin
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of emerin protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber emerin
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced emerin protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber calpain-3
terms.definition: A deviation from normal in the amount of calpain-3 in muscle tissue. Calpains are intracellular nonlysosomal cysteine proteases modulated by calcium ions. A typical calpain is a heterodimer composed of two distinct subunits, one large (over 80 kDa) and the other small (30 kDa). While only one gene encoding the small subunit has been demonstrated, there are many genes for the large one. CAPN3 is similar to ubiquitous Calpain 1 and 2 (m-calpain and micro-calpain), but contains specific insertion sequences (NS, IS1 and IS2). Calpains cleave target proteins to modify their properties, rather than breaking down the substrates.

terms.name: Absent muscle fiber calpain-3
terms.definition: Western blot shows complete lack of calpain-3 protein in the muscle biopsy tissue.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber calpain-3
terms.definition: Western blot reveals reduced calpain-3 protein in the muscle biopsy tissue.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber perlecan
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced perlecan protein in the muscle biopsy. Perlecan is a basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein (HSPG) also known as heparan sulfate proteoglycan 2 (HSPG2).

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber lamin A/C
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维核纤层蛋白A/C异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal amount of lamin A/C in muscle tissue. The LMNA gene gives rise to at least three splicing isoforms including the two main isoforms, lamin A and lamin C. These are constitutive components of the fibrous nuclear lamina and have different roles, ranging from mechanical nuclear membrane maintenance to gene regulation.

terms.name: Reduced muscle fiber lamin A/C
terms.definition: A decreased amount of lamin A/C in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.

terms.name: Sacralization of the fifth lumbar vertebra
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly, in which the transverse process of the last lumbar vertebra (L5) fuses to the sacrum on one side or both, or to ilium, or both.

terms.name: Abnormal endometrium morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the inner mucous membrane of the uterus.

terms.name: Endometriosis
terms.definition: The growth of endometrial tissue outside the uterus.

terms.name: Impaired ristocetin cofactor assay activity
terms.name_zh: 瑞斯托霉素辅因子活性检测异常
terms.definition: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin to platelet-poor plasma.

terms.name: Impaired von Willebrand factor collagen binding activity
terms.name_zh: 血管性血友病因子胶原结合活性受损
terms.definition: Reduced ability of von Willebrand factor (vWF) to bind collagen. Abnormal response to collagen as manifested by reduced or lacking ability of plasma von WIllebrand Factor to bind collagen. An ELISA-based assay is typically used; the test is sensitive to loss of von Willebrand Factor high molecular weight multimers.

terms.name: Abnormal von Willebrand factor multimer distribution
terms.name_zh: 血管性血友病因子多聚体分布异常
terms.definition: Deviation from the normal von Willebrand factor multimer pattern.

terms.name: Absence of large von Willebrand factor multimers
terms.name_zh: 大分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体缺失
terms.definition: Absence of large von Willebrand Factor multimers on gel electrophoresis.

terms.name: Abnormal presence of ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers
terms.name_zh: 超大型血管性血友病因子多聚体异常存在
terms.definition: Detection of abnormal ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers.

terms.name: Total absence von Willebrand factor multimers
terms.definition: Complete absence of all von Willebrand factor multimers.

terms.name: Absence of intermediate von Willebrand factor multimers
terms.name_zh: 中分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体缺失
terms.definition: Lack of intermediate von Willebrand Factor multimers on gel electrophoresis.

terms.name: Enhanced ristocetin cofactor assay activity
terms.name_zh: 瑞斯托霉素辅因子活性增强
terms.definition: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by increased aggregation of platelets upon addition of low-dose ristocetin to platelet-rich plasma.

terms.name: Prolonged bleeding following circumcision
terms.definition: Bleeding that persists for a longer than usual time following circumcision.

terms.name: Excessive bleeding from superficial cuts
terms.definition: An abnormally increased degree of bleeding following a superficial injury to the surface of the skin.

terms.name: Excessive bleeding after a venipuncture
terms.definition: An abnormal high amount of bleeding following the procedure of taking a blood sample.

terms.name: Oral cavity bleeding
terms.definition: Recurrent or excessive bleeding from the mouth.

terms.name: Abnormality of the posterior hairline
synonyms: Abnormality of hairline at back of head
terms.definition: An anomaly in the placement or shape of the hairline (trichion) on the back of the head (neck), that is, the border between skin on the back of the head that has head hair.

terms.name: Abnormal bowel sounds
terms.definition: An anomaly of the amount or nature of abdominal sounds. Abdominal sounds (bowel sounds) are made by the movement of the intestines as they promote passage of abdominal contents by peristalsis.

terms.name: Hyperactive bowel sounds
terms.definition: Abnormally increased gurgling/rumbling sounds made by the movement of fluid and gas in the intestines.

terms.name: Hypoactive bowel sounds
terms.definition: An decreased amount of bowel sounds.

terms.name: Lack of bowel sounds
terms.definition: Complete lack of abdominal sounds as assayed by examination of the abdomen with a stethoscope.

terms.name: Abnormal liver parenchyma morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the liver located predominantly in the hepatocytes as opposed to stromal cells.

terms.name: Truncal titubation
terms.definition: Tremor of the trunk in an anterior-posterior plane at 3-4 Hz.

terms.name: Heart murmur
terms.definition: An extra or unusual sound heard during a heartbeat caused vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart.

terms.name: Cardiogenic shock
terms.definition: Severely decreased cardiac output with evidence of inadequate end-organ perfusion (i.e., tissue hypoxia) in the presence of adequate intravascular volume.

terms.name: Plasmacytosis
terms.definition: An abnormally increased number of plasma cells in tissues, exudates, or blood

terms.name: Cholangitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the biliary ductal system, affecting the intrahepatic or extrahepatic portions, or both.

terms.name: Cholangiocarcinoma
terms.definition: Cholangiocarcinoma is a primary cancer originating in the biliary epithelium i.e., the cholangiocytes, of the extrahepatic and intrahepatic biliary ducts. It is extremely invasive, develops rapidly, often metastasizes, and has a very poor prognosis. They are slow growing tumors which spread longitudinally along the bile ducts with neural, perineural and subepithelial extension.

terms.name: Gallbladder perforation
terms.definition: Rupture of the wall of the gallbladder.

terms.name: Scrotal pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the scrotum.

terms.name: Bence Jones Proteinuria
terms.definition: The presence of free monoclonal immunoglobulin light chains in the urine.

terms.name: Flank pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the flank.

terms.name: Cervical ectropion
terms.definition: Cervical ectropion occurs when eversion of the endocervix exposes columnar epithelium to the vaginal milieu

terms.name: Cervical polyp
terms.definition: Abnormal growth of tissue projecting from a mucous membrane of the endocervix.

terms.name: Cervicitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the uterine cervix.

terms.name: Vaginal pruritus
terms.definition: A sensation of itching in the vagina.

terms.name: Glomerulomegaly
terms.definition: Abnormally large size of glomeruli.

terms.name: Abnormal vascular physiology
terms.definition: Abnormality of vascular function.

terms.name: Jaw claudication
terms.definition: Pain in the jaw or ear induced by chewing or otherwise moving the jaw.

terms.name: Temporal artery tortuosity
terms.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the temporal artery.

terms.name: Night sweats
terms.definition: Occurrence of excessive sweating during sleep.

terms.name: Antimitochondrial antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against mitochondria.

terms.name: Dilated superficial abdominal veins
synonyms: Dilatation of the superficial abdominal veins
terms.definition: Increase in diameter of the veins located underneath the skin of the abdomen.

terms.name: Gastric varix
terms.definition: Extreme dilation of the submucusoal veins in the stomach.

terms.name: Cystic artery pseudoaneurysm
terms.definition: Presence of a pseudoaneurysm in the artery that supplies the gallbladder and cystic duct with blood. A pseudoaneurysm, also known as a false aneurysm, forms when blood leaks through a breach of the arterial wall but is contained by the adventitia or surrounding perivascular soft tissue.

terms.name: Perirenal hematoma
terms.definition: A collection of clotted blood surrounding the kidney.

terms.name: Peripheral amyelination
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the myelin sheath on a nerve.

terms.name: Peripheral hypermyelination
terms.definition: Increased amount of peripheral myelination.

terms.name: Increased peripheral myelin thickness
terms.definition: Elevated thickness of the myelin sheath of peripheral nerves, in a regular and concentric fashion.

terms.name: Myelin tomacula
terms.definition: The presence of multiple sausage-shaped swellings of the myelin sheath (The Latin tomaculum means sausage).

terms.name: Asymmetric peripheral demyelination
terms.name_zh: 不对称性周围脱髓鞘病变
terms.definition: Loss of myelin from peripheral nerves in a pattern that differs between right and left.

terms.name: Abnormality of peripheral nervous system electrophysiology
terms.name_zh: 周围神经系统电生理异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of the function of the electrical signals with which peripheral nerve cells communicate with each other or with muscles.

terms.name: Abnormality of central nervous system electrophysiology
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统电生理异常

terms.name: Abnormal peripheral action potential amplitude
terms.name_zh: 周围动作电位幅度异常
terms.definition: An anomaly in the magnitude of the action potential along a peripheral nerve, that is, of the rapid rise and fall of the electrical membrane potential of the nerve.

terms.name: Oppenheim reflex
terms.definition: Dorsiflexion of the big toe, sometimes accompanied by fanning of the other toes, elicited by stroking along the medial side of the tibia (the normal response would be no movement of the big toe).

terms.name: Gordon reflex
terms.definition: Dorsal extension of the big toe, sometimes accompanied by fanning of the other toes, elicited by compressing the calf muscles (a normal response is no movement of the big toe).

terms.name: Tetraplegia/tetraparesis
terms.definition: Loss of strength in all four limbs. Tetraplegia refers to a complete loss of strength, whereas Tetraparesis refers to an incomplete loss of strength.

terms.name: Impaired visually enhanced vestibulo-ocular reflex
terms.name_zh: 视觉增强前庭-眼反射障碍
terms.definition: The vestibulo-ocular reflex is responsible for the stabilization of the retinal image during movement. The visual vestibular ocular reflex (VVOR) or visual enhanced VOR, maintains ocular stability during head motion by generating compensatory eye movement opposite to head movement, and is a major component of visual vestibular interaction. This feature is an impairment of this reflex, manifested as the combined impairment of the three compensatory eye movement reflexes, namely the vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR), smooth pursuit (SP) and optokinetic reflex (OKR).

terms.name: Isometric tremor
terms.definition: An isometric tremor occurs with muscle contraction against a rigid stationary object (e.g., when making a fist).

terms.name: Kinetic tremor
terms.definition: Tremor that occurs during any voluntary movement. It may include visually or non-visually guided movements. Tremor during target directed movement is called intention tremor.

terms.name: Titubation
terms.definition: Nodding movement of the head or body.

terms.name: Tremor by anatomical site
terms.definition: Tremor classified by the affected body part.

terms.name: Oral motor hypotonia
terms.definition: Reduced muscle tone of oral musculature. In infants, this feature may be associated with difficulties in breast feeding, and may affect the latch, jaw motions, tongue placement, lip seal, suck/swallow/breathe pattern and overall feeding behavior.

terms.name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system synaptic transmission
terms.name_zh: 周围神经系统突触传递异常
terms.definition: An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse in the peripheral nervous system.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of bulbar muscles
terms.name_zh: 延髓肌易疲劳性肌无力
terms.definition: A type of weakness of the bulbar muscles (muscles of the mouth and throat responsible for speech and swallowing) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of chewing muscles
terms.name_zh: 咀嚼肌易疲劳性肌无力
terms.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in chewing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of speech muscles
terms.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in speech that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of swallowing muscles
terms.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in swallowing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of respiratory muscles
terms.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in breathing (respiration) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of skeletal muscles
terms.definition: A type of weakness of skeletal muscle that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles
terms.name_zh: 肢体远端肌肉易疲劳性无力
terms.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of distal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatigable weakness of neck muscles
terms.name_zh: 颈部肌肉易疲劳性无力
terms.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle in the neck that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Fatiguable weakness of proximal limb muscles
terms.name_zh: 肢体近端肌肉易疲劳性无力
terms.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of proximal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

terms.name: Response to drugs acting on neuromuscular transmission
terms.definition: Specific drugs interfere selectively with the different cellular mechanisms involved in neuromuscular transmission (synthesis, storage, release, action and inactivation of transmitter). The response of a patient to a specific drug can therefore be useful information for the differential diagnosis.

terms.name: Favorable response of weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
terms.name_zh: 肌无力对乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂反应良好
synonyms: Favourable response of weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
terms.definition: Improvement of muscle strength in response to administration of an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor.

terms.name: Unfavorable response of muscle weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
synonyms: Unfavourable response of muscle weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
terms.definition: Lack of improvement of muscle strength in response to administration of an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor.

terms.name: Increased jitter at single fiber EMG
terms.name_zh: 单纤维肌电图颤抖增宽
synonyms: Increased jitter at single fibre EMG
Increased jitter at single fibre electromyography
terms.definition: The variation in the time interval between the two action potentials of the same motor unit is called jitter. This term therefore applies to increased variability in the interval between successive action potentials of the same motor unit, which is measured by electromyography (EMG).

terms.name: EMG: incremental response of compound muscle action potential to repetitive nerve stimulation
terms.name_zh: 肌电图示重复神经刺激复合肌肉动作电位递增反应
terms.definition: A compound muscle action potential (CMAP) is a type of electromyography (EMG). CMAP refers to a group of almost simultaneous action potentials from several muscle fibers in the same area evoked by stimulation of the supplying motor nerve and are recorded as one multipeaked summated action potential. This abnormality refers to an abnormal increase in the amplitude during the course of the investigation.

terms.name: Paradoxical respiration
terms.definition: Breathing movements in which the chest wall moves in on inspiration and out on expiration, in reverse of the normal movements. It may be seen in children with respiratory distress of any cause, which leads to indrawing of the intercostal spaces during inspiration. Patients with chronic airways obstruction also show indrawing of the lower ribs during inspiration, due to the distorted action of a depressed and flattened diaphragm. Crush injuries of the chest, with fractured ribs and sternum, can lead to a severe degree of paradoxical breathing.

terms.name: Anti-neuromuscular Junction acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗神经肌肉接头乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against neuromuscular junction acetylcholine receptors.

terms.name: Calcium channel antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against voltage-gated calcium channels.

terms.name: Anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase antibody
terms.name_zh: 抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶抗体
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against muscle specific kinase (anti-MuSK Ab).

terms.name: Slow pupillary light response
terms.definition: Reduced velocity and acceleration in the pupillary light response.

terms.name: Collectionism
terms.definition: Excessive or pathological tendency to save and collect possessions.

terms.name: Emotional dearth
terms.definition: A diminished ability to experience, express, or connect with emotions across both positive and negative valences. This state is often characterized by a pervasive sense of emotional disconnection or detachment, where the individual may report feeling \

terms.name: Inappropriate crying
terms.definition: Uncontrolled episodes of crying occur without any apparent motivating stimuli.

terms.name: Inertia
terms.definition: Reduction of goal-directed behaviors linked to the impairment in frontal executive functions (planning of an action for example).

terms.name: Limb apraxia
terms.definition: Difficulty in performing the correct execution of limbs movements in absence of motor impairment.

terms.name: Punding
terms.definition: Punding is a stereotypical motor behavior characterized by an intense fascination with repetitive, excessive and non-goal oriented handling, and examining of objects.

terms.name: Semantic dementia
terms.definition: A progressive loss of the ability to remember the meaning of words, faces and objects.

terms.name: Sweet craving
terms.definition: Excessive desire to eat sweet foods.

terms.name: Visual agnosia
terms.definition: The condition is known as visual agnosia, which refers to the inability to recognize objects that are visually presented, even though the individual may have normal visual field, acuity, color vision, brightness discrimination, language, and memory.

terms.name: Perseverative thought
terms.definition: The repetitive production of the same response to different commands.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber desmin
terms.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of desmin in muscle tissue. Desmin is an 53-kDa protein.

terms.name: Accumulation of muscle fiber desmin
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of desmin protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber myotilin
terms.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of myotilin in muscle tissue. Myotilin is a 57kDa cytoskeletal protein.

terms.name: Accumulation of muscle fiber myotilin
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of myotilin protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle fiber valosin-containing protein
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维含缬酪肽蛋白异常
terms.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of valosin-containing protein in muscle tissue. Valosin-containing protein is an ubiquitously expressed multifunctional 100-kD protein that is a member of the AAA+ (ATPase associated with various activities) protein family.

terms.name: Accumulation of muscle fiber valosin-containing protein
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维含缬酪肽蛋白蓄积
synonyms: Accumulation of muscle fibre valosin-containing protein
terms.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of valosin-containing protein in the muscle biopsy.

terms.name: Central core regions in muscle fibers
synonyms: Central core regions in muscle fibres
terms.definition: The presence of disorganized areas called cores in the center of muscle fibers. There is a typical appearance of the biopsy on light microscopy, where the muscle cells have cores that are devoid of mitochondria and specific enzymes. Cores are typically well demarcated and centrally located, but may occasionally be multiple and of eccentric.

terms.name: Glycogen accumulation in muscle fiber lysosomes
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维溶酶体内糖原贮积
synonyms: Glycogen accumulation in muscle fibre lysosomes
terms.definition: An increased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue found specifically in lysosomes.

terms.name: Increased sarcoplasmic glycogen
terms.definition: Elevated glycogen content in the sarcoplasm (cytoplasm) of muscle fibers.

terms.name: Bethlem sign
terms.definition: Limitation of wrist and finger extension on asking patient to form a prayer sign. This is a result of progressive wrist and finger flexion contractures.

terms.name: Highly elevated creatine kinase
terms.definition: An increased CPK level between 4X and 50X above the upper normal level.

terms.name: Extremely elevated creatine kinase
terms.definition: An increased creatine kinase level more than 50X above the upper normal level.

terms.name: Abnormality of muscle size
terms.definition: Abnormalities of the overall muscle bulk based on clinical observation.

terms.name: Hand muscle weakness
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the musculature of the hand.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the upper arm musculature
terms.name_zh: 上臂肌肉组织发育不全
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the musculature of the upper arm, which may include the deltoid, the triceps, the biceps, and the brachioradialis.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of deltoid muscle
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the deltoid muscle.

terms.name: Portal vein thrombosis
terms.definition: Thrombosis of the portal vein and/or its tributaries, which include the splenic vein and the superior and inferior mesenteric veins.

terms.name: Hepatic vein thrombosis
terms.definition: An obstruction in the veins of the liver caused by a blood clot (thrombosis).

terms.name: Maternal fever in pregnancy
terms.definition: The occurrence of an elevated body temperature of the mother during pregnancy.

terms.name: Intrapartum fever
terms.definition: The occurrence of maternal fever during labor.

terms.name: Maternal first trimester fever
terms.definition: The occurrence of fever in a mother during the first trimester of pregnancy.

terms.name: Splanchnic vein thrombosis
terms.definition: The term splanchnic vein thrombosis encompasses Budd-Chiari syndrome (hepatic vein thrombosis), extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO), and mesenteric vein thrombosis; the word splanchnic is used to refer to the visceral organs (of the abdominal cavity).

terms.name: Mesenteric venous thrombosis
terms.definition: A clot that obstructs blood flow in a mesenteric vein (the superior and the inferior mesenteric vein drain blood from the small and large intestine).

terms.name: Enanthema
terms.definition: A sudden eruption (rash) of the surface of a mucous membrane of the mouth or pharynx.

terms.name: Pulmonary granulomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple granulomata (small nodular inflammatory lesions containing grouped mononuclear phagocytes) in the lung.

terms.name: Absent circulating B cells
terms.definition: Absence of detectable circulating B cells, commonly characterized as CD19+ or CD20+ lymphocytes, in the blood. Usually, less than 20 cells per microlitre is considered to be an absence.

terms.name: Nail bed hemorrhage
terms.definition: Small areas of bleeding (hemorrhage) under the fingernail or toenail.

terms.name: Large intestinal polyposis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple polyps in the large intestine.

terms.name: Small intestinal polyposis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple polyps in the small intestine.

terms.name: Freckled genitalia
terms.definition: One or more brown punctate macules on the skin of the genitalia.

terms.name: Hyperpigmented genitalia
terms.definition: Localized or generalized increased genital pigmentation.

terms.name: Hypopigmented genitalia
terms.definition: Localized or generalized decreased genital pigmentation.

terms.name: Microphallus
terms.definition: Length of penis more than 2 SD below the mean for age accompanied by hypospadias.

terms.name: Absent penis
terms.definition: Lack of recognizable penile structures.

terms.name: Narrow penis
terms.definition: Penile width more than 2 standard deviations (SD) below the mean for age. Alternatively circumference of the flaccid penis more than 2 SD below the mean for age. Alternatively, apparently decreased penile width for age.

terms.name: Torsion of the penis
terms.definition: Rotated position of the glans, with or without the penile shaft, of 30 degrees or more.

terms.name: Webbed penis
terms.definition: Ventral skinfold extending from penis to scrotum.

terms.name: Wide penis
terms.definition: Distance between left and right side of the flaccid penis at the attachment to the skin above the pubic symphysis more than 2 standard deviations above the mean for age.

terms.name: Calcification of the interosseus membrane of the forearm
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the fibrous sheet that connects the radius and the ulna.

terms.name: Hyperplastic callus formation
terms.definition: Increased growth of callus, the bony and cartilaginous material that forms a connecting bridge across a bone fracture during fracture healing.

terms.name: Increased circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胰岛素样生长因子1浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated red cell adenosine deaminase activity
terms.name_zh: 红细胞腺苷脱氨酶活性升高
terms.definition: Increase in the level of adenosine deaminase (ADA), an enzyme involved in purine metabolism, within erythrocytes. ADA is involved in the catabolism of adenosine.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte 2,3-diphosphoglycerate concentration
terms.definition: This term refers to an inappropriate low 2,3-DPG concentration in erythrocytes. 2,3-diphosphoglycerate (2,3-DPG) controls the movement of oxygen from red blood cells to tissues. Anemia is usually accompanied by an increased level of 2,3-DPG in order to promote tissue oxygenation.

terms.name: Abnormal erythrocyte enzyme concentration or activity
terms.name_zh: 红细胞酶浓度或活性异常
terms.definition: An altered level of any enzyme to act as catalysts within erythrocytes. This term includes changes due to altered activity of an enzyme.

terms.name: Reduced red cell adenosine deaminase level
terms.definition: Decrease in the level of adenosine deaminase (ADA), an enzyme involved in purine metabolism, within erythrocytes. ADA is involved in the catabolism of adenosine.

terms.name: Accessory scrotum
terms.definition: Additional scrotum, or part of a scrotum in an abnormal location.

terms.name: Ectopic scrotum
terms.definition: Scrotum in a position other than the usual position inferior to the base of the penis.

terms.name: Abnormal vertebral pedicle morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal morphology of a vertebral pedical.

terms.name: Hypoplastic vertebral pedicle
terms.definition: Underdeveloped vertebral pedicle.

terms.name: Hypoplastic L5 vertebral pedicle
terms.definition: Underdeveloped pedicle of the fifth lumbar vertebra.

terms.name: Rib gap
terms.definition: Radiolucent focal defect of a rib shaft.

terms.name: Cervical C3/C4 vertebral fusion
terms.definition: Fusion of cervical vertebrae at C3 and C4, caused by a failure in the normal segmentation or division of the cervical vertebrae during the early weeks of fetal development.

terms.name: Posterior rib gap
terms.definition: Radiolucent focal defect of the posterior portion of a rib shaft. The 'gaps' may lead to flail chest.

terms.name: Partial absence of the septum pellucidum
terms.definition: Only part of the septum pellucidum (a thin, triangular, vertical membrane separating the lateral ventricles of the brain) is present. This feature can be appreciated on magnetic resonance tomography or computed tomography of the brain.

terms.name: Triangular tongue
terms.definition: A form of macrogloassia (increased size of the tongue) characterized by a broad based root of the tongue but a small tongue tip, giving the appearance of a triangle.

terms.name: Splayed superior cerebellar peduncle
terms.definition: Abnormal splayed configuration (spreading out) of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

terms.name: Atrophic superior cerebellar peduncle
terms.definition: Atrophy of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

terms.name: Flattened femoral epiphysis
synonyms: Flattended end part of thigh bone
terms.definition: An abnormal flattening of an epiphysis of femur.

terms.name: Unossified sacrum
terms.definition: Lack of ossification of the sacrum.

terms.name: Lower-limb metaphyseal irregularity
terms.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of one or more metaphyses of a bone of the leg.

terms.name: Tibial metaphyseal irregularity
terms.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of a metaphysis of a tibia.

terms.name: Fibular metaphyseal irregularity
synonyms: Irregularity of wide portion of calf bone
terms.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of a metaphysis of a fibula.

terms.name: Abnormal distal femoral metaphysis morphology
terms.name_zh: 股骨远端干骺端形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of wide portion of outermost thighbone
terms.definition: An anomaly of the metaphysis of the distal femur (close to the knee).

terms.name: 10 pairs of ribs
terms.definition: Presence of only 10 (instead of the usual 12) pairs of ribs.

terms.name: Abnormality of the anterior commissure
terms.definition: An anomaly of the anterior commissure, a bundle of nerve fibers that connect the two cerebral hemispheres across the midline. The anterior commissure plays a role in pain sensation and contains decussating fibers from the olfactory tracts.

terms.name: Agenesis of the anterior commissure
terms.definition: Absence of the anterior commissure.

terms.name: Hypoplastic anterior commissure
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the anterior commissure.

terms.name: Abnormal number of vertebrae
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal number of vertebrae in the spinal column.

terms.name: 11 thoracic vertebrae
terms.definition: The presence of 11 instead of the normal 12 thoracic vertebrae.

terms.name: Flared lower limb metaphysis
synonyms: Flared metaphysis of lower limb bone
terms.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of one or more long bones of the leg.

terms.name: Flared distal tibial metaphysis
terms.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the distal tibia.

terms.name: Flared distal fibular metaphysis
synonyms: Flared outermost wide portion of of calf bone
terms.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the distal fibula.

terms.name: Upper extremity joint dislocation
terms.definition: Displacement or malalignment of one or more joints in the upper extremity (arm).

terms.name: Lower extremity joint dislocation
terms.definition: Displacement or malalignment of one or more joints in the lower extremity (leg).

terms.name: Obliteration of the calvarial diploe
terms.definition: Absence of the spongy bone structure (or tissue) of the internal part of the skull cap (i.e., of the calvarial diploe).

terms.name: Abnormal periosteum morphology
terms.definition: An anomalous structure of the periosteum, i.e., of the membrane that covers the outer surface of bones.

terms.name: Periostosis
terms.definition: Abnormal deposition of periosteal bone.

terms.name: Angular cheilitis
synonyms: Inflammation of corners of the mouth
Red and sore corners of the mouth
terms.definition: A type of inflammation of the lips involving one or both of the corners of the mouth.

terms.name: Weakness of facial musculature
terms.definition: Reduced strength of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).

terms.name: Increased intervertebral space
terms.definition: An increase in the vertical distance between adjacent vertebral bodies, observed as an increase in the intervertebral disk space.

terms.name: Abnormal vertebral artery morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the vertebral artery, the major artery of the neck that originates from the subclavian artery and merges to form the single midline basilar artery in a complex called the vertebrobasilar system.

terms.name: Vertebral artery hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the vertebral artery.

terms.name: Unilateral vertebral artery hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the vertebral artery on one side.

terms.name: Bilateral vertebral artery hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the vertebral artery on both sides.

terms.name: Cervicomedullary schisis
terms.definition: Fissure within the spinal cord of the neck.

terms.name: Abnormal macrophage count
terms.definition: An anomaly in the number of macrophages.

terms.name: Abnormal osteoclast count
terms.definition: An anomaly in the number of osteoclasts in bone tissue, bone-resorbing cells that develop from macrophages. This finding can be observed by histological examination of bone tissue.

terms.name: Decreased osteoclast count
terms.definition: Decreased number of osteoclasts in bone tissue.

terms.name: Retinal thinning on OCT
terms.definition: Reduced anteroposterior thickness of the retina. This phenotype can be appreciated by retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT).

terms.name: Multinucleated giant chondrocytes in epiphyseal cartilage
terms.name_zh: 骺软骨多核巨大软骨细胞
terms.definition: The presence of cartilage cells (chondrocytes) that are substantially increased in size and contain more than one nucleus and are located within the resting zone of the epiphyseal cartilage.

terms.name: Impaired stimulus-induced skin wrinkling
terms.name_zh: 刺激诱导皮肤皱缩反应障碍
terms.definition: A reduced ability of the skin of the fingertips to wrinkle when exposed to stimuli such as soaking in water or application of EMLA cream (the fingertip remains smooth).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating gonadotropin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环促性腺激素浓度异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the circulating level of a gonadotropin, that is, of a protein hormone secreted by gonadotrope cells of the anterior pituitary of vertebrates. The primary gonadotropins are luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).

terms.name: Decreased circulating gonadotropin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环促性腺激素浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduction of the circulating level of a gonadotropin, that is, of a protein hormone secreted by gonadotrope cells of the anterior pituitary of vertebrates. The primary gonadotropins are luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).

terms.name: Decreased circulating follicle stimulating hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环卵泡刺激素浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased circulating follicle stimulating hormone level
terms.definition: A reduction of the circulating level of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).

terms.name: Decreased circulating luteinizing hormone level
terms.name_zh: 血循环促黄体生成素水平降低
terms.definition: A reduction in the circulating level of luteinizing hormone (LH).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating luteinizing hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环黄体生成素浓度异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the circulating level of luteinizing hormone (LH).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating follicle-stimulating hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环促卵泡激素浓度异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the circulating level of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating androgen level
terms.definition: An anomaly in the blood concentration of an androgen, that is, of a steroid hormone that controls development and maintenance of masculine characteristics. The androgens include testosterone and Dehydroepiandrosterone.

terms.name: Increased circulating androgen concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环雄激素浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation of the blood concentration of an androgen, that is, of a steroid hormone that controls development and maintenance of masculine characteristics. The androgens include testosterone and Dehydroepiandrosterone.

terms.name: Decreased circulating androgen concentration
terms.definition: A reduction in the blood concentration of an androgen, that is, of a steroid hormone that controls development and maintenance of masculine characteristics. The androgens include testosterone and Dehydroepiandrosterone.

terms.name: Erythematous papule
terms.definition: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid that is reddish (erythematous) in color.

terms.name: Urticarial plaque
terms.definition: A well-circumscribed, intensely pruritic, raised wheal (edema of the superficial skin) typically 1 to 2 cm in diameter.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环胰岛素样生长因子1浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal serum insulin-like growth factor 1 level
terms.definition: An anomalous level of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胰岛素样生长因子1浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interferon-gamma concentration
terms.definition: Abnormal levels of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating interferon-gamma concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环γ干扰素浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Small cell lung carcinoma
terms.definition: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a type of highly malignant lung cancer that is composed of small ovoid cells. In the past, SCLC was called oat cell carcinoma because the microscopic appearance of the cells was felt to resemble oats. SLCLC usually originates near the bronchi and in many cases may grow and metastasize quickly.

terms.name: Squamous cell lung carcinoma
terms.definition: A type of non-small cell lung carcinoma that is derived from stratified squamous epithelial cells.

terms.name: Large cell lung carcinoma
terms.definition: A type of non-small cell lung carcinoma that is derived from undifferentiated malignant neoplasms originating from transformed epithelial cells in the lung, and which is differentiate from small-cell lung carcinoma by the larger size of the anaplastic cells, a higher cytoplasmic-to-nuclear size ratio, and a lack of salt-and-pepper appearance of the chromatin.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating eicosanoid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血类二十烷酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an icosanoid (also known as eicosanoids). These are signaling molecules derived from oxidation of 20-carbon fatty acids. Most are produced from arachidonic acid, a 20-carbon polyunsaturated fatty acid (5,8,11,14-eicosatetraenoic acid).

terms.name: Reduced muscle carnitine level
terms.definition: A reduction in the level of carnitine in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Primary Caesarian section
terms.definition: Delivery by Caesarian section representing the first time the mother has delivered by Caesarian section.

terms.name: Secondary Caesarian section
terms.definition: Delivery by Caesarian section representing where the mother has already had a previous Cesarean delivery, and this is a repeat Cesarean birth.

terms.name: Vaginal birth after Caesarean
terms.definition: Vaginal birth after Caesarean (VBAC) refers to the situation where the mother has had a previous Cesarean delivery but has now delivered vaginally.

terms.name: Delivery by Odon device
terms.definition: The Odon device is an instrument for assisted vaginal deliveries that is applied on the head of the baby and used to apply traction to assist the birth process.

terms.name: Finger hyperphalangy
terms.definition: Hyperphalangy is a digit morphology in which increased numbers of phalanges are arranged linearly within a digit. That is, there is an accessory phalanx that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges.

terms.name: Hyperphalangy of the 2nd finger
terms.definition: An accessory phalanx of the index (second) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy of the index finger results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint, resulting in radial deviation of the index finger. Note that this term refers only to this type of hyperphalangy.

terms.name: Induced vaginal delivery
terms.definition: Vaginal delivery following induction of labor, a procedure used to stimulate uterine contractions during pregnancy before labor begins on its own.

terms.name: Abnormal naive B cell proportion
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of naive B cells
terms.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of the naive B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27-IgM+, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Increased naive B cell proportion
synonyms: Increased proportion of naive B cells
terms.definition: The proportion of naive B cellsin the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal with respect to the reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Decreased naive B cell proportion
synonyms: Decreased proportion of naive B cells
terms.definition: The proportion of naive B cellsin the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal with respect to the reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Abnormal memory B cell proportion
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of memory B cells
terms.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of memory B cells in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Memory B cells develop from naive B cells. Upon antigen rechallenge, memory B cells rapidly expand and differentiate into plasma cells under the cognate control of memory Th cells (Phase IV).

terms.name: Decreased memory B cell proportion
terms.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Memory B cells develop from naive B cells. Upon antigen rechallenge, memory B cells rapidly expand and differentiate into plasma cells under the cognate control of memory Th cells (Phase IV).

terms.name: Increased memory B cell proportion
terms.definition: An elevation in the proportion of memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Memory B cells develop from naive B cells. Upon antigen rechallenge, memory B cells rapidly expand and differentiate into plasma cells under the cognate control of memory Th cells (Phase IV).

terms.name: Abnormal immature B cell proportion
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of CD19+/CD21low B cells
Abnormal proportion of immature B cells
terms.definition: A deviation from normal proportion of immature B cells (CD19+/ CD21low) in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Immature B cells (IgM+) are still in final stages of development within the bone marrow. Naive B cells are those which have left the bone marrow, before they bind to the antigen for which they're specific (IgM+/IgD+).

terms.name: Increased immature B cell proportion
synonyms: Increased proportion of CD19+/CD21low B cells
Increased proportion of immature B cells
terms.definition: An elevation in the proportion above normal of immature B cells (CD19+/ CD21low) in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Immature B cells (IgM+) are still in final stages of development within the bone marrow. Naive B cells are those which have left the bone marrow, before they bind to the antigen for which they're specific (IgM+/IgD+).

terms.name: Decreased immature B cell proportion
synonyms: Decreased proportion of CD19+/CD21low B cells
Decreased proportion of immature B cells
terms.definition: A reduction in normal proportion of immature B cells (CD19+/ CD21low)in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Immature B cells (IgM+) are still in final stages of development within the bone marrow. Naive B cells are those which have left the bone marrow, before they bind to the antigen for which they're specific (IgM+/IgD+).

terms.name: Abnormal transitional B cell proportion
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of transitional B cells
terms.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of the transitional B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27-CD24hiCD38hi or CD27-IgMhiCD38hi, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Decreased transitional B cell proportion
synonyms: Decreased proportion of transitional B cells
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of the transitional B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27-CD24hiCD38hi or CD27-IgMhiCD38hi, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Increased transitional B cell proportion
synonyms: Increased proportion of transitional B cells
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of the transitional B cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD27-CD24hiCD38hi or CD27-IgMhiCD38hi, measured as percentage of total B cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.

terms.name: Abnormal marginal zone B cell proportion
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of marginal zone B cells
terms.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of marginal zone B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.

terms.name: Decreased marginal zone B cell proportion
terms.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of marginal zone B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.

terms.name: Increased marginal zone B cell proportion
terms.definition: An elevation in the normal proportion of marginal zone B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.

terms.name: Abnormal class-switched memory B cell proportion
terms.name_zh: 类别转换记忆B细胞比例异常
synonyms: Abnormal proportion of class-switched memory B cells
terms.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM-/IgD-) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA.

terms.name: Increased class-switched memory B cell proportion
terms.name_zh: 类别转换记忆B细胞比例升高
terms.definition: An increase in the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA.

terms.name: Decreased class-switched memory B cell proportion
terms.name_zh: 类别转换记忆B细胞比例降低
synonyms: Decreased proportion of class-switched memory B cells
terms.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating thromboxane concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of thromboxane in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating leukotriene C4 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of leukotriene C4 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Spoken word recognition deficit
terms.definition: Reduced ability of lexical discrimination, which refers to the process of distinguishing a stimulus word from other phonologically similar words. Lexical discrimination can be defined as the process of correctly identifying words in the mental lexicon to match the phonological input of a stimulus.

terms.name: Choroid plexus carcinoma
terms.definition: Intraventricular papillary neoplasm derived from choroid plexus epithelium. Plexus tumors are most common in the lateral and fourth ventricles; while 80% of lateral ventricle tumors present in children, fourth ventricle tumors are evenly distributed in all age groups. Clinically, choroid plexus tumors tend to cause hydrocephalus and increased intracranial pressure. Histologically, choroid plexus papillomas correspond to WHO grade I, choroid plexus carcinomas to WHO grade III.

terms.name: Endolymphatic sac tumor
synonyms: Low-grade adenocarcinoma of endolymphatic sac origin
terms.definition: A low-grade papillary epithelial neoplasm (adenocarcinoma) with a slow growth pattern. The endolymphatic duct emerges from the posterior wall of the saccule (of the inner ear) and ends in a blind pouch, the endolymphatic sac. Endolymphatic sac tumors (ELSTs) are known under different names in the literature (Heffner tumor, aggressive papillary middle ear tumor, and low-grade adenocarcinoma of endolymphatic sac origin).

terms.name: Fallopian tube carcinoma
terms.definition: Carcinoma that originates in the Fallopian tube. It may be located in the wall or within the lumen as a growth attached to the wall by a stalk.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet granule secretion
terms.definition: Platelets are replete with secretory granules, which are critical to normal platelet function. Among the three types of platelet secretory granules - alpha-granules, dense granules, and lysosomes - the alpha-granule is the most abundant. Granule contents must be released from their intracellular repository in order to achieve their physiologic function, and this term refers to a functional defect in granule secretion.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet dense granule secretion
terms.name_zh: 血小板致密颗粒分泌异常
terms.definition: Abnormal release of dense granules from platelets.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet ATP dense granule secretion
terms.name_zh: 血小板致密颗粒ATP分泌异常
terms.definition: Abnormal secretion of the platelet dense-granule content adenosine triphosphate (ATP).

terms.name: Abnormal platelet alpha granule secretion
terms.definition: Abnormal release of alpha granule contents from platelets.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet lysosome secretion
terms.name_zh: 血小板溶酶体分泌异常
terms.definition: Abnormal release of lysosome contents from platelets.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet dense granule ATP/ADP ratio
terms.name_zh: 血小板致密颗粒ATP/ADP比值异常
terms.definition: Deviation from normal of the ratio of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) to adenosine diphosphate (ADP) within platelets.

terms.name: Abnormal platelet aggregation
terms.definition: An abnormality in the rate and degree to which platelets aggregate after the addition of an agonist that stimulates platelet clumping. Platelet aggregation is measured using aggregometer to measure the optical density of platelet-rich plasma, whereby platelet aggregation causes the plasma to become more transparent.

terms.name: Spontaneous platelet aggregation
terms.definition: Clumping together of platelets in the blood in a platelet aggregation test without addition of agents normally used to induce aggregation.

terms.name: Glucagonoma
terms.definition: An endocrine tumor of the pancreas that secretes excessive amounts of glucagon.

terms.name: Pancreatic endocrine tumor
terms.definition: A neuroendocrine tumor originating in a hormone-producing cell (islet cell) of the pancreas.

terms.name: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
terms.definition: A type of cancer that originates in the peritoneum. It is to be distinguished from metastatic cancer of the peritoneum. Peritoneal cancer can occur anywhere in the abdominal space, and affects the surface of organs contained inside the peritoneum.

terms.name: Pineocytoma
terms.definition: A type of pineal parenchymal cell neoplasm that is a mature well-differentiated tumor (WHO grade I).

terms.name: Pineoblastoma
terms.definition: Pineoblastoma is a rare primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising in the pineal gland. Pineoblastomas are classified as a WHO grade IV tumor and comprise one-fourth to one-half of pineal parenchymal tumors. Pineoblastoma is a highly cellular tumor originating in the pineal gland and containing small, poorly differentiated cells.

terms.name: Renal transitional cell carcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant tumor that arises from the transitional (urothelial) epithelial cells lining the urinary tract from the renal calyces to the ureteral orifice.

terms.name: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
terms.definition: A carcinoma that arises in a sebaseous gland (an exocrine gland of the skin that secretes sebum, a waxy substance)

terms.name: Jejunal adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the jejunum.

terms.name: Ileal adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the ileum.

terms.name: Squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue
terms.definition: A carcinoma derived from a squamous epithelial cell of the tongue.

terms.name: Verrucous cell carcinoma of the tongue
terms.definition: A low-grade variant of squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue with a warty (verrucous) appearance.

terms.name: Sarcomatoid carcinoma of the tongue
synonyms: Spindle cell carcinoma of the tongue
terms.definition: Sarcomatoid (spindle cell) carcinomas of the tongue is a variant of squamous carcinoma of tongue that is monoclonal, having evolved from a conventional squamous carcinoma with dedifferentiation associated with sarcomatoid transformation.

terms.name: Vulvar neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the female external genital tract (vulva).

terms.name: Squamous cell carcinoma of the vulva
terms.definition: A cancer that originates in the squamous cells that line the surface of the vulva.

terms.name: Vulvar melanoma
terms.definition: A type of vulvar cancer that originates from melanocytes of the vulva.

terms.name: Bartholin gland carcinoma
terms.definition: A cancer arising in a cell of the Bartholin gland, a racemose gland located slightly posterior to the opening of the vagina.

terms.name: Vulvar adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: An adenocarcinoma arising in the vulva.

terms.name: Epididymal neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the epididymis, an duct that transports spermatozoa from the testis to the vas deferens.

terms.name: Splenic cyst
terms.definition: A closed sac located in the spleen.

terms.name: Epididymal cyst
terms.definition: A smooth, extratesticular, spherical cyst in the head of the epididymis.

terms.name: Calcified ovarian cyst
terms.definition: A cyst of the ovary that exhibits deposition of calcium salts.

terms.name: Ossifying fibroma
terms.definition: A benign central bone tumor composed of fibrous connective tissue within which bone is formed.

terms.name: Ossifying fibroma of the jaw
terms.definition: A benign central bone tumor of the jaw composed of fibrous connective tissue within which bone is formed.

terms.name: Cutaneous myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma originating in the skin.

terms.name: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
terms.name_zh: 幼年型鼻咽血管纤维瘤
terms.definition: A benign but highly vascular nasopharyngeal neoplasm. The tumor originates from the sphenopalatine foramen and involves both the pterygopalatine fossa and the posterior nasal cavity.

terms.name: Neuroma
terms.definition: A tumor made up of nerve cells and nerve fibers.

terms.name: Osteochondroma
terms.definition: A cartilage capped bony outgrowth of a long bone. Osteochondroma arises on the external surface of bone containing a marrow cavity that is continuous with that of the underlying bone.

terms.name: Chondroblastoma
terms.definition: A usually benign tumor composed of cells which arise from chondroblasts or their precursors and which tend to differentiate into cartilage cells.

terms.name: Osteoid osteoma
terms.definition: A bening tumor of bone composed of a central zone named nidus which is an atypical bone completely enclosed within a well vascularized stroma and a peripheral sclerotic reaction zone.

terms.name: Pilomatrixoma
terms.definition: Pilomatricoma is an asymptomatic slowly growing benign cutaneous tumor, differentiating towards the hair matrix of the hair follicle. It is covered by normal or hyperemic skin, and usually varies in size from 0.5 to 3 cm.

terms.name: Fibrofolliculoma
terms.definition: Fibrofolliculoma is a clinically asymptomatic, 2-4 mm, skin-colored, dome-shaped smooth papule. It usually arises in the form of multiple lesions in adults in different areas such as the scalp, forehead, face, and neck. According to histology, the lesion is a fibrotic hamartoma characterized by infundibular epithelial proliferation and perifollicular fibrous proliferation.

terms.name: Anal canal squamous cell carcinoma
terms.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the anal canal.

terms.name: Anal canal adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: An adenoma carcinoma that originates in the anal canal.

terms.name: Anal margin neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor of the anal margin.

terms.name: Anal margin Paget's disease
terms.definition: An intraepithelial adenocarcinoma originating in the anal margin and characterized by presence of typical Paget's cells, appearing as large rounded vacuolated cells.

terms.name: Anal margin squamous cell carcinoma
terms.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the skin of the anal margin.

terms.name: Anal margin basal cell carcinoma
terms.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that originates in the anal margin.

terms.name: Anal margin melanoma
terms.definition: A melanoma that originates in the anal margin.

terms.name: Pulmonary carcinoid tumor
terms.definition: A malignant neuroendocrine tumor of the lung. According to histopathologic criteria (WHO 2004), carcinoids are divided into four groups i.e. typical and atypical carcinoids, large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma and small cell lung carcinoma.

terms.name: Merkel cell skin cancer
synonyms: Merkel cell cancer of the skin
Primary small cell carcinoma of the skin
Primary undifferentiated carcinoma of the skin
terms.definition: A malignant cutaneous tumor of the elderly that is characterized by an aggressive course with regional nodal involvement, distant metastases and a high rate of recurrence. Most patients present with rapidly growing, painless, firm, non-tender, dome-shaped red, occasionally ulcerated skin nodules, which have a red or bluish color, measuring up to several centimeters, on predominantly sun-exposed areas of the body. The overlying skin is smooth and shiny, sometimes exhibiting ulcerative, acneiform or telangiectatic features.

terms.name: Soft tissue sarcoma
terms.definition: A type of sarcoma (A connective tissue neoplasm formed by proliferation of mesodermal cells) that develops from soft tissues like fat, muscle, nerves, fibrous tissues, blood vessels, or deep skin tissues.

terms.name: Therapeutic abortion
terms.definition: Delivery by means of therapeutic termination of pregnancy. Therapeutic abortion may be done to end a pregnancy if the mother's life is in danger or if the baby has abnormalities involving the major organ systems and is not expected to survive after birth or by choice.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the autonomic nervous system
terms.definition: A tumor that arises from an element of the autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Mesenteric cyst
terms.definition: A closed fluid filled sac originating from the mesentary.

terms.name: Chylolymphatic mesenteric cyst
terms.definition: A type of mesenteric cyst that is lined with a thin endothelium or mesothelium and filled with chylous and lymphatic fluid.

terms.name: Abnormal electrooculogram
terms.definition: The clinical electro-oculogram (EOG) is an electrophysiological test of function of the outer retina and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) in which changes in electrical potential across the RPE are recorded during successive periods of dark and light adaptation.

terms.name: Abnormality of pattern visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 图形视觉诱发电位异常

terms.name: Abnormality of pattern onset/offset visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 图形 onset/offset 视觉诱发电位异常

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of pattern onset/offset visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 图形开/关视觉诱发电位振幅异常
synonyms: Abnormal amplitude of pattern onset/offset VEP

terms.name: Abnormal timing of pattern onset/offset visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 图形 onset/offset 视觉诱发电位时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 图形翻转视觉诱发电位时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of flash visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 闪光视觉诱发电位时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of flash visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 闪光视觉诱发电位振幅异常

terms.name: Asymmetrical distribution of flash visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 闪光视觉诱发电位分布不对称
synonyms: Crossed asymmetry of flash visual evoked potentials

terms.name: Asymmetrical distribution of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
terms.name_zh: 模式翻转视觉诱发电位分布不对称
synonyms: Crossed asymmetry of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials

terms.name: Undetectable light-adapted electroretinogram
terms.definition: No detectable response to the light-adapted 3.0 ERG (single-flash cone response). This type of ERG measures responses of the cone system; a-waves arise from cone photoreceptors and cone off-bipolar cells; the b-wave comes from On- and Off-cone bipolar cells.

terms.name: Abnormal full-field electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 全视野视网膜电图异常
terms.definition: An anomaly observed by full-field electroretinogram (ffERG). The ffERG measures the light-induced electrical activity of the retina at the corneal surface. Specifically, the ffERG records the global or total retinal electrical response to a full-field (Ganzfield) light stimulus. Isolation of the rod and cone components has important diagnostic value in differentiating between various retinal diseases. Modifying the properties of the light-stimulus (wavelength, strength, and flicker rate) as well as the adaptive state of the retina can separate the rod and cone functions of the ffERG.

terms.name: Abnormal pattern electroretinogram
terms.definition: An anomalous response to a pattern electroretinogram (PERG), a particular kind of ERG obtained in response to contrast modulation of patterned visual stimuli at constant mean luminance-typically contrast-reversing gratings or checkerboards-whose characteristics are fundamentally different from those of the traditional ERG in response to diffuse flashes of light.

terms.name: Abnormal dark-adapted electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应视网膜电图异常
terms.definition: An electroretinographic anomaly detected by dark-adapted full-field ERG. The dark adapted ERG targets rod-pathway function.

terms.name: Abnormal dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应明闪光视网膜电图异常

terms.name: Abnormal dark-adapted dim flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应弱闪光视网膜电图异常

terms.name: Abnormal light-adapted single flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应单次闪光视网膜电图异常

terms.name: Abnormal light-adapted flicker electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应闪烁光视网膜电图异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of dark-adapted dim flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应弱闪光视网膜电图时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of dark-adapted dim flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应弱闪光视网膜电图振幅异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应明闪光视网膜电图时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 暗适应明闪光视网膜电图振幅异常

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of light-adapted flicker electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应闪烁视网膜电图振幅异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of light-adapted flicker electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应闪烁视网膜电图时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of light-adapted single flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应单次闪光视网膜电图振幅异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of light-adapted single flash electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 明适应单次闪光视网膜电图时程异常

terms.name: Reduced amplitude of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram a-wave
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amplitude of the a-wave.

terms.name: Supernormal dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram b-wave
terms.definition: The b-wave amplitude exceeding the upper limit of normal under scotopic (dark-adapted) conditions with high-intensity stimulation.

terms.name: Abnormal amplitude of pattern electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 图形视网膜电图振幅异常

terms.name: Abnormal timing of pattern electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 图形视网膜电图时程异常

terms.name: Abnormal P50/N95 ratio of pattern electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 图形视网膜电图P50/N95比值异常

terms.name: Abnormal central response of multifocal electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 多焦视网膜电图中枢反应异常

terms.name: Abnormal paracentral response of multifocal electroretinogram
terms.name_zh: 多焦视网膜电图旁中心反应异常

terms.name: Exudative vitreoretinopathy
terms.name_zh: 渗出性玻璃体视网膜病变

terms.name: Choriocapillaris atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy of the capillary lamina of choroid.

terms.name: Abnormal foveal pigmentation
terms.definition: Increased or decreased pigmentation in the fovea.

terms.name: Abnormal macular vasculature morphology
terms.name_zh: 黄斑脉管系统形态异常
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the macular vasculature
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the blood vessels of the macula.

terms.name: Macular exudate
terms.definition: Yellow-white intraretinal deposits in the macula typically associated with damaged inner blood-retina barrier and exudation of serous fluid and lipids from the retinal microvasculature.

terms.name: Macular cotton wool spot
terms.definition: Fluffy white patch in the macula, representing localized areas of dense white swelling of the retinal nerve fiber layer.

terms.name: Macular thickening
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in retinal thickness in the macular area observed on fundoscopy or fundus imaging.

terms.name: Macular drusen
terms.definition: Drusen localted in the macula.

terms.name: Yellow/white macular lesion
terms.definition: A type of white and/or yellow lesion located anywhere within the macula. These lesions can be flat or raised and can vary in size from very small to bigger.

terms.name: Macular crystals
terms.definition: Crystalline deposits in the macula, located intra-retinally.

terms.name: Retinoschisis
terms.definition: Splitting of the neuroretinal layers of the retina.

terms.name: Macular telangiectasia
terms.definition: Localized irregular dilatation of small tortuous intraretinal blood vessels in the macular area.

terms.name: Clustered congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
terms.name_zh: 簇状先天性视网膜色素上皮肥厚
synonyms: Bear track congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
Grouped congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
terms.definition: Grouped, flat, well-demarcated pigmented lesions at the level of the pigment epithelium (that are said to resemble bear tracks). Less frequently, the lesions may be white ('polar bear tracks').

terms.name: Nummular pigmentation of the retina
terms.definition: Clumped pigmentary changes of nummular appearance (i.e., thought to resemble the shape of a coin or multiple coins stuck together) at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium.

terms.name: Yellow/white retinal lesion
terms.definition: An area anywhere within the retina showing pale yellow or white discoloration. Such lesions can be flat or raised and there size can range from very small to big.

terms.name: Retinal crystals
terms.definition: Crystalline deposits in the retina.

terms.name: Combined hamartoma of the retinal pigment epithelium and retina
terms.name_zh: 视网膜色素上皮及视网膜联合错构瘤

terms.name: Bradyopsia
terms.definition: Difficulty in seeing moving objects.

terms.name: Difficulty adjusting to changes in luminance
Difficulty adjusting from light to dark
Difficulty adjusting from dark to light
Moderately reduced visual acuity
terms.definition: Moderate reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 6/18 but at least 6/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 20/70 but at least 20/200. On the decimal visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 0.3 but at least 0.1.

terms.name: Mild constriction of peripheral visual field
terms.definition: A diminution of the peripheral visual field whereby at least 50 degrees of central field are preserved in all meridians.

terms.name: Moderate constriction of peripheral visual field
terms.definition: Peripheral visual field constriction with 20-49 degrees binocular visual field preserved.

terms.name: Severe constriction of peripheral visual field
terms.definition: Peripheral visual field constriction with 10-19 degrees central field preserved.

terms.name: Very severe constriction of peripheral visual field
synonyms: Very severe peripheral visual field loss
terms.definition: Peripheral visual field constriction with <10 degrees central field preserved.

terms.name: Ring scotoma
terms.definition: An annular field defect centered on fixation.

terms.name: Abnormal best corrected visual acuity test
terms.name_zh: 最佳矫正视力检查异常

terms.name: Visual acuity light perception with projection
Visual acuity light perception without projection
Abnormal Hardy-Rand-Rittler plate test
terms.name_zh: 哈迪-兰德-里特勒色板检查异常

terms.name: Abnormal visual field test
terms.definition: Abnormal result of a test designed to test an individual's central and peripheral vision by determining the ability of the individual to perceive objects at differing locations of the visual field.

terms.name: Abnormal Amsler grid test
terms.name_zh: 阿姆斯勒方格表试验异常

terms.name: Abnormal manual kinetic perimetry test
terms.name_zh: 手动动态视野检查异常

terms.name: Abnormal automated kinetic perimetry test
terms.name_zh: 自动动态视野检查异常

terms.name: Abnormal static automated perimetry test
terms.name_zh: 静态自动视野检查异常

terms.name: Abnormal Esterman grid perimetry test
terms.name_zh: 埃斯特曼网格视野检查异常
terms.definition: The Esterman grid test assays scores visual acuity. The grid consists of 100 units whose unequal size and distribution reflect the unequal functional value of different parts of the field-in effect a weighted or relative-value scale. Because each unit equals 1 percent, a simple count of units yields the functional score in percent.

terms.name: Abnormal fundus autofluorescence imaging
terms.name_zh: 眼底自发荧光成像异常
terms.definition: Fundus autofluorescence (FAF) is a non-invasive retinal imaging modality used in clinical practice to provide a density map of lipofuscin, the predominant ocular fluorophore, in the retinal pigment epithelium. Autofluorescent patterns result from the complex interaction of fluorophores such a lipofuscin, which release an autofluorescent signal, and elements such as melanin and rhodopsin, which absorb the excitation beam and attenuate autofluorescence. Other structures such as retinal vessels and the crystalline lens may also influence autofluorescence through blocking and interference.

terms.name: Abnormal optical coherence tomography
terms.name_zh: 光学相干断层扫描异常
terms.definition: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is an optical method for cross-sectional imaging with a resolution approaching that of histopathology and a depth of penetration of a few mm. In ophthalmology, OCT has become a standard of care for retinal imaging. This term groups abnormal findings that are considered OCT-specific.

terms.name: Abnormal fundus fluorescein angiography
terms.name_zh: 眼底荧光血管造影异常
