terms.definition: An abnormality observed by retinal fluorescein angiography, which involves the intravenous injection of fluorescein dye followed by fluorescent imaging of the fundus immediately after injection and for up to ten minutes thereafter. It can be used to study various retinal abnormalities including especially anomalies of the choroidal and retinal circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal indocyanine green angiography
terms.name_zh: 吲哚菁绿血管造影异常

terms.name: Abnormal OCT-measured macular thickness
terms.name_zh: 光学相干断层扫描测量黄斑厚度异常

terms.name: Increased OCT-measured macular thickness
terms.name_zh: 光学相干断层扫描测量黄斑厚度增加

terms.name: Photoreceptor layer loss on macular OCT
terms.definition: Loss of the outer nuclear layer (photoreceptor layer) as assessed by ocular coherence tomography.

terms.name: Photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular OCT
Retinal pigment epithelial loss on macular OCT
Abnormal retinal morphology on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示视网膜形态异常

terms.name: Abnormal foveal morphology on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中央凹形态异常

terms.name: Foveal photoreceptor layer loss on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中心凹感光细胞层缺失

terms.name: Foveal photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中心凹感光细胞外节缺失

terms.name: Foveal retinal pigment epithelial loss on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中心凹视网膜色素上皮层缺失

terms.name: Abnormal OCT-measured foveal thickness
terms.name_zh: 光学相干断层扫描测量黄斑中心凹厚度异常

terms.name: Increased OCT-measured foveal thickness
terms.name_zh: 光学相干断层扫描测量黄斑中心凹厚度增加

terms.name: Inner retinal layer loss on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示视网膜内层缺失

terms.name: Foveal inner retinal layer loss on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中央凹内层视网膜缺失

terms.name: Abnormal foveal pit on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中央凹凹陷异常

terms.name: Intraretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示视网膜内低反射间隙

terms.name: Subretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
Foveal intraretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中央凹视网膜内低反射间隙

terms.name: Foveal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中央凹低反射间隙

terms.name: Foveal subretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
terms.name_zh: 黄斑OCT示中心凹视网膜下低反射腔

terms.name: Irregular central macular autofluorescence
terms.name_zh: 黄斑中心自发荧光不规则

terms.name: Hyperautofluorescent macular lesion
terms.definition: Increased amount of autofluorescence in the macula as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.

terms.name: Hypoautofluorescent macular lesion
terms.definition: Decreased amount of autofluorescence in the macula as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.

terms.name: Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by normal autofluorescence
Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by abnormal autofluorescence
Occult macular dystrophy
terms.definition: Occult macular dystrophy is a, typically hereditary, abnormality of the macula associated with progressive foveal cone dysfunction and no apparent fundoscopic, full-field electroretinogram (ERG), or fluorescein angiogram abnormalities.

terms.name: Congenital stationary cone dysfunction
terms.name_zh: 先天性静止性视锥细胞功能障碍
terms.definition: Retinal phenotype characterized by cone photoreceptor dysfunction and preserved rod system. The abnormality is typically stationary or very slowly progressive and findings may include reduced central vision, color vision abnormalities, nystagmus and photophobia.

terms.name: Fundus albipunctatus
terms.definition: Widespread white lesions of uniform, small and round appearance.

terms.name: Central
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is located close to the median plane or midline of the body or of the referenced structure.

terms.name: Vitreous haze
terms.definition: Vitreous haze is the obscuration of fundus details by vitreous cells and protein exudation.

terms.name: Umbilical cord cyst
terms.definition: Any cystic lesion associated with the umbilical cord.

terms.name: Umbilical cord knot
terms.definition: An entwining of a segment of umbilical cord, usually without obstructing fetal circulation and commonly result from fetal slippage through a loop of the cord.

terms.name: Umbilical vein varix
terms.definition: Focal dilation of the umbilical vein.

terms.name: Umbilical cord hematoma
terms.definition: Bleeding from the vessels of the cord with extravasation of blood into the Wharton jelly surrounding the umbilical cord vessels.

terms.name: Marginal umbilical cord insertion
terms.definition: Insertion of the umbilical cord within 2 cm from the placental edge.

terms.name: Velamentous cord insertion
terms.definition: Insertion of the umbilical cord into the chorio-amniotic membranes of the placenta.

terms.name: Furcate cord insertion
terms.definition: Branching of the umbilical cord before its insertion into the placenta.

terms.name: Vitreous snowballs
terms.definition: Yellow-white inflammatory aggregates in the vitreous that are found in the midvitreous and inferior periphery.

terms.name: Vitreous inflammatory cells
terms.definition: The presence of inflammatory cells such as lymphocytes and macrophages in the vitreous.

terms.name: Optically empty vitreous
terms.definition: Vestigial vitreous gel occupying the immediate retrolental space and minimal to no discernible gel in the central vitreous cavity, giving the appearance of an empty vitreous cavity.

terms.name: Beevor's sign
terms.definition: Weakness of the inferior portion of the rectus abdominal muscle, which is ascertained clinically as follows. When a patient sits up or raises the head from a recumbent position, the umbilicus is displaced toward the head. This is the result of paralysis of the inferior portion of the rectus abdominal muscle, so that the upper fibers predominate pulling upwards the umbilicus.

terms.name: Rubral tremor
terms.definition: Rubral tremor is characterized by a slow coarse tremor at rest that is exacerbated by postural adjustments and by guided voluntary movements.

terms.name: Retinal neovascularization
terms.definition: In ischemic retinal disease, neovascularization (NV) involves the sprouting of new vessels from pre-existent vessels. Ischemia invariably leads to the upregulation of Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF) production. Most frequently the new vessels grow internal to the plane of the retina. However, intraretinal proliferation of new vessels can also occur.

terms.name: Peripheral retinal neovascularization
terms.definition: A type of retinal neovascularization that affects the periphery of the retina.

terms.name: Periorbital dermoid cyst
terms.definition: A cyst that is localized in the region of the orbit and exhibits an epithelial lining with a keratin-filled lumen. Hair follicles are one of the adnexal structures that are commonly found in walls of dermoid cysts.

terms.name: Abnormal ocular adnexa morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the adjacent structures (i.e., adnexa) of the eye, defined as the lacrimal apparatus, the extraocular muscles and the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows and the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Hamartoma of the orbital region
terms.definition: A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) which can originate from any tissue of the orbital region.

terms.name: Abnormal common tendinous ring morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the common tendinous ring
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the ring of fibrous tissue that surrounds the optic nerve at its entrance at the apex of the orbit. The common tendinous ring, also known as the annulus of Zinn or annular tendon, is the origin for five of the seven extraocular muscles.

terms.name: Asteroid hyalosis
terms.definition: The presence of small, white vitreous opacities consisting of calcium phosphate and complex, layered lipid deposits.

terms.name: Erosive vitreoretinopathy
terms.name_zh: 侵蚀性玻璃体视网膜病变
terms.definition: A form of vitreoretinopathy characterized by thinning (erosion) of the retinal pigment epithelium that permits increased visualization of the choroidal vessels.

terms.name: Antenatal onset
terms.definition: Onset prior to birth.

terms.name: Contracture of proximal interphalangeal joints of 2nd-5th fingers
terms.name_zh: 第2-5指近端指间关节挛缩
terms.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th fingers due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.

terms.name: Satyr ear
terms.definition: Sharp pointed superior portion of the ear, with variable overfolding of the helix.

terms.name: Mozart ear
terms.definition: A congenital auricular deformity, which is mainly characterized by a bulging appearance of the anterosuperior portion of the auricle, a convexly protruded cavum conchae, and a slit-like narrowing of the orifice of the external auditory meatus.

terms.name: Ash-leaf spot
terms.definition: A hypopigmented spot in the shape of a leaf from the mountain ash tree.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiovascular system morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the heart and blood vessels.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of myocardial trabeculae
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the right and left ventricles of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).

terms.name: Left ventricular noncompaction
terms.name_zh: 左心室心肌致密化不全
terms.definition: Left ventricular noncompaction (LVNC) is defined by 3 markers: prominent left ventricular (LV) trabeculae, deep intertrabecular recesses, and the thin compacted layer.

terms.name: Recurrent bacterial vaginosis
terms.definition: Repeated symptomatic episodes of inflammation of the vagina that can result from a spectrum of conditions that cause vaginal and sometimes vulvar symptoms, such as itching, burning, irritation, odor, and vaginal discharge.

terms.name: Abnormal adiponectin level
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue, and that plays a crucial role in the regulation of insulin sensitivity and glucose metabolism.

terms.name: Decreased adiponectin level
terms.definition: A reduced circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue.

terms.name: Increased adiponectin level
terms.definition: An elevated circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating glucagon concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环胰高血糖素浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased glucagon level
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased glucagon level
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Gingival cleft
terms.definition: A fissure in the gingiva (gums), i.e., the mucosal tissue that lies over the mandible and maxilla.

terms.name: Divergence nystagmus
terms.definition: A condition in which both eyes beat outward simultaneously.

terms.name: Brain neoplasm
terms.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from or metastasizes to the brain.

terms.name: Supratentorial neoplasm
terms.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that occurs within the intracranial cavity above the tentorium cerebelli.

terms.name: Ranula
terms.definition: A ranula is a mucocele that occurs in the floor of the mouth and usually involve the major salivary glands. Specifically, the ranula originates in the body of the sublingual gland, in the ducts of the sublingual gland, in the Wharton's duct of the submandibular gland or infrequently from the minor salivary glands at this location.

terms.name: Unilateral lung agenesis
terms.definition: Lack of development of one lung.

terms.name: Myeloschisis
terms.definition: The severe form of a neural tube defect where the open neural tube appears as a flattened, plate-like mass of nervous tissue with no overlying membrane.

terms.name: Myelocystocele
terms.definition: Myelocystocele is characterized by a large, ependyma-lined, cystic dilation of the caudal end of the central canal of the spinal cord; it projects dorsally through a lamina defect, with overlying varying amounts of lipomatous subcutaneous tissue. Myelocystoceles are associated with a tethered cord and meningocele, which communicates with the spinal subarachnoid space, but not with the central canal cyst.

terms.name: Lipomeningocele
terms.definition: A form of closed neural tube defect in which the spinal tissue lies within the spinal cord having a junction between the spinal cord and the lipoma. Intact skin covers the defect. Neurologic findings first appear during the second year of life.

terms.name: Hydrocolpos
terms.definition: Distention of the vagina caused by accumulation of fluid due to congenital vaginal obstruction.

terms.name: Uterine synechiae
terms.definition: Adhesions or scar tissue that form inside the cavity of the uterus.

terms.name: Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation
terms.definition: Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation is a choroidal type of arteriovenous malformation that develops between 6 and 11 weeks of gestation. It results from 1 or more arteriovenous fistulas shunting blood toward the prosencephalic vein of Markowski, the embryonic precursor of the vein of Galen. This abnormal shunt leads to progressive dilation of the vein and prevents its involution and subsequent development into the vein of Galen.

terms.name: Subchorionic thrombohematoma
terms.definition: A large maternal clot that separates the chorionic plate from the villous chorion.

terms.name: Bronchial atresia
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by focal obliteration of the proximal segment of a bronchus. The bronchial pattern is entirely normal distal to the site of stenosis.

terms.name: Acrania
terms.definition: Partial or complete absence of the flat bones of the cranial vault. The condition is frequently, though not always, associated with anencephaly.

terms.name: Meconium peritonitis
terms.definition: Peritonitis caused by intrauterine intestinal rupture and spillage of fetal meconium into the fetal peritoneal cavity. Intra-peritoneal meconium usually calcifies, sometimes within 24 hours. Ultrasound findings may include intraabdominal calcifications.

terms.name: Right atrial enlargement
terms.definition: Increase in size of the right atrium.

terms.name: Unguarded tricuspid valve
terms.definition: A form of agenesis of the tricuspid valve in which (although the normal orifice between the right atrium and right ventricle exists) there is no tricuspid valvular tissue.

terms.name: Subchorionic septal cyst
terms.definition: Cyst on the surface of the placenta consisting of amnion and chorion.

terms.name: Tetraphocomelia
terms.definition: Phocomelia involving all four extremities.

terms.name: Ectopic liver
terms.definition: Ectopic liver is a rare developmental anomaly in which liver tissue is situated outside the liver. Thus, ectopic liver refers to autonomous islands of normal liver parenchyma located outside the liver. The term ectopic liver is also used, to include liver appendices attached to the native liver by a thin stalk although being fully separated from the latter.

terms.name: Congenital megalourethra
terms.definition: Dilation and elongation of the penile urethra associated with absence or hypoplasia of the corpora spongiosa and cavernosa.

terms.name: Central nervous system cyst
synonyms: Cyst of the central nervous system
terms.definition: A fluid-filled sac (cyst) located within the central nervous system.

terms.name: Neurenteric cyst
terms.definition: The neurenteric cyst is a rare lesion composed of heterotopic endodermal tissue. During the third week of human embryogenesis, the neurenteric canal unites the yolk sac and the amniotic cavity as it traverses the primitive notochordal plate. Persistence of the normally transient neurenteric canal prevents appropriate separation of endoderm and notochord. This results in a variable degree of communication between neural and enteric epithelium.

terms.name: Spinal neurenteric cyst
terms.definition: A neurenteric cyst located in the spine.

terms.name: Intracranial neurenteric cyst
terms.definition: A neurenteric cyst located within the skull.

terms.name: Meromelia
terms.definition: Partial absence of a free limb (excluding girdle). It can refer to the proximal, middle or distal segment of the upper or lower limb. The deficiency may be transverse or longitudinal. Thus, meromelia is a lack of a part, but not all, of one or more limbs with the presence of a hand or foot.

terms.name: Frontoethmoidal meningocele
terms.definition: A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull at the junction of the frontal and ethmoidal bones.

terms.name: Parietal meningocele
terms.definition: A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull in the parietal region.

terms.name: Carcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant tumor arising from epithelial cells. Carcinomas that arise from glandular epithelium are called adenocarcinomas, those that arise from squamous epithelium are called squamous cell carcinomas, and those that arise from transitional epithelium are called transitional cell carcinomas (NCI Thesaurus).

terms.name: Dysplastic tricuspid valve
terms.definition: A congenital malformation of the tricuspid valve characterized by leaflet deformation.

terms.name: Vesicoallantoic abdominal wall defect
terms.definition: An abdominal wall defected related to a developmental anomaly of the allantois, which is an embryonic structure that develops as a diverticulum off the yolk sac at about 16 days post fertilization. During further development, the allantois becomes incorporated into the body of the embryo, connecting the ventral aspect of the urogenital sinus (which will develop into the upper pole of the urinary bladder) to the external portion of the umbilicus. Upon further development, the lumen of the allantois becomes obliterated and forms a thick fibrous cord called the urachus, which connects the apex of the bladder to the umbilicus. In adults, the urachus is known as the median umbilical ligament. Failure of the allantoic cavity to obliterate can result of one of four conditions: 1) congenital patent urachus (a completely open connection between bladder and umbilicus); 2) vesicourachal diverticulum (a diverticulum off the bladder but not communicating with the umbilicus); umbilical cyst and sinus (not communicating with the bladder); and 4) alternating urachal sinus. An abdominal wall defect can be associated with a urachal cyst.

terms.name: Ureterovesical junction obstruction
terms.definition: Blockage at the level of the bladder and the ureter caused by stenosis of the ureteral valves or failure of a narrow juxtavesical ureteral segment to dilate due to segmented fibrosis or localized absence of muscle.

terms.name: Sacrococcygeal teratoma
terms.definition: A teratoma arising in the sacro-coccygeal region.

terms.name: Altman type I sacrococcygeal teratoma
terms.name_zh: 奥尔特曼Ⅰ型骶尾部畸胎瘤
terms.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external and projects from the sacrococcygeal region and presents with distortion of the buttocks.

terms.name: Altman type II sacrococcygeal teratoma
terms.name_zh: 奥尔特曼Ⅱ型骶尾部畸胎瘤
terms.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external but has a large intrapelvic component.

terms.name: Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma
terms.name_zh: 奥尔特曼Ⅲ型骶尾部畸胎瘤
terms.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly intrapelvic with a small external, buttock mass.

terms.name: Anomalous muscle bundle of the right ventricle
terms.definition: An accessory (not normally present) muscle bundle in the right ventricle which obstructs the right ventricular outflow tract.

terms.name: Mediastinal teratoma
terms.definition: A teratoma located within the mediastinum (the cavity between the pleural sacs that contains the heart and all of the thoracic viscera except the lungs).

terms.name: Glial remnants posterior to lens
terms.name_zh: 晶状体后神经胶质残留
terms.definition: This anomaly, also known as Mittendorf dot, is a benign, nonprogressive recognizable lesion that does not cause visual impairment. However, it can resemble a pathological congenital or acquired cataract lesion which may enlarge and cause visual impairment. The dot appears as a black speck that ranges in size from the dot made by a sharp pencil point to the size of a poppy seed. It is usually well defined, although occasionally there may be irregular, fine lines radiating outward from the dot.

terms.name: Glial remnants anterior to the optic disc
terms.definition: Persistence of a posterior remnant of the hyaloid artery located at the optic disc.

terms.name: Hyaloid vascular remnant and retrolental mass
terms.name_zh: 玻璃体血管残留伴晶状体后肿块
terms.definition: A type of persistence of the hyaloid vascular system associated with a retrolental mass that may lead to fetal cataract.

terms.name: Dilatation of the ductus arteriosus
terms.definition: Ductus arteriosus aneurysm (DAA) is a saccular dilatation of the ductus arteriosus. DAA can be either congenital or acquired (e.g. as a complication of surgical closure of a patent ductus arteriosus). Although the majority of patients with congenital DAA are asymptomatic and have a benign course, severe complications, such as rupture or thromboembolism, can occur. DAA is likely to emerge in the third trimester from the aortic junction of the DA, extending towards its pulmonary end.

terms.name: Intraventricular hemorrhage
terms.definition: Bleeding into the ventricles of the brain.

terms.name: Preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
terms.definition: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a premature infant.

terms.name: Grade I preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
terms.definition: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that is restricted to subependymal region/germline matrix which is seen in the caudothalamic groove.

terms.name: Grade II preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
terms.definition: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that has extension into normal-sized ventricles and typically fills less than 50% of the volume of the ventricle.

terms.name: Grade III preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
terms.definition: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that has extension into dilated ventricles.

terms.name: Grade IV preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
terms.definition: Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that shows parenchymal extension.

terms.name: Dacryocystocele
terms.definition: A nasolacrimal duct obstruction presenting as a grey-blue cystic swelling just below the medial canthus. Believed to be a result of concomitant upper obstruction of the Rosenmuller valve and lower obstruction of the Hasner valve.

terms.name: Intrauterine fetal demise of one twin after midgestation
terms.name_zh: 中孕后双胎之一宫内死亡
synonyms: Intrauterine foetal demise of one twin after midgestation
terms.definition: Loss of one twin occurring after midgestation (17 weeks gestation).

terms.name: Allantoic cyst
terms.definition: A swelling formed at the base of umbilicus associated with a patent urachus which results from an allantoic remnant. The urachus is a fibrous remnant of the allantois which communicates from the apex of the urinary bladder to the umbilicus. Failed obliteration of the urachus can lead to various abnormalities: urachal cyst, urachal diverticulum, sinus or patent urachus - the most common type. Allantoic cysts in infants with patent urachus can be formed due to the drainage of urine into the umbilical cord, or in uncommon situations, after leakage of hypo-osmotic urine into the Wharton's jelly.

terms.name: Craniofacial teratoma
terms.definition: A teratoma located in the craniofacial region.

terms.name: Erythrodontia
terms.definition: Reddish, brown opalescent discoloration of teeth in normal light.

terms.name: Tooth abscess
terms.definition: A pocket of pus located within a region of a tooth.

terms.name: Periapical tooth abscess
terms.definition: A tooth abscess that occurs at the tip of the root (apex) of a tooth.

terms.name: Adipocyte hypertrophy
terms.definition: An increase in mean adipocyte cell size. This feature can be measured by determining the average cell diameter of adipocytes microscopically using abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue obtained by biopsy.

terms.name: Renal fibrosis
terms.definition: Renal fibrosis is the consequence of an excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix that occurs in virtually every type of chronic kidney disease.

terms.name: Mesangiolysis
terms.definition: Partial or complete dissolution of the mesangial matrix, identified by reduced staining on a periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) or silver stain.

terms.name: Amniotic Sheet
terms.definition: A sheet like projection that can result from uterine synechiae that has been encompassed by the expanding chorion and amnion.

terms.name: Ochronosis
terms.definition: Brown or blue-gray discoloration of the skin that can present on the axillary and inguinal areas, face, palms or soles. In addition, blue-black discoloration can be apparent on skin overlying cartilage in which the pigment is deposited, such as the ears. This is a characteristic manifestation of alkaptonuria, which is an autosomal recessively inherited deficiency of homogentisic acid oxidase that results in accumulation of homogentisic acid in collagenous structures. The sclerae are also typically involved.

terms.name: Sleep terror
terms.definition: Autonomic arousal, screaming, sweating, crying, outbursts during sleep, usually no recollection at the individual level; typically observed by others.

terms.name: Ear pain
terms.definition: Pain in the ear can be a consequence of otologic disease (primary or otogenic otalgia), or can arise from pathologic processes and structures other than the ear (secondary or referred otalgia).

terms.name: Epignathus
terms.definition: Epignathus is a teratoma originating from the upper jaw, usually connected with the sphenoid bone or hard palate.

terms.name: Exencephaly
terms.definition: A malformation of the neural tube with a large amount of protruding brain tissue and absence of calvarium.

terms.name: Craniorachischisis
terms.definition: A neural tube defect in which both the brain and spinal cord remain open to varying degrees.

terms.name: Mallet finger
terms.definition: Mallet finger refers to a condition in which the end joint of a finger bends but will not straighten by itself. In this situation, the joint can be pushed straight but will not hold that position on its own.

terms.name: Proximal femoral focal deficiency
terms.definition: Proximal femoral focal deficiency is a deformity manifested by hypoplasia of a variable portion of the femur with shortening of the entire limb.

terms.name: Internuclear ophthalmoplegia
terms.definition: An abnormality of conjugate lateral gaze in which the affected eye shows impairment of adduction. The pathognomonic clinical sign of internuclear ophthalmoplegia is an impaired adduction while testing horizontal saccades on the side of the lesion in the ipsilateral medial longitudinal fascicule.

terms.name: Mitochondrial swelling
terms.definition: The mitochondrial matrix refers to the substance occupying the space enclosed by the inner membrane of a mitochondrion, which contains enzymes, DNA, granules, and inclusions of protein crystals, glycogen, and lipid. Mitochondrial swelling refers to an increase in size of the mitochondrial matrix. This phenomenon is thought to be related to a permeabilized inner membrane that originates a large swelling in the mitochondrial matrix. Mitochondrial swelling may distend the outer membrane until it ruptures.

terms.name: Modic type vertebral endplate changes
terms.definition: An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate according to a widely used classification published by Dr. Michael Modic.

terms.name: Modic type I vertebral endplate changes
terms.definition: An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a low signal on T1-weighted sequences and high signal on T2-weighted sequences. Modic type I changes are thought to represent bone marrow edema and inflammation.

terms.name: Modic type II vertebral endplate changes
terms.definition: An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a high signal on T1-weighted sequences and high- or isointense signal on T2 sequences. Modic type II signals are thought to indicate fatty replacement in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Modic type III vertebral endplate changes
terms.definition: An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a low signal on T1 and T2-weighted sequences. Modic type III signals are thought to correspond to subchondral sclerosis seen on plain radiographs.

terms.name: Ethmocephaly
terms.definition: Ethmocephaly is the rarest form of holoprosencephaly, which occurs due to an incomplete cleavage of the forebrain. Clinically, the disease presents with a proboscis, hypotelorism, microphthalmos and malformed ears.

terms.name: Abnormality of the protein C anticoagulant pathway
terms.definition: An anomaly of the protein C anticoagulant pathway, which serves as a major system for controlling thrombosis, limiting inflammatory responses, and potentially decreasing endothelial cell apoptosis in response to inflammatory cytokines and ischemia. A natural anticoagulant system denoted the protein C pathway exerts its anticoagulant effect by regulating the activity of FVIIIa and FVa. The vitamin K-dependent protein C is the key component of the pathway. Activated protein C (APC) cleaves and inhibits coagulation cofactors FVIIIa and FVa, which result in downregulation of the activity of the coagulation system. The endothelial protein C receptor stimulates the T-TM-mediated activation of protein C on the endothelial cell surface. The two cofactors, protein S and the intact form of FV, enhance the anticoagulant activity of APC.

terms.name: Increased circulating free fatty acid level
terms.name_zh: 血循环游离脂肪酸水平升高
terms.definition: A higher than normal levels of the fatty acids which can occur in plasma as a result of lipolysis in adipose tissue or when plasma triacyglycerols are taken into tissues.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 6 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白介素6浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of interleukin-6 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Anomic aphasia
terms.definition: An inability to name people and objects that are correctly perceived. The individual is able to describe the object in question, but cannot provide the name.

terms.name: Mediastinal cystic lymphangioma
terms.definition: A lymphangioma (congenital malformation consisting of focal proliferations of well-differentiated lymphatic tissue in multi cystic or sponge like structures) located within the mediastinum, i.e., the central compartment of the thoracic cavity that is surrounded by loose connective tissue. Mediastinal lymphangioma is a slow growing mass with benign features, and accounts for 1% of all mediastinal tumors.

terms.name: Photopsia
terms.definition: Perceived flashes of light.

terms.name: Cerumen abnormality
terms.definition: Any anomaly of the cerumen (ear wax), the yellowish waxy substance secreted in the ear canal.

terms.name: Impacted cerumen
terms.definition: Blockage of the external auditory canal by a buildup of earwax.

terms.name: Excessive cerumen
terms.definition: An increased quantity of earwax.

terms.name: Abnormal cerumen color
terms.definition: An anomalous earwax color. Earwax (cerumen) is usually light to dark brown or orange in color.

terms.name: Abnormal jaw morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the jaw, the bony structure of the mouth that consists of the mandible and the maxilla.

terms.name: Jaw neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor originating in the jaw (mandible or maxilla).

terms.name: Jaw swelling
terms.definition: Abnormal enlargement in the upper jaw (maxilla) or in the lower jaw (mandible).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating C-peptide concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of C-peptide in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating C-peptide concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of C-peptide in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C-peptide concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of C-peptide in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced volume of central subdivision of bed nucleus of stria terminalis
terms.definition: A diminished volume of the central part of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis.

terms.name: Abnormality of the bed nucleus of stria terminalis
terms.definition: The stria terminalis is a slender, compact fiber bundle that connects the amygdala (amygdaloid body) with the hypothalamus and other basal forebrain regions. The bed nucleus of the stria terminalis is a limbic forebrain structure that receives heavy projections from, among other areas, the basolateral amygdala, and projects in turn to hypothalamic and brainstem target areas that mediate many of the autonomic and behavioral responses to aversive or threatening stimuli. This term refers to an anomaly of the bed nucleus.

terms.name: Scaphocephaly
terms.definition: Scaphocephaly is a subtype of dolichocephaly where the anterior and posterior aspects of the cranial vault are pointed (boat-shaped). Scaphocephaly is caused by a precocious fusion of sagittal suture without other associated synostosis.

terms.name: Abnormal visual accommodation
terms.definition: An anomaly in the process of visual accommodation, which is the process of adjustment of the eye to enable sharp vision of objects at different distances. Accommodation is mediated by contraction of the ciliary muscles, which alter the convexity of the lens and, consequently, its refractive power.

terms.name: Reduced visual accommodation
terms.definition: A decreased ability of the eye to adjust and thereby enable sharp vision of objects at different distances.

terms.name: Lower eyelid retraction
terms.definition: Inferior malposition of the lower eyelid margin without eyelid eversion.

terms.name: Platonychia
terms.definition: Abnormal flat nail.

terms.name: Trachyonychia
terms.definition: Excessive longitudinal ridging that gives the surface of the nail plate a rough appearance. It results from multiple foci of defective keratinization of the proximal nail matrix.

terms.name: Absent lunula
terms.definition: Lack of the lunula at the base of a nail. The lunula is the crescent-shaped whitish area of the bed of a fingernail or toenail.

terms.name: Fast-growing nails
terms.definition: Nails whose growth is quicker than normal.

terms.name: Abnormal nail growth
terms.definition: Nail whose growth pattern or speed deviates from normal.

terms.name: Ragged cuticle
terms.definition: The cuticle (properly known as the eponychium, or the medial nail fold or the proximal nail fold), is the thickened layer of skin surrounding fingernails and toenails. Its function is to protect the area between the nail and epidermis from exposure to bacteria. This term refers to the presence of and irregular edge or outline of the cuticle.

terms.name: Abnormal tongue morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the tongue.

terms.name: Abnormal tongue physiology
terms.definition: Any functional anomaly of the tongue.

terms.name: Tongue pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the tongue.

terms.name: Enlarged tonsils
terms.definition: Increase in size of the tonsils, small collections of lymphoid tissue facing into the aerodigestive tract on either side of the back part of the throat.

terms.name: Absent tonsils
terms.definition: Lack of observable tonsillar tissue.

terms.name: Orange discolored tonsils
terms.definition: A phenomenon of orange colored oral tonsils. This feature is characteristic of Tangier disease and illustrated will by Figure 1 of PMID:19470903.

terms.name: Lipoma of the tongue
terms.definition: A lipoma localized to the tongue. May present as a nontender, soft, spherical mass of the tongue.

terms.name: Gingival recession
terms.definition: The loss of gum tissue. The result is that gum tissue is recessed and its position on the tooth is lowered, exposing the roots of the teeth.

terms.name: Beaked nails
terms.definition: Severe nail curvature, causing the tip of the nail to point downwards with respect to the axis of the finger. Beaked nails are caused by resorption of the distal digit.

terms.name: Central nail canal
terms.definition: The presence of a depressed line (canal) in the center of the nail.

terms.name: Ski jump nail
terms.definition: Nails that slope upward at the free edge.

terms.name: Hooded eyelid
terms.definition: Eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open.

terms.name: Hooded lower eyelid
terms.definition: Lower eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open.

terms.name: Hooded upper eyelid
terms.definition: Upper eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open.

terms.name: Scleral thickening
terms.definition: Increased dimension of the sclera in the anterior-posterior axis.

terms.name: Mizuo phenomenon
terms.definition: Change in the color of the fundus from red in the dark-adapted state to golden immediately or shortly after the onset of the light. The color of the fundus reflex in the light adapted state has also been described as golden-yellow, gray-white, and yellow-white. This reflex can appear either homogeneous or in streaks in the fundus. The retinal vessels appear to be protruding in contrast to the radiant background. Dark adaptation leads to disappearance of the unusual fundus coloration [Digital Journal of Ophthalmology 2008; Volume 14, Number 14].

terms.name: Absent foveal reflex
terms.definition: Absent reflectivity of the fovea, which normally is a bright pinpoint of light that is observed to move sideways or up and down in response to movement of the opthalmoscope.

terms.name: Eyelid fasciculation
terms.definition: Tiny, repetitive muscle contractions in the eyelids, causing the appearance of twitching.

terms.name: Wheezing
terms.definition: A high-pitched whistling sound associated with labored breathing.

terms.name: Abnormal breath sound
terms.definition: An anomalous (adventitious) sound produced by the breathing process.

terms.name: Crackles
terms.definition: Crackles are discontinuous, explosive, and nonmusical adventitious lung sounds normally heard in inspiration and sometimes during expiration. Crackles are usually classified as fine and coarse crackles based on their duration, loudness, pitch, timing in the respiratory cycle, and relationship to coughing and changing body position.

terms.name: Rhonchi
terms.definition: Abnormal breath sounds characterized by low-pitched, snoring or rattle-like sounds.

terms.name: Vitreous strands
terms.definition: Fiber- or rope-like opacities located within the vitreous humor.

terms.name: Neck pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the neck.

terms.name: Shoulder pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the shoulder.

terms.name: Elbow pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the elbow.

terms.name: Wrist pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the wrist.

terms.name: Finger pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the finger.

terms.name: Hip pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the hip.

terms.name: Knee pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the knee.

terms.name: Ankle pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the ankle.

terms.name: Toe pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the toe.

terms.name: Choking episodes
terms.definition: Incidents in which a piece of food or other objects get stuck in the upper airway and provoke coughing, gagging, inability to talk, and difficulty breathing.

terms.name: Cardiac amyloidosis
terms.definition: Extracellular deposition in cardiac tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding.

terms.name: Undetectable pattern electroretinogram
terms.definition: Absent response to a pattern electroretinogram (PERG).

terms.name: Heliotrope rash of eyelid
terms.definition: Heliotrope rash is a violaceous discoloration of the eyelids associated with periorbital edema.

terms.name: Abnormality of venous physiology
terms.definition: An anomaly of venous function.

terms.name: Abnormal jugular venous pressure
terms.definition: An anomaly of the jugular venous pressure. The internal jugular veins, being continuous with the superior vena cava, provide a visible measure of the degree to which the systemic venous reservoir is filled. The vertical height above the right atrium to which they are distended and above which they are in a collapsed state provides an imperfect reflection of the right atrial pressure.

terms.name: Elevated jugular venous pressure
terms.definition: Increased jugular venous pressure.

terms.name: Hepatojugular reflux
terms.definition: The examiner applies firm but persistent pressure over the liver for 10 seconds while observing the mean jugular venous pressure. Normally there is either no rise or only a transient (i.e., 2 to 3 sec) rise in mean jugular venous pressure. A sustained increase in the mean venous pressure until abdominal compression is released is abnormal and indicates impaired right heart function. This abnormal response is called hepatojugular reflux.

terms.name: Abnormal pulse pressure
terms.definition: An anomaly of the pulse pressure, which is defined as the systolic pressured minus the diastolic pressure.

terms.name: Low pulse pressure
terms.definition: Reduced amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure).

terms.name: High pulse pressure
terms.definition: Increased amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure).

terms.name: Heterotaxy
terms.definition: An abnormality in which the internal thoraco-abdominal organs demonstrate abnormal arrangement across the left-right axis of the body.

terms.name: Scleral staphyloma
terms.definition: A staphyloma is a localized defect in the eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure.

terms.name: Anterior staphyloma
terms.definition: A localized defect in the anterior eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure.

terms.name: Posterior staphyloma
terms.definition: A localized defect in the posterior eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure.

terms.name: Eye movement-induced pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eye that is worse in certain directions of gaze and during prolonged gaze holding.

terms.name: Addictive behavior
terms.definition: When an activity, substance, object, or behavior becomes a major focus of a person's life, excluding other activities, or has begun to harm the individual or others physically, mentally, or socially, it can be considered addictive behavior. A person can become addicted or compulsively engaged with anything.

terms.name: Anti-topoisomerase I antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗拓扑异构酶I抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against topoisomerase I.

terms.name: Abnormal CSF amyloid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液淀粉样蛋白浓度异常
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Decreased CSF amyloid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液淀粉样蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: Reduced concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Elevated CSF amyloid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液淀粉样蛋白浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Nasal flaring
terms.definition: Widening of the nostrils upon inhalation as a manifestation of respiratory distress.

terms.name: Intercostal retractions
terms.definition: A pulling inward of the soft tissues between the ribs upon inhalation. This is a sign of increased use of the chest muscles for breathing and is a manifestation of respiratory distress.

terms.name: Large elbow
terms.definition: Abnormal increased size of the elbow joint.

terms.name: Large knee
terms.definition: Abnormally increased size of the knee joint.

terms.name: Vertical orbital dystopia
terms.definition: The orbits do not lie on the same horizontal plane, that is, one eye is lower than the other.

terms.name: Monorchism
terms.definition: Having only one testis in the scrotum.

terms.name: Anorchism
terms.definition: An abnormality of XY sexual development characterized by the absence of both testes at birth.

terms.name: Abnormality of spinal facet joint
terms.definition: An anomaly of the small joints located between and behind adjacent vertebrae.

terms.name: Facet joint arthrosis
terms.definition: Osteoarthritis of facet joints in the spine. Degeneration of cartilage in the facet joints results in bone rubbing on bone and reactive new bone formation visible on X-ray.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac ventricular function
terms.definition: An abnormality of the cardiac ventricular function.

terms.name: Anti-centromere antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the centromeres or centromere components.

terms.name: Oxygen desaturation on exertion
terms.definition: Oxygen saturation less than 95% on exertion or arterial partial pressure of oxygen falling by more than 1kPa.

terms.name: Abnormality of pulmonary circulation
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of that portion of the cardiosvascular system that carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs and returns oxygenated blood back to the heart.

terms.name: Increased pulmonary capillary wedge pressure
terms.definition: Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure (PCWP) above 15mmHg.

terms.name: Reduced FEV1/FVC ratio
synonyms: Obstructive deficit on pulmonary function test
Obstructive deficit on pulmonary function testing
terms.definition: Abnormally low FEV1/FVC (FEV1 - forced expiratory volume in 1 second; FVC forced vital capacity).

terms.name: Abnormality on pulmonary function testing
terms.definition: Any anomaly measure by pulmonary function testing, which includes spirometry, measures of diffusing capacity, and plethysmography.

terms.name: Interlobular septal thickening
terms.definition: Presence of thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a CT scan.

terms.name: Shoulder impingement
terms.definition: Trapping and compression of the rotator cuff tendons during shoulder movements.

terms.name: Coronary artery aneurysm
terms.definition: Enlargement of the diameter (cross-section) of a coronary artery as defined by a focal dilation of a segment at least 1.5 times larger than the reference vessel.

terms.name: Femoroacetabular impingement
terms.definition: Femoroacetabular impingement (FAI) results from one or more bony abnormalities that lead to abnormal contact between the acetabulum and the femoral head or neck. The femoral abnormality is proposed to cause compression and shear stresses in the region between the labrum and cartilage, anterosuperiorly. These stresses cause a separation between the labrum and cartilage as the labrum is pushed outwards and the cartilage is pushed centrally. This eventually leads to articular degeneration and eventually global hip osteoarthritis.

terms.name: Gastrojejunal tube feeding in infancy
terms.definition: Feeding problem necessitating gastrojejunal tube feeding.

terms.name: Recurrent parasitic infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to parasitic infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of parasitic infection.

terms.name: Abnormal T cell apoptosis
terms.definition: Abnormal apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories.

terms.name: Increased T cell apoptosis
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories.

terms.name: C3 nephritic factor positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against C3 convertase (C3bBb).

terms.name: Congenital shortened small intestine
terms.definition: Substantially shortened length of the small intestine as a result of a developmental defect.

terms.name: Hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.definition: A brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter.

terms.name: Periventricular white matter hyperintensities
terms.definition: Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the cerebral ventricles.

terms.name: Deep cerebral white matter hyperintensities
terms.definition: Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from locations distant from the ventricular system.

terms.name: Abnormal response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator
terms.name_zh: 短效肺血管扩张剂反应异常
terms.definition: Pulmonary vasodilator testing is performed during right-heart catheterization and involves a short-acting vasoactive agent such as adenosine, epoprostenol, or inhaled nitric oxide. The current definition of a normal (positive) response is a drop in mean pulmonary artery pressure of at least 10 mm Hg (or 20 percent) to below 40 mm Hg.

terms.name: Insufficient response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator
terms.name_zh: 短效肺血管扩张剂反应不足
terms.definition: No fall in mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) falls by at least 10 mmHg to an absolute value less than 40 mmHg without a degradation in cardiac output (CO) in response to a short-acting vasoactive agent such as adenosine, epoprostenol, or inhaled nitric oxide.

terms.name: Abnormal gastrointestinal motility
terms.definition: An anomaly of the muscular contractions that propel food though the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Abnormal gastrointestinal transit time
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal amount of time required for food to pass through the intestines.

terms.name: Decreased intestinal transit time
terms.definition: A reduction in the length of time required for food to pass through the intestines.

terms.name: Pruritis on abdomen
terms.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the abdomen.

terms.name: Pruritis on hand
terms.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the hand.

terms.name: Pruritus on foot
terms.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the foot.

terms.name: Pruritis on breast
terms.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the breast.

terms.name: Palmomental reflex
terms.definition: A type of primitive reflex characterized by an involuntary contraction of the mentalis muscle of the chin caused by stimulation of the thenar eminence of the palm.

terms.name: Grasp reflex
terms.definition: A type of primitive reflex that can be elicated when the hand of the examiner is gently inserted into the palm of the patient's hand. The palmar surface is stroked or simply touched. The flexor surfaces of the fingers may be stimulated also by the examiner's fingers. The stimulus should be in a distal direction. With a positive response, the patient grasps the examiner's hand with variable strength and continues to grasp as the examiner's hand is moved. Ability to release the grip voluntarily depends on the activity of the reflex; some patients can do so readily, while others can even be lifted off the bed, since the grasp has such power [NCBI Books:NBK395].

terms.name: Glabellar reflex
terms.definition: A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by repetitive tapping on the forehead. Normal subjects usually blink in response to the first several taps, but if blinking persists, the response is abnormal and considered to be a sign of frontal release. Persistent blinking is also known as Myerson's sign.

terms.name: Snout reflex
terms.definition: A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by tapping the upper lip lightly. The contraction of the muscles causes the mouth to resemble a snout.

terms.name: Suck reflex
terms.definition: A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by lightly touching or tapping on the lips with an object such as a tongue blade, reflex hammer, or the examiner's finger. At times the reflex is obtained merely by approaching the lips with an object. A positive suck reflex consists of sucking movements by the lips when they are stroked or touched.

terms.name: Thunderclap headache
terms.definition: Severe head pain with sudden onset, reaching its maximum intensity in less than one minute and lasting from one hour to ten days.

terms.name: Liver kidney microsome type 1 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 肝肾微粒体1型抗体阳性
synonyms: Anti-liver kidney microsomal type 1 antibody positivity
Anti-type I liver-kidney microsomal antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against P450 2D6, a cytochrome P450 mono-oxygenase. Anti-LKM-1 antibodies are considered to be a diagnostic marker of autoimmune hepatitis type 2 (AIH2).

terms.name: Anti-liver cytosolic antigen type 1 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗肝细胞胞质1型抗原抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a 60-kd peptide contained in the liver cytosolic fraction.

terms.name: Bifid clitoris
terms.definition: Two clitorides located side by side.

terms.name: Duplicated clitoris
terms.definition: Supernumerary clitoris.

terms.name: Exaggerated rugosity of the labia majora
terms.definition: Marked rugae formation of the skin of the labia majora.

terms.name: Abnormal peristalsis
terms.definition: An anomaly of the wave-like muscle contractions of the digestive tract.

terms.name: Cerebellar edema
terms.definition: Swelling from fluid accumulation (serous fluid infiltration into the interstitial space) in the cerebellum.

terms.name: Oral erythroplakia
terms.definition: A velvety red but not ulcerated lesion of the oral mucosa. The texture may be roughened or normal, and the lesion is neither raised nor depressed.

terms.name: Abnormal intestinal smooth muscle morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of intestinal smooth muscle morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the intestine.

terms.name: Abnormal layering of muscularis propria
terms.definition: Abnormal layering of the intestinal muscularis propria into three layers; (1) inner circular; (2) additional oblique; and (3) outer longitudinal layer.

terms.name: Fibrotic muscularis propria
terms.definition: The presence of excessive fibrous connective tissue in the muscularis propria of the intestine. Fibrosis is a reparative or reactive process.

terms.name: Enteric intraneuronal nuclear inclusion bodies
terms.definition: Aggregates of stainable substances (proteins) in the nuclei of enteric neurons.

terms.name: Palpebral thickening
terms.definition: An increased thickness of the eyelid not related to acute inflammation.

terms.name: Vulvodynia
terms.definition: Pain in the vulvar area

terms.name: Conjunctival papillae
terms.definition: Raised tissue masses located on the palpebral conjunctiva with a central vessel. Papillae are created by a focal infiltration of inflammatory cells.

terms.name: Conjunctival follicles
terms.definition: Small, dome-shaped nodules without a prominent central vessel located on the conjunctiva. The lymphoid follicles are located in the subendothelial region of the conjunctiva. They consist of a germinal center that contains immature, proliferating lymphocytes, as well as a corona that contains mature lymphocytes and plasma cells.

terms.name: Elevated gamma-glutamyltransferase level
terms.name_zh: γ-谷氨酰转移酶水平升高
terms.definition: Increased level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues.

terms.name: Glomerular deposits
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of protein in the glomerulus.

terms.name: Pulmonary venous hypertension
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in pressure in the pulmonary veins, usually as a result of left atrial hypertension.

terms.name: Skeletal muscle fibrosis
terms.definition: Excessive formation of fibrous bands of scar tissue in between muscle fibers.

terms.name: Birdshot choroidal lesions
terms.definition: Multiple cream-yellow colored hypopigmented lesions typically located at the level of the outer choroid. They are between 50 and 1,500 micrometers in size with a characteristic nasal, radial distribution in the postequatorial fundus.

terms.name: Conjunctival hyperemia
terms.definition: Dilatation of the blood vessels of the conjunctiva leading to a red appearance of the sclera.

terms.name: Addictive alcohol use
terms.definition: An addictive behavior is defined as drinking excessive amounts of alcohol over a prolonged period of time, having difficulty in reducing the amount of alcohol consumed, strongly desiring alcohol, and experiencing withdrawal symptoms when not drinking alcohol.

terms.name: Abnormality of cardiovascular system electrophysiology
terms.name_zh: 心血管系统电生理异常
terms.definition: An anomaly of the electrical conduction physiology of the heart.

terms.name: Ventricular septal aneurysm
terms.definition: A bowing (bulging to one side) of the interventricular septum of more than 15 mm on either side in adults and 5 mm in children during normal cardiac motion.

terms.name: Membranous ventricular septal aneurysm
terms.definition: Bowing (bulging out) of the membranous part of the interventricular septum of more than 10-15 mm into the cavity of an adjacent ventricle (usually into the right ventricle).

terms.name: Muscular ventricular septal aneurysm
synonyms: Aneurysm of the muscular ventricular septum
terms.definition: Bowing (bulging out) of the muscular part of the interventricular septum of more than 10-15 mm into the cavity of an adjacent ventricle (usually into the right ventricle).

terms.name: Microspherophakia
terms.definition: Microspherophakia is a rare congenital anomaly characterized by the abnormal spherical shape of the crystalline lens. It is characterized by an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens associated with reduced equatorial diameter. The primary pathology lies in the development of zonules. The condition is often bilateral and is characterized by small, thick, and spherical lenses.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the great vessels
terms.definition: A structural anomaly affecting a blood vessel involved in the circulation of the heart, i.e., the superior or inferior vena cava, the pulmonary arteries, the pulmonary veins, and the aorta.

terms.name: Aortic stiffness
terms.definition: The elastic properties of the aorta allow the aorta to store half of the cardiac ejected blood volume per beat, whereby aortic recoil during diastole pushes the remaining stored volume forward into the peripheral circulation, a phenomenon known as the Windkessel function. Aortic stiffness occurs as the elastic fibers within the arterial wall become disrupted due to mechanical stress (with age or due to other factors). Aortic stiffness refers to a reduction in the elasticity of the aorta, which is associated with an elevated pulse pressure, increased wave reflection, and often hypertension.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary artery morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the structure of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary artery physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the function of the pulmonary artery.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary vein morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the structure of the pulmonary veins.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary vein physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the function of the pulmonary veins.

terms.name: Abnormal vena cava physiology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the function of the veins that return deoxygenated blood from the body into the heart, i.e., the superior vena cava and the inferior vena cava.

terms.name: Abnormal systemic blood pressure
terms.definition: A chronic deviation from normal pressure in the systemic arterial system.

terms.name: Postexertional symptom exacerbation
terms.definition: Post-exertional symptom exacerbation (PESE), also referred to as post-exertional malaise (PEM), is defined as the worsening of symptoms that can follow minimal cognitive, physical, emotional, or social activity, or activity that could previously be tolerated. Symptoms typically worsen 12 to 72 hours after activity and can last for days or even weeks, sometimes leading to a relapse.

terms.name: Cryptozoospermia
terms.definition: A type of oligozoospermia in which spermatozoa can be detected in an ejaculate only after centrifugation and inspection of the pellet.

terms.name: Pontine tegmental cap
terms.definition: An abnormal curved or vaulted (capped) structure covering the middle third of the dorsal pontine tegmentum and projecting into the fourth ventricle.

terms.name: Abnormal factor VIII activity
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal activity of coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X.

terms.name: Increased factor VIII activity
terms.definition: Increased activity of the coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X.

terms.name: Decreased CSF/serum albumin ratio
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液/血清白蛋白比值降低
terms.definition: A reduction below normal limits of the ratio of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) albumin concentration to serum albumin concentration.

terms.name: Dilatation of large choroidal vessels
terms.definition: Enlargement of the large blood vessels in the choroid.

terms.name: Reduced brain glutamine level by MRS
terms.definition: An decrease in the level of glutamine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Abnormal CSF/serum albumin ratio
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液/血清白蛋白比值异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal range of the ratio of the albumin concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) to the concentration in serum (which may be defined as 3.2-9.0). This is an index of blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity, adjusted for the serum albumin concentration, and an increased ratio is taken as a sign of a loss of integrity of the BBB with leakage of albumin into the CSF.

terms.name: Ovarian thecoma
terms.definition: A sex cord-stromal tumor of the ovary. Thecomas range from small tumors to large solid or solid-cystic masses of up to 15 cm. They are unilateral in over 90 percent of cases and are rarely malignant. Thecomas are stromal tumors made up of cells that resemble theca cells, lutein cells and fibroblasts. They are traditionally classified within the sex cord-stromal tumor category of ovarian tumor types.

terms.name: Abnormal serum bile acid concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of serum bile acid concentration.

terms.name: Decreased serum bile acid concentration
terms.definition: A reduction in the concentration of bile acid in the blood.

terms.name: Biliary epithelial hyperplasia
terms.definition: Hyperplasia of lining epithelia of the septal and large bile ducts manifesting as micropapillary projections or as a stratification of the epithelium with or without dilatation of the duct lumen.

terms.name: Suppurative cholangitis
terms.definition: Cholangitis characterized by the presence of numerous polymorphonuclear cells around and within the wall as well as within the lumen of the ducts. This may involve ducts of any size and is occasionally associated with abscess formation (cholangitic abscess).

terms.name: Granulomatous cholangitis
terms.definition: Cholangitis characterized by the accumulation of granulomas. Granulomas are aggregates of modified macrophages (epithelioid cells) and other inflammatory cells that accumulate after chronic exposure to antigens. The underlying trigger may be exposure to noxious agents that cannot be biochemically degraded or to immune dysfunction. The ultimate result is a release of a variety cytokines that stimulate mononuclear cells that fuse to form multinucleated giant cells with a surrounding rim of lymphocytes and fibroblasts.

terms.name: Lymphoid cholangitis
terms.definition: Cholangitis characterized by a close association between duct branches, usually interlobular bile ducts, and lymphocytic aggregates, which may show a follicular arrangement.

terms.name: Pleomorphic cholangitis
terms.definition: Cholangitis associated with mixed inflammatory infiltrates and the presence of fibrosis or sclerosis of the biliary tree.

terms.name: Sclerosing cholangitis
terms.definition: Cholangitis associated with evident ductal fibrosis that develops as a consequence of long-standing bile duct inflammatory, obstruction, or ischemic injury; it can be obliterative or nonobliterative.

terms.name: Abnormal pancreatic duct morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the pancreatic duct, which is the tubular structure that collects exocrine pancreatic secretions and transports them to the duodenum.

terms.name: Duplication of pancreatic duct
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of two separate pancreatic ducts.

terms.name: Pancreas divisum
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly of the pancreas that results from failed fusion of the dorsal and ventral ducts during embyological development. Three variants have been described: type 1 or classical divisum in which there is total failure of fusion; type 2 in which dorsal drainage is dominant in the absence of the duct of Wirsung; and type 3 or incomplete divisum where a small communicating branch is present.

terms.name: Megaduodenum
terms.definition: Dilation and elongation of the duodenum with hypertrophy of all layers of the duodenum.

terms.name: Atretic vas deferens
terms.definition: Abnormal closure or blockage of the vas deferens.

terms.name: Cerebrospinal fluid rhinorrhoea
terms.definition: Drainage of cerebrospinal fluid through the nose. This can occur when there is a fistula between the dura and the skull base and discharge of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the nose.

terms.name: Abnormal vestibular saccule morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the saccule of the vestibule. The saccule is the otolith organ that senses motions in the sagittal plane (i.e., up-down movement).

terms.name: Vestibular saccular degeneration
terms.definition: Deterioration or loss of the tissues of the saccule of the vestibule.

terms.name: Minifascicle formation
terms.definition: A nerve fascicle or fasciculus is a small bundle of axons, enclosed by the perineurium. A minifascule refers to a group of thinly myelinated and unmyelinated axons surrounded by a delicate perineurium, and with a smaller diameter than a normal nerve fascicle.

terms.name: Neuritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of a nerve.

terms.name: Polyneuritis
terms.definition: Simultaneous inflammation of multiple nerves.

terms.name: Hemiareflexia
terms.definition: Areflexia that is limited to one side of the body.

terms.name: Acroparesthesia
terms.definition: A type of paresthesia (tingling, pins-and-needles, burning or numbness or stiffness) that occurs in the hands and feet and particularly in the fingers and toes.

terms.name: Orofacial action-specific dystonia induced by speech
Lingual dystonia
terms.definition: Involuntary protrusions, movements, spams and contortions of the tongue.

terms.name: Ainhum
terms.definition: Development of a fibrotic constriction ring involving the base of one or more toes, conditioning eversion and absorption of distal structures, possibly progressing to spontaneous amputation.

terms.name: Hyperphalangy of the 3rd finger
terms.definition: An accessory phalanx of the third (middle) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint.

terms.name: Fatty streak
terms.definition: Yellow-colored streaks, patches, or spots on the intimal surface of arteries. Fatty streaks stain red with Sudan III or Sudan IV.

terms.name: Thin-cap fibroatheroma
terms.definition: Thin-cap fibroatheroma is characterized by a relatively large necrotic core with an overlying thin fibrous cap measuring less than 65 micrometers and typically containing numerous macrophages, and is considered to be the precursor lesion of plaque rupture which is the most common cause of coronary thrombosis.

terms.name: Ankylosis
terms.definition: A reduction of joint mobility resulting from changes involving the articular surfaces.

terms.name: Intrahepatic portal vein sclerosis
terms.definition: Sclerosis of the intrahepatic portal veins of the liver and generally accompanied by non-cirrhotic portal hypertension, features of which may include splenomegaly and varices.

terms.name: Alternating radiolucent and radiodense metaphyseal lines
terms.name_zh: 干骺端透X线与阻X线交替线
terms.definition: Areas of radio-opaque sclerotic bands alternating with those of normal lucency give rise to stripes akin to a zebra.

terms.name: Swiss cheese atrial septal defect
terms.definition: Multiple defects in the atrial septum.

terms.name: Eccrine syringofibroadenoma
terms.definition: Eccrine syringofibroadenoma (ESFA) is a benign adnexal tumor arising most often on the extremities of elderly individuals characterized by anastomosing cords of cuboidal epithelial cells surrounded by a fibrovascular stroma containing plasma cells and ductal structures. ESFA stains positively with epithelial membrane antigen (EMA) and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA).

terms.name: Pyknotic bone marrow neutrophils
terms.definition: Nuclear lobes of neutrophils in the bone marrow are thickened and condensed, and individual lobes are connected by unusually long chromatin filaments.

terms.name: Bone marrow hypercellularity
terms.definition: A larger than normal amount or percentage of hematopoietic cells relative to marrow fat.

terms.name: Squamous Papilloma
terms.definition: A benign epithelial neoplasm characterized by a papillary growth pattern and a proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells without morphologic evidence of malignancy [NCI thesaurus].

terms.name: Oropharyngeal squamous papilloma
terms.definition: A benign exophytic neoplasm that arises from the oropharynx. It is characterized by the presence of a connective tissue core covered by stratified squamous epithelium [NCI thesaurus].

terms.name: Multiple mucosal neuromas
terms.definition: Multiple painful, dome-shaped, translucent pink to skin-colored papules on oral mucosa. Histologically, the lesions may demonstrate dermal proliferation of well-demarcated nerve bundles associated with abundant mucin and surrounded by a distinct perineural sheath.

terms.name: Cylindroma
terms.definition: A benign skin adnexal tumor of eccrine differentiation.

terms.name: Gastric leiomyosarcoma
terms.definition: A malignant neoplasm of the stomach that grows submucosally in the gastric wall. Necrosis and hemorrhage may be visible radiologically. Histologically, spindle cells with abnormal mitotic activity may be visible.

terms.name: Snail-like ilia
terms.definition: The ilia is round and hypoplastic with a very flat acetabular roof and a very unusual medial projection of bone that is said to resemble the head of a snail. Figure 4 of PMID:3799723 illustrates this feature.

terms.name: Internal notch of the femoral head
terms.definition: A small V-shaped indentation on the internal aspect of the femoral head. This feature is well illustrated in Figure 5 of PMID:11694546.

terms.name: Lactescent serum
terms.definition: Serum sample with a grossly white (milk-like, i.e., lactescent) appearance. This feature is indicative of an extremely elevated serum triglyceride level.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CEA concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of CEA (carcinoembryonic antigen) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating mucin 16 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环黏蛋白16浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of mucin-16 (also known as CA-125) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating retinol-binding protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环视黄醇结合蛋白浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of retinol-binding protein in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating retinol-binding protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环视黄醇结合蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of retinol-binding protein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Impaired urinary acidification
terms.definition: The kidney contributes towards acid-base homeostasis by excreting H+ ions and retaining bicarbonate. This process is known as acidification of the urine. The pH of urine ranges normally from 4.5 to 8. The inability to reduce the pH of the urine in a situation where it would be otherwise expected is known as an acidification defect.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
Abnormal insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic infection
terms.definition: Presence of a protracted or persistent infection by a pathogen potentially related to an underlying abnormality of the immune system that is not able to clear the infection.

terms.name: Decreased circulating GH-binding protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环生长激素结合蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of GH-binding protein (= growth hormone-binding protein) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced insulin-like factor 3 level
terms.definition: Blood concentration of insulin-like factor 3 (ILF3) is below normal limits.

terms.name: Spermatogenesis maturation arrest
terms.definition: Maturation arrest (MA) is defined as germ cells that fail to complete maturation. Uniform MA is characterized by spermatogenic arrest at the same stage of spermatogenesis throughout the seminiferous tubules. MA is subcategorized into early MA, in which only spermatogonia or spermatocytes are found, and late MA, in which spermatids are detected without spermatozoa.

terms.name: Spermatocyte maturation arrest
terms.definition: A type of spermatogenesis maturation arrest in which the block of developmental occurs in the spermatocyte stage. Testicular histology shows seminiferous tubules with Sertoli cells, spermatogonial cells and spermatocytes but no further differentiated cells like round spermatids.

terms.name: Round spermatid arrest
synonyms: Maturation arrest of spermatogenesis at spermatid stage
terms.definition: A failure of spermatogenesis to progress beyond the round spermatid stage. The round spermatid is the first haploid cells produced during spermatogenesis and normally further develop into mature spermatozoa. This abnormality can be visualized with testicular biopsy and is characterized seminiferous tubules with increased numbers of round spermatids with few or no mature spermatozoa.

terms.name: Obstruction of the superior vena cava
terms.definition: Blockage of blood flow through the superior vena cava (SVC). Because the venous drainage from the upper extremities, upper thorax and head is obstructed, SVC obstruction presents with symptoms related to engorgement of these areas. Both the degree of SVC compromise and the extent of collateral veins determine the varied clinical presentation, which can be as mild as slight facial and upper extremity edema or as dire as intracranial swelling, seizures, hemodynamic instability and tracheal obstruction.

terms.name: Strawberry tongue
terms.definition: Inflamed tongue with hyperplastic (enlarged) fungiform papillae that is said to resemble a strawberry or raspberry.

terms.name: Type A4 brachydactyly
