terms.definition: An abnormal gyral pattern characterized by abnormalities of sulcal depth or orientation and a thickened cortex intermediate between pachygyria and polymicrogyria.

terms.name: Aspartic aciduria
terms.definition: A increased concentration of aspartic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Asparaginuria
synonyms: Increased level of asparagine in urine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of asparagine in the urine.

terms.name: Testicular mass
terms.definition: An abnormal bulge or lump in a testis. A testicular mass has a long differential diagnosis including testicular torsion, epididymitis, acute orchitis, strangulated hernia and testicular cancer.

terms.name: Increased urinary phosphoserine level
terms.name_zh: 尿磷酸丝氨酸水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of phosphoserine in urine
terms.definition: An increased level of phosphoserine in the urine.

terms.name: Unilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria
terms.definition: A type of perisylvian polymicrogyria that largely affects one side of the brain.

terms.name: Bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria
terms.name_zh: 双侧外侧裂周多小脑回畸形
terms.definition: A type of perisylvian polymicrogyria that affects both sides of the brain.

terms.name: Breast mass
terms.definition: A breast lump is any discrete mass in a breast noticed by the patient, significant other, or physician.

terms.name: Subcortical band heterotopia
terms.definition: A form of subcortical heterotopia with mislocalized gray matter within the white matter.It is defined as longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter. It is part of the lissencephaly spectrum.

terms.name: Bilateral generalized polymicrogyria
terms.name_zh: 双侧全脑多小脑回畸形
terms.definition: Symmetric generalized polymicrogyria with no obvious gradient or region of maximal severity; may have abnormal high signal in white matter.

terms.name: Posterior predominant subcortical band heterotopia
terms.definition: Longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter visible along the occipital cortex.

terms.name: Anterior predominant subcortical band heterotopia
terms.name_zh: 前为主型皮质下带状灰质异位
terms.definition: Longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter visible in the frontal and temporal lobes.

terms.name: Diffuse subcortical band heterotopia
terms.name_zh: 弥漫性皮质下带状异位
terms.definition: Longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter visible along the whole brain.

terms.name: Hydroxylysinuria
terms.definition: The presence of an elevated amount of 5-hydroxylysine in the urine. This compound is a hydroxylated derivative of the amino acid lysine that is present in certain collagens.

terms.name: Parasagittal parieto-occipital polymicrogyria
terms.definition: Polymicrogyria in parasagittal and mesial aspects of parieto-occipital cortex.

terms.name: Retinal microaneurysm
terms.definition: A localized dilation or outpouching of microvasculature formed due to disruption of the vessel wall of a retinal capillary blood vessel. The lesions present as small red dots with distinct margins and are not larger than a blood vessel width at the disk margin.

terms.name: Periglomerular fibrosis
terms.definition: Circumferential fibrosis in the interstitium surrounding Bowman's capsule

terms.name: Abnormal HDL subfraction concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白亚组分浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of an HDL subfraction, which can be determined by methods such as electrophoresis followed by densitometric determination of the areas under the peaks. Large HDL subfractions are defined as HDL1 (greater than 12 nm), HDL2b (9.7-12 nm), and HDL2a (8.8-9.69 nm). Small HDL subfractions are defined as HDL3a (8.2-8.79 nm), HDL3b (7.8-8.19 nm), and HDL3c (7.20-7.79 nm).

terms.name: Abnormal HDL2a concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白2a浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL2a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.80-9.69 nm.

terms.name: Increased HDL2a concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白2a浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL2a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.80-9.69 nm.

terms.name: Decreased HDL2a concentration
terms.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL2a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.80-9.69 nm.

terms.name: Abnormal HDL2b concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白2b浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL2b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 9.7-12 nm.

terms.name: Decreased HDL2b concentration
terms.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL2b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 9.7-12 nm.

terms.name: Increased HDL2b concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白2b浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL2b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 9.7-12 nm.

terms.name: Abnormal HDL3a concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白3a浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL3a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.2-8.79 nm.

terms.name: Abnormal HDL3b concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白3b浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL3b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.8-8.19 nm.

terms.name: Abnormal HDL3c concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白3c浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL3c subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3c particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.20-7.79 nm.

terms.name: Increased HDL3a concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白3a浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL3a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.2-8.79 nm.

terms.name: Decreased HDL3a concentration
terms.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL3a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.2-8.79 nm.

terms.name: Increased HDL3b concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白3b浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL3b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.8-8.19 nm.

terms.name: Decreased HDL3b concentration
terms.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL3b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.8-8.19 nm.

terms.name: Increased HDL3c concentration
terms.name_zh: 高密度脂蛋白3c浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL3c subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3c particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.20-7.79 nm.

terms.name: Decreased HDL3c concentration
terms.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL3c subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3c particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.20-7.79 nm.

terms.name: Delayed umbilical cord separation
terms.definition: Separation of the umbilical cord occurs at an abnormally late timepoint.

terms.name: Neonatal omphalitis
terms.definition: An infection of the umbilicus and/or surrounding tissues occurring in the neonatal period.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating C-reactive protein concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of C-reactive protein in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating C-reactive protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环C反应蛋白浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased C-reactive protein level in blood
Reduced C-reactive protein level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of C-reactive protein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Platelet anisocytosis
terms.definition: Abnormally increased variability in the size of platelets.

terms.name: Airborn particle hypersensitivity
terms.name_zh: 空气传播颗粒超敏反应
terms.definition: An abnormally increased sensitivity to airborn particles. This can be diagnosed on the basis of the medical history, taking into account seasonality or a relationship to the concentration of airborn particles in the environment of the affected individual. Aerosol challenge is a gold standard of establishment of the symptom. There exist particle hypersensitivity (diesel exhaust, metals, inorganic material) vs. allergen (including pollen dander, etc) hypersensitivity. The responses are usually different and testing for allergen hypersensitivity is done in concert with serum IgE and or skin testing to the suspected allergen.

terms.name: Blood group B
terms.definition: ABO phenotype B, corresponding to the genotype BO or BB.

terms.name: Blood group AB
terms.definition: ABO phenotype AB, corresponding to the genotype AB.

terms.name: Blood group O
terms.definition: ABO phenotype O, corresponding to the genotype OO.

terms.name: Past medical history
terms.definition: In a medical encounter, the physician generally will interview the patient about his or her current problem, and may perform additional testing. The past medical history (PMH) in contrast records information about the patient's medical, personal and family history that might be relevant to the presenting illness or to provide optimal clinical management. The PMH generally includes (if relevant) other major illnesses, hospitalizations, surgeries, injuries, allergies, gynecologic and obstetric history, family history, personal history including occupational history, alcohol and drug use, etc.

terms.name: Status post organ transplantation
terms.definition: The affected individual has received an organ transplant previous to the current medical encounter.

terms.name: Pulmonary cyst
terms.definition: A round circumscribed space within a lung that is surrounded by an epithelial or fibrous wall of variable thickness. A cyst usually has a thin and regular wall (less than 2 mm) and contains air, although some may contain fluid.

terms.name: Pulmonary bulla
terms.definition: Pulmonary bullae are rounded focal regions of emphysema with a thin wall which measure more than 1 cm in diameter. They are often subpleural in location and are typically larger in the apices. In some cases, bullae can be very large and result in compression of adjacent lung tissue. A giant bulla is arbitrarily defined as one that occupies at least one third of the volume of a hemithorax. When large, bullae can simulate pneumothorax. The most common cause is paraseptal emphysema but bullae may also be seen in association with centrilobular emphysema.

terms.name: Pulmonary bleb
terms.definition: A bleb is a small gas-containing space within the visceral pleura or in the subpleural lung, not larger than 1 cm in diameter. CT findings show a bleb as a thin-walled cystic air space contiguous with the pleura.

terms.name: Achlorhydria
terms.definition: A condition in which production of hydrochloric acid in the stomach is absent.

terms.name: Abnormal dermoepidermal hemidesmosome morphology
terms.name_zh: 真皮表皮半桥粒形态异常
terms.definition: An abnormal structure or appearance of hemidesmosomes, multiprotein complexes that facilitate the stable adhesion of basal epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane.

terms.name: Positive blood arsenic test
terms.definition: Detection of arsenic in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Oral melanotic macule
terms.definition: Flat, distinct, discolored area of oral mucosal membrane less than 1 cm wide not associated with a change in the thickness or texture of the affected mucosal membrane. The lesions are small, solitary, well-circumscribed and often uniformly pigmented.

terms.name: Oral melanoacanthoma
terms.definition: Oral melanoacanthoma usually presents as an asymptomatic, ill-defined, rapidly enlarging, macular pigmentation. Although most lesions are heavily pigmented, the coloration may or may not be uniform. Any mucosal site may be affected, but buccal mucosal involvement is most common. Although typically solitary, rare patients may present with multifocal lesions.

terms.name: Abnormal lip pigmentation
terms.definition: Abnormal coloring of the lip, whereby the lip discolored, blotchy, or darker or lighter than normal.

terms.name: Labial melanotic macule
terms.definition: Flat, distinct, discolored area on the lip less than 1 cm wide not associated with a change in the thickness or texture.

terms.name: Reduced granulocyte CD18 level
terms.definition: Reduced level of CD18 on the granulocyte surface. This feature can be assessed by flow cytometry.

terms.name: Unlayered lissencephaly
terms.definition: A type of lissencephaly whereby upon neuropathological examination the cortical plate is severely disorganized with a festooned-like pattern and with neither lamination nor clear demarcation between white and gray matter.

terms.name: 2-3-layered lissencephaly
terms.definition: Pachygyria-agyria spectrum whereby at neuropathological examination the cortical plate consists of a two-three layered organization made up of a molecular layer, a relatively thin wavy layer with a higher cellular density and a third layer with lower cellularity.

terms.name: Narrowing of medullary canal
terms.definition: A reduction in diameter and volume of the central cavity of bone where red or yellow bone marrow is located.

terms.name: Abnormal phosphoribosylpyrophosphate synthetase level
terms.name_zh: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶水平异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal level of the enzyme phosphoribosyl pyrophosphatesynthetase, which catalyzes the synthesis of PP-ribose-P from ATP and ribose-5-phosphate.

terms.name: Decreased phosphoribosylpyrophosphate synthetase level
terms.name_zh: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶水平降低
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced level of the enzyme phosphoribosyl pyrophosphatesynthetase, which catalyzes the synthesis of PP-ribose-P from ATP and ribose-5-phosphate.

terms.name: Increased circulating palmitate level
terms.name_zh: 血循环棕榈酸水平升高
terms.definition: An elevation beyond the normal concentration of palmitate (palmitic acid) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating fibronectin level
terms.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of fibronectin the the blood circulation.

terms.name: Ureteral hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the ureter.

terms.name: Bladder trabeculation
terms.definition: Muscular projections that protrude into the lumen of the bladder, criss-crossing the walls of the bladder on its inner surface.

terms.name: Aplasia of the olfactory bulb
terms.definition: Lack of formation (congenital absence) of the olfactory bulb.

terms.name: Past obstetric history
terms.definition: Information about past pregnancies including gravidity (number of times a woman has been pregnant, regardless of the outcome), parity (total number of births), gestational age of births, and medical conditions related to past pregnancies.

terms.name: History of stillbirth
terms.definition: One or more previous pregnancies resulted in stillbirth, defined as death of a fetus in the later stages of pregnancy (definitions in the literature vary, with cut-offs ranging from 20 to 28 weeks gestation).

terms.name: Anti-asialoglycoprotein receptor antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗去唾液酸糖蛋白受体抗体阳性
terms.definition: Presence of autoantibodies against the asialoglycoprotein receptor (ASGPR) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Monilethrix
terms.definition: The hair shaft has a beaded appearance due to the presence of elliptical nodes that have the diameter of normal hair and are medullated, regularly separated by internodes that are narrow, devoid of medulla and are the site of fracture.

terms.name: Focal polymicrogyria
terms.definition: Polymicrogyria affecting one or multiple small areas of the cerebral cortex.

terms.name: Abnormal urine urobilinogen level
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of urobilinogen in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased urine urobilinogen
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of urobilinogen in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin B6 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating vitamin B6 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Lateral spinal meningocele
terms.definition: Protrusion of the arachnoid and dura through spinal foramina.

terms.name: Preimplantation lethality
terms.definition: It is estimated that about 40-70 percent of human embryos produced in vitro fertilization (IVF) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) are viable embryos, whereas others arrest at different early stages of development. The phenotype of preimplantation lethality is inferred if IVF and ICSI cycles fail because all of an individual's embryos are arrested at early stages of development.

terms.name: Beta-aminoisobutyric aciduria
terms.definition: An increased amount of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine. Beta-aminoisobutyric acid is a non-protein amino acid originating from the catabolism of thymine and valine.

terms.name: Abnormal pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
terms.name_zh: 垂体糖蛋白激素α亚基水平异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081).

terms.name: Decreased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
terms.name_zh: 垂体糖蛋白激素α亚基水平降低
synonyms: Decreased pituitary glycoprotein alpha subunit level
Decreased pituitary glycoprotein polypeptide alpha subunit level
terms.definition: An reduced concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081).

terms.name: Elevated fecal sodium
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of sodium in feces.

terms.name: Abnormal fecal osmolality
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram.

terms.name: Elevated fecal osmolality
terms.definition: Abnormally high concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram.

terms.name: Reduced fecal osmolality
terms.definition: Abnormally low concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram.

terms.name: Abnormal fecal pH
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal pH of feces. The pH reflects the acidity or alkalinity of a solution on a logarithmic scale on which 7 is neutral, whereby lower values are more acid and higher values more alkaline.

terms.name: Elevated fecal pH
terms.definition: Abnormally high fecal pH, i.e., abnormal alkalinity of feces.

terms.name: Decreased fecal pH
terms.definition: Abnormally low fecal pH, i.e., abnormal acidity of feces.

terms.name: Increased circulating argininosuccinic acid
terms.name_zh: 血循环精氨琥珀酸升高
terms.definition: An increased level of the non-proteinogenic amino acid argininosuccinic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Anti-myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: Presence of antibodies in the serum that react against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein.

terms.name: Elevated circulating trypsinogen concentration
terms.name_zh: 血胰蛋白酶原浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of trypsinogen in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal terminal:vellus ratio
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of terminal to vellus hairs.

terms.name: Elevated terminal:vellus ratio
terms.definition: An increased proportion of terminal hairs compared to vellus hairs.

terms.name: Reduced terminal:vellus ratio
terms.definition: A terminal:vellus ratio under 4:1 is characteristic of androgenetic alopecia.

terms.name: Giant neutrophil granules
terms.definition: The presence of abnormally large granules in neutrophils. This finding can be appreciated on a peripheral blood smear. The finding is characteristic of Chediak Higashi syndrome. The giant granules are derived from azurophil granules, whereas peroxidase-negative granules are not involved in their formation.

terms.name: Exacerbated by tobacco use
synonyms: Smoking or tobacco use exacerbates symptoms
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by smoking tobacco products.

terms.name: Exacerbated by contraceptive medication exposure
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by taking contraceptive medication.

terms.name: Exacerbated by barbiturate exposure
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by taking barbituates.

terms.name: Ameliorated by ethanol ingestion
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by drinking alcohol (ethanol).

terms.name: Lhermitte's sign
terms.definition: An electric shock-like sensation that occurs on flexion of the neck. This sensation radiates down the spine, often into the legs, arms, and sometimes to the trunk.

terms.name: Hydrophobia
terms.definition: The word hydrophobia has been used to describe the avoidance of drinking in the presence of hydrophobic spasms that can be observed in human rabies (described as a blockage in the throat with worsening of dyspnea). However, rarely, the same word has been used to describe panic reactions observed in a patient when offered a glass of water. This term does not refer to the latter meaning.

terms.name: Alien limb phenomenon
terms.definition: Alien limb phenomenon refers to involuntary motor activity of a limb in conjunction with the feeling of estrangement from that limb.

terms.name: Labiomental fasciculations
terms.definition: Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the chin.

terms.name: Polyembolokoilamania
terms.definition: Habitual insertion of foreign bodies into bodily orifices.

terms.name: Onychotillomania
terms.definition: Onychotillomania is characterized by the compulsive or irresistible urge in patients to pick at, pull off, or harmfully bite or chew their nails.

terms.name: Tendon pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to a tendon.

terms.name: Superiorly positioned umbilicus
terms.definition: The position of the umbilicus (belly button) is abnormally high (superior).

terms.name: Four-vessel umbilical cord
terms.definition: Four-vessel umbilical cord containing two arteries and two veins.

terms.name: Supernumerary lacrimal punctum
terms.definition: A congenital developmental anomaly characterized by the presence of an additional lacrimal punctum in an eyelid.

terms.name: Deep dermatophytosis
terms.definition: A type of invasive dermatophyte infection of the deep dermis characterized by extensive dermal infiltration by fungal elements.

terms.name: Severe dermatophyte infection
terms.definition: Infection that extends deeply into the dermis by dermatophytes, fungi that typically cause different types of superficial infection (tinea) or skin, hair, or nails.

terms.name: Majocchi's granuloma
terms.definition: Majocchi's granuloma (MG) is an inflammatory and granulomatous, dermatophytic infection characterized by a granulomatous inflammation around the hair follicle. Histopathologically, MG demonstrates a nodular perifollicular granulomatous infiltrate of lymphoid cells, macrophages, epithelioid cells, multinucleated giant cells, and neutrophils. Unlike superficial dermatophytoses, fungal hyphae and spores can be detected not only on the surface of the epidermis but also within or around the hair follicles.

terms.name: Disseminated dermatophytosis
terms.definition: A type of invasive dermatophyte infection characterized by vascular involvement and dissemination to other organs.

terms.name: Increased Burr cell count
terms.definition: Burr cells, also known as echinocytes, have a speculated border over the entire cell surface. Burr cells are commonly found in both end-stage renal disease and liver disease. Small numbers of Burr cells are commonly found in healthy individuals.

terms.name: Masseter muscular weakness
terms.definition: Reduced strength of the masseter muscle, whose primary function is to elevate the mandible and thereby raise the mandible towards the maxilla, closing the jaw.

terms.name: Self hugging
terms.definition: Involuntary, tic-like movements consisted of crossing both arms across the chest and tensing the body or clasping the hands and squeezing the arms to the sides. The movements last a few seconds and may occur in series or flurries, generally accompanied by facial grimacing and occasional grunting.

terms.name: Ameliorated by immunosuppresion
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with immunosuppresive medication.

terms.name: Tendon thickening
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the thickness (diameter) of a tendon.

terms.name: Long thumb
terms.definition: Length of the thumb is greater than normal.

terms.name: Exacerbated by acetylcholinesterase inhibitor exposure
terms.name_zh: 乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂暴露加重
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor such as tensilon (edrophonium) or pyridostigmine (Mestinon).

terms.name: Ameliorated by acetylcholinesterase inhibitor
terms.name_zh: 乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂可缓解
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor such as mestinon or tensilon.

terms.name: Inferiorly positioned umbilicus
terms.definition: The position of the umbilicus (belly button) is abnormally low (inferior).

terms.name: Elevated urinary 4-hydroxybutyric acid
terms.definition: An increased amount of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased tissue succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织琥珀酸半醛脱氢酶活性降低
synonyms: Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
Decreased succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase leukocyte activity
terms.definition: Reduced level of succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase (SSADH).

terms.name: Elevated CSF gamma-aminobutyric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液γ-氨基丁酸浓度升高

terms.name: Elevated CSF 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液4-羟基丁酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Abnormally increased level of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Elevated circulating acetone concentration
terms.definition: An increased level of acetone in the blood circulation. Acetone is one of the predominant ketone bodies.

terms.name: Exacerbated by methylxanthine ingestion
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by ingestion of food containing a methylxanthine compound (for instance, coffee, caffeine, chocolate).

terms.name: Cervical (neck)
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the neck.

terms.name: Increased number of lymph nodes
terms.definition: An abnormally elevated number of lymph nodes in an anatomical region.

terms.name: Delayed fracture healing
terms.definition: A delay in healing of a fracture past the expected duration.

terms.name: Pretibial dimple
terms.definition: A groove or crease on the shins (pretibial, i.e., over the shin bone). Pretibial creases may be obvious at birth and may range from 3 cm to over 15 cm in length and lengthen as the limb grows. They appear as an elongated dimple because of the attachment of skin to underlying tissue (e.g., to the tibia). The dimple or crease grows in proportion to the growth of the leg.

terms.name: Joint extensor surface localization
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in extensor surface of the joint. The extensor surface refers to the skin on the opposite side of a joint.

terms.name: Joint flexor surface localization
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in flexor surface of the joint. The flexor surface refers to the skin that touches when a joint is bent (flexed).

terms.name: Knuckle pad
synonyms: Knuckle pads on dorsal aspect of finger joints
terms.definition: Knuckle pads are benign fibrofatty subcutaneous pads located over the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints that can be mistaken for arthritis. Rarely they affect the dorsal aspect of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints. Clinically they are painless and often affect both hands in an asymmetrical pattern.

terms.name: Exacerbated by pregnancy
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by being pregnant.

terms.name: Lithoptysis
terms.definition: Expectoration (coughing up) of a broncholith. Broncholithiasis is defined as the presence of calculi in the tracheobronchial tree. It is a rare disease but can be characterized by clinical and radiological findings of a calcified lymph node eroding bronchial wall and opening into the bronchial lumen.

terms.name: Predominant small joint localization
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that mainly affects the small joints, including fingers, toes, interphalangeal, metacarpophalangeal, metatarsophalangeal, wrists, ankles, vertebrae, and neck.

terms.name: Abdominal rigidity
terms.definition: Involuntary tightening of the abdominal musculature that occurs in response to touching the abdomen to avoid pain. Rigidity can occur in the presence of abdominal inflammation and usually involves only the inflamed area.

terms.name: Abdominal guarding
terms.definition: A voluntary contraction of the abdominal wall musculature to avoid pain.

terms.name: Low intraocular pressure
terms.definition: An abnormal decrease of the pressure within the eye.

terms.name: Increased placental thickness
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated placental thickness.

terms.name: Persistent asymmetrical tonic neck reflex
synonyms: Tonic neck reflex asymmetrical and persistent
terms.definition: Persistence beyond the normal age (roughly the first half of the first year of life) of the asymmetric tonic neck reflex (ATNR), which is an easily elicited primitive reflex in the immediate newborn period. The ATNR refers to the phenomenon whereby when the face of an infant is turned to one side, the ipsilateral arm and leg extend and the contralateral arm and leg flex. This posture has been compared to a typical posture of fencers.

terms.name: Howell-Jolly bodies
terms.definition: Howell-Jolly bodies are small, intra-erythrocytic remnants of erythrocyte nuclei. These inclusions are solitary in each erythrocyte and strongly basophilic. These are often confused with overlying platelets, but can be distinguished by the presence of a halo around overlying platelets.

terms.name: Hemorrhoids
terms.definition: Enlarged, bulging blood vessels in and around the anus often associated with rectal bleeding, itching, and pain.

terms.name: Abnormal pulse
terms.definition: An anomaly of the rhythmic throbbing of an artery that reflects the widening of the artery as blood flows through it and is caused by successive contractions of the heart.

terms.name: Weak pulse
terms.definition: A diminution in the amplitude (strength) of the pulse such that the examiner has difficulty feeling the pulse.

terms.name: Absent pulse
terms.definition: The pulsation of an artery where the pulse is taken (e.g. the radial artery at the wrist) cannot be detected on physical examination.

terms.name: Bounding pulse
terms.definition: Increased amplitude (strength) of the pulse.

terms.name: Circumoral cyanosis
terms.definition: Persistent blue color of the skin that surrounds the mouth.

terms.name: History of bone marrow transplant
synonyms: Status post haematopoietic stem cell transplantation
Status post hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
terms.definition: A past medical history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation involving myeloablative chemoradiotherapy followed by stem cell rescue with autologous or human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched stem cells derived from a donor.

terms.name: Absent sperm flagella
terms.definition: Sperm cells lacking flagella.

terms.name: Short sperm flagella
terms.definition: Sperm cells with abnormally short flagella.

terms.name: Coiled sperm flagella
terms.definition: Sperm cells whose flagella are twisted (coiled).

terms.name: Microcephalic sperm head
terms.definition: Decreased size of the head of sperm.

terms.name: Tapered sperm head
terms.definition: Sperm with cigar-shaped heads that gradually dimish in diameter (taper).

terms.name: Dacryocytosis
terms.definition: Presence of teardrop-shaped red blood cells.

terms.name: Ileitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the ileum.

terms.name: Oval macrocytosis
terms.definition: Enlarged, oval-shaped erythrocytes (red blood cells).

terms.name: Lipiduria
terms.definition: An increased lipid content in the urine.

terms.name: Urinary mulberry cells
terms.definition: Distal tubular epithelial cells in which globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) has accumulated. they are the characteristic feature of Fabry disease. Urinary mulberry bodies are a component of mulberry cells that can be distinguished easily from fat particles by their inner lamellar appearance.

terms.name: Temporal bossing
terms.definition: Prominence (bulging) in the temple region, which is the part of the skull where the frontal, parietal, temporal, and sphenoid bones join on the side of the head.

terms.name: Pontine ischemic lacunes
terms.definition: Lacunes are infarcts less than 15 mm in diameter in the cortical white matter or in the corona radiata, internal capsule, centrum semiovale, thalamus, basal ganglia, or pons.

terms.name: Increased oocyte death
terms.definition: An increase in death of oocytes, the female germ cell (egg cell), which can be observed clinically in the setting of in vitro fertilization.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary nucleobase concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal level of a nucleobase in the urine. Nucleobases are nitrogen-containing biological compounds that form nucleosides: adenine (A), cytosine (C), guanine (G), thymine (T), and uracil (U).

terms.name: Elevated urinary cytidine
terms.definition: Increased levels of urinary cytidine, a pyrimidine nucleoside in which cytosine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond.

terms.name: Elevated urinary uridine level
terms.definition: Increased levels of urinary uridine, a ribonucleoside composed of a molecule of uracil attached to a ribofuranose moiety via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond.

terms.name: Decreased circulating 12-HETE
terms.definition: A reduction in the concentration of 12-HETE in the blood circulation, a metabolite of arachidonic acid.

terms.name: Intracellular accumulation of Dol-PP-GlcNAc2Man5
terms.definition: Intracellular accumulation of the lipid-linked oligosaccharide intermediate Man5GlcNAc2-PP-dolichol.

terms.name: Clonal T cell receptor rearrangement
terms.definition: Presence of a predominant T cell clone. In PCR-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of one or two prominent bands within a valid size range. In NGS-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of a high number of reads that map to a single T cell receptor clone.

terms.name: Third ventricle colloid cyst
terms.definition: An epithelial lined cyst filled with gelatinous material. The gelatinous material commonly contains mucin, old blood, cholesterol, and ions. Most colloid cysts identified are currently asymptomatic and identified incidentally on imaging. When a colloid cyst does cause issues, it most commonly causes obstructive hydrocephalus.

terms.name: Vascular hamartoma
terms.definition: A benign focal growth composed of vascular tissue.

terms.name: Abnormal bulbus cordis morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal structure of the bulbus cordis, which is the single outflow tract of the heart during early embryogenesis.

terms.name: Abnormal renal interstitial morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the interstitium of the kidney. The renal interstitium is defined as the intertubular, extraglomerular, extravascular space of the kidney. It is bounded on all sides by tubular and vascular basement membranes and is filled with cells, extracellular matrix, and interstitial fluid.

terms.name: Renal interstitial foam cells
terms.definition: Accumulation of foam cells (FC) in the interstitium of the kidney. Renal FCs display phenotypic characteristics of macrophages and belong to the monocyte/macrophage lineage. Histologically, renal FCs are characterized by round cells with small nuclei and an abundant PAS-positive cytoplasm with lipid-containing vacuoles.

terms.name: Renal interstitial neutrophil infiltration
terms.definition: Increased numbers of neutrophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal interstitial eosinophil infiltration
terms.definition: Increased numbers of eosinophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal interstitial plasma cell infiltration
terms.definition: Increased numbers of plasma cells in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal interstitial calcium oxalate
terms.definition: The presence of birefringent calcium- and oxalate deposits in interstitial cells of the kidney.

terms.name: Hand apraxia
terms.definition: Inability to perform purposeful (learned) movements with the hand upon command, even though the command is understood and there is a willingness to perform the movement. Hand apraxia includes the inability to grasp, pick up, and hold large and small objects.

terms.name: Renal lymphocytic tubulitis
terms.definition: Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by lymphocytes.

terms.name: Renal neutrophilic tubulitis
terms.definition: Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by neutrophils.

terms.name: Renal interstitial hemosiderin
terms.definition: Deposition of hemosiderin (a golden-brown, granular pigment derived from ferritin) in interstitial cells of the kidney.

terms.name: Aplasia of the right hemidiaphragm
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the right-sided diaphragm.

terms.name: Myoglobin casts
terms.definition: A type of acelluar casts with positive myoglobin staining A that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented.

terms.name: Renal tubular basement membrane denudation
terms.definition: Naked basement membranes without tubular epithelium.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell detachment
terms.definition: Tubular cross section with a space between the basolateral aspect of tubular epithelium and its basement membrane; classified as global when at least 2/3 circumference of the tubular cross section are involved and segmental when less than 2/3 are involved.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell cytoplasmic vacuolization
terms.definition: Tubular cross section with intracytoplasmic vacuoles in at least one tubular epithelial cell. This feature is classified as isometric when vacuoles are round and similar in size and coarse when vacuoles were not round in shape or varied in size.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell sloughing
terms.definition: At least one free floating cell in the tubular lumen without attachment to adjacent cells or basement membrane in a tubular cross section without detachment. These cells must not aggregate into a tubular shape and completely fill the lumen, if so, it should be classified as a cast.

terms.name: Blebbing of apical cytoplasm of renal tubular epithelial cells
terms.name_zh: 肾小管上皮细胞顶端细胞质起泡
terms.definition: Tubular cross section with round/irregular cytoplasmic protrusion, shaped like the Greek capital letter Omega (or it may be more vertically elongated Omega), pinched off from apical membrane without apparent closure of the lumen, involving over 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section. The feature can be further classified into proximal or distal tubule.

terms.name: Abnormal renal tubular epithelial morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the renal tubular epithelial cells (RTEC), a layer of cells in the outer layer of the renal tubule. These cells play a role in the absorption of substances such as glucose and amino from the primary urine.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell hyaline droplets
terms.definition: Tubular epithelium with round strongly PAS-positive cytoplasmic droplet material in at least one tubular epithelial cell.

terms.name: Multinucleation of renal tubular epithelial cells
terms.name_zh: 肾小管上皮细胞多核化
terms.definition: Tubular epithelial cells with greater than 3 nuclei in a single epithelial cell, often overlapping with each other in a single plane of view.

terms.name: Prominent nucleoli of renal tubular epithelial cells
terms.definition: Tubular epithelium with nucleoli clearly visible at 100-fold magnification.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell simplification
terms.definition: Tubular cross section with flattened tubular cell cytoplasm (height unequivocally less than width), with complete loss of brush border involving greater than 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section, resulting in an apparent increase in the size of the lumen, without the presence of casts.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell mitosis
terms.definition: Tubular epithelial cells in any mitotic phase, identified by distinctively visible chromosome in either prophase, metaphase, anaphase or telophase configuration.

terms.name: High renal tubular epithelial cell N/C ratio
terms.name_zh: 肾小管上皮细胞核质比高
synonyms: High N/C ratio of renal tubular epithelial cells
terms.definition: At least one tubular epithelial cell with average sized cytoplasmic area and a nuclear area 3 times greater than average sized nuclei.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial lipofuscin
terms.definition: Presence of increased amount of lipofuscin, a yellow, granular cytoplasmic pigment in the renal tubules.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell swelling
terms.definition: Tubular cross section lined entirely by tubular epithelium with convex apical cell membrane (i.e., cells are shaped like an upside down U, and lack a distinct smaller protrusion seen in blebbing as defined above) resulting in apparent complete closure of the lumen.

terms.name: Thyroidization-type tubular atrophy
terms.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by a thyroid-like appearance, with small round tubules with markedly flattened, simplified epithelium and uniform intratubular casts.

terms.name: Endocrine-type tubular atrophy
terms.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by endocrine-like appearance of tubules, which are small and have narrow lumina, clear cells, and relatively thin basement membranes.

terms.name: Tubulointerstitial mycobacterial infiltration
terms.definition: Renal tubulointerstitial infiltration of mycobacteria identified on acid-fast or Fite stains. Can be associated with granulomatous inflammation.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell hemosiderin
terms.definition: Tubular epithelial cells containing cytoplasmic hemosiderin, brown-golden granular pigment.

terms.name: Triphalangeal hallux
terms.definition: A hallux (big toe) with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis.

terms.name: Renal interstitial amyloid deposits
terms.definition: Deposition of amyloid in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Amyloid is is made up of 10 nm (on average) fibrils that are most commonly composed of monoclonal light chains (AL), transthyretin (TTR), amd LECT2, or occur in the setting of long standing systemic inflammation.

terms.name: Renal glomerular amyloid deposition
terms.definition: Amyloid deposits located in the glomeruli in a focal segmental, diffuse segmental or diffuse global fashion. This abnormality can be accompanied by mesangial involvement and in later stages also involvement of the peripheral capillaries.

terms.name: Abnormal diffusion weighted cerebral MRI morphology
synonyms: Diffusion weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DWI) abnormality
MRI diffusion abnormality of the cerebrum
terms.definition: A diffusion abnormality observed in diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain. Molecular diffusion refers to the notion that any type of molecule in a fluid (eg, water) is randomly displaced as the molecule is agitated by thermal energy. Restricted diffusion of water appears bright on diffusion-weighted images.

terms.name: Renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposits
terms.definition: Accumulation of an immunoglobulin in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. The immunoglobulin may be a monoclonal Ig or the corresponding heavy-chain (HC) or light-chain (LC) subunit. By convention this definition excludes Ig-derived amyloidosis (amyloidosis can be distinguished by its affinity for Congo red staining).

terms.name: Renal interstitial hemorrhage
terms.definition: A focal collection of 20 or more red blood cells within the interstitium, that is irregular in shape (i.e., collections do not conform to the shape of tubules or capillary networks), without surrounding endothelium or tubular epithelium, and is in an area of intact core.

terms.name: Renal necrosis
terms.definition: Cell death (necrosis) affecting one or more parts of the kidney.

terms.name: Perinephric abscess
terms.definition: A perinephric abscess is a collection of suppurative material in the perinephric space (i.e., the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney).

terms.name: Intrarenal abscess
terms.definition: An encapsulated collection of pus and necrotic material within the renal parenchyma. The destruction of renal parenchyma is associated with suppurative/neutrophil-rich inflammation and necrosis.

terms.name: Hyperchromasia of renal tubular epithelial cells
synonyms: Condensed chromatin of renal tubular epithelial cells
terms.definition: At least one tubular cross section with all tubular epithelial nuclei having a chromatin pattern resembling normal mature lymphocytes.

terms.name: Tubular luminal dilatation
terms.definition: Dilatation (expansion beyond the normal dimension) of the cavity (lumen) of tubules of the kidney. The tubular cross section displays an attenuated brush border (apical PAS positivity greater than 10 percent of the normal expected height, but unequivocally less than normal expected height), resulting in an apparent increase in the size of lumen.

terms.name: Renal intratubular casts
terms.definition: Urinary casts are formed in the distal convoluted tubule or the collecting duct by solidification of protein in the lumen of the kidney tubules. This term refers to casts located within the tubuli of the kidney. More precisely, casts are defined as a material that completely fills and expands the tubular lumen with simplification of surrounding tubular epithelium. Casts are classified as either nuclear debris/granular brown material, red blood cell, white blood cell, myeloma, or myoglobin cast.

terms.name: Intratubular bilirubin casts
terms.definition: A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. On H&E (red brown), PAS (amaranth purple), trichrome (red with ragged contours), Hall (olive-emerald green).

terms.name: Intratubular erythrocyte cast
terms.definition: Casts that contain red blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney.

terms.name: Intratubular vancomycin casts
terms.name_zh: 肾小管内万古霉素管型
terms.definition: Intratubular casts composed of vancomycin aggregates and uromodulin.

terms.name: Intratubular leukocyte casts
terms.definition: Casts that contain white blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney.

terms.name: Intratubular dihydroxyadenuria crystals
terms.name_zh: 肾小管内二羟腺嘌呤结晶
terms.definition: Intratubular crystals composed of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine are small needle-shaped brownish crystals that are highly birefringent under polarized light and black by Jones methenamine silver.

terms.name: Intratubular light-chain casts
terms.definition: The presence of casts containing immunoglobulin light chains within the lumina of the renal tubules.

terms.name: Intratubular hemoglobin casts
terms.name_zh: 肾小管内血红蛋白管型
terms.definition: A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented. On H&E (red granular), PAS (purple), trichrome (red granular), Hall (yellow brown). Stain positively for Hemoglobin A.

terms.name: Renal papillary necrosis
terms.definition: Premature death of cells in the renal papilla (the apex of a renal pyramid which projects into the cavity of a calyx of the kidney and through which collecting ducts discharge urine). Histologically, one observes pale tissue with typical appearance of coagulative necrosis, affecting the renal papillae. Necrosis can be identified by pyknotic nuclei and simplified, flattened epithelium of proximal tubules. The tubular and glomerular basement membranes are still visible without viable nuclei.

terms.name: Intratubular hyaline casts
terms.definition: A type of acellular urinary cast located within the distal tubules of the kidney and that is composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein. Correspondingly, these casts have a low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends.

terms.name: Intratubular myoglobin cast
terms.name_zh: 肾小管内肌红蛋白管型
terms.definition: Casts located within the tubuli of the kidney and that contain myoglobin. Myoglobin casts are composed of round granules that may line up in chains or aggregate in clusters. Their color ranges from pink to red-brown with hematoxylin and eosin stain, light brown to black with Jones methenamine silver stain, pink to bright magenta with periodic acid-Schiff stain, and bright red with trichrome stain. Immunoperoxidase staining with antibody to myoglobin is stronglypositive in the casts.Electron microscopy shows globular casts with an electron-dense core and a somewhat less-intense periphery. Substructure is absent. This feature may be accompanied by acute tubular injury with variable flattening of tubular epithelial cells, loss of brush borders, and intratubular sloughed epithelial cells.

terms.name: Tubulointerstitial microganismal infiltration
terms.definition: Infiltration of microorganisms into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as observed by appropriate staining procedures, e.g., bacteria on a bacterial stain (Brown and Hopps) or fungi on PAS or silver stain.

terms.name: Tubulointerstitial viral infiltration
terms.definition: Infiltration of viruses into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as demonstrated on renal biopsy by viral inclusions which can be seen on routine stains or with immunohistochemistry.

terms.name: Renal interstitial edema
terms.definition: Edema is characterized but the acute swelling of the stroma, with expansion of the interstitial space without the a concurrent increase in interstitial cells or extracellular matrix. Histologically this change is appreciated as interstitial areas of lower optical density.

terms.name: Elevated urine mevalonic acid level
terms.definition: An abnormally increased amount of mevanolate in the urine. Mevanolate is that hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mevalonic acid.

terms.name: Elevated leukocyte cystine
terms.definition: An increased concentration of cystine within white blood cells.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CCL18 concentration
synonyms: Elevated C-C motif chemokine 18 level in blood
Increased C-C motif chemokine 18 level in blood
Increased C-C motif chemokine ligand 18 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of CCL18 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Renal interstitial granulomas
terms.definition: Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present.

terms.name: Renal interstitial necrotizing granulomas
terms.definition: An organized collection of histiocytes (specifically macrophages) localized in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Through light microscopy, the activated histiocytes appear as epithelioid cells with round to oval nuclei, often with irregular contours and abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders. They may also coalesce to form multinucleated giant cells. Granulomas may be associated with a peripheral cuff of lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined. Granulomas can present as necrotizing or non-necrotizing. Microscopically, necrotizing granulomas distinctly have central necrosis with a palisaded lymphohistiocytic reaction and a cuff of chronic inflammation.

terms.name: Renal interstitial non-necrotizing granulomas
terms.definition: Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present with no necrosis.

terms.name: Renal interstitial deposits
terms.definition: Abnormal accumulation of a metabolite, protein, or protein-derived substance in the interstitial region of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal interstitial mononuclear cell infiltration
terms.definition: Presence of interstitial mononuclear leukocytes, i.e., white blood ceclls with a single round nucleus, including lymphocytes and monocytes but not including granulocytes (which have multilobed nuclei).

terms.name: Renal interstitial xanthogranulomatous inflammation
terms.definition: Inflammation of interstitial tissues of the kidney consisting of foamy macrophages admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and neutrophils and occasional giant cells.

terms.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell apoptosis
terms.definition: Increased apoptosis (programmed cell death) of tubular epithelial cells. The cells are rounded with increased eosinophilia and contain fragmented, densely basophilic nuclear debris.

terms.name: Tubularization of Bowman capsule
terms.definition: The presence of cuboidal to columnar epithelium (height greater than width) lining the Bowman capsule, in an absence of adjacent segmental sclerosis, crescents, or collapsing variant of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis; scored as present or absent in at least one glomerulus.

terms.name: Skewfoot
terms.definition: A type of flat-foot characterized by hindfoot abductovalgus, metatarsus adductus, and Achilles tendon shortening. The predominant radiographic findings include forefoot adduction with lateral subluxation of the navicular on the talus and heel valgus. Very abnormal shoe wear is noted on the medial side. Calluses occur under the metatarsal heads and the head of the plantar-flexed talus.

terms.name: Elevated CSF glial fibrillary acidic protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液胶质纤维酸性蛋白浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated CSF glial fibrillary acidic protein level
terms.definition: Increased concentration of glial fibrillary acidic protein in cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Elevated CSF chitinase-3-like protein 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液几丁质酶-3样蛋白1浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of chitinase-3-like protein 1 in cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Elevated CSF chitotriosidase 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液壳三糖苷酶1浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of chitotriosidase 1 in cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Elevated lactate:pyruvate ratio
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the molar ratio of lactate to pyruvate in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Impaired flow-mediated arterial dilatation
terms.name_zh: 血流介导动脉扩张障碍
terms.definition: Flow-mediated dilatation is a noninvasive tests of endothelial function that leverages ultrasound to measure arterial diameter and its response to an increase in shear stress, which normally causes endothelium-dependent dilatation. This term pertains to an abnormal reduction in the magnitude of dilatation. Flow-mediated dilatation is usually measured at the brachial artery.

terms.name: Decreased adipose tissue tocopherol level
terms.name_zh: 脂肪组织生育酚水平降低
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of tocopherol in fat tissue.

terms.name: Febrile status epilepticus
terms.definition: A seizure lasting 30 minutes without fully regaining consciousness, provoked by fever (temperature greater than 38.0 degrees Celcius) at the time of seizure-onset, without a prior history of afebrile seizure and with no evidence of an acute central nervous system infection or insult.

terms.name: Elevated circulating lyso-globotriaosylsphingosine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环溶血球三糖鞘氨醇浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the level of globotriaosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb3) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Status epilepticus with prominent motor symptoms
terms.definition: Status epilepticus with prominent motor signs during the prolonged seizure.

terms.name: Non-convulsive status epilepticus with coma
terms.definition: A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms and in the presence of coma.

terms.name: Convulsive status epilepticus
terms.definition: A type of status epilepticus characterized by a prolonged bilateral tonic-clonic seizure, or repeated bilateral tonic-clonic seizures without recovery between.

terms.name: Generalized convulsive status epilepticus
terms.name_zh: 全身性惊厥性癫痫持续状态
terms.definition: A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of generalized onset that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus.

terms.name: Focal-onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
terms.name_zh: 进展为双侧惊厥性癫痫持续状态的局灶起始性发作
synonyms: Focal onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
Focal-onset seizure evolving into generalised convulsive status epilepticus
Focal-onset seizure evolving into generalized convulsive status epilepticus
Partial onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus
Partial-onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus
terms.definition: A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of focal onset (which could be with awareness or impaired awareness, either motor or non- motor) that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus.

terms.name: Focal motor status epilepticus
terms.name_zh: 局灶性运动性癫痫持续状态
terms.definition: Status epilepticus with focal motor signs originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. Involves musculature in any form. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement.

terms.name: Adversive status epilepticus
terms.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by continuous neck or body rotation and conjugate gaze deviation in a direction contralateral to the responsible epileptic focus. This includes some forms of tonic status epilepticus.

terms.name: Repeated focal motor seizures
terms.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated motor, typically clonic events repeatedly affecting the same segments of the body with spread of clonic movements through contiguous body parts unilaterally, and repeating over a sufficiently prolonged period to reach a diagnosis of status epilepticus.

terms.name: Hyperkinetic status epilepticus
terms.definition: Status epilepticus characterized by continuous hyperkinetic proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements such as pedaling pelvic thrusting, thrashing, or rocking movements.

terms.name: Myoclonic status epilepticus
terms.definition: A type of motor status epilepticus with repeating bilateral sudden brief (less than 100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography.

terms.name: Myoclonic status epilepticus without coma
terms.definition: A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the absence of coma.

terms.name: Myoclonic status epilepticus with coma
terms.definition: A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the presence of coma.

terms.name: Tonic status epilepticus
terms.definition: Tonic status epilepticus is a type of status epilepticus characterized by focal or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, which may be electrographically generalized or focal.

terms.name: Non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
terms.definition: A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms in the absence of coma.

terms.name: Autonomic status epilepticus
terms.name_zh: 自主神经性癫痫持续状态
terms.definition: Autonomic status epilepticus is a type of non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma with prominent autonomic features regardless of whether it is electrographically generalized or focal.

terms.name: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
terms.name_zh: 无昏迷的局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态
terms.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically focal. It is a prolonged focal non-motor seizure.

terms.name: Cutaneous wound
terms.definition: A cutaneous wound is a defined as a disruption of normal anatomic structure and function of the skin that occurs owing to an injury of the skin. Wound healing is a dynamic, interactive process involving soluble mediators, blood cells, extracellularmatrix, and parenchymal cells. Wound healing has three phases: inflammation, tissue formation, and tissue remodeling, that overlap in time.

terms.name: Acute cutaneous wound
terms.definition: A cutaneous wound that is proceeding through an orderly and timely reparative process that results in sustained restoration of the anatomic and functional integrity of the skin.

terms.name: Chronic cutaneous wound
terms.definition: A cutaneous wound that has failed to proceed through the orderly and timely process to produce an atomic and functional integrity, or proceeded through the repair process without establishing a sustained anatomic and functional result.

terms.name: Generalized-onset motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 全面性发作性运动性发作
terms.definition: A generalized motor seizure is a type of generalized-onset seizure with predominantly motor (involving musculature) signs. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement.

terms.name: Eyelid myoclonia seizure
terms.definition: An eyelid myoclonia seizure is a type of generalized myoclonic seizure which may or may not be associated with loss of awareness.

terms.name: Focal non-motor seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by non-motor signs or symptoms (or behavior arrest) as its initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure involves an alteration in a cognitive function (which can be a deficit or a positive phenomenon such as forced thought), which occurs at seizure onset. To be classified as a focal cognitive seizure, the change in cognitive function should be specific and out of proportion to other relatively unimpaired aspects of cognition, because all cognition is impaired in a focal impaired awareness seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal aware cognitive seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware non-motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性非运动性发作
terms.definition: A focal non-motor seizure in which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性听觉失认发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
terms.name_zh: 伴听觉失认的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by auditory agnosia as the initial semiological manifestation. For example a person may hear a ringing sound, but may not connect this with the concept that the sound is from a telephone ringing.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with memory impairment
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性记忆损害发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment
terms.name_zh: 伴记忆损害的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by transient memory impairment as the initial semiological manifestation whilst other cognitive functions and awareness are preserved at seizure onset. The memory impairment may be an inability to recall events occurring prior to the seizure (retrograde amnesia), or failure to encode new memories for events occurring during the seizure (anterograde amnesia).

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with dissociation
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性分离发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dissociation characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with dissociation
terms.name_zh: 伴分离症状的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by an experience of being disconnected from, though aware of, self or environment as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with dyscalculia/acalculia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性计算困难/失算发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia and or acalculia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia/acalculia
terms.name_zh: 伴计算困难/失算的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dyscalculia / acalculia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking
terms.name_zh: 伴强迫思维的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by forced thinking as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with neglect
terms.name_zh: 伴忽视的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by neglect as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia
terms.name_zh: 伴阅读困难/失读的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dyslexia / alexia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 伴接受性言语困难/失语的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by receptive dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 伴传导性言语困难/失语的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by conduction dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia/agraphia
terms.name_zh: 伴书写困难/失写的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dysgraphia / agraphia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion
terms.name_zh: 伴左右定向障碍的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by left-right confusion as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with anomia
terms.name_zh: 伴命名障碍的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by anomia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 伴表达性言语困难/失语的局灶性认知发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by expressive dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with illusion
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性错觉发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with forced thinking
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性强迫思维发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with left-right confusion
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性左右定向障碍发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性阅读困难/失读发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with anomia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性命名不能发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with anomia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with dysgraphia/agraphia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性书写困难/失写发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性感觉性言语困难/失语发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware clonic seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal clonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性运动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with version
terms.name_zh: 伴偏转的局灶性意识障碍性运动性发作
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with version
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with version characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness bilateral motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性双侧运动性发作
terms.definition: A focal bilateral motor seizure characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal bilateral motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性双侧运动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure (it commences in one hemisphere) involving bilateral muscle groups rapidly at seizure onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness non-motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性非运动性发作
terms.definition: A focal non-motor seizure characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with dystonia
terms.name_zh: 伴肌张力障碍的局灶性意识障碍性运动性发作
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with dystonia
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with dystonia characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal motor seizure with dystonia
terms.name_zh: 伴肌张力障碍的局灶性运动性发作
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure in which the initial semiological manifestation is the sustained contraction of both agonist and antagonist muscles producing athetoid or twisting movements, which produces abnormal postures.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with dysarthria/anarthria
terms.name_zh: 伴构音障碍/构音不能的局灶性意识障碍性运动性发作
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with dysarthria/anarthria
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal motor seizure with dysarthria/anarthria
terms.name_zh: 伴构音障碍/构音不能的局灶性运动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by difficulty with articulation of speech, due to impaired coordination of muscles involved in speech sound production as the initial semiological manifestation. Receptive and expressive language functions are intact, however speech is poorly articulated and is less intelligible.

terms.name: Focal motor seizure with paresis/paralysis
terms.name_zh: 伴轻瘫/瘫痪的局灶性运动性发作
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure characterized by weakness or complete paralysis of a muscle or group of muscles as the initial semiological manifestation.

terms.name: Focal aware tonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性知觉性强直发作
terms.definition: A type of focal tonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware motor seizure with dystonia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性运动性肌张力障碍发作
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with dystonia
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with dystonia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness tonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性强直发作
terms.definition: A focal tonic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness clonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性阵挛发作
terms.definition: A type of focal clonic seizure during which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point in the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness hyperkinetic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性多动性发作
terms.definition: A focal hyperkinetic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with agitation
terms.name_zh: 伴激越的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with agitation is characterized by the presence of psychomotor agitation as an expressed or observed emotion, at the outset of the seizure. Because of the unpleasant nature of these seizures, patients may also have anticipatory anxiety about having seizures.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness atonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性失张力发作
terms.definition: A focal atonic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure
terms.name_zh: 伴欣快的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure is characterized by the presence of a positive emotional experience with pleasure, bliss, joy, enhanced personal well-being, heightened self-awareness or ecstasy.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness myoclonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性肌阵挛发作
terms.definition: A focal myoclonic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware hyperkinetic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性多动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal hypermotor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware motor seizure with paresis/paralysis
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性运动性轻瘫/瘫痪发作
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with paresis/paralysis
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware motor seizure with dysarthria/anarthria
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性运动性构音困难/构音不能发作
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with dysarthria/anarthria
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性发作
terms.definition: A focal emotional seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with anger
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性愤怒发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anger in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with anger
terms.name_zh: 伴愤怒的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anger is characterized by the presence of anger, as an expressed or observed emotion, at the outset of the seizure. It may be accompanied by aggressive behavior.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia
terms.name_zh: 伴偏执的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia is characterized by the presence of paranoia as an expressed or observed emotion at the outset of the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with fear/anxiety/panic
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性恐惧/焦虑/惊恐发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anxiety, fear or panic as an expressed or observed emotion at the outset of the seizure, in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal emotional seizure with fear/anxiety/panic
terms.name_zh: 伴恐惧/焦虑/惊恐的局灶性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anxiety is characterized by the presence of anxiety, fear or panic as an expressed or observed emotion, at the outset of the seizure. Because of the unpleasant nature of these seizures, patients may also have anticipatory anxiety about having seizures.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性有意识自主神经性发作
synonyms: Focal autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness
Localised autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness
Localized autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness
Partial autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness
terms.definition: A focal aware autonomic seizure has an initial manifestation pertaining to autonomic nervous system function, which may be objective (for example, pupillary dilation) or subjective (for example, nausea). As a type of focal aware seizure, awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with paranoia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性偏执发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with pleasure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性愉悦发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with crying
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性哭泣发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with crying (dacrystic)in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with agitation
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性激越发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with agitation in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware emotional seizure with laughing
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性情感性发笑发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with laughing in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: A focal emotional seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
