terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with pleasure
terms.name_zh: 伴愉悦感的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with anger
terms.name_zh: 伴愤怒的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anger in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with paranoia
terms.name_zh: 伴偏执的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with laughing
terms.name_zh: 伴发笑的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with laughing in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with crying
terms.name_zh: 伴哭泣的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with crying in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with fear/anxiety/panic
terms.name_zh: 伴恐惧/焦虑/惊恐的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anxiety, fear or panic as an expressed or observed emotion at the outset of the seizure, in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with agitation
terms.name_zh: 伴激越的局灶性意识障碍性情感性发作
terms.definition: A focal emotional seizure with agitation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
synonyms: Focal autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness
Localised autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness
Localized autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness
Partial autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure characterized by impaired awareness at some point within the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware hemiclonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性偏侧阵挛发作
terms.definition: A focal hemiclonic seizure in which awareness is retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware myoclonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性肌阵挛发作
terms.definition: A type of focal myoclonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with vestibular features
terms.name_zh: 伴前庭特征的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by symptoms of dizziness, spinning, vertigo or sense of rotation as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
terms.name_zh: 伴冷热感觉的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot or cold as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with pallor/flushing
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性自主神经性苍白/潮红发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with pallor/flushing
terms.name_zh: 伴苍白/潮红的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by changes of the skin as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation/constriction
terms.name_zh: 伴瞳孔扩大/缩小的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by pupillary dilatation or contraction as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with erection
terms.name_zh: 伴勃起的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by penile erection as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate/defecate
terms.name_zh: 伴排尿/排便急迫感的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by an urge to unripe or defecate as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with hypoventilation/hyperventilation/altered respiration
terms.name_zh: 伴通气不足/通气过度/呼吸改变的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by changes in respiratory rate as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with piloerection
terms.name_zh: 伴竖毛的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation/constriction
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性自主神经性瞳孔散大/缩小发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with hypoventilation/hyperventilation/altered respiration
terms.name_zh: 伴通气不足/通气过度/呼吸改变的局灶性有意识自主神经性发作
terms.definition: An autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with erection
terms.name_zh: 伴勃起的局灶性有意识自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with erection characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with lacrimation
terms.name_zh: 伴流泪的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by lacrimation as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with piloerection
terms.name_zh: 伴立毛的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A Focal autonomic seizure with piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal autonomic seizure with palpitations/tachycardia/bradycardia/asystole
terms.name_zh: 伴心悸/心动过速/心动过缓/心搏停止的局灶性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by changes in heart rate as the initial semiological feature.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with urge to urinate/defecate
terms.name_zh: 伴排尿/排便急迫感的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with hypoventilation/hyperventilation/altered respiration
terms.name_zh: 伴通气不足/通气过度/呼吸改变的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: An autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with lacrimation
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性自主神经性流泪发作

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with pallor/flushing
terms.name_zh: 伴苍白/潮红的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation/nausea/vomiting/other gastrointestinal phenomena
terms.name_zh: 伴上腹部感觉/恶心/呕吐/其他胃肠道症状的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation/constriction
terms.name_zh: 伴瞳孔散大/缩小的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with erection
terms.name_zh: 伴勃起的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with erection characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with urge to urinate/defecate
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性自主神经性尿意/便意发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with lacrimation
terms.name_zh: 伴流泪的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with lacrimation characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with piloerection
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性自主神经性立毛发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with palpitations/tachycardia/bradycardia/asystole
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性自主神经性心悸/心动过速/心动过缓/心搏停止发作
terms.definition: An autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation/nausea/vomiting/other gastrointestinal phenomena
terms.name_zh: 伴上腹部不适/恶心/呕吐/其他胃肠道症状的局灶性有意识自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Migrating focal seizure
terms.name_zh: 游走性局灶性癫痫发作
terms.definition: A migrating focal seizure is a seizure that involves different body parts, usually without overlap, in a consecutive manner so that the offset of a seizure in one part coincides with its onset in another, even shifting multiple times between the sides of the body. They can be associated with autonomic manifestations.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with palpitations/tachycardia/bradycardia/asystole
terms.name_zh: 伴心悸/心动过速/心动过缓/心搏停止的局灶性意识障碍性自主神经性发作
terms.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware behavior arrest seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性行为终止发作
terms.definition: A focal behavior arrest seizure characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness behavior arrest seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性行为终止发作
synonyms: Focal impaired awareness behaviour arrest seizure
terms.definition: A focal behavior arrest seizure characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with anomia
terms.name_zh: 伴命名不能的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with anomia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Tonic seizure
terms.definition: A tonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by unilateral or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 伴感觉性言语障碍/失语的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: A myoclonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.

terms.name: Generalized myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 全身性肌阵挛-强直-阵挛发作
terms.definition: A generalized myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a single or multiple jerks of limbs bilaterally, followed by tonic and clonic phases. The initial jerks can be considered to be either a brief period of clonus or myoclonus.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with left-right confusion
terms.name_zh: 伴左右定向障碍的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with olfactory features
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性嗅觉症状发作
terms.definition: Seizures characterized by olfactory phenomena at onset - usually an odor, which is often unpleasant.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with neglect
terms.name_zh: 伴忽视的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness hemiclonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性偏侧阵挛发作
terms.definition: A focal hemiclonic seizure in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with vestibular features
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性前庭症状发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by symptoms of dizziness, spinning, vertigo or sense of rotation.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with memory impairment
terms.name_zh: 伴记忆损害的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyscalculia/acalculia
terms.name_zh: 伴计算困难/计算不能的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dysgraphia/agraphia
terms.name_zh: 伴书写困难/书写不能的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with olfactory features
terms.name_zh: 伴嗅觉特征的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with olfaction in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with vestibular features
terms.name_zh: 伴前庭特征的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with vestibular features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with visual features
terms.name_zh: 伴视觉特征的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with visual features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Neonatal seizure
terms.definition: A seizure occurring within the neonatal period (28 days beyond the full term date).

terms.name: Neonatal seizure with electrographic correlate
terms.definition: Neonatal seizure is a seizure type that occurs in neonatal period and is characterized by an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end. This event can be associated or not with a clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure is an electrographic event occurring in neonatal period and coupled with a clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
terms.name_zh: 伴头部感觉的局灶性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache as its first clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Neonatal electrographic only seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electrographic only seizure is an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end, which is not associated with a clinical manifestation.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant motor features.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups; it can be symmetric or asymmetric.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal).

terms.name: Neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at multiple sites.

terms.name: Neonatal focal myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal focal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) which occurs focally.

terms.name: Neonatal focal clonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is unilateral regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral clonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the clonic jerking is bilateral.

terms.name: Neonatal multifocal clonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups, which occurs at multiple sites.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a sustained increase in muscle tone, usually focal, that can be unilateral or bilateral, and lasting a few seconds to minutes.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical autonomic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor autonomic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant features of autonomic alterations, involving cardiovascular, pupillary, gastrointestinal, sudomotor, vasomotor, and thermoregulatory functions. May present as apnea.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure with behavior arrest
synonyms: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure with behaviour arrest
Neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioral arrest
Neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioural arrest
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor seizure with behavior arrest is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure characterized by an arrest of activities, freezing, immobilization, with or without apnea and/or other autonomic manifestations.

terms.name: Neonatal focal tonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal focal tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure with a focal sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical sequential seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

terms.name: Focal neonatal sequential seizure
terms.name_zh: 新生儿局灶性序列性发作
terms.definition: Focal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic focal signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

terms.name: Multifocal neonatal sequential seizure
terms.name_zh: 多灶性新生儿序贯性发作
terms.definition: Multifocal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic multifocal signs.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically.

terms.name: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism
synonyms: Neonatal electroclinical motor seizure with automatism
terms.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, and in association with other features.

terms.name: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism
terms.definition: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body asymmetrically.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body but asymmetrically.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at both sides of the body asymmetrically.

terms.name: Neonatal epileptic spasm
terms.definition: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. May occur in clusters.

terms.name: Neonatal seizure with unilateral automatism
terms.definition: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatisms is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at one side of the body.

terms.name: Neonatal seizure with bilateral symmetric automatism
terms.definition: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body symmetrically.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically.

terms.name: Bilateral asymmetric neonatal sequential seizure
terms.name_zh: 双侧不对称新生儿序贯性癫痫发作
terms.definition: Asymmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting asymmetrically with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

terms.name: Neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm
terms.definition: Neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs at one side of the body.

terms.name: Bilateral symmetric neonatal sequential seizure
terms.name_zh: 双侧对称新生儿序贯性癫痫发作
terms.definition: Symmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting symmetrically but with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs symmetrically at both sides of the body.

terms.name: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm
terms.definition: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs asymmetrically at both sides of the body.

terms.name: Generalized-onset epileptic spasm
terms.name_zh: 全面性发作性癫痫痉挛
terms.definition: A type of epileptic spasm of generalized onset.

terms.name: Focal-onset epileptic spasm
terms.name_zh: 局灶起始的癫痫性痉挛
terms.definition: A type of epileptic spasm of focal onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness epileptic spasm
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性癫痫性痉挛
terms.definition: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware epileptic spasm
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性癫痫性痉挛
terms.definition: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is preserved throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus
terms.name_zh: 伴负性肌阵挛的局灶性运动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by a sudden interruption in normal tonic muscle activity lasting 500 ms or less, without evidence of preceding myoclonus as the initial semiological manifestation. The interruption in muscle tone is briefer than seen in a focal atonic seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness hemifacial clonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性偏侧面肌阵挛发作
terms.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with impairment of awareness in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性忽视发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Aphasic status epilepticus
terms.definition: Aphasic status epilepticus is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma characterized by a cognitive (rather than motor) language deficit.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性表达性言语困难/失语发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with visual features
terms.name_zh: 伴视觉特征的局灶性知觉感觉性发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colors, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 伴传导性言语障碍/失语的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
terms.name_zh: 伴冷热感觉的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware hemifacial clonic seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性偏侧面肌阵挛发作
terms.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with retained awareness throughout.

terms.name: Photosensitive myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure
terms.definition: Generalised myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure provoked by flashing or flickering light.

terms.name: Focal aware bilateral motor seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性双侧运动性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal bilateral motor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性运动性负性肌阵挛发作
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with negative myoclonus
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
terms.name_zh: 伴负性肌阵挛的局灶性意识障碍性运动性发作
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with negative myoclonus
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with paresis/paralysis
terms.name_zh: 伴轻瘫/瘫痪的局灶性意识障碍性运动性发作
synonyms: Focal motor impaired awareness seizure with paresis/paralysis
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
terms.name_zh: 无昏迷的全身性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态
synonyms: Generalised non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
terms.definition: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically generalized. It is a prolonged absence seizure.

terms.name: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
terms.name_zh: 伴意识障碍的局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态
synonyms: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of awareness
terms.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness is impaired.

terms.name: Status epilepticus with ictal paresis
terms.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by prolonged ictal paresis or inhibitory motor seizures.

terms.name: Typical absence status epilepticus
terms.definition: Typical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged typical absence seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with auditory features
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性听觉症状发作
terms.definition: A type of focal sensory seizure with auditory features during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus
terms.definition: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged myoclonic absence seizure. Myoclonic absence status epilepticus consists of proximal, predominantly upper extremity myoclonic jerks corresponding with 3 Hz spike-wave discharges in the EEG.

terms.name: Oculoclonic status epilepticus
terms.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repetitive and rapid saccades, in association with epileptic discharges.

terms.name: Refractory status epilepticus
terms.definition: Refractory status epilepticus is defined as status epilepticus continuing despite two appropriately selected and dosed antiepileptic drugs, including a benzodiazepine.

terms.name: Super-refractory status epilepticus
terms.definition: Super-refractory status epilepticus is defined as refractory status epilepticus continuing for 24 h or more following initiation of anesthetic medications, including cases in which seizure control is attained after induction of anesthetic drugs but recurs on weaning the patient off the anesthetic agent.

terms.name: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
terms.name_zh: 无意识障碍的局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态
synonyms: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with retained awareness
Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of awareness
terms.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness remains intact.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia
terms.name_zh: 伴阅读困难/失读的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性幻觉发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with illusion
terms.name_zh: 伴错觉的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性头部感觉异常发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
terms.name_zh: 伴听觉失认的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性传导性言语困难/失语发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性冷热感觉异常发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot and then cold.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
terms.name_zh: 伴头部感觉的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness seizure with dissociation at onset
terms.name_zh: 起病伴分离症状的局灶性意识障碍性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive epileptic seizure with dissociation at the onset of the seizure and with impairment of awareness at at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with auditory features
terms.name_zh: 伴听觉症状的局灶性意识障碍性感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with auditory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
terms.name_zh: 伴似曾相识感/陌生感的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性认知性似曾相识/陌生感发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory features
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性躯体感觉症状发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move. Awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination
terms.name_zh: 伴幻觉的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
terms.name_zh: 伴表达性言语障碍/失语的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Generalized atonic seizure
terms.definition: Generalized atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1-2 s, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking
terms.name_zh: 伴强迫思维的局灶性意识障碍性认知性发作
terms.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory features
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性感觉性味觉症状发作
terms.definition: A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory features
terms.name_zh: 伴躯体感觉特征的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware motor seizure with version
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性运动性偏转发作
synonyms: Focal motor aware seizure with version
terms.definition: A focal motor seizure with version characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

terms.name: Infection-related seizure
terms.definition: Seizure associated with a presumed or proven infection (excluding infection of the central nervous system) or inflammatory state without an alternative precipitant such as metabolic derangement, and regardless of the presence or absence of a fever.

terms.name: Gastroenteritis-related afebrile seizure
terms.definition: Afebrile (less than 38.0 degrees Celcius), brief, and generalized seizures accompanying gastroenteritis without an alternative cause.

terms.name: Seizure precipitated by febrile infection
terms.definition: Any form of seizure occurring at the time of a fever (temperature at or above 38.0 degrees Celcius) without infection of the central nervous system, and without an alternative cause such as severe metabolic derangement, occurring at any age.

terms.name: Febrile seizure outside the age of 3 months to 6 years
terms.definition: Any type of seizure (most often a generalized tonic-clonic seizure) occurring with fever (at least 38.0 degrees Celsius) but in the absence of central nervous system infection, severe metabolic disturbance or other alternative precipitant in people beyond the typical arrange of 3 months-6 years with no prior history of afebrile seizure.

terms.name: Music-induced seizure
terms.definition: Seizure precipitated by listening to music or other complex sounds.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with gustatory features
terms.name_zh: 伴味觉特征的局灶性意识障碍感觉性发作
terms.definition: A focal sensory seizure with gustatory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal automatism seizure
terms.definition: A focal seizure characterized at onset by coordinated motor activity. This often resembles a voluntary movement and may consist of an inappropriate continuation of preictal motor activity.

terms.name: Focal orofacial automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性口面自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.

terms.name: Focal manual automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性手部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset.

terms.name: Focal pedal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性足部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

terms.name: Focal perseverative automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性重复动作自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.

terms.name: Focal vocal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性发声自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.

terms.name: Focal verbal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性言语自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.

terms.name: Focal sexual automatism seizure
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.

terms.name: Focal head nodding automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性点头自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.

terms.name: Focal undressing automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性脱衣自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.

terms.name: Focal aware undressing automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性知觉性脱衣自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性自动症发作
terms.definition: A focal seizure with automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

terms.name: Focal aware automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性有意识自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware orofacial automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性口面自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware manual automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性手部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware pedal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性足部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

terms.name: Focal aware perseverative automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性持续性自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware vocal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性知觉性发声自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware verbal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性知觉性言语自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal aware sexual automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性知觉性性行为自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness orofacial automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性口面部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.

terms.name: Focal aware head nodding automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶清醒性点头自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness manual automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性手部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by manual automatisms at onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness pedal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性足部自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness perseverative automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性持续性自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness vocal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性发声自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness verbal automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性言语自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness sexual automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性自动症性发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness head nodding automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性点头自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.

terms.name: Focal impaired awareness undressing automatism seizure
terms.name_zh: 局灶性意识障碍性脱衣自动症发作
terms.definition: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.

terms.name: Elevated CSF neurofilament light chain concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液神经丝轻链浓度升高
terms.definition: Neurofilament light chain (NfL) is a neuronal cytoplasmic protein highly expressed in large caliber myelinated axons. Its levels increase in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood proportionally to the degree of axonal damage in a variety of neurological disorders, including inflammatory, neurodegenerative, traumatic and cerebrovascular diseases.

terms.name: Abnormal chondrocyte morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormal structure of a chondrocyte, which is a polymorphic cell that forms cartilage.

terms.name: Lacunar halos around chondrocytes
terms.name_zh: 软骨细胞周围腔隙晕环
terms.definition: Concentric rings around the chondrocytes.

terms.name: Increased circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
terms.name_zh: 血循环胰甘油三酯脂酶水平升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase activity
terms.definition: An increased level of triacylglycerol lipase in the blood circulation (can be measured in serum or plasma).

terms.name: Airway hyperresponsiveness
terms.definition: An increased sensitivity of the airways to an inhaled constrictor agonist, a steeper slope of the dose-response curve, and a greater maximal response to the agonist.

terms.name: Spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak
terms.definition: A spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak (SCSFL) is a spontaneous and unexplained leak of the cerebrospinal fluid from the dura surrounding either the brain (cranial leak) or spine (spinal leak).

terms.name: Posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea
terms.definition: Grayish, polygonal pattern of opacities with intervening clear zones across the central cornea that resembles crocodile skin.

terms.name: Intrusion symptom
terms.definition: Unintentional re-experiencing of a traumatic event involves symptoms that typically include sensory impressions and emotional responses stemming from the trauma. These symptoms seem to lack a sense of time perspective and context.

terms.name: Intrusive mental imagery
synonyms: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories
terms.definition: After experiencing psychological trauma, individuals may repeatedly encounter sensory-perceptual impressions of the event that intrude into their consciousness involuntarily. These intrusive memories often manifest as visual images (such as mental pictures), but can also involve sounds, smells, tastes, and physical sensations. They are accompanied by a variety of negative emotions linked to the most intense moments of the traumatic memory.

terms.name: Recurrent trauma-related distressing dreams
terms.definition: Recurrent distressing dreams occur when the content and/or emotional impact of the dream is connected to a traumatic event or events.

terms.name: Physiological reactivity to cues
terms.definition: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event(s).

terms.name: Dissociation
terms.definition: Disruption or detachment of certain aspects of one's normal psychological functioning typically involves a disconnection or separation from thoughts, feelings, sensations, memories, or one's sense of identity or reality.

terms.name: Intense psychological distress to cues
terms.name_zh: 线索诱发强烈心理痛苦
terms.definition: Intense or prolonged psychological distress occurs when individuals are exposed to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event or events.

terms.name: Avoidance of stimuli associated with traumatic event
terms.name_zh: 回避创伤事件相关刺激
terms.definition: Avoidance of or efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s). Avoidance of or efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s).

terms.name: Abnormal urine pH
terms.definition: A deviation of urine pH from the normal range of 4.5 to 7.8.

terms.name: Alkaline urine
terms.definition: Urine pH of 8 or higher.

terms.name: Renal interstitial inflammation
terms.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium potentially involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic areas, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

terms.name: Renal cortical interstitial inflammation
terms.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic renal cortex, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

terms.name: Renal medullary interstitial inflammation
terms.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the interstitium of the renal medulla, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

terms.name: Renal interstitial fibrosis
terms.definition: The accumulation of collagen and related extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules in the interstitium of the kidney. The interstitium is expanded by the presence of collagen that stain blue on trichrome. Tubules are not back to back, but rather separated by fibrosis and can be atrophic.

terms.name: Renal interstitial calcium phosphate deposits
terms.definition: The presence of interstitial aggregates of purple finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate deposits.

terms.name: Abnormal renal tubular lumen morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal structure or form of the lumen (opening) of kidney tubules.

terms.name: Renal tubular viral cytopathic changes
terms.definition: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage. Tubular destruction may be associated with necrotizing interstitial granulomas. Severe granulomatous tubulointerstitial nephritis appears to be characteristic of adenoviral infection and is quite rare in other viral infections. Focal wedge-shaped necrosis may occur in renal parenchyma. Immunostaining for adenovirus shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in infected cells.

terms.name: Usual-type tubular atrophy
terms.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy in which the tubules show thick tubular basement membranes lined by small cuboidal or flat cells. Generally accompanied by fibrosis.

terms.name: Renal tubular cytomegalovirus inclusions
terms.definition: Characteristic intranuclear glassy-appearing basophilic inclusions with surrounding halo (owl's eye-type inclusion) and marked increase in the size of the cell (cytomegaly), particularly in tubular epithelial cells and in endothelial cells. Often accompanied by cytopathic changes including patchy interstitial pleomorphic infiltrate with lymphocytes, plasma cells, and macrophages.

terms.name: Renal tubular adenovirus inclusions
terms.definition: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. The inclusions stain positive for adenovirus (e.g., Figure 3 of PMID:29273157). Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. Occasionally glomerular visceral and parietal epithelial cells can be infected. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage.

terms.name: Renal tubular polyoma virus inclusions
terms.definition: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions have a ground-glass appearance with irregular central clearing, or a coarse, vesicular appearance. Distal tubules are involved more often than proximal tubules. There may be only medullary involvement in early stages, and parietal epithelial cells may be involved in later stages of the infection. Infected epithelial cell nuclei stain with antibody to the large T antigen of the SV40 virus, which serves as a surrogate marker of human polyomavirus infection.

terms.name: Renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusions
terms.definition: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions that stain positive for herpes simplex virus (HSV). HSV is typically associated with multinucleated giant cells with nuclear inclusions and may cause hemorrhagic interstitial nephritis.

terms.name: Dysmorphic hematuria
terms.definition: The presence of dysmorphic urinary erythrocytes. This feature can be observed by phase-contrastmicroscopy, differential interference microscopy, and bright-field microscopy. The acanthocyte or G1 cell, which is a doughnut-shaped cell with one or more blebs, is reported to constitute a special form of dysmorphic erythro-cyte (D cell) specific for glomerular hematuria.

terms.name: Urinary oval fat bodies
terms.definition: The presence in the urine of desquamated tubular epithelial cells or macrophages filled with lipid droplets.

terms.name: Intratubular calcium oxalate casts
terms.definition: Birefringent calcium- and oxalate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.

terms.name: Intratubular calcium phosphate casts
terms.definition: Purple and finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.

terms.name: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystalluria
terms.definition: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystals in the urine.

terms.name: Tubular microcystic change
terms.definition: Dilated renal tubules (over twice the diameter of a normal proximal tubule) containing eosinophilic amorphous material. This feature is generally accompanied by scalloping of the cast profile. The epithelium lining the microcyst is generally flattened and does not reveal brush border.

terms.name: Complex renal cyst
terms.definition: A renal cyst characterized by epithelium lined space (squamous/columnar) with septations.

terms.name: Uric acid crystalluria
terms.definition: The presence of uric acid crystals in the urine.

terms.name: Interstitial emphysema
terms.definition: Interstitial emphysema is characterized by air dissecting within the interstitium of the lung, typically in the peribronchovascular sheaths, interlobular septa, and visceral pleura. It is most commonly seen in neonates receiving mechanical ventilation. It is rarely recognized radiographically in adults and is infrequently seen on CT scans. It appears as perivascular lucent or low attenuating halos and small cysts.

terms.name: Centrilobular emphysema
terms.definition: A type of emphysema characterized by destroyed centrilobular alveolar walls and enlargement of respiratory bronchioles and associated alveoli. This is the commonest form of emphysema in cigarette smokers. CT findings are centrilobular areas of decreased attenuation, usually without visible walls, of nonuniform distribution and predominantly located in upper lung zones.

terms.name: Panacinar emphysema
terms.definition: Panacinar emphysema involves all portions of the acinus and secondary pulmonary lobule more or less uniformly. It predominates in the lower lobes and is the form of emphysema associated with1-antitrypsin deficiency. CT scans show a generalized decrease of the lung parenchyma with a decrease in the caliber of blood vessels in the affected lung. Severe panacinar emphysema may coexist and merge with severe centrilobular emphysema. The appearance of feature less decreased attenuation may be indistinguishable from severe constrictive obliterative bronchiolitis.

terms.name: Expiratory air trapping
terms.definition: Abnormal retention of gas within a lung or part of a lung, as a result of airway obstruction of abnormalities in lung compliance. In the classic presentation, the lung will appear normal at inspiration, but on exhalation, the diseased portions of the lung which have lost connective tissue recoil will remain lucent while the healthy portions of the lung will become more dense due to atelectasis. This helps distinguish it from mosaic attenuation due to patchy fibrosis, as occurs with nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, and in early usual interstitial pneumonitis (the hallmark imaging diagnosis of interstitial lung disease) in which there is no change with inspiration and expiration.

terms.name: Traction bronchiectasis
terms.definition: Distortion of the bronchial airways due to mechanical traction on the bronchi resulting from fibrosis of the surrounding lung parenchyma. CT findings represent irregular bronchial dilatation caused by surrounding retractile pulmonary fibrosis. Dilated airways are usually identifiable as such but may be seen as cysts.

terms.name: Computed tomographic halo sign
terms.definition: CT finding of ground-glass opacity surrounding a nodule or mass. It was first described as a sign of hemorrhage around foci of invasive aspergillosis. The halo sign is nonspecific and may also be caused by hemorrhage associated with other types of nodules or by local pulmonary infiltration by neoplasm.

terms.name: Nodular-centrilobular without tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary HRCT
terms.definition: A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography which are anatomically located centrally within secondary pulmonary lobules. Centrilobular nodules may be dense (i.e., solid) and of homogeneous opacity or ground-glass opacity, and may range from a few millimeters to about 1 cm in size. Because of the similar size of secondary lobules, centrilobular nodules often appear to be evenly spaced. Centrilobular nodules are usually separated from the pleural surfaces, fissures, and interlobular septa by a distance of at least several millimeters. They may appear patchy or diffuse in different diseases.

terms.name: Abnormal bronchoalveolar lavage fluid morphology
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡灌洗液形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal type or counts of nucleated immune cells and acellular components in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid. BAL us performed with a fiberoptic bronchoscope in the wedged position within a selected bronchopulmonary segment. BAL is commonly used to inform the differential diagnosis of interstitial lung disease or to monitor therapeutic interventions.

terms.name: Abnormal cellular composition of bronchoalveolar fluid
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡液细胞成分异常
synonyms: Abnormal cell differential of broncho-alveolar fluid
terms.definition: Deviation from the commonly in healthy people observe cellular distribution. Normal ranges are macrophages over 80%, lymphocytes less than 15%, neutrophils less than 3%, eosinophils less than 0.5%, mast cells less than 0.5%.

terms.name: Abnormal bronchoalveolar fluid protein level
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡液蛋白水平异常
synonyms: Abnormal biochemical composition of broncho-alveolar fluid
Abnormal level of proteins in the broncho-alveolar fluid
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of protein in the bronchoalveolar fluid.

terms.name: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid lymphocyte proportion
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡灌洗液淋巴细胞比例升高
terms.definition: Usually, Lymphoycytes make up less than 15% of all cells found in the bronchoalveloar lavage fluid. This elevated cell proportion can be induced by virus or drugs, or is associated with specific diseases.

terms.name: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid neutrophil proportion
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡灌洗液中性粒细胞比例升高
synonyms: Elevated level of neutrophils in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid
terms.definition: Usually, Neutrophils make up less than 3% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. In children, standard value of neutrophils is higher depending on their age (children under the age of 5 show a maximum value of 10%). This elevated cell proportion is a sign for acute and chronic infections (HP:0012387, HP:0006538) and can be associated to specific diseases.

terms.name: Lipid-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡液载脂巨噬细胞
terms.definition: Accumulation of lipids in alveolar macrophages with droplet-shaped fat inclusions.

terms.name: Hemosiderin-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡液含铁血黄素巨噬细胞
synonyms: Accumulation of hemosiderin laden alveolar macrophages
terms.definition: Hemosiderin-laden macrophages (HLM) in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid were originally known as adiagnostic biomarker of alveolar hemorrhage, but have also been observed in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) with histopathological pattern of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP).

terms.name: Absent bronchoalveolar surfactant-protein C
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡表面活性蛋白C缺失
terms.definition: Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein C in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid. Comment: Pulmonary surfactant is a highly surface-active mixture of proteins and lipids that is synthesized and secreted onto the alveoli by type II epithelial cells. The protein part of surfactant constitutes of four types of surfactant proteins (SP), SP-A, SP-B, SP-C and SP-D. SP-A and SP-D are hydrophilic proteins that regulate surfactant metabolism and have immunologic functions, whereas SP-B and SP-C are hydrophobic molecules, which play a direct role in the organization of the surfactant structure in the interphase and in the stabilization of the lipid layers during the respiratory cycle. Lack of SP-C may result of surfactant metabolism dysfunction and is also observed in patients with other diffuse parenchymal lung diseases, pathogenetically related to the alveolar surfactant region.

terms.name: Absent bronchoalveolar dimeric surfactant-protein B
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡二聚体表面活性蛋白B缺失
terms.definition: Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein B in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid.

terms.name: Atoll sign
terms.definition: CT finding of central ground-glass opacity surrounded by denser consolidation of crescentic shape (forming more than three-fourths of a circle) or complete ring of at least 2 mm in thickness. A rare sign, it was initially reported to be specific for cryptogenic organizing pneumonia, but was subsequently described in patients with paracoccidioidomycosis.

terms.name: Abnormal alveolar macrophage morphology
terms.name_zh: 肺泡巨噬细胞形态异常
terms.definition: Alveolar macrophages usually make up the majority of cells in the bronchoalveolar space (over 80%). The may contain intracellular material depending on underlying diseases or due to exposition to inhaled particles.

terms.name: Dust particle inclusion in alveolar macrophages
terms.name_zh: 肺泡巨噬细胞尘粒包涵体
terms.definition: Accumulation of inhaled, nondigestable particles in macrophages.

terms.name: Smoker-inclusions in alveolar macrophages
terms.definition: In otherwise healthy smokers, characteristic so called smoker-inclusion can be found within the macrophages in the bronchoalveolar fluid. These blue/ black/ round/ oval cytoplasmic inclusions consist of pigmented lipid deposits.

terms.name: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid eosinophil proportion
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡灌洗液嗜酸性粒细胞比例升高
terms.definition: Usually, eosinophils make up less than 0.5% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. But in eosinophilic lung disease, the eosinophil cell proportion typically represents more than 25%. Comment: An elevated level of eosinophil cells are also a result of infections, or an allergic reaction or can be drug-induced.

terms.name: Persistent head lag
terms.definition: The Premie-Neuro and the Dubowitz Neurological Examination score head lag in the same manner. Scoring for both is as follows: 0 = head drops and stays back, 1 = tries to lift head but drops it back, 2 = able to lift head slightly, 3 = lifts head in line with body, and 4 = head in front of body. This term applies if head lag persists beyond an expected age at a level of 0 or 1. Persistent head lag beyond age 4 mo has been linked to poor outcomes.

terms.name: Delayed ability to roll over
terms.definition: Delayed achievement of the ability to roll front to back and back to front.

terms.name: Localized pulmonary hemorrhage
terms.definition: Circumscribed pulmonary hemorrhage originating from a single bleeding site in the lungs. This can be due to infections, tumorigenesis, foreign bodies, or vascular abnormalities. Patient often feel the site of bleeding, contrast CT scan or angiography may localize the bleeder.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary fissure morphology
terms.definition: An abnormal form or number of the pulmonary fissures.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary fissure architecture
terms.definition: An abnormal form or location of a pulmonary fissure.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary fissure count
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal number of pulmonary fissures.

terms.name: Supernumerary pulmonary fissure
terms.definition: Presence of a lung fissure that does not exist normally. Supernumerary fissures include the superior accessory fissure, the medial basal fissure, the left horizontal fissure, and the azygos fissure form supernumerary lobes.

terms.name: Decreased pulmonary fissure count
terms.definition: Lack of one or more of the normal pulmonary fissures.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating cystatin-C concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cystatin-C in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating cystatin-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胱抑素C浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of cystatin-C in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating cystatin-C concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胱抑素C浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of cystatin-C in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased fecal porphyrin
terms.definition: Abnormally high concentration of fecal porphyrins in feces.

terms.name: Subglottic laryngitis
terms.definition: Narrowing of the larynx, commonly occurring during viral respiratory tract infections, in particular in children, leads to symptoms such as hoarseness, a barking cough, stridor, and sometimes dyspnea and respiratory failure.

terms.name: Laryngeal papilloma
terms.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the larynx.

terms.name: Bronchial papilloma
terms.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on a bronchus.

terms.name: Tracheal papilloma
terms.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the trachea.

terms.name: Palmar warts
terms.definition: Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the palm. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).

terms.name: Plantar warts
terms.definition: Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the sole of the foot. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).

terms.name: Diffuse alveolar damage
terms.definition: Diffuse alveolar damage (DAD) describes a common histologic injury pattern of the lung. The early stages are characterized by epithelial cell necrosis and sloughing, fibrous exsudate, edema, and hyaline membranes made of surfactant and proteins, filling the alveoli. This results in impaired gas exchange. In later stages, type II cells and myofibroblasts proliferate within the interstitium and airspaces. The corresponding clinical entity is acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). DAD may result from pulmonary drug toxicity, occurs in immunosuppressed, severe viral infections, acute interstial pneumonitis, and crack cocaine inhalation.

terms.name: Architectural distortion of the lung
terms.definition: Architectural distortion is characterized by abnormal displacement of bronchi, vessels, fissures, or septa caused by diffuse or localized lung disease, particularly interstitial fibrosis. This is visible in lung biopsy and CT scans in a distorted appearance and is usually associated with pulmonary fibrosis and accompanied by volume loss.

terms.name: Increased Z-disc width
terms.definition: Abnormally increased width of the Z-disk of the sarcomere, resulting from splitting or opening of the Z-disc (c.f., Figure 2 of PMID:28732005).

terms.name: Increased fecal coproporphyrin 1
terms.definition: Abnormally high concentration of coproporphyrin 1 in feces.

terms.name: Increased fecal coproporphyrin 3
terms.definition: Abnormally high concentration of coproporphyrin 3 in feces

terms.name: Platystencephaly
terms.definition: Extreme width of the skull in the occipital region, with anterior narrowing and prognathism.

terms.name: Abnormal salivary metabolite concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a metabolite in saliva.

terms.name: Abnormal salivary cortisol level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cortisol in saliva.

terms.name: Decreased salivary cortisol level
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced concentration of cortisol in saliva.

terms.name: Increased salivary cortisol level
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated concentration of cortisol in saliva.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgD concentration
terms.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood.

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgD concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating IgD
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgD can be measured.

terms.name: Male reproductive system neoplasm
terms.definition: A neoplasm that affects the male reproductive system.

terms.name: Female reproductive system neoplasm
terms.definition: A neoplasm that affects the female reproductive system.

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgE concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgE concentration
terms.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating IgE
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood circulation, whereby at most trace quantities of IgE can be measured.

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgA concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin A (IgA) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating total IgG
synonyms: Chronic (near) absent total IgG in blood
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG can be measured.

terms.name: White oral mucosal macule
terms.definition: A small circumscribed whitish change in the color of the oral mucosa that is neither elevated nor depressed.

terms.name: Retinal peau d'orange
terms.definition: A pebbly orange appearance of the fundus that is said to resemble the skin of an orange.

terms.name: Anti-U1 ribonucleoprotein antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗U1核糖核蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence autoantibodies in the serum that react to proteins (70 Kd, A, C) that are associated with U1 RNA and form U1snRNP.

terms.name: Anti-glomerular basement membrane-antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗肾小球基底膜抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to the glomerular basement membrane.

terms.name: Hyperpyrexia
terms.definition: An extreme elevation of core body temperature above normal defined as a rectal temperature of 41.1 degrees Celsius (106 degrees Fahrenheit).

terms.name: Triggered by an abusive adult
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is induced by an abusive adult (usually a parent).

terms.name: Anti-MDA5 antibody positivity
synonyms: Increased level of anti-melanoma differentiation-associated protein 5 antibodies
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to Anti-MDA5 (Anti-melanoma differentiation-associated proteine 5).

terms.name: Anti-citrullinated protein antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗瓜氨酸化蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence autoantibodies in the serum that react do different citrullinated antigens, including filaggrin, fibrinogen, vimentin and collagen.

terms.name: Abnormal Schwann cell morphology
terms.definition: Abnormality of schwann cells, glial cells that ensheath axons of neurons in the peripheral nervous system and are necessary for their maintenance and function.

terms.name: Decreased nasal nitric oxide
terms.definition: Reduced level of nasal nitric oxide (nNO). Current American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society (ATS/ERS) guidelines for nNO measurements recommend air aspiration via a nasal probe while the subject exhales through the mouth against resistance in order to maintain velum closure.

terms.name: Anti-RNA-polymerase-III-autoantibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗RNA聚合酶III自身抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to RNA-polymerase III.

terms.name: Increased circulating precipitin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环沉淀素浓度升高
synonyms: Increased level of antigen-precipitating IgG antibodies
terms.definition: The concentration (titer) of antigen-precipitating IgG in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-Sm antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to seven proteins that consist of a core of small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (snRNP) particles.

terms.name: Cytokine storm
terms.definition: Excessive or uncontrolled release of proinflammatory cytokines.

terms.name: Abnormal chorion morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the fetal part of the placenta, which is known as the chorion.

terms.name: Edematous chorionic villi
terms.definition: Swelling of the chorionic villi owing to fluid accumulation.

terms.name: Motor regression
terms.definition: Loss of previously achieved motor skills, as manifested by loss of developmental motor milestones.

terms.name: Bipedal edema
terms.definition: A palpable swelling in both feet and ankles caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid).

terms.name: Michaelis-Gutmann bodies
terms.definition: Basophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions in macrophages. The inclusions have a small, round laminated appearance. Electron microscopy of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies exhibits partially digested bacteria.

terms.name: Body ache
