terms.definition: Body ache is a complaint that is often used to denote vague symptoms of mild fatigue, lethargy, or dull aches. We will define it here to mean a dull and poorly localizable pain that is described by the affected individual to affect multiple joints or body parts or even the entire body.

terms.name: Substantia nigra hypointensity on susceptibility-weighted imaging
synonyms: Low signal intensity in the substantia nigra on susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI)
terms.definition: Hypointence (dark) appearance of the substantia nigra inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI).

terms.name: Globus pallidus hypointensity on susceptibility-weighted imaging
terms.name_zh: 磁敏感加权成像苍白球低信号
terms.definition: Hypointence (dark) appearance of the globus pallidus inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI).

terms.name: Pharyngalgia
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the throat.

terms.name: Impaired executive functioning
terms.definition: A disturbance of executive functioning, which is broadly defined as the set of abilities that allow for the planning, executing, monitoring, and self-correcting of goal-directed behavior while inhibiting task-irrelevant behavior. At least some degree of executive skill is needed to complete most cognitive tasks, and deficits in executive abilities are central to many clinical conditions, including fronto-temporal dementia.

terms.name: Non-epileptic seizure
terms.definition: Psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (PNES) are not abnormal perceptions or abnormal beliefs/judgments, nor are they epileptic attacks. They are behaviors that simulate epileptic attacks, not fully consciously.

terms.name: Pseudoseizure
terms.definition: Sudden, involuntary seizure-like attacks that, unlike epileptic seizures, are not related to electrographic ictal discharges.

terms.name: Myoclonic tremor
terms.definition: A tremor-like cortical myoclonus. The tremulous movements are in fact small, high-frequency myoclonic jerks, induced by posture or action. They can be mild, but can also be more incapacitating. When present in the lower limbs, these may lead to gait disorders and even drop attacks. These tremor-like movements during action can be mistaken for essential tremor or epileptic seizures.

terms.name: Impaired ability to plan
terms.definition: Impaired ability to anticipate future events, implement instructions or goals, and develop appropriate steps ahead of time in order to carry out a task or activity.

terms.name: Impaired ability to organize
terms.definition: Impaired ability to bring order to information, actions, or materials to achieve a goal or to follow an established organized routine.

terms.name: Decreased circulating terminal complement component concentration
terms.name_zh: 血终末补体成分浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration below the lower limit of normal of one or more components of the the terminal membrane attack complex (MAC) portion of complement, which represents the lytic, pore-forming part of the system. The MAC comprises seven components: C5b, C6, C7, C8 (a heterotrimer composed of C8alpha, C8beta and C8gamma) and multiple copies of C9.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C7 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C7 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C6 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C6 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C5 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C5 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased factor IX activity
terms.definition: Elevated activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

terms.name: Abnormal factor IX activity
terms.definition: Abnormal activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

terms.name: Shortened sleep phase
terms.definition: A tendency to sleep fewer hours than usual while feeling well-rested.

terms.name: Renal interstitial globotriaosylceramide inclusions
terms.definition: Accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) in kidney tissues, which can be quantified as the number of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) inclusions/kidney interstitial capillary (KIC).

terms.name: Mild albuminuria
terms.definition: The presence of mildly increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) less than 30 mg/gm (less than 3.4 mg/mmol).

terms.name: Severe albuminuria
terms.definition: The presence of severely increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio greater than 300 mg/gm (greater than 34 mg/mmol).

terms.name: Medication crystalluria
terms.definition: A variety of drugs may occasionally cause transient crystalluria, in isolation or in conjunction with other urinary abnormalities. Overdose, dehydration, or hypoalbuminaemia, which increases the unbound drug which is ultrafiltrated by the glomerulus, are the factors usually favoring the precipitation of crystals within the tubular lumina. In some cases, medication-induced crystalluria has a distinct phenotypic appearance. For instance, Sulphadiazine crystals appear as strongly birefringent 'shocks of wheat' or 'shells' with an amber color. Acyclovir crystals are birefringent and needle-shaped, and when present in abundance give to urine a silky and opalescent macroscopic appearance.

terms.name: Renal interstitial IgG4+ plasma cell infiltration
terms.definition: An increased number of IgG4+ plasma cells in the interstitial space of the kidney.

terms.name: Impaired self monitoring
terms.definition: Impaired ability to track awareness of the effect that one's behavior has on others and how it compares with standards or expectations for behavior.

terms.name: Impaired task monitoring
terms.definition: Impaired ability to keep track of one's problem-solving success or failure, and to identify and correct mistakes during performance of a goal.

terms.name: Abnormal macroscopic urine appearance
terms.definition: Anomalous physical appearance (color, cloudiness, clarity) or odor of urine.

terms.name: Urate tophus
terms.definition: Intradermal urate crystal deposits appeared as small, superficial, pustule-like, whitish lesions. The lesions may be the focus of inflammatory episodes with increasing pain, swelling, and erythema of the intradermal tophi.

terms.name: Steroid-responsive anemia
terms.definition: Amelioration of anemia upon treatment with a steroid medication.

terms.name: Inappropriately normal thyroid-stimulating hormone level
terms.name_zh: 促甲状腺激素水平不当正常
terms.definition: A normal or elevated serum thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level in the face of an elevation in circulating FT4 and/or FT3.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating free T4 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环游离甲状腺素浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of free thyroxine (T4) in the blood circulation. Circulating T4 is almost entirely bound to specific transport proteins such as thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) but it is the unbound (free) fraction that is able to enter tissues and exert effects.

terms.name: Increased circulating free T4 concentration
terms.definition: An elevated concentration of free thyroxine (fT4) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating free T4 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环游离甲状腺素浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of free thyroxine (fT4) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thyroid gland
terms.name_zh: 甲状腺发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Abnormal TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test
terms.name_zh: 促甲状腺激素释放激素兴奋试验促甲状腺激素反应异常
synonyms: Abnormal TSH response to TRH stimulation test
terms.definition: Thyrotrophin-releasing hormone (TRH) is a hypothalamic tripeptide synthesized by, stored within, and released from the hypothalamus. It stimulates the synthesis and release of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) from the anterior pituitary gland. Following administration of exogenous TRH, a transient increase in serum TSH is expected. This term refers to an abnormal response in the TRH stimulation test.

terms.name: Absent TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test
terms.name_zh: 促甲状腺激素释放激素兴奋试验TSH反应缺失
terms.definition: Failure to increase serum TSH levels in response to a TRH stimulation test.

terms.name: Reduced TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test
terms.definition: A lower than normal TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test.

terms.name: Increased circulating farnesol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环法尼醇浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevated level of farnesol in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal antral follicle count
terms.definition: Any deviation from a count of antral follicles that is normal for age. Antral follicles appear as small fluid-filled sacs that contain an immature egg. Antral follicle count can be measured (usually on day 2-5 of the menstrual cycle) by transvaginal ultrasound. The number of antral follicles may reflect ovarian reserve.

terms.name: Reduced antral follicle count
terms.definition: A count of antral follicles that is lower than normal for age.

terms.name: Increased antral follicle count
terms.definition: A count of antral follicles that is higher than normal for age.

terms.name: Quotidian fever
terms.definition: Fever that occurs at daily intervals.

terms.name: Valinuria
terms.definition: Urine valine level above the normal range.

terms.name: Branched-chain aminoaciduria
terms.definition: An increased level of a branched chain family amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased aromatic amino acid level in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿芳香族氨基酸水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated level of an aromatic amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Tyrosinuria
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of tyrosine in the urine.

terms.name: Increased urine succinate level
terms.definition: The concentration of succinate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased glutamine family amino acid level in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿谷氨酰胺族氨基酸水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated level of an glutamine family amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased urine glutamate level
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glutamate in the urine.

terms.name: Increased sulfur amino acid level in urine
synonyms: Increased sulfur-containing amino acid level in urine
Increased sulphur amino acid level in urine
terms.definition: An elevated level of a sulfur-containing amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased aspartate family amino acid level in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿天冬氨酸族氨基酸水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated level of an aspartate family amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased urine proteinogenic amino acid derivative level
terms.name_zh: 尿蛋白氨基酸衍生物水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated urine level of a compound that is derived from an amino acid.

terms.name: Increased urinary non-proteinogenic amino acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿非蛋白氨基酸水平升高
synonyms: Abnormal urinary non-proteinogenic amino acid level
Elevated urinary non-proteinogenic amino acid level
terms.definition: An increased level in the urine of an alpha-amino acid which is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.

terms.name: Increased serine family amino acid in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿丝氨酸族氨基酸升高
terms.definition: An increased level of a serine family amino acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased proteinogenic amino acid level in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿蛋白源性氨基酸水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated level of a proteinogenic amino acid in the urine. These are the 23 alpha-amino acids that are precursors to proteins, and are incorporated into proteins during translation. The group includes the 20 amino acids encoded by the nuclear genes of eukaryotes together with selenocysteine, pyrrolysine, and N-formylmethionine.

terms.name: Elevated urine aconitic acid level
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of aconitic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Monkey wrench femoral neck
synonyms: Monkey wrench appearance of femoral neck
Monkey wrench configuration of the proximal femur
Swedish key appearance of femoral neck
Swedish key configuration of the proximal femur
terms.definition: The femoral neck region shows medial metaphyseal beaking and a significant enlargement of the lesser trochanter (with some enlargement also of the greater trochanter), producing a monkey wrench (Swedish key) configuration of the proximal femur. A monkey wrench refers to a type of adjustable wrench with one fixed and one adjustable jaw at right angles to a straight handle.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CHI3L1 concentration
synonyms: Elevated chitinase-3-like protein 1 level in blood
Increased chitinase-3-like protein 1 level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of CHI3L1 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Inappropriate absence of fever
terms.definition: Failure to develop fever in the presence of an infection that normally would be expected to elicit a febrile response.

terms.name: Interhypothalamic adhesion
terms.definition: An abnormal parenchymal band connecting the medial margins of the left and right hypothalami across the third ventricle.

terms.name: Elevated circulating D-dimer concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of D-dimers, a marker of fibrin degradation, in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环蛋白氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of proteinogenic amino acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid derivative concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环蛋白氨基酸衍生物浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid derivative concentration
Abnormal proteinogenic amino acid derivative level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of proteinogenic amino acid derivative in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating non-proteinogenic amino acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环非蛋白氨基酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating non-proteinogenic amino acid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an alpha-amino acid that is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alpha-aminobutyric acid concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of alpa-aminobutyric acid in the blood circulation. Alpha-aminobutyric acid alpha-amino acid that is butyric acid bearing a single amino substituent located at position 2.

terms.name: 3-hydroxyisovaleric aciduria
terms.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyisovaleric acid in the urine above the normal range.

terms.name: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein C-III concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环载脂蛋白C-III浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated apolipoprotein C-III level in blood
Increased apolipoprotein C-III level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein C-III in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Gallop rhythm
terms.definition: In the normal heart cycle, two heart sounds can be heard by auscultation per cycle: S1 and S2. A gallop rhythm refers to the presence of three or four heart sounds per cardiac cycle, which is said to resemble the gallop of a horse.

terms.name: Quadruple gallop rhythm
terms.definition: A type of gallop rhythm in which both the third and the fourth sounds are present.

terms.name: Elevated circulating tenascin-C concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of tenascin-C in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Duodenal gastric metaplasia
terms.definition: Foci of gastric-type mucus-secreting cells interspersed between duodenal enterocytes. These foci of gastric epithelial cells contain Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive neutral mucin and lack a brush border.

terms.name: Duodenitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the upper small intestine (duodenum).

terms.name: Abnormal right ventricular function
terms.definition: Anomalous physiology (function) of the right ventricle.

terms.name: Elevated right ventricular systolic pressure
terms.definition: Elevation of right ventricular systolic pressure (RVSP) above normal limits. In adults, RVSP is normally 20-30 mmHg.

terms.name: Nummular eczema
terms.definition: A type of eczema characterized by pruritic coin-shaped patches on the skin. Nummular eczema most commonly occurs on the extremities, particularly the legs, but may occur anywhere on the trunk, hands, or feet

terms.name: Barking cough
terms.definition: A cough with a characteristic sound that has been compared to a seal's bark.

terms.name: Absent P wave
synonyms: Absence of P wave on electrocardiography
terms.definition: The P wave that normally precedes each QRS complex by a fixed PR interval of 120 to 200 milliseconds is not present.

terms.name: Elevated circulating osteopontin concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of osteopontin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating sorbitol concentration
terms.definition: An concentration of sorbitol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Follicular lymphoma
terms.definition: An indolent B cell lymphoproliferative disorder of transformed follicular center B cells. Follicular lymphoma is characterized by diffuse lymphadenopathy, bone marrow involvement, splenomegaly and less commonly other extranodal sites of involvement.

terms.name: Cutaneous necrosis
terms.definition: Skin and subcutaneous tissue necrosis (tissue death). Clinically, cutaneous necrosis may present as a painful and extremely tender black eschar (dead tissue found in a full-thickness wound) surrounded by dusky grey-red colored skin or as slough (dead tissue, usually cream or yellow in colour).

terms.name: Abnormality of the musculoskeletal system
terms.definition: An anomaly of the musculoskeletal system, which consists of the bones of the skeleton, muscles, cartilage, tendons, ligaments, joints, and other connective tissue. The musculoskeletal system supports the weight of the body, maintains body position and produces movements of the body or of parts of the body.

terms.name: Delayed ability to crawl
terms.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to crawl at an appropriate developmental stage. Normal infant motor development is marked by a series of postural milestones including learning to crawl on hands and knees between the ages of 6 and 10 months.

terms.name: Abnormal shoulder physiology
terms.definition: Anopmalous function of the shoulder. The shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint that is made up of humerus, scapula and clavicle, which are connected by the sternoclavicular joint (SC), the acromioclavicular joint (AC), the glenohumeral joint (GH), and the scapulothoracic joint (ST). The GH, AC and SC joints link the upper extremity to the axial skeleton at the thorax and enable movement at the shoulder joint: flexion, extension, and rotation of the arm.

terms.name: Abnormal renal echogenicity
terms.definition: Anomalous echogenicity of the kidney on ultrasound examination.

terms.name: Renal medullary hyperechogenicity
terms.definition: Increased echogenecity of the medullary region of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal cortical hyperechogenicity
terms.definition: Increased echogenecity of the kidney cortex.

terms.name: Abdominal adhesions
terms.definition: Fibrous bands (i.e., bands of scar-like tissue) that span two or more intra-abdominal organs and/or the inner abdominal wall (i.e. peritoneal membrane).

terms.name: Hepatic infarction
terms.definition: Hepatic infarction is defined as areas of coagulative necrosis from hepatocyte cell death caused by local ischemia. Liver infarctions appear as hypoechoic nonvascular regions on conventional and Doppler sonography.

terms.name: Lymph node abscess
terms.definition: An inflamed lymph node that is filled with pus.

terms.name: Abnormal pulmonary alveolar system morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the pulmonary acinus, alveolar parenchyma, or alveoli.

terms.name: Right atrial thrombus
terms.definition: A thrombus (i.e., a blood clot formed in situ within the vascular system) located in the right atrium of the heart.

terms.name: Elevated circulating uracil concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of uracil in the blood circulation is above the normal range.

terms.name: Blake's pouch cyst
terms.definition: The presence of an upwardly displaced normal cerebellar vermis, normal appearance of the fastigium, tentorium and size of the cisterna magna.

terms.name: Severe SARS-CoV-2 infection
terms.definition: Unusually severe clinical course of SARS-CoV-2 infection, manifested clinically by features such as dyspnea and hypoxia with diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities of the lungs on computed tomographic scan with progressive respiratory insufficiency necessitating oxygen supplementation or mechanical ventilation.

terms.name: Long nasal bridge
terms.definition: Increased superior-inferior length of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose.

terms.name: Jejunitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the middle section of the small intestine.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环铜蓝蛋白浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating methylsuccinic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甲基琥珀酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of methylsuccinic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating short-chain fatty acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环短链脂肪酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of short-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating isovaleric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环异戊酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of isovaleric acid, a C5, branched-chain saturated fatty acid, in the blood concentration.

terms.name: Intrahepatic bile duct dilatation
terms.definition: Increased diameter (caliber) of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts).

terms.name: Anorectal abscess
terms.definition: An abscess located at the junction of the anal canal and the rectum.

terms.name: Abnormal pharynx morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the pharynx.

terms.name: Abnormal pharynx physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the pharynx.

terms.name: Elevated circulating dodecenoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环十二碳烯酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased circulation of dodecenoylcarnitine, C12:1, in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating deoxypyridinoline concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环脱氧吡啶啉浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of lysyl-pyridinoline (deoxypyridinoline) cross-links in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating L-alloisoleucine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血L-别异亮氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated urine L-alloisoleucine level
terms.name_zh: 尿L-别异亮氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Abnormally increased level of L-alloisoleucine in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-methylhistidine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血3-甲基组氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Abnormal increase of the concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced respiratory ciliary beating frequency
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the number of beats per unit time of the respiratory cilia.

terms.name: Reduced urinary inosine level
terms.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Inosine is a purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.

terms.name: Decreased urinary guanosine level
terms.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Guanosine is a purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary purine level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a purine compound in the urine. Purines are aromatic heterocyclic compounds containing a purine moiety, which is formed a pyrimidine-ring ring fused to an imidazole ring. Two of the four deoxyribonucleotides (deoxyadenosine and deoxyguanosine) and two of the four ribonucleotides (adenosine, or AMP, and guanosine, or GMP) are purines.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary pyrimidine level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a pyrimidine compound in the urine. Pyrimidines and pyrimidine derivatives are compounds containing a pyrimidne ring, which is a six-member aromatic heterocycle which consists of two nitrogen atoms (at positions 1 and 3) and four carbon atoms. The nucleotides cytosine, thymine and uracil are pyrimidines.

terms.name: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
terms.definition: An increased number and/or abnormal type of bacteria in the small bowel. Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth has been defined as the presence of greater than one hundred thousand bacteria (i.e. colony-forming units, CFU) per mL of proximal jejunal aspiration. The normal value is ten thousand or few CFU/ml.

terms.name: Focal active colitis
terms.definition: Focal active colitis (FAC) is characterized by focal crypt damage caused by neutrophils. FAC is characterized by an inflammatory infiltrate consisting of intraepithelial neutrophils and/or neutrophils invading the lumen of the criptae, with no other microscopic alteration of the colonic mucosa and, in particular, without the presence of signs of chronic inflammation.

terms.name: Necrotizing enterocolitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the intestine leading to bacterial invasion causing cellular damage and death which causes necrosis of the colon and intestine.

terms.name: Recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to viral upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections (otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).

terms.name: Neutrophilic urticarial dermatosis
terms.definition: A neutrophilic interstitial, perivascular and/or perieccrine infiltrate with leukocytoclasia. Notably, leukocytoclastic vasculitis is not present.

terms.name: Reduced mevalonate kinase activity
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced activity of mevalonate kinase, which is a key enzyme in the mevalonate biosynthetic pathway that leads to the synthesis of both cholesterol and nonsterol isoprenoids.

terms.name: Reduced total lung capacity
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced volume of air in the lungs upon the maximum effort of inspiration.

terms.name: Abnormal skinfold thickness measurement
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of a skinfold thickness, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.

terms.name: Abnormal triceps skinfold thickness
terms.name_zh: 肱三头肌皮褶厚度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the thickness of the triceps skinfold, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.

terms.name: Increased triceps skinfold thickness
terms.name_zh: 肱三头肌皮褶厚度增加
terms.definition: Increased thickness of the triceps skinfold, which is measured halfway down the back of the upper arm is increased.

terms.name: Milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
terms.name_zh: 支气管肺泡灌洗液乳糜样外观
terms.definition: Return of lavage fluid with a milky appearance due to the accumulation of a mixture of pulmonary surfactant, which is a lipoprotein complex, in the alveolar space.

terms.name: Bloody bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
terms.name_zh: 血性支气管肺泡灌洗液
terms.definition: Return of lavage fluid characteristically has a bloody appearance in pulmonary alveolar hemorrhage. This is due to admixture of blood, which typically increases with each consecutive lavage portion. Microscopically erythrocytes can be seen. After 24 to 48 h macrophages contain phagocytosed erythrocytes, indicating previous bleeding.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 5-oxoproline concentration
terms.name_zh: 血5-氧代脯氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of L-pyroglutamic acid in the blood is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Submandibular lymph node enlargement
terms.definition: Increased size of the lymph nodes that are located beneath the mandible (lower jaw).

terms.name: Elevated circulating suberic acid concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of suberic acid in the blood circulation. Suberic acid is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,6-dicarboxy derivative of hexane.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 8 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白介素8浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-8 in the circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating aconitic acid concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of aconitic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Torsion of appendix of testis
synonyms: Twisted vestigial remnant of the Muellerian duct
terms.definition: The appendix testis or hydatid of Morgagni, is a vestigial remnant of the Müllerian duct located on the superior pole of the testicle between the testis and epididymis. Although this appendage has no vital function, it is present in 50% of males. Torsion of twisting of this vestigial remnant can be incredibly painful, but usually requires no medical intervention.

terms.name: Spinal epidural abscess
synonyms: A severe pyogenic infection of the epidural space
terms.definition: Spinal epidural abscess (SEA) is caused by a suppurative infection in the epidural space. The mass effect of the abscess can compress and reduce blood flow to the spinal cord, conus medullaris, or cauda equina.

terms.name: Increased circulating cathepsin D level
terms.name_zh: 血循环组织蛋白酶D水平升高
terms.definition: An increase in concentration of cathepsin D in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Bilobed right lung
terms.definition: A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only two lobes of the right lung.

terms.name: Triggered by EBV infection
synonyms: Triggered by Epstein Barr virus infection
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by the Epstein-Barr virus.

terms.name: Misalignment of the pulmonary veins
terms.definition: The term is commonly used to describe a putative abnormal location of pulmonary vein branches adjacent to pulmonary arteries within the same adventitial sheath. However, evidence has been provided that the vessels in question are not pulmonary veins, however represent dilated bronchial veins.

terms.name: Hyperimidodipeptiduria
terms.definition: Elevated levels of proline-containing dipeptides in urine.

terms.name: Cystic acne
terms.definition: A severe type of acne characterized by the formation of cysts enclosing a mixture of keratin and sebum.

terms.name: Radiculomegaly
terms.definition: Tooth root length more than 2 SD above mean, or subjectively apparently increased tooth root length.

terms.name: Hypertrichotic hyperpigmented patch
terms.definition: A large nonpalpable spot of the skin over 1 cm in dimension with increased pigmentation and increased hair growth.

terms.name: Increased circulating selenium concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating selenium concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Ballooning hepatocyte degeneration
terms.definition: Swelling of the hepatocyte, rounding of its contour, and alteration of the cytoplasm, which takes on a reticulated, rarefied, or flocculant quality. The cytoplasm of the ballooned hepatocytes often contains clumps of eosinophilic ropey material known as Mallory-Denk bodies (MDBs) or Mallory hyaline, which is composed of hyperphosphorylated misfolded intermediate filaments, ubiquitin, and ubiquitin-binding protein P62.

terms.name: Perioral erythema
terms.definition: Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the mouth.

terms.name: Perianal erythema
terms.definition: Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the anus.

terms.name: Portal inflammation
terms.definition: Infiltration of portal fields by inflammatory cells.

terms.name: Hepatic lobular inflammation
terms.definition: Infiltration of inflammatory cells in lobules of the liver. A focus of lobular inflammation can be defined as two or more inflammatory cells (neutrophils, lymphocytes and other mononuclear cells, eosinophils and microgranulomas) within the lobule present within the sinusoids or surrounding injured hepatocytes (ballooned or apoptotic hepatocytes).

terms.name: Triggered by viral infection
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by a virus.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 10 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白细胞介素10浓度升高
terms.definition: An elevation of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Triceps hyporeflexia
terms.definition: Reduced intensity of the triceps tendon reflex.

terms.name: Biceps hyporeflexia
terms.definition: Reduced intensity of the biceps tendon reflex.

terms.name: Brachioradialis hyporeflexia
terms.definition: Reduced intensity of the brachioradialis tendon reflex.

terms.name: Brachioradialis hyperreflexia
terms.definition: Increased intensity of the brachioradialis reflex.

terms.name: Triceps hyperreflexia
terms.definition: Increased intensity of the triceps reflex.

terms.name: Biceps hyperreflexia
terms.definition: Increased intensity of the biceps reflex.

terms.name: Hyperactive Achilles reflex
terms.definition: Increased intensity of the Achilles reflex.

terms.name: Increased CD21low B cell proportion
synonyms: Increased proportion autoreactive unresponsive CD21-/low B cells
terms.definition: Increased proportion relative to B-lymphocytes of a subset of B lymphocytes characterized by dim/low levels of CD21, i.e., CD21-/low, in flow cytometry, and additionally enriched in autoreactive clones as determined for instance by clonse showing rheumatoid factor (anti-IgG) reactivity and antibodies recognizing cytoplasmic and to a lesser extent nuclear structures.

terms.name: Alveolar capillary dysplasia
terms.name_zh: 肺泡毛细血管发育不良
terms.definition: A developmental defect of the alveolar airspace during cananicular lung development characterized by a decreased number of pulmonary capillaries located away from the alveolar epithelium, thickened alveolar septae, media hypertrophy of small pulmonary arteries and muscularization of distal arterioles, and in some cases lymphangiectasis.

terms.name: Acinar dysplasia
terms.definition: Arrest of lung development in the pseudoglandular stage (weeks 8 to 16 of human gestation) resulting in small sized lungs, predominantly composed of bronchial and bronchiolar structures embedded in abundant loose mesenchyme that is poorly vascularized. Acinar structures are essentially absent, with no significant formation of saccules and no alveoli.

terms.name: Congenital alveolar dysplasia
terms.definition: Arrest of lung development in the cananicular stage (weeks 18 to 26 of human gestation) resulting in simplified acinar spaces, frequently with abundant intervening mesenchyme and no alveoli. In later arrest growth stages early saccular formations may be seen. May resemble the lobular maldevelopment often seen in alveolar capillary dysplasia/misaligment of the pulmonary veins without vein misalignment or marked hypertensive changes of the pulmonary arteries.

terms.name: Decreased total iron binding capacity
terms.definition: A reduction in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity.

terms.name: Abnormal total iron binding capacity
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added.

terms.name: Elevated urine suberic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of suberic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Recurrent viral pneumonia
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral pneumonia, as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral pneumonias.

terms.name: Obliterative abnormality of the renal glomerulus
Glomerular hyalinosis
terms.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus. Distribution can include vascular pole, perihilar, tip or neither tip, perihilar or vascular.

terms.name: Perihilar glomerular hyalinosis
terms.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the vascular pole/perihilum.

terms.name: Glomerular hyalinosis at the tubular pole
terms.name_zh: 肾小管极肾小球透明变性
terms.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the tip/tubular pole.

terms.name: Glomerular hyalinosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
terms.name_zh: 远离血管极和肾小管极的肾小球透明变性
terms.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at neither tip nor perihilar/vascular poles. Both the vascular and the tubular pole are present in the glomerular cross section.

terms.name: 2-ethylhydracylic aciduria
terms.definition: An increased concentration of 2-ethylhydracylic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased CD4:CD8 ratio
terms.definition: An abnormal elevation of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells.

terms.name: Inverted CD4:CD8 ratio
terms.definition: CD4:CD8 ratio less than 1, measured either as proportion of total CD3+ T cells, or in absolute numbers per microliter. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population. Normally there are relatively more CD4+ than CD8+ T cells.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular parietal epithelial cell morphology
terms.name_zh: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞形态异常
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the parietal epithelial cells that line the inside of Bowman's capsule and form an inconspicuous sheet of flat epithelial cells in continuity with the proximal tubular epithelial cells at the urinary pole and with the podocytes at the vascular pole.

terms.name: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hyperplasia
terms.name_zh: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞增生
synonyms: Hyperplasia of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell
terms.definition: Increased number of parietal epithelial cells lining Bowman's capsule. Hyperplasia leads to the cells being present in 2 or more layers, often with crowding and multilayering.

terms.name: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hypertrophy
terms.name_zh: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞肥大
synonyms: Hypertrophy of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell
terms.definition: An abnormality of the glomerular parietal epithelial cells characterized by (1) Increased parietal epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets; or (2) enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. Both features can be present

terms.name: Bowman capsular hyaline drops
synonyms: Capsular hyaline drops within Bowman's capsule
terms.definition: An insudative accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material protruding from Bowman's capsule into the urinary space. Although not always evident by light microscopy, this material is located between Bowman's capsule and the parietal epithelial cells, in some cases associated with newly formed matrix material.

terms.name: Glomerular synechial adhesion
terms.definition: An area of basement membrane continuity between the glomerular tuft and Bowman's capsule, without intervening crescent and not adjacent to an area of segmental sclerosis.

terms.name: Triceps areflexia
terms.definition: Inability to elicit triceps tendon reflex.

terms.name: Brachioradialis areflexia
terms.definition: Inability to elicit brachioradialis tendon reflex.

terms.name: Biceps areflexia
terms.definition: Inability to elicit biceps tendon reflex.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular mesangial cellularity
terms.name_zh: 肾小球系膜细胞密度异常
terms.definition: Abnormal number of its constituent cells of the mesangium of the glomerulus of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular mesangial matrix morphology
terms.name_zh: 肾小球系膜基质形态异常
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the glomerular matrix. Mesangial cells generate and embed in their own extracellular matrix. The mesangial matrix is different in composition from the glomerular basement membrane. Its constituents are type IV collagen (but only the alpha1 and alpha2 chains); type V collagen; laminin A, B1, and B2; and considerable amounts of fibronectin, heparan sulfate and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans, entactin, and nidogen. Furthermore, small amounts of the proteoglycans decorin and biglycan are found in the mesangial matrix.

terms.name: Paramesangial deposits
terms.definition: Mesangial immune deposit located adjacent to the paramesangial glomerular basement membrane.

terms.name: Mesangial hyaline deposition
terms.definition: Extracellular mesangial accumulation of moderately electron-dense, generally homogenous, amorphous-appearing extracellular material.

terms.name: Difficulty descending stairs
terms.definition: Reduced ability to desscend stairs.

terms.name: Cognitive fatigue
terms.definition: A failure to sustain attention that requires self-motivation to optimize performance.

terms.name: Visceral epithelial cell detachment
terms.definition: Detachment of visceral epithelial cells (podocytes) from underlying glomerular basement membrane with intervening new loose basement membrane material (pale on Hematoxylin and eosin, periodic acid-Shiff, trichrome, or silver stain) forming a so-called 'halo'.

terms.name: Podocyte microvillous transformation
terms.definition: Cytoplasmic projections into the urinary space from the luminal side of the podocyte.

terms.name: Visceral epithelial cell capping
terms.definition: Layer of hypertrophied visceral epithelial cells overlying a sclerosed segment of the tuft of the glomerulus.

terms.name: Elevated RV/TLC ratio
terms.definition: An increase in the ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and (3) body plethysmography. An elevated RV/TLC can be interpreted as a sign of air trapping and hyperinflation.

terms.name: Polyalveolar lobe
terms.definition: An elevation of the total count of alveoli as determined by microscopic point-counting of randomly taken lung sections, not secondary to abnormalities in number, size and structure of the airways. In polyaveolar lobe, the number of alveoli is generally increased three to fivefold.

terms.name: Horseshoe lung
terms.definition: A horseshoe lung is an uncommon congenital abnormality caused by the partial fusion of the bases of both lungs behind the pericardial sac.

terms.name: Pulmonary necrosis
terms.definition: Cellular death affecting one or more parts of the lung. Necrosis is caused by diverse external and internal factors which result in the unregulated digestion of cell components.

terms.name: Glycogen accumulation in pulmonary interstitial cells
terms.definition: Accumulation of immature interstitial cells containing abundant cytoplasmic glycogen defined by periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) positive cells.

terms.name: Abnormal alveolar type II pneumocyte morphology
synonyms: Abnormal alveolar epithelial type II cell morphology
Abnormal pulmonary type II cell morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of alveolar type 2 (ATII) cells.

terms.name: Type II pneumocyte hypertrophy
terms.definition: Increase in size of type II pneumocytes, characterized by qualitative morphologic alterations, including cuboidal shapes, increased nucleocytoplasmic ratio, enlarged nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and various alterations in their nuclear chromatin.

terms.name: Pulmonary amyloidosis
terms.definition: Extracellular deposition in lung tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding.

terms.name: Multiple pulmonary interstitial hyalinized nodules
terms.definition: Fibrosing nodules, consisting of either unilateral or bilateral central whorled deposits of lamellar collagen hyalin.

terms.name: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintensity
synonyms: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintense lesion
terms.definition: Hyperintense lesion in the substantia nigra on magnetic resonance T2 imaging.

terms.name: Nailfold capillary tortuosity
terms.definition: An increased number of turns of the blood vessels of the nailfold with a charactereistic winded or twisted appearance of the blood vessels.

terms.name: Elevated residual volume
terms.definition: Increase in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation.

terms.name: Palmar hyperlinearity
terms.definition: Exaggerated skin markings (dermatoglyphics) on the palms of the hand.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interferon gamma concentration
terms.definition: A reduction in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Anorectal stricture
terms.definition: Narrowing of the anorectum associated with inflammation or scar tissue.

terms.name: Congenital lobar overinflation
terms.definition: A congenital malformation characterized by an overdistended segment of lung, affecting an party of a lobe or the entire one. It results in progressive overinflation of one or more lobes.

terms.name: Pancolitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the entire colon.

terms.name: Delayed ability to walk with support
terms.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to walk with support (cruise) at an appropriate developmental stage.

terms.name: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
terms.definition: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) is a sudden, unexpected, witnessed or unwitnessed, non-traumatic and non-drowning death, occurring in benign circumstances, in an individual with epilepsy, with or without evidence for a seizure and excluding documented status epilepticus, in which postmortem examination has not revealed a cause of death.

terms.name: Non-motor seizure
terms.definition: A seizure with clinical manifestation but without motor signs (other than possible behavior arrest) as its initial clinical manifestation. The electrographic onset may be generalized, focal, or unknown.

terms.name: Livedo racemosa
terms.definition: Livedo racemosa describes a reddish-blue mottling of the skin in an irregular, reticular pattern. It differs from the more common livedo reticularis by its shape. Livedo racemosa consists of broken circular segments resulting in a seemingly larger pattern, as opposed to the fine, regular, complete network of livedo reticularis. Livedo racemosa results from permanent impairment of peripheral blood flow and, unlike livedo reticularis, it persists on warming.

terms.name: Renal artery aneurysm
terms.definition: Increase in diameter of a segment of the renal artery that can be defined as a focal, isolated dilatation of all three layers of the arterial wall over 1.5 times the diameter of the disease-free proximal adjacent arterial segment.

terms.name: Transphyseal fracture of the distal humerus
terms.definition: A fracture through the distal humeral physis that separates the entire distal humeral epiphysis from the metaphysis.

terms.name: Absent platelet dense granules
terms.definition: Lack of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelles.

terms.name: Enlarged platelet dense granules
terms.definition: Increased size of platelet dense granules.

terms.name: Podocyte myelin figures
terms.definition: Lamellated intracytoplasmic lipid inclusions within podocytes.

terms.name: Glomerular pseudocrescent
terms.definition: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia with resulting cellular crowding of the the urinary space. In contrast with true crescents, these proliferations lack inflammatory cells and fibrin. The cells are typically plump (not spindle-shaped) and often vacuolated, and Bowman's capsule is usually intact.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular capillary lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 肾小球毛细血管腔形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the capillary of the renal glomerulus.

terms.name: Deflation of the glomerular tuft
terms.definition: Wrinkling and folding of the capillaries without epithelial cell (podocyte) hyperplasia (formerly called ischemic type of collapse) involving o 80% of the glomerular tuft. The wrinkling is generally made by small regular folds of the glomerular basement membrane.

terms.name: Glomerular capillary collapse
terms.definition: Collapse is generally accompanied by other descriptors such as hypertrophy and hyperplasia of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, halo, protein droplets in podocytes and glomerular parietal epithelial cells (PECs).

terms.name: Glomerular capillary congestion
terms.definition: Global distention of glomerular capillaries with intraluminal intact red blood cells.

terms.name: Glomerular capillary microaneurysm
terms.name_zh: 肾小球毛细血管微动脉瘤
terms.definition: Glomerular capillary dilatation due to loosening/detachment of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) from its anchoring points, usually in the context of mesangiolysis or nodular glomerulosclerosis.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular endothelial cell morphology
terms.name_zh: 肾小球内皮细胞形态异常
terms.definition: An abnormal structure of the glomerular endothelial cells, which are highly specialized cells with fenestrae and a charged luminal glycocalyx layer that contribute to the filtration barrier.

terms.name: Loss of glomerular endothelial cell fenestration
terms.name_zh: 肾小球内皮细胞窗孔缺失
terms.definition: Loss of round to oval discontinuities normally present in the glomerular capillary endothelial cell cytoplasm.

terms.name: Glomerular endotheliosis
terms.definition: Enlargement of glomerular endothelial cells by cytoplasmic swelling with resulting partial or complete occlusion of the lumen.

terms.name: Glomerular endothelial tubuloreticular inclusion
terms.name_zh: 肾小球内皮细胞管网状包涵体
terms.definition: Inter-anastomosing tubular structures located within cisternae of endoplasmic reticulum, most often within endothelial cells and associated with exposure to interferon.

terms.name: Glomerular fibrinoid necrosis
terms.definition: Fibrin associated with glomerular basement membrane disruption and/or lysis of the mesangial matrix; this lesion does not require the presence of karyorrhexis.

terms.name: Reduced CD95-induced lymphocyte apoptosis
terms.definition: Reduced amount of programmed cell death in peripheral blood lymphocytes following exposure to CD95 (APO-1/Fas), which is a member of the death receptor family, a subfamily of the TNF-R superfamily. Crosslinking of CD95 with its natural ligand CD95L (CD178) or with agonistic antibodies such as anti-APO-1 induces apoptosis in sensitive cells.

terms.name: Enterocutaneous fistula
terms.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the intra-abdominal intestinal tract and the skin.

terms.name: Paratracheal lymphadenopathy
terms.definition: Enlargement of lymph nodes surrounding the trachea.

terms.name: Circulating nucleated red blood cells
terms.definition: The presence of nucleated red blood cells in the peripheral blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal glomerular basement membrane morphology
terms.name_zh: 肾小球基底膜形态异常
terms.definition: Any abnormal sttructure of the glomerular basement membrane.

terms.name: Segmentally thickened glomerular basement membrane
terms.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a segmental and increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.

terms.name: Diffusely thickened glomerular basement membrane
terms.name_zh: 肾小球基底膜弥漫性增厚
terms.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.

terms.name: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with no electron dense deposits
terms.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by electron microscopy.

terms.name: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with electron dense deposits
Glomerular basement membrane lucencies
terms.definition: Lucent zones within the glomerular basement membranes. May reflect remote/resolved deposits.

terms.name: Glomerular basement membrane wrinkling
terms.definition: Irregular folding of the glomerular basement membrane with an intact lamina densa.

terms.name: Glomerular subendothelial widening
terms.definition: Expansion of the space between the glomerular endothelium and lamina densa by electron-lucent material.

terms.name: Glomerular karyhorrhectic debris
terms.definition: Apoptotic, pyknotic, and fragmented nuclei within the glomerulus.

terms.name: Glomerular fibrin thrombus
terms.definition: An aggregate of coagulated blood containing fibrin, with or without entrapped cellular elements, within a glomerular capillary lumen.

terms.name: Glomerular hyaline pseudothrombus
terms.definition: Intracapillary amorphous, eosinophilic material consisting of immune deposits.

terms.name: Glomerular lipoprotein thrombus
terms.definition: Intracapillary silver-positive material that is finely vacuolated and laminated, and stains with oil red O on frozen sections.

terms.name: Mesangial Immune complex deposition
terms.definition: Extracellular meangial accumulation of finely granular material corresponding to immunoglobulin and/or complement by immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry; most typically electron-dense although this may decrease with resorption of the deposit.

terms.name: Binucleated visceral epithelial cells
terms.definition: Visceral epithelial cells with 2 nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.

terms.name: Multinucleated visceral epithelial cells
terms.definition: Visceral epithelial cells with more than two nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Abnormal complement factor H-related protein 1 level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of complement factor H-related protein 1 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Decreased complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Decreased complement factor H-related protein 1 level
Decreased complement factor H-related protein 1 level in blood
Reduced complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Reduced complement factor H-related protein 1 level
Reduced complement factor H-related protein 1 level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of complement factor H-related protein 1 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Elevated complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Elevated complement factor H-related protein 1 level
Elevated complement factor H-related protein 1 level in blood
Increased complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
Increased complement factor H-related protein 1 level
Increased complement factor H-related protein 1 level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of complement factor H-related protein 1 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 1-methylhistidine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环1-甲基组氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of 1-methylhistidine in the blood circulation. 1-methylhistidine is a derivative of L-histidine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血4-羟基苯乙酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 4-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary monocarboxylic acid level
terms.definition: Abnormally increased amount of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine. Monocarboxylic acids are molecules with one COOH functional group.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating fetuin-A concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环胎球蛋白A浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of fetuin-A in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating fetuin-A concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胎球蛋白A浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of fetuin-A in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating fetuin-A concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胎球蛋白A浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of fetuin-A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Patellar overgrowth
terms.definition: Excessive growth of the kneecap (patella).

terms.name: Ileoileal intussusception
terms.definition: A type of intussusception of the small intestine in which one part of the ileum invaginates (telescopes) into another part of the ileum.

terms.name: Osmotic diarrhea
terms.definition: Osmotic diarrhea results from the presence of osmotically active, poorly absorbed solutes in the bowel lumen that inhibit normal water and electrolyte absorption.

terms.name: Abdominal aortic dissection
terms.definition: A tear in the intimal layer of the abdominal aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers.

terms.name: Abnormal Bowman space morphology
terms.definition: Structural anomaly located in Bowman's space, which represents the beginning of the urinary space and is contiguous with the proximal convoluted tubule of the nephron.

terms.name: Urinary space collagenization
terms.definition: Acellular collagenous matrix within Bowman's space, not associated with extracapillary hypercellularity or necrosis, associated with sclerosis or deflation of the tuft.

terms.name: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia
terms.definition: Increased number of visceral epithelial cells (2 or more layers), often with crowding and multilayering, but without continuity with the parietal epithelium.

terms.name: Visceral epithelial hyaline droplets
terms.definition: Round to ovoid, Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, fuchsinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions within visceral epithelial cells.

terms.name: Glomerular crescent formation
terms.definition: Glomerular crescent refers hyperplastic lesions involving 10% or more of the circumference of Bowman's capsule. Crescents can be composed of a variable mixture of epithelial/leukocyte hypercellularity, fibrous matrix, and fibrin.

terms.name: Cellular crescent
terms.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of greater than two cell layers and involving more than 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of greater than 75% cells with or without fibrin, and less than 25% fibrous matrix.

terms.name: Fibrocellular crescent
terms.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of more than 2 cell layers and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of 25% to 75% cells with or without fibrin, and the remainder fibrous matrix.

terms.name: Fibrous crescent
terms.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary fibrosis composed of greater than 75% matrix and of less than 25% cells with or without fibrin, usually associated with disruption of Bowman's capsule and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference.

terms.name: Mesangial cell loss
terms.definition: Loss of mesangial cells segmentally or globally.

terms.name: Glomerular obsolescence
terms.definition: Globally sclerotic glomeruli are that are small and without hyalinosis and may appear with collapse of the tuft with collagenization of the urinary space. Bowman's capsule is completely or partially absent and there is no periglomerular fibrosis and glomerular size is decreased by more than 50% compared to all other glomeruli in the same biopsy. Obsolescent glomeruli may appear to be receding into the interstitium.

terms.name: Glomerular capillary wall duplication without cellular interposition
terms.name_zh: 肾小球毛细血管壁复制无细胞插入
terms.definition: Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix, with or without endocapillary hypercellularity and no evidence of interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.

terms.name: Glomerular capillary wall duplication with cellular interposition
terms.name_zh: 肾小球毛细血管壁复制伴细胞插入
terms.definition: Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix with interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.

terms.name: Elevated circulating homovanillic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环高香草酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of homovanillic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating sebacic acid concentration
terms.definition: Increased concentration of sebacic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating hydroxyphenyllactic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环羟苯乳酸浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of 4-hydroxyphenlyllactic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Nail psoriasis
terms.definition: Psoriatic nail abnormality characterized by the presence of neutrophils in the nail bed epithelium, hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, presence of exudates on the corneal epithelium, focal hypogranulosis and psoriasiform hyperplasia of the nail bed.

terms.name: Type II pneumocyte hyperplasia
terms.definition: Increase in the number of type II pneumocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal postural reflex
terms.definition: Anomaly of the physiological response to maintain the body's posture when movement and position is altered.

terms.name: Impaired neck-righting reflex
terms.definition: Abnormal neck-righting response, which is said to be a physiological response when a child is placed flat on his or her back and the head is turned 90 degrees to the right or the left. With a normal neck-righting response, there follows a reflected torsion of the vertebral column in the same direction as the induced rotation of the neck. That is, the whole body follows the direction in which the head was turned. The response is present from birth to the age of five years.

terms.name: Acute phase response
terms.definition: Presence of one or more manifestations of the acute phase response. Acute phase proteins (APP) are blood proteins primarily synthesized by hepatocytes as part of the acute phase response (APR). The APR is part of the early-defense or innate immune system, which is triggered by different stimuli including trauma, infection, stress, neoplasia, and inflammation. The APR results in a complex systemic reaction with the goal of reestablishing homeostasis and promoting healing.

terms.name: Elevated circulating serum amyloid A concentration
terms.name_zh: 血血清淀粉样蛋白A浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating serum amyloid A concentration
Elevated serum amyloid A level in blood
Increased serum amyloid A level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of serum amyloid A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Jaw contracture
terms.definition: Limitation of motion of the jaw due to structural changes in a muscle such as the massseter responsible for jaw movement.

terms.name: Abnormal embryonic development
terms.definition: An anomaly in the development of the embryo, that is, of the early developmental stage of development that follows the fertilization of an egg by sperm.

terms.name: Abnormal preimplantation embryonic development
terms.definition: An anomaly in the development of the embryo in a stage prior to implantation.

terms.name: Zygotic cleavage failure
terms.definition: Failure of a fertilized oocyte to undergo the first round of cell division.

terms.name: Abnormal gametogenesis
terms.definition: An anomaly in the process by a a haploid cell is formed from a diploid cells through meiosis. In males, diploid spermatogonia produce two haploid cells (secondary spermatocytes) in meiosis I and four haploid spermatids in meiosis II. In females, primordial germ cells under meiosis II before birth to form primary oocytes. Once puberty cell begins, these cells form secondary oocytes through meiosis II.

terms.name: Abnormal female meiosis
terms.definition: Anomalous oocyte meiosis

terms.name: Increased circulating inosine concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of inosine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating guanosine concentration
terms.definition: Increased concentration of guanosine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating sitosterol concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of beta-sitosterol in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Anti-aquaporin 4 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗水通道蛋白4抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against aquaporin-4.

terms.name: Mucoid diarrhea
terms.definition: Passage of an increased number of stools containing mucus, a thick fluid substance secreted by mucous membranes.

terms.name: Pleural cobblestoning
terms.definition: A pleural cobblestone appearance characterized by irregular bumps surrounded by depressed lines in open lung biopsy. Caused by underlying scarring causing retraction of the interlobular septa where they insert on the pleura.

terms.name: Neuralgia
terms.definition: Pain (An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience) along the course of a nerve.

terms.name: Psychic epileptic aura
terms.definition: Aura with affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual phenomena including illusory or composite hallucinatory events.

terms.name: Cognitive epileptic aura
terms.definition: A purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to altered cognition.

terms.name: Epileptic aura
terms.definition: An epileptic aura is a purely subjective clinical manifestation of an epileptic seizure. If an epileptic aura is not followed by loss of awareness or propagation to a bilateral tonic-clonic seizure then it is a type of focal aware non-motor seizure.

terms.name: Seizure cluster
terms.definition: A fourfold or greater increase of usual seizure frequency within a 3-day period, where the patient demonstrates full recovery between seizure events within the cluster. The seizure cluster should be recognizable by the primary clinician, carer or patient.

terms.name: Elevated forced expiratory volume in one second
terms.definition: An increase in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second, compared to some standard or previous measure of same subject.

terms.name: Candida esophagitis
terms.definition: Candida infections of the esophagus are considered opportunistic infections and are seen most commonly in immunosuppressed patients, the most common symptoms being dysphagia, odynophagia, and retrosternal pain.

terms.name: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis
terms.definition: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis involves sudden and potentially lethal increases in PAP and PVR that cause acute rise in right atrial and right ventricular end-diastolic pressure accompanied by low cardiac output.

terms.name: Abnormal blood vessel morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of a blood vessel (artery, arteriole, capillary, venule, or vein).

terms.name: Abnormal urine metabolite level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a metabolite in urine.

terms.name: Increased urine deoxypyridinoline level
terms.name_zh: 尿脱氧吡啶啉水平升高
terms.definition: An increased level of deoxypyridinoline in the urine. Deoxypyridinoline is a crosslink product of collagen molecules found in bone and excreted in urine during bone degradation, has been described as a marker of bone turnover.

terms.name: Elevated circulating o-phosphoserine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血邻磷酸丝氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of o-phosphoserine in the blood circulation. o-phosphoserine is a derivative of serine.

terms.name: Limited head rotation
terms.definition: Reduced range of motion turning the head side to side.

terms.name: Abnormal urine osmolality
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal range of concentration of particles in urine.

terms.name: Hyperosthenuria
terms.definition: An abnormally high urinary specific gravity, i.e., increased concentration of solutes in the urine.

terms.name: Impaired ability to shift attention
terms.definition: A behavioral abnormality whereby a person is unable to move freely from one situation, activity or aspect of aa problem to another as circumstances demand. Key aspects of shifting include the ability to make transitions, problem solve flexibly, switch or alternate attention, and change focus from one mind-set or topic to another. Mild deficits in the ability to shift compromise the efficiency of problem solving, whereas more severe difficulties are reflected in perseverative behaviors. Sometimes this is described as being rigid or inflexible.

terms.name: Nasal ulcer
terms.definition: An open sore of the nasal mucosa.

terms.name: Recurrent coughing spasms
terms.definition: Repeated occurrence of episodes of coughing, with each episode consisting of at least five minutes of continuous coughing.

terms.name: Hyaline membranes
terms.definition: Hyaline membranes are homogeneous eosinophilic material composed of cellular debris, plasma proteins, and surfactant plastered against alveolar ducts and alveolar walls. The hyaline membranes are deposited along the walls of the alveoli, where gas exchange typically occurs, thereby making gas exchange difficult.

terms.name: Lipoid pneumonia
terms.definition: A specific form of lung inflammation that results from accumulation of lipids in the alveoli. Lipoid pneumonia can be either exogenous or endogenous in cause based on the source of the lipid.

terms.name: Endogenous lipoid pneumonia
terms.definition: A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is the body itself. When an airway is obstructed, it is often the case that distal to the obstruction, lipid-laden macrophages and giant cells fill the lumen of the disconnected airspace.

terms.name: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia
terms.definition: A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is external to the body.

terms.name: Orthodeoxia
terms.definition: Low level of blood oxygen induced by changing from a recumbent to an upright position.

terms.name: Platypnea
terms.definition: A type of dyspnea that occurs when the affected person changes from a recumbent to an upright position.

terms.name: Cavitating leukodystrophy
terms.name_zh: 空洞性脑白质营养不良
terms.definition: A type of leukodystrophy characterized by multiple small cavitations typically in the periventricular and deep cerebral white matter. The cavitations are visible as a central cavity with cerebrospinal fluid-like signal intensity.

terms.name: Bronchial telangiectasia
terms.definition: Telangiectasias (small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes) located in the trachoebronchial system.

terms.name: Bronchocentric granulomatosis
terms.name_zh: 支气管中心性肉芽肿病
terms.definition: Granulomatous inflammation that surrounds the bronchi and bronchioles, replacing bronchial walls and mucosa. In bronchocentric granulomatosis, the lumen of the airway contains necrotic debris, and palisaded histiocytes surround the lumen.

terms.name: Abnormal KCO
terms.name_zh: 一氧化碳转运系数异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of KCO. The KCO is a measurement of the rate constant for alveolar uptake of CO during breath-holding in the single breath measurement of DLCO at full inflation. The DLCO is derived as the product of the KCO and the single breath alveolar volume (VA) divided by PB-PH2O.

terms.name: Increased KCO
terms.name_zh: 一氧化碳转运系数升高
terms.definition: Increased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).

terms.name: Decreased KCO
terms.name_zh: 一氧化碳转运系数降低
terms.definition: Decreased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).

terms.name: Anthracosis
terms.definition: Anthracosis is the deposition of black carbon pigment. It is commonly seen in perihilar lymph nodes as well as within lung parenchyma. There can be prominent storiforming (i.e., spiral patterning) of histiocytes, to such an extent as to mimic a neoplastic lesion histologically. Anthracosis is a common finding in smokers and polluted city dwellers.

terms.name: Alveolar septal thickening
terms.definition: Increased width of the alveolar septum, which is the structure that separates neighboring alveoli. This finding can be appreciated on histology.

terms.name: Increased airway neuroendocrine cells
terms.name_zh: 气道神经内分泌细胞增多
terms.definition: Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cells (NECs) within distal airways. There are no formal criteria for an increase (which is also dependent on the sensitivity of the staining method), findings of neuroendocrine cells in at least 70% of bronchioles by lung biopsy and at least 10% NECs in an individual airway are consistent with the diagnosis of Neuroendocrine cell hyperplasia of infancy in the appropriate clinical setting. Increases are also seen in other clinical settings. Neuroendocrine neoplasms of the lung encompass NE tumors (NETs), which split into typical and atypical carcinoids, and NE carcinomas (NECs).

terms.name: Increased airway neuroepithelial bodies
terms.name_zh: 气道神经上皮小体增多
terms.definition: Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cell cluster (neuroepithelial bodies) in the alveolar ducts.

terms.name: Bilateral superior vena cava
terms.definition: The presence of a left and a right superior vena cava.

terms.name: Nasal chondritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the cartilage of the nose.

terms.name: Elevated circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血硬脂酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of O-stearoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating palmitoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血棕榈酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of palmitoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude
terms.name_zh: 复合肌肉动作电位波幅降低
terms.definition: Reduced level of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP), which is recorded following electrical stimulation of a nerve from surface electrodes overlying a muscle supplied by that nerve.

terms.name: Elevated urinary collagen degradation products
terms.definition: Increased level in the urine of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.

terms.name: Elevated urine pyridinoline level
terms.definition: An increased amount of pyridinoline in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating collagen degradation product concentration
terms.name_zh: 血胶原降解产物浓度异常
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration in the blood circulation of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.

terms.name: Elevated circulating pyridinoline concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (pyridinoline) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal bronchial artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of a bronchial artery.

terms.name: Bronchopulmonary anastomosis
terms.definition: Abnormal arterial anastomosis (connection) between bronchial and pulmonary arteries.

terms.name: Bronchial artery dilatation
