terms.definition: This is a general term that denotes a reduced ability to perform the work that one performed prior to an illness, and may be related to pain, cognitive dysfunction, fatigue or other physical disabilities.

terms.name: Pseudo-chilblain
terms.definition: Acral areas of erythema with vesicles or pustules. The lesions resemble chilblains and have purpuric areas, affecting hands and feet.

terms.name: Vesicular eruption
terms.definition: A type of acute-onset skin rash characterized by multiple vesicles, which are circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevation generally considered less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point. The fluid contained in a vesicle may be clear, serous, or hemorrhagic.

terms.name: Monomorphic vesicular eruption
terms.definition: A type of vesicular eruption in which the vesicles are at same stages.

terms.name: Polymorphic vesicular eruption
terms.definition: A type of vesicular eruption in which the vesicles are at different stages.

terms.name: Papulovesicular eruption
terms.definition: An acute onset rash characterized by by multiple vesicles, which are circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevations with a diameter less than 10mm at the widest point, and by multiple papules, which are circumscribed, solid epidermal elevations with no visible fluid with a diameter less than 10mm at the widest point.

terms.name: Cortical sclerosis of the iliac wing
terms.definition: Increased density related to increased bone mass in the outermost layer (edge) of the iliac wing.

terms.name: Subpleural curvilinear line
terms.definition: This finding is a thin curvilinear opacity, 1-3 mm in thickness, lying less than 1 cm from and parallel to the pleural surface. It corresponds to atelectasis of normal lung if seen in the dependent posteroinferior portion of lung of a patient in the supine position and is subsequently shown to disappear on CT sections acquired with the patient prone. It may also be encountered in patients with pulmonary edema or fibrosis (other signs are usually present).

terms.name: Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor
terms.name_zh: 胚胎发育不良性神经上皮肿瘤
terms.definition: Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor (DNT) is a benign glioneuronal neoplasm that most commonly occurs in children and young adults and may present with medically intractable, chronic seizures. Lesions vary in size from 10 to 25 mm, although occasionally larger tumors of up to 70 mm have been reported. Grossly, tumors appear as well-defined, solitary nodular masses or poorly demarcated lesions. On the cut section, most tumors are cortically located and may extend into the underlying subcortical white matter in larger tumors. Multi-nodular appearance or cystic changes are commonly found

terms.name: Elevated urinary homogentisic acid
terms.definition: An increased amount of homogentisic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Tearfulness
terms.definition: A feeling of sadness characterized by episodes of crying that can occur suddenly and are not easily controlled in social situations.

terms.name: Progressive massive fibrosis
terms.definition: This condition is caused by slow-growing conglomeration of dust particles and collagen deposition in individuals (mostly coal workers) heavily exposed to inorganic dust. Progressive massive fibrosis manifests as masslike lesions, usually bilateral and in the upper lobes. Background nodular opacities reflect accompanying pneumoconiosis, with or without emphysematous destruction adjacent to the massive fibrosis. Lesions similar to progressive massive fibrosis sometimes occur in other conditions, such as sarcoidosis and talcosis.

terms.name: Perioral hyperkeratosis
terms.definition: Increased thickness of the stratum corneum (the outer layer of the skin) in the skin surrounding the mouth.

terms.name: Anti-3-hydroxy- 3-methylglutaryl-coA reductase antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶抗体阳性

terms.name: Increased sputum production
terms.definition: An increase in the amount of airway mucus. This feature may be characterized by frequent or excessive throat clearing (exhalation through tightly constricted laryngopharyngeal tissues accompanied by vibration of the palatoglossal arch and the vocal folds serving to clear mucus from the airway).

terms.name: Rest dyspnea
terms.definition: A perception of shortness of breath that occurs independently of exertion.

terms.name: Pulmonary interstitial thickening
terms.definition: Pathological thickening of the pulmonary interstitium visualized radiographically and divided into interlobular and intralobular septal thickening.

terms.name: Repeated implantation failure
terms.definition: Repeated implantation failure refers to a situation in which embryos of good quality fail to implant following several in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment cycles.

terms.name: Anti-signal recognition particle antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗信号识别颗粒抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against anti-signal recognition particle.

terms.name: Multiple meningiomas
terms.definition: The occurrence of multiple distinct meningiomas in the same individual.

terms.name: Hippocampal sclerosis
terms.definition: Hippocampal sclerosis is a neuropathologic finding characterized by neuronal loss and gliosis in the CA-1 and subiculum of the hippocampus.

terms.name: EEG with frontal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the frontal region.

terms.name: EEG with temporal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the temporal region.

terms.name: EEG with central epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图中央区痫样放电
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the central region.

terms.name: EEG with parietal epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the parietal region.

terms.name: EEG with occipital epileptiform discharges
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the occipital region.

terms.name: EEG with centrotemporal epileptiform discharges
terms.name_zh: 脑电图中央颞区痫样放电
terms.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the centrotemporal region.

terms.name: Autonomic epileptic aura
terms.definition: An autonomic epileptic aura is a purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to autonomic nervous system function. Autonomic auras include cardiorespiratory (e.g., palpitations and shortness of breath), gastrointestinal, genitourinary (genital sensations, urinary urge), and cutaneous (feeling of warmth or cold) sensations. Abdominal auras constitute the most common type of autonomic aura. These include sensations of nausea, pain, or indescribable discomfort in the abdominal or periumbilical area that can be static, rise to the chest and throat, or descend into the lower abdominal region.

terms.name: Abnormal cerebral venous sinus morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the cerebral venous sinuses
terms.definition: Abnormal structure of the venous sinuses that drain blood from the cerebral veins and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the arachnoid granulations to the internal jugular veins.

terms.name: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
terms.definition: An intracranial thrombosis of the venous sinuses. These typically present with headache, seizures or venous stroke secondary to raised cerebral venous pressure. Cerebral venous sinus thromboses usually affect larger areas of brain parenchyma than those affected by cerebral vein thromboses.

terms.name: Thin corpus callosum
terms.definition: An abnormally thin corpus callous, due to atrophy, hypoplasia or agenesis. This term is intended to be used in situations where it is not known if thinning of the corpus callosum (for instance, as visualized by magnetic resonance tomography) is due to abnormal development (e.g. a leukodystrophy) or atrophy following normal development (e.g. neurodegeneration).

terms.name: Lupus nephritis
terms.definition: Lupus nephritis is a type of glomerulonephritis that constitutes one of the most severe organ manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus. Lupus nephritis is subclassified in six distinct classes, that represent different manifestations and severities of renal involvement and guide the therapeutic management.

terms.name: Diffuse lupus nephritis
terms.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with active or inactive diffuse, segmental or global endocapillary or extracapillary glomerulonephritis involving at least 50% of all glomeruli, typically with diffuse subendothelial immune deposits, with or without mesangial alterations.

terms.name: Mesangial proliferative lupus nephritis
terms.name_zh: 系膜增生性狼疮性肾炎
terms.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with purely mesangial hypercellularity of any degree or mesangial matrix expansion by lightmicroscopy, with mesangial immune deposits. A few isolated subepithelial or subendothelial deposits may be visible by immunoflourescence or electron microscopy, but not by light microscopy.

terms.name: Minimal mesangial lupus nephritis
terms.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with normal glomeruli by light microscopy, but mesangial immune deposits by immunofluorescence.

terms.name: Membranous lupus nephritis
terms.definition: A lupus nephritis subclass with global or segmental subepithelial immune deposits or their morphological sequelae by light microscopy and by immunofluorescence or electron microscopy, with or without mesangial alterations. May occur in combination with class III or IV, in which case both classes are diagnosed. May show advanced sclerosis

terms.name: Focal lupus nephritis
terms.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with active or inactive focal, segmental or global endocapillary or extracapillary glomerulonephritis involving less than 50% of all glomeruli, typically with focal subendothelial immune deposits, with or without mesangial alterations

terms.name: Advanced sclerotic lupus nephritis
terms.name_zh: 晚期硬化性狼疮性肾炎
terms.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with at least 90% of glomeruli globally sclerosed without residual activity.

terms.name: Low-grade vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux without dilation of the renal calyces (Grade I-II).

terms.name: High-grade vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with dilation of the renal calyces (Grade III - V).

terms.name: Grade I vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux into the ureter only.

terms.name: Grade II vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux into a non-dilated pyelocalyceal system.

terms.name: Grade III vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with dilatation of the collecting system.

terms.name: Primary vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux due to abnormalities in ureterovesical junction, e.g. ectopic insertion of the ureter or short intravesical tunnel at the ureterovesical junction.

terms.name: Secondary vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux induced by increased bladder pressures in patients with voiding dysfunction e.g. in case of congenital posterior urethral valves or neurogenic bladder dysfunction.

terms.name: Grade V vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with massive dilation of the collecting system and severe tortuosity of the ureter.

terms.name: Grade IV vesicoureteral reflux
terms.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with more-extensive dilation with blunting of the calyces and tortuosity of the ureter.

terms.name: Intrarenal reflux
terms.definition: Severe vesicoureteral reflux reaching the kidney parenchyma.

terms.name: Macular agenesis
terms.definition: A congenital defect characterized by lack of development of the macula.

terms.name: Global cerebellar dysplasia
terms.definition: A type of cerebellar dysplasia that affects the entire cerebellum.

terms.name: Dysplasia of the superior cerebellar vermis
terms.definition: A type of cerebellar dysplasia that affects the upper part of the cerebellar vermis.

terms.name: Intrascapular pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the area between the shoulder blades.

terms.name: Abnormal exteroceptive sensation
terms.definition: A type of somatic sensory dysfunction characterized by abnormality of superficial sensation that is mediated by receptors in skin and mucous membranes.

terms.name: Hypoesthesia
terms.definition: Decreased ability to perceive touch.

terms.name: Abnormal functional residual capacity
terms.definition: A deviation from normal values for the functional residual capacity, which is defined as the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation.

terms.name: Reduced functional residual capacity
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation.

terms.name: Elevated functional residual capacity
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation.

terms.name: Abnormal residual volume
terms.definition: Any deviation from normal values of the residual volume, which is defined as the volume of air left in the lungs at the end of maximal expiration (ie. the volume of air which you cannot voluntarily exhale from your lungs).

terms.name: Reduced residual volume
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation.

terms.name: Abnormal left ventricular end-diastolic volume
terms.name_zh: 左心室舒张末期容积异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of end-diastolic volume of the left ventricle, which is the volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole).

terms.name: Increased left ventricular end-diastolic volume
terms.name_zh: 左心室舒张末期容积增加
terms.definition: Abnormally high volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole).

terms.name: Decreased left ventricular end-diastolic volume
terms.name_zh: 左心室舒张末期容积减小
terms.definition: Abnormally low volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole).

terms.name: Pancreatic steatosis
terms.definition: Fat infiltration in the pancreas.

terms.name: Labial abscess
terms.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the labia.

terms.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium
terms.definition: Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium.

terms.name: Decreased maximal oxygen uptake
terms.definition: Maximum oxygen uptake (VO2max) is defined as the highest rate of oxygen uptake and utilization by the body during intense, maximal exercise, whereby further increases in work rate do not bring on additional rises in VO2 (i.e. plateau). VO2Max is typically measured with a treadmill and ergometer and the participant exercises with increasing levels of intensity. VO2Max is the point at which oxygen uptake no longer increases despite an increase in workload.

terms.name: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis
terms.definition: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis is a granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate composed of neutrophils, lymphocytes, plasma cells, xanthomatous histiocytes, and multinucleated giant cells.

terms.name: Middle cerebral artery stroke
terms.definition: Acute onset neurological deficits such as weakness, dizziness, numbness, issues with speech, or visual changes related to sudden impairment of blood flow to a part of the brain due to occlusion or rupture of the middle cerebral artery to the brain.

terms.name: Death in adulthood
terms.definition: Cessation of life at the age of 16 years or later.

terms.name: Death in middle age
terms.definition: Death between the age of 40 and 60 years.

terms.name: Death in late adulthood
terms.definition: Death at an age of at least 60 years.

terms.name: Polymelia
terms.definition: Polymelia is a congenital anomaly, which is defined as the presence of accessory limbs attached to various body regions and could be classified as cephalomelia (extra-limb attached to the head), notomelia (extra-limb attached to the back bone), thoracomelia (extra-limb attached to the thorax), and pyromelia (extra-limb attached to the pelvis).

terms.name: Abnormal single motor unit action potential
terms.name_zh: 单个运动单位动作电位异常
terms.definition: Abnormally high or low single motor unit action potential reading (-Pk Amps).

terms.name: Penile thrush
terms.definition: Overgrowth of candida albicans in the penis.

terms.name: Fundic gland polyposis
terms.definition: Multiple polyps in the acid-secreting mucosa of the gastric body and fundus. Fundic gland polyps (FGP) are usually 1 to 5 mm in size, though larger polyps have been found. FGPs are typically sessile, shiny, translucent, pale to pinkish in color (resembling the surrounding mucosa), and often exhibit tiny surface blood vessels. These polyps have characteristically been observed to chunk off or detach entirely at the base when removed with cold forceps, in contrast to other types of gastric polyps.

terms.name: Gastric adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: An adenocarcinoma arising from the stomach glandular epithelium. Gastric carcinoma often produces no specific symptoms when it is superficial and potentially surgically curable, although up to 50% of patients may have nonspecific gastrointestinal complaints such as dyspepsia.

terms.name: Pleuritic chest pain
terms.definition: Pleuritic chest pain is characterized by sudden and intense sharp, stabbing, or burning pain in the chest when inhaling and exhaling.

terms.name: Abnormal RV/TLC ratio
terms.name_zh: 残气量/肺总量比值异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and body plethysmography.

terms.name: Decreased RV/TLC ratio
terms.definition: An abnormally low ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining after maximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in the lungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and body plethysmography.

terms.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid
terms.name_zh: 肾小管尿酸重吸收障碍
terms.definition: Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid.

terms.name: Pulmonary imaging sign
terms.definition: An abnormal pulmonary imaging finding defined by eponym or reference to signs, symbols, or naturalistic images.

terms.name: Enamel pearls
terms.definition: Small nodules of enamel on the root of a tooth.

terms.name: Supernumerary cusp
terms.definition: Additional cusps of a dental crown.

terms.name: Leung cusp
terms.definition: An additional cusp located in the middle of the occlusal surface.

terms.name: Barrel-shaped tooth
terms.definition: A tooth crown with convex mesial and distal surfaces.

terms.name: Bulbous tooth
terms.definition: A tooth crown with a marked cervical area constriction.

terms.name: Tapered tooth
terms.definition: A tooth with a crown that narrows from proximal toward the incisal edge. Tapering of teeth typically involves incisors.

terms.name: Semilunar tooth
terms.definition: An incisor with a half-moon shape incisal edge.

terms.name: Molar incisor malformation
terms.definition: Molar incisor malfomation (MIM) is composed of normal crown with marked cervical constriction, thin, narrow short roots which is a combination of signs that occurs in deciduous and permanent molars.

terms.name: Dentin dysplasia
terms.definition: This is a bundled term as dentin dysplasia is composed of short roots with pointed ends and taurodontism and intrapulpal calcifications.

terms.name: Enamel agenesis
terms.definition: Complete or almost complete absence of enamel.

terms.name: Hypomature enamel
terms.definition: Enamel with a white or brown discoloration without hypoplasia.

terms.name: Cementum hypoplasia
terms.definition: The decrease or absence of cementum. The cementum anchors the periodontal ligament attachment fiber between the tooth root and the alveolar bone. Its absence leads to early loss of teeth.

terms.name: Cementum overgrowth
terms.definition: Excess of cementum on the tooth root surface.

terms.name: Triggered by cheese ingestion
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating cheese.

terms.name: Thistle tube shaped pulp
terms.definition: A thistle tube shape of the pulp chamber, meaning an enlarged coronal pulp chamber with narrow pulp canals giving a radiographic appearance of the shape of a thistle tube or a flame. It may occur isolated or associated with other dental anomalies and rare diseases such as dentinogenesis imperfecta, which should be assessed and coded separately. The diagnosis thistle tube shape pulp requires clinical and radiographic examinations.

terms.name: Tooth ankylosis
terms.definition: Fusion of a tooth with alveolar bone.

terms.name: Cross bite
terms.definition: Lingual occlusion of buccal cusps and/or incisal edge of maxillary teeth to the buccal cusps and/or incisal edge of mandibular teeth.

terms.name: Triggered by food ingestion
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating a certain food.

terms.name: Acral overgrowth
terms.definition: Excessive growth of hands and feet (predominantly due to soft tissue swelling). Typical manifestations include shoe size increase, foot enlargement, glove tightness, and hand enlargement.

terms.name: Growth without growth hormone
terms.name_zh: 非生长激素依赖性生长

terms.name: Abnormal leukocyte physiology
terms.definition: A functional abnormality of a white blood cell.

terms.name: Leukocyte migration defect
terms.definition: Any abnormality of leukocyte motility in response to chemokines, which is required for the inflammatory response to infections, and for organ development, tissues homeostasis, and vascularization.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating sex hormone concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a sex hormone in the blood circulation

terms.name: Blistering by anatomical location
terms.name_zh: 按解剖部位分类的水疱形成
terms.definition: Blistering (presence of multiple fluid filled blisters) categorized according to the body site where they occur.

terms.name: Blistering by histological location
terms.name_zh: 按组织学部位分类的水疱形成
terms.definition: Blistering (presence of multiple fluid filled blisters) categorized according to the layer of the skin in which the blister originates. The skin is divided into three layers. The epidermis (outermost layer, which mainly consists of keratinocytes), the dermis, and a subcutaneous layer. The epidermis is divided into five layers: the basal lamina (innermost layer), the basal cell layer, the stratum spinosum, the stratum granulosum, and the stratum corneum (outermost layer). Cleavage in epidermolysis bullosa (EB) simplex occurs within the basal keratinocytes; in junctional EB, within the lamina lucida; and in dystrophic EB occurs in the sublamina densa, in the upper portion of the dermis (papillary dermis). In Kindler's EB, cleavage can occur in the basal keratinocytes, in the lamina lucida, or below the lamina densa.

terms.name: Intra-epidermal blistering
terms.definition: A type of blistering in which the lesions are located within the epidermis with loss of cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes. In simplex EB, cleavage occurs in the basal layer, which is the innermost layer of the epidermis and consists of a single layer of basal germinative cells (mostly epidermal Keratinocytes) that proliferate and thereby produce new cells for other epidermal layers. As the cells move towards the upper layers of the epidermis they mature and eventually form cornified cells. The suprabasal cell layer lies directly above the basal layer and is composed of five to ten layers of cells.

terms.name: Sub-lamina densa cleavage
synonyms: Blistering with sub-lamina densa plane of cleavage
terms.definition: A type of blistering in which the cleavage plane of blisters is located below the lamina densa.

terms.name: Subepidermal blistering
terms.definition: A type of blistering in which the lesions are located beneath the epidermis.

terms.name: Non-necrotizing granuloma
terms.definition: A granuloma which is not associated with necrotic changes.

terms.name: Abnormal epidermis stratum granulosum morphology
terms.definition: An abnormal structure of the stratum granulosum, which is is a thin layer of cells in the epidermis lying above the stratum spinosum and below the stratum corneum.

terms.name: Absent keratohyalin granules
terms.definition: Lack of keratohyalin granules, which are normally present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin.

terms.name: Spermatocele
terms.definition: A cystic structure arising from the epididymis, rete testis or efferent ductuli. These structures are filled with spermatozoa containing fluid that may be milky. These cysts are usually outside the tunica vaginalis and, as with hydrocele, transluminate easily.

terms.name: Increased circulating 17 hydroxypregnenolone concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环17羟孕烯醇酮浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of 17alpha-hydroxypregnenolone in the blood circulation. 17alpha-hydroxypregnenolone is a 21-carbon steroid that is converted from pregnenolone by steroid 17-alpha-hydroxylase, as an intermediate in the biosynthesis of gonadal steroid hormones and adrenal corticosteroids.

terms.name: Decreased circulating dihydrotestosterone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环双氢睾酮浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of dihydrotestosterone in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating androstenedione concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating androstenedione concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环雄烯二酮浓度降低
terms.definition: Reduced concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Perilobular
terms.definition: Situated or occurring around a lobe of an organ.

terms.name: Paraseptal
terms.definition: Characterized by predominant involvement of the distal alveoli and their ducts and sacs. It is characteristically bounded by any pleural surface and the interlobular septa.

terms.name: Bronchocentric
terms.definition: Centered in bronchi or bronchioles.

terms.name: Centrilobular
terms.definition: Located in the center of the secondary pulmonary lobules, which are the functional units of the lungs.

terms.name: Miliary
terms.definition: Characterized by numerous small lesions said to resemble millet seed.

terms.name: Reticular
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles a net or network-like structure.

terms.name: Perilymphatic
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near lymphatic structures (node or vessel).

terms.name: Apical
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at the apex of an organ. For instance, apical refers to the superior portion of the lung.

terms.name: Pulmonary mass
terms.definition: A mass in the lung seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics).

terms.name: Mass on thoracic imaging
terms.definition: A mass is any pulmonary, pleural, or mediastinal lesion seen on chest radiographs as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics). Mass usually implies a solid or partly solid opacity. CT allows more exact evaluation of size, location, attenuation, and other features.

terms.name: Mediastinal mass
terms.definition: A mass in the mediastinum seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics).

terms.name: Pleural mass
terms.definition: A mass in the pleura seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics).

terms.name: Superior mediastinal mass
terms.definition: A type of mediastinal mass that is located above the thoracic plane (a horizontal line that runs from the manubriosternal joint (sternal angle or angle of Louis) to the inferior endplate of T4).

terms.name: Inferior mediastinal mass
terms.definition: A type of mediastinal mass that is located below the thoracic plane (a horizontal line that runs from the manubriosternal joint (sternal angle or angle of Louis) to the inferior endplate of T4).

terms.name: Anterior mediastinal mass
terms.definition: A type of inferior mediastinal mass that is located in front of the pericardium.

terms.name: Middle mediastinal mass
terms.definition: A type of inferior mediastinal mass that is located withinthe pericardium.

terms.name: Posterior mediastinal mass
terms.definition: A type of inferior mediastinal mass that is located behind the pericardium.

terms.name: Hyperdense pulmonary mass
terms.definition: A type of pulmonary mass with high attenuation.

terms.name: Cavitating pulmonary mass
terms.definition: Thick-walled abnormal gas-filled interstitial mass within a lung with a diameter greater than 30 mm.

terms.name: Livedo
terms.definition: A reddish-blue mottled condition of skin caused by inflammation of the cutaneous blood vessels.

terms.name: Elevated circulating sCD25 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of sCD25 (= soluble CD25, = soluble interleukin-2 receptor alpha-chain, = soluble IL-2 receptor alpha) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Malaise
terms.definition: A feeling of general discomfort, weakness, or lack of health.

terms.name: Abnormal renal vascular morphology
terms.definition: Anomalous structure of a blood vessel in the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal intrarenal artery morphology
synonyms: Abnormal kidney arterial blood vessel morphology
terms.definition: An anomalous structure of an artery located in the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal arcuate artery morphology
terms.definition: Anomalous structure of the arc-shaped arteries located at the border of the renal cortex and renal medulla.

terms.name: Dysphoria
terms.definition: A pervasive state of negatively valenced emotional unease and dissatisfaction along with an inner discomfort that is disproportionate to external circumstances and may include heightened emotional reactivity. It is associated with a mixture of overlapping negative emotions that are difficult to disentangle.

terms.name: Testicular pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to one or both testes.

terms.name: Postmenopausal bleeding
terms.definition: Uterine bleeding that occurs after at least one year of amenorrhea in a woman who is not receiving hormone therapy.

terms.name: Ocular pruritus
terms.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching in the region of the eye.

terms.name: Early satiety
synonyms: Not able to finish a normal-sized meal
terms.definition: The condition of being unable to eat a full meal because of a feeling of fullness (satiety), or or feeling very full after eating only a small amount of food.

terms.name: Postprandial fullness
terms.definition: Feeling excessively full after meals.

terms.name: Racing thoughts
terms.definition: An inner sense (from the self) that thoughts are moving abnormally fast and in a manner that the individual typically feels that the rate is beyond their control, i.e. they feel unable to slow the rate of thoughts. Racing thoughts by themselves have a linear progression, following a line of thinking or logic, which distinguishes racing thoughts from flight of ideas. Racing thoughts may however, co-occur with or be independent from flight of ideas, they may be associated with pressured speech or be an internal perception of the rate of thinking. The core element being the rate of the thoughts themselves.

terms.name: Sense of impending doom
terms.definition: A feeling that something life-threatening or tragic is about to occur.

terms.name: Spinal hypomyelination
terms.definition: Reduced amount of myelin in the spinal cord resulting from defective myelinogenesis.

terms.name: Phantageusia
terms.definition: A form of altered taste sensation in which the affected person perceives a taste, usually an unpleasant one, in the absence of a corresponding stimulus in the environment.

terms.name: Receptive aphasia
terms.definition: A type of aphasia that is characterized by impaired language comprehension.

terms.name: Bilingual aphasia
terms.definition: The term bilingual aphasia is used to refer to aphasia in persons who speak two or more languages. When a multilingual speaker has aphasia following a stroke, the languages spoken premorbidly may show comparable or differential patterns of impairment. Differential patterns may manifest as greater impairment in one language compared to another, or as differences in the characteristics of aphasia. Clinical reports of bilingual aphasia show dissociations in the processing of the language learned first (L1) and and second (L2), with one language more impaired than the other. Other cases show a pattern of differential recovery where L2 is recovered only after L1. Another pattern is alternating antagonism; i.e., patients access one language in spontaneous speech and inhibit the other language for alternating periods. This term should be used for a type of aphasia in a person who speaks multiple languages in which the impairment is different for different languages.

terms.name: Coldness
terms.definition: Relative coldness of a body part to palpitation, often acccompanied by feelings of coldness.

terms.name: Oculomotor synkinesis
terms.definition: Elevation of the upper eyelid on attempted downward gaze or adduction, adduction of the eye on attempted upward or downward gaze, and constriction of the pupil on attempted adduction.

terms.name: Abnormal intrarenal vein morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal structure of a vein located inside the kidney parenchyma.

terms.name: Abnormal arcuate vein morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the arcuate vein. The arcuate veins cross traverse along the corticomedullary junction (at the border of the kideny cortex and medulla).

terms.name: Abnormal interlobular vein morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the interlobular veins of the kidney. An interlobular vein is surrounded by the renal cortex and located between renal lobules (consisting of the nephrons surrounding a single medullary ray and draining into a single collecting duct).

terms.name: Abnormal interlobular vein lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉管腔形态异常
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the interlobular vein lumen
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly located in the the inside space of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Cholesterol emboli within interlobular vein lumen
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉腔内胆固醇栓子
terms.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of interlobular veins. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

terms.name: Intraluminal thrombi within interlobular veins
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉管腔内血栓
terms.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding vascular lumen of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Organized thrombi within interlobular vein lumen
terms.definition: Thrombi containing fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal peritubular capillary morphology
terms.name_zh: 管周毛细血管形态异常
terms.definition: Anomalous structure of the capillaries that are derived from the efferent arteriole, forming a capillary network that surrounds the distal portions of the nephron tubule,

terms.name: Abnormal cortical peritubular capillary morphology
terms.name_zh: 皮质管周毛细血管形态异常
terms.definition: Anomalous structure of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Multilamellation of cortical peritubular capillary basement membranes
terms.name_zh: 皮质管周毛细血管基膜多层化
synonyms: Multilamellation of basement membranes within cortical peritubular capillaries
terms.definition: Duplicated basement membranes of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney and arranged in multiple concentric layers.

terms.name: Cortical peritubular capillaritis
terms.name_zh: 皮质肾小管周围毛细血管炎
terms.definition: Inflammation of the peritubular capillaries in the cortex of the kidney characterized by Inflammatory cells in over 10 percent of the interstitial capillaries in the cortex with at least some capillaries having three or more luminal cells.

terms.name: Abnormal cortical peritubular capillary lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 皮质管周毛细血管腔形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the peritubular capillary in the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal medullary peritubular capillary morphology
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管形态异常
terms.definition: Anomalous structure of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney.

terms.name: Medullary peritubular capillaritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the peritubular capillaries in the medulla of the kidney characterized by Inflammatory cells in over 10 percent of the interstitial capillaries in the cortex with at least some capillaries having three or more luminal cells.

terms.name: Medullary peritubular capillary erythrocyte congestion
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管红细胞淤积
terms.definition: Substantially increased numbers of red blood cells within capillaries surrounding tubules in the medulla of the kidney. This feature is assessed in histological images as the presence of numerous erythrocytes in a segment of the capillary such that the vessel appears to be congested (not open).

terms.name: Multilamellation of medullary peritubular capillary basement membranes
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管基膜多层化
synonyms: Multilamellation of basement membranes within medullary peritubular capillaries
terms.definition: Duplicated basement membranes of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney and arranged in multiple concentric layers.

terms.name: Abnormal medullary peritubular capillary lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管腔形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the peritubular capillary in the medulla of the kidney.

terms.name: Medullary peritubular capillary lumen cholesterol emboli
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管腔胆固醇栓塞
synonyms: Cholesterol emboli within the medullary peritubular capillary lumen
terms.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

terms.name: Medullary peritubular capillary intraluminal thrombi
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管腔内血栓
synonyms: Intraluminal thrombi within medullary peritubular capillaries
terms.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney.

terms.name: Medullary peritubular capillary lumen organized thrombi
terms.name_zh: 髓质管周毛细血管腔机化血栓
synonyms: Organised thrombi within the medullary peritubular capillary lumen
Organized thrombi within the medullary peritubular capillary lumen
terms.definition: Thrombi containing fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the peritubular capillaries of the medulla of the kidney.

terms.name: Cortical peritubular capillary lumen cholesterol emboli
terms.name_zh: 皮质肾小管周围毛细血管腔胆固醇栓塞
terms.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

terms.name: Cortical peritubular capillary intraluminal thrombi
terms.name_zh: 皮质肾小管周围毛细血管腔内血栓
synonyms: Intraluminal thrombi within cortical peritubular capillaries
terms.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Cortical peritubular capillary lumen organized thrombi
terms.name_zh: 皮质肾小管周围毛细血管腔机化血栓
terms.definition: Thrombi containing fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the peritubular capillaries of the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal arcuate vein lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 弓状静脉管腔形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space (lumen) of the arcuate vein of the kidney.

terms.name: Arcuate vein lumen cholesterol emboli
terms.name_zh: 弓形静脉管腔胆固醇栓塞
synonyms: Cholesterol emboli within arcuate vein lumen
terms.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of arcuate veins of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

terms.name: Arcuate vein intraluminal thrombi
terms.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Arcuate vein lumen organized thrombi
terms.name_zh: 弓形静脉管腔机化血栓
synonyms: Organised thrombi within arcuate vein lumen
Organized thrombi within arcuate vein lumen
terms.definition: Thrombi containing fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal arcuate vein intima/media morphology
terms.name_zh: 弓状静脉内膜/中膜形态异常
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly located in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Arcuate vein intimal mucoid edema
terms.name_zh: 弓形静脉内膜黏液样水肿
synonyms: Intimal mucoid edema within arcuate veins
Intimal mucoid oedema within arcuate veins
terms.definition: Accumulation of edematous extracellular matrix in the inner layer (intima) of arcuate veins of the kidney. The material resembles mucus and appears pale blue on hematoxylin and eosin staining.

terms.name: Arcuate vein intimal/medial myxomatous degeneration
terms.name_zh: 弓形静脉内膜/中膜黏液样变性
synonyms: Myxomatous change within arcuate vein intima/media
terms.definition: Accumulation of myxoid material (mucus-like material) within the inner or middle layer of the arcuate vein of the kidney.

terms.name: Arcuate vein intima/medial amyloidosis
terms.name_zh: 弓形静脉内膜/中膜淀粉样变
terms.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney. Amyloidosis stains Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy.

terms.name: Abnormal cortical radial artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the radial arteries that branch off at right angles from the arcuate artery and carry blood toward the cortex of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal cortical radial artery lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 皮质桡动脉腔形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the cortical radial arteries of the kidney.

terms.name: Cortical radial artery lumen cholesterol emboli
terms.name_zh: 皮质桡动脉腔胆固醇栓塞
terms.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of cortical radial arteries (interlobular arteries) of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

terms.name: Abnormal arcuate artery intima/media morphology
terms.name_zh: 弓状动脉内膜/中膜形态异常
synonyms: Abnormalities of the arcuate arterial intima/media
terms.definition: Anomalous structure of the inner or middle layer of the arc-shaped arteries located at the border of the renal cortex and renal medulla.

terms.name: Cortical radial artery intimal/medial amyloidosis
terms.name_zh: 皮质桡动脉内膜/中膜淀粉样变
terms.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the glomerular, interstitial or vascular compartments of the interlobular arteries of the kidney. Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy

terms.name: Abnormal cortical radial artery intima/media morphology
terms.name_zh: 皮质桡动脉内膜/中膜形态异常
synonyms: Abnormalities of the interlobular arterial intima/media
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the inner or middle layer of the cortical radial arteries (also known as interlobular arteries) of the kidney.

terms.name: Abnormal renal arteriole morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the glomerular arterioles. The interlobar arteries of the kidney branch into arcuate arteries, cortical radiate arteries, and then into afferent arterioles. After passing through the renal corpuscle, the capillaries form the efferent arteriole. The afferent and efferent arterioles are difficult to distinguish histologically and are thus both included in this term and its descendents.

terms.name: Abnormal renal arteriole lumen morphology
terms.name_zh: 肾小动脉管腔形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space (lumen) of renal arterioles.

terms.name: Renal arteriolar lumen cholesterol emboli
synonyms: Cholesterol emboli within the arteriolar lumen
terms.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of arterioles of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

terms.name: Abnormal renal arteriole intima/media morphology

terms.name: Abnormal arcuate artery endothelium morphology

terms.name: Arcuate artery intima/media arteriosclerosis

terms.name: Renal intimal/medial arteriolitis

terms.name: Renal arteriole intima/media arteriolosclerosis
terms.definition: Thickening of the intima of renal arterioles with fibrosis and/or duplication of the elastic lamina.

terms.name: Renal arteriole medial atrophy

terms.name: Arcuate vein medial hypertrophy

terms.name: Arcuate vein medial atrophy

terms.name: Cortical radial artery medial hypertrophy

terms.name: Cortical radial artery medial atrophy

terms.name: Cortical radial artery medial/intimal arteriitis
terms.name_zh: 皮质桡动脉中膜/内膜动脉炎

terms.name: Arcuate artery intima/media amyloidosis

terms.name: Arcuate artery intimal mucoid edema
terms.name_zh: 弓形动脉内膜黏液样水肿

terms.name: Arcuate intimal/medial venulitis

terms.name: Renal arteriole medial hypertrophy
terms.definition: Increased thickness of middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.

terms.name: Renal arteriole intima/media storage material accumulation
synonyms: Accumulated storage material within arteriolar intima/media

terms.name: Renal arteriole endoarterial hypercellularity

terms.name: Renal arteriole leukocytic endoarterial hypercellularity

terms.name: Renal arteriole foam cell endoarterial hypercellularity

terms.name: Renal arteriole neutrophil endoarterial hypercellularity

terms.name: Arcuate artery intima/media liquefactive necrosis

terms.definition: Accumulation of material other than amyloid (glycogen, glycosphingolipid in Fabry's disease, sphingomyelin in Nieman Pick disease, glucosylceramide in Gaucher's disease, gangliosides, mucopolysaccahrides, phytanic acid in Refsum disease) in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Cortical radial artery intima/media necrosis

terms.definition: A type of cortical radial artery intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue retains the outlines of the dead structures.

terms.name: Renal arteriole intima/media necrosis

terms.name: Abnormal interlobular vein intima/media morphology
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜形态异常

terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜硬化

terms.name: Interlobular vein intimal mucoid edema
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜黏液样水肿

terms.name: Interlobular vein intima/media amyloidosis
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜淀粉样变

terms.name: Interlobular vein intima/media venulitis
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜静脉炎

terms.name: Interlobular vein intima/media granulomatous venulitis

terms.definition: A type of interlobular vein intima/media venulitis that is characterized by circumscribed inflammatory lesions comprised primarily of macrophages present in inflamed veins.

terms.name: Interlobular vein intima/media necrosis
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜坏死
terms.definition: Cell death (necrosis) in the inner or middle layer of the interlobular vein of the kidney.

terms.name: Interlobular vein intima/media liquefactive necrosis
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜液化性坏死

terms.name: Interlobular vein medial atrophy
terms.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decreased thickness) of the medial layer pf the interlobular veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Interlobular vein medial hypertrophy
terms.definition: Increased thickness of middle layer of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

terms.name: Interlobular vein intima/media multilamellation
terms.name_zh: 小叶间静脉内膜/中膜多层化

terms.name: Absent second fingernail
terms.definition: Absence of the fingernail of the index (second) finger.

terms.name: Volar fingernail
terms.definition: The presence of an extra nail on the palmar (volar, ventral) surface of the finger.

terms.name: Talar aplasia
terms.definition: Absent talus owing to a congenital defect.

terms.name: Reduced beta-hexosaminidase B activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme beta-hexosaminidase in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Excessive dynamic airway collapse
terms.definition: Excessive anterior displacement of the tracheal and/or bronchial membranous wall.

terms.name: Paroxysmal tonic upgaze
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of sustained upward deviation of the eyes and incomplete downward saccades, and normal horizontal eye movements without impairment of consciousness.

terms.name: Vertebral artery tortuosity
terms.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the vertebral arteries.

terms.name: Celiac artery dissection
terms.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the celiac artery wall.

terms.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein C-II concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环载脂蛋白C-II浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased apolipoprotein C-II level in blood
Reduced apolipoprotein C-II level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein C-II in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urinary 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine level
terms.name_zh: 尿8-氧代-7,8-二氢鸟苷水平升高
terms.definition: An elevated amount of 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine in the urine.

terms.name: Elongated femoral neck
terms.definition: Increased length of the neck of the femur.

terms.name: Tortuous lymphatic vessels
terms.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of lymphatic vessels.

terms.name: Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor
terms.definition: A rare, endocrine active tumor that causes severe renal phosphate wasting, which in turn can lead to critical osteomalacia. Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumors (PMTs) are typically small and mostly benign tumors producing fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF-23). FGF-23 lowers the expression of sodium/phosphate cotransporters, which are the primary transport proteins responsible for phosphate reabsorption in the kidneys. The paraneoplastic overproduction of FGF-23 lowers reabsorption of phosphate and causes severe paraneoplastic renal phosphate wasting and hypophosphatemia. FGF-23 also affects vitamin D levels by lowering 25-hydroxyvitamin D 1-alpha-hydroxylase in the proximal renal tubules and by increasing the expression of vitamin D 24-hydroxylase, a mitochondrial enzyme responsible for inactivating vitamin D metabolites.

terms.name: Amygdala microinfarct
terms.definition: An infarct located in the almond-shaped body of basal nuclei anterior to the inferior horn of the lateral ventricle of the brain, within the temporal lobe that can only be observed microscopically.

terms.name: Hippocampal microinfarct
terms.definition: An infarct located in the structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation that can only be observed microscopically.

terms.name: Cartilaginous tracheobronchomalacia
terms.name_zh: 软骨性气管支气管软化
terms.definition: Softening of the tracheal and/or bronchial cartilage resulting in segmental tracheal and/or bronchial weakness.

terms.name: Vasa previa
terms.definition: Vasa previa occurs when the membranes that contain the umbilical cord traverse the membranes overlying the internal os of the cervix. There is a high risk of fetal mortality if not identified perinatally.

terms.name: Chronotropic incompetence
terms.definition: Inability of the heart to increase its rate commensurate with increased activity or demand.

terms.name: Viral encephalitis
terms.definition: An inflammation of brain parenchyma due to infection with a virus. Viral encephalitis can occur as a rare complication of common infections (eg, herpes virus infections) or can occur as a characteristic presentation of rare viruses (eg, rabies virus infection). Encephalitis may be the only neurologic manifestation of infection, or may occur in association with meningitis, myelitis, radiculitis, or neuritis. Viral encephalitis is associated with neurological dysfunction.

terms.name: Dependency on parenteral nutrition
terms.definition: Inability to ingest sufficient quantities of nutrition by mouth or by tube-feeding with the corresponding requirement for intravenous administration of nutrition.

terms.name: Microvillus inclusions
terms.definition: The presence of vacuoles bearing centripetal microvilli in small gut villus enterocytes.

terms.name: Microvillar PAS-positive secretory granules
terms.definition: The presenceaccumulationof periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) granules in the subapical region of small intenstinal microvilli, appearing as different kinds of vesicular/tubular structures.

terms.name: Perinuclear cardiomyocyte vacuolization
terms.definition: Formation of vacuoles, i.e., membrane-bound organelles, in the portion of the cytoplasm near the nucleus within myocytes of the heart.

terms.name: Single-lobed right lung
terms.definition: A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only one lobe of the right lung, which normally has three lobes.

terms.name: Bronchial hemorrhage
terms.definition: Bronchial hemorrhage is a focal bleeding located in the bronchial system. It can be diagnosed by tracheobronchoscopy.

terms.name: Tracheal hemorrhage
terms.definition: Tracheal hemorrhage is a focal bleeding within the trachea. It be diagnosed by tracheobronchoscopy.

terms.name: Anti-Complement factor H antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against complement factor H.

terms.name: Anti-phospholipase A2 receptor antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗磷脂酶A2受体抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the phospholipase A2 receptor.

terms.name: Broad medial eyebrow
terms.definition: Regional increase in the width (height) of the middle portion of the eyebrow.

terms.name: Parosmia
terms.definition: Misperception of existing odor, that is, distorted or altered olfactory perception in the presence of known stimuli.

terms.name: Decreased dendritic spine number
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of spines on a given dendrite.

terms.name: Decreased urinary lysyl-pyridinoline-hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline ratio
terms.name_zh: 尿赖氨酰吡啶啉-羟赖氨酰吡啶啉比值降低
terms.definition: A decreased amount of the urinary cross-links lysyl-pyridinoline (LP, or deoxypyridinoline DPD) as compared to hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (HP, or pyridinoline PYD). Both are established biochemical markers of osteoclastic bone resorption and collagen degradation.

terms.name: Posterior atrophy of corpus callosum
terms.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the posterior portion of the corpus callosum.

terms.name: Opto-chiasmatic atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting (atrophy) of the optic chiasm.

terms.name: Pelvic lipomatosis
terms.definition: Overgrowth of fat in the perivesical and perirectal area.

terms.name: Increased megakaryocyte colony forming unit count
terms.name_zh: 巨核细胞集落形成单位计数升高
terms.definition: Increased numbers of megakryocyte precursors (megakaryocyte colony forming units) in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Reduced progressive sperm motility
terms.definition: A reduced proportion of sperm that move in a straight line or large circles; alternatively, an increased proportion of sperm that move in tight circles or in some other non-linear fashion.

terms.name: Palmoplantar hypohidrosis
terms.definition: Decreased sweating on the palms and soles.

terms.name: Curvilinear pericallosal lipoma
terms.name_zh: 曲线状胼胝体周脂肪瘤
terms.definition: A type of pericallosal lipoma that is thin and curves around the posterior end of the splenium of the corpus callosum.

terms.name: Tubulonodular pericallosal lipoma
terms.definition: A type of pericallosal lipoma with a rounded or lobular appearance and a diameter that is usually above 2 cm. They are anteriorly situated and are associated with extensive callosal and often fronto-facial anomalies. A tubulonodular pericallosal lipoma can extend into the choroid plexus or lateral ventricles.

terms.name: Cavitating pulmonary nodule
terms.definition: Thick-walled abnormal gas-filled interstitial nodule within a lung.

terms.name: Anti-HLA antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen (HLA).

terms.name: Anti-class I HLA antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a class I human leukocyte antigen (HLA). Class I HLA corresponds to MHC class I (A, B, and C).

terms.name: Anti-class II HLA antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a class II human leukocyte antigen (HLA). Class I HLA corresponds to MHC class II (DP, DM, DO, DQ, and DR).

terms.name: Anti-HLA-A antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-A (HLA-A).

terms.name: Anti-HLA-A IgG1 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of IgG1 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-A (HLA-A).

terms.name: Anti-HLA-A IgG3 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of IgG3 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-A (HLA-A).

terms.name: Anti-HLA-B antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-B (HLA-B).

terms.name: Anti-HLA-B IgG1 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of IgG1 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-B (HLA-B).

terms.name: Anti-HLA-B IgG3 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of IgG3 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-B (HLA-B).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating GABA concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating saccharopine concentration
terms.definition: An increased concentration of saccharopine in the blood circulation. L-saccharopine is the N(6)-(1,3-dicarboxypropan-1-yl) derivative of L-lysine.

terms.name: Hepatic foam cells
terms.definition: The presence of foam cells, a type of macrophage that localizes to fatty deposits on blood vessel walls, in the liver.

terms.name: Lip cyanosis
terms.definition: Bluish discoloration of the lips.

terms.name: Facial cyanosis
terms.definition: Bluish discoloration of one or more regions of the face.

terms.name: Central cyanosis
terms.definition: Generalized bluish discoloration of the body and the visible mucous membranes, which occurs due to inadequate oxygenation secondary to conditions that lead to an increase in deoxygenated hemoglobin or presence of abnormal hemoglobin.

terms.name: Peripheral cyanosis
terms.definition: Bluish discoloration of the distal extremities in the absence of cold temperature or stress. Peripheral cyanosis can involve hands, fingertips, or toes, and sometimes circumoral and periorbital areas. Mucous membranes are generally not involved.

terms.name: Differential cyanosis
terms.definition: Differential degree of bluish discoloration between the upper and lower extremities.

terms.name: Pharyngeal exudate
terms.definition: Fluid exuded from the posterior wall of the pharynx.

terms.name: Pseudo-chilblains on toes
terms.definition: Inflammatory chilblain-like nodules on the feet and/or toes.

terms.name: Pseudo-chilblains on fingers
terms.definition: Inflammatory chilblain-like nodules on the hands and/or fingers.

terms.name: Silent hypoxemia
terms.definition: Abnormally low blood oxygen level without the presence of dyspnea.

terms.name: Ventricular couplet
terms.definition: Two consecutive premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) with no intervening normal beats.

terms.name: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia
terms.definition: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia (BDVT) is a regular ventricular tachyarrhythmia (VT) with two different QRS morphologies alternating at a rate typically between 140 and 180 bpm.

terms.name: Dorsal hirsutism
terms.definition: Abnormally increased hair growth in the lskin of the back.

terms.name: Increased fecal bile acid
terms.definition: Elevated amount of bile acids in the feces.

terms.name: Trident pelvis
terms.definition: Spurs at the medial and lateral acetabular margin and in the center of the acetabulum gives rise to shape resembling a three-pronged spear known as trident.

terms.name: Angulated muscle fibers
terms.definition: Normal muscle fibers are polygonal-shaped in cross section, are multinucleated, and have minimal amounts of endomysial connective tissue. In contrast, angulated (also known as angular) muscle fibers have long and narrow vertices (corners) with sharp edges and a pointed tip.

terms.name: Mandibular osteolysis
terms.definition: Osteolysis (destruction of bone through bone resorption with removal or loss of calcium) localized to the mandible.

terms.name: Rib osteolysis
terms.definition: Osteolysis (destruction of bone through bone resorption with removal or loss of calcium) localized to a rib.

terms.name: Decreased circulating chenodeoxycholic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环鹅脱氧胆酸浓度降低
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of chenodeoxycholic acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated urinary prostaglandin E2 level
terms.definition: An increased amount of prostaglandin E2 in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary prostaglandin E2 metabolite level
terms.name_zh: 尿前列腺素E2代谢物水平升高
terms.definition: An increased amount of prostaglandin E2 metabolite (PGE-M) in the urine.

terms.name: Hypoplastic anterior limbs of the internal capsule
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the frontal part (anterior crus or anterior limb) of the internal capsule.

terms.name: Impaired toe-walking ability
terms.definition: Difficulty or reduced ability to walk on toes. Toe-walking can be tested as a part of the neurological examination. Foot plantar flexion weakness leads to difficulties in walking on toes.

terms.name: Decreased acid ceramidase activity
terms.name_zh: 酸性神经酰胺酶活性降低

terms.name: Probst bundles
terms.definition: Probst bundles (also known as longitudinal callosal fascicles) are neuroanatomical homologues to the corpus callosum and can occur in association with callosal agenesis. Probst bundles are white matter fibers that normally cross the corpus callosum but (because of the agenesis of the corpus callosum) fail to cross the midline, such that when they reach the corticoseptal boundary, they turn and run parallel to the interhemispheric fissure within the septal leaves, indenting the medial walls of the lateral ventricles.

terms.name: Anti-side-chain cleavage enzyme antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗侧链裂解酶抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against cytochrome P450 cholesterol side-chain cleavage enzyme (P450scc), which is encoded by CYP11A1 cytochrome P450 family 11 subfamily A member 1 (Gene ID:1583).

terms.name: Increased fecal calprotectin level
terms.name_zh: 粪便钙卫蛋白水平升高
terms.definition: An increased amount of calprotectin in the feces.

terms.name: Fetal anomaly
terms.definition: Structural or functional abnormalities of the fetus. Note that this section comprises terms that describe abnormalities that are specific to the fetus or differ from the corresponding general terms. A term from anywhere in the Human Phenotype Ontology can be applied to a fetus if appropriate.

terms.name: Abnormal fetal morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the fetus.

terms.name: Abnormal fetal physiology
terms.definition: Any functional anomaly of the fetus.

terms.name: Triggered by fava bean ingestion
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating fava beans.

terms.name: Anti-steroid 17alpha-hydroxylase antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗类固醇17α-羟化酶抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against steroid 17alpha-hydroxylase.

terms.name: Anti-insulin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against insulin.

terms.name: Anti-islet antigen-2 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against tyrosine phosphatase IA-2.

terms.name: Anti-salivary protein antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against salivary protein.

terms.name: Anti-Zinc transporter 8 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗锌转运蛋白8抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against zinc transporter 8.

terms.name: Anti-carbonic anhydrase VI antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against carbonic anhydrase VI.

terms.name: Tonofilament clumping
terms.definition: Formation of lumps of tonofilaments, which are bundles of keratin filaments. In some but not all epithelia, keratin filaments are conspicuously bundled as tonofilaments. Inside the cell they braid the nucleus, span through the cytoplasm and are attached to the cytoplasmic plaques of the typical epithelial cell-cell junctions, the desmosomes.

terms.name: Anti-plasminogen binding peptide antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗纤溶酶原结合肽抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against plasminogen binding peptide.

terms.name: Anti-parotid secretory protein antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗腮腺分泌蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against parotid secretory protein.

terms.name: Anti-enterocyte antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗肠上皮细胞抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against enterocytes.

terms.name: Anti-21-hydroxylase antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against 21-hydroxylase.

terms.name: Abnormal fetal long-bone echogenicity
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal appearing echogenicity of the fetal bone. Echogenicity refers to the ability of tissue to reflect ultrasound waves back toward the transducer and produce an echo. Whenever there is an interface of structures with different echogenicities, a visible difference in contrast will be apparent on the screen. The higher the echogenicity of tissues, the brighter they appear on ultrasound imaging.

terms.name: Reduced fetal long bone echogenicity
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased echogenicity of fetal long bones in a prenatal sonographic investigation. This finding is due to hypomineralization and can be seen in some disorders such as hypophosphatasia, osteogenesis imperfecta, and achondrogenesis.

terms.name: Increased fetal long bone echogenicity
terms.definition: An abnormally elevated echogenicity of fetal long bones in a prenatal sonographic investigation. This finding is due to hypermineralization.

terms.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein B concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环载脂蛋白B浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein B in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗酪氨酰-tRNA合成酶抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against tyrosyl-tRNA synthetase.

terms.name: Anti-asparaginyl-tRNA synthetase antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗天冬氨酰tRNA合成酶抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against asparaginyl-tRNA synthetase.

terms.name: Anti-histidyl tRNA synthetase antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗组氨酰tRNA合成酶抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against histidyl tRNA synthetase.

terms.name: Anti-cytosolic-5-nucleotidase-1A antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗胞质5'-核苷酸酶1A抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against cytosolic-5-nucleotidase-1A (cN1A).

terms.name: Anti-Ki antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ki.

terms.name: Anti-sp100 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against sp100. Autoantibodies causing the MND pattern are directed against sp100, sp140, promyelocytic leukemia nuclear body proteins (PML) or ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) proteins, while in the punctate nuclear envelope pattern, the target antigens are gp210, nucleoporin-62 or laminin B receptor proteins.

terms.name: Anti-beta-2-Glycoprotein I IgG antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗β2糖蛋白I IgG抗体阳性
terms.definition: Presence of IgG antibodies against beta 2 glycoprotein I in the circulation. Beta-2 glycoprotein I (beta2GPI) is the principal target of autoantibodies in the antiphospholipid syndrome.

terms.name: Anti-beta-2-Glycoprotein I IgM antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗β2糖蛋白I IgM抗体阳性
terms.definition: Presence of IgM antibodies against beta 2 glycoprotein I in the circulation. Beta-2 glycoprotein I (beta2GPI) is the principal target of autoantibodies in the antiphospholipid syndrome.

terms.name: Anti-tyrosine phosphatase region of islet antigen-2 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗胰岛抗原-2酪氨酸磷酸酶区抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the tyrosine phossphatase region of islet antigen 2A (this region is a specific part of IA-2). Usually IA-2A are measured using the intracellular portion of IA-2 (IA-2ic) made up of the protein tyrosine phosphatase (PTP) and juxtamembrane (JM) regions.

terms.name: Pagetic bone lesion
terms.definition: Paget's disease of bone (PDB) is a chronic progressive metabolic bone disease characterized by abnormal activation of osteoclasts that results in abnormal bone resorption and compensatory osteogenic sclerosis. DB can affect one (monostotic form) or more (polyostotic form) regions of the skeleton, with multiple constitutive symptoms, including bone pain, bone deformity, pathological fracture, tinnitus, hearing loss, vision loss, and osteoarthritis.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 9 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素9浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 9 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 9 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 9 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 10 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素10浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 10 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 21 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素21浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 21 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 21 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 21 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 21 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白细胞介素21浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 21 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 22 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素22浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 22 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 22 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白介素22浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 23 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素23浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 23 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 23 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白介素23浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 27 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素27浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 27 concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 27 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白介素27浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 17A concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素17A浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 17A concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 17A concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白细胞介素17A浓度升高
terms.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Vertebral artery aneurysm
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the vertebral artery .

terms.name: Fusion of the caudate and putamen
terms.definition: Abnormal joined appearance of the caudate and putamen with an absence of the anterior limb of the internal capsule.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the liver
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the liver.

terms.name: Segmental hypoplasia of liver
terms.definition: Anatomically the liver is divided into right and left lobes based on the attachment of its peritoneal ligaments. This term refers to a developmental anomaly characterzied by the underdevelopment of one of the lobes of the liver. This is a rare and usually asymptomatic anomaly that can be detected incidentally on cross sectional imaging with computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging.

terms.name: Spastic triplegia
terms.definition: Spastic weakness found in both lower extremities and one upper extremity.

terms.name: Elevated circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
Elevated insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit concentration
Elevated insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level
Elevated insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level in blood
Increased insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit concentration
Increased insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level
Increased insulin-like growth factor-binding protein complex acid labile subunit level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Median pseudocleft lip
terms.definition: A type of mild median cleft lip in which the central tubercle of the upper lip is replaced by a mucosal cleft in the midline.

terms.name: Patella alta
terms.definition: Patella alta is a patella that rides abnormally high in relation to the femur, the femoral trochlea, or the tibia, with decreased bony stability requiring increased knee flexion angles to engage the trochlea.

terms.name: Clavicular pseudarthrosis
