terms.definition: A break or tear in the trachea.

terms.name: Increased myocardial glycogen content
terms.definition: Elevated amount of glycogen in the myocardium.

terms.name: Triggered by monoamine oxidase inhibitor
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a monoamine oxidase inhibitor.

terms.name: Triggered by serotonin reuptake inhibitor
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a serotonin reuptake inhibitor.

terms.name: Ameliorated by acetazolamide
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with acetazolamide.

terms.name: Ameliorated by exposure to medication
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a medication. Terms in this subhierarchy are intended to be used for cases in which the fact that a manifestation of a disease responds to a specific treatment can be used in the differential diagnosis.

terms.name: Ameliorated by vitamin B12
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with vitamin B12.

terms.name: Ameliorated by thiamine
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with thiamine.

terms.name: Ameliorated by dantrolene
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with dantrolene.

terms.name: Ameliorated by biotin
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with biotin.

terms.name: Reduced bone-marrow megakaryocyte size
terms.definition: Decreased in average size (diameter) of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow. Megakaryocyte diameter can be assessed as using automated cellular imaging systems.

terms.name: Hairshafts with longitudinal grooves
terms.definition: Long narrow depressions running lengthwise in hairshafts. This feature can be appreciated by scanning electron microsopy.

terms.name: Mycobacterium bacteremia
terms.definition: Presence of viable mycobacteria in the blood.

terms.name: Decreased delta-aminolevulinate dehydratase activity
terms.name_zh: δ-氨基乙酰丙酸脱水酶活性降低
terms.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme delta-aminolevulinate dehydratase. The enzyme is active in erythrocytes.

terms.name: Elevated circulating pancreatic secretory trypsin inhibitor activity
terms.name_zh: 血胰分泌胰蛋白酶抑制剂活性升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating serine protease inhibitor Kazal type I
terms.definition: Increased activity of the enzyme pancreatic secretory trypsin inhibitor in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Presence of uterus in 46,XY individual
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly in which an individual with an X chromosome and a Y chromosome (usually 46,XY) has a uterus. The uterus and Fallopian tubes are derived from the Müllerian duct and thus this phenotype is generally also associated with the presence of Fallopian tubes.

terms.name: Intraluminal meconium calcification
terms.definition: Deposition of calcium in meconium present in the internal cavity of the fetal bowel. This manifestation may be the result of any distal intestinal obstruction.

terms.name: Portal vein hypoplasia
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the portal vein.

terms.name: Adrenal leiomyoma
terms.definition: Adrenal leiomyoma is a rare, benign solid tumor that develops from the smooth muscle of the adrenal vein and its tributaries

terms.name: Small intestinal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate
terms.definition: Infiltration of the wall of the small intestine by lymphocytes and mature plasma cells.

terms.name: Triggered by neuroleptic medication
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to neuroleptic (also known as antipsychotic) medication.

terms.name: Abnormal peroxisomal morphology
terms.name_zh: 过氧化物酶体形态异常
terms.definition: Structural anomaly of peroxisomes, which are small, membrane-enclosed metabolic organelles with roles in the metabolism of complex lipids and reactive ionic species.

terms.name: Absence of peroxisomes
terms.definition: Lack of observable peroxisomes. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.

terms.name: Paucity of peroxisomes
terms.definition: Reduced number of observable peroxisomes per cell. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.

terms.name: Reduced sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase activity
terms.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase, which typically is measured in a biopsy specimen from liver or muscle.

terms.name: Deficit at segmental level
terms.definition: Refers to distribution of neurological deficits that corresponds to a deficit of a specific spinal segment and all segments below it.

terms.name: Rhabdoid tumor
terms.definition: Rhabdoid tumors are rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis. The most common anatomic localizations are the central nervous system, the kidneys, and other soft tissues.

terms.name: Rhabdoid tumor of the ovary
terms.definition: A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the ovary that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers.

terms.name: Cardiac rhabdoid tumor
terms.definition: A rare and aggressive neoplasms developing mainly in the kidney but also in cerebral and extra-cerebral tissues and rarely in the heart. Histologically, rhabdoid renal and extrarenal tumors share common characteristics. The cells are polygonal, with eccentric, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions. The tumors have an infiltrative growth pattern, necrosis, and high proliferative index. The immunohistochemistry tools of investigation facilitate differential diagnosis by showing loss of INI-1 expression, usually accompanied by germline mutations of the SMARCB1 gene. When INI-1 is still expressed in the affected tissues, a rhabdoid tumor with SMARCA4 mutations should be considered.

terms.name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of the bladder
terms.definition: A rhabdoid tumor (a rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis) originating in the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of liver
terms.definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in the liver. MRT are best characterized by the presence of round or polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, typical eosinophilic perinuclear inclusions, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Immunohistochemical expression of vimentin and epithelial markers and lack of staining for S-100, myoglobin and desmin are commonly found, but are non-specific.

terms.name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of muscle
terms.definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Neck teratoma
terms.definition: A teratoma located in the neck.

terms.name: Kidney teratoma
terms.definition: A teratoma located in a kidney.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide-riboside level
terms.name_zh: 尿5-氨基-4-咪唑甲酰胺核苷水平升高
terms.definition: Increased amount of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide(AICA)-riboside in the urine. AICA-riboside is the dephosphorylated counterpart of AICAR, an intermediate of de novo purine biosynthesis.

terms.name: Aplasia of posterior communicating artery
synonyms: Absence of both posterior communicating arteries
terms.definition: A developmental anomnaly characterized by the lack of development of the posterior communicating artery.

terms.name: Optic pit
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by congenital excavation of the optic nerve head.

terms.name: Ameliorated by naloxone
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with naloxone, an opioid antagonist.

terms.name: Ameliorated by pyridoxal phosphate
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of pyridoxal phosphate (activated vitamin B6).

terms.name: Thickened intrahepatic portal venules
terms.definition: Increased width of the vascular wall of portal venules within the liver.

terms.name: Ovarian fibrosis
terms.definition: Excessive proliferation of fibroblasts and deposition of extracellular matrix within the ovary.

terms.name: Pigment incontinence
terms.definition: A process in which melanosomes (melanin granules) are deposited in the dermis. The dermal melanosomes are observed to be mainly in macrophages. This phenomenon of pigmentary incontinence usually follows an inflammatory process with the basic feature of basal cell damage, such as in lichen planus, lupus erythematosus, Riehl's melanosis, incontinentia pigmenti (Bloch-Sulzberger), and fixed drug eruption. Incontinence of pigment, or dropping off of epidermal melanin into the dermis, frequently produces a clinically recognizable and characteristic slate-gray pigmentation.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal keratin 10 protein expression
terms.definition: Amount of keratin 10 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal collagen IV protein expression
synonyms: Skin biopsy: collagen IV antibody staining abnormal or absent

terms.name: Reduced epidermal bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 protein expression
synonyms: Skin biopsy: BPAG1-e antibody staining abnormal or absent
terms.definition: Lower than normal amount of bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 (BP230) in the epidermis.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal collagen VII protein expression
synonyms: Skin biopsy: collagen VII antibody staining abnormal or absent

terms.name: Reduced epidermal collagen XVII protein expression
synonyms: Skin biopsy: collagen XVII antibody staining abnormal or absent

terms.name: Reduced epidermal integrin alpha6beta4 protein expression
synonyms: Skin biopsy: integrin alpha6beta4 antibody staining abnormal or absent

terms.name: Reduced epidermal plectin protein expression
synonyms: Skin biopsy: plectin antibody staining abnormal or absent

terms.name: Bloodstream Trypanosoma cruzi
synonyms: Trypanosoma cruzi present on peripheral blood smear
terms.definition: Presence of Trypanosoma cruzi in the blood stream. Trypanosoma cruzii is the etiological agent of Chagas disease.

terms.name: Abnormal lymph node cell composition
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal distribution of cell types or their relative proportions in a lymph node.

terms.name: Lipid-laden lymph node macrophages
terms.definition: Lymph node with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids.

terms.name: Abnormal pancreatic acinus morphology
terms.definition: Structural anomal of pancreatic acinus.

terms.name: Cochlear nerve hypoplasia
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the cochlear nerve.

terms.name: Glutathionuria
terms.definition: Level of glutathione in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Nevus psiloliparus
terms.definition: Nevus psiloliparus is a rare fatty tissue nevus that is a marker for encephalocraniocutaneous lipomatosis, a neurocutaneous syndrome with ocular and central nervous system anomalies. Clinically, nevus psiloliparus is often described as a congenital alopecia and appears as an irregularly shaped, circumscribed area of alopecia on the scalp. Histopathology demonstrates a near-complete absence of mature hair follicles with preservation of arrector pili muscles and mature adipocytes within the dermis.

terms.name: Crypt hyperplasia
terms.definition: Crypt hyperplasia denotes elongation of the length of the crypts of Lieberkuhn, a process that initially precedes villous atrophy. Elongation may be caused by expansion of the lamina propria as a result of the proliferation of stromal cells, an influx of inflammatory cells and tissue remodeling.

terms.name: Increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环硫酸脱氢表雄酮浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环甲状腺素结合球蛋白浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血甲状腺素结合球蛋白浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased thyroxine-binding globulin level in blood
Reduced thyroxine-binding globulin level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环β-氨基异丁酸浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating dihydrouracil concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环二氢尿嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of dihydrouracil in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of uracil that is also known as 5,6-dihydrouracil.

terms.name: Elevated circulating dihydrothymine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环二氢胸腺嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of dihydrothymine in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of thymine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血N-氨甲酰基-β-丙氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentrationof N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated ciculating 5-hydroxymethyluracil concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环5-羟甲基尿嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased CSF creatinine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of creatinine in the cerebrrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary creatine level
terms.definition: An increased amount of creatine in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased circulating biotin concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of biotin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating thrombopoietin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血血小板生成素浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.

terms.name: Decreased circulating C1q concentration
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of the C1q protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. C1q is the first component of the classical pathway and is composed of the C1qA chain, C1qB chain, and C1qC chain, which are encoded by C1qA, C1qB, and C1qC genes.

terms.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein A-II concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环载脂蛋白A-II浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased apolipoprotein A-II level in blood
Reduced apolipoprotein A-II level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein A-II in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating DOPA concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF DOPA concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the cerebrospinal fluid above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating porphyrin concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of porphyrins in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating transcobalamin-2 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of transcobalamin-2 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Polychromasia
terms.definition: Increased variation in the color of the erythrocytes (red blood cells), including pale red, normal or dark colors, indicating a highly variable hemoglobin concentration. Typically this indicates the release of immature erythrocytes in states of anemia.

terms.name: Decreased circulating myo-inositol concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of myo-inositol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating arabinitol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环阿拉伯糖醇浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of arabinitol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine arabitol level
terms.name_zh: 尿阿拉伯糖醇水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of arabitol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine erythritol level
terms.definition: Amount of erythritol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating erythritol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环赤藓糖醇浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of erythritol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating matrix metalloproteinase 2 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环基质金属蛋白酶2浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased 72 kDa type IV collagenase concentration
Decreased 72 kDa type IV collagenase level
Decreased 72 kDa type IV collagenase level in blood
Reduced 72 kDa type IV collagenase concentration
Reduced 72 kDa type IV collagenase level
Reduced 72 kDa type IV collagenase level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of matrix metalloproteinase 2 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating coenzyme concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of a coenzyme (an organic molecule that binds to the active sites of an enzyme to promote the catalysis of a reaction) is above or below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl methionine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血S-腺苷甲硫氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of S-adenosyl methionine (SAM) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. SAM is a cosubstrate involved in methyl group transfers, transsulfuration, and aminopropylation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环膜辅蛋白浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环膜辅蛋白浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
Decreased membrane cofactor protein level in blood
MCP (membrane cofactor protein) low in blood
Reduced membrane cofactor protein level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环膜辅蛋白浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
Elevated membrane cofactor protein level in blood
Increased membrane cofactor protein level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hepatic xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the liver. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Adrenal xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the adrenal gland. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Splenic xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spleen. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Spinal cord xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spinal cord. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Brain xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the brain. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Pulmonary xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the lung. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Bone marrow xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the bone marrow. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Lymph node xanthomatosis
terms.definition: Lipid deposits localized within one or more lymph nodes. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

terms.name: Xanthoma of bone
terms.definition: Xanthoma of bone is an exceedingly rare benign primary bone tumor histologically characterized by mononuclear macrophage-like cells, abundant foam cells, and multinucleated giant cells.

terms.name: Ameliorated by folinic acid
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with folinic acid.

terms.name: Triggered by succinylcholine anesthetic
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a succinylcholine anesthetic such as suxamethonium.

terms.name: Exogenous androgen exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treated with an exogenous androgen medication.

terms.name: Reduced muscle enolase activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme enolase in muscle tissue. The enzyme enolase catalyzes the interconversion of 2-phosphoglycerate and phosphoenolpyruvate. In adult human muscle, over 90% of enolase activity is accounted for by the beta-enolase subunit, the protein product of the ENO3 gene.

terms.name: Dopamine antagonist exposure
terms.name_zh: 多巴胺受体拮抗剂暴露
terms.definition: History of having been treated with a dopamine antagonist including metaclopramide, phenothiazine; haloperidol, chlorpromazine, promethazine, prochlorperazine, ziprasidone, and quetiapine.

terms.name: Muscle fiber granulofilamentous inclusion bodies
terms.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that contain a mxiture of granules and filaments.

terms.name: Bone marrow myeloid vacuolization
synonyms: Vacuolization of bone marrow myeloid precursors
terms.definition: Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of myeloid precursors in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Pulmonary cylindroma
terms.definition: A cylindroma located in the lung. Cylindromas are well-circumscribed, smooth, pale pink nodular tumors, often with arborizing vessels visible. The tumors are slow growing and vary in size from a few millimeters to over 5 mm.

terms.name: Colonic fibrinopurulent exudate
terms.definition: Fluid visible on the colonic surface containing fibrin, inflammatory cells, and cellular debris.

terms.name: Bloodstream microfilaria
terms.definition: Presence of filaria in the blood stream. Filariasis is a common cause of elephantiasis in Coastal Districts of India. The initial manifestations are repeated episodes of fever with chills and rigor, lymphadenopathy which gradually progress to elephantiasis. In India filarial infestation is commonly caused by W. bancrofti and Brugia malayi, the former responsible for almost 98 percent of all cases.

terms.name: Skin infectious agent
terms.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the skin.

terms.name: Dermal microfilaria
terms.definition: Presence of filariae in the skin.

terms.name: Dermal papillary IgA deposition
synonyms: Granular IgA deposits at the dermal papillae
terms.definition: Accumulation of immunoglobulin A (IgA) surrounding dermal papillae, which are specialized cells that support the hair follicle.

terms.name: Dermal immune complex deposition
terms.definition: Accumulation of antigen-bound antibody in the skin.

terms.name: Abnormal liver metabolite concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of a metabolite in the liver is above or below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Hepatic polyglucosan accumulation
synonyms: Accumulation of polyglucosan bodies in the liver
terms.definition: Intracellular accumulation of polyglucosan bodies-containing amylopectinlike polysaccharide-in the liver.

terms.name: Urinary bladder neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) located in the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Synovial granuloma
terms.definition: An aggregation of macrophages (forming in response to chronic inflammation) localized in the lining of a joint (synovium).

terms.name: Elevated urine fumaric acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of fumaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine N-acetylaspartic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿N-乙酰天冬氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of N-acetylaspartate in the urine, when corrected for urine concentration, is above upper limit of normal. This feature can be measured using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.

terms.name: Elevated urine suberylglycine level
terms.name_zh: 尿辛二酰甘氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Level of suberylglycine in urine above upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine phenylpropionylglycine level
terms.name_zh: 尿苯丙酰甘氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Level of phenylpropionylglycine in urine above upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine octenedioic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of octenedioic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Monocarboxylic aciduria
terms.definition: Level of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal. A monocarboxylic acid is an oxoacid containing one carboxy group.

terms.name: Elevated urine octanoic acid level
terms.definition: Amount of octanoic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine glutaconic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of glutaconic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxyglutaric level
terms.name_zh: 尿3-羟基戊二酸水平升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine malonic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of malonic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine propionylglycine level
terms.name_zh: 尿丙酰甘氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of propionylglycine in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine tiglylglycine level
terms.name_zh: 尿巴豆酰甘氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of tiglylglycine in the urine above upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 2-methylacetoacetic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-甲基乙酰乙酸水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of 2-methylacetoacetic acid in the urine above upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxypropionic acid level
terms.definition: Amount of 3-hydroxypropionic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 2-methylcitric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-甲基柠檬酸水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of 2-methylcitric acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 4-hydroxyisovaleric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿4-羟基异戊酸水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of 4-hydroxyisovaleric acid in urine above upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-羟基-3-甲基戊酸水平升高
terms.definition: Amount of 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal. 2-Hydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid or 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid (HMVA) is an organic acid generated by L-isoleucine metabolism.

terms.name: Shoulder contracture
terms.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the shoulder joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

terms.name: Shoulder extension contracture
terms.definition: Lack of the full expected passive range of flexion of the shoulder joint (Shoulder flexion puts the arms from a resting position at one's sides to straight above the head; thus, with shoulder extension contracture it is not possible to raise the arms above the head fully).

terms.name: Thumb extension contracture
terms.definition: Movement in the sagittal plane that increases the angle of the thumb joint (straightens the joint); motion involving posterior bending of the vertebral column or returning to the upright position from a flexed position.

terms.name: Tongue myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma (benign soft tissue neoplasm characterized by the presence of spindle and stellate cells, lobulated growth pattern, and myxoid stroma formation) localized in the tongue.

terms.name: Abnormal knee morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the knee joint or surrounding structures.

terms.name: Abnormal knee physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the knee joint.

terms.name: Knee contracture
terms.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the knee joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

terms.name: Knee extension contracture
terms.definition: A type of knee joint contracture in which the knee lacks full expected flexion, such that the upper and lower leg cannot be brought together.

terms.name: Abnormal ankle morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the ankle.

terms.name: Abnormal ankle physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the ankle.

terms.name: Toe joint contracture
terms.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of a toe joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

terms.name: Extension contracture of toe
terms.definition: A type of toe joint contracture in which the joint lacks full expected flexion, so that the two bony segments on either side of their connecting joint cannot be brought together.

terms.name: Finger joint contracture
terms.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of a finger joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

terms.name: Extension contracture of finger
terms.definition: A type of finger joint contracture in which the joint lacks full expected flexion, so that the two bony segments on either side of their connecting joint cannot be brought together.

terms.name: Reduced muscle telethonin level
synonyms: Muscle biopsy: telethonin low or absent
terms.definition: Amount of telethonin protein expression in muscle tissue below lower limit of normal. Telethonin is a 19-kDa sarcomeric protein, localized to the Z-disc of skeletal and cardiac muscles.

terms.name: Abnormal enzyme concentration or activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal liver enzyme activity or concentration
synonyms: Abnormal hepatic enzyme activity or concentration
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in liver tissue.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic urocanase activity
terms.definition: Activity of urocanase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis
terms.name_zh: 脑苷脂硫酸盐水解障碍
terms.definition: Reduced hydrolysis (splitting of a bond and the addition of the hydrogen anion of water) of the sulfuric ester linkage in the molecule of cerebroside sulfate, possibly leading to accumuation of cerebroside sulfate.

terms.name: Reduced peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase activity
terms.definition: Diminished enzyme activity of peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase, an enzyme that metabolizes glutaryl-CoA (a metabolite of L-lysine, L-hydroxy-lysine and L-tryptophan) by dehydrogenation to glutaconyl-CoA directly followed by decarboxylation of this to crotonyl-CoA.

terms.name: Reduced sterol 27-hydroxylase activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme sterol 27-hydroxylase, which participates in the degradation of cholesterol to bile acid. Sterol 27-hydroxylase catalyzes the first step in the normal oxidation of the steroid side chain, converting cholesterol, as well as different 7a-hydroxylated cholesterol metabolites, to 27-oxygenated steroids.

terms.name: Reduced short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme Short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (SCAD), a key enzyme of fatty acid beta-oxidation that catalyzes the first step in mitochondrial beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

terms.name: Reduced 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PGDH), which catalyzes the first step in the pathway by converting D-3-phosphoglycerate (PGA), an intermediate in glycolysis, to phosphohydroxypyruvate concomitant with the reduction of NAD+.

terms.name: Elongated mitochondria
terms.definition: Increase in length of mitochondria.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase activity
terms.definition: Activity of methionine adenosyltransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal. Note that there are multiple methionine adenosyltransferase isoezymes.

terms.name: Substantia nigra dopaminergic neuron loss
terms.definition: Degeneration and loss of neurons in the substantia nigra of the brain.

terms.name: Intramuscular lipoma
terms.definition: A lipoma that is located within a muscle.

terms.name: Cutaneous telangiectasia
terms.definition: Dilated blood vessels on the skin.

terms.name: Abnormal aromatase activity
terms.definition: Aromatase activity outside of the normal range.

terms.name: Elevated aromatase activity
terms.definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced aromatase activity
terms.definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Corneal amyloidosis
terms.definition: A form of amyloidosis that is located in the cornea.

terms.name: Abnormal keratinocyte morphology
terms.name_zh: 角质形成细胞形态异常
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the keratinocyte. The keratinocyte is the major cell type of the epidermis and is responsible for generating the protective barrier.

terms.name: Keratinocyte vacuolization
terms.definition: Increased number of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in keratinocytes.

terms.name: Parotid gland adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the parotid gland.

terms.name: Pulmonary vasculitis
terms.definition: Cellular inflammation, vessel destruction, and tissue necrosis of the blood vessels of the lung.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic D-glycerate kinase activity
terms.definition: Activity of D-glycerate kinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Lymph-node hemophagocytosis
terms.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages in a lymph node.

terms.name: Superior pubic ramus hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the upper branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).

terms.name: Uterine adenofibroma
terms.definition: A rare benign mullerian mixed tumor of the uterus composed of benign epithelial and mesenchymal components.

terms.name: Pulmonary hamartoma
terms.definition: A benign malformation of the lung that includes an abnormal mixture of tissue components such as cartilage, epithelium, fat, or muscle which are common to the lung but without preservation of the organ architecture.

terms.name: Peripheral axonal distension
terms.definition: An abnormal histological finding characterized by an increase in the cross-section area of peripheral nerve axons (up to 20-25 micrometers in diameter).

terms.name: Decreased circulating alpha-mannosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 循环α-甘露糖苷酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal hepatocyte morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the hepatocyte, which is the main cell type that makes up the liver perncyhma. Hepatocytes are usually binucleated and appear as sheets in the liver tissue.

terms.name: Hepatic melanin-like lysosomal pigmentation
terms.name_zh: 肝黑色素样溶酶体色素沉着
terms.definition: Accumulation of dark, coarsely granular pigment localized in lysosomes of centrilobular hepatocytes.

terms.name: Reduced uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase (UROD; EC 4.1.1.37) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced heme oxygenase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme heme oxygenase below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Swollen achromatic neurons in the cerebral cortex
terms.definition: The presence of enlarged and swollen neurons that lack Nissl bodies (the rough endoplasmic reticulum-achromasia refers to neurons that lack Nissl bodies) in the cortex of the brain.

terms.name: Vacuolated hepatocytes
terms.definition: Presence of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in hepatocytes, which normally rarely contain vacuoles.

terms.name: Lack of oocyte pronucleus formation
terms.name_zh: 卵母细胞原核形成障碍
terms.definition: An abnormality of oocyte maturation characterized by the inability of oocytes to form pronuclei after in vitro fertilization procedures. Oocytes normally show two pronuclei 17 to 20 hours after in vitro insemination.

terms.name: Self-healing squamous epithelioma
terms.definition: A type of skin tumor that initially presents as a reddish macule and subsequently becomes papular, enlarged, ulcerated and ultimately heals leaving pitted scars.

terms.name: Elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Sarcoplasmic bodies
terms.definition: Rounded or oval structures that appeared brown on hematoxylin and eosin and red on the modified Gomori trichrome stain.

terms.name: Elevated CSF hydroxyproline concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液羟脯氨酸浓度升高

terms.name: Reduced CSF cystine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of cystine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal. Cystine is sulfur-containing amino acid obtained by the oxidation of two cysteine molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating beta-mannosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血β-甘露糖苷酶活性异常
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase outside normal limits. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

terms.name: Elevated circulating beta-mannosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环β-甘露糖苷酶活性升高
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase above the upper limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

terms.name: Reduced circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性异常
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性升高
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血S-腺苷-L-同型半胱氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl-L-methionine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血S-腺苷-L-甲硫氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration S-adenosyl-L-methionine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Exercise-triggered malignant hyperthermia
terms.definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by exercise-induced life-threatening hyperthermia with a body temperature over 40 degrees C and signs of encephalopathy ranging from confusion to convulsions or coma. Incidence increases with rising ambient temperature and relative humidity. Manifestations may include rhabdomyolysis (presenting with myalgia, muscle weakness, and myoglobinuria), tachycardia, and in severe cases multiorgan failure.

terms.name: Anesthesic-triggered malignant hyperthermia
terms.definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature to 39-42 degrees C in response to inhalational anesthetics such as halothane or to muscle relaxants such as succinylcholine.

terms.name: Elevated CSF argininosuccinic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液精氨琥珀酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of argininosuccinic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF aspartylglucosamine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液天冬氨酰葡糖胺浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alpha-oxoadipic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血α-氧代己二酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of alpha-oxoadipic acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal erythrocyte metabolite concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞代谢物浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal range of a metabolite in red blood cells.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of glutathione in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Glutathione (GSH) is an important redox active biomolecule critical in the maintenance and regulation of cellular and organismal health.

terms.name: Elevated CSF sarcosine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液肌氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of sarcosine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced CSF methionine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of methionine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating homoarginine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环高精氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of homoarginine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary formiminoglutamic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿亚胺甲基谷氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The concentration of formiminoglutamic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF proline concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液脯氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of proline in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary S-sulfocysteine level
terms.name_zh: 尿S-磺基半胱氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Level of S-sulfocysteine high in urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating S-sulfocysteine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血S-磺基半胱氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of S-sulfocysteine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Sertoli cell hyperplasia
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis.

terms.name: CSF infectious agent
terms.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: CSF mycobacteria
terms.definition: Mycobacterium present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). This feature can be ascertained by CSF microscopy.

terms.name: Fungemia
synonyms: Presence of fungi in the blood
terms.definition: Detection of a fungal organism (such as candida or coccidioides) in the blood stream.

terms.name: Supraclavicular lymphadenopathy
terms.definition: Enlarged lymph node located just above the clavicle (collarbone).

terms.name: Inguinal lymphadenopathy
terms.definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the inguinal region (groin).

terms.name: Axillary lymphadenopathy
terms.definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the axillary region (armpit).

terms.name: Positive Murphy sign
terms.definition: Murphy's sign is elicited in patients with acute cholecystitis by asking the patient to take in and hold a deep breath while palpating the subcostal region. In practice, Murphy's sign is performed by palpating the subcostal region during inspiration. If pain is elicited and the patient suddenly stops their inspiratory effort, a positive Murphy's sign has been elicited.

terms.name: Bilious emesis
terms.definition: Vomiting whereby the vomit has the color of bile, yellowish-green.

terms.name: Ameliorated by NSAID
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).

terms.name: Fetal exposure history
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to a medication or other substance.

terms.name: Fetal barbiturate exposure
terms.name_zh: 胎儿巴比妥类药物暴露
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to barbiturate medications such as phenobarbital. Barbiturates are used medically as anxiolytics, hypnotics, and anticonvulsants.

terms.name: Fetal narcotic exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to narcotic medications such as morphine or codeine. Narcotics are used medically to treat moderate or severe pain.

terms.name: Ameliorated by ethosuximide
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of ethosuximide. Ethosuximide is most often used to treat absence seizures.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal extracellular matrix protein 1 protein expression
terms.definition: Lower than normal amount of extracellular matrix protein 1 (ECM1) in the epidermis.

terms.name: Neurofibroma by anatomical location
terms.definition: Neurofibroma categorized according to the anatomical site of origin.

terms.name: Tongue neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the tongue.

terms.name: Cardiac neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the heart.

terms.name: Gastric neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the stomach.

terms.name: Renal neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the kidney.

terms.name: Muscle fiber polyglucosan inclusion bodies
terms.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in muscle fibers.

terms.name: Abnormal rete ridge morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal structure of the rete ridges (also known as rete pegs), which are downward projections of epithelium surrounding the connective tissue papillae in between the dermal papillae.

terms.name: Rete ridge elongation
terms.definition: Increased length of the rete rdiges of the epidermis.

terms.name: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis
terms.definition: Accumulation of monoclonal CD1a-positive Langerhans cells in the bronchioles and alveolar interstitium that can cause damage to the lungs.

terms.name: Lumbar hypolordosis
terms.definition: Flattening of a curve in the spine in the lumbar (lower back) region.

terms.name: Battle sign
terms.definition: Battle sign is bruising over the mastoid process that is typically the result of head trauma. It is retroauricular or mastoid ecchymosis that is typically the result of head trauma. Battle sign typically requires significant head trauma and may indicate significant internal injury to the brain and not just the posterior cranial vault or mastoid.

terms.name: Decreased skull base length
terms.definition: Reduced anterioposterior dimension of the skull base.

terms.name: Oscillopsia
terms.definition: A visual disturbance in which objects in the visual field appear to oscillate (jump, jiggle, vibrate).

terms.name: Decreased blink rate
terms.definition: The frequency with which the eye is blinked is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal blink rate
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal frequency of blinking the eye.

terms.name: Elevated blink rate
terms.definition: The frequecy with which the eye is blinked is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Purulent sputum
terms.definition: Sputum contains pus.

terms.name: Maternal hyperthyroidism
terms.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of hyperthyroidism during the corresponding pregnancy.

terms.name: Perineal
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the perineum (the region of skin between the genitals and the anus).

terms.name: Gadolinium exposure
terms.definition: History of exposure to gadolinium, a contrast medium often used for magnetic resonance imaging.

terms.name: Purulent parotid gland drainage
terms.definition: Excretion of pus (purulent discharge) from the opening of the parotid duct.

terms.name: Obstipation
terms.definition: Obstipation is the inability to pass either stool or flatus (gas).

terms.name: Posttussive emesis
terms.definition: Vomiting following a coughing spell.

terms.name: Vasculitis by anatomical site
terms.definition: Vasculitis categorized according to the anatomical site where the finding is localized.

terms.name: Vasculitis by histology
terms.definition: Vasculitis categorized according to type of histological abnormality.

terms.name: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
terms.definition: A type of vasculitis characterized by the presence of debris of neutrophils within the blood vessel walls.

terms.name: Accumulation of lipid droplets in small-bowel enterocytes
terms.name_zh: 小肠上皮细胞脂滴蓄积

terms.name: Pericardial friction rub
terms.definition: A pericardial friction rub is a grating, to-and-fro sound that occurs in phase with the heart sounds.

terms.name: Abnormal muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
terms.name_zh: 肌肉琥珀酸脱氢酶染色异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue.

terms.name: Increased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
terms.name_zh: 肌肉琥珀酸脱氢酶染色增强

terms.name: Decreased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
terms.name_zh: 肌肉琥珀酸脱氢酶染色减弱

terms.name: Small intestinal hamartoma
terms.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the small intestine.

terms.name: Pyriform sperm head
terms.definition: Pyriform spermatozoa consist of a normally shaped acrosomal structure which can be normal in size or enlarged, while the post-acrosomal region shows severe elongation and an acute narrowing to the posterior end, ending in about the same thickness as the connecting mid-piece.

terms.name: Excess residual spermatozoal cytoplasm
terms.definition: Excess residual cytoplasm is associated with abnormal spermatozoa produced from a defective spermiation process. This abnormal excess cytoplasm should not be confused with more physiological cytoplasmic residues that can be observed in direct microscopy of the ejaculate but not in dried, fixed and stained morphology smears.

terms.name: Cardiomyocyte hyaline bodies
terms.definition: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions within the cytoplasm of cardiomyocytes.

terms.name: Hepatic hemophagocytosis
terms.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the liver.

terms.name: CSF hemophagocytosis
terms.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Splenic hemophagocytosis
terms.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the spleen.

terms.name: Urinary bladder granulomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the urinary bladder as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

terms.name: Epidermal necrosis
terms.definition: Death of keratinocytes in the epidermis layer of the skin, which generally manifests as extensive exfoliation (separation of the epidermis from the underlying dermis).

terms.name: Exacerbated by flexion
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) bending of a limb or joint.

terms.name: Hemolacria
terms.definition: The presence of blood in tears.

terms.name: Corneal foreign body sensation
synonyms: Foreign body sensation in the eye
terms.definition: A perception that an object is in contact with the eye.

terms.name: Buttock pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the buttock (round fleshy area at the lower rear area of a human trunk).

terms.name: Vaginal foreign body sensation
terms.definition: A perception that an object located in the vagina.

terms.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
terms.definition: Attacks of breathlessness that occur at night and may awaken the sleeping patient.

terms.name: Eyelid pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eyelid.

terms.name: Abnormal sperm physiology
terms.definition: Abnormality of a sperm function including protection of paternal DNA, traversing the female reproductive tract, oocyte localisation, penetration of the zona pellucida, oocyte activation and centriole deposition.

terms.name: Small acrosomal area
terms.definition: Reduction in size of the acrosome below the lower limit of normal. The acrosome is a unique membranous organelle located over the anterior part of the sperm nucleus. According to the World Health Organization criteria, the acrosome must be clearly visible, comprising approximately 40-70 percent of the sperm head.

terms.name: Bent sperm flagella
terms.definition: The proportion of sperm cells whose flagella is sharply curved or has a sharp angle is above normal limits.

terms.name: Spermiation failure
terms.definition: Spermiation failure is indicated by apparently normal spermiogenesis, but the presence of retained Sd2 spermatids in stages III-V of human spermatogenesis, whereas maturation arrest is indicated by a lack of late Sd1 and Sd2 spermatids in the epithelium.

terms.name: Hypospermatogenesis
terms.definition: A morphological abnormality visible upon biopsy of the germinal epithelium of the testis in which the cellularity of the germinal epithelium is reduced in general, so that all stages of germ cells (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, and spermatids) are present but reduced in number. This term applies to biopsies with some tubules showing diminished amounts of qualitatively complete spermatogenesis in combination with a vast majority of tubules that lack germ cells.

terms.name: Conjunctival membrane
terms.definition: Formation of a sheet of tissue by coagulum of exudate over the conjunctiva of the eye that if removed leaves behind a denuded bleeding surface.

terms.name: Extreme oligozoospermia
terms.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than zero but less than 2 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than zero but less than one million sperm per milliliter.

terms.name: Mild oligozoospermia
terms.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 30 but less than 39 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 10 but less than 15 million sperm per milliliter.

terms.name: Moderate oligozoospermia
terms.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 10 but less than 29 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 5 but less than 10 million sperm per milliliter.

terms.name: Severe oligozoospermia
terms.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 2 but less than 10 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 1 but less than 5 million sperm per milliliter.

terms.name: Iris nodule
terms.definition: The presence of a nodule (small rounded lump of tissue) in the iris.

terms.name: Koeppe nodules
terms.definition: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie at the pupillary margin.

terms.name: Bussaca nodules
terms.definition: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie on the iris surface.

terms.name: Decreased CSF copper concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of copper in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Diffuse pulmonary lymphoid hyperplasia
terms.name_zh: 弥漫性肺淋巴组织增生
terms.definition: Diffuse lymphoid hyperplasia (DLH) describes the pathological entity that lies between follicular bronchiolitis and lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia (LIP). It is pathologically characterized by a diffuse peribronchiolar proliferation of hyperplastic lymphoid follicles (BALT), extended along the lymphatics to involve the interlobular septa and pleura. Unlike LIP, DHL does not show uniform involvement of the alveolar septa.

terms.name: Ameliorated by steroid medication
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a steroid medication such as prednisone.

terms.name: Triggered by levothyroxin exposure
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of levothyroxin (thyroid hormone).

terms.name: Reduced muscle laminin alpha-2 chain staining
terms.definition: A decreased amount of laminin alpha-2 chain in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.

terms.name: Adrenal cortical sclerosis
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of of the outer layer (cortex) of the adrenal gland due to fibrosis.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic fructose-1,6-phosphate aldolase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Pancreatic hamartoma
terms.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the pancreas.

terms.name: Liver angiomyolipoma
terms.definition: A benign liver neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.

terms.name: Cardiac lipoma
terms.definition: A lipoma that is located within a the heart.

terms.name: Peripheral nerve polyglucosan inclusion bodies
terms.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in peripheral nerve fibers.

terms.name: Cardiac polyglucosan accumulation
terms.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in myocardial tissue.

terms.name: Cystic nephroma
terms.definition: A benign cystic neoplasm of the kidney.

terms.name: Absent dermal elastic fibers
terms.definition: Elastic fibers not demonstrable in skin biopsy.

terms.name: Cleavage at junction of stratum corneum and stratum granulosum
terms.name_zh: 角质层颗粒层交界分离
terms.definition: Splitting of the skin (cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes) localized to the interface between the stratum corneum and stratum granulosum layers of the epidermis.

terms.name: Lymphoid hyperplasia
terms.definition: An abnormal bone marrow finding characterized by many poorly circumscribed and occasionally confluent lymphoid nodules. The nodules contain small and uniform lymphocytes with rounded nuclei, clumped chromatin, and without prominent nucleoli.

terms.name: Absence of epidermal lamellar bodies
terms.definition: Lack of lamellar bodies (LBs) inthe epidermis. LBs are specialized organelles that contain pro-barrier lipids imparting a fully lamellar internal structure, but also other cargoes such as enzymes (lipid metabolizing and proteolytic), enzyme inhibitors, and antimicrobial peptides.

terms.name: Gastrointestinal granulomatosis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the gastrointestinal tract (Pylorus, esophagus, jejunum, ileum, cecum, rectum, perirectal area, esophagus) as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

terms.name: Enlarged sperm head vacuole
terms.definition: Increased size of sperm vacuoles, which are surface concavities typically located at the the tip or middle area of sperm heads. According to the WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen, sperm head vacuoles are considered abnormal when exceeding 20% of the cross-sectional area of the head. Vacuoles are found in almost all samples with normal sperm morphology; this term applies if the proportion of sperm with abnormally large vacuoles is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Ureteral hamartoma
terms.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the ureter.

terms.name: Fetal methimazole exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to methimazole.

terms.name: Fetal procarbazine exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to procarbazine.

terms.name: Fetal fluorouracil exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to fluorouracil.

terms.name: Fetal cytarabine exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cytarabine.

terms.name: Fetal tetracycline exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to tetracycline.

terms.name: Fetal quinine exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to quinine.

terms.name: Fetal cyclophosphamide exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cyclophosphamide.

terms.name: Fetal metronidazole exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to metronidazole.

terms.name: Fetal phenobarbital exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenobarbital.

terms.name: Fetal phenytoin exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenytoin.

terms.name: Periumbilical
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near the umbilicus (belly button).

terms.name: Maternal obesity during pregnancy
terms.definition: A history of obesity, which can be defined as a body mass index of 30 or greater, in the mother of a fetus or index patient.

terms.name: Maternal amniocentesis
terms.definition: A history of amniocentesis having been performed in the mother of a fetus or index patient.

terms.name: Typified by highly variable age of onset
terms.definition: Description of conditions in which age of onset is highly variable even in family members who share the same disease-associated variant or variants.

terms.name: Abnormal leukocyte enzyme concentration or activity
terms.name_zh: 白细胞酶浓度或活性异常
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme as measured in leukocytes is above or below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Reduced tissue beta-glucuronidase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of beta-glucuronidase (EC 3.2.1.31) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte alpha-L-fucosidase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an alpha-L-fucosidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase B activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase B as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte steroid sulfatase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase C as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase A activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of the lysosomal enzyme arylsulfatase A (EC 3.1.6.8) as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Decreased alpha-galactosidase A activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-galactosidase below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive fecal parasite test
terms.definition: Demonstration of parasite in stool specimen, e.g., Parasites present on wet mount of stool.e

terms.name: Positive stool infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in stool positive.

terms.name: Positive stool giardia antigen
terms.definition: Test for giardia antigen in stool such as immune assay or DFA positive.

terms.name: Entamoeba histolytica antibody positive in stool
terms.name_zh: 粪便溶组织内阿米巴抗体阳性
terms.definition: Demonstration of antibody directed against Entamoeba histolytica in stool.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte free porphyrin concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of porphyrin in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating urocanic acid concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of urocanic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary epinephrine level
terms.definition: The concentration of epinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased CSF epinephrine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液肾上腺素浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of epinephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating epinephrine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环肾上腺素浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of epinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating norepinephrine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环去甲肾上腺素浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of norepinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary norepinephrine level
terms.name_zh: 尿去甲肾上腺素水平降低
terms.definition: The concentration of norepinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary metaepinephrine level
terms.name_zh: 尿变肾上腺素水平降低
terms.definition: The concentration of metanephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased CSF metanephrine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液甲氧基肾上腺素浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of metanephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating metanephrine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甲氧基肾上腺素浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of metanephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Ovarian mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the ovary. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Adrenal mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the adrenal gland. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Uterine mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Prostatic calculus
terms.definition: Calcium deposits in the prostate gland.

terms.name: Decreased portal vein velocity
terms.definition: A reduction in the velocity of portal venous flow, generally measured by Doppler ultrasound. Portal venous flow is normally towards the liver with peak systolic velocities in the range of 20-40 cm/s.

terms.name: Uterine cervix mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the cervis of the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary uromodulin level
terms.definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for usine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary uromodulin level
terms.definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urine phenylacetylglutamine level
terms.name_zh: 尿苯乙酰谷氨酰胺水平升高
terms.definition: The concentration of phenylacetylglutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urine guanidinoacetic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive urine infectious agent nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of DNA and RNA originating from an infectious agent (bacteria, viruses, parasites and fungi) in the urine.

terms.name: Positive CMV urine nucleic acid test
synonyms: Positive cytomegalovirus urine nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive Neisseria gonorrhoeae urine nucleic acid test
synonyms: Neisseria gonorrhoeae PCR positive in urine
terms.definition: Detection of Neisseria gonorrhoeae nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive enterovirus urine nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of enterovirus nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Elevated brain glycine level by MRS
terms.definition: An increase in the level of glycine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Elevated brain polyol compounds by MRS
terms.name_zh: MRS示脑多元醇化合物升高
terms.definition: An increase in the level of polyol compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Elevated brain gamma-aminobutyric acid by MRS
terms.name_zh: MRS示脑γ-氨基丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: An increase in the level of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: History of recent anticoagulant ingestion
terms.definition: Medical history of ingestion of anticoagulants prior to presentation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating antidiuretic hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环抗利尿激素浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of antidiuretic hormone, also known as vasopressin, is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating growth hormone-releasing hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环生长激素释放激素浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of growth hormone-releasing hormone above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal amniotic fluid protein concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of a protein in the amniotic fluid from normal limits

terms.name: Decreased amniotic fluid alpha-fetoprotein concentration
terms.name_zh: 羊水甲胎蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the amniotic fluid below lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating vitamin E concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环维生素E浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of vitamin E in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating calcitonin concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Decreased circulating calcitonin concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating thyrotropin releasing hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血促甲状腺激素释放激素浓度降低
synonyms: Thyrotropin releasing hormone (TRH) low in blood
terms.definition: Concentration of thyrotropin releasing hormone below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating uroporphyrin concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of uroporphyrin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urine pentacarboxylporphyrin level
terms.name_zh: 尿五羧基卟啉水平升高
terms.definition: Concentration of pentacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urine hexacarboxylporphyrin level
terms.name_zh: 尿六羧基卟啉水平升高
terms.definition: Concentration of hexacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环脱氢表雄酮浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased erythrocyte coproporphyrin concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞粪卟啉浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of coproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased erythrocyte uroproporphyrin concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞尿卟啉浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of uroproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein E concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环载脂蛋白E浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased apolipoprotein E level in blood
Reduced apolipoprotein E level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein E in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein E concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环载脂蛋白E浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated apolipoprotein E level in blood
Increased apolipoprotein E level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein E in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Acrosomal hypoplasia
terms.definition: Reduction in the size of the acrosome of the head of spermatozoa.

terms.name: Oocyte maturation arrest
terms.definition: Oocyte maturation arrest (OMA) can manifest as failed in vitro fetilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) attempts using affected oocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal anus morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the anus.

terms.name: Abnormal anus physiology
terms.definition: A functional anomaly of the anus.

terms.name: Weak anal sphincter tone
terms.definition: Reduced muscle tone of the sphincter of the anus.

terms.name: Reduced muscle 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Reduced liver 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in liver tissue.

terms.name: Nasal mucosa vasculitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of blood vessels in the mucosa of the nasal cavity.

terms.name: Pituitary blastoma
terms.definition: Pituitary blastoma is a distinctive anterior hypophyseal tumor of infants

terms.name: Peripheral axon spheroid formation
terms.definition: Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons.

terms.name: Reduced liver carboxylesterase 1 activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme carboxylesterase 1 in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal dermis morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the dermis, the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer.

terms.name: Perivascular dermis hyaline deposition
terms.definition: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the dermis layer of the skin.

terms.name: Perivascular small intestinal hyaline deposition
terms.definition: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the wall of the small intestine.

terms.name: Large keratohyaline granules
terms.definition: Abnormally large keratohyalin granules (KHG). KHG are typically present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin (and epithelium of the mucosae). KHG are protein structures found in the keratinocytes of the stratum granulosum.

terms.name: Decreased muscle lipoic acid content
terms.definition: Reduced amount of lipoic acid in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic cystathionine gamma-lyase activity
terms.definition: Activity of cystathionine gamma-lyase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Digestive system neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the digestive system.

terms.name: Lumbar spondylosis
terms.definition: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the lumbar vertebral column.

terms.name: Decreased circulating acid maltase activity
terms.name_zh: 循环酸性麦芽糖酶活性降低
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme acid maltase (also known as alpha-1,4-glucosidase) below the lower limit of normal.
