terms.name: Abnormal circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血7-脱氢胆固醇浓度异常
terms.definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环7-脱氢胆固醇浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating lathosterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环羊毛甾醇浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of lathosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating desmosterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环链甾醇浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of desmosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating sialic acid concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of sialic acid in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Purulent synovial fluid
terms.definition: The synovial fluid (also known as synovia, i.e., the fluid found in the cavities of synovial joints) contains increased quantities of white blood cells.

terms.name: Muscle fiber calsequestrin 1-containing inclusion bodies
terms.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that demonstrate immunoreactivity for calsequestrin 1.

terms.name: Palatine myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma (A benign tumor composed of myxomatous tissue composed of loosely-arranged spindle, polygonal, and stellate cells) localized to the palate. Clinically, such tumors may present as a sessile nodule on the hard palate.

terms.name: Vaginal myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized in the vagina.

terms.name: Decreased dermal collagen
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced amount of collagen fibers in the dermis.

terms.name: Irregularly shaped keratohyaline granules
terms.name_zh: 透明角质颗粒形态不规则
terms.definition: Abnormal shape of keratohyaline granules in dermal keratinocytes.

terms.name: Tubular shadows
terms.definition: Tubular shadows are characterized by a complete absence of cells in the testicular tubules, meaning that germ cells as well as somatic Sertoli cells are absent. The cells have been replaced by hyalinization.

terms.name: Multiple eyelid margin cysts
terms.definition: Presence of many apocrine hidrocystoma (cysts) on the margins of the eyelids.

terms.name: Altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath
terms.definition: The fibrous sheath is a structure in the midpiece of the sperm flagellum surrounding the outer dense fibers. It comprises two longitudinal columns and transverse ribs. In case of altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath the symmetrical structure is lost, most commonly with the columns not being opposite to each other, which can be visualized by electron microscopy.

terms.name: Uterine myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the uterus.

terms.name: Uterine cervix myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the the cervix of the uterus.

terms.name: Typified by complete penetrance
terms.definition: Penetrance describes the proportion of genotype positive individuals that develop disease given a lifespan of 80 years. For example, penetrance of Neurofibromatosis type 1 is close to 100%.

terms.name: Osteochondromyxoma
terms.definition: A rare benign chondroid and osteoid matrix-producing neoplasm of bone characterized by extensive myxoid changes. OMX originate from bony cortices and have been observed in the nasal region, as well as the tibia and radius.

terms.name: Gangliocytoma
terms.definition: A low-grade central nervous system tumor composed of dysplastic ganglion cells, usually presenting in children or young adults and located in the cerebral hemispheres.

terms.name: Duodenal gastrinoma
terms.definition: A gastrinoma, a neuroendocrine tumors characterized by the secretion of gastrin with resultant excessive gastric acid production, that is localized to the duodenum.

terms.name: Thymic carcinoid tumor
terms.definition: A primary thymic neuroendocrine tumor.

terms.name: Bone marrow eosinophilia
terms.name_zh: 骨髓嗜酸性粒细胞增多
terms.definition: Count of eosinophils in the bone marrow above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Exacerbated by lithium exposure
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with lithium.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
terms.definition: Activity of glycogen debrancher enzyme (also known as amylo-1,6-glucosydase, 4-alpha-glucantransferase) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Asymmetrical insertion of the midpiece into the head
terms.name_zh: 精子中段头部插入不对称
terms.definition: Insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon on an axis that diverges from the midline axis of the spermatozoon head. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Bent sperm neck
terms.definition: Sharply angled insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this feature is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿3,6-环氧二羧酸水平升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Gallbladder biliary sludging
terms.definition: Presence of biliary sludge (a mixture of particulate solids that have precipitated from bile) in the gallbladder. Such sediment consists of cholesterol crystals, calcium bilirubinate pigment, and other calcium salts. Sludge is usually detected on transabdominal ultrasonography.

terms.name: Exacerbated by amiodarone exposure
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with amiodarone.

terms.name: Ureteral mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the ureter. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Wide cavum septum pellucidum
terms.definition: Width of the cavum septum pellucidum above the upper limit of normal, which is defined as a separation of greater than one cm of the leaves of the cavum septum pellucidum.

terms.name: Hypoplastic trochlear nerve
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the trochlear nerve, which is the fourth cranial nerve and one of the ocular motor nerves that controls eye movement.

terms.name: Thymic cyst
terms.definition: A closed sac of tissue (cyst) located in the thymus. Thymic cysts are a rare, benign anomaly, are usually asymptomatic, and mostly occur in the anterior mediastinum .

terms.name: Uterine cyst
terms.definition: A closed sack of tissue (cyst) located in the uterus.

terms.name: Urinary bladder mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the urinary bladder. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Endosteal scalloping
terms.definition: A series of indentations or erosions on a normally smooth margin of the inner layer of the cortex (i.e. the endosteum) of bones.

terms.name: Urinary bladder hamartoma
terms.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Peritoneal mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the peritoneal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Fallopian tube mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the Fallopian tube. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Aplasia of the pyramids of the medulla oblongata
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the pyramids, that is, of the paired structures located at the medial aspect of the ventral medulla that flank the anterior median fissure.

terms.name: Bathrocephaly
terms.definition: A deformity of the posterior skull with bulging of the midportion of the occipital bone that is often associated with a benign variant of the mendosal suture.

terms.name: Occipital horn
terms.definition: Downward pointing exostoses of the occipital bone situated in the tendinous insertions of the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles.

terms.name: Absent pituitary stalk
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by failure to develop of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Abnormal pituitary stalk morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Interrupted pituitary stalk
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by a discontinuity of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Facial synkinesis
terms.definition: Unintentional movement in one area of the face produced during intentional movement of another area of the face.

terms.name: Synkinesis
terms.definition: Unintentional movement in one area of the body produced during intentional movement of another area of the body.

terms.name: Exposure to birds
terms.definition: History of exposure to birds.

terms.name: Perianal anesthesia
terms.definition: Loss of sensation to the area of buttocks, perianal space and thighs.

terms.name: Failure of phenylephrine to induce blanching of eye redness
terms.name_zh: 去氧肾上腺素无法诱发眼红变白
synonyms: Phenylephrine does not induce blanching of eye redness
terms.definition: Instillation of 2.5% phenylephrine drops into the eye does not induce blanching of eye redness. Failure to blanch suggests redness caused by scleral vessel engorgement (e.g., scleritis) or extravascular cause (e.g., hemorrhage), not episcleritis or conjunctivitis.

terms.name: Fetal alcohol exposure
synonyms: Exposure to alcohol in the womb
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to ethanol (alcohol).

terms.name: Reduced cellular cobalamin uptake
terms.definition: Diminished ability of cells to transport cobalamine from the extracellular space to the cytoplasm.

terms.name: Focal necrotic brainstem lesion
terms.name_zh: 脑干局灶性坏死性病变
terms.definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the brainstem.

terms.name: Focal necrotic optic nerve lesion
terms.name_zh: 视神经局灶性坏死性病变
terms.definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the optic nerve.

terms.name: Focal necrotic thalamus lesion
terms.name_zh: 丘脑局灶性坏死性病变
terms.definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the thalamus.

terms.name: Interstitial dermal edema
terms.definition: Accumulation of fluid in the interstitial spaces of the skin. This finding can be appreciated my microscopic examination of a skin biopsy.

terms.name: Shoulder external rotation contracture
synonyms: External rotation contracture of the shoulder joint
terms.definition: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by decreased internal rotation of shoulder, that is, by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability to internally rotate the humerus at the shoulder joint (if the arm is flexed at the elbow, Internal rotation of the shoulder rotates the forearm towards the center of the body).

terms.name: Thumb adduction contracture
terms.definition: A type of thumb contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability of the metacarpal-phalangeal and/or interphalangeal joints of the thumb to bring from medial side to neutral position, where the neutral position for the thumb is when the distal and proximal segments of the thumb joint are in linear alignment.

terms.name: Hip internal rotation contracture
terms.definition: The inability to rotate the proximal or upper limb segment laterally past anatomic neutral moving away from the midline, when viewed from anteriorly. Anatomic neutral position is defined as the trans-epicondylar axis of the distal humerus (for upper extremity) or femur (for lower extremity) is parallel to the sagittal plane of the body. This type of contracture is characterized by a turning of the knee from a neutral position to one facing more the midline, where the neutral position for the hip is with knee pointing directly anteriorly (less than or equal to 45 degrees).

terms.name: Reduced tissue fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase activity
terms.definition: Activity of fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase (EC 3.1.3.11) below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver and leukocytes.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic carbamoylphosphate synthetase 1 activity
terms.definition: Activity of carbamoylphosphate synthetase 1 in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced intraepidermal small nerve fiber density
terms.definition: Reduced number of small nerve fibers in the skin.

terms.name: Femoral artery duplication
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the presence of a supernumerary femoral artery.

terms.name: Intracellular accumulation of collagen VII
terms.definition: Collagen VII is the major molecular constituent of anchoring fibrils in the skin. Collagen VII is synthesized as three identical pro-alpha1(VII) polypeptide chains, which are hydroxylated and glycosylated in a coordinated manner and then fold into triple-helical procollagen VII in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). Mature collagen VII undergoes a multistep fibril polymerization process to form the anchoring fibrils. Mutant pro-alpha1(VII) polypeptide chains or procollagen VII molecules do not pass the ER quality control and are retained in the ER or designated for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation resulting in reduced amounts of collagen VII in the skin.

terms.name: Reduced reticular lamina anchoring fibril density
terms.definition: Diminished amount of the anchoring fibrils in the basement membrane zone that normally attach the epithelium to the basement membrane.

terms.name: Reduced lamina lucida anchoring filament density
terms.definition: Diminished amount of the anchoring filaments that normally bridge the lamina lucida and insert into the lamina densa in the cutaneous basement membrane zone.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal keratin 5 protein expression
terms.definition: Amount of keratin 5 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal keratin 14 protein expression
terms.definition: Amount of keratin 14 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal keratin protein expression
terms.definition: Amount of one or more keratins in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase activity
terms.definition: Activity of alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Hepatic sinusoidal dilatation
terms.definition: Presence of an increased amount of blood in the hepatic capillaries.

terms.name: Thin spermatozoon midpiece
terms.definition: The cross-sectional size (diameter) of the midpiece of the spermatozoon is below the lower limit of normal. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Thick spermatozoon midpiece insertion
terms.definition: Increased width of the midpiece of the spermatozoon. The midpiece is the structure that is located between the head and the flagella (tail) of the spermatozoon. This term applies if the width of the midpiece increases progressively from the flagella to the head and if the proportion of individual spermatozoa with this anomaly is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Shoulder adduction contracture
terms.definition: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in the active and passive ability to abduct the shoulder. This results in the shoulders being closer to midline. The affected individual is not able to position the shoulders away from the body.

terms.name: Occupational exposure history
terms.definition: Exposure to a substance that results from the performance of an employee's duties.

terms.name: Occupational silver exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure to silver that has occurred in relation to performance of job duties.

terms.name: Abnormal femoral artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the femoral artey, a large blood vessel that provides oxygenated blood to lower extremity structures and in part to the lower anterior abdominal wall.

terms.name: Extrahepatic bile duct fibrosis
terms.definition: Accumulation of fibrous connective tissue (collagen) in the extrahepatic bile ducts.

terms.name: Elevated circulating short-chain acylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血短链酰基肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of short-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Short chain acylcarnitines have between two and five carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C2-C5),

terms.name: Elevated circulating C4-acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of C4-acylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating medium-chain acylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环中链酰基肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of medium-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Medium-chain acylcarnitines have between six and twelve carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C6-C12),

terms.name: Elevated circulating long-chain acylcarnitine concentration

terms.definition: Concentration of long-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Long-chain acylcarnitines have between thirteen and twenty carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C13-C20),

terms.name: Elevated circulating C5 acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of C5 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C5 acylcarnitines have a five-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C18 acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of C18 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C18 acylcarnitines have a eighteen-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C16 acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of C16 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C16 acylcarnitines have a sixteen-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Elevated circulating very long-chain acylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环极长链酰基肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of very long-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Very long-chain acylcarnitines have twentyone or more carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C21 and higher),

terms.name: Elevated circulating acetylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of acetylcarnitine (C2 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acetylcarnitine has a two-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Elevated circulating methylmalonylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甲基丙二酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of methylmalonylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyhexadecanoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环3-羟基十六烷酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyhexadecanoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C6 acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of C6 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C6 acylcarnitines have a six-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Elevated circulating methylglutarylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甲基戊二酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of O-methylglutarylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyisovalerylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环3-羟基异戊酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyisovalerylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyhexanoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环3-羟基己酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyhexanoylcarnitine (C6-OH) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating carnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of carnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating tiglylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血巴豆酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of tiglylcarnitine (C5:1) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating acetylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of acetylcarnitine (C2 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Acetylcarnitine has a two-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Decreased circulating octadecenoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环十八烯酰肉碱浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of octadecenoylcarnitine (C18:1 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Absent pigmentation of chest
synonyms: Lack of skin coloring on chest
Lack of skin colouring on chest
terms.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the chest.

terms.name: Aplasia of facial bones
synonyms: Failure of development of facial bones

terms.name: Hyperparakeratosis
terms.definition: Histological term to illustrate the combined presence of parakeratosis and hyperkeratosis. Abnormal keratinization of the epidermal stratum corneum (horny layer) with increased keratin formation and preservation of the nuclei in the superficial cells.

terms.name: Chromosome breakage
synonyms: High frequency of chromosome breaks in lymphocytes
terms.definition: Elevated rate of chromosomal breakage or interchanges occurring either spontaneously or following exposure to various DNA-damaging agents. This feature may be assayed by treatment of cultured lymphocytes with agents such as chemical mutagens, irradiation, and alkylating agents.

terms.name: Increased activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
terms.name_zh: 线粒体呼吸链活性升高

terms.name: Chorioretinal hypopigmentation
terms.name_zh: 脉络膜视网膜色素减退
terms.definition: Focal or global or heterogeneous loss of choroidal and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) pigmentation in the absence of atrophy.

terms.name: Chorioretinal hyperpigmentation
terms.name_zh: 脉络膜视网膜色素沉着过度

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone
terms.name_zh: 第五跖骨发育不全/缺如

terms.name: Abnormality of the second metatarsal bone
synonyms: Abnormality of the 2nd long bone of foot

terms.name: Abnormality of the fourth metatarsal bone
synonyms: Abnormality of the 4th long bone of foot

terms.name: Onychogryphosis of fingernail
terms.definition: Thickened fingernails.

terms.name: Toenail onycholysis
terms.definition: Painless and spontaneous separation of a toenail from the nail bed.

terms.name: Aplasia of the eccrine sweat glands
Hypoplasia of the eccrine sweat glands
Macular edema
terms.definition: Thickening of the retina that takes place due to accumulation of extracellular fluid in the macula as a nonspecific response to blood-retinal barrier breakdown. It can either have a cystoid aspect in the fovea, or a more diffuse aspect.

terms.name: Absent upper eyelashes
synonyms: Failure of development of upper eyelashes

terms.name: Decreased adipose tissue
terms.definition: The amount of adipose tissue (fat) in the body or a part of the body is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal lower limb bone morphology
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of bones of the lower limbs
Abnormal shape of bones of the lower limbs

terms.name: Abnormal upper limb bone morphology
synonyms: Abnormal morphology of bones of the upper limbs
Abnormal shape of bones of the upper limbs

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of ulna
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the ulna, a bone of the forearm the extends from the elbow to the little finger.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating creatine kinase activity
synonyms: Abnormal levels of creatine kinase in blood
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal activity of creatine kinase in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Happy demeanor
terms.definition: A conspicuously happy disposition, characterized by frequent smiling and laughing, which may be contextually inappropriate or unrelated to the situation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating renin concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of renin in the blood, a central hormone in the control of blood pressure and various other physiological functions.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating folate concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of folate in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal lymphocyte count
terms.definition: Any abnormality in the total number of lymphocytes in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal total natural killer cell count
terms.name_zh: 总自然杀伤细胞计数异常
synonyms: Abnormal number of natural killer cells
Abnormality of natural killer cell count
terms.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of total natural killer (NK) cells, commonly characterized as CD3-CD19- and CD16+ or CD56+ lymphocytes, in the blood, per microlitre, or altered NK cell phenotype, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, measured ex vivo.

terms.name: Abnormal tympanic membrane morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the tympanic membrane

terms.name: Asymmetry of the size of ears
synonyms: Asymmetry of the size of ears

terms.name: Asymmetry of the shape of the ears
synonyms: Asymmetry of the shape of the ears

terms.name: Asymmetry of the position of the ears
Neoplasm of the outer ear
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the outer ear.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the inner ear
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the inner ear.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the ceruminal gland
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ceruminal gland.

terms.name: Cutaneous atresia of the external auditory canal
Osseous atresia of the external auditory canal
Acquired stenosis of the external ear canal
synonyms: Cutaneous stenosis of the external auditory canal
terms.definition: Stenosis or narrowing of the external ear canal (EAC) occurs lateral to the tympanic membrane resulting in a skin lined blind canal.

terms.name: Osseous stenosis of the external auditory canal
terms.definition: A narrowing of the bony part of the ear canal, which can be congenital or acquired through causes like chronic infections, trauma, or radiation therapy.

terms.name: Abnormal lateral semicircular canal morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the horizontal semicircular canal
Morphological abnormality of the lateral semicircular canal

terms.name: Abnormal posterior semicircular canal morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the posterior semicircular canal

terms.name: Abnormal anterior semicircular canal morphology
synonyms: Morphological abnormality of the anterior semicircular canal

terms.name: Absence of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
Abnormal Eustachian tube morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the Eustachian tube (ET). The ET is a biomechanical valve between the nasopharynx and the middle ear. Physiologically, it controls the passive adaptation of the middle ear air pressure to the ambient air pressure primarily via direct muscular actions of the soft palate. In the closed state it protects the middle ear. Inadequate function of the ET causes middle ear ventilation disorders.

terms.name: Abnormality of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
Abnormality of the acoustic reflex
terms.definition: An abnormality in the reflexive contraction of the middle-ear muscles in response to sound stimulation.

terms.name: Impairment of the the acoustic reflex
Impairment of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
Abnormal sweat homeostasis
terms.definition: An abnormality of the composition of sweat or the levels of its components.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating iron concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of iron in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal motor nerve conduction velocity
terms.name_zh: 运动神经传导速度异常

terms.name: Abnormal sensory nerve conduction velocity
terms.name_zh: 感觉神经传导速度异常

terms.name: Abnormal circulating ferritin concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of ferritin. Ferritin concentration can be measured in serum or plasma.

terms.name: Abnormal transferrin saturation
terms.definition: Any abnormality in the serum transferrin saturation, which is calculated by dividing the serum iron level by total iron-binding capacity.

terms.name: Comedonal acne
terms.definition: A type of acne in which open and closed comedones comprise the majority of the lesions, with substantially fewer papules and pustules.

terms.name: Mucinous histiocytosis
terms.name_zh: 黏液性组织细胞增生症
terms.definition: Multiple subcutaneous non-fragile and skin-coloured papules characterized by interstitial infiltrate of spindle and epithelioid histiocytes, and mucin. There are well circumscribed aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes and mucin in the upper and middle dermis,with the histiocytes arranged between collagen bundles and separated from the epidermis by a Grenz zone.

terms.name: Lipogranulomatosis
terms.definition: Yellow nodules of lipoid material are deposited in the skin and mucosae. This gives rise to granulomatous reactions.

terms.name: Reduced circulating 5-oxoprolinase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of 5-oxoprolinase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme catalyzes the reaction 5-oxo-L-proline + ATP + 2 H(2)O = L-glutamate + ADP + 2 H(+) + phosphate.

terms.name: Dystopic os odontoideum
terms.definition: Os odontoideum is classified into two anatomic types (orthotopic and dystopic). Os odontoideum is defined as an ossicle that consists of smooth and separate caudal portions of the odontoid process. With orthotopic os odontoideum, the ossicle moves with the anterior arch of the atlas, while the dystopic type consists of an ossicle near the basion, or one that is fused with the clivus

terms.name: L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria
terms.definition: An increase in the level of L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Dicarboxylic acidemia
synonyms: Elevated dicarboxylic acid level in blood
Increased dicarboxylic acid level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of dicarboxylic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Cortical myoclonus
terms.definition: Cortical myoclonus mainly affects the distal upper limbs and face, which reflects the largest cortical representations of these body areas. It is often focal, but may be multifocal, bilateral or generalized, as a consequence of intracortical and transcallosal spreading of abnormal activity. It typically occurs on voluntary action and may affect speech and gait. Cortical myoclonic jerks are stimulus sensitive, typically to touch, but sensitivity to visual stimuli is also described. Most patients with cortical myoclonus have both positive myoclonus and NM, occurring either independently or together as a complex of the two kinds of myoclonus. If cortical myoclonus is prolonged and lasts for hours, days or weeks, it is called epilepsia partials continua and is considered to be a rare form of focal epileptic status. Focal cortical myoclonus almost always points to an underlining lesion of the sensori-motor cortex, which produces hyperexcitability (e.g. vascular, inflammatory or neoplastic).

terms.name: Woolly scalp hair
terms.definition: The presence of wooly hair on the scalp. The term wooly hair refers to an abnormal variant of hair that is fine, with tightly coiled curls, and often hypopigmented. Optical microscopy may reveal the presence of tight spirals and a clear diameter reduction as compared with normal hair. Electron microscopy may show flat, oval hair shafts with reduced transversal diameter.

terms.name: Acne inversa
terms.definition: A chronic skin condition involving the inflammation of the apocrine sweat glands, forming pimple-like bumps known as abscesses.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxybutyric acid
terms.definition: An increased amount of 3-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary carboxylic acid
terms.definition: An increased amount of carboxylic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Abnormal spaced incisors
synonyms: Abnormality of spacing of front teeth

terms.name: Orthokeratosis
terms.definition: Formation of an anuclear keratin layer

terms.name: Lipomas of eyelids
terms.definition: Fatty tumors on the eyelids.

terms.name: Periostitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the periosteum

terms.name: Abnormality of extrinsic muscle of tongue
Platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase deficiency
terms.definition: Reduced level of platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating phospholipid concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a phospholipid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal level of platelet-activating factor
terms.name_zh: 血小板活化因子水平异常

terms.name: Increased level of platelet-activating factor
terms.name_zh: 血小板活化因子水平升高

terms.name: Decreased level of platelet-activating factor
terms.name_zh: 血小板活化因子水平降低

terms.name: Chapped lip
terms.definition: Cracking, fissuring, and peeling of the skin of the lips.

terms.name: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia
terms.definition: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia is a nonparoxysmal tachyarrhythmia characterized by an increased resting heart rate (HR) and/or an exaggerated HR response to minimal exertion or a change in body posture. HR is constantly above the physiological range with no appropriate relation to metabolic or physiological demands.

terms.name: Maculopapular exanthema
terms.definition: A skin rash that is characterized by diffuse cutaneous erythema with areas of skin elevation. It may evolve to vesicles or papules as part of a more severe clinical entity. Different degrees of angioedema with involvement of subcutaneous tissue may also appear.

terms.name: Neonatal sepsis
terms.definition: Systemic inflammatory response to infection in newborn babies.

terms.name: Osteochondrosis
terms.definition: Abnormal growth ossification centers in children. Initially a degeneration/ necrosis followed by regeneration or recalcification.

terms.name: Scaling skin
terms.definition: Refers to the loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes.

terms.name: Rectus femoris muscle atrophy
synonyms: Atrophy of the rectus femoris muscles

terms.name: APUdoma
synonyms: amine precursor uptake and decarboxylation tumors
amine precursor uptake and decarboxylation tumours
terms.definition: An endocrine tumor arising from an APUD cell.

terms.name: Increased head circumference
terms.definition: An abnormally increased head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart.

terms.name: Decreased head circumference
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart. Microcephaly is defined as a head circumference (HC) that is great than two standard deviations below the mean of age- and gender-matched population based samples. Severe microcephaly is defined with an HC that is three standard deviations below the mean.

terms.name: Mild microcephaly
terms.definition: Decreased occipito-frontal (head) circumference (OFC). For the microcephaly OFC must be between -3 SD and -2 SD compared to appropriate, age matched, normal standards (i.e. -3 SD <= OFC < -2 SD).

terms.name: Encephalomalacia
terms.definition: Encephalomalacia is the softening or loss of brain tissue after cerebral infarction, cerebral ischemia, infection, craniocerebral trauma, or other injury.

terms.name: Motor impersistence
terms.definition: The inability to maintain postures or positions (such as keeping eyes closed, protruding the tongue, maintaining conjugate gaze steadily in a fixed direction, or making a prolonged 'ah' sound) without repeated prompts.

terms.name: Simultanapraxia
terms.definition: A subset of motor impersistence, defined as the inability to perform more than two of the simple voluntary acts simultaneously, such as closing the eyes and protruding the tongue.

terms.name: Abnormal consumption behavior
terms.definition: Recurrent abnormal consumption of food, liquids, or objects that could have negative consequences for the individual.

terms.name: Abnormal CSF neopterin concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液新蝶呤浓度异常
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Elevated CSF neopterin level
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液新蝶呤水平升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Decreased CSF neopterin level
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液新蝶呤水平降低
terms.definition: Decreased concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating neopterin concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of neopterin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal CSF pterin concentration
terms.definition: Abnormal concentration of a pterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Elevated CSF biopterin level
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液生物蝶呤水平升高
terms.definition: Concentration of biopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased CSF biopterin level
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液生物蝶呤水平降低
terms.definition: Concentration of biopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating biopterin concentration
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of biopterin in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal skin morphology of the palm
terms.definition: An abnormality of the skin of the palm, that is, the skin of the front of the hand.

terms.name: Risus sardonicus
terms.definition: Fixed sarcastic grimace and anxious expression. Caused by spasms of the masseter and other facial muscles.

terms.name: Hypopnea
terms.definition: Hypopnea is referring to breathing that is abnormally shallow.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating insulin concentration
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of insulin in the body.

terms.name: Hypoinsulinemia
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of insulin in the blood.

terms.name: Elevated hemoglobin A1c
terms.definition: An increased concentration of hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), which is the product of nonenzymatic attachment of a hexose molecule to the N-terminal amino acid of the hemoglobin molecule. This reaction is dependent on blood glucose concentration, and therefore reflects the mean glucose concentration over the previous 8 to 12 weeks. The HbA1c level provides a better indication of long-term glycemic control than one-time blood or urinary glucose measurements.

terms.name: Reduced total natural killer cell count
terms.definition: The absolute count of natural killer cells in the blood, per microlitre, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Absent natural killer cells
terms.definition: Absence of detectable circulating NK cells, commonly characterized as CD3-CD19- and CD16+ or CD56+ lymphocytes, in the blood. Usually, less than 20 cells per microlitre is considered to be an absence.

terms.name: Abnormal size of the dental root
Maternal thrombophilia
terms.definition: An increased tendency towards thrombosis in the mother during a pregnancy.

terms.name: Pulmonary hemorrhage
terms.definition: Pulmonary hemorrhage is a bleeding within the lungs. Older children and adults may spit blood or bloody sputum. Neonates, infants and young children usually do not spit up blood. Anemia, pulmonary infiltrates, increasingling bloody return on BAL and the presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in broncho-alveolar lavage (BAL) fluid or lung biopsy can diagnose lung bleeding. Alveolar macrophages contain phagocytosed red blood cells and stain positive for hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, after about 48-72 hours following pulmonary hemorraghe. Previous or recurrent bleeding can thus be distinguished from fresh events. A differentiation into local or diffuse is of importance. Also differentiate if pulmonary hemorrhage is due to a primary lung disorder or a manifestation of a systemic disease.

terms.name: Abnormality of fibrinolysis
terms.definition: Clinical phenotype characterized by delayed bleeding accelerated break down of blood clot (fibrinolysis)

terms.name: Decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor Multimers
terms.name_zh: 高分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体减少
terms.definition: A decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor multimers.

terms.name: Decreased level of heparin co-factor II
terms.definition: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of heparin co-factor II

terms.name: Decreased level of histidine-rich glycoprotein
terms.name_zh: 富组氨酸糖蛋白水平降低
terms.definition: Decrease of these levels result in increased inhibition of fibrinolysis and reduced inhibition of coagulation

terms.name: Decreased circulating plasminogen concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环纤溶酶原浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of plasminogen in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased level of thrombomodulin
terms.name_zh: 血栓调节蛋白水平降低
terms.definition: Thrombomodulin is a cofactor in the thrombin induced activation of Protein C. In the case of deficiency there will be less Protein C and tendency to clot

terms.name: Decreased level of tissue plasminogen activator
terms.name_zh: 组织型纤溶酶原激活物水平降低
terms.definition: The tPA protein catalyzes the conversion of plasiminogen to plasmin, and thus break down of clots. When there is a deficiency there will be an increase of thrombosis

terms.name: Delayed onset bleeding
terms.definition: Abnormal bleeding related to a procedure or trauma which does not start at the time of the initial insult, but after delay by at least 24 hours.

terms.name: Factor XIII subunit A deficiency
terms.definition: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit A, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.

terms.name: Factor XIII subunit B deficiency
terms.definition: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit B, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.

terms.name: Leukocyte inclusion bodies
terms.definition: The presence of intraceullar inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in leukocytes.

terms.name: Hyperfibrinolysis
terms.definition: Increased degradation of fibrin, associated with clot instability and bleeding

terms.name: Impaired binding of factor VIII to VWF
terms.name_zh: VIII因子与血管性血友病因子结合障碍
synonyms: von Willebrand Disease Type II Normandy
terms.definition: Impaired binding of factor VIII to von Willebrand Factor. This is determined using a modified ELISA assay.

terms.name: Impaired neutrophil chemotaxis
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞趋化性受损
terms.definition: An impairment of the migration of neutrophils towards chemoattractants as part of the innate immune response

terms.name: Increased plasma vitamin K epoxide after vitamin K supplementation
terms.name_zh: 补充维生素K后血浆维生素K环氧化物升高
terms.definition: Increased plasma vitamin K epoxide after vitamin K supplementation is present in VKCFD (vitamin K-dependent clotting factor deficiency) type 2, but not in VKCFD type 1.

terms.name: Increased ratio of VWF propeptide to VWF antigen
terms.name_zh: 血管性血友病因子前肽/血管性血友病因子抗原比值升高
terms.definition: An increased VWF propeptide to VWF antigen indicates that deficiency of VWF is not due to impaired synthesis but due to rapid clearance. The VWF propeptide is measured by ELISA.

terms.name: Increased RIPA
terms.name_zh: 瑞斯托霉素诱导血小板聚集升高
terms.definition: Increased platelet agglutination in response to low-dose ristocetin

terms.name: Muscle hemorrhage
terms.definition: Bleeding occurring within a muscle

terms.name: Prolonged euglobulin clot lysis time
terms.definition: Abnormally increased length of time required for an in vitro clot to dissolve in the absence of the normal plasmin inhibitors. This test is a clinical assay used to measure fibrinolysis. The euglobulin fraction of plasma is precipitated and used to form clot by addition of thrombin; after clot forms the rate of clot breakdown (fibrinolysis) can be monitored.

terms.name: Prolonged Russell's viper venom time
terms.definition: Increased time to coagulation in the Russell's viper venom assay

terms.name: Reduced alpha-2-antiplasmin activity
terms.definition: Reduced activity of alpha-2-antiplasmin. This protein inactivates the protease plasmin that drives fibrinolysis.

terms.name: Reduced antithrombin antigen
terms.definition: Reduced antithrombin antigen. A reduced level of antithrombin may lead to an increased risk of thrombus formation.

terms.name: Reduced euglobulin clot lysis time
terms.definition: Abnormally decreased length of time required for an in vitro clot to dissolve in the absence of the normal plasmin inhibitors. This test is a clinical assay used to measure fibrinolysis. The euglobulin fraction of plasma is precipitated and used to form clot by addition of thrombin; after clot forms the rate of clot breakdown (fibrinolysis) can be monitored.

terms.name: Reduced plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
terms.definition: Reduced activity of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1. This protein down-regulates fibrinolysis in the circulation by inhibiting the two major plasminogen activators: tissue-plasminogen activator and urokinase-plasminogen activator.

terms.name: Reduced plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 antigen
terms.definition: Reduced level of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 antigen.

terms.name: Reduced prothrombin antigen
terms.definition: Reduced prothrombin antigen as measured by ELISA assay. Prothrombin is a vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor that is proteolytically cleaved to form thrombin.

terms.name: Hand dimple
terms.definition: A cutaneous indentation resulting from tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) of the hand.

terms.name: Aplastic/Hypoplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
terms.name_zh: 鼻咽腺样体发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasopharyngeal adenoids.

terms.name: Abnormal size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
terms.definition: A deviation in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

terms.name: Hypoplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the nasopharyngeal adenoids.

terms.name: Aplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
terms.definition: Absence of the nasopharyngeal adenoids as a developmental defect.

terms.name: Decreased size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
terms.definition: An abnormal decrease in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

terms.name: Increased size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
terms.definition: An abnormal increase in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

terms.name: Glue ear
terms.definition: Middle ear is filled with glue-like fluid instead of air.

terms.name: Jaw pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the jaw.

terms.name: Upper limb muscle hypertrophy
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in muscle size and mass of one or both arms not due to training.

terms.name: Impaired glucose tolerance
terms.definition: An abnormal resistance to glucose, i.e., a reduction in the ability to maintain glucose levels in the blood stream within normal limits following oral or intravenous administration of glucose.

terms.name: Hyperintensity of MRI T2 signal of the spinal cord
terms.definition: A region of high intensity (brightness) observed upon magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of the spinal cord.

terms.name: Adenocarcinoma of the intestines
terms.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the intestines.

terms.name: Adenocarcinoma of the small intestine
terms.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the small intestine.

terms.name: Adenocarcinoma of the large intestine
terms.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the large intestine.

terms.name: Frequency
terms.definition: Class to represent frequency of phenotypic abnormalities within a patient cohort.

terms.name: Obligate
terms.definition: Always present, i.e. in 100% of the cases.

terms.name: Very frequent
terms.definition: Present in 80% to 99% of the cases.

terms.name: Frequent
terms.definition: Present in 30% to 79% of the cases.

terms.name: Occasional
terms.definition: Present in 5% to 29% of the cases.

terms.name: Very rare
terms.definition: Present in 1% to 4% of the cases.

terms.name: Excluded
terms.definition: Present in 0% of the cases.

terms.name: Abnormal axial muscle morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the axial musculature, comprising muscles of the head and neck, muscles of the vertebral column, muscles of the thoracic wall, muscles of the abdominal wall, and muscles of the pelvic floor.

terms.name: Nasogastric tube feeding
terms.definition: The condition of inability to eat normally treated by placement of a thin tube through the nose into the stomach that is then used to carry food.

terms.name: Cyclically decreased total neutrophil count
terms.name_zh: 周期性总中性粒细胞计数降低
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of the absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, which occurs cyclically and then recovers without intervention.

terms.name: Abnormal location of the eyebrow
terms.definition: Anomalous anatomical placement of the eyebrow.

terms.name: Preauricular cyst
terms.definition: Preauricular sinus is an occasional finding and most frequently appears as a small pit close to the anterior margin of the ascending portion of the helix. The opening has also been reported along the postero superior margin of the helix, the tragus or the lobule. Preauricular sinus may lead to the formation of a subcutaneous cyst that is intimately related to the tragal cartilage and the anterior crus of the helix.

terms.name: Decreased circulating free fatty acid level
terms.name_zh: 血循环游离脂肪酸水平降低

terms.name: Abnormal circulating free fatty acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环游离脂肪酸浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal circulating free fatty acid level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a free fatty acid in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Increased urinary glycerol
terms.definition: An increased concentration of glycerol in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating glycerol concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of glycerol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating iron concentration
synonyms: Decreased iron cation level in blood
Reduced iron cation level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of iron cation in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased male libido
terms.definition: Increased desire for sexual activity on the part of a male.

terms.name: Decreased male libido
terms.definition: Reduced desire for sexual activity on the part of a male.

terms.name: Male sexual dysfunction
terms.definition: A problem occurring during any phase of the male sexual response cycle that prevents the individual from experiencing satisfaction from the sexual activity

terms.name: Male anorgasmia
terms.definition: Inability of a male to reach orgasm.

terms.name: Sterile arthritis
terms.definition: An inflammatory arthritis characterized by purulent synovial fluid with neutrophil accumulation, but with negative cultures.

terms.name: Symmetric polyarthritis
terms.definition: Polyarthritis refers to a joint disease that involves at least five joints. One or more signs of inflammation, including pain, movement restriction, swelling, warmth, and redness, are seen in the joints involved. Polyarthritis is defined as symmetric if at least half of the joints involved are affected in a symmetric (i.e., both right and the left) fashion.

terms.name: Oligoarthritis
terms.definition: A type of arthritis that affects up to four joints in the first six months of disease.

terms.name: Blind vagina
terms.definition: The vagina ends in a blind pouch or sac rather than being connected to the internal genitalia.

terms.name: Tongue edema
terms.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tongue.

terms.name: Blue urine
terms.definition: An abnormal blue color of the urine.

terms.name: Red urine
terms.definition: An abnormal red color of the urine.

terms.name: Dark urine
terms.definition: An abnormal dark color of the urine.

terms.name: Red-brown urine
terms.definition: An abnormal red-brown color of the urine.

terms.name: Dark yellow urine
terms.definition: An abnormal dark-yellow color of the urine.

terms.name: Purple urine
terms.definition: An abnormal purple color of the urine.

terms.name: Eyelid erythema
terms.definition: Redness of the skin of the eyelids, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.

terms.name: Heliotrope rash
terms.definition: In a heliotrope rash, the color of the skin turns to violet, which is the color of the heliotrope flower.

terms.name: Bull's eye rash
terms.definition: A cutaneous eruption that consists of multiple (at least two) concentric erythematous rings.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the olfactory bulb
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the olfactory bulb.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the olfactory bulb
terms.definition: An abnormal morphology of the olfactory bulb (bulbus olfactorius), which is involved in olfaction, i.e. the sense of smell.

terms.name: Focal hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.name_zh: MRI示脑白质局灶性高信号
terms.definition: An abnormal area of increased brightness (hyperintensity) that is limited to one particular area.

terms.name: Multifocal hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.name_zh: MRI示脑白质多灶性高信号
terms.definition: An abnormal area of increased brightness (hyperintensity) that occurs in several distinct areas.

terms.name: Confluent hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.name_zh: MRI示脑白质融合性高信号
terms.definition: Areas of brighter than expected MRI signal in the white matter of the brain whereby individual patches run together.

terms.name: Focal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.name_zh: MRI示脑白质局灶性低信号

terms.name: Multifocal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.name_zh: MRI示脑白质多灶性低信号

terms.name: Confluent hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
terms.name_zh: MRI示脑白质融合性低信号

terms.name: Purulent rhinitis
terms.definition: Chronic rhinitis accompanied by pus formation.

terms.name: Nipple localization
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is distributed around the nipples or located in the nipples.

terms.name: Breast microcalcification
terms.definition: The term breast microcalcification is used to define calcium deposits in the breast with a diameter of less than 1 mm.

terms.name: Architectural distortion of breast
terms.definition: Architectural distortion is defined as an architectural disruption of the normal breast that does not have obvious mass opacities, which may be early signs of breast carcinoma.

terms.name: Asymmetric thickening of the nipple-areolar complex
terms.name_zh: 乳头乳晕复合体不对称增厚
terms.definition: Thickening of the skin around the nipple with a distribution that is not equal on all sides.

terms.name: Perimenopausal
terms.definition: Perimenopause, or the menopausal transition, encompasses that period of time during which physiologic changes mark progression toward a woman's final menstrual period. This phase begins with the onset of menstrual irregularities and continues until a woman reaches menopause, or one year after amenorrhea has occurred. Perimenopause can last for a variable amount of time, the median of which is four years.

terms.name: Mastitis
terms.definition: Mastitis is defined as an inflammation of the breast and may or may not be accompanied by infection.

terms.name: Ameliorated by menopause
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by menopause.

terms.name: Fluctuance on palpation
terms.definition: Yielding to alternate pressure by palpating fingers so as to suggest that the area being felt contains fluid.

terms.name: History of vasectomy
terms.definition: A medical history of having undergone a vasectomy prior to the current presentation.

terms.name: Pain in penis
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the penis.

terms.name: Left ventricular thrombus
terms.definition: A blood clot (thrombus) localized in the left ventricle. Left ventricular thrombus is a serious complication of acute myocardial infarction and also of non-ischemic cardiomyopathies.

terms.name: Gelatinous ascites
terms.definition: A type of ascites characterized by copious amounts of mucinous ascites and mucinous peritoneal implants, leading to progressive obliteration of the peritoneal cavity and intestinal obstruction.

terms.name: Diffuse breast nodularity
terms.definition: Breast tissue with a lumpy or ropelike texture.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary nitrogen compound level
terms.name_zh: 尿含氮化合物水平异常
terms.definition: The amount of a nitrogen compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Decreased urinary biopterin level
terms.definition: The amount of biopterin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal urine guanidinoacetic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside normal limits.

terms.name: Elevated urine guanidinoacetic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary neopterin level
terms.definition: The amount of neopterin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary inosine level
terms.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary inosine level
terms.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary guanosine level
terms.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary guanosine level
terms.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary hypoxanthine level
terms.definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Decreased urinary hypoxanthine level
terms.definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Absent neutrophil lactoferrin
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞乳铁蛋白缺如
terms.definition: The absence of lactoferrin in neutrophil granules, which could be caused by either an isolated failure of synthesis of this protein (or the production of an antigenically unrecognizable form of lactoferrin) or a complete deficiency of specific granule production.

terms.name: Neutrophil nuclear clefts
terms.definition: An abnormality of the nucleus of neutrophils, which presents as either a type I nuclear cleft, where the nuclear cleft may show a transition into a round/oval shape. The second type nuclear cleft, which runs perpendicular to the nuclear surface, and this type of cleft might be related to nuclear lobe formation.

terms.name: Low neutrophil alkaline phosphatase
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞碱性磷酸酶降低
terms.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase in neutrophils, which could be due to absence of enzyme or the production of defective enzyme.

terms.name: Increased neutrophil mitochondria
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞线粒体增多
terms.definition: An increased number of mitochondria detected in neutrophils.

terms.name: Increased neutrophil ribosomes
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞核糖体增多
terms.definition: An increased number of ribosomes detected in neutrophils.

terms.name: Bladder outlet obstruction
terms.definition: A compression or resistance upon the bladder outflow channel at any location from the bladder neck to urethral meatus, which usually causes lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS).

terms.name: Decreased expression of GPI-anchored proteins on the cell surface
terms.name_zh: 细胞表面GPI锚定蛋白表达降低
terms.definition: A decrease in the protein expression of GPI-anchor proteins, such as CD55 and CD59, at the cell surface, which suggests a defect in GPI-anchor biosynthesis.

terms.name: Starch intolerance
terms.definition: An inability to digest starch.

terms.name: Renal tubular cyst
terms.definition: Tubular lumnal dilatation/prominence lined by simple layer of cuboidal-to-flat tublar epihelial cells.

terms.name: Ageusia
terms.definition: A rare condition that is characterized by a complete loss of taste function of the tongue.

terms.name: Agenesis of putamen
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the absence of the putamen owing to its failure to develop.

terms.name: Fractured humerus
terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the humerus.

terms.name: Hot cross bun sign
terms.definition: A cruciform-shaped hyperintensity within the pons found on T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG4 concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG4 concentration
terms.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating IgG4
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG4 can be measured.

terms.name: Fractured calcaneus
terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the calcaneus.

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG2 concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG2 concentration
terms.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating IgG2
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG2 can be measured.

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG1 concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG1 concentration
terms.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating IgG1
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG1 can be measured.

terms.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG3 concentration
terms.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG3 concentration
terms.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood.

terms.name: Fractured thoracic vertebra
terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the thoracic vertebra.

terms.name: Chronic absent circulating IgG3
terms.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG3 can be measured.

terms.name: Abnormal immunoglobulin level in body fluid
terms.name_zh: 体液免疫球蛋白水平异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in body fluids, such as mucous.

terms.name: Increased immunoglobulin level in body fluid
terms.name_zh: 体液免疫球蛋白水平升高
terms.definition: An elevation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in body fluids, such as mucous.

terms.name: Decreased immunoglobulin level in body fluid
terms.name_zh: 体液免疫球蛋白水平降低
terms.definition: An reduction from normal levels of immunoglobulins in body fluids, such as mucous.

terms.name: Decreased body fat percentage
terms.definition: The percentage of fat as a part of total body weight below the norm, usually defined as less than 14% for females and less than 8% for males.

terms.name: Abnormal exhausted T cell proportion
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of exhausted T cell relative to T cell in the blood.

terms.name: Fractured lower leg
terms.definition: Bone fracture anywhere in the tibia, fibula, or ankle.

terms.name: Fractured skull
terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the skull.

terms.name: Fractured phalanx
terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the phalanx.

terms.name: Compression-fractured thoracic vertebra
terms.definition: A fracture of the thoracic vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.

terms.name: Compression-fractured vertebra
terms.definition: A fracture of the vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.

terms.name: Compression-fractured cervical vertebra
terms.definition: A fracture of the cervical vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.

terms.name: Compression-fractured lumbar vertebra
terms.definition: A fracture of the lumbar vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.

terms.name: Avulsion fractured humerus
terms.definition: A fractured in which a fragment of the humerus tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

terms.name: Avulsion fractured tibia
terms.definition: A fractured in which a fragment of the tibia tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

terms.name: Pelvic avulsion fracture
synonyms: Avulsion fractured pelvic region of trunk
terms.definition: An avulsion fracture (i.e., a type of fracture in which a piece of bone tears away from the site where the muscle attaches to the bone) of a bone of the pelvis.

terms.name: Avulsion fractured epiphysis of femur
terms.definition: A fractured in which the fragment of the epiphysis of femur bone tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

terms.name: Emotional hypersensitivity
terms.definition: Heightened emotional reactivity or response to environmental stimuli, including the emotions of others that include behaviors or expressive outbursts that are beyond the accepted cultural range and norms.

terms.name: Beau's lines
terms.definition: A nail dystrophy that is preseents as grooved lines that run from side to side on the fingernail or the toenail that may look like indentations or ridges on the nail plate. They are caused by temporary disruption in the growth of proximal nail matrix. Trauma is usually the initiating factor such as infections, severe medical illnesses, major surgery/anesthesia, medication side effects, and autoimmune disease.

terms.name: Complete tracheal ring
terms.definition: Continuous or nearly continuous configuration of the cartilaginous tracheal ring.

terms.name: Decreased middle cerebral artery pulsatility index
terms.name_zh: 大脑中动脉搏动指数降低
terms.definition: Abnormally reduced blood flow pulsatility in in the middle cerebral artery (MCA). The pulsatility index (PI) is calculated using the following equation PI = (peak systolic velocity-end-diastolic velocity)/mean velocity.

terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the metaphysis of femur.

terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the right clavicle.

terms.definition: A fracture or multiple fractures of one or more of three bones in the ankle joint: the tibia (shinbone), the fibula (outer ankle bone), and the talus (which is the bone that connects your leg to your foot).

Neural tube defect
terms.definition: A neural tube defect arises when the neural tube, the embryonic precursor of the brain and spinal cord, fails to close during neurulation. The cranial region (anencephaly) or the low spine (open spina bifida; myelomeningocele) are most commonly affected although, in the severe NTD craniorachischisis, almost the entire neural tube remains open, from midbrain to low spine.

terms.name: Aplasia of lymphatic vessels
terms.definition: Aplasia (absence) of the lymphatic vessels.

terms.name: Abnormal substantia nigra morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the substantia nigra, which is a midbrain dopaminergic nucleus which has a critical role in modulating motor movement and reward functions as part of the basal ganglia circuitry.

terms.name: Abnormal peripheral nerve morphology by anatomical site
terms.name_zh: 按解剖部位分的周围神经形态异常
terms.definition: Abnormal morphology of a specific peripheral nerve

terms.name: Decreased urine bicarbonate concentration
terms.definition: Abnormally decreased concentration of hydrogencarbonate in the urine.

terms.name: Congenital malformation of the left heart
terms.definition: Defect or defects of the morphogenesis of the left heart identifiable at birth.

terms.name: Narrow palpebral fissure
terms.definition: Reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids.

terms.name: Abnormal mediastinum morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the central compartment of the thoracic cavity.

terms.name: Microlissencephaly
terms.definition: Severe microcephaly and lissencephaly with granular surfaces with immature cortical plate, reduced in thickness, with focal polymicrogyria and immature small neurons with rare processes, intermingled with a considerable number of glial elements.

terms.name: Eosinophilic fasciitis
terms.name_zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞性筋膜炎
terms.definition: Inflammation and thickening (localized fibrosis) of the fascia, the tissue under the skin and over the muscle, typically associated with a build up of eosinophils in the muscles and tissues.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3-aminoisobutyric acid
terms.definition: An increased amount of 3-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Gastric lymphoma
terms.definition: Lymphoma that originates in the stomach itself.

terms.name: Osteolysis involving bones of the upper limbs
Abnormal circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环乳酸脱氢酶浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal serum concentration/activity of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), which catalyzes the reduction of pyruvate to form lactate.

terms.name: Reduced circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of lactate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C4 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C4 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C4a concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C4a in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement C4b concentration

terms.name: Elevated circulating acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name_zh: 血循环胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基浓度降低
