terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to bronchiolitis as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchiolitis.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin B12 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B12 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin B1 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B1 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin B2 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B2 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin B5 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B5 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin B8 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B8 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating folate concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of folic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormality of vitamin metabolism
terms.definition: An anomaly in the metabolism of a vitamin.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin C concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of vitamin C in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin C concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin C in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin D concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of vitamin D or a vitamin D metabolite in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin D concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin D in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin E concentration
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of vitamin E in the blood circulation. Vitamin E is a lipophilic vitamin that is also known as alpha-tocopherol.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin E concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of vitamin E in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Pollakisuria
terms.definition: Increased frequency of urination.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the ureter
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the ureter.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the urethra
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the urethra.

terms.name: Dysuria
terms.definition: Painful or difficult urination.

terms.name: Anuria
terms.definition: Absence of urine, clinically classified as below 50ml/day.

terms.name: Oliguria
terms.definition: Low output of urine, clinically classified as an output below 300-500ml/day.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the thymus
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the thymus.

terms.name: Thymoma
terms.definition: A tumor originating from the epithelial cells of the thymus.

terms.name: Liver abscess
terms.definition: A localized, circumscribed collection of purulent material (pus) within the liver parenchyma, typically resulting from a bacterial, parasitic, or fungal infection. Unlike hepatitis, which is often diffuse, an abscess is a focal lesion.

terms.name: Limb duplication
terms.definition: Congenital duplication of all or part of a limb.

terms.name: Urachus fistula
terms.definition: Persistence of the urachal canal with drainage of urine from the bladder through the persistent allantois canal to the umbilicus.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the lung
terms.definition: Tumor of the lung.

terms.name: Pleuropulmonary blastoma
terms.definition: A rare cancer originating in the lung or pleural cavity that occurs most often in infants and young children but also has been reported in adults. Pleuropulmonary blastoma is regarded as malignant.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating phosphate ion concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环磷酸根离子浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of phosphate ion in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating calcium-phosphate regulating hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血钙磷调节激素浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal Ca2+ PO4 regulating hormone level
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of a hormone that is involved in the regulation of phosphate and calcium.

terms.name: Wind-swept deformity of the knees
terms.definition: The appearance of abnormal valgus deformity in one knee in association with varus deformity in the other.

terms.name: Scleritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the sclera.

terms.name: Inflammatory abnormality of the eye
terms.definition: Inflammation of the eye, parts of the eye or the periorbital region.

terms.name: Episcleritis
synonyms: Inflammation of the thin layer on top of the white part of eye
terms.definition: Inflammation of the episclera, a thin layer of tissue covering the white part (sclera) of the eye.

terms.name: Abnormal fascia morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of fascia.

terms.name: Fasciitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of fascia, the tissue under the skin and over the muscle.

terms.name: Abnormality of the supraorbital ridges
synonyms: Abnormality of the brow of the face
terms.definition: An anomaly of the supraorbital portion of the frontal bones.

terms.name: Periorbital edema
terms.definition: Edema affecting the region situated around the orbit of the eye.

terms.name: Palpebral edema
terms.definition: Edema in the region of the eyelids.

terms.name: Femoral hernia
terms.definition: A hernia which occurs just below the inguinal ligament, where abdominal contents pass through a naturally occurring weakness called the femoral canal.

terms.name: Abnormal localization of kidney
terms.definition: An abnormal site of the kidney.

terms.name: Cognitive impairment
terms.definition: Abnormal cognition is characterized by deficits in thinking, reasoning, or remembering.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the heart
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the heart.

terms.name: Arterial stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of an artery.

terms.name: Carotid artery stenosis
terms.definition: Narrowing of the carotid arteries.

terms.name: Abnormal forebrain morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the forebrain, which has as its parts the telencephalon, diencephalon, lateral ventricles and third ventricle.

terms.name: Exstrophy
terms.definition: Eversion of a hollow organ and exposure, inside out, and protruded through the abdominal wall.

terms.name: Tendon rupture
terms.definition: Breakage (tear) of a tendon.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the trachea
terms.definition: A neoplasm of the trachea.

terms.name: Hemihypertrophy of lower limb
terms.definition: Overgrowth of only one leg.

terms.name: Hemihypertrophy of upper limb
terms.definition: Overgrowth of only one arm.

terms.name: Asymmetric growth
synonyms: Uneven or disproportionate growth of one body part compared to another
terms.definition: A growth pattern that displays an abnormal difference between the left and the right side.

terms.name: Hemiatrophy
terms.definition: Undergrowth of the limbs that affects only one side.

terms.name: Hemiatrophy of lower limb
terms.definition: Unilateral atrophy (reduction in size) of a leg.

terms.name: Hemiatrophy of upper limb
terms.definition: Unilateral atrophy (reduction in size) of an arm.

terms.name: Lower limb asymmetry
synonyms: Left and right leg differ in length or width
terms.definition: A difference in length or diameter between the left and right leg.

terms.name: Upper limb asymmetry
terms.definition: Difference in length or size between the right and left arm.

terms.name: Diplomyelia
terms.definition: Duplication of the spinal cord.

terms.name: Diastomatomyelia
terms.definition: Coexistence of two hemicords, at variable levels, causing splaying of the posterior vertebral elements. Results in neurological deficits in lower limb or perineum.

terms.name: Triplomyelia
terms.definition: Triplication of the spinal cord - extremely rare.

terms.name: Hydromyelia
terms.definition: Dilation of central canal from incomplete fusion of the posterior columns or persistence of the primitive large canal of the embryo.

terms.name: Amyelia
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the spinal cord.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the endocrine system
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the endocrine system.

terms.name: Abnormally ossified vertebrae
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of one or more vertebrae.

terms.name: Carcinoid tumor
terms.definition: A tumor formed from the endocrine (argentaffin) cells of the mucosal lining of a variety of organs including the stomach and intestine. These cells are from neuroectodermal origin.

terms.name: Cardiac diverticulum
terms.definition: A cardiac diverticulum is a rare congenital malformation which is either fibrous or muscular.

terms.name: Fibrous cardiac diverticulum
terms.definition: A fibrous cardiac diverticulum refers to an aneurysm and usually appears as an isolated congenital anomaly.

terms.name: Biliary tract neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the biliary system.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the gallbladder
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the gallbladder.

terms.name: Amaurosis fugax
terms.definition: A transient visual disturbance that is typically caused by a circulatory, ocular or neurological underlying condition.

terms.name: Urinary bladder inflammation
terms.definition: Inflammation of the urinary bladder.

terms.name: Lipoatrophy
synonyms: Loss of fat tissue in localised area
Loss of fat tissue in localized area
terms.definition: Localized loss of fat tissue.

terms.name: Mucosal telangiectasiae
terms.definition: Telangiectasia of the mucosa, the mucous membranes which are involved in absorption and secretion that line cavities that are exposed to the external environment and internal organs.

terms.name: Barrett esophagus
terms.definition: An abnormal change (metaplasia) in the cells of the inferior portion of the esophagus. The normal squamous epithelium lining of the esophagus is replaced by metaplastic columnar epithelium. Columnar epithelium refers to a cell type that is typically found in more distal parts of the gastrointestinal system.

terms.name: Dilatation of renal calices
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement of the renal calices, the system of ducts of the kidney that collect urine.

terms.name: Nasal polyposis
terms.definition: Polypoidal masses arising mainly from the mucous membranes of the nose and paranasal sinuses. They are freely movable and nontender overgrowths of the mucosa that frequently accompany allergic rhinitis.

terms.name: Corneal perforation
terms.definition: A rupture of the cornea through which a portion of the iris protrudes.

terms.name: Endocarditis
terms.definition: An inflammation of the endocardium, the inner layer of the heart, which usually involves the heart valves.

terms.name: Telangiectasia of the skin
terms.definition: Presence of small, permanently dilated blood vessels near the surface of the skin, visible as small focal red lesions.

terms.name: Sterile pyuria
terms.definition: Patients who routinely have greater than 20 leukocytes per microliter, but have abacterial urine, are said to have sterile pyuria.

terms.name: Abnormal preputium morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the retractable fold of skin that covers the tip of the penis.

terms.name: Paraphimosis
terms.definition: The foreskin becomes trapped behind the glans penis, and cannot be pulled back to its normal flaccid position covering the glans penis.

terms.name: Urogenital fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula affecting the genitourinary system.

terms.name: Rectal fistula
terms.definition: The presence of a fistula affecting the rectum.

terms.name: Peritoneal abscess
terms.definition: The presence of an abscess of the peritoneum.

terms.name: Calcification of cartilage
terms.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in cartilage.

terms.name: Esophageal web
terms.definition: Thin (2-3mm) membranes of normal esophageal tissue consisting of mucosa and submucosa that can be congenital or acquired. Congenital webs commonly appear in the middle and inferior third of the esophagus, and they are more likely to be circumferential with a central or eccentric orifice. Acquired webs are much more common than congenital webs and typically appear in the cervical area (postcricoid). Clinical symptoms of this condition are selective (solid more than liquids) dysphagia, thoracic pain, nasopharyngeal reflux, aspiration, perforation and food impaction (the last two are very rare).

terms.name: Camptocormia
terms.definition: An abnormal forward-flexed posture e.g. forward flexion of the spine, which is noticeable when standing or walking but disappears when lying down. It is becoming an increasingly recognized feature of Parkinson's disease and dystonic disorders.

terms.name: Absent nares
terms.definition: The nostrils (the paired channels of the nose) are not present.

terms.name: Pulmonary edema
terms.definition: Fluid accumulation in the lungs.

terms.name: Bifid penis
terms.definition: Two penile structures, separated from the tip to the base of the shaft.

terms.name: Penoscrotal transposition
terms.definition: A partial or complete positional exchange between the penis and the scrotum, with positioning of the scrotum superior to the penis.

terms.name: Eclampsia
terms.definition: An acute and life-threatening complication of pregnancy, which is characterized by the appearance of tonic-clonic seizures, usually in a patient who had developed pre-eclampsia. Eclampsia includes seizures and coma that happen during pregnancy but are not due to preexisting or organic brain disorders.

terms.name: Preeclampsia
terms.definition: Pregnancy-induced hypertension in association with significant amounts of protein in the urine.

terms.name: Toxemia of pregnancy
terms.definition: Pregnancy-induced toxic reactions of the mother that can be as harmless as slight Maternal hypertension or as life threatening as Eclampsia.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the lip
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the lip.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the respiratory system
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the respiratory system.

terms.name: Dysmenorrhea
terms.definition: Pain during menstruation that interferes with daily activities.

terms.name: Metrorrhagia
terms.definition: Bleeding at irregular intervals.

terms.name: Maternal hyperphenylalaninemia
synonyms: High blood phenylalanine level in mother
terms.definition: A medical history of exposure during the fetal period to hyperphenylalaninemia because the mother had phenylketonuria with inadequate control during pregnancy.

terms.name: Multiple glomerular cysts
terms.definition: The presence of many cysts in the glomerulus of the kidney related to dilatation of the Bowman's capsule.

terms.name: Odontogenic neoplasm
terms.definition: Neoplasm involving odontogenic cells, an odontogenic tumor.

terms.name: Death in early adulthood
terms.definition: Death between the age of 16 and 40 years.

terms.name: Myositis
terms.definition: A general term for inflammation of the muscles without respect to the underlying cause.

terms.name: Ovarian neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ovary.

terms.name: Testicular teratoma
terms.definition: The presence of a teratoma of the testis.

terms.name: Testicular seminoma
terms.definition: The presence of a seminoma, an undifferentiated germ cell tumor of the testis.

terms.name: Leydig cell neoplasia
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the testis with origin in a Leydig cell.

terms.name: Sertoli cell neoplasm
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the testis with origin in a Sertoli cell.

terms.name: Germinoma
terms.definition: A type of undifferentiated germ cell tumor that may be benign or malignant.

terms.name: Dysgerminoma
terms.definition: The presence of a dysgerminoma, i.e., an undifferentiated germ cell tumor of the ovary.

terms.name: Maternal seizure
terms.definition: A seizure during pregnancy.

terms.name: Abnormal corpus cavernosum morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the corpus cavernosum, the erectile tissue of the penis.

terms.name: Displacement of the urethral meatus
synonyms: Displacement of the external urethral orifice
Displacement of the male external urethral orifice
terms.definition: A displacement of the external urethral orifice from its normal position (in males normally placed at the tip of glans penis, in females normally placed about 2.5 cm behind the glans clitoridis and immediately in front of that of the vagina).

terms.name: Esophageal diverticulum
terms.definition: The presence of a diverticulum of the esophagus.

terms.name: Midline facial cleft
terms.definition: A congenital malformation with a cleft (gap or opening) in the midline of the face.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the adrenal gland
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the adrenal gland.

terms.name: Pulmonary sequestration
terms.definition: The presence of a piece lung tissue which is not attached to the pulmonary blood supply and does not communicate with the other lung tissue (not connected to the standard bronchial airways and not performing a function in respiration).

terms.name: Esophagitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the esophagus.

terms.name: Neuroendocrine neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor that originates from a neuroendocrine cell.

terms.name: Carotid paraganglioma
terms.definition: A paraganglioma (a neuroendocrine neoplasm) originating in a carotid artery.

terms.name: Pulmonary paraglioma
terms.definition: A rare paranglioma of the lung, tumors that arise from extra-adrenal chromaffin cells.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the pharynx
terms.definition: A neoplasm originating in the pharynx.

terms.name: Erectile dysfunction
terms.definition: A multidimensional but common male sexual dysfunction that involves an alteration in any of the components of the erectile response, including organic, relational and psychological.

terms.name: Laryngeal cyst
terms.definition: Presence of a cyst (sac-like structure) located in the larynx.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the adrenal cortex
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the adrenal cortex.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the adrenal medulla
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the adrenal medulla.

terms.name: Abnormality of nail color
terms.definition: An anomaly of the color of the nail.

terms.name: Melanonychia
terms.definition: Dark discoloration of a fingernail or toenail (brown, black, bluish and reddish).

terms.name: Cystocele
terms.definition: Anterior vaginal wall prolapse with bulging of the bladder into the vagina.

terms.name: Thyroiditis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the thyroid gland.

terms.name: Graves disease
terms.definition: An autoimmune disease where the thyroid is overactive, producing an excessive amount of thyroid hormones (a serious metabolic imbalance known as hyperthyroidism and thyrotoxicosis). This is caused by autoantibodies to the TSH-receptor (TSHR-Ab) that activate that TSH-receptor (TSHR), thereby stimulating thyroid hormone synthesis and secretion, and thyroid growth (causing a diffusely enlarged goiter). The resulting state of hyperthyroidism can cause a dramatic constellation of neuropsychological and physical signs and symptoms, which can severely compromise the patients.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the tongue
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the tongue.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the oral cavity
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the oral cavity.

terms.name: Vaginal neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the vagina.

terms.name: Type I diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: A chronic condition in which the pancreas produces little or no insulin. Type I diabetes mellitus is manifested by the sudden onset of severe hyperglycemia with rapid progression to diabetic ketoacidosis unless treated with insulin.

terms.name: Optic neuritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the optic nerve.

terms.name: Retrobulbar optic neuritis
terms.definition: Optic neuritis that occurs in the section of the optic nerve located behind the eyeball.

terms.name: Thoracoabdominal wall defect
terms.definition: Failure of the chest and abdominal wall to close, which is likely caused by the failure of the ventral wall to close during week 4 of development.

terms.name: Thoracoabdominal eventration
terms.definition: Congenital protrusion of the abdominal or thoracic viscera, usually with a defect of the sternum and ribs as well as of the abdominal walls.

terms.name: Cellulitis
terms.definition: A bacterial infection and inflammation of the skin und subcutaneous tissues.

terms.name: Abnormal cerebral vascular morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the cerebral blood vessels
terms.definition: An anomaly of the cerebral blood vessels.

terms.name: Dyskinesia
terms.definition: A movement disorder which consists of effects including diminished voluntary movements and the presence of involuntary movements.

terms.name: Trigeminal neuralgia
terms.definition: A neuropathic disorder characterized by episodes of intense pain in the face, originating from the trigeminal nerve. One, two, or all three branches of the nerve may be affected.

terms.name: Chondritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of cartilage.

terms.name: Synotia
terms.definition: A congenital malformation characterized by the union or approximation of the ears in front of the neck, often accompanied by the absence or defective development of the lower jaw.

terms.name: Angioedema
terms.definition: Rapid swelling (edema) of the dermis, subcutaneous tissue, mucosa and submucosal tissues of the skin of the face, normally around the mouth, and the mucosa of the mouth and/or throat, as well as the tongue during a period of minutes to several hours. The swelling can also occur elsewhere, typically in the hands. Angioedema is similar to urticaria, but the swelling is subcutaneous rather than on the epidermis.

terms.name: Intestinal duplication
terms.definition: A developmental disorder in which there is a duplication the entire intestine or of a portion of the intestine.

terms.name: Abnormal pigmentation of the oral mucosa
terms.name_zh: 口腔黏膜色素沉着异常
synonyms: Abnormal pigmentation of oral mucous membrane
Abnormal pigmentation of the oral mucosa/gingivae
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pigmentation of the mucosa of the mouth.

terms.name: Coarse metaphyseal trabecularization
terms.definition: Coarse appearance of the components of the network of osseous tissue that makes up the cancellous structure of a bone, i.e., thickening of the (usually fine) white lines that are produced by trabeculae in radiograms.

terms.name: Abnormal trabecular bone morphology
terms.definition: Abnormal structure or form of trabecular bone.

terms.name: Vaginal hydrocele
terms.definition: A type of hydrocele testis in which the processus vaginalis remains patent only around the testes, and, as fluid accumulates, it renders the testes impalpable.

terms.name: Vulval varicose vein
terms.definition: Varicosity of veins in the vulval region.

terms.name: Premature skin wrinkling
terms.definition: The presence of an increased degree of wrinkling (irregular folds and indentations) of the skin as compared with age-related norms.

terms.name: Esophageal duplication
terms.definition: A developmental disorder in which there is a duplication of a portion of the muscle and submucosa of the esophagus without epithelial duplication.

terms.name: Tracheal atresia
terms.definition: A congenital absence or considerable underdevelopment of the trachea such that communication between the larynx proximally and the alveoli of the lungs distally is lacking.

terms.name: Salivary gland neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of a salivary gland.

terms.name: Abnormal Sharpey fiber morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of Sharpey's fibers (bone fibers, or perforating fibers), which are a matrix of connective tissue consisting of bundles of strong collagenous fibers connecting periosteum to bone.

terms.name: Polyotia
terms.definition: The presence of an extra auricle on one or both sides of the head.

terms.name: Decreased corneal thickness
terms.definition: A decreased anteroposterior thickness of the cornea.

terms.name: Mosaic central corneal dystrophy
terms.name_zh: 马赛克样中央角膜营养不良

terms.name: Abnormality of the curvature of the cornea
Increased corneal curvature
terms.definition: An increase in the degree of curvature of the cornea compared to normal.

terms.name: Iridodonesis
terms.definition: Tremulousness of the iris on movement of the eye, occurring in subluxation of the lens.

terms.name: Tibial torsion
terms.definition: Twisted position of the tibia (shin bone) associated with pathological rotation of the leg.

terms.name: Lipedema
terms.definition: Excess deposit and expansion of adipose tissue in an unusual pattern which cannot be lost through diet and exercise .

terms.name: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
terms.definition: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors (MPNSTs) are aggressive soft tissue sarcomas (STS) with nerve sheath differentiation and a tendency to metastasize.

terms.name: Subcutaneous neurofibroma
terms.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the subcutis (subcutaneous region).

terms.name: Scarring
terms.definition: A scar refers to a lesion in which wound, burn, or sore has not healed completely and fibrous connective tissue has developed.

terms.name: Abnormal arachnoid mater morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Arachnoid mater.

terms.name: Abnormal pia mater
terms.definition: An abnormality of the pia mater.

terms.name: Arachnoid cyst
synonyms: Fluid-filled sac located in membrane surrounding brain or spinal cord
terms.definition: An extra-parenchymal and intra-arachnoidal collection of fluid with a composition similar to that of cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Tongue thrusting
terms.definition: Pressing forward of the tongue in the mouth, a retained motoric habit from infantile swallowing patterns

terms.name: Cerebral visual impairment
terms.definition: A form of loss of vision caused by damage to the visual cortex rather than a defect in the eye.

terms.name: Abnormal glial cell morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the glia cell.

terms.name: Abnormal oligodendroglia morphology
terms.name_zh: 少突胶质细胞形态异常
terms.definition: One of the three types of glia cells that, with the nerve cells, compose the central nervous system and are characterized by sheetlike processes that wrap around individual axons to form the myelin sheath of nerve fibers.

terms.name: Abnormal astrocyte morphology
terms.name_zh: 星形胶质细胞形态异常
terms.definition: An abnormality of astrocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal microglia morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the microglial cells. They are also known as brain-resident macrophages or Hortega cells.

terms.name: Impulsivity
terms.definition: Acting on the spur of the moment or on a momentary basis without consideration of outcomes; having difficulty establishing or following plans; experiencing a sense of urgency and engaging in behavior that is uninhibited, cannot be inhibited, and is uncontrolled. The possibility of repression is inconceivable.

terms.name: Abnormal thoracic spine morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the thoracic vertebral column.

terms.name: Abnormal lumbar spine morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the lumbar vertebral column.

terms.name: Self-injurious behavior
terms.definition: Self-aggression.

terms.name: Abnormal cementum morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the cementum, which is the mineralized connective tissue covering the dental root. The cementum allows anchoring of the fibers of the periodontal ligament. Cementum is secreted by cementoblasts, which may be, later on, embedded in the cementum. Cementum can be acellular (along the two third coronal portion of the root) and cellular (in the apical and interradicular part of the root).

terms.name: Lens coloboma
terms.definition: A sectoral indentation of the crystalline lens, usually due to zonular weakness or absence.

terms.name: Mediastinal lymphadenopathy
synonyms: Swollen lymph nodes in center of chest
Swollen lymph nodes in centre of chest
terms.definition: Swelling of lymph nodes within the mediastinum, the central compartment of the thoracic cavities that contains the heart and the great vessels, the esophagus, and trachea and other structures including lymph nodes.

terms.name: Hypercoagulability
terms.definition: An abnormality of coagulation associated with an increased risk of thrombosis.

terms.name: Lichenification
terms.definition: Thickening and hardening of the epidermis seen with exaggeration of normal skin lines.

terms.name: Kaposi's sarcoma
terms.definition: A systemic disease which can present with cutaneous lesions with or without internal involvement. Tumors are caused by Human herpesvirus 8 (HHV8), also known as Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV).

terms.name: Histiocytosis
terms.definition: An excessive number of histiocytes (tissue macrophages).

terms.name: Bronchogenic cyst
terms.definition: A rare congenital cystic lesion of the lungs in the mediastinum.

terms.name: Transverse facial cleft
terms.definition: A horizontal cleft of the face, varying from slight widening of the mouth, to a cleft extending to the ear.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the parathyroid gland
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the parathyroid gland.

terms.name: Abnormal vertebral epiphysis morphology
synonyms: Abnormal shape of the end part of the vertebra bone
terms.definition: An anomaly of one or more epiphyses of one or more vertebrae.

terms.name: Abnormal soft palate morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the soft palate.

terms.name: Abnormal eating behavior
terms.definition: Abnormal eating habits involve excessive or insufficient consumption of food, or any other abnormal pattern of food consumption.

terms.name: Bulimia
terms.definition: A form of anomalous eating behavior characterized by binge eating is followed by self-induced vomiting or other compensatory behavior intended to prevent weight gain (purging, fasting or exercising or a combination of these).

terms.name: Vascular neoplasm
terms.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm (tumor) originating in the vascular system.

terms.name: Abnormality of the humeroulnar joint
terms.definition: An anomaly of the joint between the trochlear notch of ulna and the trochlea of humerus, which is part of the elbow joint.

terms.name: Macrodactyly of finger
terms.definition: A type of Macrodactyly affecting one or several fingers.

terms.name: Macrodactyly of toe
terms.definition: A type of Macrodactyly affecting one or several toes.

terms.name: Chest pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the chest.

terms.name: Atelectasis
synonyms: Partial or complete collapse of part or entire lung
terms.definition: Collapse of part of a lung associated with absence of inflation (air) of that part.

terms.name: Esophageal neoplasm
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the esophagus.

terms.name: Abnormal liver lobulation
terms.definition: Formation of abnormal lobules (small masses of tissue) in the liver.

terms.name: Schizophrenia
terms.definition: A mental disorder characterized by a disintegration of thought processes and emotional responsiveness. It most commonly manifests as auditory hallucinations, paranoid or bizarre delusions, or disorganized speech and thinking. It is accompanied by significant social or occupational dysfunction. The onset of symptoms typically occurs in young adulthood, with a global lifetime prevalence of about 1%. This term is not a helpful parent term to describe abnormal experiences.

terms.name: Mania
terms.definition: A state of abnormally elevated or irritable mood, arousal, and/or energy levels.

terms.name: Pancreatoblastoma
terms.definition: A rare pediatric carcinoma of the pancreas.

terms.name: Gangrene
synonyms: Death of body tissue due to lack of blood flow or infection
terms.definition: A serious and potentially life-threatening condition that arises when a considerable mass of body tissue dies (necrosis).

terms.name: Clubbing of fingers
terms.definition: Terminal broadening of the fingers (distal phalanges of the fingers).

terms.name: Clubbing of toes
terms.definition: Terminal broadening of the toes (distal phalanges of the toes).

terms.name: Hemobilia
terms.definition: Bleeding into the biliary tree.

terms.name: Abnormality of the lymphatic system
terms.definition: An anomaly of the lymphatic system, a network of lymphatic vessels that carry a clear fluid called lymph unidirectionally towards either the right lymphatic duct or the thoracic duct, which in turn drain into the right and left subclavian veins respectively.

terms.name: Lymphangioma
terms.definition: Lymphangiomas are rare congenital malformations consisting of focal proliferations of well-differentiated lymphatic tissue in multi cystic or sponge like structures. Lymphangioma is usually asymptomatic due to its soft consistency but compression of adjacent structures can be seen due to the mass effect of a large tumor.

terms.name: Abnormality of the tonsils
terms.definition: An abnormality of the tonsils.

terms.name: Abnormal lymphatic vessel morphology
terms.definition: A structural anomaly of the vessel that contains or conveys lymph fluid.

terms.name: Abnormal placenta morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the placenta, the organ that connects the developing fetus to the uterine wall to enable nutrient uptake, waste elimination, and gas exchange.

terms.name: Choriocarcinoma
terms.definition: A malignant, trophoblastic and aggressive cancer, usually of the placenta. It is characterized by early hematogenous spread to the lungs and belongs to the far end of the spectrum of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), a subset of germ cell tumors.

terms.name: Hyperperistalsis
terms.definition: Excessively active peristalsis (wave of contraction of the tubular organs of the gastrointestinal tract) marked by excessive rapidity of the passage of food through the stomach and intestine.

terms.name: Hypoperistalsis
terms.definition: Reduced or inadequate peristalsis, with resultant slow passage of contents through the digestive tract.

terms.name: Hyperostosis
terms.definition: Excessive growth or abnormal thickening of bone tissue.

terms.name: Dural ectasia
terms.definition: A widening or ballooning of the dural sac surrounding the spinal cord usually at the lumbosacral level.

terms.name: Recurrent pharyngitis
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to pharyngitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of pharyngeal infection that are unusual in frequency or severity for a healthy individual of the same age.

terms.name: Exostoses
synonyms: Formation of new noncancerous bone on top of existing bone
terms.definition: An exostosis is a benign growth the projects outward from the bone surface. It is capped by cartilage, and arises from a bone that develops from cartilage.

terms.name: Cryoglobulinemia
terms.definition: Increased level of cryoglobulins in the blood. Cryoglobulins are abnormal immunoglobulins, especially IGG or IGM, that precipitate spontaneously when serum is cooled below 37 degrees Celsius.

terms.name: Urogenital sinus anomaly
terms.definition: A rare birth defect in women where the urethra and vagina both open into a common channel.

terms.name: Conjunctival hamartoma
terms.definition: A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) of the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Abnormal sacroiliac joint morphology
terms.definition: An anomaly of the sacroiliac joint, which connects the base of the spine (sacrum) to the ilium (a hip bone).

terms.name: Breast aplasia
terms.definition: Failure to develop and congenital absence of the breast.

terms.name: Insomnia
terms.definition: Persistent difficulty in starting or maintaining sleep, or waking up earlier than desired, despite having adequate opportunities and conditions for sleep.

terms.name: Fused lips
synonyms: Adhesion of upper and lower lips
Fusion of upper and lower lips
terms.definition: Lack of separation of the upper and lower lips.

terms.name: Torus palatinus
terms.definition: A bony protrusion present on the midline of the hard palate.

terms.name: Acantholysis
terms.definition: The loss of intercellular connections, such as desmosomes, resulting in loss of cohesion between keratinocytes.

terms.name: Abnormally straight spine
terms.definition: The absence of the normal curvature of the vertebral column.

terms.name: Orchitis
terms.definition: Testicular inflammation.

terms.name: Toenail dysplasia
terms.definition: An abnormality of the development of the toenails.

terms.name: Fingernail dysplasia
terms.definition: An abnormality of the development of the fingernails.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the middle ear
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the middle ear.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the pancreas
terms.name_zh: 胰腺发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: A congenital underdevelopment (aplasia or hypoplasia) of the pancreas.

terms.name: Pancreatic aplasia
terms.definition: Aplasia of the pancreas.

terms.name: Malposition of the stomach
terms.definition: Abnormal anatomical location of the stomach. This feature may be due to intestinal malrotation.

terms.name: Abnormal periungual morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the region around the nails of the fingers or toes.

terms.name: Ungual fibroma
terms.definition: Flesh-colored papule in or around the nail bed. Ungual fibromas may be periungual (arising under the proximal nail fold) or subungual (originating under the nail plate).

terms.name: Sepsis
terms.definition: Sepsis is defined as life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection.

terms.name: Long fingers
terms.definition: The middle finger is more than 2 SD above the mean for newborns 27 to 41 weeks EGA or above the 97th centile for children from birth to 16 years of age AND the five digits retain their normal length proportions relative to each other (i.e., it is not the case that the middle finger is the only lengthened digit), or, Fingers that appear disproportionately long compared to the palm of the hand.

terms.name: Gastric diverticulum
terms.definition: An outpouching of the gastric wall.

terms.name: Scalp tenderness
terms.definition: Pain or discomfort of the scalp elicited by palpation.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the colon
terms.definition: Congenital absence or underdevelopment of the colon.

terms.name: Halitosis
terms.definition: Noticeably unpleasant odors exhaled in breathing.

terms.name: Testicular torsion
terms.definition: Testicular torsion is when the spermatic cord to a testicle twists, cutting off the blood supply. The most common symptom is acute testicular pain.

terms.name: Blue nevus
terms.definition: A solitary, bluish, smooth surfaced macule, papule or plaque that is generally round or oval in shape. The histopathology of blue nevi varies by subtype, but general characteristics include a vertical wedge or bulbous shaped proliferation of spindle cells, dendritic melanocytes, and melanophages into a sclerotic dermis or subcutis.

terms.name: Lip hyperpigmentation
synonyms: Darkening of skin of the lips

terms.name: Renovascular hypertension
synonyms: Hypertension due to renal artery hyperplasia
terms.definition: The presence of hypertension related to stenosis of the renal artery.

terms.name: Long thorax
terms.definition: Increased inferior to superior extent of the thorax.

terms.name: Intestinal fistula
terms.definition: An abnormal connection between the gut and another hollow organ, such as the bladder, urethra, vagina, or other regions of the gastrointestinal tract.

terms.name: Glomerulopathy
terms.definition: Inflammatory or noninflammatory diseases affecting the glomeruli of the nephron.

terms.name: Urethrocele
terms.definition: The prolapse of the female urethra into the vagina.

terms.name: Rectocele
terms.definition: A Rectocele results from a tear in the rectovaginal septum (which is normally a tough, fibrous, sheet-like divider between the rectum and vagina). Rectal tissue bulges through this tear and into the vagina as a hernia. There are two main causes of this tear: childbirth, and hysterectomy.

terms.name: Cheilitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the lip.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the nail
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the nail.

terms.name: Increased total lymphocyte count
terms.definition: Increase in the number or proportion of lymphocytes in the blood.

terms.name: Increased total T cell count
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in the absolute number of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, per microliter of blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

terms.name: Galactorrhea
terms.definition: Spontaneous flow of milk from the breast, unassociated with childbirth or nursing.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin K concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin K in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Vitreous floaters
terms.definition: Deposits of various size, shape, consistency, refractive index, and motility within the eye's vitreous humor, which is normally transparent.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the small intestine
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the small intestine.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the large intestine
terms.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the large intestine.

terms.name: Benign neoplasm of the central nervous system
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统良性肿瘤

terms.name: Malignant neoplasm of the central nervous system
terms.name_zh: 中枢神经系统恶性肿瘤
terms.definition: A tumor that originates in the pineal gland, has moderate cellularity and tends to form rosette patterns.

terms.name: Atrophodermia vermiculata
terms.definition: Symmetrical vermiform facial atrophy that affects mainly the forehead, the chin, the ear lobes and helices. Atrophodermia vermiculata is characterized by erythema and follicular plugs on the cheeks, developing into painless reticular impressions.

terms.name: Recurrent cutaneous abscess formation
terms.definition: An increased susceptibility to cutaneous abscess formation, as manifested by a medical history of recurrent cutaneous abscesses.

terms.name: Hepatic agenesis
terms.definition: Absence of the liver owing to a failure of the liver to develop.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the eyebrow
terms.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the eyebrow.

terms.name: Microgastria
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly with a small tubular or saccular midline stomach.

terms.name: Septo-optic dysplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the optic nerve and absence of the septum pellucidum.

terms.name: Anaphylactic shock
terms.definition: An acute hypersensitivity reaction due to exposure to a previously encountered antigen.

terms.name: Palmoplantar pustulosis
terms.definition: A chronic, relapsing, pustular eruption that is localized to the palms and soles.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the male external genitalia
synonyms: Neoplasia of the male external genitalia
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the male external genitalia.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the scrotum
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the scrotum.

terms.name: Neoplasm of the penis
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the penis.

terms.name: Abnormal emotional state
terms.definition: A disturbance in the experience or expression of emotion, characterized by alterations in valence, intensity, frequency, or duration. It may also involve emotional responses that are mismatched, exaggerated, or incongruent relative to internal expectations or external contextual stimuli, such as experiencing negative affect in response to neutral or positive events.

terms.name: Abnormal fear-induced behavior
terms.definition: An abnormal fear-induced behavior includes observable actions. This behavior is characterized by abnormal responses to fear or abnormal fear levels. Examples of such behavior include avoiding fear-inducing situations.

terms.name: Hypoplastic areola
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the areola, the circular area of pigmented skin surrounding the nipple.

terms.name: Aplasia of the musculature
terms.definition: Absence of the musculature.

terms.name: Triceps hypoplasia
terms.definition: Hypoplasia of the triceps muscle.

terms.name: Poorly ossified vertebrae
terms.definition: Decreased ossification of the vertebral bodies.

terms.name: Flat sella turcica
terms.definition: An abnormally flat sella turcica.

terms.name: Dilatation of celiac artery
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the celiac artery.

terms.name: Dilatation of superior mesenteric artery
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the superior mesenteric artery .

terms.name: Dilatation of Inferior mesenteric artery
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the inferior mesenteric artery .

terms.name: Sclerotic vertebral body
terms.definition: Increase in bone density of the vertebral body.

terms.name: Short femoral neck
terms.definition: An abnormally short femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).

terms.name: Broad ischia
terms.definition: Increased width of the ischium, which forms the lower and back part of the hip bone.

terms.name: Short iliac bones
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the iliac bones.

terms.name: Duodenal stenosis
terms.definition: The narrowing or partial blockage of a portion of the duodenum.

terms.name: Palmar telangiectasia
terms.definition: The presence of telangiectases on the skin of palm of hand.

terms.name: Plantar telangiectasia
terms.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located on the skin of sole of foot.

terms.name: Abnormal palm morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the palm, that is, of the front of the hand.

terms.name: Abnormality of the plantar skin of foot
terms.definition: An abnormality of the plantar part of foot, that is of the soles of the feet.

terms.name: Thick hair
terms.definition: Increased density of hairs, i.e., and elevated number of hairs per unit area.

terms.name: Hemimacroglossia
synonyms: Hypertrophy of half of the tongue
Increased size of half of the tongue
terms.definition: Increased length and width of one half of the tongue.

terms.name: Infra-orbital crease
synonyms: Crease in skin under the eye
Groove in skin under the eye
terms.definition: Skin crease extending from below the inner canthus laterally along the malar process of the maxilla and zygoma.

terms.name: Renal diverticulum
terms.definition: Cystic, urine-containing intrarenal cavities lined with transitional cell epithelium that communicate through a narrow channel with the collecting system.

terms.name: Nephrogenic rest
terms.definition: Abnormally persistent clusters of embryonal cells, representing microscopic malformations (dysplasias) of the developing kidney.

terms.name: Congenital mesoblastic nephroma
terms.definition: Congenital mesoblastic nephroma is a type of kidney tumor that is usually found before birth by ultrasound or within the first 3 months of life. It contains fibroblastic cells (connective tissue cells), and may spread to the other kidney or to nearby tissue.

terms.name: Fibrous hamartoma
terms.definition: A rare, benign soft tissue tumor that typically occurs within the first two years of life.

terms.name: Chorangioma
terms.definition: Hamartoma-like growth in the placenta consisting of blood vessels.

terms.name: Compensatory scoliosis
terms.definition: A scoliosis which is the results of a difference in leg length (which might be due to hemihypertrophy or hemihypotrophy of a leg) and the resulting tilting of the pelvis. If untreated this will lead to the development of scoliosis over time.

terms.name: Lateral venous anomaly
terms.definition: Persistence of the embryonic dorsal or sciatic vein system that normally should have involuted around the tenth to twelfth week of intrauterine life.

terms.name: Abnormality of globe location
terms.definition: An abnormality in the placement of the ocular globe (eyeball).

terms.name: Abnormality of globe size
terms.definition: An abnormality in the size of the ocular globe (eyeball).

terms.name: Abnormal ductus choledochus morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the common bile duct
terms.definition: An abnormality of the Common bile duct, a tube-like anatomic structure in the human gastrointestinal tract, formed by the union of the Common hepatic duct and the Cystic duct from the gall bladder.

terms.name: Bifid xiphoid process
terms.definition: A cleft of the xiphoid process of the sternum.

terms.name: Abnormality of the xiphoid process
terms.definition: An abnormality of the xiphoid process of the sternum.

terms.name: Prominent xiphoid process
terms.definition: Increased prominence of the xiphoid process of the sternum.

terms.name: Broad xiphoid process
terms.definition: Increased side-to-side width of the xiphoid process of the sternum.

terms.name: Rectal polyposis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple rectal hyperplastic/adenomatous polyps.

terms.name: Connective tissue nevi
terms.definition: Connective tissue nevi are hamartomas in which one or several components of the dermis is altered.

terms.name: Enlarged sylvian cistern
terms.definition: An increase in size of the subarachnoid space associated with the lateral cerebral sulcus (Sylvian fissure).

terms.name: Open operculum
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the operculum.

terms.name: Abnormal renal medulla morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the medulla of the kidney.

terms.name: Narrow foramen obturatorium
terms.definition: Decreased width of the foramen obturatorium. The foramen obturatorium (also known as the obturator foramen) is a hole located between the ischium and pubis bones of the pelvis.

terms.name: Dense metaphyseal bands
synonyms: Lead lines in metaphyses of bones
terms.definition: Dense radiopaque bands of bone which are thicker than the adjacent diaphyseal cortex and may form at the metaphysis of growing bones. They appear on radiographs as bone that is more radiopaque that the adjacent diaphyseal cortex.

terms.name: Lateral ventricular asymmetry
terms.definition: Abnormal difference in size between the left and right lateral cerebral ventricles.

terms.name: Enlarged hippocampus
terms.definition: Increase in size of the hippocampus.

terms.name: Excessive shyness
terms.definition: Atypically high degree of awkwardness or apprehension experienced when approaching or being approached by others.

terms.name: Hyperesthesia
terms.definition: Increased sensitivity to stimulation, excluding the special senses, which may refer to various modes of cutaneous sensibility including touch and thermal sensation without pain, as well as to pain.

terms.name: Dysharmonic skeletal maturation
terms.definition: Different levels of maturation of different bones.

terms.name: Dysharmonic accelerated bone age
terms.definition: A type of dysharmonic skeletal maturation in which there is an acceleration in skeletal maturation whose degree differs markedly in different bones.

terms.name: Splayed epiphyses
terms.definition: Flaring (widening) of the epiphysis.

synonyms: Abnormal morphology of the palpebral fissure
Abnormal shape of the opening between the eyelids
