terms.name: Abnormal size of the palpebral fissures
synonyms: Abnormal size of the opening between the eyelids
terms.definition: An abnormal size of the palpebral fissures for example unusually long or short palpebral fissures.

terms.name: Intestinal polyposis
terms.definition: The presence of multiple polyps in the intestine.

terms.name: Neoplasm of fatty tissue
terms.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of adipose tissue.

terms.name: Acrokeratosis
terms.definition: Overgrowth of the stratum corneum characterized by flesh-coloured or slightly pigmented smooth or warty papules on the upper surface of hands and feet.

terms.name: Cerebral white matter agenesis
synonyms: Agenesis of the cerebral white matter
terms.definition: Congenital defect with failure of the development of the cerebral white matter.

terms.name: Protanomaly
terms.definition: A type of anomalous trichromacy associated with defective long-wavelength-sensitive (L) cones, causing the sensitivity spectrum to be shifted toward medium wavelengths. This leads to difficulties especially in distinguishing red and green.

terms.name: Corneal erosion
synonyms: Damage to outer layer of the cornea of the eye
terms.definition: An erosion or abrasion of the cornea's outermost layer of epithelial cells.

terms.name: Down-sloping shoulders
terms.definition: Low set, steeply sloping shoulders.

terms.name: Choroid plexus papilloma
terms.definition: Choroid plexus papilloma is a histologically benign neoplasm located in the ventricular system of the choroid plexus.

terms.name: Priapism
terms.definition: A painful and harmful medical condition in which the erect penis doesn't return to its flaccid state, despite the absence of both physical and psychological stimulation, within four hours.

terms.name: Premature chromatid separation
terms.definition: The presence of premature sister chromatid segregation.

terms.name: Mandibular pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the mandible.

terms.name: Ocular pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eye.

terms.name: Pretibial myxedema
terms.definition: A diffuse, non-pitting edema and thickening of the skin usually on the anterior aspect of the lower legs spreading to the dorsum of the feet.

terms.name: Vasculitis in the skin
terms.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects skeletal muscle tissue.

terms.name: Kayser-Fleischer ring
terms.definition: Grey-green or brownish-pigmented ring in the deep epithelial layers at the outer border of the cornea.

terms.name: Papule
terms.definition: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point.

terms.name: Skin plaque
terms.definition: A plaque is a solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter.

terms.name: Skin nodule
synonyms: Growth of abnormal tissue on or under the skin
terms.definition: Morphologically similar to a papule, but greater than either 10mm in both width and depth, and most frequently centered in the dermis or subcutaneous fat.

terms.name: Skin vesicle
terms.definition: A circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevation less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point that (i) Contain serous exudates or serum mixed with blood or pus; (ii) Are discrete, grouped, irregularly distributed, or linear as in Rhus dermatitis; (iii) Are short-lived. Vesicles may break spontaneously or evolve into bullae by enlarging or coalescing with other vesicles.

terms.name: Pustule
terms.definition: A small elevation of the skin containing cloudy or purulent material usually consisting of necrotic inflammatory cells.

terms.name: Epidermoid cyst
terms.definition: Nontender, round and firm, but slightly compressible, intradermal or subcutaneous cyst measuring 0.5-5 cm in diameter. Epidermal cysts are intradermal or subcutaneous tumors, grow slowly and occur on the face, neck, back and scrotum. They usually appear at or around puberty, and as a rule an affected individual has one solitary or a few cysts. A central, dark comedone opening (punctum) may be present.

terms.name: Skin erosion
terms.definition: A discontinuity of the skin exhibiting incomplete loss of the epidermis, a lesion that is moist, circumscribed, and usually depressed.

terms.name: Skin ulcer
terms.definition: A discontinuity of the skin exhibiting complete loss of the epidermis and often portions of the dermis and even subcutaneous fat.

terms.name: Verrucae
terms.definition: Warts, benign growths on the skin or mucous membranes that cause cosmetic problems as well as pain and discomfort. Warts most often occur on the hands, feet, and genital areas.

terms.name: Porokeratosis
terms.definition: A clonal disorder of keratinization with one or multiple atrophic patches surrounded by a clinically and histologically distinctive hyperkeratotic ridgelike border called the cornoid lamella.

terms.name: Cat cry
terms.definition: The presence of a characteristic high-pitched cry that sounds similar to the meowing of a kitten.

terms.name: Chondritis of pinna
terms.definition: Inflammation of the cartilage of the external ear.

terms.name: Upper limb hypertonia
terms.definition: Increased muscle tone observed in the arms of the affected person.

terms.name: Bracket metacarpal epiphyses
synonyms: Bracket shaped end part of long bone of hand

terms.name: Hemihypotrophy of lower limb
terms.definition: Shortening of a leg affecting only one side.

terms.name: Small hand
terms.definition: Disproportionately small hand.

terms.name: Macular scar
terms.definition: Fibrous connective tissue consequent upon healing of a wound (i.e., a scar) located in the macula.

terms.name: Marcus Gunn pupil
terms.definition: An aberrant pupillary response characterized by (i) Constriction of pupils of both eyes when the light stimulus is applied to the normal eye, and (ii) Dilatation of pupils of both eyes when the light stimulus is rapidly transferred from the normal eye (after brief light exposure to the normal eye) to the affected eye.

terms.name: Colorectal polyposis
terms.definition: Multiple abnormal growths that arise from the lining of the large intestine (colon or rectum) and protrude into the intestinal lumen.

terms.name: Asymmetry of iris pigmentation
terms.definition: Asymmetry between the two irides or asymmetry between different parts of one iris.

terms.name: Recurrent spontaneous abortion
terms.definition: Repeated episodes of abortion (Expulsion of the product of fertilization before completing the term of gestation) without deliberate interference.

terms.name: Peripheral retinal atrophy
terms.definition: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the peripheral retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells.

terms.name: Peripheral vitreoretinal degeneration
terms.definition: A type of vitreoretinal degeneration with manifestations that are concentrated at the periphery of the retina.

terms.name: Episodic quadriplegia
terms.definition: Intermittent episodes of paralysis of all four limbs.

terms.name: Respiratory insufficiency due to defective ciliary clearance
Giant cell hepatitis
synonyms: Giant cell hepatitis on liver biopsy
Giant cell hepatitis shown on biopsy
terms.definition: Chronic hepatitis characterized by parenchymal inflammation with formation of large multinucleated hepatocytes in response to a variety of insults to the liver.

terms.name: Triangular-shaped open mouth
terms.definition: A facial appearance characterized by a permanently or nearly permanently opened mouth, in which the upper lip is tented in a way that the opened mouth has the appearance of a triangle.

terms.name: Oral mucosal blisters
terms.definition: Blisters arising in the mouth.

terms.name: Absent skin pigmentation
terms.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring).

terms.name: Sparse or absent eyelashes
synonyms: Partial to total absence of eyelashes

terms.name: Absent fifth fingernail
terms.definition: Absence of nail of little finger.

terms.name: Absent/shortened outer dynein arms
terms.name_zh: 外侧动力蛋白臂缺如/缩短
synonyms: Respiratory cilia have shortened or absent outer dynein arms

terms.name: Metabolic alkalosis
terms.definition: Metabolic alkalosis is defined as a disease state where the pH is elevated to greater than 7.45 secondary to some metabolic process.

terms.name: Recurrent upper and lower respiratory tract infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to upper and lower respiratory tract infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of upper and lower respiratory tract infections.

terms.name: Malabsorption of Vitamin B12
synonyms: Vitamin B12 deficiency caused by intestinal malabsorption

terms.name: Acute hepatitis
terms.definition: Acute hepatic injury resulting from inflammation typically accompanied by increased serum alanine transaminase activity. Etiologies include viral hepatitis, drugs, toxins, and autoimmune disorders.

terms.name: Chronic active hepatitis
terms.definition: Chronic hepatitis associated with recurrent clinical exacerbations, extrahepatic manifestations, and progression to cirrhosis.

terms.name: Chronic hepatitis
terms.definition: Hepatitis that lasts for more than six months.

terms.name: Chronic hepatitis due to cryptosporidium infection
terms.name_zh: 隐孢子虫感染性慢性肝炎
synonyms: Hepatitis, chronic, due to cryptosporidium infection
terms.definition: Chronic hepatitis caused by Cryptosporidium infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.

terms.name: Atrial cardiomyopathy
terms.definition: Any complex of structural, architectural, contractile or electrophysiological changes affecting the atria with the potential to produce clinically relevant manifestations.

terms.name: Biventricular hypertrophy
terms.definition: Thickening of the heart walls in both ventricles.

terms.name: Epileptic encephalopathy
terms.definition: A condition in which epileptiform abnormalities are believed to contribute to the progressive disturbance in cerebral function. Epileptic encephalaopathy is characterized by (1) electrographic EEG paroxysmal activity that is often aggressive, (2) seizures that are usually multiform and intractable, (3) cognitive, behavioral and neurological deficits that may be relentless, and (4) sometimes early death.

terms.name: Megaloblastic erythroid hyperplasia
synonyms: Bone marrow biopsy shows megaloblastic erythroid hyperplasia

terms.name: Mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation
terms.name_zh: 黏液样细胞外基质积聚
synonyms: Cystic medial necrosis of the aorta
terms.definition: An increase of medial mucoid extracellular matrix creating translamellar and/or intralamellar expansions including extracellular pools as noted on an H&E stain and/or a stain to highlight extracellular matrix material (Movat's pentachrome, Alcian blue, etc.).

terms.name: Neuronal loss in basal ganglia
terms.definition: A reduction in the number of nerve cells in the basal ganglia.

terms.name: Abnormal liver function tests during pregnancy
terms.name_zh: 妊娠期肝功能检查异常
synonyms: Abnormal liver function tests during pregnancy
Abnormal liver function tests during pregnancy, resolves postpartum

terms.name: CSF lymphocytic pleiocytosis
terms.definition: An increased lymphocyte count in the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Increased serum bile acid concentration during pregnancy
terms.name_zh: 妊娠期血清胆汁酸浓度升高
synonyms: Increased serum bile acid concentration during pregnancy, resolves

terms.name: Cutaneous mastocytosis
terms.definition: Multifocal dense infiltrates of mast cells in cutaneous tissue.

terms.name: Agenesis of lateral incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of lateral incisor

terms.name: Agenesis of mandibular lateral incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of mandibular lateral incisor

terms.name: Agenesis of permanent mandibular lateral incisor
synonyms: Absence of adult mandibular lateral incisor
Absence of permanent mandibular lateral incisor
Failure of development of permanent mandibular lateral incisor

terms.name: Agenesis of primary mandibular lateral incisor
synonyms: Absence of deciduous mandibular lateral incisor
Absence of lower front baby tooth
Absence of primary mandibular lateral incisor
Agenesis of deciduous mandibular lateral incisor
Failure of development of deciduous mandibular lateral incisor
Failure of development of primary mandibular lateral incisor

terms.name: Agenesis of maxillary incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of maxillary incisor
Failure of development of upper incisor

terms.name: Agenesis of mandibular incisor
synonyms: Failure of development of mandibular incisor

terms.name: Tall chin
terms.definition: Increased vertical distance from the vermillion border of the lower lip to the inferior-most point of the chin.

terms.name: Chin with vertical crease
terms.definition: Vertical crease fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin with the face at rest.

terms.name: Extra concha fold
terms.definition: Folds or ridges within the concha that are distinct from the crus helix.

terms.name: Focal absence of the external ear
terms.definition: Absence of a localized portion of the ear that cannot be described by a more precise term (e.g., absent ear lobe).

terms.name: Long ear
terms.definition: Median longitudinal ear length greater than two SD above the mean determined by the maximal distance from the superior aspect to the inferior aspect of the external ear.

terms.name: Short ear
terms.definition: Median longitudinal ear length less than two SD above the mean determined by the maximal distance from the superior aspect to the inferior aspect of the external ear.

terms.name: Polymenorrhea
terms.definition: Frequent menses; menstrual cycles lasting less than 21 days.

terms.name: Menometrorrhagia
terms.definition: Prolonged/excessive menses and bleeding at irregular intervals.

terms.name: Abnormal vomer morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of the vomer.

terms.name: Abnormality of ophthalmic artery
terms.definition: Abnormality of the first branch of the internal carotid artery.

terms.name: Abnormality of the peripheral nervous system
synonyms: Abnormality of the peripheral nervous system
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the part of the nervous system that consists of the nerves and ganglia outside of the brain and spinal cord.

terms.name: Abnormality of the somatic nervous system
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the part of the peripheral nervous system associated with sensation and skeletal muscle voluntary control of body movements.

terms.name: Abnormality of somatic nerve plexus
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the somatic nerve plexus.

terms.name: Abnormality of masticatory muscle
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the masticatory muscle.

terms.name: Abnormal mouth floor morphology
synonyms: Abnormality of the floor of mouth
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the mouth floor.

terms.name: Abnormality of the submandibular region
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the submandibular region, the region between the mandible and the hyoid bone contains the submandibular and sublingual glands, suprahyoid muscles, submandibular ganglion, and lingual artery.

terms.name: Abnormal ganglion morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of nerve cell cluster or a group of nerve cell bodies located in the autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system ganglion morphology
terms.name_zh: 周围神经系统神经节形态异常
synonyms: Abnormality of ganglion of peripheral nervous system
terms.definition: An abnormality of nerve cell cluster or a group of nerve cell bodies located in the peripheral autonomic nervous system.

terms.name: Abnormal cranial ganglion morphology
terms.definition: An abnormality of nerve cell cluster or a group of nerve cell bodies located in the autonomic nervous system of the cranium.

terms.name: Otitis externa
terms.definition: Inflammation or infection of the external auditory canal (EAC), the auricle, or both.

terms.name: Recurrent ear infections
terms.definition: Increased susceptibility to ear infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of ear infections.

terms.name: Epigastric pain
terms.definition: Pain that is localized to the region of the upper abdomen immediately below the ribs.

terms.name: Fish odor
terms.definition: Body odor characterized by an offensive body odor and the smell of rotting fish due to the excessive excretion of trimethylamine (TMA) in the urine, sweat, and breath of affected individuals.

terms.name: Musty odor
terms.definition: Pungent body odor.

terms.name: Vaginal fish odor
terms.definition: A fish odor in the vaginal area, that is characteristic of bacterial vaginosis (BV), and is due to trimethylamine (TMA).

terms.name: Abnormal distribution of cell junction proteins in buccal mucosal cells
terms.name_zh: 颊黏膜细胞连接蛋白分布异常
terms.definition: An anomalous amount or location of cell junction proteins such as plakoglobin or Cx43.

terms.name: Abnormal periodontium morphology
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the periodontium.

terms.name: Alveolar bone loss around teeth
terms.definition: A decrease in the amount of alveolar bone around the root of a tooth.

terms.name: Recurrent oral herpes
terms.definition: Recurrent episodes of oral herpes, typically characterized by blisters or ulcers on the gums, lips and/or tongue caused by herpes virus.

terms.name: Cleft lip
terms.definition: A gap in the lip or lips.

terms.name: Submucous cleft of soft and hard palate
terms.definition: Soft and hard-palate submucous clefts are characterized by bony defects in the midline of the soft and hard palate that are covered by the lining (ie mucous membrane) of the roof of the mouth.

terms.name: Unilateral alveolar cleft of maxilla
terms.definition: One sided alveolar cleft of the maxilla.

terms.name: Bilateral alveolar cleft of maxilla
terms.definition: Nonmidline alveolar cleft of the maxilla.

terms.name: Abnormal T cell activation
terms.definition: Any abnormality in the activation of T cells, i.e. the change in morphology and behavior of a mature or immature T cell resulting from exposure to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific.

terms.name: Abnormal liver morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the bile-secreting organ that is important for detoxification, for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism, and for glycogen storage.

terms.name: Abnormal neural tube morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hollow epithelial tube found on the dorsal side of the vertebrate embryo that develops into the central nervous system (i.e. brain and spinal cord).

terms.name: Decreased circulating 1,5 anhydroglucitol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环1,5-脱水葡萄糖醇浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased level of 1,5 anhydroglucitol in serum
terms.definition: Concetration of 1,5 anhydroglucitol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酸水平升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of allantoin in serum
terms.definition: An increase in the level of allantoin in the serum.

terms.name: Elevated circulating gamma-aminobutyric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环γ-氨基丁酸浓度升高
synonyms: Increased level of GABA in serum
Increased level of gamma-aminobutyric acid in serum
terms.definition: An increase in the level of Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating GABA concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环γ-氨基丁酸浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased level of gamma-aminobutyric acid in serum
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of GABA in the serum.

terms.name: Decreased level of erythritol in urine
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of erythritol in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased CSF erythritol concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液赤藓糖醇浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased level of erythritol in cerebrospinal fluid
terms.definition: Concentration of erythritol in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating D-threitol concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of D-threitol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased CSF D-threitol concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液D-苏糖醇浓度升高
synonyms: Increased level of D-threitol in CSF
Increased level of D-threitol in cerebrospinal fluid
terms.definition: The concentration of D-threitol in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of D-threitol in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of D-threitol in the urine.

terms.name: Decreased level of D-mannose in urine
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of D-mannose in the urine.

terms.name: Increased circulating galactitol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环半乳糖醇浓度升高
synonyms: Increased level of galactitol in plasma
terms.definition: The concentration of galactitol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of galactitol in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of galactitol in the urine.

terms.name: Increased level of galactonate in red blood cells
terms.name_zh: 红细胞半乳糖酸水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of galactonate in RBCs
Increased level of galactonate in erythrocytes
terms.definition: An increase in the level of galactonate in the red blood cells.

terms.name: Increased level of galactitol in red blood cells
terms.name_zh: 红细胞半乳糖醇水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of galactitol in erythrocytes
terms.definition: An increase in the level of galactitol in the red blood cells.

terms.name: Increased level of hippuric acid in blood
synonyms: Increased level of N-benzoylglycine in blood
terms.definition: An increase in the level of hippuric acid in the blood.

terms.name: Increased level of hippuric acid in urine
synonyms: Increased level of N-benzoylglycine in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of hippuric acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased level of L-fucose in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of L-fucose in the urine.

terms.name: Increased level of propylene glycol in blood
synonyms: Increased level of propane-1,2-diol in blood
terms.definition: An increase in the level of propylene glycol in the blood.

terms.name: Increased level of ribitol in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of ribitol in the urine. Ribotol is a crystalline pentose alcohol (C5H12O5) and is a metabolic end product formed by the reduction of ribose.

terms.name: Increased CSF ribitol concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液核糖醇浓度升高
synonyms: Increased level of ribitol in cerebrospinal fluid
terms.definition: The concentration of ribitol in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of ribose in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of ribose in the urine.

terms.name: Increased CSF ribose concentration
synonyms: Increased level of ribose in CSF
Increased level of ribose in cerebrospinal fluid
terms.definition: The concentration of ribose in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of xylitol in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of xylitol in the urine.

terms.name: Increased CSF xylitol concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液木糖醇浓度升高
synonyms: Increased level of xylitol in CSF
Increased level of xylitol in cerebrospinal fluid
terms.definition: The concentration of xylitol in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of L-pyroglutamic acid in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of L-pyroglutamic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Chronic urticaria
terms.definition: Urticaria characterized by spontaneously recurring hives for 6 weeks or longer.

terms.name: Physical urticaria
terms.definition: Urticaria caused by physical agents, such as heat, cold, light, friction.

terms.name: Cold urticaria
terms.definition: Urticaria may be caused by cold temperatures.

terms.name: Aquagenic urticaria
terms.definition: A form of physical urticaria, in which contact with water, regardless of its temperature and source, evokes pruritic follicular wheals on the skin.

terms.name: Solar urticaria
terms.definition: Urticaria in response to exposure to ultraviolet-A (UVA), ultraviolet-B (UVB), visible and rarely infrared light.

terms.name: Vibratory urticaria
terms.definition: Urticaria in response to dermal vibration, with coincident degranulation of mast cells and increased histamine levels in serum.

terms.name: Exercise induced anaphylaxis
terms.definition: Anaphylaxis after physical activity.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating biotinidase concentration
terms.definition: An abnormality in the biotinidase level, an enzyme that releases biotin from biocytin, the product of biotin-dependent carboxylases degradation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating biotinidase concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环生物素酶浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of biotinidase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Biotidinase is an enzyme that releases biotin from biocytin, the product of biotin-dependent carboxylases degradation.

terms.name: Elevated circulating biotinidase concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环生物素酶浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of biotinidase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Biotidinase is an enzyme that releases biotin from biocytin, the product of biotin-dependent carboxylases degradation.

terms.name: Eosinophilic infiltration in the stomach mucosa
terms.name_zh: 胃黏膜嗜酸性粒细胞浸润
terms.definition: Infiltration of eosinophils in the stomach mucosa, that is diagnosed by an upper endoscopy and microscopy that shows more than 20 eosinophils per high-power field in association with peripheral eosinophilia and the absence of secondary cause of eosinophilia.

terms.name: Idiopathic anaphylaxis
terms.definition: A rare form of anaphylaxis for which triggers cannot be identified despite a detailed history and careful diagnostic assessment.

terms.name: Drug-induced anaphylaxis
terms.definition: A form of anaphylaxis that is triggered by intake of drugs or medications.

terms.name: Eosinophilic infiltration of the esophagus
terms.name_zh: 食管嗜酸性粒细胞浸润
terms.definition: Infiltration of numerous eosinophils (usually greater than 15 per high power field) into the squamous epithelium of the esophagus, and layering of eosinophils on the surface layer of the esophagus.

terms.name: Eosinophilic microabscess formation in the esophagus
terms.name_zh: 食管嗜酸性微脓肿形成
synonyms: Eosinophilic micro-abscess formation in the esophagus
Eosinophilic micro-abscess formation in the oesophagus
Eosinophilic microabscess formation in the esophagus
terms.definition: The formation of small localized collection of eosinophiles (an eosinophilic microabscess) in the esophagus. Usually clusters of greater than or equal to 4 eosinophils are seen, that appear as exudates or white spots or white plaques.

terms.name: Increased level of methylsuccinic acid in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿甲基琥珀酸水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of pyrotartaric acid in urine
terms.definition: The concentration of methylsuccinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating myristic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环肉豆蔻酸浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated myristic acid level in blood
Increased level of tetradecanoic acid in serum
Increased myristic acid level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of myristic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased level of N-acetylneuraminic acid in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿N-乙酰神经氨酸水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of NANA in urine
Increased level of Neu5Ac in urine
terms.definition: An increase in the level of N-acetylneuraminic acid in the urine.

terms.name: Increased level of N-acetylneuraminic acid in fibroblasts
terms.name_zh: 成纤维细胞N-乙酰神经氨酸水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of NANA in fibroblasts
Increased level of Neu5Ac in fibroblasts
Increased level of sialic acid in fibroblasts
terms.definition: An increase in the level of N-acetylneuraminic acid in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Defective interstrand cross-link repair
terms.definition: A defect in the of the process of interstrand cross-link repair: removal of a DNA interstrand crosslink (a covalent attachment of DNA bases on opposite strands of the DNA) and restoration of the DNA. DNA interstrand crosslinks occur when both strands of duplex DNA are covalently tethered together (e.g. by an exogenous or endogenous agent), thus preventing the strand unwinding necessary for essential DNA functions such as transcription and replication.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the chest musculature
terms.name_zh: 胸部肌肉组织形态异常
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the chest muscles.

terms.name: Abnormality of the back musculature
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the back muscles.

terms.name: Abnormal morphology of the shoulder musculature
terms.name_zh: 肩部肌肉组织形态异常
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the shoulder (glenohumeral) muscles, which comprise the rotator cuff (supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor, subscapularis), the deltoid, the latissimus dorsi, and the pectoralis major.

terms.name: Hippocampal atrophy
terms.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of hippocampus tissue that was once present.

terms.name: Increased cotinine level
terms.definition: Increased concentration of cotinine in urine.

terms.name: Blood xenobiotic
terms.definition: The presence of a xenobiotic in blood.

terms.name: Increased circulating troponin I concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环肌钙蛋白I浓度升高
synonyms: Increased troponin I level in blood
terms.definition: An increased concentration of tropnin I in the blood, which is a cardiac regulatory protein that controls the calcium mediated interaction between actin and myosin. Raised cardiac troponin concentrations are now accepted as the standard biochemical marker for the diagnosis of myocardial infarction.

terms.name: Increased circulating troponin T concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环肌钙蛋白T浓度升高
synonyms: Increased troponin T level in blood
terms.definition: An increased concentration of tropnin T in the blood, which is a cardiac regulatory protein that controls the calcium mediated interaction between actin and myosin. Raised cardiac troponin concentrations are now accepted as the standard biochemical marker for the diagnosis of myocardial infarction.

terms.name: Hyperketonemia
synonyms: Increased level of ketone bodies in blood
terms.definition: An increase in the level of ketone bodies (acetoacetic acid, beta-hydroxybutyric acid, and acetone) in the blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in blood
terms.definition: An anomaly in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase.

terms.name: Elevated circulating glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶活性升高
synonyms: Elevated glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in blood
Increased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in blood
terms.definition: The activity of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶活性降低
synonyms: Decreased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in blood
Reduced glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in blood
terms.definition: The activity of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in dried blood spot
terms.name_zh: 干血斑葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平异常
synonyms: Abnormal G6PD level in dried blood spot
Abnormal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in DBS
terms.definition: An anomaly in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in a dried blood spot.

terms.name: Increased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in dried blood spot
terms.name_zh: 干血斑葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平升高
synonyms: Increased G6PD level in dried blood spot
Increased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in DBS
terms.definition: An increase in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in a dried blood spot.

terms.name: Decreased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in dried blood spot
terms.name_zh: 干血斑葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平降低
synonyms: Decreased G6PD level in dried blood spot
Decreased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in DBS
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in a dried blood spot.

terms.name: Abnormal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in leukocytes
terms.name_zh: 白细胞葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平异常
terms.definition: An anomaly in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in leukocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal erythrocyte glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal G6PD level in red blood cells
Abnormal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in red blood cells
terms.definition: An anomaly in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in red blood cells.

terms.name: Abnormal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in tissue
terms.name_zh: 组织葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平异常
terms.definition: An anomaly in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in tissue.

terms.name: Increased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in tissue
terms.name_zh: 组织葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平升高
terms.definition: An increase in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in tissue.

terms.name: Decreased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in tissue
terms.name_zh: 组织葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平降低
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in tissue.

terms.name: Decreased erythrocyte glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased G6PD level in red blood cells
Decreased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in red blood cells
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in red blood cells.

terms.name: Increased erythrocyte glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶浓度升高
synonyms: Increased G6PD level in red blood cells
Increased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in red blood cells
terms.definition: An increase in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in red blood cells.

terms.name: Decreased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in leukocytes
terms.name_zh: 白细胞葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平降低
terms.definition: A decrease in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in leukocytes.

terms.name: Increased glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase level in leukocytes
terms.name_zh: 白细胞葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶水平升高
terms.definition: An increase in the level of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase in leukocytes.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
terms.name_zh: 血UDP葡萄糖-4-表异构酶浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal UDP-glucose 4-epimerase activity level in plasma
Abnormal circulating uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase concentration
Abnormal uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma
terms.definition: An abnormality in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

terms.name: Increased circulating UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环UDP葡萄糖-4-表异构酶浓度升高
synonyms: Increased circulating uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase concentration
Increased uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma
terms.definition: An increase in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

terms.name: Decreased circulating UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-表异构酶浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased UDP glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma
Decreased circulating uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase concentration
Decreased uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma
terms.definition: A decrease in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

terms.name: Abnormal erythrocyte UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞UDP葡萄糖-4-表异构酶浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal UDP-glucose 4-epimerase level in red blood cells
Abnormal erythrocyte uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase concentration
Abnormal uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells
terms.definition: An abnormality in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

terms.name: Increased erythrocyte UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞UDP葡萄糖-4-表异构酶浓度升高
synonyms: Increased UDP-glucose 4-epimerase level in red blood cells
Increased uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells
terms.definition: An increase in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

terms.name: Decreased erythrocyte UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞UDP葡萄糖-4-表异构酶浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased UDP-glucose 4-epimerase level in red blood cells
Decreased erythrocyte uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase concentration
Decreased uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells
terms.definition: A decrease in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

terms.name: Increased CSF urate concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液尿酸盐浓度升高
terms.definition: Increased concentration of urate in the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Positive meconium barbiturate test
terms.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in meconium.

terms.name: Positive hair barbiturate test
terms.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in the hair.

terms.name: Positive stool barbiturate test
terms.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in the stool.

terms.name: Positive gastric fluid barbiturate test
terms.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in the gastric fluid.

terms.name: Increased intestinal transit time
terms.definition: An increase in the length of time required for food to pass through the intestines.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating nicotinurate concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of nicotinurate in the blood.

terms.name: Increased circulating nicotinurate level
terms.name_zh: 血循环烟尿酸水平升高
terms.definition: An increased amount of nicotinurate in the blood.

terms.name: Positive methadone plasma/serum test
terms.definition: Detection of methadone or its metabolite 2-ethylidene-1,5-dimethyl-3,3- diphenylpyrrolidine (EDDP) in plasma or serum.

terms.name: Positive plasma/serum cotinine test
terms.definition: Detection of cotinine, an alkaloid found in tobacco and the predominant metabolite of nicotine, in plasma or serum.

terms.name: Folate deficiency in CSF
terms.definition: A reduced concentration of folic acid, which is also known as vitamin B9 in the cerebrospinal fluid.

terms.name: Abnormal cord blood measurement
terms.definition: An abnormality in any umbilical cord measurement performed after birth, such as the blood gas level.

terms.name: Abnormal blood gas level in cord blood
Hyperoxemia in cord blood
terms.definition: An abnormally high level of blood oxygen in the cord blood.

terms.name: Hypoxemia in cord blood
terms.definition: An abnormally low level of blood oxygen in the cord blood.

terms.name: Hypercapnia in cord blood
synonyms: High cord blood carbon dioxide level
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level in the cord blood.

terms.name: Hypocapnia in cord blood
synonyms: Low cord blood carbon dioxide level
terms.definition: Abnormally decreased blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level in the cord blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating 5-methyltetrahydrofolate concentration
terms.name_zh: 血5-甲基四氢叶酸浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal concentration of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (5-MTHF) in the blood.

terms.name: Reduced blood 5-methyltetrahydrofolate level
terms.definition: A decreased concentration of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate in the blood.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of maxilla relative to mandible
terms.name_zh: 上颌相对下颌发育不全
synonyms: Disorder of maxillary and mandibular dental arch relationship
terms.definition: Abnormally small dimension of the maxilla (upper jaw) relative to the mandible (lower jaw).

terms.name: Hypoplasia of mandible relative to maxilla
terms.name_zh: 下颌相对上颌发育不全
synonyms: Disorder of mandibular and maxillary dental arch relationship
terms.definition: Abnormally small dimension of the mandible (lower jaw) relative to the maxilla (upper jaw).

terms.name: Increased anti-dairy protein IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗乳制品蛋白IgE抗体水平升高
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against dairy proteins, including casein, alpha-lactalbumin, beta-lactoglobulin or bovine serum albumin contained in cow, sheep or goat milk and milk products.

terms.name: Increased anti-animal protein IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗动物蛋白IgE抗体水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of anti-animal protein IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against animal proteins, such as albumins that are present in animal hair, dander, shed skin, saliva and urine.

terms.name: Increased anti-seafood IgE antibody level
synonyms: Increased level of anti-seafood IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against seafood, including fish, shrimp, lobster, crab, squid and abalone.

terms.name: Increased anti-dust mite IgE antibody level
synonyms: Increased level of anti-dust mite IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against dust mites, such as house dust mites.

terms.name: Increased anti-bacteria IgE antibody level
synonyms: Increased level of anti-bacteria IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against bacteria.

terms.name: Increased anti-drug IgE antibody level
synonyms: Increased level of anti-drug IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against a drug or class of drugs, such as antibiotics.

terms.name: Increased anti-feather IgE antibody level
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against feathers, which could be indicative of an allergy against feathers themselves, or mite allergens present in feathers.

terms.name: Increased anti-food allergen IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗食物过敏原IgE抗体水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of anti-food allergen IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against proteins found in foods, such as milk, egg, soy, wheat, peanut, treenut, fish, and shellfish.

terms.name: Increased anti-plant based food allergen IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗植物性食物过敏原IgE抗体水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of anti-plant based food allergen IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against a plant based food allergen, including vegetables and fruits.

terms.name: Increased anti-gluten IgE antibody level
synonyms: Increased level of anti-gluten IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye.

terms.name: Increased anti-nut food product IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗坚果类食品IgE抗体水平升高
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against nut food products such as peanuts or tree nuts, such as hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, and almonds.

terms.name: Increased anti-egg IgE antibody level
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against eggs, including egg whites, egg yolks, and egg proteins such as ovoalbumin and ovomucoid.

terms.name: Increased anti-fungi IgE antibody level
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against fungus, such as molds like zygomycota, ascomycota and deuteromycota.

terms.name: Increased anti-meat allergen IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗肉类过敏原IgE抗体水平升高
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against meat, such as mammalian meat, including beef or pork, or poultry, like duck or chicken.

terms.name: Increased anti-parasite IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗寄生虫IgE抗体水平升高
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against parasites, such as helminths (parasitic worms, such as Ascaris lumbricoides, Trichuris trichiura, Ancylostoma duodenalis, Necator americanus, Strongyloides stercoralis) or parasites such as Toxoplasma gondii.

terms.name: Increased anti-insect IgE antibody level
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against antigens from insects such as moths, mosquitos, or cockroaches.

terms.name: Increased anti-venom IgE antibody level
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against venom from insects such as bees, wasps, hornets, yellowjackets.

terms.name: Increased anti-plant product IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗植物产品IgE抗体水平升高
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against antigens from plants and products derived from plants, such as wood or pollen.

terms.name: Positive urine norcotinine test
terms.definition: Detection of norcotinine, a metabolite of nicotine, in urine.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating IgA concentration
terms.name_zh: 血免疫球蛋白A浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgA immunoglobulin in blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating IgE concentration
terms.name_zh: 血免疫球蛋白E浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgE immunoglobulin in blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating IgG concentration
terms.name_zh: 血免疫球蛋白G浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgG immunoglobulin in blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating IgM concentration
terms.name_zh: 血免疫球蛋白M浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgM immunoglobulin in blood.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating IgD concentration
terms.name_zh: 血免疫球蛋白D浓度异常
terms.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgD immunoglobulin in blood.

terms.name: Decreased circulating IgD concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环免疫球蛋白D浓度降低
terms.definition: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin D (IgD) in blood.

terms.name: Increased circulating IgD concentration
terms.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin D in blood.

terms.name: Increased anti-animal dander IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗动物皮屑IgE抗体水平升高
synonyms: Increased level of anti-dander IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against animal dander, tiny scales shed from animal skin or hair, such as from pet dogs or cats.

terms.name: Increased anti-house dust mite IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗屋尘螨IgE抗体水平升高
synonyms: Increased anti-house dust IgE antibody level
Increased level of anti-house dust IgE antibody
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against house dust mites, a common allergen.

terms.name: Increased anti-alpha-gal IgE antibody level
terms.name_zh: 抗α-半乳糖IgE抗体水平升高
synonyms: Increased anti-galactose-alpha-1, 3 galactose IgE antibody level
terms.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against galactose-alpha-1, 3 galactose (alpha-gal), a carbohydrate found in mammalian meat.

terms.name: Decreased neutrophil toll-like receptor signalling
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞Toll样受体信号传导降低
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of neutrophil activation following toll-like receptor (TLR) ligation, commonly measured by evaluation of CD62L shedding after stimulation with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) using flow cytometry.

terms.name: Persistently decreased total neutrophil count
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of the absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, which persists for 3 or more months.

terms.name: Myeloid maturation arrest
synonyms: Myeloid maturation arrest in bone marrow
terms.definition: Chornic neutropenia arising from an impaired proliferation and maturation of myeloid progenitor cells in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Cyclic neutropenia in myeloid maturation arrest in bone marrow
terms.name_zh: 骨髓髓系成熟停滞性周期性中性粒细胞减少症
terms.definition: Cyclic neutropenia arising from an impaired proliferation and maturation of myeloid progenitor cells in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Transiently decreased total neutrophil count
terms.definition: Abnormal decrease of the absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, which persists for less than 3 months and then spontaneously recovers, but does not recur cyclically.

terms.name: Infection associated neutropenia
terms.name_zh: 感染相关性中性粒细胞减少症
terms.definition: Transient neutropenia caused by an infection, such as with a virus, bacteria or protozoan.

terms.name: Neutrophilia in presence of infection
terms.definition: An increased number of neutrophils circulating in the blood during an infection, such as with a bacteria, virus or fungus.

terms.name: Neutrophilia in absence of infection
terms.definition: An increased number of neutrophils circulating in the blood in the absence of an infection. Factors contributing to neutrophilia could include inflammation or congenital disorders.

terms.name: Hepatopulmonary fusion
terms.definition: Fusion of the liver with the lung.

terms.name: Asymmetrical gluteal crease
terms.definition: The presence of an asymmetrical gluteal crease, the horizontal crease formed by the inferior aspect of the buttocks and the posterior upper leg.

terms.name: Wide space between 4th and 5th toe
synonyms: Wide space between the 4th and 5th toe
terms.definition: A widely spaced gap between the fourth toe and the fifth (pinky) toe.

terms.name: Lower cranial nerve dysfunction
terms.definition: A functional abnormality affecting the lower cranial nerves, which include the paired 9th (glossopharyngeal), 10th (vagal), 11th (accessory) and 12th (hypoglossal) cranial nerves.

terms.name: Brain imaging abnormality
terms.definition: An anomaly of metabolism or structure of the brain identified by imaging.

terms.name: Subglottic hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the airway, typically below the vocal chords, that can cause severe obstruction of the airway.

terms.name: Supraglottic hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the upper part of the larynx (voice box) including the epiglottis; the area above the vocal cords.

terms.name: Visceral hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma arising from within visceral structures, the internal organs of the body.

terms.name: Intestinal hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the intestines, which includes the bowel.

terms.name: Spleen hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the spleen.

terms.name: Labial hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the upper lip.

terms.name: Esophageal hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the esophagus.

terms.name: Laryngeal hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the glottic or supraglottic regions.

terms.name: Vulvar hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the vulva.

terms.name: Retropharyngeal hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the retropharyngeal space, the portion of the peripharyngeal space that is located posterior to the pharynx.

terms.name: Paraspinal hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the paraspinal muscular region, the muscles next to the spine.

terms.name: Lumbosacral hemangioma
terms.definition: A spinal cord hemangioma located in the lumbosacral spine region.

terms.name: Supraumbilical raphe
terms.definition: An abnormality of the sternum that presents at birth as a ventral sternal non-union defect, due to an abnormality of the fusion of the layers of the skin. It presents as a scar-like line that extends upward from the umbilicus (belly button).

terms.name: Sternal pit
terms.definition: A sternal pit is a small indentation or dimple in the skin overlying the sternum of the chest. In some cases, the skin defect can be linear, extending several inches over the sternum.

terms.name: Pituitary gland cyst
terms.definition: A fluid-filled sacs that develop on or near the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Atrophic pituitary gland
terms.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Pediatric onset
terms.definition: Onset of disease manifestations before adulthood, defined here as before the age of 16 years, but excluding neonatal or congenital onset.

terms.name: Dyspepsia
terms.definition: A heterogeneous group of symptoms that are localized in the epigastric region. Typical dyspeptic symptoms include postprandial fullness, early satiation, epigastric pain and epigastric burning, but other upper gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, belching or abdominal bloating often occur.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating amylase concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of amylase in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Positive blood acetaminophen test
terms.definition: Detection of acetaminophen in the blood.

terms.name: Positive norpropoxyphene blood test
terms.definition: Detection of norpropoxyphene in the blood, a major metabolite of the opioid analgesic drug dextropropoxyphene.

terms.name: Positive meconium methadone test
terms.definition: Detection of methadone or its metabolite 2-ethylidene-1,5-dimethyl-3,3- diphenylpyrrolidine (EDDP) in meconium.

terms.name: Positive blood molindone test
terms.definition: Detection of molindone in the blood, an antipyschotic used for treatment of schizophrenia.

terms.name: Intrathoracic hemangioma
terms.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the intrathoracic or chest region.

terms.name: Hyperamylasemia
terms.definition: The concentration of amylase in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hypoamylasemia
terms.definition: The concentration of amylase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive urine norpropoxyphene test
terms.definition: Detection of norpropoxyphene in urine.

terms.name: Negativism
terms.definition: Opposing or not responding to instructions or external stimuli.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating isohemagglutinin concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环同族血凝素浓度异常
synonyms: Abnormal level of natural antibody to blood group agents
Abnormal natural antibody level to blood group antigens in blood (isohemagglutinin)
terms.definition: An abnormal level of isohemagglutinin in the blood. An isohemagglutinin refers to the naturally occurring antibodies in the ABO blood group system (i.e., anti-A in a group B person, anti-B in a group A person, and anti-A, anti-B, and anti-A,B in a group O person).

terms.name: Absent circulating isohemagglutinin
synonyms: Absent natural antibody to blood group agents
Complete or near-complete absence of isohemagglutinins
terms.definition: Absent or undetectable level of isohemagglutinin. An isohemagglutinin refers to the naturally occurring antibodies in the ABO blood group system (i.e., anti-A in a group B person, anti-B in a group A person, and anti-A, anti-B, and anti-A,B in a group O person).

terms.name: Decreased specific antibody response to protein vaccine
terms.name_zh: 蛋白疫苗特异性抗体反应降低
terms.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against proteins in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.

terms.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to tetanus vaccine
terms.name_zh: 破伤风疫苗特异性抗体应答完全或近完全缺失
terms.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a tetanus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.

terms.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to hepatitis B vaccine
terms.name_zh: 乙肝疫苗特异性抗体应答完全或近完全缺失
terms.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a hepatisis B antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.

terms.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to tetanus vaccine
terms.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a tetanus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.

terms.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to hepatitis B vaccine
terms.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a hepatitis B antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.

terms.name: Decreased specific antibody response to unconjugated polysaccharide vaccine
terms.name_zh: 非结合多糖疫苗特异性抗体反应降低
terms.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against unconjugated polysaccharides in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.

terms.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to unconjugated pneumococcus polysaccharide
