terms.definition: Two-sided or bilateral weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure.

terms.name: Hyperplasia of the maxilla
terms.definition: Abnormally increased dimension of the maxilla, especially relative to the mandible, resulting in a malocclusion or malalignment between the upper and lower teeth or in anterior positioning of the nasal base, increased convexity of the face, increased nasolabial angle, or increased width (transverse dimension of the maxilla.

terms.name: Hyperplasia of the premaxilla
synonyms: Hyperplasia of the primary palate bone
Increased size of the primary palate bone
terms.definition: An abnormality of the premaxilla (the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla) causing it to appear relatively large in size compared to the other parts of the maxilla or other facial structures.

terms.name: Positive infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in a specimen positive.

terms.name: Aqueous humor viral DNA positivity
terms.definition: The presence of viral DNA (e.g., cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex virus, or varicella zoster virus) in the aqueous humor of the eye.

terms.name: Electronic cigarette exposure history
terms.definition: History of use of electronic cigarettes (vaping).

terms.name: Gottron sign
terms.definition: Erythematous macules or patches over extensor surfaces of elbows, knuckles, knees, and ankles.

terms.name: Hypertension resistant to conventional therapy
terms.name_zh: 常规治疗抵抗性高血压
terms.definition: Resistant hypertension is defined as above-goal elevated blood pressure in a patient despite the concurrent use of 3 antihypertensive drug classes, commonly including a long-acting calcium channel blocker, a blocker of the renin-angiotensin system (angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker), and a diuretic.

terms.name: Tibiofibular interosseous membrane calcification
synonyms: Calcification of the interosseous membrane of leg
Calcification of the middle tibiofibular joint
terms.definition: Deposition of excess calcium in the interosseous membrane of the leg, which extends between the interosseous crests of the tibia and fibula and separates the anterior and posterior muscles of the lower leg.

terms.name: Supracondylar elbow fracture
terms.definition: A type of elbow fracture that involves the distal humerus just above the elbow.

terms.name: Abnormal alcohol consumption
terms.definition: Alcohol abuse or dependence.

terms.name: Thoracic lordosis
terms.definition: Thoracic lordosis refers to an abnormal curvature of the thoracic spine in which the thoracic spine displays lordosis (inward curve) instead of the normal kyphosis (outward curve).

terms.name: Radiation into left arm
terms.definition: Refers to pain or discomfort that is perceived to travel from the chest into the left arm.

terms.name: Radiation into right arm
terms.definition: Refers to pain or discomfort that is perceived to travel from the chest into the right arm.

terms.name: Small joint hypermobility
terms.definition: The capability that a small joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes. Small joints include metacarpophalangeal joints, proximal interphalangeal joints, \nsecond to fifth metatarsophalangeal joints, and wrists.

terms.name: Large joint hypermobility
terms.definition: The capability that a large joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes. Large joints include shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, and ankles.

terms.name: Intracranial calcification
terms.definition: Intracranial calcifications refer to calcifications within the brain parenchyma or vasculature. The five major components of the brain comprise the cerebrum, cerebellum, brain stem, pituitary gland, and hypothalamus.

terms.name: Anti-thyroid antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against one or more components on the thyroid.

terms.name: Bloodstream pathogen-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 血流病原体特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: Positive serology for a exposure to an infectious agent (i.e., examining serum for the presence of pathogen-specific antibodies).

terms.name: Anti-SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus type 2 (SARS-CoV-2).

terms.name: Anti-West Nile virus antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗西尼罗河病毒抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the West Nile virus.

terms.name: Anti-microfilaria antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a microfilaria (parasite).

terms.name: Anti-trypanosoma cruzi antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of trypanosoma cruzi.

terms.name: Anti-chikungunya virus antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗基孔肯雅病毒抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of chikungunya virus.

terms.name: Anti-chlamydia psittaci antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗鹦鹉热衣原体抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of chlamydia psittaci.

terms.name: Anti-herpes simplex antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗单纯疱疹病毒抗体阳性
synonyms: HSV antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of herpes simplex.

terms.name: Bloodstream virus-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 血流病毒特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a virus.

terms.name: Bloodstream parasite-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 血流寄生虫特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a parasite.

terms.name: Bloodstream antibacterial antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a bacterium.

terms.name: Anti-Japanese encephalitis virus-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗乙脑病毒特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the Japanese encephalitis virus.

terms.name: Anti-chlamydia trachomatis-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗沙眼衣原体特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of chlamydia trachomatis.

terms.name: Anti-Epstein-Barr virus-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗EB病毒特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the Epstein Barr virus (EBV).

terms.name: Anti-babesia-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗巴贝虫特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a parasite of the genus Babesia (parasite).

terms.name: Anti-Zikavirus-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗寨卡病毒特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the Zika virus.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream nucleic acid pathogen test
terms.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of a test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen.

terms.name: Positive microfilaria PCR test in the blood circulation
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of a microfilarial parasite in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Positive JC-virus PCR test in the blood circulation
synonyms: JC virus PCR in blood positive
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of the JC-virus (JC-Polyomavirus, John Cunningham virus) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Placenta previa
terms.definition: Implantation of the placenta over or near the internal os of the cervix.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating organic compound concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环有机化合物浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of an orrganic compound from the normal range. An organic compound is defined as any compound that contains a carbon atom.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating beta-carotene concentration
terms.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of beta-carotene in the blood circulation from the normal range.

terms.name: Decreased circulating beta-carotene concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环β-胡萝卜素浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of beta-carotene in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating beta-carotene concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环β-胡萝卜素浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of beta-carotene in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Mammary blocked duct
terms.definition: Blocked mammary ducts represent an area of localized milk stasis, typically associated with breast engorgement and resulting in a localized tender breast lump or area of blushed color; the breast may feel hot; and there may be a white, painful bleb on the end of the nipple.

terms.name: Bloodstream antifungal antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a fungus.

terms.name: Anti-coccidioidal antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a fungus of the Coccidioides genus.

terms.name: Anti-cryptococcal antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a fungus of the Cryptoccous genus.

terms.name: Anti-mycoplasma antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a mycoplasmal component.

terms.name: Anti-rickettsial antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a rickettsial bacterium. Rickettsiae are gram-negative bacteria with an obligate intracellular life cycle circulating between mammalian hosts and hematophagous arthropod vectors

terms.name: Anti-Bartonella henselae antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗汉赛巴通体抗体阳性
synonyms: Bartonella henselae antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Bartonella.

terms.name: Anti-Dengue virus antibody positivity
synonyms: Dengue antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Dengue virus.

terms.name: Anti-arbovirus antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of an Arbovirus.

terms.name: Anti-lymphocytic choriomeningitis antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒抗体阳性
synonyms: Lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV).

terms.name: Anti-varicella-zoster antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗水痘-带状疱疹病毒抗体阳性
synonyms: Varicella-zoster antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Varicella-zoster virus.

terms.name: Anti-rubella antibody positivity
synonyms: Rubella antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of rubella virus.

terms.name: Anti-cytomegalovirus antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗巨细胞病毒抗体阳性
synonyms: CMV antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of cytomegalovirus (CMV).

terms.name: Anti-measles antibody positivity
synonyms: Measles antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of measles virus.

terms.name: Anti-schistosoma antibody positivity
synonyms: Schistosoma antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a parasite of the genus Schistosomiasis is a parasitic disease historically known as bilharzia caused by the trematode of the genus Schistosoma. Schistosomiasis is a parasitic disease historically known as bilharzia caused by the trematode of the genus Schistosoma.

terms.name: Anti-Powassan virus antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗波瓦桑病毒抗体阳性
synonyms: Powassan encephalitis antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a Powassan virus (POW), which is an arbovirus within the family of Flaviviruses primarily found in the Northeastern United States, Canada, and Russia. It is a zoonotic infection transmitted to humans by several tick species and is the only member of the tick-borne flaviviruses endemic to North America.

terms.name: Marker expression
terms.definition: Detection of a marker such as a protein by immunohistochemistry or related investigation techniques. The presence or absence of such markers can be used to identify cell types on the basis of a profile of expressed markers. These terms do not imply abnormality and can be used for any cell type or organ.

terms.name: BCL2 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of BCL2 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-BCL2 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: BCL6 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of BCL6 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-BCL6 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD5 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD5 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD5 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD10 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD10 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD10 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD23 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD23 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD23 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD38 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD38 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD38 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD45 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD45 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD45 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: Cyclin D1 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of cyclin D1 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-cyclin D1 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: FMC7 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of FMC7 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-FMC7 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD19 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD19 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD19 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: CD20 expression
terms.definition: Detection of the presence of CD20 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD20 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).

terms.name: Past surgical history
terms.definition: information about the patient's previous surgical treatments that might be relevant to the presenting illness or to provide optimal clinical management.

terms.name: Abnormal superficial temporal artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of a superficial temporal artery, originating from the external carotid artery and passing over the zygomatic process. The superficial temporal artery is located on the superficial parts of the forehead and sides of the head and face.

terms.name: Skip lesions on temporal artery biopsy
terms.definition: Patchy inflammation of the superficial temporal artery, forming isolated foci of arteritis.

terms.name: Abnormal brain-evoked potentials
terms.definition: Any anomaly of brain-evoked potentials, defined as potentials generated by exteroceptive stimuli reflect synchronized activity by neuronal and axonal groups in the central nervous system (CNS) resulting from the arrival of nerve impulses after stimulation of a peripheral nerve or its receptors. Depending on the type of stimulus, evoked potentials are categorized as visual (VEP), auditory (AEP), or somatosensory (SSEP). Motor evoked potentials (MEP) occur when the brain's motor area is stimulated. They result from the activation of a sufficient number of motor units.

terms.name: Sputum infectious agent
terms.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the sputum, as characterized by sputum culture or other investigation.

terms.name: Positive Mycobacterium avium sputum culture
terms.definition: Growth of mycobacterium avium in a sputum culture.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream infectious agent antigen test
terms.definition: A test result demonstrating the presence of an antigen (marker such as a protein against which an antibody reacts) specific to an infectious agent.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream Cysticercosis antigen test
terms.definition: Demonstration of an antigen specific to Cysticercosis in the bloodstream.

terms.name: Klazomania
terms.definition: Involuntary attacks of compulsive paroxysmal shouting. The shouting behaviors may be extremely loud and not related to the ongoing mental state of the affected individual. Shouting episodes may occur in bouts and last for several hours.

terms.name: Coprolalia
terms.definition: Coprolalia denotes the involuntary utterance of obscenities. Intent is an important classifier in coprolalic behaviors, and unfortunately it remains unclear how to objectively distinguish coprolalia from common swearing.

terms.name: Continuous involuntary vocalizations
terms.definition: Continuous groaning, moaning, grunting, and shrieking.

terms.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the uterine cervix
terms.name_zh: 宫颈发育不全/发育不良
terms.definition: Congenital absence or underdevelopment of the uterine cervix.

terms.name: Cervical hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the uterine cervix.

terms.name: Primary peritoneal serous papillary adenocarcinoma
terms.definition: A serous papillary adenocarcinoma that arises from the lining of the peritoneum

terms.name: Positive skin infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in skin positive.

terms.name: Positive skin fungus test
terms.definition: A test for fungus, e.g., fungal hyphae, in a skin specimen (usually a skin scraping), demonstrates the presence of fungi. Most commonly, a skin scraping is obtained using a small scalpel blade, the specimen is placed on a clean glass slide, a drop of potassium hydroxide (KOH) is added, and the specimen is examined microscopically for fungal structures such as hyphae or yeast.

terms.name: Nasal secretion eosinophilia
terms.definition: Count of eosinophils in nasal secretions (for instance, nasal discharge) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Nasal secretion neutrophilia
terms.definition: Count of neutrophils in nasal secretions (for instance, nasal discharge) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Seminal vesicle agenesis
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by congenital absence of the seminal vesicle.

terms.name: Head impulse test has corrective saccade
terms.name_zh: 头脉冲试验存在矫正性扫视
terms.definition: In a patient with nystagmus, The examiner briskly rotates the head of the patient while having the patient fixate on a target. A corrective saccade indicates the patient's eye will move in one direction and quickly return back to neutral position.

terms.name: Positive CSF infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) positive.

terms.name: Positive CSF toxoplasma gondii nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Toxoplasma gondii nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Elevated circulating plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
terms.name_zh: 血纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1活性升高
terms.definition: The activity or concentration of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
terms.name_zh: 循环纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1活性异常
terms.definition: The activity or concentration of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of the normal range.

terms.name: Brain localization
terms.definition: The pattern by which a phenotype is localized to or predominant in a part of the brain.

terms.name: Frontal cortical localization
terms.definition: Localization to or predominance in the frontal cortex of the brain.

terms.name: Posterior fossa localization
terms.definition: Localization to or predominance in the parts of the brain within the posterior fossa.

terms.name: Subcortical localization
terms.definition: Localization to or predominance in the subcortical region of the brain.

terms.name: Parietal cortex localization
terms.definition: Localization to or predominance in the parietal cortex of the brain.

terms.name: Occipital cortex localization
terms.definition: Localization to or predominance in the occipital cortex of the brain.

terms.name: Tobacco use history
terms.definition: History of use of tobacco products such as cigarettes.

terms.name: Bartholin cyst
terms.definition: A fluid-filled sac near the vaginal opening. A Bartholin cyst is usually unilateral, asymptomatic blockage of the Bartholin gland, which may lead to a painless swelling.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating hepatic transaminase concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环肝转氨酶浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of alanine aminotransferase or aspartate aminotransferase.

terms.name: Reduced circulating aspartate aminotransferase concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine succinic acid level
terms.definition: The concentration of succinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive CSF varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test
synonyms: Positive CSF varicella zoster virus PCR
Varicella zoster virus PCR in CSF positive
terms.definition: Detection of Varicella zoster virus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: CSF pathogen-specific antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液病原体特异性抗体阳性
terms.definition: Positive serology in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) for a exposure to an infectious agent (i.e., examining CSF for the presence of pathogen-specific antibodies).

terms.name: Positive CSF nucleic acid pathogen test
terms.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen.

terms.name: CSF varicella zoster antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液水痘带状疱疹抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of varicella zoster virus.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 6 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of interleukin-6 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C12 acylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of C12 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C12 acylcarnitines have a twelve-carbon acyl chain.

terms.name: Frontalis muscle overactivity
terms.definition: Increased activity of the frontalis muscle, causing a characteristic staring and astonished facial expression.

terms.name: Nasal dermoid cyst
terms.definition: An ectodermal inclusion cyst containing skin and skin appendages; sebaceous glands, hair follicles, and occasionally sweat glands.

terms.name: Elevated circulating complement C3 concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the complement component C3 in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating inhibin B concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating lipoprotein(a) concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein(a) in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Positive blood infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the blood circulation positive.

terms.name: Positive respiratory tract infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the respiratory tract positive.

terms.name: Body odor
terms.definition: A perceived unpleasant smell given off by the body.

terms.name: Anal pain
terms.definition: Pain in and around the anus or rectum (perianal region).

terms.name: Urethritis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the urethra.

terms.name: Iris flocculi
terms.definition: Multiple cysts along the pupillary margin that appear as spherical or tear-drop-shaped pigmented lesions or wrinkled masses emerging from the pupillary border of the iris.

terms.name: Cornea verticillata
terms.definition: Golden brown or gray deposits with a clockwise, whorl-like distribution in the inferior interpalpebal portion of the cornea.

terms.name: Dysplastic gangliocytoma of the cerebellum
terms.name_zh: 小脑发育不良性神经节细胞瘤
terms.definition: It is a rare, slowly growing tumor of the cerebellum, a gangliocytoma sometimes considered to be a hamartoma, characterized by diffuse hypertrophy of the granular layer of the cerebellum.

terms.name: Moon facies
terms.definition: A rounded, puffy face with fat deposits in the temporal fossa and cheeks, a double chin.

terms.name: Abnormal gonadotropin-releasing hormone concentration
terms.name_zh: 促性腺激素释放激素浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of the normal gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH). Intermittent GnRH secretion from the hypothalamus acts upon its receptor in the anterior pituitary to regulate the production and release of the gonadotropins, follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH).

terms.name: Lack of gonadotropin-releasing hormone pulsatility
terms.name_zh: 促性腺激素释放激素脉冲分泌缺乏
terms.definition: Secretion of gonadotropin-releasing hormone that does not occur in a pulsatile fashion.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac test
terms.definition: Abnormal test result of cardiovascular physiology.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac MRI
terms.definition: Abnormal results of a MRI for the heart.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac catheterization
terms.definition: Abnormal results from the diagnostic tests resulting from cardiac catheterization.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac exercise stress test
terms.name_zh: 心脏运动负荷试验异常
terms.definition: Abnormal results of exercise on heart function.

terms.name: Abnormal resting energy expenditure from metabolic cart test
terms.name_zh: 代谢车检测静息能量消耗异常
terms.definition: Resting energy expenditure (REE) can be measured with indirect calorimetry using a metabolic cart, which is used to measure the oxygen consumption (VO2) and carbon dioxide production (VCO2).

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac biomarker test
terms.name_zh: 心脏生物标志物检测异常
terms.definition: Abnormal blood test results measuring creatine kinase (CK), CK-MB, troponin (TROPI), myoglobin, and/or cardiac enzymes.

terms.name: Reduced brain gamma-aminobutyric acid level by MRS
terms.definition: An decreased level of gamma-aminobutyric acid in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Abnormal circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
terms.name_zh: 血脱氢表雄酮浓度异常
terms.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone in the circulation.

terms.name: Shoulder muscle aplasia
terms.definition: Absence of shoulder muscles.

terms.name: Aplasia of the musculature of the pelvis
terms.name_zh: 骨盆肌肉组织发育不全
terms.definition: Absence of the musculature of the pelvis.

terms.name: Hypoplasia of the musculature of the pelvis
terms.name_zh: 骨盆肌肉组织发育不全
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the musculature of the pelvis.

terms.name: Aplastic colon
terms.definition: Congenital absence of the colon

terms.name: Cotton wool plaques
terms.definition: Deposition of large, diffuse cotton wool amyloid plaques (CWPs) lacking a dense core and associated neuritic changes.

terms.name: Abnormal hepatic glycogen storage
terms.definition: Change in normal glycogen storage content.

terms.name: Sclerosis of the carpal bones
terms.definition: An elevation in bone density in one or more carpal bones of the hand.

terms.name: Abnormal neuron branching
terms.definition: Abnormality of the structure and branching of the dendrites of a neuron.

terms.name: Abnormal natural killer subset distribution
terms.name_zh: 自然杀伤细胞亚群分布异常
terms.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion natural killer subsets relative to the total number of natural killer cells.

terms.name: Nasolacrimal sac obstruction
terms.definition: Blockage of the nasolacrimal sac.

terms.name: Nasolacrimal sac granuloma
terms.definition: A mass of granulation tissue in response to chronic dacryocystitis as polypoid formations or they follow accidental injury, from probing and as a reaction to retained foreign bodies in the sac.

terms.name: Nasolacrimal sac papilloma
terms.definition: Benign tumor of the nasolacrimal sac.

terms.name: Nasolacrimal sac epithelial papillary carcinoma
terms.definition: The malignant epithelial neoplasm with papillary growths in the nasolacrimal sac.

terms.name: Conjunctival cicatrization
terms.definition: An abnormality of the conjuctiva and ocular surface caused by conjunctival inflammation and associated with scarring.

terms.name: Dermolipoma of the conjunctiva
terms.definition: A benign tumor composed of adipose tissue and dense connective tissue usually located near the temporal fornix.

terms.name: Myopic astigmatism
terms.definition: A condition where one or both of the two principal meridians focus in the front of the retina when the eye is at rest.

terms.name: Latent hypermetropia
terms.definition: A term to describe when farsightedness is masked when the accommodative muscles are used to increase the focusing power of the eye.

terms.name: Eyelid retraction
terms.definition: With the eyes in primary position, the sclera is visible above the superior corneal limbus.

terms.name: Upper eyelid retraction
terms.definition: An elevation of the eyelid above the normal level in the primary position.

terms.name: Collier's sign
terms.definition: A unilateral or bilateral eyelid retraction due to midbrain lesions.

terms.name: Seborrhoeic blepharitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the eyelid due to overactivity of the sebaceous gland.

terms.name: Nasolacrimal sac lymphoma
terms.definition: A type of lymphoma that involves the nasolacrimal sac.

terms.name: Delayed canalization of nasolacrimal duct
terms.definition: A very common condition in which the extreme end of the nasolacrimal duct underneath the inferior turbinate fails to complete its canalization in the newborn period.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity
terms.definition: An avascular or abnormally vascularized retina that occurs in premature infants and can lead to blindness.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 1
terms.definition: The retinal vessels stop and then a linear flat white line is present that usually runs the circumference of the vascular retina.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 2
terms.definition: The accumulating neovascularization thickens and manifests as a linear bump. The neovascularization remains along the surface of the retina and does not extend off the retina into the cortical vitreous.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 3
terms.definition: The neovascularization accumulates at the edge of the vascularized retina and extends into the vitreous (also called extra retinal fibrosis proliferation). In cases of Zone 2 and Zone 3, this may be sausage shaped. In more posterior Zone 1 disease, the stage 3 can appear as a direct extension of the normal retinal vessels but extending tangentially over the avascular retina.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4
terms.definition: Scar tissue that forms a continuous sheet coming up from the edge of the vascularized retina. This scar tissue can grow toward the vitreous base/posterior lens capsule resulting in traction, distortion, and even detachment.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4a
terms.definition: A detachment that involves the peripheral retina that does not extend into the macula.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4b
terms.definition: A detachment that involves the peripheral retina that involves the macula itself. The detachment usually starts in the temporal periphery although can also involve the nasal retina as well.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5
terms.definition: Funnel detachment from the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5a
terms.definition: An open funnel detachment of the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5b
terms.definition: A closed funnel detachment of the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity zone I
terms.definition: Retinopathy which extends from the center of the optic disc to twice the distance from the center of the optic disc to the center of the macula.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity zone II
terms.definition: Retinopathy which extends centrifugally from the edge of zone I to the nasal ora serrata.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity zone III
terms.definition: Retinopathy which is a residual crescent of retina anterior to zone II.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity plus
terms.definition: Venous dilatation and arteriolar tortuosity of the posterior retinal vessels and may later increase in severity to include iris vascular engorgement, poor pupillary dilatation (rigid pupil), and vitreous haze. This definition has been further refined in the later clinical trials in which the diagnosis of plus disease could be made if sufficient vascular dilatation and tortuosity are present in at least 2 quadrants of the eye.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity pre-plus
terms.definition: As vascular abnormalities of the posterior pole that are insufficient for the diagnosis of plus disease but that demonstrate more arterial tortuosity and more venous dilatation than normal.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity threshold
terms.definition: A retinopathy with a 50% likelihood of progressing to retinal detachment. Threshold disease is considered to be present when stage 3 retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) is present in either zone I or zone II, with at least 5 continuous or 8 total clock hours of disease, and the presence of plus disease.

terms.name: Retinopathy of prematurity prethreshold
terms.definition: High risk patients who were in Zone 1 (no Plus or stage 3) or Zone 2 with Plus or stage 3 but not both.

terms.name: Latent myopia
terms.definition: The difference between total and manifest myopia.

terms.name: Paralytic ectropion
terms.definition: A type of ectropion associated with orbicularis muscle weakness caused by cranial nerve VII palsy.

terms.name: Conjunctival dermolipoma
terms.definition: A conjuctival lesion composed of adipose tissue and dense connective tissue. Such choristomas of dermal elements are normally found at the outer canthus, and have a gelatinous appearance. Classically, there is an indistinct posterior border (with the lesion frequently extending into the orbit) and a well-demarcated anterior border several millimeters posterior to the limbus.

terms.name: Absolute eccentric fixation
terms.definition: Eccentric fixation in which the angle of eccentricity equals the objective angle of deviation.

terms.name: Abnormal ocular alignment
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal ocular alignment.

terms.name: Dissociated vertical deviation
terms.definition: An incomitant tendency for an occluded eye to elevate and extort which resolves on uncovering.

terms.name: Dissociated horizontal deviation
terms.definition: A change in horizontal ocular alignment, unrelated to accommodation, that is brought about solely by a change in the balance of visual input from the two eyes.

terms.name: Alternating hypertropia
terms.definition: A type of vertical tropia in which, when one eye is fixing, the other eye is deviated upwards.

terms.name: Alternating hyperphoria
terms.definition: A type of vertical phoria in which, in dissociation, the occluded eye deviates upwards.

terms.name: Alternating hypotropia
terms.definition: A type of vertical tropia in which, when one eye is fixing, the other eye is deviated downwards.

terms.name: Alternating hypophoria
terms.definition: A type of vertical phoria in which, in dissociation, the occluded eye deviates downwards.

terms.name: Pseudophakia
terms.definition: The term pseudophakia refers to having an artificial lens implanted after the natural eye lens has been removed. During cataract surgery the natural cloudy lens is replaced by an pseudophakia intraocular lens (IOL).

terms.name: Optic nerve gray crescent
terms.definition: Having a characteristic appearance of a slate gray area of pigmentation within the disk margins that commonly appears along the inferotemporal or temporal neuroretinal rim areas.

terms.name: Peripapillary atrophy
terms.definition: Thinning in the layers of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium around the optic nerve.

terms.name: Optic nerve sheath meningioma
terms.definition: A benign tumor of meningothelial cells of the meninges that usually occurs in middle age. It is typically unilateral and there is an association with neurofibromatosis type 2.

terms.name: Periocular capillary hemangioma
terms.definition: A capillary hemangioma surrounding the eyeball but within the orbit.

terms.name: Lymphangioma of the orbit
terms.definition: A hamartoma of lymph vessels that usually presents in childhood. It tends to increase in size with head-down posture and with the Valsalva maneuver. Superficial lesions are visible as transilluminable cystic spaces of the lid or conjunctiva that may also contain blood. Deep lesions may cause gradual proptosis or present acutely with orbital pain and reduced vision due to hemorrhage.

terms.name: Orbital rhabdomyosarcoma
terms.definition: A mesenchymal tumor that is considered to be the commonest primary orbital malignancy in children. Histologically, it may be differentiated into embryonal, alveolar, and pleomorphic types. It is usually intraconal or within the superior orbit.

terms.name: Food allergy
terms.definition: Primary food allergies primarily occur as a result (most likely) of gastrointestinal sensitization to predominantly stable food allergens (glycoproteins). A secondary food allergy develops after primary sensitization to airborne allergens (e. g., pollen allergens) with subsequent reactions (due to cross-reactivity) to structurally related often labile allergens in (plant) foods.

terms.name: Latex allergy
terms.definition: Latex allergy is an IgE-mediated immediate hypersensitivity response to natural rubber latex (NRL) protein with a variety of clinical signs ranging from contact urticaria, angioedema, asthma, and anaphylaxis.

terms.name: Food-induced anaphylaxis
terms.definition: Food-induced anaphylaxis is a severe, potentially fatal, systemic allergic reaction that occurs suddenly after contact with an allergy-causing food.

terms.name: Venom-induced anaphylaxis
terms.definition: A form of anaphylaxis that is triggered by exposure to venom.

terms.name: Verruca plana

terms.name: Bilateral basilar pulmonary fibrosis
terms.definition: It is a bilateral reticular pattern of linear or lineonodular densities that are most pronounced in basilar portions of the lungs on standard chest x-ray. It is the third minor criterion for scleroderma diagnosis.

terms.name: Abnormal cardiac magnetic resonance imaging finding
terms.name_zh: 心脏磁共振成像结果异常
terms.definition: Abnormal finding by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), which uses non-ionizing radiation via a strong magnetic field and radio frequency energy to generate three dimensional images. This term comprises findings that are specific to MRI. Findings such as ventricular spetum defect that can be detected by multiple modalities should be coded separately.

terms.name: Elevated myocardial native T2
terms.definition: Increased duration of myocardial T2 time without gadolinium contrast. Elevated T2, which can detect myocardial edema.

terms.name: Myocardial late gadolinium enhancement
terms.definition: Areas of high signal intensity in magnetic resonance imaging of the heart appearing 10 to 15 minutes after injection of the intercellular contrast agent gadolinium.

terms.name: Pericardial late gadolinium enhancement
terms.definition: Areas of high signal intensity in magnetic resonance imaging of the pericardium appearing around 10 minutes after injection of the intercellular contrast agent gadolinium.

terms.name: Elevated myocardial native T1
terms.definition: Increased duration of myocardial T1 time without gadolinium contrast. T1 mapping consists of quantifying the T1 relaxation time of a tissue by using analytical expressions of image-based signal intensities. A fundamental principle of MR imaging is that the signal intensity of pixels is based on the relaxation of hydrogen nuclei protons in a static magnetic field. The T1 relaxation times between two tissues vary substantially. Edema, fat infiltration, and fibrosis also cause differences in T1 relaxivity.

terms.name: Bronchoconstriction
terms.definition: Tightening of smooth muscle surrounding the bronchi and bronchioles with consequent wheezing and shortness of breath.

terms.name: Formation of multiple pronuclei during fertilization
terms.definition: Pronuclei formation is a critical process during fertilization. Normally, there are two pronuclei (2PN), including the paternal pronucleus and the maternal pronucleus, in the zygote after fertilization. It is generally accepted that multiple pronuclei (MPN) formation is due to the abnormal extrusion of the second polar body or to abnormal fertilization with multiple sperm. The MPN therefore can cause infertility and recurrent failure of IVF/ICSI.

terms.name: Kinesiophobia
terms.definition: An excessive, irrational, and debilitating fear of carrying out a physical movement due to a feeling of vulnerability to painful injury or reinjury.

terms.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of bicarbonate
terms.name_zh: 肾小管碳酸氢盐重吸收障碍
terms.definition: Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of bicarbonate.

terms.name: History of congenital HPV infection
terms.name_zh: 先天性人乳头瘤病毒感染史
terms.definition: A congenital human papillomavirus (HPV) infection of the newborn. Congential HPV infection can manifest as condyloma cuminata in the newborn.

terms.name: Anti-desmoglein-1 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗桥粒芯糖蛋白1抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoglein-1, a dermal cell adhesion molecule.

terms.name: Anti-desmoglein-3 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗桥粒芯糖蛋白3抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoglein-3, a dermal cell adhesion molecule.

terms.name: Anti-envoplakin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against envoplakin, a cytoskeletal linker protein that links intermediate filaments to cellular junctions.

terms.name: Anti-periplakin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against periplakin.

terms.name: Anti-desmoplakin I antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗桥粒斑蛋白I抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoplakin-1.

terms.name: Anti-desmoplakin II antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗桥粒斑蛋白II抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoplakin-II.

terms.name: Anti-BP230 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against BP230.

terms.name: Anti-BP180 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against BP180.

terms.name: Anti-laminin 332 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗层粘连蛋白332抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against laminin-332.

terms.name: Anti-laminin 6 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗层粘连蛋白6抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against laminin-6.

terms.name: Anti-laminin gamma1 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗层粘连蛋白γ1抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against laminin gamma-1.

terms.name: Anti-laminin antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗层粘连蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a laminin. Laminins are major components of the basement membrane.

terms.name: Anti-integrin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against an integrin. Integrins are a family of cell adhesion molecules with 24 known integrin heterodimers. Integrins transduce mechanical and biochemical signals from fibrotic extracellular matrix into the cell, activate latent TGFbeta, and subsequently modulate fibroblast adhesion, migration, and growth.

terms.name: Anti-transglutaminase 6 antibody
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against transglutaminase 6.

terms.name: Anti-LAD-1 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against LAD-1, which is the soluble 120 kDa ectodomain of BP180.

terms.name: Anti-LABD97 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against LABD97, which is structurally identical to a portion of the extracellular domain of BPAg2. BPAg2, a 180 kDa bullous pemphigoid antigen, is a transmembrane protein important for basement membrane cohesion.

terms.name: Antigliadin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against gliadin.

terms.name: Anti-reticulin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against reticulin.

terms.name: Anti-type VII collagen antibody
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against collagen type VII.

terms.name: False perception of self-motion
terms.definition: A perception that one's body is moving or swaying despite lack of motion of the body.

terms.name: Non-spinning vertigo
terms.definition: A perception of unsteadiness of dizziness that is not characterized bythe spinning sensation of classic vertigo, but rather by an oscillatory perception (rocking, bobbing, or swaying despite the fact that the subject is not moving).

terms.name: Infection-associated lymphopenia
terms.name_zh: 感染相关性淋巴细胞减少症
terms.definition: Decreased lymphocyte count during infections.

terms.name: Primary obstructive megaureter
terms.definition: Megaurater associated with obstruction or an adynamic ureteral segment in the ureterovesical junction.

terms.name: Encysted hydrocele of the cord
terms.definition: A type of hydrocele testis in which both the proximal and distal portions of processus vaginalis get obliterated while the central portion remains patent and fluid accumulates within it.

terms.name: Congenital hydrocele
terms.definition: Congenital hydrocele occurs when processus vaginalis is patent and communicates with the peritoneal cavity. This communication allows the movement of peritoneal fluid but is too small to allow the intra-abdominal contents to herniate through.

terms.name: Infantile hydrocele
terms.definition: Infantile Hydrocele is a type pf hydrocele in which the processus vaginalis gets obliterated at the level of the deep inguinal ring. However, the portion distal to it remains patent and allows fluid accumulation.

terms.name: Decreased mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion
terms.name_zh: 黏膜相关恒定T细胞比例降低
synonyms: Reduced mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion
Reduced proportion of mucosal-associated invariant T cells
terms.definition: A decreased proportion of circulating mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells relative to total T cell count.

terms.name: Puerpural onset
terms.definition: Onset of a phenotypic abnormality or a disease during childbirth or in the period immediately following.

terms.name: AA amyloidosis
terms.definition: Extracellular tissue deposition of fibrils that are composed of fragments of and/or intact serum amyloid A protein, a hepatic acute phase reactant.

terms.name: Fracture type
terms.definition: Category of fracture. Terms from this subontology can be used together with terms in the subontology that descends from Bone fracture (HP:0020110).

terms.name: Greenstick fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the broken bone is not completely separated.

terms.name: Transverse fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the break is in a straight line across the bone.

terms.name: Spiral fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the break spirals around the bone.

terms.name: Oblique fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which there is a diagonal break across the bone.

terms.name: Compression fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the bone is crushed, causing the broken bone to be wider or flatter in appearance.

terms.name: Comminuted fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the break is in three or more pieces and fragments are present at the fracture site.

terms.name: Segmental fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the same bone is fractured in two places, so there is a floating segment of bone.

terms.name: Open fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which there is an open wound or break in the skin near the site of the broken bone.

terms.name: Closed fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the broken bone that does not penetrate the skin.

terms.name: Avulsion fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture that is localied near to a a tendon or ligament and a small fragment of bone is separated from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

terms.name: Displaced fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture in which the ends of the fractured bone are no longer aligned.

terms.name: Exanthem
terms.definition: A widespread rash.

terms.name: Intestinal inflammation
terms.definition: A reaction characterizeds by capillary dilatation, leukocytic infiltration, redness, heat, pain, swelling localized to the in the intestinal tract.

terms.name: Abnormal apoptosis
terms.definition: Any abnormality of programmed cell death (apoptosis), which is defined as the orchestrated collapse of a cell characterized by membrane blebbing, cell shrinkage, condensation of chromatin, and fragmentation of DNA followed by rapid engulfment of the corpse by neighboring cells. Apoptosis is distinguished from death by necrosis by the absence of an associated inflammatory response.

terms.name: Decreased FasL-mediated apoptosis
terms.definition: A reduced amount of programmed cell death upon stimulation of the FAS receptor, which normally induces caspase-8 dependent apoptosis.

terms.name: Glomerular proteinuria
terms.definition: A type of proteinuria characterized by increased permeability of the glomerular capillary wall to macromolecules (particularly albumin), whereby protein excretion can reach 20 g/24 h and consists mainly of albumin.

terms.name: Abnormal lung development
terms.definition: A structural defect associated with abnormal development of the lung.

terms.name: Pancreatic alpha-cell hyperplasia
terms.definition: A diffuse and specific increase in the number of alpha-cells.

terms.name: 3-4 metacarpal synostosis
synonyms: Middle and ring finger metacarpal synostosis
Synostosis of third and the fourth metacarpal bones
terms.definition: A congenital hand malformation characterized by the coalescence of the coalescence of third and fourth metacarpals (i.e., those corresponding to the middle and ring fingers).

terms.name: Sleep related hallucination
terms.definition: Hallucination during onset/falling asleep in any sensory modality, usually auditory, visual, or tactile.

terms.name: Poor sleep
terms.definition: Subjectively or observationally reported sleep that is insufficiently restorative, disrupted, or of inadequate quality, regardless of duration. Poor sleep may involve difficulty maintaining sleep continuity, frequent awakenings, a sense of light or shallow sleep, or waking up feeling unrefreshed. It is typically identified through self-report or clinical interview and not by objective measurements.

terms.name: Abnormal iliac artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the iliac artery.

terms.name: Iliac artery aneurysm
terms.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the iliac artery.

terms.name: Abnormal interest
terms.definition: Any deviation from normal intensity or subject of a person's interests, which can be defined as a state of giving selective attention to something.

terms.name: Persistent preoccupation with parts of objects
synonyms: Fixated interest with parts of objects
terms.definition: A type of abnormal interest characterized by a persistent and intense focus on parts of a toy/object. For example, affected individuals may spin the wheels on a toy car rather than drive the toy car.

terms.name: Fixated interests
terms.definition: Highly restricted, fixated interests that are abnormal in intensity or focus (e.g., strong attachment to or preoccupation with unusual objects, excessively circumscribed or perseverative interests).

terms.name: Abnormal language feature
terms.definition: The presence of any atypical form of expressive language.

terms.name: Pronoun reversal
terms.definition: Atypical language features characterized by first vs. second or third person pronoun errors such as using 'you' or 'he/she' in place of 'I'.

terms.name: Involuntary vocalization
terms.definition: Production of sound done without will or conscious control. Involuntary vocalizations include tics, stereotypies vocalizations as part of dystonia or chorea, continuous vocalizing behaviors such as groaning or grunting, pathological laughter and crying, and others. These vocalizations are not recognized as socially or culturally appropriate.

terms.name: Reduced frequency of facial expressions
terms.definition: The number of times facial expressions are produced in a given period is lower than expected given the social and cultural context.

terms.name: Use of another person's body to communicate
terms.definition: Moving another person's hand, body part, or body to communicate a desire, e.g. pushing or pulling someone toward a desired object or placing someone's hand on something.

terms.name: Fixated interest with abnormal focus
terms.definition: A fixated interest in a specific topic that is atypical for the social context of the individual, such as topics of a non-social nature like fossils or vacuum cleaners.

terms.name: Fixated interest with abnormal intensity
terms.definition: An abnormally intense interest in a topic or object that is not atypical for the social context of the affected person.

terms.name: Sensory seeking
terms.definition: Unusual interest in sensory aspects of the environment.

terms.name: Reduced production of gestures
terms.definition: Diminished use of typical non-verbal conversational gestures such as shaking the head to indicate no or nodding the head to indicate yes.

terms.name: Reduced cooperative play
terms.definition: Impairment in a child's ability to be able to play in a way that involves peer collaboration. Collaborative play involves things such as verbal and non-verbal communication (e.g., self-initiated interactions), turn-taking, sharing, reciprocity, and collaborative problem-solving. It is often contrasted to parallel play, which involves a form of social play in which two children do similar activities near each other and often mimic each other. Typically developing children develop collaborative play between the ages of 4 and 5.

terms.name: Lack of interest in peers
synonyms: Reduced desire to interact with peers
terms.definition: Lack of interest in peers of comparable age and social groups is evident when an individual, such as a child, shows more interest in socializing with adults rather than children their own age.

terms.name: Reduced sharing of interests
terms.definition: An absence or abnormally low frequency of engaging with others to share personal interests or topics. Interest sharing includes offers of information about oneself as a form of social interaction.

terms.name: Reduced object sharing
terms.definition: An absence or reduction in object sharing. Object sharing is an early emerging social skill in which a child will share objects such as toys, balls, or books with parents or peers during object play.

terms.name: Abnormal communicative facial expressions
terms.definition: Abnormal expressions (movements or position of muscles of the face that convey the emotional state of an individual to observers during social interactions) comprising abnormalities of quantity, range, context-appropriateness, and quality.

terms.name: Facial expressions that do not match the context
terms.definition: Production of facial expressions that are misaligned with the social context.

terms.name: Abnormal quality of facial expression
terms.definition: Spontaneous production of communicative facial expressions that have poor quality or are exaggerated or muted.

terms.name: Abnormal gesture use
terms.definition: Abnormality in the use of gestures defined as hand, shoulder, and head movements that convey a shared meaning within a culture that replace or supplement verbal communication.

terms.name: Poor conversational reciprocity
terms.definition: Reduced use of reciprocal (back and forth) conversation, as compared to what would be expected for language level.

terms.name: Ectopic tooth eruption
terms.definition: A condition in which the permanent teeth, because of deficiency of growth in the jaw or segment of jaw, assume a path of eruption that intercepts a primary tooth, causes its premature loss and produces a consequent malposition of the permanent tooth.

terms.name: Corpus cavernosum hypoplasia
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by undergrowth of the corpus cavernosum.

terms.name: Elevated circulating thymine concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of the nucleobase thymine in the blood circulation above the normal range.

terms.name: Positive lactose hydrogen breath test
terms.definition: Elevated hydrogen gas level in exhaled breath following oral administration of lactose. In individuals with lactose intolerance, undigested lactose in the colon will be metabolized by colonic bacteria, releasing hydrogen gas.

terms.name: Triggered by exposure to medication
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of a medication.

terms.name: Triggered by allopurinol
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to allopurinol.

terms.name: Ameliorated by oral zinc supplementation
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by oral zinc supplementation.

terms.name: Curved dental root
terms.definition: A root of a tooth that is more rounded than normal.

terms.name: Abnormal four chamber view of the fetal heart
terms.name_zh: 胎儿心脏四腔心切面异常
terms.definition: The four-chamber (4Ch) view of the fetal heart is the most widely used screening examination for the detection of structural cardiac abnormalities during routine fetal ultrasonography. In the healthy normal fetus, the apical 4Ch view demonstrates four well-developed chambers, a concordant atrioventricular (AV) connection, unobstructed AV valves (mitral and tricuspid valves), the foramen ovale flap opening into left atrium (LA), and an intact interventricular septum. Additionally, the pulmonary venous opening can be visualized at the LA wall. Any structural deviations from normal anatomy may lead to congenital heart disease that can be determined by the 4Ch view of the fetal heart's ultrasound imaging.

terms.name: Spleen hamartoma
terms.definition: A hamartomatous lesion (benign focal lesions composed of disorganized tissue elements) localized in the spleen.

terms.name: Positive lupus band test
terms.definition: Deposits of immunoglobulins and complement components along the dermoepidermal junction.

terms.name: Bone marrow erythroid vacuolization
terms.definition: Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of erythroid precursors in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Triggered by electromagnetic field
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to an electromagnetic field.

terms.name: Exposure history
terms.definition: Information about current and past exposure to metals, dust, fibers, fumes, chemicals, biologic hazards, radiation, noise, and/or vibration at work or home.

terms.name: Asbestos exposure
terms.definition: History of exposure to asbestos, a fibrous mineral with physical and chemical properties that make it resistant to heat and degradation.

terms.name: Medication history
terms.definition: Information about current or past medications taken by an individual.

terms.name: Aminoglycoside exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken aminoglycoside antibiotics.

terms.name: Statin exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken statins, also known as HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors.

terms.name: Potassium-sparing diuretic exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken a potassium-sparing diuretic exposure such as amiloride, eplerenone, spironolactone, and triamterene.

terms.name: Carbamazepine exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken carbamazepine.

terms.name: Valproate exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken valproate (valproic acid).

terms.name: Hydralazine exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken hydralazine.

terms.name: Calcium channel blocker exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken a calcium channel blocker such as amlodipine, nicardipine, nifedipine, verapamil, or diltiazem.

terms.name: Triggered by poison ivy, poson oak, or sumac
synonyms: Contact with poison ivy, poison oak, or sumac
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure (cutaneous contact) to poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac. These three plants each contain urushiol. Contact with these plants is the most common causes of clinically diagnosed allergic contact dermatitis.

terms.name: History of exclusive breast feeding
terms.definition: A past medical history of having been fed exclusively by breast feeding.

terms.name: Nutrition history
terms.definition: A part of the past medical history consisting of information about the typical food intake of an individual.

terms.name: High dietary oxalate intake
synonyms: Foods high in oxalate, high intake
terms.definition: A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing high levels of oxalate, such as green-leaf vegetables, tea, nuts, chocolate and rhubarb.

terms.name: Recent honey ingestion
terms.definition: A history of ingestion of honey in recent weeks.

terms.name: Raw egg-white ingestion
terms.definition: A history of eating raw egg whites.

terms.name: Exacerbated by sodium channel blocking agent exposure
terms.name_zh: 钠通道阻滞剂暴露加重
synonyms: Sodium channel blocking drugs aggravate findings
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by administration of sodium channel blocking agents such as phenytoin, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine, topiramate, and zonisamide.

terms.name: Addictive nitrous oxide use
terms.name_zh: 一氧化二氮成瘾性使用
terms.definition: Addiction to inhaled nitrous oxide gas (N2O) is a growing concern.

terms.name: Recent blood transfusion
terms.definition: A past medical history of a recent blood transfusion.

terms.name: Ameliorated by colchicine
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of colchizine.

terms.name: Ameliorated by vitamin D
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of vitamin D.

terms.name: Exacerbated by phenytoin exposure
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by administration of phenytoin.

terms.name: Triggered by angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to anngiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor such as benazepril, captopril, enalapril, fosinopril, and lisinopril.

terms.name: Prostaglandin E1 exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treateed with prostaglandin E1.

terms.name: 5-fluorouracil exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treated with 5-fluorouracil.

terms.name: 6-mercaptopurine exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treateed with 6-mercaptopurine.

terms.name: Isoniazid exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treateed with isoniazid.

terms.name: Absent cavum septum pellucidum
terms.definition: The cavum septum pellucidum (CSP) is an important fetal midline forebrain landmark that is normally visible by prenatal sonography. This term refers to the lack of visibility of the CSP on prenatal sonography. The CSP normally can be visualized between 18 and 37 weeks of gestation. Lack of visualization of the CSP in this time period generally requires follow up and may indicate the presence of underlying malformations such as malformations of the corpus callosum. The lack of CSP before 18 weeks or after 37 weeks of gestation (or postnatally) is considered a normal finding.

terms.name: Fetal abdominal cyst
terms.definition: Fetal abdominal cysts are usually detected during the second trimester anomaly scan or discovered incidentally at later gestations. However, a definitive diagnosis is often not made until postnatal life. The most common etiologies of fetal abdominal cysts are: ovarian, gastrointestinal cystic duplication, liver and choledochal, meconium pseudocysts, mesenteric and adrenal. Following identification of a cyst, careful morphological assessment allows the prediction of their natural history and importantly, the likelihood of surgical intervention being required postnatally.

terms.name: Fetal bowel dilatation
terms.definition: Fetal bowel dilatation is characterized by fluid-filled intestinal loops which measure at least fifteen millimeters long or seven millimeters in diameter. Ultrasonographic image of dilated fetal bowel is a sign of intestinal mechanical or functional obstruction and its prevalence will depend on the underlying condition: bowel atresia or stenosis, malrotation with volvulus, meconium ileus, total colonic aganglionosis, and meconium plug syndrome. The etiology of fetal bowel dilatation is a difficult prenatal diagnosis since ultrasound has limited accuracy for bowel evaluation.

terms.name: Left ventricular dilatation
terms.definition: Enlargement of the chamber of the left heart ventricle.

terms.name: Fetal trigonocephaly
terms.definition: A fetal ultrasound finding defined by flattening of the occiput with pointing of the frontal bones and brachycephaly with an increased cephalic index. It is characterized by keel shaped deformity of forehead with midline ridge, bilateral fronto temporal constriction with compensatory biparietal expansion, supra orbital and lateral orbital retrusion and hypotelorism. This finding is said to resemble a strawberry.

terms.name: Abnormal fetal heart outflow tract
terms.definition: A prenatal anomaly of the outflow tract. Fetal ultrasound may not always be able to easily and accurately describe the outflow anomaly, but can detect abnormal anatomy. Often, follow up with a fetal echo is recommended, but fetal ultrasound is limited.

terms.name: Recent past medical history
terms.definition: History of events that precede the current presenting condition and are thought to be of potential relevance, having occurred in the hours, days, or weeks before the current condition.

terms.name: History of recent viral illness
terms.definition: Medical history of a viral illness in recent weeks.

terms.name: History of recent dental procedure
terms.definition: Medical history of a dental procedure in recent weeks.

terms.name: Abnormal hepatic artery morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hepatic artery or its branches.

terms.name: Hepatic artery hyperplasia
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the hepatic arteries.

terms.name: Lymph node necrosis
terms.definition: Areas of necrotic tissue within a lymph node.

terms.name: Multinucleated neuron
terms.definition: Neurons that contain more than one nucleus.

terms.name: History of recent contralateral injury
terms.definition: A history of an injury that occurred several hours, days, or weeks before the current presenting complaint and is located on the other side of the body relative to the current presenting complaint.

terms.name: Alternating laterality
terms.definition: Occurring on the left and right in succession. This term can refer to alternating sides of the body (e.g., Alternating hemiplegia) or alternative sides of the visual field (e.g., some migraine auras).

terms.name: Cervical squamous cell papilloma
terms.name_zh: 宫颈鳞状细胞乳头状瘤
terms.definition: A benign tumor arising from the epithelial surface of the cervix and usually caused by Human Papillomavirus infection.

terms.name: Liver leiomyoma
terms.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm that arises in the liver.

terms.name: Typified by high penetrance
terms.definition: Description of conditions in which only an incomplete but relatively high proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for incomplete, but high penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least 80 percent but less than 100 percent of individuals with the given genotype would manifest the disease with a full lifespan.

terms.name: Typified by moderate penetrance
terms.definition: Description of conditions in which only a moderate proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for moderate penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least 20 percent but less than 80 percent of individuals with the given genotype would manifest the disease with a full lifespan.

terms.name: Typified by low penetrance
terms.definition: Description of conditions in which only a low proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for low penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least some but less than 20 percent of carriers would manifest the disease with a full lifespan.

terms.name: Decreased Succinyl-CoA 3-ketoacid CoA transferase activity
terms.name_zh: 琥珀酰辅酶A3-酮酸辅酶A转移酶活性降低
terms.definition: Decreased activity of the enzyme succinyl-CoA 3-ketoacid CoA transferase.

terms.name: Reduced phytanic acid oxidase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase (PhyH; EC 1.14.11.18) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. PhyH plays a role in the catabolism of phytanic acid, a branched-chain fatty acid that is a normal constituent of the human diet.

terms.name: Reduced bifunctional protein activity
terms.definition: Diminished activity of hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 4 (HSD17B4), also known as D-bifunctional protein (DBP), a peroxisomal enzyme that catalyzes multiple steps of beta-oxidation of very long chain fatty acids.

terms.name: Decreased circulating plasmalogen concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环缩醛磷脂浓度降低
terms.definition: Reduced plasmalogen concentration in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Post-vaccination varicella zoster virus infection
synonyms: Varicella zoster virus infection after vaccination
terms.definition: Infection with live, attenuated varicella-zoster virus following vaccination. This is an extremely rare event that may indicate immunocompromise.

terms.name: Recent steroid exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treated with corticosteroid medications in recent weeks.

terms.name: Shark teeth
terms.definition: Eruption of permanent teeth behind deciduous (baby) teeth before they have fallen out, resulting in a double row of teeth. This phenomen is typically observed between the ages of 5 to 7 years.

terms.name: Pontine T2 hypointensity
terms.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the pons.

terms.name: Anti-platelet antigen antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗血小板抗原抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against antigens present on the surface of thrombocytes such as the glycoproteins GPIIb/IIIa, GPIb/IX, and GPIa/IIa.

terms.name: Anti-voltage-gated potassium channel antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗电压门控钾通道抗体阳性
synonyms: Voltage gated potassium channel antibodies in blood
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a voltage-gated potassium channel.

terms.name: Vegan diet
terms.definition: A history of following a vegan diet characterized by avoidance of food sourced from animals including meat, fish, and dairy products.

terms.name: History of previous pregnancy with hydrops fetalis
synonyms: History of hydrops fetalis in newborn offspring
terms.definition: One or more previous pregnancies in which the fetus developed hydrops fetalis.

terms.name: Ameliorated by potassium supplements
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingesting a potassium supplement.

terms.name: Ameliorated by niacin
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingesting niacin (vitamin B3).

terms.name: Aggravated by exposure to medication
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with a medication.

terms.name: Bleeding ameliorated by vitamin K
synonyms: Vitamin K treatment reduces bleeding significantly
terms.definition: Applies to bleeding that is significantly reduced by treatment with vitamin K.

terms.name: Anti-retroviral therapy exposure
terms.name_zh: 抗逆转录病毒治疗暴露
terms.definition: History of having been treated with an antiretroviral agent.

terms.name: Potassium-wasting diuretic exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treated with a potassium-wasting diuretic such as thiazide (chlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, hydrochlorothiazide, indapamide, metolazone) and loop (bumetanide, ethacrynic acid, furosemide, torsemide) diuretics.

terms.name: Tricyclic antidepressant exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treated with a tricyclic antidepressant medication.

terms.name: Excessive dental attrition
synonyms: Excessive wear and tear on teeth
terms.definition: A higher than expected amount of attrition of teeth, as menifested by loss of tooth characteristics including rounding or sharpening of incisal edges, loss of cusps, and fracturing of teeth, to an extent that is deemed more than would be expected at a given age.

terms.name: Positionally dependent pain
terms.definition: Pain improves or worsens with changes in body position.

terms.name: Abnormal erythrocyte adenosine triphosphate concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞三磷酸腺苷浓度异常
terms.definition: Concentration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in red blood cells (erythrocytes) outside of the normal range.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte adenosine triphosphate concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in red blood cells (erythrocytes) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated erythrocyte adenosine triphosphate concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞三磷酸腺苷浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in red blood cells (erythrocytes) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Spermatogonial maturation arrest
terms.definition: A type of spermatogenesis maturation arrest in which the block of developmental occurs in the spermatogonial stage. Testicular histology shows seminiferous tubules with Sertoli cells and spermatogonial cells but no further differentiated cells like spermatocytes or round spermatids.

terms.name: Elevated circulating neuron-specific enolase concentration
terms.name_zh: 血神经元特异性烯醇化酶浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of neuron-specific enolase above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte alpha-mannosidase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of an alpha-mannosidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating alpha-mannosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环α-甘露糖苷酶活性升高
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced leukocyte cathepsin D activity
