terms.definition: A history of high intake of spciy foods with ingrediaents such as capsaicin, pepper, chili, ginger, garlic, onion, fenugreek, and turmeric.

terms.name: Oil-drop brown pigmentation of the corneal limbus
terms.definition: Brown pigment spots in the limbus (border between the cornea and the sclera).

terms.name: Hazardous alcohol use
terms.definition: Hazardous drinking is defined as a quantity or pattern of alcohol consumption that places individuals at risk for adverse health events. This could include alcohol use despite potentially hazardous or risky consequences, such as operating heavy machinery or drunk driving.

terms.name: Social anxiety
terms.definition: Excessive fear of embarrassment, humiliation, or rejection when exposed to possible negative evaluation by others when engaged in a public performance or social interaction.

terms.name: Placidity
terms.definition: Flat affect and reduced response to emotional stimuli. Fear and anger responses that are normally present are blunted.

terms.name: Phaeohyphomycosis
terms.definition: Phaeohyphomycosis refers to infections due to a large group of heterogenous organisms called dematiaceous or melanized fungi. These fungi are distinguished by the predominance of melanin in their cell walls, which likely acts as a virulence factor. Virtually, everyone is exposed to dematiaceous fungi through inhalation, as they are ubiquitous in the environment, although the development of infection is extremely uncommon.

terms.name: Autophony
terms.definition: Hearing one's own voice resonating loudly in the ear.

terms.name: High altitude exposure
terms.definition: A history of being at high altitude in situations such hiking, mountain climbing, travel to mountains, or air travel.

terms.name: History of recent hospitalization
terms.definition: A past medical history of recently being hospitalized.

terms.name: Palpitations terminated by Valsava maneuver
terms.definition: Cessation of palpitations can be induced by Valsava maneuver.

terms.name: Long telomere length
terms.definition: Abnormally long telomeres in somatic cells.

terms.name: Reduced circulating aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase activity
terms.definition: The activity of aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (also known as DOPA decarboxylase, tryptophan decarboxylase, and 5-hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Subclavian artery stenosis
terms.definition: Abnormal narrowing of the subclavian artery.

terms.name: Pulsatile liver
terms.definition: Cardiac synchronous pulsation on palpation.

terms.name: Neuropathic pain
terms.definition: Neuropathic pain is triggered by lesions to the somatosensory nervous system that alter its structure and function so that pain occurs spontaneously and responses to noxious and innocuous stimuli are pathologically amplified.

terms.name: Repeated cold water exposure
terms.definition: A history of repeated exposure to cold water, as may result, for instance, from surfing, diving, kayaking, or swimming.

terms.name: Tinnitus exacerbated by swallowing
terms.definition: Tinnitus (sound heard by a subjhect when no corresponding external sound is present) that is made worse by swallowing.

terms.name: Rhythmic movements of the tympanic membrane
terms.definition: Regularly occurring motion of the tympanic membrane (eardrum), which is located between the inner and middle ear. This can be a manifestation of tensor tympani myoclonus, which can also be ascertained as sawtooth patterns on long-term tympanometry.

terms.name: Elongated temporal styloid process
terms.definition: The length of the temporal styloid process is above the upper limit of normal. The styloid process is a cylindrical, slender, needle-like projection of varying lengths averaging 2 to 3 cm. The styloid process projects from the inferior part of the petrous temporal bone and offers attachment to the stylohyoid ligament and the stylohyoid, stylopharyngeus, and styloglossus muscles.

terms.name: Ameliorated by nitroglycerin
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with nitroglycerin.

terms.name: Pulsus paradoxus
terms.definition: Pulsus paradoxus refers to a systolic pressure drop greater than 10mmHg during inspiration.

terms.name: Chest pain triggered by palpation
terms.definition: Chest pain can be induced by palpation of the chest, which may be an indication of costochondritis.

terms.name: Chest pain described as pressure
terms.definition: Discomfort in the chest described as pressure, heaviness, or tightness.

terms.name: Chest pain described as ripping or tearing
terms.definition: Chest pain described as a tearing or ripping sensation.

terms.name: Ameliorated by flexion
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by bending (flexing) a joint.

terms.name: Located on the chest
terms.definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring around the thorax (chest).

terms.name: Localized to the penis
terms.definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring in or on the penis.

terms.name: Snowstorm pattern of uterus on ultrasound
terms.definition: A sonographic snowstorm pattern of the uterus that results from the presence of a complex vesicular intrauterine mass containing many grape-like cysts.

terms.name: Multiparity
terms.definition: History of multiple previous births.

terms.name: Exposure to aquatic animals
terms.definition: History of exposure to aquatic animals.

terms.name: Superficial blush-like subcutaneous fatty lesions
terms.definition: Multiple, oblong, fatty lesions in the superficial subcutaneous fatty tissue. They are mostly under 2 cm in long axis diameter. They demonstrate nodular (blush-like) increased fluid signal at unenhanced MRI and are markedly hyperechoic at ultrasound.

terms.name: Dermal multinucleated giant cells
terms.definition: Presence of giant cells in the dermis. Giant cells are formed by fusion of various cells such as macrophage, epithelioid cells, monocytes, etc., These are multi-nucleated, large in size, and generally present at the site of chronic inflammation and other granulomatous conditions.

terms.name: Exacerbation of eyelid lesion by crying
terms.definition: Applies to an eyelid lesion such as hemangiomas or varices that swells upon crying.

terms.name: Localized to upper eyelid
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the upper eyelid.

terms.name: Aerophagia
terms.definition: Repetitive air swallowing and belching and that may result in abdominal distention.

terms.name: Vaginal passage of hydatidiform mole tissue
synonyms: Solid tissue passed by the vagina
terms.definition: Passage from the vagina of hyatidiform tissue, appearing as clusters of vesicles (similar to small grapes) developed from the transformation of chorionic villi. This is a manifestation of a molar pregnancy (hyatidiform mole).

terms.name: Abnormal nipple discharge
terms.definition: Abnormal fluid that seeps out of the nipple of the breast. Nipple discharge is categozied as lactational, physiologic, or pathologic.

terms.name: Hepatolithiasis
terms.definition: The presence of gallstones within the intrahepatic bile ducts proximal to the right and left hepatic ducts.

terms.name: Excessive eructation
terms.definition: Abnormally frequent belching (expelling gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth).

terms.name: Esophageal fibrosis
terms.definition: Fibrosis located in the subepithelial portion of the esophagus. Fibrosisis is defined by the overgrowth, hardening, and/or scarring of various tissues and is attributed to excess deposition of extracellular matrix components including collagen.

terms.name: Triggered by extension of leg
terms.definition: This term refers to pain that is triggered by extending (straightening) the leg.

terms.name: Increased myocardial pyrophosphate uptake
terms.name_zh: 心肌焦磷酸盐摄取增加
terms.definition: Amount of pyrophosphate uptake by the myocardium as demonstrated by by technetium pyrophosphate (99mTc-PYP) scintigraphy above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Ameliorated by nerve block
terms.definition: Refers to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by anesthetic block of a nerve.

terms.name: Brief tear break-up time
terms.definition: Tear film break up time (number of seconds that elapse between the last blink and the appearance of the first dry spot in the tear film) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Cutaneous granuloma
terms.definition: A granuloma localized to the skin, that is, a chronic inflammatory manifestation with localized aggregation of histiocytes with or without other inflammatory cells (such as plasma cells, eosinophils, or neutrophils), with or without necrosis, with or without vasculitis, with or without calcification, and with or without foreign bodies. Granulomas may be due to infection or chronic inflammatory disease or reactions to foreign material.

terms.name: Heterotopic dermal ossification
terms.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the dermis (i.e., the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer).

terms.name: Thinning of outer muscular layer of small bowel
terms.definition: The depth of the outer muscular layer of the small bowel is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Renal lymphangiectasia
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly of renal lymphatics that results from a failure of the lymphatics to make communication with the rest of the lymph trunks. The abnormal lymphatics thus dilate and form cystic spaces at the renal sinus and in the perinephric space.

terms.name: Pharyngeal myxoma
terms.definition: A myxoma (benign, locally infiltrative neoplasms arising from mesenchymal origin) localized to the pharynx.

terms.name: Subcutaneous arteriolar thrombosis
terms.definition: Fibrin thrombi inside subcutaneous arterioles.

terms.name: Renal vasculitis
terms.definition: Vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) in the kidney. Renal vasculitis can be observed with numerous disorders and presents clinically as rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis (RPGN) which is characterized by acute kidney injury (AKI), haematuria and proteinuria. Histological examination of the kidney reveals severe inflammation in the form of crescent formation, glomerular necrosis and vasculitis of small and medium sized vessels within the kidney.

terms.name: Pancreatic islet beta cell iron deposition
terms.definition: Accumulation of abnormally high amounts of iron in beta cells of the pancreas.

terms.name: Nasal hamartoma
terms.definition: A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the nose.

terms.name: Metachromatic intraneuronal lipid deposits
terms.name_zh: 神经元内异染性脂质沉积
terms.definition: A type of metachromasia localized to a peripheral nerve. Metachromasia may be defined as the staining of tissue or tissue components such that the color of the tissue-bound dye complex differs significantly from the color of the original dye complex to give a marked contrast in color. For instance in metachromatic leukodystrophy, bloated Schwann cells, containing granularmetachromatic storage material May display a characteristic yellow green dichroism under crossed polarised light.

terms.name: Reduced phosphoserine phosphatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of phosphoserine phosphatase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
synonyms: Alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase low in fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic beta-ureidopropionase activity
terms.definition: Activity of beta-ureidopropionase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic dihydropyrimidinase activity
terms.definition: Activity of dihydropyrimidinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Sunken fontanelle
terms.definition: Fontanelle that is more deeply set than normal. Fontanelles are normally relatively firm and curve only slightly inward. A sunken fontanelle can be a sign of dehydration or marasmus.

terms.name: Angulation of penis
terms.definition: Formation of an angle (tilt) along the shaft of the penis.

terms.name: History of urethral procedure or catheterization
terms.definition: A past medical history of a procedure or catheterization involving the urethra.

terms.name: Penile swelling
terms.definition: Abormal enlargement of the penis owing to accumulation of fluid.

terms.name: Reduced muscle alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Brown tumor
terms.definition: A brown tumor is a bone lesion that results from bony resorption by excess osteoclastic activity, and replacement by fibrous tissue and giant cells. Brown tumor is an uncommon pathognomonic sign of hyperparathyroidism.

terms.name: Dermal flame figures
terms.definition: Flame-figures are composed of a central part consisting of collagen fibers and eosinophilic granules, surrounded by a histiocytic and eosinophilic infiltrate. Subsequently, eosinophils tend to disappear and are replaced by phagocytic granulomas, consisting of histiocytes and sometimes giant cells, around the flame figures.

terms.name: Postpartum exacerbation
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is present during pregnancy and becomes worse following birth.

terms.name: Retinoid exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken retinoids.

terms.name: Propylthiouracil exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treated with propylthiouracil.

terms.name: History of outdoor activities
terms.definition: History of spending a substantial amount of time outdoors with occupation or hobbies related to the outdoors, including hunting, gardening, farming, agriculture, horticulture, miners, working in wet fields.

terms.name: Draining sinus tract in skin
synonyms: Tract under skin draining associated abscess
terms.definition: A sinus tract is an abnormal channel that originates from the skin or a mucous surface to a deep-seated focus of suppuration.

terms.name: Corneal transplant history
terms.definition: Past medical history of surgical replacement of the cornea with corneal tissue from a donor.

terms.name: Spontaneous lens capsule rupture
terms.definition: Breakage of the capsule of the lens. This is most often observed as a complication of lens surgery, but this term refers to lens capsule rupture not related to surgery or major trauma.

terms.name: Contact lens wearer
terms.definition: A past medical history of wearing contact lenses.

terms.name: Airway mucosal thickening
terms.definition: Increase in thickness of the mucosa of the airways above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Hyperpolarized transepithelial nasal potential difference
terms.name_zh: 超极化跨上皮鼻电位差
terms.definition: Increased (more negative) voltage across the nasal epithelium.

terms.name: Corneopalpebral synechiae
terms.definition: An adhesion between the conjunctiva of the eyelid and the cornea.

terms.name: Breast intraductal papilloma
terms.definition: Intraductal papilloma is a benign tumor found within breast ducts. The abnormal proliferation of ductal epithelial cells causes growth. A solitary intraductal papilloma is usually found centrally posterior to the nipple affecting the central duct. Multiple intraductal papillomas are located peripherally, found in any breast quadrant affecting the peripheral ducts.

terms.name: Precipitous labor
terms.definition: Precipitous labor is extremely rapid labor and delivery, usually defined as expulsion of the fetus within less than 3 hours of commencement of regular contractions.

terms.name: Twin pregnancy
terms.definition: Maternal history of a pregnancy with two fetuses in the uterus.

terms.name: Vaginal mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the vagina. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Costovertebral angle tenderness
terms.definition: Pain that is elicited by palpation of the region inside of the costovertebral angle, which is formed by the 12th rib and the spine.

terms.name: Cervical motion tenderness
terms.definition: Pain that is elicited by moving the uterine cervix. This finding can be ascertained by pelvic exam. Cervical motion tenderness is a gynecological exam finding that could be indicative of peritoneal infection.

terms.name: Abnormal urethral discharge
terms.definition: Fluid that originates from the urethra that is not urine, pre-ejaculate or semen.

terms.name: Supernumerary finger flexion crease
terms.definition: The presence of an extra digital crease in and individual with normal joint anatomy.

terms.name: Large joint predominance
terms.definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that mainly affect large joints.

terms.name: Monoarticular
terms.definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that affects a single joint.

terms.name: Hockey-stick palmar crease
terms.definition: An abnormality of the upper palmar crease whereby the crease widens and ends between the second and third fingers and is said to resemble a hockey stick.

terms.name: Elevated urinary succinyladenosine level
terms.name_zh: 尿琥珀酰腺苷水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of succinyladenosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxymethyluracil level
terms.name_zh: 尿5-羟甲基尿嘧啶水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urine creatinine level
terms.definition: The amount of creatinine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary deoxyuridine level
terms.definition: The amount of deoxyuridine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary dihydrouracil level
terms.name_zh: 尿二氢尿嘧啶水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of dihydrouracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary dihydrothymine level
terms.name_zh: 尿二氢胸腺嘧啶水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of dihydrothymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary sulfatide level
terms.definition: The amount of sulfatides in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Sulfatides are derived from GalCer via esterification of a sulfate group to 3-hydroxyl of the galactose moiety.

terms.name: Elevated urinary xanthurenic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of xanthurenic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urinary N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharide level
terms.name_zh: 尿N-乙酰葡糖胺富集寡糖水平升高
terms.definition: Presence of N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharides in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2'-deoxyadenosine level
terms.definition: The amount of 2'-deoxyadenosine (dAdo) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test
terms.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of the 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test, which indicates the presence of alpha-ketoacids in the urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary dolichol level
terms.definition: The amount of dolichol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary bile acid level
terms.definition: The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary creatine/creatinine ratio
terms.definition: The ratio of creatine to creatinine concentration in the urine is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary thymidine level
terms.definition: The amount of thymidine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary glutarylglycine level
terms.name_zh: 尿戊二酰甘氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of glutarylglycine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary indican level
terms.definition: Detection of indican in the urine. Urinary indican concentration may be elevated in small bowel bacterial overgrowth. Indican is produced by bacterial deconjugation of dietary tryptophan to indole which is absorbed at all levels of the intestine, but principally from the small bowel.

terms.name: Dacrolith
terms.definition: Dacryolith is a concretion (accumulation of sediment) within the nasolacrimal system.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase activity
synonyms: Gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase low in erythrocytes
terms.definition: Activity of gamma-glutamylcysteine synthetase (EC 6.3.2.2) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased erythrocyte nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide-cytochrome b5 reductase activity
terms.name_zh: 红细胞烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸-细胞色素b5还原酶活性降低
terms.definition: The activity of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH)-cytochrome b5 reductase in erythrocytes (red blood cells) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase (AMACR; EC 5.1.99.4) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Low semen volume
terms.definition: Volume of semen in ejaculate below the lower limit of normal. This finding can be ascertained by semen analysis. Comment: Sperm are produced within the testis, in the process of spermatogenesis, then travel through the male reproductive tract (the seminiferous tubules, epididymis, vas deferens, prostate and urethra). As the sperm travel, seminal fluid is added from the seminal vesicles, prostate, testis and epididymis and periurethral glands. The function of the ejaculate is to transport sperm into the female genital tract and to provide a suitable environment for sperm survival during this transit.

terms.name: Elbow localization
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the elbow.

terms.name: Enlarged lunula
terms.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the visible portion of the distal nail matrix that extends beyond the proximal nail fold, which is referred to as the lunula.

terms.name: Heel localization
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the heel.

terms.name: Splinter hemorrhages
terms.definition: Thin, red to reddish-brown lines of blood (hemorrhages) under the nails. Splinter hemorrhages run vertically under the nails.

terms.name: Lateral thrust
terms.definition: Lateral thrust (LT) refers to an abnormal knee joint motion in the early stance phase where the knee joint center moves laterally. Also known as varus thrust, LR is defined as the dynamic worsening or abrupt onset of varus (bow-leg) alignment as the limb accepts weight (stance phase), with a return to less varus and more neutral alignment during lift-off and the non-weight-bearing (swing) phase of gait, varus thrust is a potent mechanical risk factor for medial knee osteoarthritis progression.

terms.name: Cerebral contusion
terms.definition: A contusion is a region of injured tissue in which blood capillaries have been ruptured without laceration (bruise). Brain contusions are bruises of the cortical surface that damage the surface from the outside inward, producing disruption of tissue and vessels. The term cerebral contusion describes the pathology of focal necrosis and hemorrhage, typically observed in older children, involving particularly cerebral cortex and subcortical white matter. Such lesions are usually found in coup and contrecoup, as well as inferior orbital, frontal, and temporal locations. Cerebral contusions cause permanent damage to tissues of the cerebrum. The etiology of cerebral contusion is trauma to the head.

terms.name: Fecolith
terms.definition: A mass of accumulated hardened fecal matter.

terms.name: Appendicitis
terms.definition: Appendicitis is an inflammation of the vermiform appendix, which is a hollow organ located at the tip of the cecum, usually in the right lower quadrant of the abdomen.

terms.name: Left ventricular aneurysm
terms.definition: A severely scarred portion of infarcted ventricular myocardium that does not contract normally but instead bulges outward while the rest of the ventricle contracts during systole.

terms.name: Boot-shaped cardiac silhouette
terms.definition: An abnormal form of the heart seen upon chest radiography in which the heart displays an upturned apex and slight concave pulmonary artery segment. This configuration is said to resemble a boot.

terms.name: Hydrosalpinx
terms.definition: Hydrosalpinx is a distension or dilatation of the fallopian tube in the presence of a distal tubal occlusion.

terms.name: Elevated methylhex-dienedioic level by MRS
terms.name_zh: 磁共振波谱示甲基己二烯二酸水平升高
terms.definition: An increase in the level of 3-methylhex-2,4-dienedioic acid or 3-methylhex-3,4-dienedioic acid in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Perihepatic enhancement
terms.definition: Increased signal (contrast enhancement) surrounding the liver observed on computer tomography or magnetic resonance imaging following administration of contrast agents.

terms.name: Reduced in vitro contracture test threshold
synonyms: Caffeine in vitro contracture test positive
Halothane in vitro contracture test positive
terms.definition: The in vitro contracture test determines the sensitivity of freshly obtained skeletal muscle specimens to caffeine or halothane applied to a bathing solution. Muscles from persons susceptible to malignant hyperthermia have lower contracture thresholds for these agents than do normal muscle.

terms.name: Reduced F-wave amplitude
terms.definition: Reduced strength (amplitude) of the F-wave, which is an electrophysiological artifact produced by antidromic activation of motoneurons following distal electrical stimulation of motor nerve fibers.

terms.name: Enlarged peroxisomes
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of peroxisomes.

terms.name: Adrenocortical hyperplasia
terms.definition: A non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands, specifically the cortex, although the cortex cannot be definitively identified by conventional imaging. Adrenal cortical hyperplasia is defined radiologically as a non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands.

terms.name: Lymphocytic infiltration of the parotid gland
terms.definition: Accumulation of lymphocytes in the parotid gland. This feature is generally defined as a count of lymphocytes per area that is above normal limits on histopathological examination.

terms.name: Bone marrow granuloma
terms.definition: A granuloma (a focal aggregate of immune cells that forms in response to a persistent inflammatory stimulus) localiyed to the bone marrow. A granuloma characteristically demonstrates the compact organization of mature macrophages, which may or may not be associated with other inflammatory cell types.

terms.name: Neuronal intranuclear inclusion bodies
terms.definition: The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neurons.

terms.name: Pancreatic atrophy
terms.definition: Wasting (shrinking) of the pancreas.

terms.name: Decreased pancreatic acinar cell density
terms.name_zh: 胰腺腺泡细胞密度降低
terms.definition: Number (count) of pancreatic acinar cells reduced below normal. This feature can be ascertained by pancreas biopsy.

terms.name: Unesterified cholesterol accumulation in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: An abnormal result of the filipin test. This test is based on the reaction of unesterified cholesterol with fluorescent antibiotic filipin giving a strongly fluorescent, stable cholesterol-filipin complex suitable for in situ detection. An abnormal test result is present if there is a perinuclear accumulation of staining in lysosomal storage organelles (LSOs).

terms.name: Splenic lipid-laden macrophage infiltration
terms.definition: Accumulation of foamy cells (lipid-laden macrophages) in the parenchyma of the spleen.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic N-acetylglutamate synthase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of N-acetylglutamate synthase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Excessive licorice consumption
terms.definition: Ingestion of large amounts of licorice.

terms.name: Shoulder localization
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the shoulder.

terms.name: Pregnancy conceived despite intrauterine device
terms.definition: Intrauterine devices (IUDs) are used for contraception. Rarely pregnancy occurs despite the presence of an IUD. Such pregnancies are associated with an increased risk of spontaneous abortion and preterm delivery due to infection, and a higher risk of maternal septic complications.

terms.name: Maternal folate deficiency
terms.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of folate deficiency during the corresponding pregnancy.

terms.name: Maternal zinc deficiency
terms.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of abnormally low zinc levels during the corresponding pregnancy.

terms.name: Use of intrauterine device
terms.definition: Intrauterine devices (IUD) are commonly used for contraception. IUD complications are rare, but include perforation, pelvic infection, expulsion, missing strings, and difficult IUD removal.

terms.name: History of recent central venous catheter
terms.name_zh: 近期中心静脉导管置管史
terms.definition: A past medical history of a recent central venous catheter (CVC). A CVC is an indwelling device inserted into a large, central vein (most commonly the internal jugular, subclavian, or femoral) and advanced until the terminal lumen resides within the inferior vena cava, superior vena cava, or right atrium. CVCs can be a necessary producre for critically ill patients with indications such as total parenteral nutrition administration, dialysis, plasmapheresis, medication administration, and hemodynamic monitoring, and to facilitate further complex interventions such as transvenous pacemaker placement. Complications include arrhythmia, central vein stenosis, and sepsis.

terms.name: History of total parenteral nutrition dependence
terms.definition: A past medical history of a recent depence on total parenteral nutrition (TPN), which refers to intravenously administered nutrition being the only source of nutrition the patient is receiving.

terms.name: Pain alleviated by testicle elevation
terms.definition: This refers to testicular pain that is lessened or made more bearable by elevation of the testicle.

terms.name: Abdominal wall mass
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the abdominal wall (the skin, fascia, and muscle encases the abdominal cavity and viscera). The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Tympanic membrane bulging
terms.definition: The tympanic membrane protrudes (swells outwards). This feature may be observed with otoscopy.

terms.name: Ear pain exacerbated by manipulating tragus or pinna
terms.name_zh: 牵拉耳屏/耳廓加重耳痛
terms.definition: Applies to pain of the ear that is worsened, aggravated, or exacerbated by touching or moving the tragus or pinna.

terms.name: Lateral neck mass
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the side of the neck. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Occipital location
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the occiput (back part of the head).

terms.name: Anterior neck swelling
terms.definition: Abormal enlargement of the front part of the neck owing to accumulation of fluid.

terms.name: Uvular swelling
terms.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the uvula related to an abnormal accumulation of fluid.

terms.name: History of gastric bypass surgery
terms.definition: History of having received gastric bypass surgery. This is a procedure that reduces the functional volume of the stomach and is used to treat morbid obesity.

terms.name: Triggered by volatile organic compounds
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to volatile organic compounds (VOCs), which comprise various organic chemicals which are released as gases from different liquids or solids.

terms.name: History of radiation therapy
terms.definition: A medical history of having undergone radiation therapy, which is a treatment that uses ionizing radiation for purposes such as the control the growth of malignant cells in cancer treatment.

terms.name: Absent otoacoustic emissions
terms.definition: Failure to record otoacoustic emissions (OAE), i.e., sounds generated from the cochlea in response to an acoustic stimulus and transmitted across the middle ear to the external ear canal.

terms.name: Thickened tympanic membrane
terms.definition: The tympanic membrane (eardrum, myringa) is a thin, semitransparent, oval membrane, approximately 1 cm in diameter, that separates the external acoustic meatus from the tympanic cavity. Thickening refers to an increase of the dimension across the membrane.

terms.name: Filum terminale lipoma
terms.definition: Filum terminale lipomas (FTLs) are a type of lumbosacral lipoma in which the fat is entirely within the filum terminale and separate from the conus medullaris.

terms.name: Low tetrahydrocortisol (THF) plus 5-alpha-THF/tetrahydrocortisone (THE) ratio
terms.name_zh: 四氢皮质醇(THF)加5α-THF/四氢可的松(THE)比值降低
terms.definition: The relative concentration of tetrahydrocortisol plus 5-alpha-tetrahydrocortisol relative to that of tetrahydrocortisone is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-soluble liver antigen/liver pancreas antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗可溶性肝抗原/肝胰抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against soluble liver antigen.

terms.name: Anti-thrombospondin type I domain-containing 7A antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗含I型血小板反应蛋白结构域7A抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against thrombospondin type I domain-containing 7A.

terms.name: Antisperm antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against sperm antigens.

terms.name: Decreased circulating ficolin-3 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环纤维胶凝蛋白3浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of ficolin-3 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal seminal vesicle morphology
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the seminal vesicle. The seminal vesicles are a pair of glands that also include the prostate gland and the bulbourethral glands and are located in the pelvis superior to the rectum, inferior to the fundus of the bladder and posterior to the prostate. The seminal vesicles contribute around 70% of the fluid that will eventually become semen.

terms.name: Seminal vesicle cyst
terms.definition: A cyst (sac-like mass that may contain serous liquid or semisolid material) caused by distention of the seminal vesicle due to atresia of the ejaculatory duct.

terms.name: Silica dust exposure
terms.definition: History of exposure to respirable crystalline silica (SiO2).

terms.name: Anti-osteoprotegerin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against osteoprotegerin.

terms.name: History of adrenalectomy
terms.definition: A past medical history of having had a surgical procedure to remove the adrenal glands.

terms.name: Elevated mitochondrial citrate synthase activity
terms.name_zh: 线粒体柠檬酸合酶活性升高
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme mitochondrial citrate synthase (EC:2.3.3.1) in muscle tissue is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced muscle lactate dehydrogenase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme lactate dehdrogenase (LHD; 1.1.1.27) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. LDH catalyzes the conversion of pyruvate to lactate and back, as it converts NAD+ to NADH and back.

terms.name: Reduced muscle phosphoglycerate mutase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme Phosphoglycerate mutase (PGM) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. PGM is an enzyme that catalyzes step 8 of glycolysis (EC 5.4.2.11).

terms.name: Reduced muscle phosphorylase kinase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme muscle phosphorylase kinase (PhK) in muscle tissue below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced 3-beta-hydroxysteroid-delta-5-desaturase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of 3-beta-hydroxysteroid-delta-5-desaturase, also known as Sterol C5-desaturase (EC 1.3.3.2), or SC5D below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic glucose-6-phosphatase activity
terms.definition: Activity of glucose-6-phosphatase (EC 3.1.3.9) in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic glucose-6-phosphate translocase activity
terms.definition: Activity of glucose-6-phosphate translocase in liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Cerebrospinal fluid erythrocytes
terms.definition: The presence of red blood cells (RBCs) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). The CSF normally does not contain RBCs (erythrocytes).

terms.name: Elevated CSF cholestanol concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液胆甾烷醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of cholestanol in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal. Cholestanol is the 5-alpha-dihydro derivative of cholesterol.

terms.name: Elevated CSF apolipoprotein B concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液载脂蛋白B浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein B in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF myelin basic protein concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液髓鞘碱性蛋白浓度升高
synonyms: Myelin basic protein high in CSF
terms.definition: The concentration of myelin basic protein in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced CSF pyridoxal-5'-phosphate concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of pyridoxal-5'-phosphate in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF thymine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液胸腺嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of thymine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF 5-hydroxymethyluracil concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液5-羟甲基尿嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液N-氨甲酰-β-氨基异丁酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF N-carbamyl-beta-alanine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液N-氨甲酰-β-丙氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of N-carbamyl-beta-alanine in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF dihydrouracil concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液二氢尿嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of dihydrouracil in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF dihydrothymine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液二氢胸腺嘧啶浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of dihydrothymine in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating angiotensin-converting enzyme concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环血管紧张素转换酶浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme level in blood
Increased angiotensin-converting enzyme level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of angiotensin-converting enzyme in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased 3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase activity
terms.name_zh: 3-羟基异丁酸脱氢酶活性降低
terms.definition: The activity of 3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating 3-hydroxyisobutyryl-CoA hydrolase activity
terms.definition: The activity of 3-hydroxyisobutyryl-CoA hydrolase in the blood corculation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced HMG-CoA lyase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A lyase (HMG CoA lyase) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced circulating acyl-CoA oxidase activity
terms.definition: The activity of acyl-CoA oxidase activity in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating xanthine oxidase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme xanthine oxidase (EC 1.17.3.2) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced methylmalonate semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: The activity of methylmalonate semialdehyde dehydrogenase ( EC 1.2.1.27) in cultured fibroblasts is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Pharyngeal mass
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the pharynx (i.e., the throat, the space that connects the nose and mouth to the larynx and esophagus). The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Positive stool occult blood test
terms.definition: The presence of hidden (occult) blood in the stool.

terms.name: Painful defecation
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort that occurs when passing stool.

terms.name: Recent history of caustic substance ingestion
terms.definition: Medical history of a recent ingestion of a caustic substance, i.e., a highly acidic or alkaline chemicals that can cause severe burns to the mouth and digestive tract when swallowed.

terms.name: Delayed passage of meconium
terms.definition: Failure to pass meconium (the first stool following birth) in the first 48 hours of life.

terms.name: Single second heart sound
terms.definition: The second sound can remain single throughout the respiratory cycle due to either absence of one component or to synchronous occurrence of the two components. Since the pulmonary vascular impedance increases with age, many normal patients over age 50 have a single S2 or at most a narrow physiologic split on inspiration because P2 occurs early. A single second sound, however, is usually due to inability to auscultate a relatively soft pulmonic component. Such inability is rare in healthy infants, children, and young adults and is uncommon even in older persons under good auscultatory conditions using a rigid stethoscopic diaphragm.

terms.name: Elevated aortic transvalvular pressure gradient
terms.definition: The gradient (in this case, drop) in pressure across the aortic valve is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Prosthetic heart valve
terms.definition: A past surgical history of the implanation of an artificial heart valve.

terms.name: Failure to increase oxygen saturation on hyperoxia test
terms.name_zh: 高氧试验氧饱和度升高障碍
terms.definition: Hyperoxia test is the initial method to distinguish critical congenital heart disease (CCHD) from pulmonary disease. The test consists in measuring an arterial blood gas at room air and 100% inspired oxygen after 10 minutes. Neonates with congenital heart disease are usually not able to increase PaO2 above 100 mm Hg during 100% oxygen administration. In patients with pulmonary disease, PaO2 generally increased greater than or equal to 100 mm Hg with 100% oxygen as ventilation-perfusion discrepancies are overcome. A positive result indicates the cardiac origin and further cardiac workup is indicated to rule out CCHD.

terms.name: High-set nipples
terms.definition: Placement of the nipples at a higher than normal location.

terms.name: Decreased muscle caveolin-3 level
terms.name_zh: 肌肉小窝蛋白-3水平降低
terms.definition: The amount of calveolin-3 in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal tissue enzyme concentration or activity
terms.name_zh: 组织酶浓度或活性异常
terms.definition: Concentration of an enyzme in a tissue is above or between the limit of normal. This term is intended to be used for enzymes that can be measured in multiple tissues other than blood.

terms.name: Splenic necrosis
terms.definition: Cell dealth (necrosis) located in the spleen.

terms.name: Carcinoid tumor of the pancreas
terms.definition: A carcinoid tumor of the pancreas (CTP) is a rare neuroendocrine tumor arising from the serotonin-secreting cells (enterochromaffin or Kultscitsky's cells).

terms.name: Elevated circulating dihydroxyphenylacetic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环二羟苯乙酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of dihydroxyphenylacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Inappropriately low concentration of acetoacetate
terms.name_zh: 乙酰乙酸浓度不当降低
terms.definition: Lower than appropriate concentration of acetoacetate in states such as hypoglycemia in which the normal response would be to elevate acetoacetate.

terms.name: Inappropriately low concentration of beta-hydroxybutyrate
terms.definition: Lower than appropriate concentration of beta-hydroxybutyrate in states such as hypoglycemia in which the normal response would be to elevate acetoacetate.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxybutyryl-carnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环3-羟基丁酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxybutyryl-carnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxyamide concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液5-氨基-4-咪唑甲酰胺浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxyamide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating tumor necrosis factor alpha concentration
terms.name_zh: 血肿瘤坏死因子α浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of tumor necrosis factor alpha in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating pyrimidine 5-prime-nucleotidase activity
terms.definition: The activity of concentration of pyrimidine 5-prime-nucleotidase (EC 3.1.3.5) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Diminished prolactin response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation
terms.name_zh: 促甲状腺激素释放激素刺激下催乳素反应减弱
terms.definition: The increase in prolactin concentration (PRL) following stimulation with thyrotropin (thyrdoid releasing hormone) as compared to baseline PRL concentration is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating complement component 1s concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环补体成分1s浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of complement component 1s (C1s) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating corticosteroid-binding globulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环皮质类固醇结合球蛋白浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased corticosteroid-binding globulin level in blood
Reduced corticosteroid-binding globulin level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of corticosteroid-binding globulin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating thyroglobulin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血甲状腺球蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of thyroglobulin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated circulating granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor concentration
Elevated granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor level in blood
Increased granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液D-2-羟基戊二酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of D-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Esophageal mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the esophagus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Bursa fluid crystals
terms.definition: The presence of crystals (microscopic solids that form distinct lattices, with definable fixed angles, faces, walls) in the bursa fluid.

terms.name: Enlarged gastric folds
terms.definition: Giant gastric folds are recognized at endoscopy as an increase in the size of the gastric rugae and a lack of flattening.

terms.name: Gastric intraepithelial lymphocytosis
terms.name_zh: 胃上皮内淋巴细胞增多
terms.definition: The count of lymphocytes located in the epithelial layer of the gastric mucosa is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Small intestinal intraepithelial lymphocytosis
terms.definition: The count of lymphocytes located in the epithelial layer of the mucosa of the small intestine is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Fetal lung hyperechogenicity
terms.definition: Increased response (echo) of lung tissue of a fetus observed on prenatal sonography. Increased echo response is conventially displayed as a higher degree of brightness.

terms.name: Necrotizing vasculitis
terms.definition: A histopathological finding characterized by inflammation of the arterial and/or capillary and/or venous blood vessels, leading to a change in the vascular wall as a whole.

terms.name: Abnormal proximal convoluted tubule morphology
terms.definition: Any structural anomaly of the proximal convoluted tubule, which is the first tubular component of the nephron and arises as a continuation of the Bowman space from the tubular pole of the renal corpuscle. The proximal convoluted tubule is located within the renal cortex.

terms.name: Demonstration of Leishmania in tissue
terms.name_zh: 组织内利什曼原虫检出
terms.definition: Presence of Leishmania, a parasitic protozoan, in a tissue specimen. Leishmania is responsible for leishmaniasis.

terms.name: Pneumocystis cysts in respiratory secretions
terms.definition: Demonstration of cysts of Pneumocystis (a genus of related fungal species) in respiratory secretions such as nasopharyngeal secretions or pleural fluid.

terms.name: Spinal cord granuloma
terms.definition: An aggregation of macrophages (forming in response to chronic inflammation) localized in or on the spinal cord.

terms.name: Impaired folate absorption
terms.definition: Reduced ability to absorb folate in the diet. This finding can be measured by a folic acid loading test in which blood concentration of folate is measured after oral administration of folic acid.

terms.name: Positive hydrogen breath test
synonyms: Positive glucose or lactulose hydrogen breath test
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated quantiy of hydrogen measured by a hydrogen breath test (HBT). HBTs administer substrates such as glucose, lactulose, lactose and fructose and subsequently measure hydrogen exhaled in the breath using a gas chromatograph.

terms.name: History of recent plant thorn skin puncture
terms.name_zh: 近期植物刺皮肤刺伤史
terms.definition: A history of a plant skin puncture preceding the current presenting condition by hours, days, or weeks.

terms.name: Absent circulating kappa chain-bearing immunoglobulin
terms.name_zh: 循环携带κ链免疫球蛋白缺失
terms.definition: Nondetectable kappa chain in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Pseudoglioma
terms.definition: A circumscribed whitish-yellow mass in the posterior chamber associated with retinal folds and sometimes retinal detachment and is said to resemble a retinal glioma.

terms.name: Papillary dermal edema
terms.definition: Swelling due to fluid acculuation of the papillary dermis.

terms.name: Fetal tachycardia
terms.definition: The number of beats per minute (bpm) of the fetal heart is above the upper limit of the normal for the gestational age. Fetal tachycardia is thus defined as a heart rate greater than 160-180 bpm.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxykynurenine level
terms.name_zh: 尿3-羟基犬尿氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxykynurenine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: 2-oxoadipic aciduria
terms.definition: The amount of 2-oxoadipic acid in the urine, normaliyed for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating methionine sulfoxide concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甲硫氨酸亚砜浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of methionine sulfoxide in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating pipecolic acid concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of pipecolic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary pipecolic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of pipecolic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF saccharopine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液酵母氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of saccharopine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating glycylproline concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环甘氨酰脯氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration in the bloodstream of glycylproline above the upper limit of normal. Glycylproline is a dipeptide composed of glycine and proline, and is an end product of collagen metabolism that is further cleaved by prolidase (EC 3.4.13.9).

terms.name: Elevated circulating octanoylcarnitine concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of octanoylcarnitine (C8:0) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating decanoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环癸酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of decanoylcarnitine (C10:0) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: 2--hydroxyphenylacetic aciduria
terms.definition: Increased concentration of 2-hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the urine.

terms.name: 4-hydroxyphenyllactic aciduria
terms.definition: Amount of 4-hydroxyphenyllactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF beta-alanine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液β-丙氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of beta-alanine present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 2-aminoadipic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环2-氨基己二酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 2-aminoadipic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine level
terms.name_zh: 尿N-氨甲酰基-β-丙氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine present in urine, when adjusted for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF cystathionine concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液胱硫醚浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of cystathionine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary gamma-glutamylphenylalanine level
terms.name_zh: 尿γ-谷氨酰苯丙氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of gamma-glutamylphenylalanine in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating aspartylglucosamine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环天冬氨酰葡糖胺浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary saccharopine level
terms.definition: The amount of saccharopine in the urine, when normalized to urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Tectal plate enlargement
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the tectal plate (also known as the tectum or the quadrigeminal plate). The tectum is the dorsal portion of the midbrain (brainstem).

terms.name: Retroperitoneal mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the retroperitoneal region. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Focal T1 hyperintense brainstem lesion
terms.name_zh: 脑干局灶性T1高信号病变
terms.definition: A lighter than expected T1 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.

terms.name: Subchondral fracture
terms.definition: A type of fracture that occurs in the trabecular cancellous bone just beneath the subchondral bone plate without disruption of the articular surface.

terms.name: Deep neck abscess
terms.definition: An abscess (i.e., a circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris) localized in the area surrounded by the deep fascia of the neck including the pharynx, larynx, trachea, upper esophagus, thyroid, and parathyroid glands. Infections of pharyngeal, tonsillar, and laryngeal origin affect this space, which includes the parapharyngeal and retropharyngeal spaces.

terms.name: Epiglottic enlargement
terms.definition: Anlarged and edematous epiglottis. This sign can be observed on a lateral radiograph of the neck and it suggests a diagnosis of acute infectious epiglottitis.

terms.name: Prevertebral space enlargement
terms.definition: Increase in the anterior posterior dimension of the prevertebral space, which is located in the neck region between the anterior part of the cervical spine and the deep layer of the deep cervical fascia running between the transverse processes of the spine.

terms.name: Third cranial nerve thickening
terms.definition: Increase in diameter of the third cranial nerve (oculomotor nerve). This feature can be observed by magnetic resonance imaging and may be accompanied by contrast enhancement.

terms.name: Elevated tissue sphingomyelin concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of sphoingomyelin in tissues above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: History of recent iodated contrast medium administration
terms.definition: Medical history of recent iodinated or radioiodine contrast use.

terms.name: Difficulty passing nasogastric tube
terms.definition: Difficulty inserting a nasogastric tube (NGT), a flexible plastic tube that is placed through the nose and esophagus into the stomach and used to administer drugs or for feeding. There are certain circumstances that may make NGT insertion difficult. They are esophageal narrowing, comatose or intubated patients, and patients who have sustained severe facial or skull injuries.

terms.name: Persistent falcine venous sinus
terms.definition: A falcine sinus that does not involute but persists beyond birth is defined as a persistent falcine sinus. In the 20-mm embryo stage, the primitive falx cerebri contains the sagittal plexus, a meshwork of anastomotic venous channels from which the superior sagittal sinus and straight sinus are thought to develop. A persistent falcine sinus represents a persistent channel of the caudal anastomotic loops of the sagittal plexus.

terms.name: Penis uncircumcised
terms.definition: A medical history in a male of not having been circumcized.

terms.name: History of facial cosmetic use
terms.definition: A medical history of use of facial makeup.

terms.name: Snapping sensation at metacarpophalangeal joint
terms.definition: A feeling of clicking or snapping at the knuckle (metacarpophalangeal joint) upon extension of flexion of the finger.

terms.name: Forearm pain
terms.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the forearm.

terms.name: Rotational fracture
terms.definition: A type of displaced fracture in which there has been a rotation of the distal fracture fragment in relation to the proximal portion.

terms.name: Localized over bony prominences
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated on the skin in areas where bones are close to the surface (bony prominences).

terms.name: History of compressive footwear
terms.definition: A past medical history of wearing tight shoes, toe-box shoes, or high heel shoes.

terms.name: Decreased skin turgor
terms.definition: Reduced skin turgor means reduced elastic recoil of the skin to its normal contour after being pinched in a fold.

terms.name: Recent foraged mushroom consumption
terms.definition: Medical history of recently eating wild mushrooms.

terms.name: Proximal to distal progression
terms.definition: Refers to symptomatology that begins in the proximal limbs and subsequently affects the distal limbs.

terms.name: Autonomic-voluntary dissociation of facial movements
terms.name_zh: 面部运动自主-随意分离
terms.definition: The selective paralysis of voluntary fascio-pharyngo-glosso-masticatory movements with preservation of reflexive and automatic functions is referred to as autonomic-voluntary dissociation, which is a distinctive feature of Anterior opercular syndrome (also known as Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome).

terms.name: Jaw mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the jaw. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Excessive nocturnal light exposure
terms.definition: Exposure to continuous light at night, including night-shift work or a nocturnal lifestyle.

terms.name: Menstruating female between menarche and menopause
terms.definition: Past medical history of a woman who is menstruating, i.e., not premenstrual or post-menopause.

terms.name: Preterm premature rupture of membranes
terms.definition: PPROM (preterm premature rupture of membranes) occurs at less than 37 weeks of gestation. PPROM can happen spontaneously, during preterm labor, or following a procedure such as amniocentesis.

terms.name: History of abdominal surgery
terms.definition: A past medical history that indicates that the patient had a surgical procedure involving the abdomen.

terms.name: Thickened Descemet membrane
terms.definition: The thickness of the Descement membrane is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Incomplete right bundle branch block
terms.name_zh: 不完全性右束支传导阻滞
terms.definition: Right bundle branch block (RBBB) represents an abnormality in the intraventricular electrical conduction system of the human heart, generating enlarged QRS and modified vectors on the electrocardiogram (ECG). Incomplete RBBB (IRBBB) is defined by (i) QRS duration between 110 and 120 ms in adults; (ii) rsr, rsR, or rSR in leads V1 or V2. The R or r deflection is usually wider than the initial R wave. In a minority of patients, a wide and often notched R wave pattern may be seen in leads V1 and/or V2; (iii) S wave of greater duration than R wave or greater than 40 ms in leads I and V6 in adults; and (iv) Normal R peak time in leads V5 and V6 but greater than 50 ms in lead V1. The first 3 criteria should be present to make the diagnosis. When a pure dominant R wave with or without a notch is present in V1, criterion 4 should be satisfied.

terms.name: Perimenopausal onset
terms.definition: Onset of signs or symptoms of disease during the period of a woman's life shortly before the occurrence of the menopause.

terms.name: Postmenopausal onset
terms.definition: Onset of signs or symptoms of disease during the period of a woman's life after the occurrence of the menopause.

terms.name: Spastic monoplegia
terms.definition: Spastic weakness found in only one upper or lower extremity.

terms.name: Mosaic attenuation pattern in lung
terms.definition: Mosaic attenuation pattern in the lung is a term used to describe regions of differing pulmonary attenuation on CT imaging. It is a non-specific finding, although is associated with several conditions such as obstructive small airway disease, occlusive vascular disease (in which case is called mosaic perfusion pattern), pulmonary edema, and parenchymal diseases.

terms.name: Elevated aldosterone:renin ratio
terms.definition: The ratio of aldosterone concentration to renin concentration is above the upper limit of normal. If aldosterone is expressed in ng/dl and plasma renin activity is expressed as ng/ml/hr, then values above 20 with aldosterone level above 15 are considered indicative of primary aldosteronism.

terms.name: Meteorism
terms.definition: An increase in the gas content inside the bowel associated with distension of the abdomen and hydroaeric noises. The most common symptom of meteorism is a bloated sensation. It may be associated with abdominal discomfort. Some individuals may also complain of a distended stomach and excessive belching and/or passage of flatus.

terms.name: Failure to elevate ammonia on ischemic exercise
terms.name_zh: 缺血运动后氨升高障碍
terms.definition: Normal subjects display an increase in the concentration of ammonia in the blood following an ischemic exercise test. This term refers to an increase in ammonia that is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Labile Hypertension
terms.definition: Frequent fluctuations of blood pressure between normal and high levels, changing more dramatically than normal.

terms.name: Absent axon flare response after intradermal histamine injection
terms.name_zh: 皮内组胺注射后轴突潮红反应缺失
terms.definition: The axon reflex (also known as the flare response) is a response that is stimulated by peripheral nerves of the body that travels away from the nerve cell body and branches to stimulate target organs. In the human skin, there are three different phenomena mediated by axon reflex mechanism; flare, sweating and pilomotion. Stroking or intradermal injection of histamine or substance P into the human skin pro- duces widespread vasodilatation (flare) and plasma extravasation (wheal). This term refers to the failure of intradermal hista injection to elicit flare.

terms.name: Reduced sympathoneural responses to the cold pressor test
terms.definition: Response to the cold pressor test below the lower limit of normal. The cold pressor test is a simple and validated test in which the subject immerses one hand or foot into ice water for 1 to 3 minutes while blood pressure (BP) and heart rate are monitored. The cold stimulus activates afferent sensory pathways that, in turn, trigger a sympathetic response resulting in an increase in BP.

terms.name: Positive stool Giardia antigen test
terms.definition: Fecal analysis for Giardia antigen is abnormal. Tests include direct fluorescent-antibody (DFA), which detects intact organisms, and enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), which detect soluble stool antigens.

terms.name: Excessive blood loss during delivery
terms.definition: Loss of a substantial amount of blood during delivery (some definitions stipulate 1000 ml or more), typically associated with manifestations such as low blood pressure, a rapid heart rate, dizziness, light-headedness, fatigue, and weakness.

terms.name: Cardiac valve vegetations
terms.definition: Endocarditis infection occurs along the edges of the heart valves. Damage to the cardiac endothelium followed by platelet and fibrin deposition results in a sterile lesion known as nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis (NBTE) or vegetation. Microbes entering the bloodstream via routine or invasive procedures adhere to the vegetation and are engulfed in an outer meshwork of fibrin and platelets. Subsequent rapid microbial multiplication in a protected area of impaired host defense leads to vegetation growth and continuous bacteremia.

terms.name: Thoracic cage flatness
terms.definition: The anteroposterior dimension of the chest on the lateral radiograph is often relatively narrow compared with the chest width on the frontal radiograph.

terms.name: Absent zona pellucida
terms.definition: Lack of the oocyte extracellular matrix region (zona pellucida). This feature can be observed following follicular aspiration (retrieval of eggs for fertility treatments).

terms.name: Umbilical cord prolapse
terms.definition: The presence of the umbilical cord (UC) between the fetal presenting part and the cervix, regardless of the membrane status (intact or ruptured). Descent of the UC through the cervix is essential for diagnosing cord prolapse. It can be either overt (past the presenting part) or occult (alongside the presenting part).

terms.name: Increased ratio of deoxypyridinoline to pyridinoline cross-links in urine
terms.name_zh: 尿脱氧吡啶啉/吡啶啉交联比值升高
terms.definition: The relative concentration of deoxypyridinoline (Dpyr) to that of pyridinoline (Pyr) cross-links in urine is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary thymine level
terms.definition: The amount of thymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary indoleacetic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of indoleacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic phosphorylase kinase activity
terms.definition: Activity of phosphorylase kinase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal. Phosphorylase kinase (PhK) has a major regulatory role in the breakdown of glycogen. The enzyme PhK comprises four copies each of four subunits, encoded by PHKA1, PHKA2, PHKB, and PHKG.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic ornithine transcarbamylase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of ornithine transcarbamylase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary quinolinic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of quinolinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Quinolinic acids is a pyridinedicarboxylic acid that is pyridine substituted by carboxy groups at positions 2 and 3. It is a metabolite of tryptophan.

terms.name: Rectal duplication
terms.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by an additional rectum that is typically lined with intestinal mucosa with one or more cell types of the gastrointestinal tract overlying submucosa and smooth muscle layer.

terms.name: Thinned small intestinal mucosa
terms.definition: Abrnormal reduction in the height of the mucosa of the small intestine. The mucosa is arranged in regular circular folds (the circular valves of Kerckrin), the mucosal surface is covered with small projections called villi, which are slender, about 1.5-2 mm long projections of the mucosa into the lumen. In between the villi are the crypts. This term refers to a pathological thinning of these structures.

terms.name: Seminal vesicle hypoplasia
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by underdevelopment of one or both seminal vesicles, which are the two small glands that store and produce the majority of the fluid that makes up semen.

terms.name: Decreased fetal abdominal circumference
terms.definition: The distance around the abdomen of a fetus, generally as measured by prenatal sonography, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Prenatal flattened diaphragm
terms.definition: The diaphragm normally projects up into the thoracic cavity. In the presence of malformations such as enlarged lungs, the diaphragm may appear abnormally flat or even everted (with the middle of the diaphragm projecting downwards into the abdominal cavity).

terms.name: Snowflake effect in amniotic cavity
terms.definition: Dense floating particles in amniotic fluid, said to resemble snowflakes. This finding can result from shedding of the epidermis in conditions such as Harlequin ichthyosis.

terms.name: Thickened mitral valve cusp
terms.definition: An abnormally increased thickness of a leaflet of the mitral valve.

terms.name: Antiparietal cell antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against parietal cell antigens.

terms.name: Anti-intrinsic factor antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against intrinsic factor.

terms.name: Anti-human immunodeficiency virus antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

terms.name: Anti-polio virus antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗脊髓灰质炎病毒抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of poliovirus.

terms.name: Anti-NR2A antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the N-Methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor NR2A subunit.

terms.name: Antistreptolysin O antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗链球菌溶血素O抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against streptolysin O.

terms.name: Reduced tissue tissue AICAR transformylase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase; EC 2.1.2.3) a in a tissue is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Ameliorated by gastric acid-reducing therapy
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with an agent that reduces gastric acidity such as proton pump inhibitors, histamine receptor blockers,omeprazole, esomeprazole, dexlansoprazole, pantoprazole, lansoprazole, famotidine, or ranitidine.

terms.name: Anti-coagulation factor antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against a coagulation factor.

terms.name: Tachyphagia
terms.definition: Excessively rapid eating of food.

terms.name: Reduced tissue argininosuccinate synthetase activity
synonyms: Reduced argininosuccinate synthetase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Concentration of argininosuccinate synthetase (EC 6.3.4.5) in body tissues is below the lower limit of normal. Clinically, argininosuccinate synthetase is measured in the liver or in cultered skin fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced aspartoacylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of aspartoacylase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. Aspartoacylase (EC 3.5.1.15), also called aminoacylase-2, is an enzyme that hydrolyzes N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid (NAA) to aspartate and acetate.

terms.name: Reduced malonyl-CoA decarboxylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of malonyl-CoA decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.9) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
synonyms: Reduced MCAD activity in cultured fibroblasts
Reduced medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (EC 1.3.8.7;MCAD) in tissues is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced cystathionine beta-synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of cystathionine beta-synthase (EC 4.2.1.22) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced muscle glycogen phosphorylase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme glycogen phosphorylase in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. Glycogen phosphorylase (EC 2.4.1.1) is also known as amylophosphorylase, muscle phosphorylase a and b, polyphosphorylase, and myophosphorylase.

terms.name: Reduced muscle 6-phosphofructokinase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme 6-phosphofructokinase in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. 6-phosphofructokinase (EC 2.7.1.11) is also known as phosphofructokinase I and phosphohexokinase. The PFKM gene encodes the muscle isoform of phosphofructokinase. PFK catalyzes the irreversible conversion of fructose-6-phosphate to fructose-1,6-bisphosphate and is a key regulatory enzyme in glycolysis.

terms.name: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.

terms.name: Reduced succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid-CoA transferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid-CoA transferase (SCOT, or OXCT1; EC 2.8.3.5) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Blunted aldosterone response to aldosterone suppression test
terms.name_zh: 醛固酮抑制试验中醛固酮反应迟钝
terms.definition: A non-suppressible aldosterone excess, defined as an abnormal result of one of any four suppression tests. These tests use oral sodium loading, oral fludrocortisone, oral captopril, or saline infusion to suppress aldosterone secretion.

terms.name: Flank mass
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the flank, which is the fleshy part of the side of the body between the ribs and the hip.

terms.name: Synovial cyst
terms.definition: A fluid-filled sac or pouch-like mass that is a distention of a preexisting bursa in a joint, tendon sheaths or bursae. Synovial cysts contain synovial fluid and are lined by synovial membrane.

terms.name: Brown pigmentation of the conjunctiva
terms.definition: Deposition of brown pigmentation in the conjunctiva.

terms.name: Gastrocnemius contracture
terms.definition: Limitation of simultaneous ankle dorsiflexion and knee extension during mid-stance of gait.

terms.name: Central thinning of the outer nuclear layer of the retina
terms.name_zh: 视网膜外核层中央变薄
terms.definition: Reduced thickness of the outer nuclear layer in the middle region of the retina. The outer nuclear layer (ONL) of the retina contains the nuclei of the cone and rod photoreceptors. Loss of the cellular machinery found in these nuclei causes irreparable loss of the photoreceptors and the capacity for visual function. This feature can be appreciated by directional optical coherence tomography.

terms.name: Sonographic renal salt and pepper pattern
terms.definition: Heterogeneous, increased parenchymal echogenicity.
