This imaging appearance is caused by multiple tiny cysts smaller than or just approaching the size necessary for detection, which disrupt the echo pattern without being clearly distinguishable, and appear as white grains on renal ultrasound, mainly in a subcapsular location.

terms.name: Ductus venosus agenesis with intrahepatic drainage
terms.name_zh: 静脉导管缺如伴肝内引流
terms.definition: A form of ductus venosus agenesis in which the umbilical vein connects via the portal sinus to the portal venous system (PVS) without giving rise to the ductus venosus. In some cases an intrahepatic shunt from a portal to a hepatic vein can be detected prenatally. This variant has been reported to have a favorable prognosis.

terms.name: Ductus venosus agenesis with extrahepatic drainage and liver bypass
terms.name_zh: 静脉导管缺如伴肝外引流及肝脏旁路
terms.definition: A form of ductus venosus agenesis in which umbilical vein does not connect to the portal venous system. The liver is bypassed and the umbilical vein drains into a systemic vein such as the inferior vena cava. This variant has been reported to have an unfavorable prognosis due to a presumed association with congestive heart failure and hydrops.

terms.name: Elevated circulating D-glyceric acid concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of D-gyceric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF D-glyceric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液D-甘油酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of D-carboxylic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Ameliorated by riboflavin
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of riboflavin (Vitamin B2).

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 1beta concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白细胞介素1β浓度升高
terms.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-1beta in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Reduced neutrophil myeloperoxidase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of myeloperoxidase (EC 1.11.1.7) as measured in neutrophils is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Jugular foramen stenosis
terms.definition: Reduction in diameter of the jugular foramen, an opening in the base of the skull that is located behind the carotid canal and is formed by the temporal bone and the occipital bone. The inferior petrosal sinus, three cranial nerves, the sigmoid sinus, and meningeal arteries pass through the jugular foramen.

terms.name: Intramural intestinal gas
terms.definition: The presence of extraluminal gas within the bowel wall.

terms.name: Delayed scintigraphic gallbladder filling
terms.name_zh: 胆囊闪烁显像充盈延迟
terms.definition: Hepatobiliary scintigraphy is a nuclear imaging technique that permits evaluation of the liver and biliary system for acute and chronic cholecystitis, biliary atresia, biliary obstruction, and post-surgical biliary leak. With this investigation, a radiotracer is administered intravenously, bound to albumin, transported to the liver, and excreted into the biliary system. This term refers to a longer than normal time for the radiotracer to be visualized in the gallbladder. This finding may be a sign of chronic gallbladder disease or partial obstruction of the common bile duct.

terms.name: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation
terms.definition: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation is defined as an abnormal vascular net, developed from one or more feeding arteries and enlarged early draining veins, creating an arteriovenous shunting.

terms.name: Anti-perilipin-1 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗脂滴包被蛋白-1抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against perilipin-1 (PLIN1).

terms.name: Splenic calcification
terms.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the spleen.

terms.name: Short esophagus
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in the length of the esophagus.

terms.name: Gastric perforation
terms.definition: A full-thickness injury of the wall of the stomach.

terms.name: Gastric volvulus
terms.definition: A gastric volvulus occurs when the stomach rotates on itself at least 180 degrees along its transverse or longitudinal axis.

terms.name: Elevated circulating sCD163 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of sD163 (= soluble cluster of differentiation 163, = soluble CD163) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive cold agglutinin test
terms.definition: Cold agglutinin are erythrocyte antibodies which possess the property of agglutinating red blood cells at temperatures of below 37 degrees C, this phenomenon is reversible after heating.

terms.name: Anti-D-L antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of Donath-Landsteiner (D-L) autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum.

terms.name: Anti-erythrocyte autoantibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗红细胞自身抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against an antigen on the surface of erythrocytes (red-blood cells).

terms.name: Non-glucose reducing substance in urine
terms.definition: Abnormal result for this screening test for urinary reducing substances including glucose, fructose, galactose, lactose, pentose and maltose, as well as amino acids, cysteine, tyrosine, homogentisic acid, ketone bodies, ascorbic acid and many drugs. This term is applied if the urine stick test for glucose was negative (normal).

terms.name: Elevated urinary succinylaminoimidazole carboxamide riboside level
terms.name_zh: 尿琥珀酰氨基咪唑羧酰胺核苷水平升高
terms.definition: Presence of succinylaminoimidazole carboxamide riboside (SAICAr). SAICAr is a toxic intermediate metabolite of purine synthesis.

terms.name: Elevated urine hyaluronic acid level
terms.definition: Excessive amount of hyaluronic acid in urine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary methylmalonylcarnitine level
terms.name_zh: 尿甲基丙二酰肉碱水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of methylmalonylcarnitine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine trihydroxycholestanoic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿三羟基胆甾烷酸水平升高
terms.definition: Presence of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine. Trihydroxycholestanoic acid is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of cholic acid. Elevated plasma levels of trihydroxycholestanoic acid have been found in patients with Zellweger syndrome.

terms.name: Elevated CSF ammonia concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of amonia in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive CSF VDRL test
terms.definition: An abnormal (positive) result of the Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) test performed in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), suggesting past or present neurosyphilis.

terms.name: Elevated CSF guanidinoacetic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液胍基乙酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: CSF oligoclonal immunoglobulin G bands
terms.definition: Oligoclonal immunoglobulin G (IgG) bands (OCBs) are a useful diagnostic tool to detect a central humoral response. In particular, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)-restricted OCBs represent a hallmark of multiple sclerosis (MS).

terms.name: Decreased CSF 3-methoxy-4-hydroxyphenylglycolaldehyde concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液3-甲氧基-4-羟基苯乙二醇醛浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of 3-methoxy-4-hydroxyphenylglycolaldehyde in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF alpha-crystallin B chain concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液αB-晶状体蛋白浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of alpha-crystallin B chain in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced CSF creatine concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of creatine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating vitamin K-dependent protein Z concentration
terms.name_zh: 血维生素K依赖性蛋白Z浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased circulating vitamin K-dependent protein Z concentration
Decreased vitamin K-dependent protein Z concentration
Decreased vitamin K-dependent protein Z level
Decreased vitamin K-dependent protein Z level in blood
Reduced vitamin K-dependent protein Z concentration
Reduced vitamin K-dependent protein Z level
Reduced vitamin K-dependent protein Z level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin K-dependent protein Z in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 27-hydroxycholesterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环27-羟基胆固醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 27-hydroxycholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating lysophosphatidylcholine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环溶血磷脂酰胆碱浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of lysophosphatidylcholines in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating insulin-like growth factor 2 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of insulin-like growth factor 2 (IGF2) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal. IGF2 is a peptide hormone regulating various cellular processes such as proliferation and apoptosis.

terms.name: Decreased circulating nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Diminished circulating reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环还原型烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环成纤维细胞生长因子23浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced CSF asparagine concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of asparagine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Pancreatic mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the pancreas. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Small intestine mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the small intestine. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Facial nerve compression
terms.definition: Impingement of another object such as a blood vessel upon the facial nerve, causing it to lose volume in the compressed region.

terms.name: Pulmonary perfusion defect
terms.definition: Lack of blood perfusion in a specific area of the lung. Pulmonary ventilation (V) and Perfusion (Q) scan, also known as lung V/Q scan, is a nuclear test that uses the perfusion scan to delineate the blood flow distribution and the ventilation scan to measure airflow distribution in the lungs.

terms.name: Ectopic ureteral orifice
terms.definition: Drainage of the ureter on one or both sides into an abnormal location. Normally the ureter drains via the internal ureteral orifice at the trigone of the urinary bladder. Ectopic ureteral orifice can be either intravesical (bladder neck) or, more often, extravesical. Ectopia in women is more frequently found in the urethra and the vaginal vestibule; much less frequently in vagina and in uterus. In men it is mostly found in the posterior urethra; in the male genital tract is very rare.

terms.name: Duplicate uterine cervix
terms.definition: A congenital developmental defect characterized by the presence of two cervices on the uterus.

terms.name: Intradural spinal lipoma
terms.definition: Intradural spinal lipoma (ISL) constitutes approximately 1% of all spinal tumors and is usually associated with lumbo-sacral spinal dysraphism. ISLs unassociated with spinal dysraphism are rare with only a few cases being reported in literature. They are seen in children and young adults and are situated on the posterior aspect of the spinal cord in the cervico-thoracic or thoracic regions. They represent intradural, subpial, juxtamedullary lesions.

terms.name: T2 hyperintense cerebellar lesion
terms.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the cerebellum. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the cerebellum.

terms.name: Inferior vena cava obstruction
terms.definition: Physical invasion or compression of the inferior vena cava by a pathological process or by thrombosis within the vein itself.

terms.name: Rheumatoid nodule
terms.definition: A well-demarcated, flesh colored, subcutaneous and usually freely movable lump or mass. Rheumatoid nodules can vary in size from small, pea sized lesions up to the size of a lemon and are most often round. The nodules usually are doughy or firm however and not tender. Typically rheumatoid nodules are distributed over areas of repeated trauma or pressure and occur adjacent to joints on extensor surfaces, such as the elbow, fingers and forearms.

terms.name: Elevated circulating proinsulin concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of proinsulin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Burning eye sensation
terms.definition: A feeling of stinging or irritation of the eyes.

terms.name: Collarettes
terms.definition: Buildup of waxy flesh-colored scales on the margin of the eyelid.

terms.name: Tympanic membrane bulla
terms.definition: Presence of blisters (bullae) on the tympanic membrane, often accompanied by fever, thickening, and erythematous appearance of the tympanic membrane, decreased or absent light reflex, and decreased mobility.

terms.name: Beard and mustache distribution
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at regions of the male face covered by a beard or mustache.

terms.name: Kerion
terms.definition: Kerion is an erythematous, boggy, tender, often sterile, weeping nodule or plaque with pustules and draining sinuses. Hair in these areas appears lusterless, brittle, and is easily plucked. Kerion can be solitary or multiple but is usually unilateral. Patients with inflammatory tinea barbae may have constitutional symptoms like fever and malaise. Kerion is a coalesced sterile pustule, but occasionally they can get superinfected with cutaneous bacteria and develop regional lymphadenopathy.

terms.name: Truncal location
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the trunk of the body. The trunk is the main part of a person's body, not including the head, legs, or arms.

terms.name: Reduced Acyl-CoA:dihydroxyacetone phosphate acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of acyl-CoA:dihydroxyacetone phosphate acyltransferase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced alkyl-dihydroxyacetonephosphate synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
synonyms: Reduced alkyl-DHAP synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of alkyl-dihydroxyacetonephosphate (DHAP) synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Glomerular fibronectin deposits
terms.definition: Accumulation of fibronectin in the glomerulus.

terms.name: Renal tubular karyomegaly
terms.definition: Marked enlargement of nuclei observed predominantly in the proximal convoluted tubule cells.

terms.name: Reduced tissue acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity
terms.definition: Activity of acetyl-CoA carboxylase in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver.

terms.name: Elevated urinary glycolic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of glycolic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine propionic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of propionic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary butyric acid level
terms.definition: The amount of butyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary isovaleric acid level
terms.definition: The amount of isovaleric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of alpha-ketoglutarate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating ghrelin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胃饥饿素浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of ghrelin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Ghrelin is a 28-amino-acid peptide predominantly secreted in the stomach and stimulates appetite and growth hormone (GH) release.

terms.name: Decreased circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血硬脂酰肉碱浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of stearoylcarnitine (C18:0) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced urinary iodine level
terms.definition: The amount of iodine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating interleukin 15 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白细胞介素15浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of interleukin 15 (IL-15) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating squalene concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of squalene in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 6 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素6浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 6 (IL-6) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 12 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环白细胞介素12浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 12 in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Elevated blood mercury concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of mercury in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.

terms.name: Elevated blood cadmiun concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of cadmium in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.

terms.name: Elevated thallium concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of thallium in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating CC chemokine concentration
terms.definition: The concentration in the blood circulation of a member of the CC chemokine family is outside of normal limits.

terms.name: Decreased CSF asialotransferrin to transferrin ratio
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液去唾液酸转铁蛋白/转铁蛋白比值降低
terms.definition: The concentration of asialotransferrin relative to that of transferrin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-desmocollin antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗桥粒芯胶蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmocollin.

terms.name: Occupational exposure to raw nonsynthetic textiles
terms.definition: A history of exposure by inhalation of airborne particles generated during the processing of raw, nonsynthetic textiles, particularly cotton. Classically, exposure to cotton dust during the spinning and manufacturing process causes byssinosis. However, exposure to jute, flax, and hemp fibers has also been implicated in its development.

terms.name: Rokitansky-Aschoff gallbladder sinuses
synonyms: Epithelial invaginations of the gallbladder forming cystic pockets
terms.definition: Localized or diffuse epithelial proliferation with hypertrophy of the muscularis layer and invagination of the mucosa through the muscularis, forming intramural diverticula (i.e., small, bulging pouches in the wall of the gallbladder).

terms.name: Porcelain gallbladder
terms.definition: Porcelain gallbladder refers to the condition in which the inner gallbladder wall is encrusted with calcium. The wall becomes brittle, hard, and often takes on a bluish hue. It is usually found incidentally on plain abdominal x-rays or other imaging because most patients are asymptomatic.

terms.name: Gallbladder adhesions
terms.definition: Strands of scar tissue bands of scar tissue that form an abnormal connection between the gallbladder and another abdominal structure. Adhesions can form followiing gallbladder inflammation (cholecystitis).

terms.name: Bilioduodenal fistula
terms.definition: An abnormal connection between the gallbladder and the duodenum.

terms.name: Pneumobilia
terms.definition: Accumulation of gas in the biliary tree.

terms.name: Ectopic gallstone
terms.definition: A gallstone located outside of the gallbladder.

terms.name: Sleep drunkeness
synonyms: Slow speech or confused thinking upon waking
terms.definition: Sleep drunkenness refers to the prolonged and pronounced difficulty with awakening from nocturnal sleep and daytime naps. This symptom should be distinguished from the milder and physiologic state of sleep inertia seen even in healthy controls.

terms.name: Mallory bodies
terms.definition: Cytoplasmic hyaline inclusions of hepatocytes that are predominantly filamentous ranging from a diameter of 3 to 24 nm vs. 10 nm of classical IF. Mallory-Denk bodies can be classified as type I (parallels filaments), II (randomly orient filaments), or III (granular and amorphous). Type II occurs in the periphery while type III occurs around the center. MDB occur in ballooned hepatocytes.

terms.name: Sulfur-containing abscess
terms.definition: An abscess containing tiny yellow clumps (sulfur granules), formed by infection with Actinomyces and generally associated with a granulomatous and suppurative infection.

terms.name: Retracted tympanic membrane
terms.definition: A condition in which part of the tympanic membrane is pull backed into the middle ear cavity (also called retraction pocket).

terms.name: Ectopic testis
terms.definition: Localization of the testis in an anatomic location other than the scrotum.

terms.name: Cerebral subcortical cyst
terms.definition: A fluid-filled sac (cyst) in the region below the cortex of the cerebrum. In magnetic resonance imaging, the fluid within the cyst has the same appearance as cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Anti-ADAMTS13 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against A Disintegrin and Metalloprotease with ThromboSpondin type 1 repeats, member 13 (ADAMTS13).

terms.name: Habitual mouth breathing
terms.definition: A tendency to breathe through the mouth. Defined as over 25-30 percent of the air passing through the mouth instead of the nose, mouth breathing often occurs due to upper airway obstruction which reduces the nasal airflow and forces the air to enter completely or partially through oral cavity.

terms.name: Squared off shoulders
terms.definition: An appearance of the shoulders whereby the neck-trapezius angle (angle between the neck and the shoulder) and the angle formed by the shoulder and the arms hanging at the side of the body are both close to 90 degrees. This gives the should the appearance of the corner of a square.

terms.name: Elevated urine mesaconic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of mesaconic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 3-methyladipic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿3-甲基己二酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 3-methyladipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine D-lactate level
terms.definition: The amount of D-lactate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. L-lactate is a familiar molecule to the human body and is also produced in large amounts in human tissues, depending on metabolic conditions. In contrast, D-lactate is produced only in minute quantities in human tissues, and is therefore not detectable in the bloodstream under normal physiological conditions.

terms.name: Elevated CSF alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液α-酮戊二酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of alpha-ketoglutarate in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methylbutanoic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2,3-二羟基-2-甲基丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methylbutanoic acidin the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Fetal oral mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the oral cavity of a fetus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined. This finding is generally first observed by prenatal sonography or magnetic resonance imaging.

terms.name: Dilated ejaculatory duct
terms.definition: Increase in diameter of the ejeculatory duct. The ejaculatory duct delivers sperm into the urethra, adding secretions from the prostate and is formed by the union of the vas deferens with the duct of the seminal vesicle.

terms.name: Decreased Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein concentration in hematopoietic cells
terms.name_zh: 造血细胞WAS蛋白浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein in hematopoietic cells is below the lower limit of normal. This feature is measured by flow cytometry or Western blotting.

terms.name: Decreased FOXP3-expressing T cell count
terms.definition: The number of T cells in peripheral blood that express FOXP3-expressing is below the lower limit of normal. This finding is determined by flow cytometry.

terms.name: Elevated circulating complement component concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环补体成分浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of a complement component in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-beta fodrin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a component of beta-fodrin.

terms.name: Elevated circulating tetradecenoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 血十四烯酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of tetradecenoylcarnitine (C14:1) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-反式,4-顺式癸二烯酰肉碱水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环2-反,4-顺癸二烯酰肉碱浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine N-acetyltyrosine level
terms.name_zh: 尿N-乙酰酪氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of N-acetyltyrosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine manganese level
terms.definition: The amount of manganese in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced urinary manganese level
terms.definition: The amount of manganese in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating catecholamine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环儿茶酚胺浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of a catecholamine in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Empty sella turcica
terms.definition: Empty sella or arachnoidocele has been defined as the herniation of the subarachnoid space within the sella turcica, associated with elongated pituitary stalk and flattening of the pituitary gland.

terms.name: Elevated brain guanidinoacetate level by MRS
terms.name_zh: MRS示脑胍基乙酸水平升高
terms.definition: An increase in the level of guanidinoacetate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

terms.name: Elevated circulating beta-hCG concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环β-人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度升高
synonyms: Elevated choriogonadotropin subunit beta level in blood
Elevated circulating choriogonadotropin subunit beta concentration
Increased choriogonadotropin subunit beta level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of beta-hCG in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CXCL10 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of C-X-C motif chemokine 10 (CXCL10) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 12 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of interleukin 12 (IL-12) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
synonyms: Fibroblast growth factor 23 hormone low in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环成纤维细胞生长因子23浓度异常
terms.definition: The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of normal.

terms.name: Impaired heel-walking ability
terms.definition: Difficulty or reduced ability to walk on heels. Heel-walking can be tested as a part of the neurological examination. Foot dorsal extension weakness leads to difficulties in walking on heels.

terms.name: Anti-prothrombin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against prothrombin.

terms.name: Anti-factor V antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against factor V.

terms.name: Anti-factor VII antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor VII.

terms.name: Anti-factor VIII antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor VIII.

terms.name: Anti-factor IX antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor IX.

terms.name: Anti-factor X antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor X.

terms.name: Anti-factor XI antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor XI.

terms.name: Anti-factor XIII antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor XIII.

terms.name: Anti-factor H antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor H.

terms.name: Extremities cold to touch
terms.definition: Cool or cold arms or legs related to peripheral vasoconstriction, the narrowing of blood vessels resulting from the contraction of muscular walls in large arteries and the small arterioles of skin and most internal organs. Following exposure to low ambient temperatures, vasoconstriction decreases heat dissipation from skin surfaces, thus preventing life-threatening hypothermia.

terms.name: Ruffled acrosome
terms.definition: An irregular wavy appearance of sperm acrosomes.

terms.name: Elevated circulating calprotectin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环钙卫蛋白浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of calprotectin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: 4-5 toe cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 4 and 5.

terms.name: Poly-hill sign
terms.definition: A typical physical examination in patients with muscular dystrophies and selective weakness and atrophy of the trapezius muscle and proximal deltoid muscle. The contour of the back shows unique hills and drops.

terms.name: 3-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
synonyms: Webbed third, fourth, and fifth finger
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the third to the fifth fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

terms.name: Radioulnar subluxation
terms.definition: Partial dislocation of the radioulnar joint.

terms.name: Non-pitting edema
terms.definition: Non-pitting edema occurs when excess fluid builds up in the body causing swelling that does not indent when pressure is applied. It usually occurs in the limbs, and often results from underlying medical conditions affecting lymphatic system function.

terms.name: Anti-human ferritin peptide antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗人铁蛋白肽抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the human ferritin peptide.

terms.name: Elevated CSF L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液L-2-羟基戊二酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated erythrocyte inosine triphosphate concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞三磷酸肌苷浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of inosine triphosphate in red blood cells is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte inosine triphosphatase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of inosine triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase (EC 3.6.1.19) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating alpha-1,3-fucosyltransferase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-1,3-fucosyltransferase is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Diminished neutrophil myeloperoxidase activity
terms.name_zh: 中性粒细胞髓过氧化物酶活性降低
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme myeloperoxidase (EC 1.11.1.7) in neutrophils below the lower limit of normal. This feature can be measured by peroxidase cytochemistry or biochemical assays. Myeloperoxidase is a lysosomal hemoprotein located in the azurophilic granules of polymorphonuclear leukocytes and monocytes.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte uroporphyrinogen III cosynthase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of uroporphyrinogen III (EC 4.2.1.75) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated 18-hydroxycorticosterone to aldosterone ratio
terms.definition: The relative concentration in the blood circulation of 18-hydroxycorticosterone compared to that of aldosterone is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 21-deoxycortisol concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环21-脱氧皮质醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 21-deoxycortisol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated monolysocardiolipin/cardiolipin ratio
terms.name_zh: 单溶血心磷脂/心磷脂比值升高
terms.definition: The concentration of monolysocardiolipin related to that of cardiolipin is above the upper limit of normal. This is a functional assay that can be performed from a blood spot to diagnose Barth syndrome (OMIM:302060).

terms.name: Low maternal vitamin B12 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of vitamin B12 in the mother's blood during pregnancy is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating inhibin A concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环抑制素A浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of inibin A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased circulating inhibin B concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环抑制素B浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating lipoprotein(a) concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环脂蛋白(a)浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein(a) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Lipoprotein(a), also known as apolipoprotein(A), is encoded by LPA (HGNC:6667).

terms.name: Reduced circulating lipoprotein(a) concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein(a) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal. Lipoprotein(a), also known as apolipoprotein(A), is encoded by LPA (HGNC:6667).

terms.name: Abnormal urinary bile acid level
terms.definition: The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione reductase activity
terms.definition: Activity of glutathione reductase (EC 1.6.4.2) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Failure to elevate lactate upon ischemic exercise test
terms.name_zh: 缺血运动试验乳酸升高障碍
terms.definition: Failure to elevate lactate in blood washed out from ischemically exercised muscles as assayed by the forearm ischemic exercise test.

terms.name: Elevated circulating cholestanol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胆甾烷醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of cholestanol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Cholestanol is the 5-alpha-dihydro derivative of cholesterol.

terms.name: Livestock exposure
terms.definition: A medical history of having been exposed to livestock (animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm ).

terms.name: Synchronous skin lesions
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality of the skin in which multiple lesions occur at the same time.

terms.name: Serpentine skin location
terms.definition: Refers to a skin lseion that has a snake-like (serpentine) shape.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary organic compound level
terms.name_zh: 尿有机化合物水平异常
terms.definition: The amount of an organic compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal. An organic compound is defined here as a chemical compound that contains a carbon-hydrogen or carbon-carbon bond, although some other definitions exist. Examples of organic compounds includes alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatic compounds, alcohols, ketones, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, and esters.

terms.name: Elevated urinary histamine level
terms.definition: The amount of histamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary N-methylhistamine level
terms.definition: The amount of N-methylhistamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary ureidopropionic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of ureidopropionic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary porphyrin level
terms.definition: The amount of a porphyrin compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Porphrins are natural pigments containing a fundamental skeleton of four pyrrole nuclei united through the alpha-positions by four methine groups to form a macrocyclic structure. Porpyrins giove rise to heme and combalamine.

terms.name: Elevated urinary coproporphyrin level
terms.definition: The amount of a coproporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Eccrine sweat gland predominance
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality of the skin that is located in or surrounding eccrine sweat glands.

terms.name: Poorly demarcated skin lesion
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality of the skin whose boundary to the surrounding normal skin is not clearly defined.

terms.name: History of recent cat bite
terms.definition: Medical history of a recent bite or scratch injury due to a cat.

terms.name: History of recent stay in area with inadequate sewage sanitation
terms.name_zh: 近期污水卫生条件差地区停留史
terms.definition: A history of having been in an area with inadequate sewage sanitation in the recent past.

terms.name: Positive cutaneous herpes simplex virus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of cutaneous herpes simplex virus nucleic acid in the skin by a method such as polymerase chain reaction. The sample is usually obtained by cutaneous swabs from skin lesions.

terms.name: Positive CSF mycobacterium tuberculosis nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive mycobacterium CSF microscopy
terms.definition: The demonstration of mycobacterium by microscopy of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Positive treponema pallidum PCR test in the blood circulation
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of treponema pallidum in the blood circulation by a method such a polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive human Immunodeficiency virus nucleic acid test in the blood circulation
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of human immunodeficiency vrus (HIV) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive CSF enterovirus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of enteroviral nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive CSF Borrelia burgdorferi nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Borrelia burgdorferi nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive CSF arbovirus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of arbovus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR..

terms.name: Positive Bartonella henselae nucleic acid test in the blood circulation
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Bartonella henselae in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive Dengue virus PCR test in the blood circulation
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of the Dengue virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive CSF JC-virus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of JC-virus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Bloodstream Malaria parasite
terms.definition: Presence of malaria parasites in the peripheral blood.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream plasmodium falciparum nucleic acid pathogen test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Plasmodium falciparum (a type of Malaria parasite) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Decreased erythrocyte fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase activity
terms.name_zh: 红细胞果糖-1,6-二磷酸醛缩酶活性降低
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase (EC 4.1.2.13) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced circulating dopamine beta-hydroxylase activity
terms.definition: Concentration of Dopamine beta-hydroxylase (DBH; EC 1.14.17.1) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. DBH catalyzes the oxidative hydroxylation of dopamine to norepinephrine.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte bisphosphoglycerate mutase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of bisphosphoglycerate mutase (BPGM; EC 5.4.2.4;) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. BPGM is a multifunctional enzyme specifically found in red blood cells that synthesizes 2,3-diphosphoglycerate through its synthase activity and degrades it through its phosphatase activity.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte adenylate kinase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of adenylate kinase (EC 2.7.4.3) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal. Adenylate kinase is a ubiquitous monomeric enzyme that catalyzes the reversible conversion of MgATP plus AMP to MgADP plus ADP and contributes to homeostasis of the adenine nucleotide composition in the cell.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte hexokinase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of hexokinase (EC 2.7.1.1) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Arginase catalyzes the last step of the urea cycle.

terms.name: Decreased circulating carboxypeptidase N activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme Carboxypeptidase N (arginine carboxypeptidase, EC 3.4.17.3) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated red cell pyruvate kinase activity
terms.name_zh: 红细胞丙酮酸激酶活性升高
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of pyruvate kinase (EC 2.7.1.40) in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal. Pyruvate kinase (EC 2.7.1.40) is a glycolytic enzyme that catalyzes the transphosphorylation from phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) to ADP, yielding pyruvate and ATP.

terms.name: Reduced circulating adenosine deaminase-2 activity
terms.definition: Concentration of adenosine deaminase 2 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced sepiapterin reductase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of sepiapterin reductase (7,8-dihydrobiopterin:NADP+ oxidoreductase; EC 1.1.1.153) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Elevated circulating vasoactive intestinal peptide concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环血管活性肠肽浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating cholesterol sulfate concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环硫酸胆固醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of cholesterol sulfate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating lipoprotein-X concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环脂蛋白X浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein-X in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating oxalate concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of oxalate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated blood ethylene glycol concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of ethylene glycol in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.

terms.name: Midline notching of lower lip
terms.definition: Exaggerated indentation at the very middle (midline) of the lower lip.

terms.name: Reduced tissue thymidine phosphorylase activity
terms.definition: Activity of thymidine phosphorylase (EC 2.4.2.4) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes.

terms.name: Reduced tissue tripeptidyl peptidase 1 activity
synonyms: Reduced tripeptidyl peptidase 1 activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1;EC 3.4.14.9) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. TTP1 activity can be measured in tissues including fibroblasts and leukocytes muscle.

terms.name: Reduced tissue arginine:glycine amidinotransferase activity
terms.definition: Activity of L-arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (GATM; EC 2.1.4.1) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. GATM activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue aspartylglucosaminidase activity
terms.definition: Activity of aspartylglucosaminidase (AGA; EC 3.5.1.26) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. AGA activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase activity
terms.definition: Activity of carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase (CACT) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. CACT activity can be measured in multiple tissues.

terms.name: Reduced circulating 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase activity
terms.definition: The activity of 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced tissue mannosyl-oligosaccharide glucosidase activity
terms.definition: Activity of mannosyl-oligosaccharide glucosidase (MOGS) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. MOGS activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue 3-methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme 3-methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase (EC 4.2.1.18) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
terms.definition: Activity of gamma-glutamyltransferase in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Positive oropharangeal infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the oropharynx positive. The oropharynx is defined as the middle part of the throat and includes the soft palate, the side and back walls of the throat, the tonsils, and the posterior one-third of the tongue.

terms.name: Positive oropharynx poliovirus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of poliovirus nucleic acid in the oropharynx by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive synonvial fluid infectious agent test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the synovial fluid (i.e., in a joint) positive.

terms.name: Positive synonvial fluid culture
terms.definition: Growth of an infectious agent in a culture derived from synovial fluid.

terms.name: Positive synovial fluid gram stain
terms.definition: Demonstration of the presence of bacteria by gram staining of joint (synovial) fluid. The sample is generally obtained by arthrocentesis.

terms.name: Anti Parvovirus antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of parvovirus.

terms.name: Brain parenchymal tuberculoma
terms.definition: Tuberculoma results from hematogenous spread of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M. tb) from an extracranial source. Diagnosis is based on computed tomography (CT) scan and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies with a similar ring-enhancing lesion.

terms.name: Muscle arteriovenous malformation
terms.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in muscle tissue.

terms.name: Bone arteriovenous malformation
terms.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in a bone.

terms.name: Periosteal elevation
terms.definition: Lifting or separation of the periosteum from the outer surface of a bone. Periosteal elevation is usually seen in benign process, frequently in cranioencephalic traumas. There is an elevation of the periosteum after blood, like in cephalohematomas.

terms.name: Esophageal dilation
terms.definition: Widening (relatively uniform increase in diameter) of a segment of the esophagus.

terms.name: Spinal lipoma
terms.definition: A lipoma that is localized to the spine.

terms.name: Loose body in joint
terms.definition: Small fragments of articular cartilage that break off in a joint as a result of a injury, degeneration, or other processes.

terms.name: Paraspinal arteriovenous malformation
terms.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in adjacent to the spine, i.e., in a location that is normally occupied by muscles, ligaments, nerves, and other tissues that run alongside the spinal column.

terms.name: Supernumerary tarsal bone
terms.definition: The presence of an additional tarsal bone that is not one of the canonical tarsal bones (cuboid, medial, intermediate, and lateral cuneiform, navicular, talus, calcaneus).

terms.name: Maxillary cyst
terms.definition: A closed sac that has developed in the upper jaw bone (maxilla) and contains fluid or semi-solid material. Cystic lesions of the maxilla are benign entities with both odontogenic and non-odontogenic origins.

terms.name: Mandibular cyst
terms.definition: A closed sac that has developed in the lower jaw bone (mandibula) and contains fluid or semi-solid material.

terms.name: Sixth cranial nerve hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the six cranial nerve (abducens nerve).

terms.name: Third cranial nerve hypoplasia
terms.definition: Underdevelopment of the third cranial nerve (oculomotor nerve).

terms.name: Elevated urinary succinylacetone level
terms.name_zh: 尿琥珀酰丙酮水平升高
terms.definition: Presence in the urine of succinylacetone, which is one of the toic block metabolites formed in tyrosinaemia type 1 because of a defect in the final enzyme of the pathway of the degradation of tyrosine, namely fumarylacetoacetase (FAH, EC 3.7.1.2).

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2-oxoisocaproic level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-氧代异己酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2-oxoisocaproic in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2-oxovaleric acid level
terms.definition: The amount of 2-oxovaleric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2-hydroxyisocaproic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-羟基异己酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2-hydroxyisocaproic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary isovalerylglycine level
terms.name_zh: 尿异戊酰甘氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of isovalerylglycine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2-甲基-3-羟基丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxypentanoic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxypentanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 7-hydroxyoctanoic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of 7-hydroxyoctanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary D-glyceric acid level
terms.definition: The amount of D-glyceric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxyisobutyric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿3-羟基异丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxyisobutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3,4-Dihydroxybutyric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿3,4-二羟基丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 3,4-Dihydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxyadipic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿3-羟基己二酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxyadipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated erythrocyte galactose-1-phosphate concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞半乳糖-1-磷酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of galactose-1-phosphate in red blood cells (erythrocytes) above the upper level of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating chitotriosidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环壳三糖苷酶活性升高
terms.definition: Increased activity or concentration of the enzyme chitotriosidase. Serum chitotriosidase is a biomarker that has shown high specificity and sensitivity in patients with sarcoidosis.

terms.name: Squamosal suture synostosis
terms.definition: Premature closure of the squamosal suture, which is one of the lateral minor skull sutures, separating the parietal and squamous temporal bones.

terms.name: Enlarged fetal lungs
terms.definition: The size (volume) of the lungs of a fetus above the upper limit of normal for the gestational age.

terms.name: Orbital inflammation
terms.definition: An inflammatory condition localized to the orbit, presenting capillary dilatation, leukocytic infiltration, redness, heat, and pain. CT or MIR Imaging demonstrates enlargement of the muscle belly of one (or more) extraocular muscles typically with the involvement of tendinous insertions. Inflammation can also be observed in surrounding tissues, including the orbital fat, lacrimal gland, and optic nerve sheath.

terms.name: Reduced Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme has phosphoinositide 5-phosphatase (EC 3.1.3.36) activity.

terms.name: Reduced muscle glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
terms.definition: Activity of the gycogen debrancher enzyme (GDE) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. GDE is a large monomeric protein with two catalytic activities: amylo-1,6-glucosidase (EC 3.2.1.33) and 4-alpha-glucanotransferase (EC 2.4.1.25).

terms.name: Reduced tissue UDP-glucuronyl-transferase activity
synonyms: Reduced liver uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase activity
Reduced tissue uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase below the lower limit of normal. The activity of this enzyme can be measured in liver and rarely in other tissues.

terms.name: Temporal artery giant cells
terms.definition: The presence of giant cells in the temporal artery. This is a feature of giant cell arteritis. Giant cells are multinucleated cells formed by fusion of multiple macrophages and are typically located in the intima of the arterial wall. This feature is typically demonstrated by temporal artery biopsy but other arteries may also be affected.

terms.name: Reduced phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Activity of phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (EC 4.1.1.32) is below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Elevated urinary pyrroline hydroxycarboxylic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿吡咯啉羟羧酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of pyrroline hydroxycarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary N-tau-ribosylhistidine level
terms.name_zh: 尿N-τ-核糖基组氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: Presence of N tau-ribosylhistidine (His-R) in the urine. His-R is a histidine derivative found in the urine of histidinemic patients.

terms.name: Elevated urinary ureidoisobutyric acid level
terms.definition: The amount of ureidoisobutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Ureidoisobutyric acid is increased in the urine of patients with beta-ureidopropionase (EC 3.5.1.6) deficiency.

terms.name: Elevated urinary N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿N-氨甲酰基-β-氨基异丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Nipple epidermal Paget cells
terms.definition: Malignant, intraepithelial adenocarcinoma cells of variable sizes usually large in size, present singly or in the form of small groups within the epidermis of the nipple. Cells may be ovoid, round, or signet-ring forms, usually mucin positive, and the cytoplasm may contain periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, diastase-resistant granules, indicating the presence of neutral mucopolysaccharides. The cells possess microscopic features of glandular cells with pale to clear vacuolated cytoplasm, and nuclei are usually high-grade with prominent nucleoli.

terms.name: Penile corporal blood gas ischemia
terms.definition: Partial pressure of oxygen (pO2) in cavernous blood of the penis is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Recent temporal region trauma
terms.definition: A history of an injury to the temporal region of the skull that occurred recently (several hours, days, or weeks before the current presenting complaint).

terms.name: Rest limb pain
terms.definition: Rest pain is a continuous unrelenting pain due to ischemia of the lower leg, beginning with or being aggravated by elevation and being relieved by sitting with legs in a dependent position or by standing.

terms.name: Scalloped appearance of liver surface
synonyms: Scalloping of surface of liver and spleen
Scalloping of the surface of the liver and spleen
terms.definition: A lesion associated with pseudomyxoma peritonei whosetypical CT appearance is scalloping of the surface of the liver and spleen caused by loculated accumulations of mucin, which distinguishes mucin from fluid ascites. The mucinous material is similar in density to water. There are also islands of higher attenuation due to scattered solid elements and calcification within mucinous material.

terms.name: Nipple thickening
terms.definition: Thickening of the skin around the nipple.

terms.name: Hypoechoic breast mass
terms.definition: A breast mass visualized by sonography that displays a lower than normal echo signal (and this that appears dark gray in the typical ultrasound image).

terms.name: Unilocular ovarian cyst
terms.definition: An ovarian cyst without septa and a solid component.

terms.name: Mesenteric torsion
terms.definition: Mesenteric torsion is a pathological rotation of the intestinal tract around the axis of the mesenteric root, resulting in rapid occlusion of the cranial mesenteric artery.

terms.name: High-pitched bowel sounds
terms.definition: Abnormal bowel sounds of an unually high frequency.

terms.name: Exacerbated by opiate medication
terms.definition: Applied to a sign orr symptom that is worsed by administration of opiate medications.

terms.name: Breast granuloma
terms.definition: Formation of a non-necrotizing granuloma in breat tissue typically in combination with a localized infiltrate of multi-nucleated giant cells, epithelioid histiocytes, lymphocytes, and plasma cells.

terms.name: Exposure to cosmetic fragrances
terms.definition: A history of exposure to fragrances found in cosmetic products.

terms.name: Sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication
terms.definition: Sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication or a salivary stimulus. Facial warmth, flushing, and sweating in the territory of the auriculotemporal nerve overlying the parotid gland, which may include the preauricular skin, the temporal skin, the scalp, and the temporomandibular joint region. Symptoms occur during meals, especially with spicy and sour foods. This feature is inferred to be a consequence of injury to the auriculotemporal nerve, a branch if the trigeminal nerve.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic glyoxylate reductase activity
terms.definition: Activity of glyoxylate reductase/hydroxypyruvate reductase (GRHPR; EC 1.1.1.79) in liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: PAS-positive lymphocyte vacuolization
terms.definition: Presence of lymphocytes with positive staining for periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) cytoplasmic vacuoles.

terms.name: Lipid-laden bone-marrow macrophages
terms.definition: Bone marrow with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids.

terms.name: Bone marrow monocytosis
terms.definition: Increased count of monocytes in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Sunflower cataract
terms.definition: Sunflower cataract (SC) is a type of anterior subcapsular cataract almost only seen in Wilson disease, an autosomal-recessive condition with a defect in the metabolism of copper leading to accumulation of copper in the liver and basal ganglia. SC consists of a thin, centralized opacification that is located directly under the anterior capsule and encompasses between one-third and one-half of the anterior lens pole surface area. In all cases, the central opacification is surrounded by additional, secondary opacifications arranged in ray-like structures around it. This pattern is said to resemble a sunflower, with a large central disk surrounded by petals.

terms.name: Anti-lamin A antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗核纤层蛋白A抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against lamin A.

terms.name: Anti-lamin C antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗核纤层蛋白C抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against human lamin C.

terms.name: Anti-vinculin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against vinculin.

terms.name: Anti-annexin A5 antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against annexin A5.

terms.name: Bulging fontanelle
terms.definition: An outward curving of a fontanelle, which occurs when fluid builds up in the brain or the brain swells, causing increased pressure inside the skull.

terms.name: 3-4 toe cutaneous syndactyly
terms.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 3 and 4.

terms.name: Triangular nail
terms.definition: Nail so wide as long with a distal part presenting an acute angle.

terms.name: Distal tibiofibular synostosis
terms.definition: Fusion of the distal (i.e.., located away from the trunk) part of the tibia and fibula.

terms.name: Abnormal metacarpal ossification
synonyms: Abnormal maturation of long bone of hand
terms.definition: Any abnormal process of ossification of the metacarpal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metacarpal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metacarpal I). At the eighth to ninth week of fetal life, ossification commences in the middle of the body. At the third year the distal extremities of the metacarpals of the fingers and the base of the metacarpal of the thumb begin to ossify; they unite with the bodies at about the twentieth year.

terms.name: Rib spur
terms.definition: A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from a rib.

terms.name: Crescent-shaped iliac bone
terms.definition: Deficient mineralization of the iliac wings, giving a paraglider/crescent shape to the iliac bone.

terms.name: Abnormal ischium ossification
terms.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of ischial bones.

terms.name: Femoral neck fracture
terms.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the neck of femur.

terms.name: Papillary dermis eosinophilic hyaline material
terms.definition: Accumulation of eosinophilic hyaline material observed around the papillary dermis and the blood vessels located in it. The papillary dermis is the uppermost layer of the dermis. It intertwines with the rete ridges of the epidermis and is composed of fine and loosely arranged collagen fibers.

terms.name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
terms.definition: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) is an exocrine neoplasm of the pancreas consisting of epithelial cells growing within the pancreatic ducts (main pancreatic duct or its major branches) and producing mucin. IPMN is a mucin-producing pancreatic cystic tumor. IPMN contains epithelial cells that can create papillary projections.

terms.name: Medium vessel vasculitis
terms.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects medium-sized blood vessels. By common usage, vasculitis predominantly refers to arterial disease. Medium-sized vasculitis is observed in diseases including polyarteritis nodosa, Kawasaki disease, and cutaneous polyarteritis nodosa.

terms.name: Elevated muscle fiber laminin alpha 5 expression
terms.name_zh: 肌纤维层粘连蛋白α5表达升高
terms.definition: A decreased amount of laminin alpha-5 in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue. Laminin subunit alpha-5 is a protein encoded by the LAMA5 gene.

terms.name: Paravertebral mass
terms.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized next to the vertebral column. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Phlebolith
terms.definition: A calcified structure that forms within a vein. The pathogenesis of phleboliths is thought to involve an organized thrombus produced when the peripheral blood flow slows. The thrombus calcifies, form- ing the core of the phlebolith. Then, the fibrinous com- ponent undergoes secondary calcification and becomes attached. Repetition of this process causes enlargement of the phlebolith.

terms.name: Bladder rupture
terms.definition: A perforation in the wall of the urinary bladder. Bladder rupture, a relatively rare condition, is most commonly due to abdominal or pelvic trauma but may be spontaneous or iatrogenic in association with surgical or endoscopic procedures. In most cases, patients with bladder rupture have gross hematuria. Other symptoms of bladder rupture include pelvic pain, lower abdominal pain, and difficulty voiding.

terms.name: Elevated myocardial iron load
terms.definition: Increased amount of iron in myocardial tissue.

terms.name: Right ventricular regional wall motion abnormality
terms.definition: The occurrence of abnormal or absent contractility of a region of the heart muscle of the right ventricule. Conventional assessment of RWMA is based on visual interpretation of endocardial excursion and myocardial thickening from the echocardiogram videos.

terms.name: Right ventricular regional akinesia
terms.definition: A region of the right ventricle exhibits absent contraction (akinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle.

terms.name: Right ventricular regional dyskinesia
terms.definition: A region of the right ventricle exhibits abnormal contraction (dyskinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle, leading to outward bulging or ballooning during contraction or inadequate inward movement.

terms.name: Right ventricular aneurysm
terms.definition: A localized, abnormal dilation or bulging of a portion of the right ventricular wall.

terms.name: Glomerular immune-complex deposition
terms.name_zh: 肾小球免疫复合物沉积
terms.definition: Accumulation of immune deposits, containing immunoglobulins, complement, and other proteins, at various intraglomerular locations. This can lead to glomerulonephritis, with the type of injury that results being dependent on four factors: the mechanism of the deposit formation, the site of deposit formation, the composition of the deposits and the amount of the deposits.

terms.name: Glomerular PLA2R immune-complex deposition
terms.name_zh: 肾小球PLA2R免疫复合物沉积
terms.definition: Accumulation of immune deposits, containing auto-antibodies against the podocyte antigen M-type phospholipase A2 receptor (PLA2R) in intraglomerular locations.

terms.name: Elevated urinary L-glycerate level
terms.definition: The amount of L-glycerate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Breast myxoma
terms.definition: A rare, benign mesenchymal tumor of the breast characterized histologically by stellate, round, and spindle-shaped cells with vesicular nuclei and scant cytoplasm that are scattered in the myxoid stroma.

terms.name: Ovarian cystadenoma
terms.definition: A common, benign ovarian tumor that carries a good prognosis. The two most frequent types of cystadenomas are serous and mucinous cystadenomas whereas endometrioid and clear cell cystadenomas are rare.

terms.name: Abnormal CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Decreased CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度降低
terms.definition: Concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary mevalonate lactone level
terms.name_zh: 尿甲羟戊酸内酯水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of mevalonate lactone in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-von Willebrand factor antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗血管性血友病因子抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to von Willebrand factor (VWF).

terms.name: Increased total natural killer cell count
terms.name_zh: 总自然杀伤细胞计数升高
terms.definition: The absolute count of natural killer cells in the blood, per microlitre, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Myositis-specific autoantibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that display a high degree of specificity for idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (myositis-specific autoantibodies (MSAs)). MSAs are clinically useful biomarkers to help the diagnosis of polymyositis/dermatomyositis (PM/DM). Many of these are also associated with a unique clinical subset of PM/DM, making them useful in predicting and monitoring certain clinical manifestations.

terms.name: Abnormal serum osmolality
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the serum osmolality, defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea.

terms.name: Low serum osmolality
terms.definition: Serum osmolality, which is defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: High serum osmolality
terms.definition: Serum osmolality, which is defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: History of compressive dressings
terms.definition: A past medical history of having been treated with tight bandages, compression sleeve, tight casts or splints, immobilizers, or similar items such as overly tight clothes, watch bands, or handcuffs.

terms.name: Triggered by overhead motions
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is induced by repeatedly performing overhead motions, such as painting a ceiling or working on objects located above the head, or some types of athletics.

terms.name: Radiating pain
terms.definition: Pain that is perceived to extend or spread out from one area of the body to another.

terms.name: Mitral opening snap
terms.definition: Opening snap is an additional sound heard in the diastole that is related to the opening of a stenotic but mobile mitral valve. It is described as an early diastolic, high-pitched sound, which is associated with opening of the mitral and/or tricuspid valve.

terms.name: Mucus in stool
terms.definition: Abnormally increased amount of mucus in the feces. Mucus is a slippery aqueous secretion produced by mucous membranes including those of the intestines.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CCL3 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of C-C Motif Ligand 3 (CCL3) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CCL4 concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of C-C Motif Ligand 4 (CCL4) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF 14-3-3 protein concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of 14-3-3 protein in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF dihydrobiopterin concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液二氢生物蝶呤浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of dihydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Left atrial fibrosis
terms.definition: Atrial fibrosis is an hallmark of atrial structural remodelling, characterized by the aberrant activation, proliferation and differentiation of fibroblasts, and subsequent excessive synthesis and irregular deposition of extracellular matrix proteins.

terms.name: Abnormal circulating proANP concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环心房钠尿肽原浓度异常
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of proANP (atrial natriuretic peptide pro-hormone) in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Decreased circulating NT-proANP concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环N末端B型利钠肽原浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of NT-proANP (= N-terminal proatrial natriuretic peptide) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环1-吡咯啉-5-羧酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced tissue delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase (P5CDH; EC 1.5.1.12) below the lower limit of normal. P5CDH can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. P5CDH is a mitochondrial matrix NAD(+)-dependent dehydrogenase which catalyzes the second step of the proline degradation pathway, converting pyrroline-5-carboxylate to glutamate.

terms.name: Elevated circulating N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血N-氨甲酰基-β-氨基异丁酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Low tissue ferrochelatase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织亚铁螯合酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of Ferrochelatase (FECH; EC 4.99.1.1) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. FECH is the terminal enzyme of the heme biosynthetic pathway, and catalyzes the insertion of iron into protoporphyrin to form heme.

terms.name: Elevated circulating heptacarboxylporphyrin concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环七羧基卟啉浓度升高
