terms.definition: The concentration of heptacarboxylporphyrin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Aggravated by menstruation
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe during mensutruation.

terms.name: Reduced breast milk zinc concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of zinc in breast milk is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary bile acid level
terms.definition: The amount of bile acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary glyoxylic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of glyoxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. The conjugate base of glyoxylic acid is known as glyoxylate.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环3-羟基邻氨基苯甲酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating CXCL9 concentration
synonyms: Elevated circulating monokine induced by gamma-interferon concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of chemokine (C-X-C motif) ligand 9 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Thickened fibular cortex
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in the thickness (distance between the inner and outer boundaries) of the outer layer (cortex) of the fibula.

terms.name: New medication added in recent weeks
terms.definition: Medical history of starting a new medication recently.

terms.name: Noctural pain
terms.definition: Pain at night.

terms.name: Femoral osteosclerosis
terms.definition: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density of the femur. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.

terms.name: Absent Bell phenomenon
terms.definition: The Bell phenomenon is the reflex upward movement of the front of the eyeball when the eyelids close (or blink). It protects the eye by helping to keep the cornea moist. This term refers to a lack of this phenomenon, which can be observed with certain conditions such as congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles.

terms.name: Dalen-Fuchs nodules
terms.definition: Nodules (yellow-white subretinal pigment epithelium lesions) that form between Bruch membrane and the retinal pigment epithelium.

terms.name: Triggering by ocular trauma
terms.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by trauma to the eye.

terms.name: Gelatinous drop-like dystrophic cornea
terms.definition: Deposition of amyloid material in the subepithelial space of the cornea.

terms.name: Hepatic reticuloendothelial system cell iron deposition
terms.name_zh: 肝网状内皮系统细胞铁沉积
terms.definition: Abnormal accumulation of iron in reticuloendothelial cells of the liver. This feature can be appreciated on liver biopsy by Perls iron stain for granular iron deposition, based on agreement that only discernible hemosiderin granules represent significant iron deposition.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal kindlin-1 expression
terms.definition: Lower than normal amount of kindlin-1 in the epidermis.

terms.name: Central giant cell lesion of the jaw
terms.name_zh: 颌骨中央性巨细胞病变
terms.definition: A benign proliferative and asymptomatic intraosseous lesion of the jaw formed by fibrous tissue that contains multiple focus of hemorrhage and an aggregation of multinucleated giant cells.

terms.name: Terminal hepatic lobular vascular occlusion
terms.definition: A type of Hepatic venous outflow obstruction characterized by fibrous concentric narrowing of zone 3 terminal hepatic venules, centrilobular hepatocyte necrosis, and sinusoidal congestion, accomapnied by necrosis of pericentral hepatocytes, and narrowing and eventual fibrosis of central veins.

terms.name: Axonal spheroids
terms.definition: During neurodegeneration, bubble-like swellings form along the length of the axon, a primary and early effect of dynamic axonal deformation. These varicosities, spheroids, or swellings have been described as beads on a string and branches bearing fruit, and they frequently appear on degenerating axons.

terms.name: Decreased liver bile salt export pump expression
terms.name_zh: 肝脏胆盐输出泵表达降低
terms.definition: Amount of bile salt export pump (BSEP, coded by the ABCB11 gene) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced tissue type II iodothyronine deiodinase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of type II iodothyronine deiodinase below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in tissues such as cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase activity
terms.definition: Activity of fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase (EC 1.2.1.3) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

terms.name: Decreased circulating pancreatic isoamylase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环胰型同工淀粉酶活性降低
terms.definition: The activity of alpha-Amylase (1,4-alpha-D-glucan-4-glucanohydrolase E. C. 3.2.1.1, pancreatic isoamylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced tissue guanidinoacetate methyltransferase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme guanidinoacetate methyltransferase in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced erythrocyte galactokinase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of galactokinase (EC 2.7.1.6) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Auspitz sign
terms.definition: The appearance of small bleeding points after successive layers of scale have been removed from the surface of psoriatic papules or plaques.

terms.name: Salty tasting skin
terms.definition: Skin tastes marked salty without an obvious explanation such as heat or exercise. This finding can be observed in infants with cystic fibrosis.

terms.name: Scalp nodule
terms.definition: A small firm lump located in the skin of the scalp that is greater than one cm in diameter.

terms.name: History of undercooked pork ingestion
terms.definition: A history of ingestion of undercooked pork. This is particularly relevant in areas with a high prevalence of cysticercosis.

terms.name: History of recent rodent exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposed to rodents (mice, rats, prarie dogs) within several weeks of the current presenting complaint.

terms.name: Positive CSF fungus test
terms.definition: Any kind of test for a fungal infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) positive.

terms.name: Positive CSF human T-lymphotropic virus type I antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of human T-lymphotropic virus type I.

terms.name: Positive chlamydia trachomatis urine nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Chlamydia trachomatis nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Anti-streptococcus deoxyribonuclease-B antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗链球菌脱氧核糖核酸酶-B抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against streptococcal deoxyribonuclease-B (ADN-B). Almost all group A streptococci have this antigen and a strong elevation of the antibody is observed in patients with acute rheumatic fever, acute glomerulonephritis and other streptococcal infections.

terms.name: Positive streptococcus A rapid antigen detection test
terms.definition: Positive detection of a group A streptococcal antigen in a test perforned on a throat swab.

terms.name: Positive synovial mycobacterial culture
terms.definition: Growth of a mycobacteria in a culture derived from synovial fluid.

terms.name: Positive mycobacterial synovial nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of mycobacteria in the synovial fluid by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive bloodstream babesia nucleic acid pathogen test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of genus Babesia (parasite) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive bloodstream influenza nucleic test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of an influenza virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive bloodstream parainfluenza virus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of parainfluenza virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive bloodstream adenovirus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of an adenovirus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Anti-Francisella tularensis antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗土拉弗朗西斯菌抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Francisella tularensis.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream MERS coronavirus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Middle East Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive nasopharyngeal corynebacterium diphtheriae nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Corynebacterium diphtheriae in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Pediculosis capitis
terms.definition: Visualization of at least one louse on visual inspection of the head hair. Use of a bright light, magnifying lens, or fine-toothed comb (lice comb) can aid in diagnosis.

terms.name: Premature glabellar skin wrinkling
terms.definition: The presence in the skin of the glabellar region of an increased degree of wrinkling (irregular folds and indentations) of the skin as compared with age-related norms.

terms.name: Flexural reticulate hyperpigmentation
synonyms: Reticular pigmented anomaly of the flexures
terms.definition: Hyperpigmented macules with a reticulate (net-like) pattern involving the neck, axillae, groins, and other flexures like the inframammary folds in females. Histopathology shows orthokeratosis or hyperkeratosis, thinning of the suprapapillary epithelium, elongation of the rete ridges, hyperpigmentation of the basal layer, and follicular cysts. A perivascular lymphohistiocytic infiltrate can be observed in the papillary dermis.

terms.name: Elevated fractional excretion of urate
terms.definition: Abnormally increased proportion of filtered urate that is excreted in the urine as calculated using the concentrations of urate and creatinine in both blood and urine. Clinically this manifests as uric acid wasting.

terms.name: Abnormal urinary creatine level
terms.definition: The amount of creatine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

terms.name: Decreased urinary creatine level
terms.definition: The amount of creatine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating PINP concentration
terms.name_zh: 血Ⅰ型前胶原N端前肽浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of PINP (= aminoterminal propeptide of type I procollagen) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased tissue S-adenosylhomocysteine hydrolase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸水解酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of S-adenosylhomocysteine hydrolase (EC 3.3.1.1) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including erythrocytes and liver.

terms.name: Decreased urinary dopamine level
terms.definition: The concentration of dopamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated erythrocyte AICA-ribotide concentration
terms.name_zh: 红细胞AICA核苷酸浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide (AICA-riboside) in red blood cells is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating monomethyl sterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环单甲基甾醇浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of monomethylsterols (such as 4alpha-monomethylsterol) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating dimethyl sterol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环二甲基固醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of dimethylsterols in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating C-terminal fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
terms.name_zh: 血C端成纤维细胞生长因子23浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of the C-terminal portion of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿5-羟吲哚乙酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid (5-HIAA) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating thiosulfate concentration
terms.name_zh: 血硫代硫酸盐浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of thiosulfate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating interleukin 1 receptor antagonist concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环白细胞介素1受体拮抗剂浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of interleukin 1 receptor antagonist (IL-1RA) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive CSF West Nile virus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of West Nile virus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive CSF herpes simplex virus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of herpes simplex virus (HSV) nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive CSF cryptococcal antigen test
terms.definition: A test result demonstrating the presence of a cryptococal antigen in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Positive rubella CSF culture
terms.definition: Growth of rubella virus in a culture derived from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Positive CSF treponema pallidum nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Treponema pallidum (syphillis) nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Decreased CSF tetrahydrobiopterin level
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液四氢生物蝶呤水平降低
terms.definition: Concentration of tetrahydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased CSF N-acetyl-aspartyl-glutamate concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液N-乙酰天冬氨酰谷氨酸浓度降低
terms.definition: The concentration of N-acetyl-aspartyl-glutamate (NAAG) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive CSF Tropheryma whipplei bacteria microscopy
terms.definition: Demonstration of Tropheryma whipplei bacteria in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) my microscopic analysis.

terms.name: CSF treponemal antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性
synonyms: Positive CSF Treponema pallidum hemoagglutination assay
Positive CSF Treponema pallidum particle agglutination test
Positive CSF fluorescent treponemal antibody absorption
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of treponema pallidum (syphilis).

terms.name: Echophenomenon
terms.definition: A stimulus triggered repetition of an action (echopraxia) or sound (echolalia) performed without the explicit awareness of an individual.

terms.name: Paracentral hyper-autofluorecence
terms.definition: Increased autofluorescence in areas adjacent to the central macula (but not including the very center).

terms.name: Fixed fetal extremities
terms.definition: A condition in which the limbs of a fetus are immobile or held in a rigid position. The limbs are consistently immobile and rigid. Fixed extremities can be observed during prenatal imaging (e.g., ultrasound).

terms.name: Abnormal peripapillary microvascular network
terms.definition: The density of the deep peripapillary microvascular network (i.e., the number of blood vessels) is below the lower limit of normal. This finding is observable by optical coherence tomography angiography.

terms.name: Auriculitis
terms.definition: Inflammation of the skin and soft tissues of the outer ear.

terms.name: Recent history of moisture in external ear canal
terms.definition: A recent history of being exposed to moisture in the external ear canal.

terms.name: History of recent trauma to external ear canal
terms.definition: Medical history of trauma to the external ear canal, including cotton-swab use, in recent weeks.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 4-tyramine level
terms.definition: The amount of 4-tyramine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxykynurenine concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环3-羟基犬尿氨酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxykynurenine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Posterior vertebral body notching
terms.definition: Exaggerated posterior vertebral notches.

terms.name: Cone-shaped distal tibial epiphysis
terms.name_zh: 胫骨远端骨骺锥形改变
terms.definition: The distal epiphysis (rounded portion of bone at the far end of the tibia distal to the growth plate) has an abnormal cone-shaped appearance, that is, the epiphysis has a globular form at the bottom, tapering to a point at the top.

terms.name: Osteoporotic femoral neck
terms.definition: Low bone mass localized in the neck of the femur. Osteoporosis is defined based on a T-score of -2.5 or lower (bone mineral density of 2.5 or more standard deviations below that of a normal young adult).

terms.name: Olanzapine exposure
terms.definition: History of having taken olanzapine.

terms.name: Reduced tissue phosphomannomutase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme phosphomannomutase (EC 5.4.2.8) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes, fibroblasts, and liver.

terms.name: Reduced tissue phosphomannose isomerase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme phosphomannose isomerase (PMI; EC 5.3.1.8) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes, fibroblasts, and liver.

terms.name: Reduced tissue palmitoyl-protein thioesterase activity
terms.definition: Activity of the enzyme palmitoyl-protein thioesterase (PPT; EC 3.1.2.22) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

terms.name: Maternal household cat exposure
terms.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of regular exposure to one or more cats, e.g., in the household.

terms.name: Protein craving
terms.definition: Unusually strong preference for protein-rich foods.

terms.name: Absent superficial temporal artery pulse
terms.definition: The pulsation of the superficial temporal artery cannot be detected on physical examination.

terms.name: Basilar artery fenestration
terms.definition: A fenestration affecting the basilar artery. Basilar fenestration typically occurs at the lower end of the basilar artery just as the vertebral arteries join Fenestrations of intracranial arteries are segmental duplications of the lumen into two distinct endothelium-lined channels, which may or may not share their adventitial layer. They can range from a small focus of divided tissue to long-segment duplication. Fenestrations are the result of partial failure of fusion of paired primitive embryologic vessels or incomplete obliteration of different anastomosis in a primitive vascular network. The association of fenestrations with aneurysms has been suggested in many small case series, though the exact relationship is not well defined.

terms.name: Displacement of the extensor tendon in metacarpophalangeal joint
terms.definition: Dislocation of the extensor tendons from their central position on the metacarpal heads can be traumatic, congenital, spontaneous, or degenerative.

terms.name: Heloma
terms.definition: A corn, also known as a clavus, heloma, or focal intractable plantar hyperkeratosis, is a type of callosity. Corns are uncomfortable, thickened skin lesions that result from repeated mechanical trauma due to friction or pressure forces.

terms.name: Exacerbated by pronation
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) pronation. Pronation of the hand involves the rotation of the forearm and wrist so that the palm of the hand faces downwards or towards the back (posteriorly).

terms.name: Distortion of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure
terms.definition: Change in the normal shape (displacement, asymmetry) of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure. This finding can be identified prenatally by sonography or magnetic resonance imaging.

terms.name: Positive lacrimal tract actinomyces culture
terms.definition: Growth of Actinomyces israelii (anaerobic filamentous gram positive) culture of lacrimal discharge or concretions.

terms.name: Eschar
terms.definition: A type of wound characterized by dry, black, hard necrotic tissue.

terms.name: History of wearing tightly fitted clothing
terms.definition: History of wearing tight clothing such as compression shorts, sports bras, bike shorts, wet suits, spandex, veils, and tight hats.

terms.name: Anti-folate receptor antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the folate receptor in the blood circulation.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream VDRL test
terms.definition: An abnormal (positive) result of the Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) test performed in peripheral blood, suggesting past or present syphilis.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream rapid plasma reagin test
terms.definition: Positive result of the the rapid plasma reagin test (RPR test. This is a rapid diagnostic test that looks for non-specific antibodies in the blood of the patient that may indicate an infection by syphilis or related non-venereal treponematoses.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream HIV p24 antigen test
terms.definition: Demonstration of the p24 antigen of human immunodeficiency virus in the bloodstream.

terms.name: Positive Quantiferon tuberculosis test
terms.definition: A positive Quantiferon test result indicating Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The Quantiferon assay is designed to stimulate IFN-gamma release from CD4+ T cells in a single tuberculosis antigen tube using long peptides from three M. tuberculosis antigens.

terms.name: Tzanck smear with multinucleated giant cells
terms.definition: Tzanck smear demonstrates multinucleated giant cells, a sign that is suggestive for herpetic infections. Such smears are taken from skin lesions and display multinucleated cells with ground glass nuclei, nuclear moulding, and margination of nuclear chromatin typical of herpes simplex and varicella infection.

terms.name: Positive Mazzotti test
terms.definition: Locally applied 1.6 percent diethylcarbamazine citrate in Nivea lotion can be used as a diagnostic test for onchocerciasis. Papular reactions are considered as positive test results.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream Tropheryma whipplei nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Tropheryma whipplei in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2,8-dihydroxyadenine level
terms.name_zh: 尿2,8-二羟基腺嘌呤水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine fructose level
terms.definition: Amount of fructose in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary uroporphyrin level
terms.definition: The amount of uroporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary phosphohydroxylysine level
terms.name_zh: 尿磷酸羟赖氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of phosphohydroxylysine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Cervical C6/C7 vertebrae fusion
terms.definition: Fusion of cervical vertebrae at C6 and C7, caused by a failure in the normal segmentation or division of the cervical vertebrae during the early weeks of fetal development, leading to a short neck with a low hairline at the back of the head, and restricted mobility of the upper spine.

terms.name: Periumbilical depression
terms.definition: The tissue that immediately surrounds the umbilicus is located below the normal plane of the abdomen.

terms.name: Thickened tibial cortex
terms.definition: Abnormally increased thicknes of the cortical layer of the tibia.

terms.name: Thickened femoral cortex
terms.definition: Abnormally increased thicknes of the cortical layer of the femur.

terms.name: Thickened cortex of the radius
terms.definition: Abnormally increased thickness of the cortical layer of the radius.

terms.name: Thickened cortex of the ulna
terms.definition: Abnormally increased thickness of the cortical layer of the ulna.

terms.name: Elevated circulating aspartate aminotransferase to alanine aminotransferase ratio
terms.name_zh: 血循环天冬氨酸氨基转移酶/丙氨酸氨基转移酶比值升高
terms.definition: Aspartate aminotransferase to alanine aminotransferase ratio increased greater than 1.5.

terms.name: Temporomandibular joint dislocation
terms.definition: The lower jawbone (mandible) pulls away from the temporomandibular joints (TMJ). It is characterized by pain, clicking and functional restriction.

terms.name: Amyloid goiter
terms.definition: Amyloidosis is defined as the accumulation of amorphous, proteinaceous material in different parts of the body. Amyloid can be deposited in the thyroid gland in such quantities to cause a clinically apparent enlargement of the gland known as Amyloid goiter.

terms.name: Prominent lesser trochanter
terms.definition: Abnormally large lesser trochanter.

terms.name: Melorheostosis
terms.definition: Regions of sclerosing hyperostosis in the cortex of long bones, which might have a radiologic appearance of dripping candle wax.

terms.name: Transverse terminal limb defect
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the extremity. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.

terms.name: Elevated circulating beta-glucuronidase activity
terms.name_zh: 血循环β-葡萄糖醛酸酶活性升高
terms.definition: The activity of beta-glucuronidase (EC 3.2.1.31) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated osmolality gap
terms.definition: Plasma osmolality is determined mainly by Sodium, its counter ions, and uncharged species such as Glucose and Urea. Knowledge of the plasma concentration of these species allows calculation of the plasma osmolality quite accurately. If the difference between the measured osmolality (MO) and calculated osmolality (CO) is known as the osmolar gap (OG) is large (greater than 15) osmolar gap can help identify the presence in plasma of substances such as ethanol, methanol, isopropanol, ethylene glycol, propylene glycol..

terms.name: Elevated circulating bile alcohol concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环胆汁醇浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of bile alcohols in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF tetrahydrobiopterin level
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液四氢生物蝶呤水平升高
terms.definition: Concentration of tetrahydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液5-羟吲哚乙酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Cerebrospinal fluid eosinophilia
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液嗜酸性粒细胞增多
terms.definition: Presence of at least 10% eosinophils in the total cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leukocyte count.

terms.name: Reduced C27 3beta-HSD activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of 3beta-hydroxy-delta5-C27-steroid oxidoreductase (C27 3beta-HSD) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Reduced procollagen-lysine,2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 1 activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of procollagen-lysine,2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 1 (PLOD1; also known as Lysyl hydroxylase; EC 1.14.11.4) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. PLOD1 catalyzes the formation of hydroxylysine in collagens and other proteins with collagen-like amino acid sequences, by the hydroxylation of lysine residues in X-lys-gly sequences.

terms.name: Diminished tissue fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织延胡索酰乙酰乙酸水解酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase (FAH; EC 3.7.1.2) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue peptidase D activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of Peptidase D (EC 3.4.13.9; also known as prolidase, imidodipeptidase, proline dipeptidase, and aminoacyl-L-proline hydrolase) below the lower limit of normal. The activity of this enzyme can be measured in erythrocytes, leukocytes, or fibroblasts.

terms.name: Reduced tissue glycine cleavage enzyme activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of the glycine cleavage enzyme below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Diminished alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.name_zh: 培养成纤维细胞α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme is a multienzyme complex consisting of 3 protein subunits, oxoglutarate dehydrogenase, also known as alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase or E1k (EC 1.2.4.2.), dihydrolipoyl succinyltransferase (DLST, or E2k; 126063), and dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (DLD, or E3; 238331). The complex catalyzes a key reaction in the Krebs tricarboxylic acid cycle.

terms.name: Increased circulating dihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环二羟基胆甾烷酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of dihydroxycholestanoic acid (DHCA) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Reduced tissue phosphorylase kinase activity
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of phosphorylase kinase below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Hyperkalemia while symptomatic
terms.definition: Increased concentration of potassium in the blood circulation specifically measured during a disease flareup, attack, or exacerbation.

terms.name: Elevated urinary gamma-glutamylcysteine level
terms.name_zh: 尿γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of gamma-glutamylcysteine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive CSF mycobacterial culture
terms.definition: Growth of mycobacteria in a culture derived from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

terms.name: Positive respiratory tract nucleic acid pathogen test
terms.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of a sputum or pharyngeal sample test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen.

terms.name: Positive respiratory tract SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus nucleic acid in the sputum or pharyngeal sample by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive fecal cryptosporidium antigen test
terms.definition: Cryptosporidium antigen present in stool. Tests include direct fluorescent-antibody (DFA), which detects intact organisms, and enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), which detect soluble stool antigens.

terms.name: Horizontal position of testicle
terms.definition: The Bell Clapper deformity is one of the causes for the testicular torsion. In this condition, testis lacks a normal attachment to tunica vaginalis and hangs freely, causing it to sit horizontally rather than vertically in the scrotum.

terms.name: Localized soft-tissue swelling on extremity
terms.name_zh: 肢体局限性软组织肿胀
terms.definition: Abnormal enlargement (swelling) that is restricted to a specific part of a limb.

terms.name: Abnormal scleral thickness
terms.definition: Any deviation from the normal height of the sclera, the white part of the eye that forms the tough, fibrous outer layer of the exterior of the eyeball.

terms.name: Multiple eyelid beaded papules
terms.name_zh: 多发性眼睑串珠状丘疹
terms.definition: Multiple beaded papules along the eyelid margins and inner canthus.

terms.name: Nonexudative conjunctivitis
terms.definition: A type of conjunctivitis that is not characterized by appreciable exudate, i.e., fluid, cells, or other substances that have escaped from blood vessels and have been deposited around the eyelids.

terms.name: Nematode in retina
terms.definition: Demonstration of a nematode (roundworm) in the retina, generally by an imaging procedure such as fundoscopy.

terms.name: Vascular compression of the eighth cranial nerve
synonyms: Neurovascular compression syndrome of the vestibulocochlear nerve
terms.definition: A condition in which blood vessels adjacent to the eighth cranial nerve (vestibulocochlear nerve) such as the anterior inferior cerebellar artery abnormally contact or compress the vestibulocochlear nerve as it exits the brainstem or travels within the cerebellopontine angle.

terms.name: Beaded bile ducts
terms.definition: Multifocal intra- and extra-hepatic bile duct strictures alternating with normal caliber or slightly dilated segments, resembling beads on a string.

terms.name: Cardiac mass
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized in the heart. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Superior olive hypertrophy
terms.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the superior olive, also known as the superior olivary complex. The superior olive is a collection of brainstem nuclei that is located in pons, functions in multiple aspects of hearing and is an important component of the ascending and descending auditory pathways of the auditory system.

terms.name: Spinal extradural arachnoid cyst
terms.definition: Spinal extradural arachnoid cyst is a cyst in the spinal canal that protrudes into the epidural space from a defect in the dura mater.

terms.name: Temporal cortex localization
terms.definition: Localization to or predominance in the temporal cortex of the brain.

terms.name: Basilar meningeal enhancement
terms.definition: Abnormal enhancement of CT or MIR contrast medium in the basilar meninges, that is, those located in the basal cisterns or spaces at the base of the brain, due to increased permeability of blood vessels in these areas.

terms.name: Megacolon
terms.definition: Persistent and substantial increase in diameter diameter and length of the colon.

terms.name: Thyroid cyst
terms.definition: A fluid-filled sac or cavity that develops due to fluid accumulation within the thyroid tissue.

terms.name: Decreased circulating sulfate concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of sulfate in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Cold intolerance
terms.definition: The inability to maintain a comfortable body temperature in a cold environment or cold temperatures.

terms.name: Head and neck distribution
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the head and neck region.

terms.name: Symmetric distribution
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is highly similar on the left and right sides of the body.

terms.name: Muscle extensor surface location
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in extensor surface of an extremity.

terms.name: Dermal foam cells
terms.definition: Presence of lipid-laden macrophages (foam cells) in the inner layer of the skin (dermis).

terms.name: Diminished tissue very long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织极长链酰基辅酶A脱氢酶活性降低
terms.definition: Diminished activity of Very long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), an enzyme that catalyzes the initial step of mitochondrial beta-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids with a chain length of 14 to 20 carbons. VLCAD activity can be measured with biochemical testing using cultured fibroblasts or lymphocytes.

terms.name: Diminished tissue glycogen branching enzyme activity
terms.name_zh: 组织糖原分支酶活性降低
terms.definition: Activity of glycogen branching enzyme in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Parotid adenoma
terms.definition: A benign tumor of the parotid salivary gland.

terms.name: Elevated serum-ascites albumin gradient (SAAG)
terms.name_zh: 血清-腹水白蛋白梯度（SAAG）升高
terms.definition: An elevation of the serum ascites albumin gradient (SAAG), which is based on the difference between the albumin level of serum and of ascitic fluid, may be used to assess the extent of ascites. The SAAG is thought to reflect the colloid osmotic pressure gradient and the degree of portal hypertension. It has been shown that SAAG is a better discriminator of portal hypertension than ascites. A SAAG of 1.1 gm/dL or higher is considered as high, indicating the presence of portal hypertension, while SAAG less than 1.1 gm/dL is low, indicating the absence of portal hypertension.

terms.name: Transverse smile
terms.definition: Inability to raise the corners of the mouth during the act of smiling due to facial muscle weakness. The act of smiling is accompanied by a horizontal movement of the mouth.

terms.name: Hyperphalangy of the 4th finger
terms.definition: An accessory phalanx of the fourth (ring) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint.

terms.name: Delayed distal femoral epiphyseal ossification
terms.name_zh: 股骨远端骨骺骨化延迟
terms.definition: Developmental delay of ossification of the distal epiphysis of the femur.

terms.name: Delayed tibial epiphyseal ossification
terms.definition: Developmental delay of ossification of an epiphysis of the tibia.

terms.name: Toe hyperphalangy
terms.definition: Hyperphalangy is a digit morphology in which increased numbers of phalanges are arranged linearly within a toe. That is, there is an accessory phalanx that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges.

terms.name: Sclerotic ilium
synonyms: Increased bone density of the ilium
terms.definition: An elevation in bone density in the ilium. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.

terms.name: Metaphyseal chevron deformity
terms.definition: The chevron sign refers to an inverted V-shape metaphyses. It is most commonly seen in the distal femur and tends to disappear with age.

terms.name: Popcorn calcification
terms.definition: Popcorn calcifications are areas of amorphous calcifications often with rings and arcs that resemble popped corn kernels in the metaphysis and epiphysis around the growth plate.

terms.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the calvaria
terms.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence or underdevelopment of the calvaria.

terms.name: Bowdler spurs
terms.definition: Transverse long bone midshaft spurs or osteochondral projections typically occuring in the fibulae and less commonly in the forearms.

terms.name: Delayed ossification of the clavicle
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the clavicle.

terms.name: Wide sacroiliac joint
terms.definition: Distance between the sacrum and the ilium bones of the pelvis at the sacroiliac joint is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Anti-Glutamate Receptor delta2 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗谷氨酸受体δ2抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against glutamate receptor delta2.

terms.name: Anti-dachshund family transcription factor 1 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗dachshund家族转录因子1抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against dachshund-homolog 1 (DACH1) autoantigen.

terms.name: Anti-potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗含钾通道四聚化结构域16抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 (KCTD16).

terms.name: Anti-regulator of G protein signaling 8 antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗G蛋白信号调节因子8抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against regulator of G-protein signaling 8 (RGS8).

terms.name: Anti-neurochondrin antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗神经软骨蛋白抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against neurochondrin .

terms.name: Anti-DCC netrin 1 receptor antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗DCC轴突导向因子1受体抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against Netrin-1 receptors DCC (deleted in colorectal carcinoma).

terms.name: Anti-recoverin antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against recoverin. Recoverins are calcium-binding proteins primarily expressed in retinal rod photoreceptors and primarily involved in phototransduction.

terms.name: Recent history of sedation by propofol infusion
terms.definition: A history of exposure to anesthesia by propofanol infusion recently before the presenting complaint.

terms.name: Enlarged humeral head
terms.definition: Size (volume) of the head of the humerus above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Enlarged radial head
terms.definition: Size (volume) of the head of the radius above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Enlarged distal tibial epiphysis
terms.definition: Size (volume) of the distal epiphysis of the tiba above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated blood bismuth concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of bismuth in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood bismuth concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.

terms.name: Elevated urine bismuth level
terms.definition: Detection of a level of bismuth in the urine high enough to raise the suspicion of bismuth toxicity, usually greater than 20microgram per deciliter.

terms.name: Distal radioulnar joint dislocation
terms.definition: Distal radioulnar joint dislocation is more commonly displaced dorsally (i.e. the distal ulna is dorsally dislocated with respect to the distal radius), but can be volarly displaced.

terms.name: Proximal radioulnar joint dislocation
terms.definition: he proximal radioulnar translocation means that both the radius and ulna are dislocated from the humerus.

terms.name: Absent toe phalanx flexion crease
terms.definition: Absence of one or more interphalangeal creases of a toe (i.e., of the transverse lines in the skin between the phalanges of the toes).

terms.name: White matter globoid cells
terms.definition: Multinucleated phagocytes in the cerebral white matter, typically are 10-15 micrometers in diameter, that contain fatty filamentous inclusions that stain positive for periodic acid-Schiff (PAS), which may be phagocytized myelin, as these cells are often found in proximity to sites where demyelination is prominent. Globoid cells have been to thought to originate from CNS resident microglia and/or infiltrating peripheral macrophages.

terms.name: Gaucher cells
terms.definition: Glucosylceramide forms fibrillar aggregates that accumulate in macrophages and result in the cell cytoplasm presenting a characteristic crumpled tissue paper appearance. These cells, known as Gaucher cells, infiltrate various organs (e.g., bone marrow, spleen, and liver) and are responsible for the major signs of Gaucher disease.

terms.name: Breast adenoma
terms.definition: A benign, well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the breast.

terms.name: Breast apocrine adenoma
terms.definition: A type of breast adenoma composed of benign apocrine cells.

terms.name: Fibrocystic breast lesion
terms.definition: A type of benign cyst or cysts in breast tissue that are typically mobile within the glandular breast tissue, chest wall, and skin and are rubber-like in texture. The main histological features are an extracellular matrix of collagen, peri canalicular patterns of stromal cells with the presence of florid epithelial hyperplasia.

terms.name: Pancreatic VIPoma
synonyms: Vasoactive intestinal peptide-secreting tumor of the pancreas
terms.definition: A type of neuroendocrine tumor that originates in the pancreas and secretes excessive amounts of vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP).

terms.name: Gastric carcinoid tumor
terms.definition: Originating from enterochromaffin-like cells, gastric carcinoid tumors are rare tumors that develop within the gastric mucosa. They can present as an isolated lesion or there can be multiple lesions. The tumor can invade locally into deeper structures of the gastrointestinal tract wall. Solitary gastric carcinoids have a greater chance for the development of malignancy and metastasis as compared to multiple gastric carcinoids due to hypergastrinemia.

terms.name: Positive skin scabies test
terms.definition: Identification of scabies by means of an examination of the skin such as microscopic identification of scabies mites, eggs, or feces from obtained scales by skin scraping.

terms.name: Positive mumps virus PCR test in the blood circulation
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of the mumps virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream tuberculosis-induced T-cell-based interferon-gamma release assay
synonyms: Positive T-SPOT-tuberculosis test in the bloodstream
terms.definition: Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in the bloodstream by means of detection of interferon-gamma secreted by T cells in response to specific antigens from Mycobacterium tuberculosis, commonly 6kD early secretory antigenic target-6 and 10kD culture filtrate protein-10.

terms.name: Positive blood Neisseria gonorrhoeae culture
terms.definition: Growth of Neisseria gonorrhoeae in a culture derived from circulating blood.

terms.name: Anti-mumps antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗腮腺炎病毒抗体阳性
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Mumps virus.

terms.name: Positive Vibrio cholerae stool culture
terms.definition: Growth of Vibrio cholerae in a culture derived from a feces sample.

terms.name: Positive cutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of mucocutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid in the skin by a method such as polymerase chain reaction. The sample is usually obtained by swab from skin or mucous membranes.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream cryptococcus culture
terms.definition: Growth of Cryptococcus in a culture derived from a blood sample.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream Borrelia miyamotoi nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Borrelia miyamotoi in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Positive bloodstream Coxsackievirus nucleic acid pathogen test
terms.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Coxsackievirus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

terms.name: Diminished tissue alpha-L-iduronidase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织α-L-艾杜糖醛酸酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-L-iduronidase (IDUA; EC 3.2.1.76) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

terms.name: Reduced tissue neuraminidase activity
terms.definition: Activity of neuraminidase (EC 3.2.1.18)in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts. Neuraminidase is also known as lysosomal sialidase.

terms.name: Nummular keratitis
terms.definition: Nummular keratitis consists of multiple scattered small round anterior corneal superficial stromal infiltrates.

terms.name: Swelling of inguinal region
terms.definition: Bulging in the area of the lower abdomen, just above the thigh and near the groin.

terms.name: Single lesion
terms.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are solitary and localized to a part of the skin, a tissue or an organ that differs from the surrounding healthy tissue.

terms.name: Dysorthography
terms.definition: A specific disorder of spelling. A score on a standardized spelling test is at least two standard errors of prediction below the level expected on the basis of the child's chronological age and general intelligence in the context of scores on reading accuracy and comprehension and on arithmetic that are within the normal range (within two standard deviations from the mean).

terms.name: Echogenic fetal colon
terms.definition: A type of echogenic fetal bowel in which the hyperechogenicity is strictly limited to the colon.

terms.name: Bone marrow edema
terms.definition: Accumulation of excess fluid in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Transverse terminal upper limb defect
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the arm, e.g. humerus, proximal forearm, wrist or finger. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.

terms.name: Trousseau sign
terms.definition: After inflating a blood pressure cuff from 10 mm Hg to 20 mm Hg over the patient's systolic blood pressure, the Trousseau sign is considered positive if carpal spasm develops, with flexion of the thumb and adduction of the finger within 3 minutes. However, this can be painful, so the time should be noted, and the cuff should be deflated once the test is positive.

terms.name: Craniocervical junction constriction
terms.definition: Congenital or acquired abnormalities of the occipital bone, foramen magnum, or first two cervical vertebrae that decrease the space for the lower brain stem and cervical cord. These malformations can lead to cranial nerve compression, vertebral artery compression, and obstructive hydrocephalus.

terms.name: Fibular torsion
terms.definition: Excessively rotated (also called torsion) position of the fibula (calf bone). An increased external rotation of the fibula in the incisura tibiofibularis of more than 5 degrees may lead to an increased pressure and will negatively affect the cartilage.

terms.name: Abnormal finger phalanx ossification
terms.definition: Any abnormal process of ossification of the phalangeal bones, which normally are ossified from the body and proximal extremity. Ossification of the body commences during the eighth week of fetal development. Ossification of the proximal extremity commences in the bones between the third and fourth years.

terms.name: Positive bloodstream EBV monospot test
terms.definition: The monospot test is a latex agglutination test which utilizes equine erythrocytes as the primary substrate and tests for specific heterophile antibodies produced by the human immune system in response to EBV infection. When these specific antibodies are present in the patient's blood specimen, exposure to equine erythrocytes will lead to clumping of the sample, thus signaling a positive agglutination reaction.

terms.name: Positive CSF Toxoplasma gondii antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Toxoplasma gondii.

terms.name: Positive tuberculin skin test
terms.definition: A positive result of the tuberculin skin test suggesting previous expouse or infection with mycobacterium teberculosis. A standard dose of five tuberculin units (TU) (0.1ml) is injected intradermally (into the skin) and read 48 to 72 h later. A person who has been exposed to the bacteria is expected to mount an immune response in the skin containing the bacterial proteins. The volar aspect of the forearm is the preferred site of test. The basis of reading is the presence or absence of induration, which may be determined by inspection (from a side view against the light as well as by direct light) and by palpation. For standardization, the diameter of induration should be measured transversely to the long axis of the forearm and recorded in millimeters.

terms.name: Anti-Treponema pallidum antibody positivity
terms.name_zh: 抗梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性
synonyms: Positive Fluorescent treponemal antibody absorption test
Treponemal antibody titer high in blood
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Treponema pallidum.

terms.name: Positive CSF Borrelia burgdorferi antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Borrelia burgdorferi.

terms.name: Positive CSF JC-virus antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of JC-virus (also known as JC-polyomavirus and John Cunningham virus).

terms.name: Neutralizing anti-rabies virus antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that act against the rabies virus function by blocking the binding of the glycoprotein to a receptor or preventing the membrane fusion process.

terms.name: Impaired hepatobiliary scintigraphy tracer uptake
terms.name_zh: 肝胆闪烁显像示踪剂摄取障碍
terms.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of radioactive tracer uptake upon hepatobiliary scintigraphy.

terms.name: Calcified pulmonary nodule
terms.definition: A pulmonary nodule with calcium deposits. On radiography, these nodules appear dense.

terms.name: Postprandial exacerbation
terms.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe following a meal.

terms.name: Koebner Phenomenon
terms.definition: The appearance of new skin lesions on previously unaffected skin secondary to trauma. This phenomenon is also termed the isomorphic (from Greek, equal shape) response, given the fact that the new lesions that appear are clinically and histologically identical to the patient's underlying cutaneous disease.

terms.name: Glenoid dysplasia
terms.definition: Glenoid dysplasia is a developmental anomaly of the scapula that is characterized by a bony deficiency of the posteroinferior glenoid and the adjacent scapular neck.

terms.name: Prolonged retraction of penile foreskin
terms.definition: A past medical history of recently having retracted the penile foreskin for a prolonged period of time. Paraphimosis commonly occurs iatrogenically, when the foreskin is retracted for cleaning, placement of a urinary catheter, a procedure such as a cystoscopy, or for penile examination. Failure to return the retracted foreskin over the glans promptly after the initial retraction can lead to paraphimosis.

terms.name: Thickened cortex of the clavicle
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the clavicle.

terms.name: Thickened cortex of the mandible
terms.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the mandible.

terms.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 1
terms.definition: Minor hypoplasia (developmental undergrowth) of the thumb, whereby all musculoskeletal and neurovascular components of the digit are present, just small in size (Blauth classification).

terms.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 2
terms.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby all of the osseous structures are present (may be small), and there is metacarpophalangeal joint ulnar collateral ligament instability and thenar hypoplasia.

terms.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3A
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IIIA
terms.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies with the carpometacarpal (CMC) joint intact. Absence of active motion at the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint.

terms.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3B
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IIIB
terms.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies characterized by basal metacarpal aplasia with deficient carpometacarpal (CMC) joint, and absence of metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint.

terms.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 4
synonyms: Hypoplasia of the thumb grade IV
terms.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb characterized by attachment to the hand only by the skin and digital neurovascular structures.

terms.name: Femoral osteopoikilosis
terms.definition: Multiple multiple, small, well-defined radiodense foci of cortical-like bone in the medullary space parallel to the trabeculae located in the femur. The loci correspond to condensations of the lamellar trabeculae on histology.

terms.name: Carotidynia
terms.definition: Pain or tenderness in the region of the carotid artery.

terms.name: Asymmetric blood pressure between arms
terms.definition: A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left arms.

terms.name: Transverse terminal lower limb defect
terms.definition: A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the leg, e.g. femur, foreleg, ankle or toe. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.

terms.name: Hemimelia of lower leg
terms.definition: A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the lower leg (eg tibia and fibula), ankle and foot.

terms.name: Hemimelia of forearm
terms.definition: A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the forearm (eg ulna and radius), wrist and hand.

terms.name: Sodium glucose transport inhibitor exposure
terms.definition: History of having been treateed with a sodium glucose transport inhibitors such as dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, canagliflozin, sglt-i, SGLT2, bexagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin, jardiance, invokana, forxiga, brenzavvy, steglatro, inpefa.

terms.name: Breath-holding spell
terms.definition: A benign paroxysmal nonepileptic disorder occurring in healthy children 6 to 48 months of age. The episodes start with a provocation such as emotional upset or minor injury, and might progress to breath holding, cyanosis, and syncope.

terms.name: Flared proximal tibial metaphysis
terms.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the proximal tibia.

terms.name: Delayed toe phalanx ossification
terms.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of any of the toe phalanges.

terms.name: Sorbitol ingestion
terms.definition: A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing sorbitol.

terms.name: Positive peritoneal fluid bacterial culture
terms.definition: Growth of bacteria in a culture dervied from ascites fluid.

terms.name: Ocular cystine crystal deposition
terms.definition: Accumulation of cystine crsytals in the eye. Patients present with crystal accumulation affecting the cornea and conjunctiva, but crystals can also be deposited in the iris, ciliary body, choroid and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), and lens capsule. Corneal crystal deposition starts in infancy in the anterior periphery of the cornea, and progresses centrally and posteriorly. The crystals, which have a fine, uniform needle-shaped structure, are diffusely distributed within the corneal tissues.

terms.name: Exuberant granulation tissue
terms.definition: A manifestation of abnormal wound healing in which there is formation of excessive granulation tissue, with the granulation tissue rising above the level of surrounding skin and creating a raised, reddish, moist, and bumpy surface.

terms.name: Oral mucosal papule
terms.definition: A small (less than 5 mm in diameter), elevated, circumscribed, solid, palpable mass located in thte mucosa of the oral cavity.

terms.name: Excessive piloerection
terms.definition: Abnormally increased degree of goose bump formation, that is, of involuntary formation of bumps on a person's skin at the base of body hairs.

terms.name: Scalp edema
terms.definition: A palpable swelling in the scalp caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid).

terms.name: Serpiginous burrow
terms.definition: A slightly raised and often reddish serpentine or curvilinear path in the skin.

terms.name: Positive brain-tissue rabies nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of rabies nucleic acid in brain tissue by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Positive respiratory tract Bordetella pertussis nucleic acid test
terms.definition: Detection of Bordetella pertussis PCR nucleic acid in in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

terms.name: Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli in wound tissue
terms.name_zh: 伤口组织抗酸杆菌检出
terms.definition: Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli by microscopic examination of wound tissue. Acid fastness is a physical property that gives a bacterium the ability to resist decolorization by acids during staining procedures.

terms.name: Positive tissue encapsulated budding yeast test
terms.definition: Identification of encapsulated budding yeasts in smears of body fluids, secretions, exudates, or other specimens.

terms.name: Positive tissue coccidioidomycosis culture
terms.definition: Growth of coccidioidomycosis in a culture derived from skin or an organ.

terms.name: Diminished tissue dihydropteridine reductase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织二氢蝶啶还原酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of dihydropteridine reductase (EC 1.6.99.7) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and erythrocytes.

terms.name: Decreased circulating transcobalamin-1 concentration
synonyms: Decreased circulating R vitamin B12 binder protein concentration
terms.definition: The concentration of transcobalamin-1 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Decreased circulating cationic trypsinogen concentration
terms.name_zh: 循环阳离子胰蛋白酶原浓度降低
synonyms: Decreased serine protease 1 level in blood
Reduced serine protease 1 level in blood
terms.definition: The concentration of cationic trypsinogen in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Diminished circulating hyaluronidase activity
terms.name_zh: 循环透明质酸酶活性降低
terms.definition: The activity or concentration of hyaluronidase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Diminished sulfotransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.name_zh: 培养成纤维细胞磺基转移酶活性降低
terms.definition: Rate of proteoglycan sulfation (sulfotransferase activity) is below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

terms.name: Elevated tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织α-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶活性升高
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) above the upper limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.

terms.name: Abnormal tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
terms.name_zh: 组织α-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶活性异常
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) outside of the limits of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.

terms.name: Elevated circulating trihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血三羟基胆甾烷酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated circulating glyoxylic acid concentration
terms.name_zh: 血循环乙醛酸浓度升高
terms.definition: The concentration of glyoxylic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated CSF sepiapterin concentration
terms.name_zh: 脑脊液墨蝶呤浓度升高
terms.definition: Concentration of sepiapterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Intrahepatic inclusion bodies
terms.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within hepatocytes.

terms.name: Muscle vacuoles
terms.definition: Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. The vacuoles are often associated with cytoplasmic and occasionally intranuclear eosinophilic inclusions.

terms.name: Nonrimmed muscle vacuoles
terms.definition: Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. On histological staining with hematoxylin and eosin, non-rimmed vacuoles lack the prominent dark border (rim) seen in rimmed vacuoles.

terms.name: Reduced hepatic glycogen phosphorylase activity
terms.definition: Activity or concentration of glycogen phosphorylase L in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

terms.name: Bone marrow hemophagocytosis
terms.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the bone marrow.

terms.name: Splenic granulomatosis
terms.definition: Splenic inflammation involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.

terms.name: Immediate detumescence of penis at time of symptom onset
terms.name_zh: 症状发作时阴茎立即疲软
terms.definition: Loss of erection at the time point of pain or other symptom onset.

terms.name: History of aortic valve replacement
terms.definition: History of having received a surgical replacement of the aortic valve.

terms.name: Coved type ST segment elevation
terms.definition: An ST-segment elevation of at least 2 mm in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by an r'-wave and a concave or straight ST segment. The descending ST segment crosses the isoelectric line and is followed by a negative and symmetric T-wave.

terms.name: Saddle-back type ST segment elevation
terms.definition: An ST-segment elevation of at least 0.5 mm (generally at least 2 mm in V2) in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by a convex ST. The r'-wave may or may not overlap the J point, but it has a slow downward slope. The ST segment is followed by a positive T-wave in V2 and is of variable morphology in V1.

terms.name: Substantially elevated circulating ethanol concentration
terms.definition: A blood concentration of ethanol that is consistent with alcohol intoxication, generally assumed to be 0.0800 g/dL or higher.

terms.name: Tortuous appearance of the stomach
terms.definition: Abnormal twisting or winding of the stomach.

terms.name: Cochlear nerve aplasia
terms.definition: A developmental defect causing an absence of the cochlear nerve resulting in sensorineural hearing loss.

terms.name: Slit-like lateral ventricle
terms.definition: Abnormally small lateral ventricle with a slit-like appearance.

terms.name: Fetal methamphetamine exposure
terms.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy (including during the period of conception) of the mother of a fetus or child to methamphetamine.

terms.name: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
terms.definition: Concentration of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿2,4-二羟基丁酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Pupillary hypersensitivity to parasympathomimetic agents
terms.definition: A higher than normal tendency of parasympathomimetic agents to induce miosis.

terms.name: Lack of pupillary response to hydroxyamphetamine
terms.name_zh: 瞳孔对羟苯丙胺无反应
terms.definition: 4-hydroxyamphetamine is used in eye drops to dilate the pupil, e.g.., to induce mydriasis for fundus examinations. This term refers to a lack of response of the pupil to topical application of 4-hydroxyamphetamine.

terms.name: Subcortical U fiber lesion
terms.definition: Abnormal morphology of subcortical U fibers, typically as assessed by abnromal intensity on magnetic resonance imaging of the brain.

terms.name: Intraspinal extradural lipoma
terms.definition: A lipoma (a benign encapsulated mass with lobulated mature adipose tissue enclosed by fibrous tissue) located within the spine but outside of the dura mater.

terms.name: Intranasal mass
terms.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the nasal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

terms.name: Liver rupture
terms.definition: Subcapsular hepatic rupture is characterized by the development of a hematoma, often quite large, beneath the liver capsule. An interval of days or hours may elapse between the time of injury and the first appearance of symptoms. A history of injury may be entirely lacking, or may be so unremarkable that it is elicited only by diligent interrogation. The hematoma tends to increase in size.

terms.name: Elevated urinary mandelic acid
terms.definition: The amount of mandelic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine malic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of malic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxysebacic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿3-羟基癸二酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxysebacic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary vanillactic acid level
terms.definition: The amount of vanillactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿4,5-二羟基己酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine hydroxyphenyllactic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿羟基苯乳酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of hydroxyphenyllactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Positive gastric CMV intranuclear inclusions
terms.definition: Demonstration of the presence of cytomegalovirus in the stomach by means of a method such as in-situ hybridization.

terms.name: Elevated urine dihydroxycholestanoic acid level
terms.name_zh: 尿二羟基胆甾烷酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of dihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urinary bile alcohol level
terms.definition: The amount of bile alcohol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Elevated urine glucose tetrasaccharide level
terms.name_zh: 尿葡萄糖四糖水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of glucose tetrasaccharide in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Increased urine 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate level
terms.name_zh: 尿4-羟基-2-氧代戊二酸水平升高
terms.definition: The amount of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

terms.name: Inability to protrude lips
terms.definition: Lack of ability to purse or pucker the lips.

terms.name: Wet voice
terms.definition: Wet voice is a perceptual vocal quality that is gurgly or liquid sounding and is due to the voice being produced through moisture. It is commonly used as an indicator of penetration and/or aspiration in clinical swallowing assessments and bedside screening tests.

terms.name: Erythema marginatum
terms.definition: An erythematous (pink-red, depending on the skin color of the affected individual) macule that spreads peripherally and coalesces to form polycyclic or serpentine patches or plaques. Lesions occur in crops over days to weeks and are evanescent. The rate of migration is 2 to 12 mm over a period of a few hours. Erythema marginatum tends to affect the trunk more than the extremities and to not be accompanied by pruritus.

terms.name: Mechanic's hands
terms.definition: Mechanic's hands are fissured, erythematous, hyperkeratotic eruptions on the hands, resembling the type of occupational dermatosis said to resemble the hands of a manual laborer. The lesions are classically on the lateral edges of the fingers and thumbs, largely sparing the palmar, and dorsal aspects of the digits.

terms.name: Hiker's feet
terms.definition: Hyperkeratotic scaly fissured plaques on the fingers/palms or soles, generally more evident on the lateral aspect of index fingers.

terms.name: Anti-HLA-DQ antibody positivity
terms.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen (HLA-DQ). DQ is one of several antigens involved in antibody-mediated rejection of organ transplants.

terms.name: Inappropriate normal or low erythropoietin
terms.name_zh: 促红细胞生成素正常或降低不当
terms.definition: Erythropoietin is produced and released into the blood by the kidneys in response to hypoxemia, and would normally be expected to increase with decreasing hemoglobin levels. This term applies if the increase fails to occur, as may be seen in conditions including chronic kidney disease.

terms.name: Rapid gastric emptying
terms.definition: A condition in which food moves through the stomach into the small intestine at an abnormally fast rate.

terms.name: Mediastinal lymph node calcification
terms.definition: Abnormal deposition of calcium in mediastinal lymph nodes.

terms.name: Eggshell calcification of lymph nodes
terms.definition: Eggshell calcification refers to fine calcification seen at the periphery of a mass and usually relates to lamellar lymph node calcification.

terms.name: Knee joint effusion
terms.definition: Abnormal accumulation of fluid within the knee joint or around the knee. Symptoms maye include, pain, swelling, and stiffness.

terms.name: Subcutaneous emphysema
terms.definition: Skin emphysema/Subcutaneous emphysema occurs when gas or air accumulates and seeps under the skin, where normally no gas should be present. While the presence of air in subcutaneous or mediastinal tissue is not dangerous in itself, prompt recognition of the underlying cause is essential.

terms.name: Elevated bone scintigraphy uptake
terms.definition: Bone scintigraph is performed with technetium 99m-labeled diphosphonates. The uptake of these radiopharmaceuticals depicts osteoblastic activity and regional blood flow to bone.

terms.name: Diminished long-chain-enoyl-CoA hydratase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.name_zh: 培养成纤维细胞长链烯酰辅酶A水合酶活性降低
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of long-chain-enoyl-CoA hydratase (EC 4.2.1.74) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.

terms.name: Diminished acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.name_zh: 培养成纤维细胞乙酰辅酶A C-酰基转移酶活性降低
synonyms: Reduced 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase activity in cultured fibroblasts
terms.definition: Concentration or activity of acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.16) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme catalyzes the reaction acetyl-CoA + an acyl-CoA = a 3-oxoacyl-CoA + CoA. It is also known as 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase and beta-ketothiolase.

terms.name: Pathological inclusion body
terms.definition: Pathological inclusion bodies are are composed of glycogen, proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, hemosiderin, and calcium, that accumulate as metabolic by-products, catabolic products of macromolecular complexes, or in the context of cell injury.

terms.name: Reduced epidermal collagen IV alpha 5 chain staining
terms.definition: Diminished or absent collagen alpha5(IV) chain staining pattern in the epidermal basement membrane.

terms.name: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 3 chain staining
terms.name_zh: 肾小球基底膜IV型胶原α3链染色减弱
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 3 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney.

terms.name: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 4 chain staining
terms.name_zh: 肾小球基底膜IV型胶原α4链染色减弱
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 4 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney.

terms.name: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 5 chain staining
terms.name_zh: 肾小球基底膜IV型胶原α5链染色减弱
terms.definition: Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 5 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney.

terms.name: Cystine nephrolithiasis
synonyms: Yellowish brown character to kidney stone suggestive of cystine
terms.definition: A cystine stone is a type of kidney stone that is yellowish brown with a granular surface. They are observed in individuals with Cystinuria and tend to be of early onset, to occur repeatedly, and to be associated with urinary tract infections.

terms.name: Hepatic cystine accumulation
terms.definition: Accumulation of cystine in the liver.

terms.name: Bone marrow cystine accumulation
terms.definition: The presence of cystine crystals in bone marrow cells as demonstrated in a fresh bone marrow aspiration sample.

terms.name: Desmoid tumor
terms.definition: Desmoid tumors are rare, locally aggressive, fibroblastic soft-tissue tumors that are characterized by infiltrative growth and tendency to recur.
